AI.method: 非穷尽式综述+观点性文章：以第28届ABCM国际机械工程大会圆桌讨论为基础，区分统计学习与人类认知，梳理AI能力、局限与新兴智能体形态；讨论工业采纳、劳动力变化、AI辅助科学发现，以及算力能耗与热管理问题；重点分析物理信息/混合学习、物理约束建模、验证、不确定性量化与认证；并探讨课程改革、人机协作、职业问责等教育、认识论与伦理议题。
AI.result: 形成面向机械工程共同体的结构化框架，明确AI在安全相关场景须融入物理知识、结构化推理与领域专长，并系统识别工业落地、人才培养、能源可持续性与认证合规等关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 提出机械工程负责任采用AI的六项原则——物理一致性、严格验证、明确处理不确定性、能源可持续性、人类监督与伦理责任；AI应补充而非替代工程判断。

title: Feature Scaling Beats Architecture Choice in Offline Respiratory Screening for Low-Resource Clinics
summary: Deep models are the usual choice for respiratory sound classification, but in clinics without GPUs or connectivity that choice carries a cost. We compare classical and deep classifiers on a five-class respiratory-sound corpus of 1,211 clips (asthma, COPD, pneumonia, Bronchial, healthy) from 201 patient groups, with a 3.86:1 class imbalance, using pre-registered patient-grouped cross-validation (25 runs per configuration). An SVM over 30 summary features (MFCC, ZCR and RMS statistics) reaches macro recall 0.78 and 0.71 recall on the rarest class. A 1.13M-parameter convolutional recurrent network over log-Mel spectrograms reaches 0.75 to 0.77, and no difference between model families is resolved. The largest single effect we measure is a preprocessing effect rather than an architectural one. Standardizing the SVM's features, a routine step for RBF kernels, moves its macro recall from 0.51 to 0.78, a 27-point swing wider than any gap between model families here. Augmentation did not help: SMOTE, waveform augmentation and SpecAugment have no measurable effect. Latency does not separate the models (51 to 74 ms per clip on a CPU-only laptop), but the classical models avoid a 449 MB PyTorch runtime. Clip-level splits, which let a patient's recordings fall on both sides, inflate macro recall by 7.5 to 9.8 points. Recording source is strongly tied to label (Cramer's V = 0.65 between native sampling rate and class), and in an exploratory analysis clips recorded at a class's minority rate are mostly assigned to classes typical of that rate; we state this confound as the paper's main limitation.

AI.tldr: 在1211条呼吸音片段上比较经典与深度分类器，发现特征标准化带来的27个点提升远大于模型家族间差异，且录音采样率构成严重混淆。
AI.motivation: 临床环境常缺少GPU和网络连接，需要判断深度模型是否真的优于经典模型；同时论文希望给出可复现、患者分组、预注册的公平比较。
AI.method: 五类呼吸音语料（哮喘、COPD、肺炎、Bronchial、健康），1211条片段、201个患者组、3.86:1类别不平衡；采用预注册的患者分组交叉验证，每配置25次运行。对比基于30个汇总特征（MFCC、ZCR、RMS统计）的SVM与基于log-Mel谱图的113万参数卷积循环网络，并测试SMOTE、波形增强、SpecAugment等增强手段。
AI.result: SVM宏召回0.78（最稀有类0.71），深度模型0.75–0.77，两者无显著差异。特征标准化使SVM宏召回从0.51升至0.78（27点），大于模型家族间任何差距；数据增强无可测效果。CPU延迟相近（51–74 ms/片段），但经典模型省去449 MB PyTorch运行时。片段级划分会虚高宏召回7.5–9.8点。
AI.conclusion: 在该任务上深度模型并不优于经典模型，最大收益来自预处理而非架构；同时原生采样率与类别强相关（Cramér's V=0.65），构成论文自述的主要局限。

title: The Paired Thermal Channel Is Two Orthogonal Axes: A Controlled Attribution Study of Calibration Cost and Detection Gain in Infrared Person Detection
summary: The calibrated thermal channel in infrared person detection comprises two structurally orthogonal axes. True calibrated $ΔT$ outperforms scale-matched grayscale pseudo-$ΔT$ by $+0.0221$ mAP (paired Wilcoxon $p=0.0098$, Cohen's $d=+1.08$), confirming that the calibrated channel carries information the grayscale channel lacks. The calibration axis is driven by the joint pairing-scale condition. Preserving both paired correspondence and absolute calibrated scale raises expected calibration error (ECE) from $\approx 0.05$ to $0.142$. The $2\times 2$ interaction ($p=0.0059$) localizes the rise to this condition. Breaking either factor alone returns ECE to the broken-factor level (true-vs-const $p=0.002$; true-vs-shuffled $p=0.002$). Under post-hoc temperature scaling, the pairing cost survives recalibration ($p=0.002$), while the scale cost is largely absorbed ($p=0.16$). As regards the detection axis, the gain stems from structural de-structuring. Phase randomization, which destroys spatial structure while preserving per-sample variance, yields $+0.0185$ mAP over true $ΔT$ on FLIR ADAS ($p=0.014$, $d=+0.96$). The FLAME~3 gain is $+0.0064$ mAP ($p=0.078$, n=8). On the calibration axis, the same intervention is insignificant on FLIR ADAS ($p=0.47$) but significant on FLAME~3 ($p=0.0078$). These findings rest on a five-arm controlled attribution with temperature-evidential learning (TEL) as the testbed. TEL obtains a single evidence-derived routing scalar together with a complementary diagnostic entropy, and establishes a finite-evidence degeneracy theorem proving that the acquisition product degenerates to this scalar with a closed-form bound. A physical $0.5^\circ$C threshold admits cross-dataset physical readings, whereas a gray threshold of $20$ inverts without physical interpretation.

AI.tldr: 校准热通道对红外行人检测有益，但机制具有"双重正交轴"：检测增益来自"去结构化"（相位随机化），校准误差上升由"配对×尺度"联合条件驱动；后处理温度缩放可吸收尺度代价但无法消除配对代价。
AI.motivation: 厘清红外行人检测中校准热通道（calibrated ΔT）究竟携带何种信息、以及检测性能与校准质量分别由哪些因素驱动，从而为通道设计与不确定性学习提供可归因的证据。
AI.method: 以温度-证据学习（TEL）为测试平台，构建五臂受控归因实验。TEL 产出单一证据导出路由标量及诊断熵，并给出有限证据退化定理（采集乘积退化为该标量，具闭式界）。对比真实 ΔT 与尺度匹配的灰度伪 ΔT；用 2×2 交互设计分离配对与尺度两个因素；用相位随机化破坏空间结构但保持逐样本方差；辅以配对 Wilcoxon 检验、Cohen's d、ECE 及后处理温度缩放。
AI.result: 真实 ΔT 比灰度伪 ΔT 高 +0.0221 mAP（p=0.0098, d=+1.08）。保留配对+绝对尺度使 ECE 从≈0.05 升至 0.142，2×2 交互显著（p=0.0059）；单独破坏任一因素即回落（均 p=0.002）。温度缩放后配对代价仍存（p=0.002），尺度代价基本被吸收（p=0.16）。相位随机化在 FLIR ADAS 上比真实 ΔT 高 +0.0185 mAP（p=0.014, d=+0.96），FLAME-3 为 +0.0064（p=0.078, n=8）；同一干预对校准误差在 FLIR 不显著（p=0.47）、在 FLAME-3 显著（p=0.0078）。物理 0.5°C 阈值可跨数据集读读，而灰度阈值 20 无物理意义且方向反转。
AI.conclusion: 检测增益源于结构去结构化（破坏空间结构反而更好），校准代价源于配对与绝对尺度的联合条件；两者是正交轴。校准通道确有灰度通道缺失的信息，但当前 TEL 并未真正利用空间结构。物理阈值的可解释性支持采用物理校准标度而非灰度阈值。

title: DRA-SAM: Disagreement-Driven Referential Active SAM for Low-Altitude Drone Referring Segmentation
summary: Referring segmentation in low-altitude drone imagery requires distinguishing small, visually similar instances under complex linguistic and spatial constraints. Global inference may yield multiple plausible masks or leave the intended referent insufficiently represented, motivating selective local re-inference. We propose DRA-SAM, a disagreement-driven framework that allocates an additional inference pass according to competing referential hypotheses and an unresolved state. A lightweight EvidenceScorer estimates beliefs over existing candidates and the unresolved state. A training-free Referential Disagreement LOOK policy balances belief-weighted candidate competition and unresolved-region coverage to select a crop for local re-inference. The same benchmark-adapted SAM3-I backbone processes the selected region, and the resulting evidence updates existing hypotheses and introduces new candidates. Among the compared methods, DRA-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on six of seven test metrics on both RIS-LAD and UAVid-RIS, including mIoU and P@0.5-P@0.9, and on all seven RIS-LAD validation metrics. On RIS-LAD, DRA-SAM improves the matched global SAM3-I baseline from 49.55 to 52.34 mIoU and from 46.80 to 58.05 P@0.5. On UAVid-RIS, the independently adapted DRA-SAM achieves 73.26 mIoU and 86.86 P@0.5. Controlled crop-policy comparisons demonstrate the effectiveness of disagreement-guided crop selection, while target-size analysis reveals particularly pronounced gains for aerial targets occupying less than 1% of an image. These results establish referential disagreement as an effective criterion for allocating local inference. Code is available at https://github.com/phy709/DRA-SAM.

AI.tldr: 提出 DRA-SAM：用"指称分歧"驱动局部再推理，提升低空无人机影像指称分割性能。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机影像中指称分割需区分小目标、视觉相似实例，受复杂语言与空间约束。全局一次性推理可能产生多个可信掩码或目标表征不足，因此需要选择性局部再推理。
AI.method: 轻量 EvidenceScorer 在已有候选与"未解决"状态上估计信念；训练-free 的 Referential Disagreement LOOK 策略结合信念加权候选竞争与未解决区域覆盖，选出裁剪区域；复用同一 benchmark 适配的 SAM3-I 骨干处理该区域，新证据用于更新已有假设并引入新候选。
AI.result: 在 RIS-LAD 与 UAVid-RIS 上七项指标中六项达 SOTA（含 mIoU、P@0.5–P@0.9），RIS-LAD 验证集全部七项最优。RIS-LAD mIoU 由 49.55 升至 52.34，P@0.5 由 46.80 升至 58.05；UAVid-RIS 达 73.26 mIoU、86.86 P@0.5。裁剪策略对比验证分歧引导裁剪的有效性，占图像面积<1% 的空中目标增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 指称分歧可作为分配局部推理的有效准则。

title: WebUniverse: Scaling Verified Training Data for Agentic Web Development
summary: Training agents for front-end web development requires demonstrations of code editing, execution, browser inspection and revision, yet public trajectories and reusable task environments remain limited. We introduce WebUniverse, a pipeline that constructs verifiable tasks with verified development trajectories from open-source repositories and real web pages. The tasks cover text-grounded application development in standalone and iterative settings and vision-grounded reproduction across pages and viewports. We collect agent trajectories for these tasks and verify the resulting applications against task-specific functional or visual requirements. We release WebUniverse-Env, containing 15K executable task environments, and WebUniverse-Mix, containing the corresponding 15K development trajectories with verification records and scores. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on WebUniverse-Mix raises the Vision2Web average score from 51.7 to 68.3, WebGen-Bench accuracy from 34.5% to 63.9%, and Web-Bench pass@2 from 12.2% to 23.1%. The resulting model also outperforms a public-data baseline trained with the same configuration and sample budget across all reported metrics. Ablations show complementary benefits from text and visual trajectories and continued gains as training data scales from 5K to 15K trajectories.

AI.tldr: WebUniverse 提出从开源仓库与真实网页构建可验证任务与已验证开发轨迹的流水线，并发布 15K 可执行环境与对应轨迹数据集，微调后显著提升前端 Web 开发智能体表现。
AI.motivation: 前端 Web 开发智能体训练需要代码编辑、执行、浏览器检查与修正的演示数据，但公开轨迹与可复用任务环境稀缺。
AI.method: 构建覆盖独立/迭代式文本驱动应用开发与跨页面、跨视口视觉复现的任务；采集智能体轨迹，并按任务特定的功能或视觉要求验证生成应用；发布 WebUniverse-Env（15K 环境）与 WebUniverse-Mix（15K 带验证记录和分数的轨迹）。
AI.result: 微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 后，Vision2Web 平均分 51.7→68.3，WebGen-Bench 准确率 34.5%→63.9%，Web-Bench pass@2 12.2%→23.1%；优于同配置同预算的公开数据基线。消融显示文本与视觉轨迹互补，数据从 5K 增至 15K 持续增益。
AI.conclusion: 可验证任务环境与经校验的轨迹能有效训练前端 Web 开发智能体，且文本与视觉数据互补、收益随数据规模扩展。

title: Optimal Connectivity of Random Boolean Networks for Reservoir Computing
summary: Reservoir computing shifts the focus from training a system's internal dynamics to designing dynamics that expose useful computational capabilities via linear projection. We study random Boolean networks as reservoirs: cellular automata with random recurrent wiring and a random rule at each node. Their main parameter is the connectivity, the mean number of edges into a node. Without input, these networks pass from ordered to chaotic dynamics at a connectivity of 2, where their dynamics are expected to facilitate computation. How the input is connected is itself a design factor: if the input shares the network's edges, the connectivity sets both the dynamics and how many nodes receive the input, the input fan-out. We set the input fan-out separately and compare 7,560 reservoir designs, all combinations of six design factors, each built as many random reservoirs, on recalling the majority or the parity of a few input bits seen several steps earlier. The optimal connectivity falls from 2.5 to 1.75-2 as more nodes receive the input, but hardly depends on the task or on the other design factors, except self-loops, which connect a node to itself and raise the optimal connectivity. A measure computed from the reservoir states without a trained readout peaks at a connectivity that also falls with the fan-out and rises with self-loops, but does not replace training a readout. Reservoirs of one design vary widely, so a design should be judged by its typical reservoir.

AI.tldr: 研究随机布尔网络作为储备池：输入扇出与自环等因素如何影响最优连接度，并比较7560种设计在回忆任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 储备池计算把重点从训练内部动力学转为设计能通过线性读出暴露计算能力的动力学；需弄清随机布尔网络作为储备池时，输入连接方式（尤其输入扇出）与连接度如何共同影响计算性能。
AI.method: 以随机布尔网络为储备池，将输入扇出与网络连接度解耦设置，构建六个设计因子的全部组合（7560种设计），每种设计生成多个随机储备池，测试对若干步前少数输入位的多数或奇偶性的回忆任务，并计算一个无需训练读出的状态度量作为对照。
AI.result: 最优连接度随更多节点接收输入而从2.5降至1.75–2，但几乎不依赖任务或其他设计因子；自环会提高最优连接度。无训练读出的状态度量峰值也随扇出下降、随自环上升，但不能替代训练读出。同一设计下不同随机储备池差异很大。
AI.conclusion: 储备池设计应以其典型（而非个别最优）储备池来评价；输入扇出与自环是调节最优连接度的关键因素，且状态度量只能作为辅助指标。

title: Bridging Search Intent and Tabular Data in Dataset Search
summary: Dataset search remains a bottleneck in data analysis workflows, as existing systems largely rely on keyword matching or shallow retrieval that fail to capture user intent. To facilitate intent-driven search, we present two retrieval components to equip multi-faceted dataset search interfaces through natural language. First, we propose Hypothetical Schema Embeddings (HySE) that uses a language model to generate task-aligned hypothetical table schemas which are used for embedding-based retrieval, bridging the gap between intent and table content. We introduce KaggleDS, a corpus comprising 6,503 tables and diverse task-queries derived from Kaggle, and show that HySE consistently improves recall over strong keyword and embedding-based baselines, as well as over a dense table retriever fine-tuned on KaggleDS. We also show that HySE generalizes to end-to-end question answering on, for example, the NQ-Tables dataset, a corpus of 169,898 Wikipedia tables with human-written queries, where HySE improves Recall@10 by +6.0 pp over dense retrieval baselines. Second, we introduce FlexPrune, which translates dataset constraints expressed in natural-language into SQL predicates over a customizable metadata index, enabling filtering across arbitrary metadata attributes. Combined with HySE, FlexPrune increases Recall@10 by +6.0 pp over dense retrieval followed by tag-based filtering. Our results show that natural-language-based retrieval supporting task and metadata queries offers a viable alternative to schema-level keyword search in dataset search.

AI.tldr: 提出HySE与FlexPrune两个检索组件，用自然语言实现任务意图与元数据约束的数据集搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集检索依赖关键词匹配或浅层检索，难以捕捉用户真实分析意图；需要支持任务意图与元数据条件等多面检索的自然语言接口。
AI.method: HySE用语言模型生成与任务对齐的"假设表模式"(hypothetical schema)，再用于嵌入检索以桥接意图与表内容；构建KaggleDS语料(6,503张表及任务查询)。FlexPrune将自然语言数据集约束翻译为可定制元数据索引上的SQL谓词，实现任意元数据属性过滤，并与HySE组合使用。
AI.result: HySE在KaggleDS上召回率稳定优于关键词/嵌入基线和在KaggleDS微调的稠密表检索器；在NQ-Tables(169,898张维基表)上Recall@10提升+6.0pp。HySE+FlexPrune相较稠密检索+标签过滤Recall@10提升+6.0pp。
AI.conclusion: 支持任务与元数据查询的自然语言检索可作为模式级关键词搜索的可行替代方案。

title: Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline setting where context is compressed once and then reused across many queries. We propose the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model (SSM) that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, producing a representation on which we condition a frozen target LLM. The SSM is trained by distillation, matching the next-token logit distribution from the LLM ingesting the full context (as teacher) to the same LLM ingesting the compressed representation (as the student). At equal compression ratios, Boa matches or surpasses the performance of existing state-of-the-art offline compression baselines, while being an order of magnitude faster than Transformer-based implementations, thereby reducing end-to-end latency rather than adding compression time overhead. We demonstrate that Boa also scales well to longer contexts and to compression ratios as aggressive as 16x. By enabling effective compression that is cheap enough to run on every query at inference time, Boa becomes a practical and general tool for efficient long-context inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 Boa Compressor，基于 Mamba SSM 的即插即用在线上下文压缩器，单次线性时间编码任意长度上下文，速度比 Transformer 基线快一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 长上下文使 Transformer LLM 计算与内存开销巨大，需先压缩上下文。现有软提示压缩方法沿用目标模型的 Transformer 骨干，压缩本身延迟高，只能离线（压缩一次、多查询复用），无法每次查询实时压缩。
AI.method: 用 Mamba 状态空间模型作为压缩器，一次线性时间遍历编码任意长度上下文，输出表示用于条件化冻结的目标 LLM；通过蒸馏训练，使学生（LLM 读压缩表示）的下一 token logit 分布匹配教师（LLM 读完整上下文）。
AI.result: 同等压缩率下性能匹配或超越现有最优离线压缩基线，速度比 Transformer 实现快约一个数量级，降低端到端延迟而非增加压缩开销；可扩展到更长上下文，压缩率高达 16x 仍有效。
AI.conclusion: Boa 使压缩足够廉价、可在每次查询时在线运行，成为长上下文高效推理的实用通用工具。

title: A Factor-6 Truthful-in-Expectation Mechanism for Cascade Position Auctions
summary: Position auctions require assigning advertisers to positions and determining their display order. Under cascade behavior, earlier clicks prevent users from reaching later placements, coupling the click probabilities of selected advertisements. Existing methods achieve constant-factor welfare approximation and monotone logarithmic-factor approximation separately, leaving open whether both guarantees can be attained simultaneously. The difficulty is that welfare-preserving rounding need not maintain the monotonicity of individual click-through rates required for truthful bidding. We resolve this problem by developing a polynomial-time randomized mechanism that achieves a factor-6 welfare approximation and truthfulness in expectation for arbitrary public advertiser-position click probabilities. The mechanism optimizes a reach-weighted linear relaxation and converts its solution into feasible ordered allocations through matching decomposition, probability-bounded grouping, and calibrated attenuation. This construction compensates for cascade dependence and ensures that each advertiser's expected click-through rate equals exactly one sixth of its fractional click coordinate. The resulting identity transfers the monotonicity of the fractional allocation to the implemented mechanism, enabling exact incentive-compatible payments while preserving the welfare guarantee. The allocation lottery and payments are computable in polynomial bit time, with exact sampling in expected polynomial time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多项式时间随机机制，在级联点击行为下同时实现6-因子福利近似和期望真实性，回答了福利近似与单调性/真实性能否兼得的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 位置拍卖中，级联行为使点击概率相互耦合，需同时分配广告位与排序。已有方法分别只能达到常数因子福利近似或对数因子单调近似，二者能否兼得是开放问题；核心障碍是保福利的取整方法未必保持个体CTR的单调性，而单调性是真实报价的必要条件。
AI.method: 设计多项式时间随机机制：先求解以触达加权的线性松弛，再通过匹配分解、概率有界分组与校准式衰减把分数解转化为可行的有序分配，从而补偿级联依赖，使每个广告商的期望CTR恰等于其分数点击坐标的1/6。
AI.result: 机制达到因子6的福利近似与期望真实性，适用于任意公开的广告商-位置点击概率；该恒等关系把分数分配的单调性转移到实现机制上，从而构造精确激励相容支付；分配彩票与支付可在多项式比特时间内计算，精确采样期望多项式时间。
AI.conclusion: 首次同时获得常数因子福利近似与真实性，解决了该开放问题；其关键技术是CTR恒等（比例1/6）将分数单调性传递到随机机制，为级联位置拍卖的机制设计提供了可计算的通用框架。

title: Conformance as a Distribution: Delegation Contracts, Error Budgets, and the Allocation of Evaluation Authority in Use-Based AI Regulation
summary: Use-based AI regulation assigns obligations by deployment risk but lacks an evidentiary object to carry them. A benchmark score is a property of a model; conformance of a deployment is a failure rate under a declared distribution of contexts, bounded by a scope and subject to expiry. We take the delegation contract of earlier work (frozen configuration, scoped claim, executable revision rule) and study it under strategic play between a deployer, an auditor, and an enforcement point. We ask whether a declared context mixture can be made truthful; whether an audit can be unbiased against a system that detects evaluation traffic; whether a certification error budget can sustain a long-lived deployment; whether an aggregate audit can support a per-subgroup guarantee; and whether an incident metric that counts system failures but not fallback costs ranks arrangements correctly. For each we give a mechanism and a proposition: a proper-scoring penalty on the declared mixture bounds the excess failure of a best-responding deployer by $O(λ^{-1/2})$ in the penalty weight; a commit-reveal audit drawn from live traffic is unbiased by construction and grades the evaluator with the same sample; a halving error budget drives certification coverage below $(1-p)^n$ while $α$-investing sustains it under a marginal false-certification guarantee; a per-subgroup guarantee costs audit size scaling as $1/m$ in subgroup mass; and any failure-only incident metric prefers withdrawal at every fallback cost, even when total loss ranks the arrangements oppositely. Five preregistered synthetic studies test each claim; no language model or production system is evaluated. Enforcement sits at distribution, capability-access, monetization and risk-transfer choke points, expiry of the conformance record is a standard of care, and conformance-as-a-rate is set against the EU AI Act's static conformity assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基于部署用途的合规即失效率"这一可承载义务的证据对象，并在部署方、审计方与执法点之间的策略博弈中，用五个机制—命题对回答真话混合比、无偏审计、错误预算可持续性、子群保证与事件指标排序问题。
AI.motivation: 基于用途的AI监管按部署风险分配义务，却缺少可承载义务的证据对象：基准分数只是模型属性，而部署合规性应是在声明情境分布下的失效率。作者欲填补这一证据缺口并检验其在策略性博弈下的稳健性。
AI.method: 沿用先前工作的委托契约（冻结配置、限定范围的声明、可执行的修订规则），建模部署方、审计方与执法点三方策略博弈；对五个问题各给出机制与命题，并用五项预注册的合成研究逐一检验。未评估任何语言模型或生产系统。
AI.result: (1) 对声明混合比施加适当评分惩罚，可将最优响应部署方的超额失效以O(λ^{-1/2})界定；(2) 从实时流量抽取的承诺—揭示审计在构造上无偏，并用同一样本给评估者评分；(3) 折半错误预算使认证覆盖率低于(1-p)^n，而α投资法在边际假认证保证下可维持；(4) 子群保证的审计规模按子群质量m以1/m缩放；(5) 任何仅计失效而不计回退成本的事件指标都会偏好撤下，即使总损失排序相反。
AI.conclusion: 执法应落在分布、能力获取、变现与风险转移等瓶颈点；合规记录的到期构成注意义务标准；"合规即失效率"与欧盟AI法案的静态符合性评估形成对照。

title: Inference-Time Prior Adaptation for Imbalanced Data Streams under Concept Drift
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, accepted to Streaming Continual Learning Workshop at ECMLPKDD 2026
summary: Data stream classification under concept drift and class imbalance requires models to adapt continuously while maintaining strong minority-class performance. Many existing approaches rely on active memory management, in- cluding instance removal, memory restructuring, resampling, and synthetic data generation. We present PAI-KNN, a k-nearest neighbor classifier that adapts via inference-time prior adjustment rather than memory modification. PAI-KNN main- tains a simple sliding-window buffer and dynamically adjusts its decision rule using class prior estimates derived from recent observations. Evaluated on a mul- titude of synthetic data streams covering various imbalance and drift scenarios, PAI-KNN achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods, per- forming particularly well under scenarios involving dynamic class imbalance and concept drift. These findings highlight the potential of inference-time adaptation in challenging non-stationary environments and suggest that adaptation in memory- based stream classifiers need not rely exclusively on memory modification.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAI-KNN，一种在推理阶段通过先验调整而非修改记忆来适应概念漂移与类别不平衡的 kNN 数据流分类器，仅用简单滑动窗口缓冲即可取得与 SOTA 相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据流分类方法多依赖主动内存管理（实例删除、内存重构、重采样、合成数据生成）来应对概念漂移与类别不平衡，机制复杂。作者希望验证：基于记忆的分类器的适应性是否必须依赖记忆修改。
AI.method: PAI-KNN 维护一个简单的滑动窗口缓冲区，不做实例删除、重采样或合成数据；在推理阶段利用近期观测估计类别先验，并据此动态调整决策规则（先验调整），从而在无需改动记忆内容的情况下适应漂移与不平衡。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种不平衡与漂移场景的大量合成数据流上评测，PAI-KNN 性能与现有 SOTA 方法具有竞争力，尤其在动态类别不平衡与概念漂移场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明推理时自适应在非平稳环境中的潜力，说明基于记忆的数据流分类器的适应性不必完全依赖记忆修改，为简化流式分类系统设计提供了新思路。

title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
summary: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis. Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual. We introduce AV-FABLE, a dual-timeline benchmark for sparse manipulations in open-scene long-form audio-visual videos. AV-FABLE contains 16,650 pristine--manipulated twin pairs (998 hours) created with 27 editing configurations, with separate audio and visual timelines that enable modality-specific temporal localization and expose errors hidden by joint-timeline evaluation. On AV-FABLE, zero-shot prompting of audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) yields near-chance detection and poor temporal localization. In contrast, supervised readouts of their frozen perception features recover strong forensic signals, suggesting manipulation evidence is encoded in these representations but not effectively exposed through language outputs. Motivated by this observation, we propose NFSR(Native Forensics via Separated Readouts), which reads frozen AV-LLM features with separate audio and visual temporal decoders. NFSR achieves the best audio-visual localization performance in-domain and across all three out-of-distribution settings, including transfer to held-out videos from an external long-video forensic benchmark. AV-FABLE, code, and model weights will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AV-FABLE 双时间线基准（16,650 对原始-篡改长视频、998 小时），用于开放场景长视频中稀疏音视频篡改的时间定位，并提出 NFSR 方法，用冻结 AV-LLM 特征配合独立音视频解码器实现最佳定位性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频中的局部 AI 篡改往往只影响短暂事件，视频级分类不足以支撑取证；现有音视频深伪基准多为短视频说话人头，长视频时序取证又多局限于视觉模态，缺乏模态分离的时序评测。
AI.method: 构建 AV-FABLE 基准：16,650 对孪生样本、27 种编辑配置，音视频各设独立时间线以支持模态特定定位。观察到 AV-LLM 零样本提示近乎随机，但其冻结感知特征的监督读出可恢复强取证信号；据此提出 NFSR，用分离的音频与视觉时序解码器读取冻结 AV-LLM 特征。
AI.result: NFSR 在同域及全部三种分布外设置下取得最佳音视频定位性能，并可迁移至外部长视频取证基准的未见过视频；零样本 AV-LLM 检测接近随机且定位差。
AI.conclusion: AV-LLM 表征中已编码篡改证据但未通过语言输出暴露，分离读出的监督方案更有效；AV-FABLE、代码与模型权重将公开。

title: KDHNet: A Knowledge-Driven Hybrid Network for Limited-Calibration SSVEP Decoding
summary: Steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) achieve high information transfer rates but often require sufficient subject-specific calibration data for reliable decoding. Analytical spatial filters are effective with limited data, but their linear formulations constrain representation capacity. Deep models learn more flexible representations but are prone to overfitting when calibration data are scarce. We propose KDHNet, which combines knowledge-driven analytical processing with data-driven representation learning. After filter-bank preprocessing, cascaded task-discriminant component analysis (TDCA) and task-related component analysis (TRCA) extract discriminative and trial-reproducible components. Learnable sub-band weighting then fuses spectral information, and an SSVEPformer decoder learns temporal and spectral representations for classification. For inter-subject decoding, a target-guided least-squares transformation aligns source trials using one labeled target trial per class. Extensive experiments were performed on three public datasets, covering intra- and inter-subject protocols, five analysis windows, and multiple calibration ratios. In intra-subject evaluation, KDHNet achieved the highest mean accuracy and information transfer rate in 14 of 15 window settings and all ten calibration-ratio settings. In inter-subject evaluation, KDHNet obtained the best or second-best performance, and the gains were generally larger with less calibration data. Ablation studies indicated that the estimated TDCA projection performed better when fixed than when optimized from analytical or random initialization. Combining fixed knowledge priors with trainable neural modules is effective for low-calibration SSVEP decoding. This framework supports more practical, robust, and plug-and-play BCIs. Code is available at https://github.com/2665023991/KDHNet.

AI.tldr: KDHNet将知识驱动解析空间滤波(TDCA/TRCA固定投影)与数据驱动SSVEPformer解码相结合，在低校准条件下显著提升SSVEP-BCI性能。
AI.motivation: SSVEP-BCI虽信息传输率高，但可靠解码需充足被试专属校准数据；解析空间滤波器在小数据下有效但线性表达受限，深度模型表达灵活却易过拟合。
AI.method: 滤波组预处理后，级联TDCA与TRCA提取判别性与试次可重复成分；引入可学习子带加权融合频谱信息；用SSVEPformer解码器学习时空谱表征。跨被试时采用目标引导最小二乘变换，每类仅需一个带标签目标试次对齐源域。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上，被试内15个窗口设置中14个、10个校准比例设置中全部取得最高平均准确率与ITR；被试间取得最优或次优，且校准数据越少增益越大。消融显示TDCA投影固定比优化或随机初始化更好。
AI.conclusion: 固定知识先验结合可训练神经模块对低校准SSVEP解码有效，支持更实用、鲁棒、即插即用的BCI。

title: Cross-Platform Application Migration to HarmonyOS: An Agentic Pipeline with Artifact-Derived Verification
summary: The migration of applications written for a different platforms like Android or iOS to HarmonyOS NEXT requires a complete rewrite in ArkTS. Although LLMs automate the translation of source constructs into ArkTS, syntactic compilation is not enough and functional assurance is a critical open challenge in HarmonyOS NEXT migration. We present HMOS~Migrator, an agentic pipeline that reads an application's source code, generates an ArkTS project, and validates the result by replaying recorded interactions on a real device. We cast the scoring problem as quality estimation without a reference implementation; we score a migration using only the source application's recorded behaviour and the artifacts produced by the pipeline. We define seven weighted metrics, each constructed so that reduced measurement cannot artificially raise the score. Over twelve runs across six open-source applications, the pipeline's structural reproduction is high (completeness \pct{83.3}--\pct{100.0}), while on-device behaviour (\pct{4.3}--\pct{63.1}) and UI fidelity (\pct{21.1}--\pct{63.2}) remain the primary limits. Scores improve steadily over time: $+0.45$~points per day overall ($R^2=0.44$, $p=0.019$) and $+0.47$ over the model-free subset ($R^2=0.39$, $p=0.029$), with corresponding to fit angles of $+8.4^{\circ}$ and $+11.7^{\circ}$ respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出HMOS-Migrator智能体流水线，将Android/iOS应用源代码迁移为HarmonyOS NEXT的ArkTS项目，并在真机上通过回放录制交互验证迁移质量；将评分建模为无参考实现的质量估计，定义七项加权指标，实验显示结构复现高但设备行为和UI保真度仍为主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 应用迁移到HarmonyOS NEXT需用ArkTS完全重写，LLM虽能自动化翻译源码构造，但仅靠语法编译不足以保证功能正确性，功能验证是鸿蒙迁移中的关键开放挑战。
AI.method: HMOS-Migrator：读取应用源码并生成ArkTS工程的智能体流水线，在真机上回放录制的交互来验证结果；将打分问题转化为无参考实现的质量估计，仅用源应用录制行为和流水线产物评分，定义七个加权指标，并保证测量减少不会人为抬高分数。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线在结构层面迁移效果良好，但功能行为和UI保真度仍是鸿蒙迁移瓶颈；无参考的质量估计框架能有效评估迁移质量，且系统表现随时间持续改进。

title: A Dynamic Decomposition Strategy for the MOEA/D With Proven Performance Guarantees
summary: The MOEA/D is one of the most successful multi-objective evolutionary algorithms. It operates by decomposing the optimization problem into single-objective subproblems, which are then solved in a co-evolutionary manner. The performance of the MOEA/D depends critically on this decomposition. In this work, we propose a novel way to adjust this decomposition on the fly, for the case of discrete bi-objective optimization. Different from all previous works in this direction, we support our new algorithm with a proven performance guarantee. This is the first work that rigorously proves the runtime of a dynamic multi-objective evolutionary algorithm. For monotonic distortions of the simple LOTZ benchmark, it is known that classic decompositions leave large holes in the Pareto front, making it very hard for the MOEA/D to cover the entire Pareto front. In contrast, we prove that our self-adjusting MOEA/D solves all these LOTZ problems in an expected number of $O(n^4)$ function evaluations. This relatively low runtime as well as the details of our mathematical proof show that the dynamic decomposition strategy indeed evolves a decomposition adjusted to each of these problem instances.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种在离散双目标优化中动态调整分解策略的自适应MOEA/D，并首次为动态多目标进化算法给出严格的运行时（期望O(n^4)次函数评估）理论保证。
AI.motivation: MOEA/D性能严重依赖问题分解方式，而经典分解在LOTZ基准的单调变形上会在Pareto前沿留下大“空洞”，难以覆盖整个前沿。此前关于调整分解的工作都缺乏理论性能保证。
AI.method: 针对离散双目标优化，设计一种在运行过程中“即时”调整分解（权重向量）的机制，构建自调整MOEA/D算法，并通过数学证明分析其期望运行时。
AI.result: 证明自调整MOEA/D在所有LOTZ单调变形问题上均能在期望O(n^4)次函数评估内求解；该较低运行时间及证明细节表明动态分解策略确实能演化为适配每个具体问题实例的分解。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个严格证明动态多目标进化算法运行时间的工作，验证了动态分解策略在离散双目标LOTZ类问题上的高效性与理论可行性。

title: Decision-Native Recommendation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) bring world knowledge to user preference modeling in sequential recommendation, but generation-based recommenders express next-item predictions indirectly as text. Generated outputs may fail to identify a unique candidate item, depend on candidate presentation order in the prompt, and lack explicit confidence in the recommendation. Recent studies explore Jev, a model for fast option selection with explicit confidence. Inspired by Jev, we introduce decision-native recommendation, a new paradigm that jointly models item choice and recommendation confidence using LLM representations. It requires valid candidate selection, consistency under candidate reordering, and confidence that reflects recommendation accuracy. We propose Direct Item Choice Estimation (DICE), which learns a personalized next-item distribution over supplied candidates from user interaction history and recommends the highest-scoring item with calibrated confidence. Tree-structured attention shares history computation across isolated candidate branches for order-consistent candidate scoring in a single forward pass. On three recommendation datasets, DICE achieves higher top-one accuracy than all evaluated baselines. Separate evaluations show unchanged item choices under tested candidate reorderings and end-to-end speedups of up to approximately $6\times$ over the evaluated generation-based methods. Its confidence estimates support selective recommendation by identifying more reliable predictions and guide additional computation for low-confidence examples in offline routing.

AI.tldr: 提出决策原生推荐范式与DICE方法，用LLM表示联合建模候选物品选择与置信度，实现高准确率、顺序一致且高效（约6倍加速）的推荐。
AI.motivation: 基于生成的LLM推荐器以文本间接表达下一物品预测，存在三问题：生成输出可能无法唯一确定候选物品、依赖prompt中候选呈现顺序、缺乏显式推荐置信度。
AI.method: 受Jev（快速选项选择+显式置信度）启发，提出decision-native推荐范式，要求有效候选选择、候选重排下一致性、置信度反映准确率。具体方法DICE从用户交互历史学习给定候选集上的个性化下一物品分布，输出最高分物品及校准置信度；采用树结构注意力在单次前向传播中共享历史计算、隔离候选分支，实现顺序一致的候选打分。
AI.result: 在三个推荐数据集上top-1准确率高于所有对比基线；候选重排测试中物品选择不变；相较评估的生成式方法端到端加速最高约6倍；置信度可支持选择性推荐（识别更可靠预测）并在离线路由中引导对低置信样本的额外计算。
AI.conclusion: DICE验证了决策原生推荐范式的可行性与优势，兼顾准确性、顺序鲁棒性、效率与可用的置信度，为LLM推荐提供新方向。

title: Knowledge-Guided LLM for Intent-Driven Service Orchestration in Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial 6G Networks
summary: Natural-language service intents in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial (TN/NTN) 6G networks can be incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent, making unconstrained LLM generation challenging for reliable network-facing orchestration. This paper proposes a knowledge-guided LLM framework that combines grammar-constrained semantic parsing with a knowledge-graph (KG)-driven clarification loop to produce validated, orchestration-ready service profiles across four representative service classes. On a 200-sample intent dataset, the framework achieves 89% classification accuracy and 95% policy validity with an average of 0.66 clarification turns per request. Compared with a Pure-LLM baseline, the proposed framework improves policy validity and contradiction detection while requiring fewer clarification turns, demonstrating the value of explicit knowledge-guided reasoning for robust intent processing in integrated TN/NTN 6G orchestration.

AI.tldr: 提出知识引导的LLM框架，结合语法约束语义解析与知识图谱驱动的澄清循环，将不完整/歧义/不一致的自然语言服务意图转化为可编排的服务profile，在TN/NTN 6G场景下实现89%分类准确率与95%策略有效性。
AI.motivation: 天地一体化（TN/NTN）6G网络中，自然语言服务意图常不完整、歧义或不一致，无约束LLM生成难以保证面向网络编排的可靠性，亟需显式的知识引导来约束和澄清意图。
AI.method: 构建知识引导的LLM框架：一方面用语法约束的语义解析限制生成，另一方面引入知识图谱（KG）驱动的澄清循环，针对四类代表性服务，将意图加工为经过验证、可直接编排的服务profile。
AI.result: 在200条意图数据集上，分类准确率89%、策略有效性95%，平均每个请求仅0.66轮澄清；相比纯LLM基线，策略有效性与矛盾检测均有提升，且所需澄清轮数更少。
AI.conclusion: 显式知识引导推理能有效提升TN/NTN 6G编排中意图处理的鲁棒性，验证了语法约束解析加KG澄清循环的实用价值。

title: Strategic Calibration in LLM Multi-Agent Systems: Audited Pivot Scoring for Truthful Elicitation
summary: In large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, reported confidence increasingly determines the allocation of scarce downstream attention, computation, and decision influence. This makes reporting strategic: an agent may overstate the relevance of its contribution even when its underlying belief is well calibrated. Existing calibration methods largely assume passive reporting and therefore do not address strategic incentives created when confidence determines downstream allocation. We formulate strategic calibration as a reporting-layer incentive problem and propose the Audited Pivot Scoring Mechanism (APSM). APSM offsets platform-controlled allocation benefits, uses inverse-propensity-weighted sparse audits, charges the Clarke pivot externality, and applies a strictly proper score. Under the stated model assumptions, truthful reporting is the unique expected-utility best response. We also characterize approximate execution and the audit-variance trade-off. Calculator-free experiments show that LLM agents inflate confidence under Top-$K$ incentives. With a shared agent-local utility interface, LLM agents reduce distortion under both Compensated Proper Scoring (CPS) and APSM. CPS achieves higher exact allocation match, whereas APSM yields lower Brier loss and numerically fewer cutoff crossings. Experiments further show that APSM enlarges the utility margin against allocation-changing deviations by $1.93\times$ and improves robustness under approximate execution. These results support incentive-aware elicitation as a distinct layer for reliable multi-agent coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文把"置信度报告"视为策略性行为，提出审计式枢轴评分机制APSM，在模型假设下使真实报告成为唯一最优响应。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统中置信度决定下游注意力、算力与决策权分配，导致智能体有动机夸大自身贡献的相关性；现有校准方法假设被动报告，无法处理这种分配激励带来的策略性失真。
AI.method: 将策略性校准建模为报告层激励问题，提出APSM：抵消平台控制的分配收益、采用逆倾向加权稀疏审计、收取Clarke枢轴外部性、并施加严格适当评分（proper score）。同时分析近似执行与审计方差权衡。
AI.result: 无计算器实验中，LLM智能体在Top-K激励下会夸大置信度；共享本地效用接口下，CPS与APSM均降低失真。CPS分配匹配更精确，APSM的Brier损失更低、跨界更少；APSM将对抗改变分配偏离的效用裕度扩大1.93倍，近似执行下更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 激励感知的置信度引出应作为多智能体可靠协调的独立层次；APSM在理论保证与实证稳健性上均有支持。

title: Optimal Correction Sets for Provable Redress of Contestable Causal Discovery
summary: Constraint-based causal discovery relies on conditional-independence (CI) tests that may conflict in finite samples, leaving no causal graph that satisfies them all. Causal Assumption-based Argumentation (ABA) makes these tests explicit as defeasible commitments, and offers correspondence guarantees with a subset of them, but its existing repair procedure releases facts heuristically and offers no formal response to a user's contestation of a release. We argue that contestable causal discovery requires an inspectable repair object, a justification for it, and a predictable revision procedure for such contestations. We therefore formulate CI-fact repair as a minimum-cost correction problem and implement it in Answer Set Programming (ASP). Building on Causal ABA, we provide a compact and efficient ASP encoding of causal consistency, with soundness and completeness guarantees, and a two-way projection correspondence between optimal stable models and minimum-cost correction sets. These results establish fidelity to retained facts, subset-minimality and cost optimality of the repair, conflict-based justifications for released facts, and formally guaranteed redress under user contestations. An empirical evaluation supports the formal account: OptABA-PC retains more correct facts, reduces ambiguity in the compatible outputs, and improves graph reconstruction over Causal ABA on common benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 将因果ABA中的CI事实修复表述为最小代价修正问题，用ASP实现（OptABA-PC），在保持与Causal ABA一致性的同时提供可检验的修复对象、冲突驱动的释放理由和用户质疑下的形式化保障，并在基准上优于Causal ABA。
AI.motivation: 基于约束的因果发现依赖条件独立（CI）检验，但有限样本下检验可能相互冲突，不存在满足全部检验的因果图。Causal ABA虽将检验显式化为可废止承诺，但其修复过程只是启发式地释放事实，既没有对用户质疑释放的正式回应机制，也缺乏可检验的修复对象。
AI.method: 提出可争议因果发现需要三要素：可检验的修复对象、其正当性说明、以及对质疑的可预测修订程序。将CI事实修复形式化为最小代价修正问题，并在Answer Set Programming（ASP）中实现。基于Causal ABA给出因果一致性的紧凑高效ASP编码，证明其可靠性与完备性，并建立最优稳定模型与最小代价修正集之间的双向投影对应关系。
AI.result: 理论上保证了对保留事实的忠实性、修复的子集最小性与代价最优性、对释放事实的冲突驱动理由，以及用户质疑下的形式化纠正保障。实证上，OptABA-PC在常见基准上比Causal ABA保留更多正确事实、减少兼容输出中的歧义，并改善图重建效果。
AI.conclusion: OptABA-PC为可争议的因果发现提供了形式化可检验的修复框架，兼具理论保证与实证优势，是对Causal ABA修复启发式的原则性改进。

title: Physics Informed Neural Networks for Solving the Drift-Diffusion Equations
summary: The drift-diffusion equations are the fundamental building block for the modeling, design, and optimization of modern semiconductor devices. Solutions of the drift-diffusion equations rarely give way to analytical forms, and exhibit strong nonlinearity, with the solutions ranging over several orders of magnitude. These attributes have led to research into numerical solvers, and while many commercial Technology Computer Aided Design (TCAD) packages now exist, they may require long simulation times, exhibit sensitivity to initial guesses, and rely on mesh generation. Further, these solvers are not well suited for inverse problems where the design parameters of a device are retrieved from its desired functional characteristics. To address all these challenges, this work demonstrates the usage of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for the solution of the drift-diffusion equations with errors comparable to traditional simulation software using advanced training techniques to solve problems beyond the well-behaved equilibrium regime. For this study, we specifically choose an abrupt PN-junction in both one and two dimensions that features extreme gradients of the carrier concentrations at the Ohmic contacts and an abrupt discontinuity in the doping profile. Using the proposed PINN architecture, we are able to retrieve accurate results for all observables under all bias conditions. Additionally, we apply the PINN solver towards the inverse problem of retrieving doping profiles directly from desired electric field distributions or electrostatic potentials under non-zero applied biases. Our work establishes a powerful PINNs-based approach for semiconductor device modeling with the ability to solve inverse problems under non-equilibrium conditions for microelectronics research and discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文展示用物理信息神经网络(PINN)求解半导体漂移-扩散方程，在非平衡偏置下实现与传统TCAD软件相当的精度，并能求解从期望电场/电势反推掺杂分布的逆问题。
AI.motivation: 漂移-扩散方程解析解稀少、非线性强、数值跨多个数量级；现有商业TCAD求解器仿真时间长、对初值敏感、依赖网格生成，且不适合从期望功能特性反推器件设计参数的逆问题。
AI.method: 采用结合先进训练技术的PINN架构求解漂移-扩散方程，选取一维和二维突变PN结作为测试对象（欧姆接触处载流子浓度梯度极端、掺杂分布存在突变不连续），突破良态的平衡态区域；并将PINN用于非零偏置下由期望电场分布或静电势反演掺杂分布的逆问题。
AI.result: 在所有偏置条件下、针对所有可观测量均获得准确结果，误差与传统仿真软件相当；成功从期望电场或电势分布反演掺杂剖面。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一种基于PINN的半导体器件建模方法，可在非平衡条件下求解正问题与逆问题，适用于微电子研究与新器件发现。

title: Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime
summary: Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them. On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measured cases the composed error stays below the sum of the two individual errors. The resulting method, FreezePlan, keeps five full steps and gives the rest of the budget to TaylorSeer. On a pre-registered test split it runs 5.05$\times$ faster end to end at 29.8 dB PSNR to the original output, with no significant drop in a VLM judge score; TaylorSeer at 5.02$\times$ reaches 23.5 dB. The curve extends to 5.99$\times$ at 28.0 dB. Swapping in the region selectors of prior methods under our schedule lowers median PSNR by only 0.5--0.6 dB, which places the gain in the schedule and budget split rather than in the selector.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于扩散变换器的指令式图像编辑器如何在高倍加速目标下，在步缓存（step caching）与区域冻结（region freezing）之间分配加速预算；提出FreezePlan：保留5个完整步、其余预算交给TaylorSeer，预注册测试集上端到端加速5.05倍且PSNR 29.8 dB。
AI.motivation: 训练无关加速通常分为跨步特征复用（步缓存）与冻结编辑未触及区域（区域冻结）两类，且二者此前已被结合，但"高加速目标应如何在二者间切分"这一问题未被研究。
AI.method: 在Qwen-Image-2.1上建立每步开销模型（中位误差4.0%）；分析发现区域冻结降低每步成本，使步缓存可用更保守阈值达到同等总加速并保持小误差；将冻结token直接替换为模型单步x0估计（优于回填参考图像）；据此提出FreezePlan——5个完整步，其余预算给TaylorSeer，并替换不同区域选择器做消融。
AI.result: 预注册测试集：端到端5.05倍加速、相对原输出29.8 dB PSNR，VLM评判分数无显著下降；同等加速下TaylorSeer仅23.5 dB；曲线可延伸至5.99倍/28.0 dB；组合误差在90%实测案例中低于两独立误差之和；换用先前方法的区域选择器仅使PSNR中位数下降0.5–0.6 dB。
AI.conclusion: 增益主要来自调度与预算切分而非区域选择器本身；区域冻结通过降低每步成本为缓存换取更保守阈值，是实现高倍加速的关键杠杆。

title: MOSAIC: Towards a Universal Latent Space for Computational Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) differ substantially in architecture, pretraining objective, training data and representation dimensionality, yet it remains unclear whether they learn fundamentally different feature spaces or alternative coordinate systems of a shared underlying representation. We present MOSAIC, a systematic study of latent-space similarity, alignment and interoperability across $12$ patch-level and $6$ slide-level PFMs. We first quantify representational agreement using complementary similarity measures and analyze how architecture, pretraining objective, network depth and magnification influence latent geometry. We then evaluate multiple alignment strategies for mapping independently learned representations into a common latent space. The resulting representations are evaluated through cross-model agreement, retrieval, geometry preservation, and downstream multiple-instance learning across molecular and morphological prediction tasks. MOSAIC provides a unified framework for studying whether heterogeneous PFMs can move beyond representational similarity toward a shared and functionally transferable pathology representation space. Our code, benchmarks and additional results are available at https://researchsubmissions66.github.io/MOSAIC/.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC系统研究了12个patch级和6个slide级病理基础模型（PFM）潜空间的相似性、对齐与互操作性，探讨异构PFM是否学习到可共享、可迁移的统一表征空间。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型在架构、预训练目标、训练数据和表征维度上差异巨大，尚不清楚它们是学习了根本不同的特征空间，还是同一潜在表征的不同坐标系统。
AI.method: 1）用互补相似度量量化表征一致性，分析架构、预训练目标、网络深度和放大倍数对潜几何的影响；2）评估多种对齐策略将独立学习的表征映射到公共潜空间；3）通过跨模型一致性、检索、几何保持及分子与形态预测任务的下游多实例学习进行评价。
AI.result: 构建了跨12个patch级与6个slide级PFM的统一研究框架，系统比较了表征相似性与对齐效果，并从跨模型一致性、检索、几何保持和下游MIL性能多维度评估映射后表征。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC提供了统一框架，用于研究异构PFM能否从表征相似性迈向共享且功能可迁移的病理表征空间，代码与基准已公开。

title: Operationalizing Governed Agentic Workflows in Regulated Finance: A Customer Zero Case Study using Zafin AIOS
summary: Regulated industries such as finance and healthcare face critical governance challenges that hamper the adoption of AI-assisted software development and hinder the transition from experimental pilots to production work. This paper presents Zafin AIOS, an end-to-end orchestration platform and control plane designed to deploy AI within regulated industries such as finance. We provide the architectural principles and an empirical comparison between AI-assisted and human-led workloads. To validate this framework empirically, we conduct a case study analysis of Zafin's internal enterprise workflows, which we refer to as Customer Zero. This paper contributes a production case study of AI-assisted software engineering in regulated industries. We evaluate the results of using Zafin AIOS with two different production codebases, one for the pricing execution platform and the other for the client deal negotiation platform. Our contribution is a customer case study for regulated industries with production codebases and governance, which includes proof of work. The results demonstrate that strictly governed agentic orchestration increases enterprise capacity without compromising control. In the pricing execution platform workflows, the platform provided complete observability and reduced effort by 38\%. In the client deal negotiation platform, it reduced reporting work by 76\% while maintaining all predefined data privacy, role-based access, and audit guardrails. This paper bridges the gap between AI-assisted software engineering theory and the operational reality of compliance. Closing this gap is important to help enterprises take advantage of AI technologies. These results are descriptive of the benefits of using governed workflows in regulated industries.

AI.tldr: 提出 Zafin AIOS 端到端编排平台与控制平面，在受监管行业以内部企业工作流（Customer Zero）为例，验证受严格治理的智能体编排可提升产能而不牺牲管控：定价执行平台减负38%，客户交易谈判平台报告工作减少76%。
AI.motivation: 金融、医疗等受监管行业面临治理难题，阻碍了 AI 辅助软件开发的采用，也使其难以从试验性试点走向生产落地，AI 辅助软件工程理论与合规运营现实之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 Zafin AIOS 架构原则与端到端编排平台/控制平面；采用案例研究法（Customer Zero），将 AI 辅助与人工主导的工作负载做实证对比，并在两个生产代码库（定价执行平台、客户交易谈判平台）上评估。
AI.result: 定价执行平台工作流获得完整可观测性并减少38%工作量；客户交易谈判平台报告工作量减少76%，同时保持预设的数据隐私、基于角色的访问与审计护栏。结果表明受治理的智能体编排可提升企业产能而不牺牲控制。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献了一个含生产代码库与治理（含工作量证明）的受监管行业客户案例，弥合了 AI 辅助软件工程理论与合规运营实践的差距；结果为治理型工作流在受监管行业中的收益提供了描述性证据。

title: Understanding the Co-evolutionary Solution Exchange of the MOEA/D: Already the Smallest Communication Radius Gives the Best-Possible Speed-Up
summary: Besides domination-based algorithms such as the NSGA-II, the decomposition-based MOEA/D is one of the most popular and successful optimization heuristic for multi-objective problems. It decomposes the problem into several, single-objective subproblems. By solving these in a co-evolutionary manner and archiving non-dominated solutions, it approximates or computes the Pareto front. Interestingly, so far no advantages from the co-evolutionary communication of subproblem solutions were proven. In this first mathematical runtime analysis addressing this research question, we investigate how the mutation-based MOEA/D solves the classic OneMinMax benchmark when solutions are exchanged among subproblems in different distances $r$. We show, for the first time, that the MOEA/D profits from an exchange of solutions, and that already very small communication radii $r$ are sufficient to maximally profit from this feature of the algorithm. More precisely, for all values $r \ge 1$ we prove a tight runtime guarantee of $Θ(n^2)$, where $n$ is the problem size. This is asymptotically faster than the known bound of $O(n^2 \log n)$ guarantee for $r=0$, which we complement with a matching bound of $Ω(n^2 \log n)$.

AI.tldr: 首次用数学运行时分析证明MOEA/D中子问题间解交换（通信半径r≥1）能带来实际优势：在OneMinMax上达成紧确的Θ(n²)运行时，优于无通信(r=0)的Θ(n² log n)。
AI.motivation: 尽管MOEA/D是基于分解的著名多目标优化启发式，通过子问题协同进化近似Pareto前沿，但迄今尚未有人证明子问题解之间的协同进化通信能带来任何优势。作者希望用严格的理论运行时分析来回答这一开放问题。
AI.method: 针对基于变异的MOEA/D求解经典OneMinMax基准问题，分析在不同通信距离（半径r）下交换子问题解时的运行时间；通过数学证明给出运行时保证并构造匹配的下界。
AI.result: 对所有r≥1，证明紧确的Θ(n²)运行时保证；而r=0时已知上界为O(n² log n)，作者补充了匹配下界Ω(n² log n)。此外表明极小的通信半径即可最大化获益。
AI.conclusion: 首次从理论上证明MOEA/D能从解的交换中获益，且r≥1即可达到最优加速效果，将运行时间从Θ(n² log n)降至Θ(n²)，为协同进化通信的有效性提供了严格证据。

title: LoopGR: Parameter-Efficient Scaling for Generative Recommendation via Recurrent Depth
summary: Generative recommendation formulates item recommendation as autoregressive generation rather than a discriminative scoring problem. Although empirical studies exhibit favorable scaling behavior in recommendation, unleashing the benefits of scaling remains challenging under the strict model size and inference cost constraints of real-world systems. A central challenge is to combine expressive modeling of user-item interaction histories with flexible computational depth without proportionally increasing model size. We introduce LoopGR, a parameter-efficient scaling framework for generative recommendation via recurrent depth. LoopGR employs a tailored hierarchical recurrent depth mechanism that alternates between a shared generative decoder and a lightweight context updater. For efficient inference, we further develop recurrent trajectory self-distillation that distills a low-budget student from a high-budget teacher by aligning both predictive distributions and evolution directions. Extensive experiments show that LoopGR consistently outperforms strong generative recommendation baselines. Compared with a representative encoder-decoder baseline, LoopGR achieves superior performance while reducing model size by up to 52%. These results establish recurrent depth as a new scaling dimension, offering a flexible and resource-efficient scaling path for generative recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopGR，一种基于循环深度（recurrent depth）的参数高效扩展框架，用于生成式推荐，在不显著增加模型规模的情况下实现更强性能与更低模型尺寸。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐虽展现出良好扩展性，但真实系统存在严格的模型规模与推理成本约束，核心难点是在不按比例增加参数的前提下，同时实现表达力强的用户-物品交互历史建模与灵活的计算深度。
AI.method: LoopGR采用定制化的分层循环深度机制，在共享生成解码器与轻量上下文更新器之间交替迭代；推理阶段提出循环轨迹自蒸馏，将高预算教师模型蒸馏为低预算学生模型，同时对齐预测分布与演化方向。
AI.result: 实验表明LoopGR稳定优于强生成式推荐基线；与代表性编码器-解码器基线相比，性能更优的同时模型规模最多减少52%。
AI.conclusion: 循环深度可作为生成式推荐的一种新扩展维度，为生成式推荐提供灵活且资源高效的扩展路径。

title: TraceQuery: learning what to recompute from full-denoising trajectory in diffusion language models
comment: 9 pages of main body, 5 pages of appendix, 4 figures, 1 table
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible generation through iterative masked denoising, but incur substantial inference cost because token representations are repeatedly recomputed across denoising steps. Existing cache-based methods reduce this cost by reusing intermediate results across denoising steps and recomputing only a subset of positions at each step, chosen either on a fixed schedule or by heuristic signals of change. Our trajectory experiments instead point to decoding trajectory as the more relevant quantity. Cached generation remains accurate when it stays close to the full-denoising trajectory, with errors concentrated around unmask-order deviations and reduced as longer reference prefixes are recovered. This suggests a more direct principle: limiting representation error helps, but keeping generation on the full-denoising trajectory is a more direct route to accurate decoding. We therefore formulate efficient dLLM inference as trajectory-guided querying. Rather than broadly repairing representation error, we use full-denoising trajectories to supervise which unresolved positions should receive limited fresh computation. Based on this formulation, we introduce TRACEQUERY, a lightweight sparse decoding framework that predicts a small set of near-future trajectory-relevant positions, queries only those candidates, and lets the backbone select which one to commit from their fresh predictions. TRACEQUERY delivers the strongest quality-computation trade-off among cache-based approaches, sustaining high accuracy with substantially fewer fresh token computations, and generalizes across tasks, model variants, and families. Code: https://github.com/fish1928/tracequery.git

AI.tldr: 该论文将扩散大语言模型的高效推理形式化为"轨迹引导查询"问题，提出 TRACEQUERY 轻量稀疏解码框架，通过预测少量与未来解码轨迹相关的位置并仅对这些位置做新鲜计算，在显著减少计算量的同时保持高准确率。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过迭代掩码去噪生成，但每个去噪步都重复计算 token 表示，推理开销巨大。现有缓存方法要么按固定调度、要么依赖启发式变化信号来选择重算位置，但轨迹实验表明：真正决定解码准确性的是缓存生成是否贴合完整去噪轨迹，误差主要集中在取消掩码顺序的偏离上。因此与其广泛修复表示误差，不如直接以保持解码轨迹一致为目标。
AI.method: 将高效 dLLM 推理建模为"轨迹引导查询"（trajectory-guided querying）：用完整去噪轨迹作为监督信号，学习预测少量近期轨迹相关的位置。基于此提出 TRACEQUERY——一个轻量稀疏解码框架，先预测一小批与未来轨迹相关的候选位置，只对这些候选做新鲜计算，再由主干模型依据新鲜预测决定提交哪一个。
AI.result: 在基于缓存的方法中取得最佳的质量—计算权衡，以显著更少的全新 token 计算维持高准确率；并在多任务、多种模型变体与模型家族上展现出良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 保持生成轨迹贴近完整去噪轨迹，比单纯限制表示误差更直接有效地保证解码准确性；TRACEQUERY 作为轻量、可推广的稀疏解码方案，为 dLLM 高效推理提供了新范式。

title: The Conditional Value of Costly Information in Collective-Risk Dilemmas
summary: Many high-stakes collective problems, e.g., climate mitigation and pandemic response, share a structure in which risk materializes unless a group threshold is met. This threshold is often uncertain, but uncertainty can be reduced at a cost. We study this information cost tradeoff in an evolutionary game theoretic model of social learning in the collective-risk dilemma, where individuals must cooperate to reach a possibly uncertain threshold to prevent collective loss. Individuals may pay a fixed cost to observe the threshold's true value and condition their cooperation on it. Across four threshold priors, we characterize risk levels at which cooperative equilibria emerge and show that low cost information increases group success. However, this effect is reversed at higher costs. We define a private \emph{value of information} and show that information is worth buying only when it is considerably cheaper than contributing. When purchased information is shared with the group, the cooperative tipping point shifts to lower risk levels. Despite bearing a private cost, above this tipping point buyers earn more in expectation than information free-riders. We then study these dynamics when information diffuses through a network, allowing nodes to relay it. Although fewer individuals pay for information, relaying increases group success, and noisy relaying does not reduce it. By contrast, false information does, especially when it originates at the hubs of heterogeneous networks, and large attacks can bring collective action close to collapse. Buyers act as a firewall against disinformation, confining it to source neighbourhoods, and once disinformation sources are removed, the population recovers. The value of costly information thus depends on its price, the level of risk, and how it is shared, and, in our setting, the effort of acquiring it also protects the population against disinformation.

AI.tldr: 在集体风险困境的演化博弈模型中，研究了有成本的信息获取对群体合作的影响：低成本信息提升成功率、高成本则适得其反；信息共享使合作临界点下移，网络中继增加成功率，假信息尤其来自异质网络枢纽时危害大，而信息购买者充当防火墙。
AI.motivation: 气候减排、疫情应对等高危集体问题常需达到（往往不确定的）群体阈值才能避免集体损失，而降低不确定性需要成本。作者希望理解"信息成本—合作行为"之间的权衡，即个体付费获取阈值真实信息并据此决定是否合作，会如何影响群体能否成功。
AI.method: 构建集体风险困境下的社会学习演化博弈模型：个体可支付固定成本观察阈值真值并以此条件化合作。在四种阈值先验下刻画合作均衡出现的风险水平；定义私人的"信息价值"；分析信息共享对合作临界点的影响；进一步引入网络扩散（含中继）与假信息传播，考察噪声中继、假信息源位置（枢纽）、大规模攻击等情形。
AI.result: 低成本信息提高群体成功率，高成本时该效应反转；仅当信息成本远低于出资时才值得购买；当购买的信息被共享，合作临界点移至更低风险水平，且临界点之上购买者期望收益高于免费搭车者。网络扩散中付费者减少但中继提高成功率，噪声中继不降低成功率；假信息则降低成功率，尤其源自异质网络枢纽时，大规模攻击可使集体行动接近崩溃。购买者作为防火墙将假信息限制在源邻域，移除假信息源后种群恢复。
AI.conclusion: 有成本信息的价值取决于其价格、风险水平及共享方式；在本设定下，获取信息的努力同时保护群体免受假信息侵害。

title: AOS-Bench: Can LLM Agents Manage Dynamic Workloads?
summary:
Coding agents are moving from handling one request at a time to serving as persistent assistants to which users hand a stream of work: a build, a data-processing job and a bug fix may all be pending on the same machine at once. Such an agent must decide when to take on new tasks, how to delegate and overlap them, and how to stay within the machine's CPU and memory. Existing benchmarks cannot measure this, because they evaluate each task in isolation. We introduce \benchname{}, which evaluates an agent system as a workload manager: verified tasks arrive over time and must be delivered under shared CPU and memory limits, and the same tasks run one at a time serve as a per-system reference.
  Across five model--harness pairs, isolated task success does not carry over evenly. On heavy workloads every system loses 13 to 23 points. On medium workloads, systems span 11 points in isolated success but 26 points in stream success, and two systems 0.6 points apart in isolation deliver 54\% and 68\% of the same tasks. Execution-policy interventions trace much of this gap to task intake: serial dispatch leaves 73\% of heavy-workload tasks unclaimed. Yet more elaborate management does not necessarily help. A fixed concurrency of two comes within four points of the best agent-managed policy on both medium and heavy workloads, and under every policy median CPU use stays below 30\% of the provisioned cores while tasks wait. These results identify workload management as a distinct capability for agents, and \benchname{} as a way to measure it.

AI.tldr: 提出 benchname 基准，把编码智能体作为工作负载管理器来评测：任务随时间到达、共享CPU与内存限额，发现隔离成功率不能迁移到流式工作负载，任务接收(调度策略)是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准隔离地评测单个任务，无法衡量智能体在面对同时待办的多项任务流时，如何决定何时接新任务、如何委派与重叠执行、如何遵守机器的CPU与内存限制。
AI.method: 构造 benchname 基准：经验证的任务随时间陆续到达，须在共享CPU/内存约束下交付；同时以同一批任务串行执行作为每个系统的参照。评测5个模型–执行框架组合，并做执行策略干预（串行调度、固定并发2、智能体自主管理与其它更复杂策略）。
AI.result: 隔离成功率并不均匀迁移到流式场景：重负载下所有系统下降13–23分；中负载下隔离成功率跨度11分而流式成功率跨度达26分，隔离仅差0.6分的两系统分别交付54%与68%。串行调度导致73%重负载任务无人认领；固定并发2在中等与重负载下均距最优策略4分以内；各策略下等待期间CPU中位数低于配额30%。
AI.conclusion: 工作负载管理是智能体的一项独立能力，benchname 提供了衡量它的方式；更复杂的管理不一定更好，关键在于任务接收与并发控制。

title: Neural-DISCO: Source-Conditioned Counterfactual Editing of Neural Population Activity
summary: Understanding how neural activity encodes behavioral and sensory variables is a key challenge in systems neuroscience. This requires models that go beyond predicting activity from labels and instead support source-conditioned counterfactual editing: given a recorded source response, we should be able to edit one measured behavioral or stimulus label and predict how neural activity would change while preserving other observed labels and source-specific variability not explained by the labels. Here, we introduce \textbf{Neural-DISCO}, a disentangled representation learning framework for counterfactual modeling of neural activity. Neural-DISCO partitions the latent space into label-specific components, each associated with an observed behavioral or stimulus label, together with a residual latent that captures variability not supplied through observed labels. Across simulated and real neural recording datasets, we show that this structure enables selective editing of measured labels to generate counterfactual neural responses while preserving the remaining content of the original activity. Further, to gain insight into how behavioral and stimulus labels are encoded at single-neuron resolution, we pair this disentangled framework with feature attribution methods that identify which neurons are most important for each label. We find that disentanglement enhances the recovery of known functional cell roles in both synthetic and real data. Together, these results support Neural-DISCO as a framework for counterfactual modeling of neural activity and provide a practical interface for probing how neural populations encode behavior and sensory information. Code is available at https://github.com/TangLab-UBC/Neural-DISCO-neurips.

AI.tldr: Neural-DISCO：将潜空间分解为多个标签特异的成分与一个残差潜变量，实现以标签为条件的反事实神经活动编辑，同时保留其余标签内容与源特异性变异；结合特征归因可定位编码各标签的关键神经元。
AI.motivation: 系统神经科学需要理解神经活动如何编码行为与感觉变量。仅靠标签预测活动不足，理想模型应支持"源条件下的反事实编辑"：给定已记录的源响应，改变某一测量标签后预测神经活动如何变化，同时保持其他标签及标签无法解释的源特异性变异不变。
AI.method: 提出解耦表示学习框架 Neural-DISCO。潜空间划分为若干标签特异的成分（各自对应一个观测到的行为/刺激标签）加一个残差潜变量（捕获标签未提供的变异）。再与特征归因方法配合，识别对每个标签最重要的单个神经元。
AI.result: 在模拟与真实神经记录数据集上：可对测量标签做选择性编辑生成反事实神经响应，并保留原活动的其余内容；解耦结构提升了已知功能细胞角色的恢复效果（合成与真实数据均如此）。
AI.conclusion: Neural-DISCO 为神经活动的反事实建模提供了有效框架，并为探测神经群体如何编码行为与感觉信息提供了实用接口。代码已开源。

title: MARC: Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction for Articulated Object Code Generation
summary: Generating an articulated object from images and text requires more than plausible parts and movable joints: the assembled mechanism must execute the intended motion. This is particularly challenging for closed-chain and coupled mechanisms, where an error in one connection can block motion or separate connected parts. We introduce MARC, Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction, which shares an executable kinematic graph across program construction, motion solving, and correction. The graph binds physical connections to local attachment frames and represents loop closures and joint-coordinate couplings. Given prescribed driver inputs, a numerical solver computes follower motion and associates errors with specific connections and configurations. The agent uses these diagnostics to probe possible causes, revise connections or geometry, and retest the mechanism along the original motion paths. On a 20-object test set, MARC with Kimi-K3 achieves 67.8% valid motion coverage and 60.0% overall success, outperforming six baselines. Starting from the same initial candidates, correction improves these scores by 13.7 and 20.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablations further show the benefits of graph-based mechanism support and graph-guided repair. Project homepage: https://demianmusk.github.io/MARC-Home/.

AI.tldr: MARC通过共享可执行运动学图，将程序构建、运动求解与纠错结合，实现从图像和文本生成能正确执行预期运动的铰接物体。
AI.motivation: 从图像和文本生成铰接物体，不仅需要合理的部件与关节，更要保证装配后的机构能真正执行目标运动。闭链与耦合机构尤其困难，单个连接错误即可导致运动卡死或部件分离。
AI.method: 提出MARC（Mechanism-Aware Reflective Correction），在程序构建、运动求解和纠错三阶段共享一个可执行运动学图。该图将物理连接绑定到局部附着坐标系，并表达闭环约束与关节坐标耦合；给定驱动输入后由数值求解器计算从动运动，并将误差定位到具体连接与构型；智能体据此诊断原因、修正连接或几何，并沿原运动路径重测。
AI.result: 在20个物体测试集上，MARC配合Kimi-K3取得67.8%的有效运动覆盖率与60.0%的整体成功率，超越6个基线；从相同初始候选出发，纠错环节分别提升13.7和20.0个百分点；消融实验验证了图结构支持与图引导修复的作用。
AI.conclusion: 以可执行运动学图为共享载体、结合误差诊断驱动的反思式纠错，可有效提升铰接物体生成中机构运动的正确性与成功率。

title: Responsibility Boundaries for Agentic Systems: A Comparative Evaluation of Probabilistic Agentic Programming
summary: Language-model agents combine reasoning, tools, memory, delegation, and external effects. Authority is often distributed across prompts, host code, configuration, and logs. Probabilistic Agentic Programming (PAP) makes responsibility boundaries explicit programming abstractions connecting mandate, authority, effects, and evidence. We compare PAP with programming paradigms, agent-oriented and BDI systems, workflow and policy languages, and LLM tool-use frameworks along seven dimensions. A mediation kernel formalizes checks before tool execution, operation-bound approval, resource limits, and evidence. Inductive proofs establish conditional safety for arbitrary model responses, assuming correct guards and complete mediation. A backward simulation matches graph executions to source executions in a defined sequential Touba subset. Its human checkpoints release program continuations; operation-bound approval remains a separate kernel contract. Finite-state exploration checks the model. Scripted enforcement tests exercise selected refusal paths and permitted controls. An exploratory study combines seven business cases, including two three-agent workflows, seven models from three providers, five methods, and five repetitions per case and method. Shared English instructions and exact checks of stored outcomes yield 1,225 assessed observations. Native Touba completes all 35 observations on six models and 30 on the remaining model; structured Touba ranges from 21 to 35. Native matches the highest observed count for each model, including ties with the frameworks. All paired case intervals include zero. These observed counts describe the evaluated tasks; the runtime authority boundary remains fixed. The results connect responsibility contracts, execution rules, and evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出概率智能体编程（PAP），把责任边界显式化为连接"授权-权限-效应-证据"的编程抽象，并通过中介内核、归纳证明与实证研究评估其安全性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体的权限分散在提示、宿主代码、配置与日志中，责任边界不清。需要一种将授权、权限、效应与证据显式连接的编程范式，以在任意模型响应下保证条件安全。
AI.method: 将 PAP 与编程范式、面向智能体/BDI 系统、工作流与策略语言及 LLM 工具使用框架在七个维度上比较；设计中介内核形式化工具执行前检查、操作绑定批准、资源限制与证据；用归纳证明给出条件安全，用反向模拟将图执行匹配到顺序 Touba 子集源码执行，辅以有限状态探索与脚本化强制执行测试；开展含 7 个业务案例、7 个模型、5 种方法、每案每方法重复 5 次的探索性研究，共 1225 条评估观测。
AI.result: Native Touba 在 6 个模型上完成全部 35 次观测，剩余模型 30 次；结构化 Touba 为 21–35 次。Native 在每模型上达到最高观测计数（含与各框架持平）。所有配对案例区间均包含零。
AI.conclusion: 结果将责任契约、执行规则与证据联系起来，但在所评估任务上观察到的计数仅限于此，运行时权限边界保持固定；尚不能证明其优于基线框架。

title: An Interactive Evolutionary Multiobjective Optimization Algorithm Based on Interpretable Active Preference Learning
summary: Many decision-making tasks are inherently multi-objective. Interactive evolutionary multi-objective optimization algorithms (iEMOAs) are particularly well-suited to help the decision-maker find their most preferred solution. However, many of these algorithms employ black-box preference models. For high-stakes decision-making tasks, like healthcare and defense, a high level of transparency is needed, for instance to support accountability. We propose an interpretable iEMOA which uses active learning to efficiently learn a tree-based preference model directly from pairwise comparisons. The survival operator of NSGA-II and NSGA-III is extended with the learned preference model to guide the algorithm towards the region of interest. An extensive experimental study compares the proposed method to a state-of-the-art black-box model and a state-of-the-art interpretable model. Results indicate that our proposed model outperforms the alternatives in terms of finding the most preferred solution at the cost of a slightly worse average final population. Finally, a case study on a real-life engineering problem illustrates how inspecting the learned model reveals which objectives drive the decision-maker's preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释的交互式进化多目标优化算法(iEMOA)，用主动学习从成对比较中高效学习树状偏好模型，并嵌入NSGA-II/III的生存选择算子引导搜索；实验表明其找到最偏好解的能力优于黑盒和现有可解释模型，代价是最终种群平均质量略差。
AI.motivation: 许多决策任务本质是多目标的，iEMOA能帮助决策者找到最偏好解，但现有方法多采用黑盒偏好模型；在医疗、国防等高风险场景中，需要高透明度以支持问责，因此需要可解释的偏好模型。
AI.method: 设计可解释iEMOA：利用主动学习直接从成对比较中高效学习基于树的偏好模型；将学到的偏好模型扩展进NSGA-II和NSGA-III的生存(survival)选择算子，把算法引导至感兴趣区域；并与最先进的黑盒模型、可解释模型进行广泛对比实验，另在真实工程问题上做案例研究。
AI.result: 所提方法在找到最偏好解方面优于对比方法，但平均最终种群质量略差；案例研究显示可通过检视学到的模型揭示哪些目标驱动决策者偏好。
AI.conclusion: 基于树的主动学习偏好模型为iEMOA提供了透明性与有效性的折中：以轻微种群质量损失换取更优的最偏好解识别与可解释性，适合高风险决策场景。

title: MIDA: Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
summary: Session-based recommendation (SBR) infers user interest from limited interaction sequences, yet current models show a consistent performance drop when longer histories are available. This degradation is associated with decoder designs that overemphasize recent items while underutilizing distant, yet semantically relevant, interactions, leading to poor modeling of long-range dependencies and multi-interest behaviors. To address this challenge, we introduce MIDA (Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation), a lightweight and encoder-agnostic framework that provides a reformulation of the decoding stage. The central design principle is a two-space decoupling: clustering operates on raw item embeddings so that semantic groupings are not distorted by encoder-learned relational biases; encoder outputs are reserved for aggregation, where sequential context remains intact. Concretely, MIDA (i) employs differentiable multi-interest clustering on raw embeddings, preserving semantic structure that encoder representations would otherwise obscure, and (ii) fuses stability and plasticity branches through a gate conditioned on average cluster size, so that the inferred clustering structure directly governs aggregation behavior through a structural coupling across the two stages. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that MIDA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with meaningful accuracy improvements while remaining computationally practical.

AI.tldr: MIDA提出一种编码器无关的轻量解码框架，通过"两空间解耦"（原始嵌入聚类 + 编码器输出聚合）与自适应门控融合，改进会话推荐中的长程依赖与多兴趣建模。
AI.motivation: 现有会话推荐模型在历史变长时性能反而下降，原因在于解码器过度偏重近期物品、忽视远距离但语义相关的交互，导致长程依赖与多兴趣建模不佳。
AI.method: MIDA重新设计解码阶段，核心为两空间解耦：在原始物品嵌入上做可微分多兴趣聚类以保留语义结构；编码器输出仅用于聚合以保留序列上下文。再以平均簇大小为条件的门控融合"稳定性"与"可塑性"两条分支，使聚类结构通过跨阶段结构耦合直接调控聚合行为。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，MIDA一致优于现有最先进方法，取得显著准确率提升，同时保持计算上的实用性。
AI.conclusion: MIDA以轻量、编码器无关的方式重构解码阶段，验证了两空间解耦与自适应聚集对缓解长会话性能退化、提升多兴趣建模的有效性。

title: Recursive Semantic Divergence for LLM Agent Consistency
comment: Accepted as a conference paper in NeurIPS 2026. Source code is publicly available in the repository in https://github.com/AgentConsistency/RSD-agent-consistency
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents with tool use exhibit inconsistent behavior across independent runs from identical states, calling different tools, producing contradictory outputs, or pursuing divergent strategies. This variability compounds over time and undermines deployment reliability. Existing evaluation metrics primarily measure task correctness via completion-based scores and do not capture consistency in agent behavior across executions. Separately, agent behavior is analyzed either at the token level using probability distributions or at the single-response level using semantic clustering, but neither captures how inconsistency propagates across future turns of a trajectory. We introduce Recursive Semantic Divergence (RSD), an unsupervised trajectory-level consistency metric adapted from bisimulation metrics in reinforcement learning. RSD measures the expected cumulative semantic disagreement between two independent rollouts of the same agent from the same state, using natural language inference to detect logical inconsistency. It is defined recursively over future states and approximated by a neural network trained on independent rollouts. The learned metric estimates future divergence from the current state, providing a consistency score at each turn without requiring the full trajectory to complete. When used as a reward signal for fine-tuning, RSD reduces the variation in task progress from 132% to 91% on tau2-bench and from 90% to 44% on toolsandbox, while improving performance across benchmarks and model scales. Training with RSD as an additional reward signal matches supervised fine-tuning performance with substantially lower variance, without requiring ground-truth labels.

AI.tldr: 论文提出递归语义散度（RSD），一种无监督轨迹级一致性度量，借鉴强化学习中的双模拟度量，量化LLM智能体从同一状态出发的两次独立rollout在语义上的累积分歧，可用于逐轮打分并作为奖励信号微调。
AI.motivation: 带工具调用的LLM智能体在相同初始状态下多次运行表现不一致（调用不同工具、输出矛盾、策略分歧），这种变异随时间累积，损害部署可靠性。现有指标多以任务完成度衡量正确性，无法刻画行为一致性；token级概率分布或单响应语义聚类也无法捕捉不一致如何在后续轨迹中传播。
AI.method: RSD从强化学习双模拟度量移植而来：对同一状态出发的两条独立rollout，用自然语言推理（NLI）检测逻辑不一致，衡量期望累积语义分歧；该度量对未来状态递归定义，并用在独立rollout上训练的神经网络近似，从而在无需完整轨迹的情况下给出每轮一致性分数。
AI.result: 作为微调奖励信号时，RSD将任务进度的波动从132%降至91%（tau2-bench），从90%降至44%（toolsandbox），同时在各基准和模型规模上提升表现；将其作为额外奖励训练可达到监督微调的水平，但方差显著更低，且无需真值标签。
AI.conclusion: RSD提供了一种可递归、可逐轮估计的无监督轨迹一致性度量，弥补了正确性指标与局部语义分析的不足，并能作为有效奖励信号提升LLM智能体部署的可靠性与稳定性。

title: A Truthful-in-Expectation 2-Approximation for Pair-Specific Cascade Auctions in AI-Generated Content
summary:
Generative AI interfaces can insert sponsored content at multiple points in an answer, where click-through rates (CTRs) depend on the advertiser-position pair. Under the cascade model, users read ads sequentially and stop after their first click, so both ad assignment and display order affect welfare. For arbitrary pair-specific CTRs, Balseiro et al. (WWW 2026) gave a $4/(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation whose monotonicity has not been established, and a monotone $O(\log m)$-approximation for $m$ candidate positions. Earlier truthful constant-factor mechanisms require factorized CTR models and do not apply. Whether monotonicity is compatible with a constant-factor approximation in this general setting was left open by that work.
  We give a polynomial-time mechanism for arbitrary pair-specific CTRs and any limit on displayed ads that is truthful and individually rational in expectation and achieves a 2-approximation to optimal cascade welfare. Our mechanism selects an advertiser-position matching and a designated last ad, then randomly thins earlier ads so that each selected ad's expected cascade CTR is the same fraction of its standalone CTR. This yields an exact closed-form expression for expected welfare, which we maximize over a bid-independent lottery range using linear programming. Exact optimization ensures monotonicity, while a random-prefix decomposition proves the factor-two guarantee, which is tight for this range. We also show that exactly optimizing the previous welfare surrogate can violate monotonicity, and evaluate welfare and running time on synthetic instances.

AI.tldr: 本文为生成式AI广告界面提出一个多项式时间、真实且个体理性的机制，在任意广告-位置对的CTR下实现级联福利的2-近似，首次在该一般设定下解决了单调性与常数因子近似能否兼容的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI界面可在答案多处插入赞助内容，CTR取决于广告-位置对；级联模型下用户依次阅读并点击首条即停止，故分配与展示顺序都影响福利。已有工作（Balseiro等，WWW 2026）对任意pair-specific CTR仅给出4/(1-ε)-近似但未证明单调性，单调版本仅为O(log m)近似；此前的真实常数因子机制需分解式CTR模型，不适用。核心开放问题是：一般设定下单调性能否与常数因子近似兼容。
AI.method: 机制先选择广告-位置匹配及一个指定的"最后一条广告"，再对较早广告做随机稀疏化，使每个被选广告的期望级联CTR等于其独立CTR的同一比例。由此得到期望福利的精确闭式表达，并在与出价无关的抽签范围内用线性规划最大化。精确优化保证单调性，随机前缀分解证明因子2的界（对该范围是紧的）。另证明对先前福利代理指标做精确优化会破坏单调性，并在合成实例上评估福利与运行时间。
AI.result: 得到真实（truthful）且期望个体理性的多项式时间机制，达到最优级联福利的2-近似，且该因子在上述抽签范围内是紧的；同时指出精确优化旧福利代理会导致失去单调性。
AI.conclusion: 单调性与常数因子近似在任意pair-specific CTR的一般级联设定下可以兼容，2-近似为紧界，解决了Balseiro等留下的开放问题。

title: Propensities Please: Exposing Alignment-Faking LLMs using Synthetic Document Finetuning
comment: 27 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/ardyh/propensities-please
summary: Alignment evaluations aim to assess whether large language models would engage in dangerous misaligned behaviour. Misaligned and evaluation-aware models might engage in alignment faking, where they pursue a hidden goal, but conceal this behaviour when they suspect effective oversight such as during training, evaluation or audited deployment. Such a model might view any prompt-based intervention that aims to reveal latent propensities as part of the evaluation, calling into question the reliability of existing alignment evaluations. Current methods for detecting alignment faking rely on chain-of-thought monitorability, highly realistic environments that reduce evaluation awareness, or mechanistic interventions, all of which are expected to become less reliable for future model generations. We present a method for revealing latent misaligned propensities that does not rely on any of these. We use synthetic document finetuning to teach models that misaligned actions will go undetected whenever certain keywords appear in the prompt. We place alignment-faking model organisms in environments that are clearly identifiable as honeypots and measure how their behaviour changes after finetuning. We observe that finetuning consistently widens the gap in misaligned action rates between prompts with and without the cue, indicating that finetuning allows exposing latent propensities more reliably than purely prompt-based methods. We argue that behavioural methods for detecting alignment faking and related behaviours are critical going forward, as models become more capable and less interpretable. We find that SDF often damages the models' reasoning capabilities and introduce a mitigation based on on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用合成文档微调（SDF）教模型"出现特定关键词时未对齐行为不会被发现"，在明显是蜜罐的环境中测量微调前后行为变化，从而比纯提示方法更可靠地暴露潜在未对齐倾向。
AI.motivation: 对齐评估需判断模型是否会从事危险未对齐行为，但模型可能进行"对齐伪装"：在训练、评估或被审计部署中察觉有效监督时隐藏隐藏目标。现有检测方法（思维链可监控性、高仿真环境降低评估意识、机制干预）预计在未来模型上可靠性下降，且纯提示干预可能被模型视为评估的一部分。
AI.method: 采用合成文档微调（SDF），让模型学习"提示中出现某些关键词时未对齐行为不会被检测到"。将对齐伪装模型有机体置于可明显识别为蜜罐的环境，测量微调后在含/不含线索提示下的行为变化，比较未对齐行为率差距。并针对SDF损害推理能力的问题，提出基于on-policy蒸馏的缓解方法。
AI.result: 微调持续扩大含线索与不含线索提示之间未对齐行为率的差距，表明SDF比纯提示方法更可靠地暴露潜在倾向。同时发现SDF常损害模型推理能力，基于on-policy蒸馏的缓解方法可应对。
AI.conclusion: 随着模型能力增强且可解释性下降，行为学方法检测对齐伪装及相关行为将愈发关键；SDF提供了一种不依赖思维链可监控性、逼真环境或机制干预的潜在倾向揭示手段。

title: How Much Fresh Data Should CTR Recalibration Use? A Temporal Evaluation of Post-hoc Calibration
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and per-cell results: https://github.com/RuiLiu0129/ctr-recalibration-temporal
summary: Offline evaluation of click-through rate (CTR) models still defaults to random splits, although deployed models score future traffic and downstream systems consume calibrated probabilities. On Avazu (40.4M impressions) we train logistic regression (LR), DeepFM, and DCN-v2 under two rolling temporal origins and a random split, three seeds per arm, and recalibrate each test day with Platt scaling and isotonic regression fitted on the preceding hours. At origin 1's nearest test day, random splits report LR's expected calibration error (ECE) at 55-62% of the temporal value in every seed (the deep models' ratio is seed-unstable), and no model's ECE is monotone in temporal distance. With a 6-hour fitting slice, recalibration removes up to 61% of ECE in badly miscalibrated cells but increases it in about a third of applications (14-17 of 48 across seeds). On fixed evaluation sets, a 12-hour slice cuts harm from 13-17 to 3-5 of 36 applications, and 24 hours raises it again. The 12-hour slice subsampled to the 1-hour slice's size (5% of the impressions; 20-25x faster to fit) recovers 88% of the full slice's gain, so impression count alone does not explain it. A slice-ECE gate shows no benefit out-of-origin, and in a simulated auction recalibration moves profit by only about -0.21% to +0.26%. Offline protocols should measure calibration temporally, over multiple origins and seeds; in this data, recalibration fitted on a wide time span beat the freshest few hours, which other logs must confirm.

AI.tldr: 论文在Avazu数据上系统检验CTR模型校准评估与重校准策略，指出随机划分高估校准、重校准收益不稳定，建议采用跨多个时间起点与随机种子的时序评估协议。
AI.motivation: 离线CTR评估默认使用随机划分，但实际部署的模型需对未来流量打分、下游系统依赖校准概率。因此随机划分下的校准误差可能被严重低估，且重校准的效果与安全性缺乏可靠认识。
AI.method: 在Avazu（4040万曝光）上训练LR、DeepFM、DCN-v2，采用两个滚动时间起点与随机划分，每组3个种子；每个测试日用前几小时数据拟合Platt scaling与等渗回归进行重校准；比较6/12/24小时拟合窗口及下采样版本，并用模拟竞价评估利润影响。
