AI.result: 随机划分下LR的ECE仅为时序值的55-62%（深模型比值随种子不稳定），ECE不随时间距离单调变化；6小时窗口最多消除61% ECE，但约1/3应用反而变差；12小时窗口将有害应用从13-17/36降至3-5/36，24小时反升；12小时窗口下采样至1小时规模仍保留88%收益；重校准对模拟竞价利润影响仅约-0.21%至+0.26%。
AI.conclusion: 离线协议应按时间、跨多个起点与种子评估校准；在该数据上，宽时间跨度的拟合优于最新几小时，但需其他日志验证。

title: Oddin: Latent Visual Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models via Self-Distillation from Image Generation
summary: Unified large multimodal models (ULMMs) are able to perform visual reasoning through interleaved text-image generation, but generating explicit intermediate images incurs significant computational overhead. While visual latent reasoning addresses this, most existing methods rely on vision-language models (VLMs) incapable of visual generation. We propose Oddin, a novel framework enabling latent visual reasoning in ULMMs. Oddin replaces intermediate images with compact latent tokens processed entirely by the understanding branch, reserving the generation branch for the final output image. We train the model via offline self-distillation with three objectives, final image generation losses, text distillation losses, and cross-entropy losses for special tokens. Oddin surpasses interleaved generation baselines and closed-source VLMs on average across seven VBVR-Pro visual reasoning tasks. Qualitative analysis reveals that latent tokens attend to relevant regions in an input image, demonstrating that ULMMs can perform complex visual reasoning without generating intermediate images.

AI.tldr: Oddin 提出在统一多模态大模型（ULMM）中用紧凑的潜在视觉 token 替代中间生成图像，实现无需中间图像的潜在视觉推理。
AI.motivation: ULMM 通过交替生成文本与图像进行视觉推理，但显式生成中间图像带来显著计算开销；现有潜在视觉推理方法多依赖不具备图像生成能力的 VLM。
AI.method: 将中间图像替换为由理解分支处理的紧凑潜在 token，生成分支仅负责最终图像输出；采用离线自蒸馏训练，含三个目标：最终图像生成损失、文本蒸馏损失、特殊 token 的交叉熵损失。
AI.result: 在七个 VBVR-Pro 视觉推理任务上平均性能超过交错生成基线和闭源 VLM；定性分析显示潜在 token 能关注输入图像的相关区域。
AI.conclusion: ULMM 可在不生成中间图像的情况下完成复杂视觉推理。

title: From Cosmetic to Structural: A Paired Experiment on Metric-Guided Agentic Refactoring
summary: The role of coding agents is expanding beyond writing new code toward maintaining existing systems as AI teammates. Yet recent studies show that agent refactorings favor superficial, consistency-oriented edits over structural transformations needed to resolve Technical Debt (TD). We investigate if explicit static-analysis feedback closes this gap. Through the CodeScene MCP server, we give an open-source agent (gptme) access to code smell reports and CodeHealth (CH) scores (1--10, higher is better), and compare guided against unguided refactorings in a paired experiment covering $24{,}620$ single-file competitive programming solutions in C++, Java, and Python. We find that guidance shifts the agent from performing cosmetic edits toward structural operations, raising the rate of effective refactorings by $21$--$26$ percentage points. The benefit depends on initial code quality, with language-dependent break-even points at CH $4.9$--$7.1$, below where the structural transformations pushed by guidance increasingly risk regression, indicating where the agent needs more support to refactor. Guided runs also shift the failure profile toward logical test failures, introduce new coupling smells, and consume $\sim$$3$--$5\times$ more tokens over $\sim$$2\times$ as many interaction turns. Our results indicate that AI teammates can benefit from similar static-analysis feedback that human developers already use, enabling structural transformations toward more effective TD remediation, at a higher token cost and more interaction turns.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究显式静态分析反馈（通过CodeScene MCP提供的代码坏味与CodeHealth评分）能否让编码智能体从表面化重构转向结构性重构以缓解技术债。在24,620个C++/Java/Python单文件竞赛题解上进行配对实验，发现引导使有效重构率提升21–26个百分点，但收益依赖初始代码质量（盈亏平衡点CH 4.9–7.1），并伴随失败类型向逻辑测试失败偏移、新耦合坏味增加、token消耗约3–5倍、交互轮次约2倍。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体的角色正从编写新代码扩展到以"AI队友"身份维护既有系统。然而已有研究表明，智能体重构偏向表面化、以一致性为导向的编辑，而非解决技术债（TD）所需的结构性变换。作者希望验证：显式的静态分析反馈能否弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 通过CodeScene MCP服务器，为开源智能体gptme提供代码坏味报告与CodeHealth（CH）评分（1–10，越高越好）；设计配对实验（引导 vs. 无引导重构），覆盖24,620个C++、Java、Python单文件竞赛编程解法，比较两类运行在操作类型、有效性、失败模式与成本上的差异。
AI.result: 引导使智能体从装饰性编辑转向结构性操作，有效重构率提升21–26个百分点；收益取决于初始代码质量，语言相关的盈亏平衡点在CH 4.9–7.1，低于该区间时引导推动的结构性变换更易引发回归。引导运行还使失败类型转向逻辑测试失败、引入新的耦合坏味，并消耗约3–5倍token、约2倍交互轮次。
AI.conclusion: AI队友可以像人类开发者一样从静态分析反馈中获益，从而进行结构性变换以更有效地消解技术债，但代价是更高的token消耗与更多交互轮次，且在低质量代码上需要更多支持才能安全重构。

title: TRON: Transferring Naturally Evolved Network Architectures into Neuroevolution
summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) is challenging because of the vast, non-linear space of artificial neural network (ANN) topologies. Evolutionary methods can generate architectures, but their effectiveness is limited by difficulties in preserving functional organization during mutation and recombination. Naturally evolved biological networks may provide organizational principles that support adaptation and evolvability. Here, we introduce TRON (TRansfer Of Natural networks), a neuroevolution framework that uses experimentally characterized protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks as architectural priors. Instead of starting from random topologies, TRON reuses biological interaction patterns as structural building blocks. It combines classical evolutionary operators with neuroevolution-inspired mechanisms, including speciation, and introduces species quarantine to protect newly generated architectures during early maturation. We evaluated TRON against established evolutionary and neuroevolutionary methods on three classification benchmarks (CORA, CITESEER, and PUBMED) and three regression benchmarks (DIABETES, FRIEDMAN, and CALIFORNIA). TRON achieved the highest predictive performance among the evaluated methods on all classification datasets and most regression tasks. It showed substantially lower variability across independent runs, indicating greater robustness and convergence stability, at increased computational cost. These findings support the use of PPI networks as effective architectural priors and suggest that biologically derived interaction networks provide more favorable substrates for neuroevolution than random topologies. More broadly, TRON demonstrates the feasibility of transferring naturally evolved network architectures into artificial intelligence systems, offering a direction for improving evolvability in NAS through the reuse of biological organizational principles.

AI.tldr: TRON框架将实验表征的蛋白质相互作用(PPI)网络作为架构先验用于神经进化搜索，在3个分类和3个回归基准上取得最高预测性能且稳定性更好，代价是计算成本增加。
AI.motivation: NAS的ANN拓扑空间巨大且非线性；进化方法虽能生成架构，但在变异与重组过程中难以保持功能组织，限制了效果。作者假设自然进化的生物网络蕴含支持适应性与可进化性的组织原则，可迁移为人工网络的架构先验。
AI.method: 提出TRON神经进化框架：不从随机拓扑出发，而是复用实验表征的PPI网络作为结构构建块；将经典进化算子与神经进化机制（如物种形成/speciation）结合，并引入"物种隔离"(species quarantine)在新生架构早期成熟阶段加以保护。
AI.result: 在分类基准CORA、CITESEER、PUBMED与回归基准DIABETES、FRIEDMAN、CALIFORNIA上与既有进化/神经进化方法对比：TRON在所有分类数据集和多数回归任务上预测性能最高；独立运行间方差显著更低，鲁棒性与收敛稳定性更好，但计算开销更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持PPI网络是有效的架构先验，生物衍生的交互网络比随机拓扑更适合作为神经进化的基底；TRON证明了将自然进化网络架构迁移到AI系统的可行性，为通过复用生物组织原则提升NAS可进化性提供了方向。

title: Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Tetun for Ad-Hoc Search
comment: The EPIA 2025 international conference on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Developing information retrieval (IR) systems that enable access across multiple languages is crucial in multilingual contexts. In Timor-Leste, where Tetun, Portuguese, English, and Indonesian are official and working languages, no cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) solutions currently exist to support information access across these languages. This study addresses that gap by investigating CLIR approaches tailored to the linguistic landscape of Timor-Leste. Leveraging an existing monolingual Tetun document collection and ad-hoc text retrieval baselines, we explore the feasibility of CLIR for Tetun. Queries were manually translated into Portuguese, English, and Indonesian to create a multilingual query set. These were then automatically translated back into Tetun using Google Translate and several large language models, and used to retrieve documents in Tetun. Results show that Google Translate is the most reliable tool for Tetun CLIR overall, and the Hiemstra LM consistently outperforms BM25 and DFR BM25 in cross-lingual retrieval performance. However, overall effectiveness remains up to 26.95 percentage points lower than that of the monolingual baseline, underscoring the limitations of current translation tools and the challenges of developing an effective CLIR for Tetun. Despite these challenges, this work establishes the first CLIR baseline for Tetun ad-hoc text retrieval, providing a foundation for future research in this under-resourced setting.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对东帝汶多语言环境（德顿语、葡萄牙语、英语、印尼语），首次探索德顿语跨语言信息检索（CLIR），构建了多语言查询集并对比Google Translate与多个大语言模型的回译效果及检索模型性能，建立了德顿语CLIR的首个基线。
AI.motivation: 东帝汶多种官方与工作语言并存，但尚不存在支持跨语言信息获取的CLIR方案，德顿语作为低资源语言缺乏相关研究，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于已有的德顿语单语文档集合与ad-hoc文本检索基线，将查询人工翻译为葡萄牙语、英语、印尼语构成多语言查询集，再用Google Translate和多个大语言模型自动回译为德顿语进行检索，对比不同翻译工具及检索模型（BM25、DFR BM25、Hiemstra LM）的效果。
AI.result: Google Translate整体上是最可靠的德顿语CLIR工具，Hiemstra LM在跨语言检索中持续优于BM25和DFR BM25；但整体效果仍比单语基线低最多26.95个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 当前翻译工具存在局限，德顿语CLIR仍面临挑战，但本工作建立了德顿语ad-hoc文本检索的首个CLIR基线，为这一低资源场景的未来研究奠定基础。

title: The Social World Model Evaluation Gap
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS). 4 pages of main text plus references and appendix. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22265403
summary: A negotiation assistant can reach a good deal without accurately predicting the other person's response. We ask whether evaluations of social world models test that prediction directly. We audit 113 works published from 1999 to 2026. 9 primary evaluations measure a real person's response to an action selected by the system or experimenter. Only 2 also compare an explicit response forecast with that response. Their predictors use information available when the action is chosen, and the evaluated responses were excluded from fitting; both randomize the intervention. A separate full-text check of 25 language-model works finds no experiment meeting these conditions. The other evaluations test current-state inference, task success, or prediction from recorded actions. We propose a 1-step negotiation experiment that separates these questions. The findings describe the audited sample, not the prevalence of this evaluation gap across the field.

AI.tldr: 本文审计1999–2026年113篇谈判/社会世界模型研究，发现真正检验"预测他人反应"的评估极少：仅9篇测量真实人对所选行动的反应，仅2篇进一步比对显式预测与实际反应；对25篇语言模型工作全文核查无一满足条件。作者提出一步式谈判实验来区分能力类型。
AI.motivation: 谈判助手可能在不准确预测对方反应的情况下达成好交易，因此"任务成功"不等于"社会世界模型的预测能力"。作者质疑现有评估是否直接检验了对他人反应的预测，而非仅考察当前状态推断、任务成功或基于已记录行动的预测。
AI.method: 系统审计113篇1999–2026年发表的文献，统计有多少工作测量真实人对系统/实验者所选行动的反应，以及其中多少同时比较了显式反应预测与该反应。设定四项严格条件：预测器仅用选行动时可获信息、被评估反应不参与拟合、干预随机化。另对25篇语言模型相关论文做全文核查，并设计一个1步谈判实验方案以分离不同问题。
AI.result: 113篇中9篇属直接预测评估（测量真实反应），仅2篇同时比较显式预测与实际反应且满足全部严格条件；25篇语言模型工作全文核查中无一满足。其余评估测的是当前状态推断、任务成功或基于记录行动的预测。
AI.conclusion: 领域存在"预测未被子真检验"的评估缺口；作者提出可分离承诺与预测能力的一步式谈判实验。结论仅适用于所审计样本，不代表全领域普及率。

title: Weighted Fairness in Multi-User Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling
summary: As constellations of satellite grow in size, and become more costly, they are increasingly funded by multiple stakeholders who expect access to the constellation's resources that is commensurate with their investment. Such cooperation raises significant challenges for constellation operation, in particular regarding the fairness of the computed schedules among stakeholders. While several existing works deal with fairness in the Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling Problem (EOSSP), most of them assume that users (e.g. space agencies, research labs, countries) have the same weights, i.e. contributed equally to the project and therefore have equal access to the constellation. However, in practice, users' contributions often differ significantly. Hence, in this paper, we study a weighted variant of the EOSSP where users are assigned weights reflecting their respective contributions to the constellation. We propose several solution concepts with varying focus on efficiency and fairness, namely weighted utilitarianism, weighted egalitarianism, weighted leximin, and weighted ordered weighed averaging (WOWA). We formulate the related optimization problems as Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs), and compare them against two natural heuristics: weighted greedy and weighted round robin. All methods are evaluated on scenarios drawn from the literature, under strict runtime constraints, in order to assess the performance of each approach with respect to both efficiency and fairness metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带权重的对地观测卫星调度问题（Weighted EOSSP），为反映用户对星座的出资贡献差异，提出加权功利主义、加权平均主义、加权字典序最小和加权有序加权平均（WOWA）等多种调度方案概念，建模为MILP，并与加权贪心、加权轮询两种启发式方法在严格时限下比较效率与公平性。
AI.motivation: 随着卫星星座规模增大、成本上升，其资金常来自多个利益相关者，各方期望按出资比例获得资源访问权。这给星座调度带来显著公平性挑战。现有EOSSP公平性研究大多假设用户权重相同（贡献相等），而现实中用户贡献往往差异很大，因此需要研究能体现贡献差异的加权公平调度。
AI.method: 论文研究带权重的EOSSP变体，为用户分配反映其对星座贡献的权重；提出若干侧重效率与公平不同权衡的方案概念：加权功利主义、加权平均主义、加权字典序最小（weighted leximin）和加权有序加权平均（WOWA）。将相应优化问题表述为混合整数线性规划（MILP），并与两种直观启发式方法——加权贪心（weighted greedy）和加权轮询（weighted round robin）——进行对比。所有方法在文献中的场景上、严格运行时限下评估，考察效率与公平指标。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果数值，仅说明在严格运行时约束下于文献场景中对各方法进行比较，以评估其在效率与公平两类指标上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 论文将EOSSP的公平性研究从等权假设推广到按贡献赋权的场景，提供了一套覆盖不同效率—公平权衡的加权方案（MILP形式化）与轻量启发式基线，并给出了在时限约束下以效率和公平指标为导向的对比评估框架。

title: Isharah-Selfie: Continuous Sign Language Recognition Dataset for One-handed Signing
summary: Current sign language recognition and translation benchmarks are commonly collected in controlled settings using fixed or studio-style cameras, particularly limiting their ability to reflect how signers communicate in everyday mobile scenarios. As such, this gap becomes increasingly evident when considering the Arabic Sign Language (ArSL), which is a primary sign language used across Arab countries. In this work, we introduce Isharah-Selfie, a large-scale ArSL dataset collected entirely using front-facing smartphone cameras under unconstrained selfie conditions. The dataset comprises 8,997 video clips performed by 16 signers across 1,493 unique sentences, covering several domains such as healthcare, education, and transportation. Unlike conventional datasets dominated by fixed-camera, two-handed signing, Isharah-Selfie captures realistic mobile communication characterized by one-handed signing, close-range viewpoints, partial body visibility, camera motion, unconstrained environments, and heterogeneous device resolutions. Each video is annotated with both gloss sequences for continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) and Arabic sentence translations for sign language translation (SLT). Moreover, we define signer-independent and unseen-sentences evaluation protocols to assess generalization across unseen signers and novel sentence compositions. Extensive benchmarks using RGB-based and pose-based data show that current CSLR and SLT methods remain challenged by selfie-style signing conditions, particularly under unseen-sentence evaluation, where compositional generalization remains weak. By releasing Isharah-Selfie, we aim to support research toward robust, user-centered sign language technologies that operate reliably in realistic smartphone-based communication settings. The Isharah-Selfie dataset is available on https://isharah-selfie.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出Isharah-Selfie，首个大规模自拍手机前置摄像头采集的阿拉伯手语数据集（8,997视频、16手语者、1,493句），含CSLR与SLT标注，并设说话人独立与未见句子评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有手语识别与翻译基准多在受控环境用固定/演播室摄像头采集，无法反映日常移动场景下的真实交流；阿拉伯手语（ArSL）领域尤为缺乏此类数据。
AI.method: 完全使用智能手机前置摄像头在无约束自拍条件下采集数据，覆盖医疗、教育、交通等领域；视频呈现单手手势、近距离视角、部分身体可见、相机运动与设备分辨率异构等特点；每条视频同时标注gloss序列（用于CSLR）和阿拉伯语句子（用于SLT），并定义signer-independent与unseen-sentences两种评估协议。
AI.result: 基于RGB与pose数据的广泛基准测试显示，现有CSLR与SLT方法在自拍式手语条件下仍显吃力，尤其unseen-sentence评测下组合泛化能力弱。
AI.conclusion: Isharah-Selfie为面向真实手机通信场景的鲁棒、以用户为中心的手语技术研究提供数据支撑，数据集已公开。

title: Lower expected Fisher rank implies better PAC generalization
summary: Deep learning architectures tend to generalize well to unseen data, but explaining this capability is still an open area of research. Under the assumption of i.i.d. data, PAC-Bayes provides a bound on generalization error, and its tightness relies on a parameter distribution that covers a large volume of low-loss solutions. The Fisher information metric endows the parameter space with a geometry for which distances reflect functional changes, and whose zero-component captures functional invariances. We define and study a Fisher-aligned parameter distribution for which we can simultaneously guarantee (1) a low-loss, thanks to the exploration constrained on the functional invariances and (2) a large log-volume of parameters, proportional to the number of zero eigenvalues. This distribution results in a high-probability generalization error bound, which scales with the expected rank of the Fisher information matrix, shedding light on the relevance of this quantity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"Fisher对齐"的参数分布，利用Fisher信息度量的零特征值方向探索功能不变性，兼顾低损失与大对数体积，从而得到与Fisher矩阵期望秩成正比的PAC-Bayes泛化误差界。
AI.motivation: 深度学习虽泛化良好，但其原因尚不清楚。PAC-Bayes在i.i.d.假设下可给出泛化误差界，但其紧致性依赖于一个能覆盖"大体积低损失解"的参数分布。如何构造这样的分布，是待解决的问题。
AI.method: 以Fisher信息度量赋予参数空间几何结构（距离反映功能变化，零分量刻画功能不变性），定义并分析一种Fisher对齐的参数分布。该分布将探索约束在功能不变子空间上以获得低损失，同时利用零特征值方向获得与零特征值数目成正比的巨大对数体积。
AI.result: 对Fisher对齐分布可同时保证：(1)低损失；(2)与零特征值数目成正比的大对数体积。由此导出一个高概率泛化误差界，其尺度随Fisher信息矩阵的期望秩增长，凸显该量的重要性。
AI.conclusion: Fisher信息矩阵的期望秩是刻画泛化能力的关键量；沿功能不变（零特征值）方向的参数体积是PAC-Bayes界紧致性的重要来源，为理解深度学习泛化提供了新视角。

title: A Canary in the Neural Mine: Catching an Image Classifier's Silent, Confident Failures
summary: Deployed vision models auto-accept confident predictions, so high-confidence errors propagate silently. Maximum Softmax Probability (MSP), the standard failure predictor, has a structural blind spot: as a scalar read from the classifier head, it is first-order blind to feature variation orthogonal to its confidence gradient. Through a factorial analysis of feature-space detectors, we identify a conditional-redundancy principle explaining why they fail to complement MSP: the class-separability geometry they measure is already encoded in MSP and collapses under fusion. The signal that survives is class-conditional typicality on the off-manifold residual---and because this residual's distribution varies by backbone, from near-Gaussian to heavy-tailed, it must be estimated non-parametrically. We instantiate these findings as CANARY, a training-free detector that computes a per-class kNN distance on the PCA residual of the penultimate feature, percentile-calibrates it on validation data, and fuses it with MSP through a single validation-tuned weight. CANARY's benefit follows a headroom law: gains grow as baseline MSP quality falls, so a single clean-validation number forecasts the improvement. With every parameter selected on in-distribution data alone, CANARY matches or improves 382 of 385 shift cells (e-AURC; 379 on AUROC) across five backbones, with worst-case regression within seed noise ($-0.0002$ AUROC) and the largest gains on natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-A/R, ObjectNet)---where deployed models are most exposed.

AI.tldr: 提出CANARY——一种免训练失败检测器，利用倒数第二层特征PCA残差的类条件kNN典型性并校准融合MSP，显著提升分布偏移下的高置信误判检测。
AI.motivation: MSP作为标准失败预测器存在结构性盲点：它是分类头读出的一阶标量，对与置信梯度正交的特征变化不敏感，导致高置信错误静默传播。现有特征空间检测器也未能有效补充MSP。
AI.method: 通过因子分析提出"条件冗余原理"，解释特征检测器为何无法补充MSP；发现幸存信号是离流形残差上的类条件典型性，且残差分布因骨干而异（近高斯到重尾），需非参数估计。据此实现CANARY：对倒数第二层特征的PCA残差计算每类kNN距离，在验证集上做百分位校准，并以单一验证调优权重与MSP融合。
AI.result: 提出"headroom law"：增益随基线MSP质量下降而增大，单一干净验证集数值即可预测改进量。所有参数仅在in-distribution数据上选择，CANARY在5个骨干、385个偏移单元中e-AURC上382个、AUROC上379个达到或超越基线，最差回退在种子噪声内（-0.0002 AUROC），自然偏移（ImageNet-A/R、ObjectNet）增益最大。
AI.conclusion: CANARY提供了一种免训练、通用性强且几乎无回归风险的失败检测方案，特别适用于模型最易暴露的自然分布偏移场景，并给出可预测增益的理论依据（headroom law）。

title: EVM-Anchored Provenance for AI-Assisted Code Evolution: A Smoke-Scale Deployment Report
summary: We report a smoke-scale deployment of an EVM-anchored provenance framework for the state stream produced by AI-assisted code generation. The system comprises codebase-state-manager, an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (MIT, v0.2.1) that exposes codebase state, transition, and reward operations to any MCP-compatible assistant, and CodebaseStateRegistry, a Solidity contract deployed on Base Sepolia that emits per-state commitment events. Payloads are pinned to the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) and indexed through a rebuildable SQLite mirror that resynchronizes by replaying contract events. We delimit precisely what anchoring does and does not attest (existence, ordering, and non-equivocation by the committer key; never truthfulness or fabrication-prevention) and outline the orthogonal supply-chain controls required to close that gap. Under an author-produced synthetic workload on a local Anvil simulator, the median commit costs 103,282 gas, modeled at US$0.0018-0.0035 in rollup fees per commit (US$17.9-34.8 per 10,000 states), and simulator latency for the create operation is 539.8 ms (p50) and 725.0 ms (p95) under loopback storage and instant mining. The live deployment holds 14 StateCommitted events verifiable on-chain; the last consumed 98,977 gas at 1 gwei (about US$0.30). All empirical figures are descriptive quantiles from a single author run; no testnet latency is reported, and no claim of superiority is made against any baseline. A receipts-trie consumption mechanism, a BountyEscrow use case, and a FAIR-aligned dataset publication pattern are specified as outlook and are not implemented. A property-by-property comparison against OpenTimestamps, Sigstore Rekor, Centrifuge AnchorRegistry, in-toto/SLSA, Radicle, and Lalli et al. places this work relative to the surrounding provenance landscape.

AI.tldr: 报告了一个锚定EVM的代码生成溯源框架的烟雾级部署：MCP服务器(codebase-state-manager) + Base Sepolia上的CodebaseStateRegistry合约，IPFS固定载荷、SQLite可重建索引，并明确界定锚定的语义边界与度量数据。
AI.motivation: AI辅助代码生成产生的状态流缺乏可验证的溯源记录。需要为代码库状态及其迁移提供存在性、顺序性和防抵赖的锚定机制，同时避免夸大锚定所能证明的内容。
AI.method: 开源MCP服务器(MIT, v0.2.1)向MCP兼容助手暴露代码库状态/迁移/奖励操作；Solidity合约CodebaseStateRegistry在Base Sepolia为每个状态发出承诺事件；载荷固定于IPFS，通过重放合约事件可重建SQLite镜像索引；在本地Anvil模拟器上以作者自造合成工作负载测量gas、费用与延迟；并与OpenTimestamps、Sigstore Rekor、Centrifuge AnchorRegistry、in-toto/SLSA、Radicle及Lalli et al.逐项对比。
AI.result: 中位提交103,282 gas，rollup费用约US$0.0018–0.0035/次(每万状态US$17.9–34.8)；create操作仿真延迟p50 539.8 ms、p95 725.0 ms。线上部署含14个可在链上验证的StateCommitted事件，最后一次消耗98,977 gas(1 gwei，约US$0.30)。
AI.conclusion: 锚定仅证明存在性、顺序性与提交者密钥的不可抵赖性，不保证真实性或防止伪造，需辅以正交的供应链控制。所有数据来自单次作者运行、无测试网延迟；receipts-trie消费机制、BountyEscrow用例与FAIR数据集发布模式仅为展望、尚未实现；不宣称优于任何基线。

title: Edge-Centric Adaptive Neural Activation via Parametric Tanh Functions
summary: Within the broader landscape of artificial intelligence architectures, this paper introduces a compact, edge-centric neural framework that resolves the computational bottlenecks of modern edge-activated paradigms like Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) while retaining their expressiveness over traditional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). While KANs demonstrate remarkable representational capacity by placing learnable univariate functions on connection edges rather than hidden nodes, their reliance on non-local B-splines introduces severe optimization hurdles, high memory overhead, and poor hardware scaling. To bridge this gap, we propose the Parametric Tanh Connection Function, a smooth, bounded architectural primitive defined as $a_{\tanh}(x;δ,α,β,γ) = δ+ α\tanh(βx + γ)$. This formulation unifies offset, amplitude, local slope, and horizontal displacement into a lightweight, 4-parameter differentiable mapping optimized edge-by-edge via backpropagation. Evaluated on dense architectures using MNIST and CIFAR-10, our parametric tanh connection model achieves significant absolute accuracy gains over traditional affine baselines-reaching 95.63% $\pm$ 0.08% on MNIST and 44.74% $\pm$ 0.18% on CIFAR-10. Crucially, it matches or exceeds the expressiveness of unconstrained 7-parameter exponential connection baselines while requiring up to 85% less training runtime. By replacing complex splines or hyper-flexible exponents with a bounded, analytically smooth hyperbolic tangent kernel, this work delivers a highly scalable, hardware-friendly compromise for heterogeneous connection-level deep learning.

AI.tldr: 提出参数化tanh连接函数，替代KAN的B样条边函数，兼顾表达力与计算效率。
AI.motivation: KAN将可学习一元函数放在连接边上具有强表达力，但其非局部B样条带来优化困难、高内存开销和硬件扩展性差的问题；需要一种轻量、硬件友好的替代方案。
AI.method: 定义4参数、平滑有界的连接原语 a_tanh(x;δ,α,β,γ)=δ+α·tanh(βx+γ)，统一偏移、幅度、局部斜率与水平位移，通过反向传播逐边优化，并在MNIST与CIFAR-10的稠密网络上评测。
AI.result: MNIST达95.63%±0.08%，CIFAR-10达44.74%±0.18%，相对传统仿射基线有显著绝对提升；表达力匹配或超过无约束7参数指数连接基线，同时训练耗时最多减少85%。
AI.conclusion: 用有界、解析平滑的tanh核替代复杂样条或超灵活指数连接，可为异构连接级深度学习提供可扩展、硬件友好的折中方案。

title: A Domain-Aware Pipeline for Structured Extraction and Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering over arXiv Superconductivity Literature
summary: Scientific literature in materials physics is growing faster than researchers can manually inspect it, yet most retrieval tools rely on keyword matching or generic question answering that ignores domain-specific structure in PDF files. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that transforms arXiv superconductivity publications into a searchable corpus with structured metadata and retrieval-augmented question answering. The system combines thematic corpus construction, domain-aware extraction of materials and superconducting transition temperatures, and hybrid retrieval that merges dense chunk embeddings with structured publication fields. We test whether normalized domain attributes improve evidence retrieval and answer groundedness relative to lexical-only and dense text-only methods. Extraction is evaluated on a manually verified gold set of 59 superconducting materials, 46 of which have confirmed experimental critical temperatures. On the 33-material primary positive subset, domain-aware pair accuracy reaches 45.5% versus 9.1% for a regex baseline. Retrieval and generation are compared under a fixed language model (qwen2.5:7b-instruct) on a 100-question benchmark, varying only the retrieval mechanism: BM25, dense, hybrid, and hybrid with domain metadata. BM25 gives the highest source recall (Recall@5 of 47%), and adding extracted metadata to hybrid retrieval does not improve it (39% versus 41%), which we attribute to noise in the extracted fields; the main bottleneck is locating the supporting span inside a correctly retrieved paper. As a materials-informatics application, literature-derived temperatures are matched to an independent theoretical reference set: 200 materials appear in both sources, and 20 have a median experimental critical temperature above the theoretical value.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个端到端流水线，将arXiv超导文献转化为带结构化元数据的可检索语料库，并实现检索增强问答；实验表明领域感知提取显著优于正则基线，但元数据未能提升检索召回，瓶颈在于定位支撑片段。
AI.motivation: 材料物理文献增长快于人工审阅能力，而现有检索工具多依赖关键词匹配或通用问答，忽视了PDF中的领域特定结构信息。
AI.method: 构建主题语料库，进行领域感知的材料与超导转变温度抽取，并采用融合稠密块嵌入与结构化出版物字段的混合检索；在固定的qwen2.5:7b-instruct模型上，用100题基准对比BM25、稠密、混合、混合+领域元数据四种检索机制，抽取效果在59种材料（46种有实验临界温度）的人工验证金标集上评估。
AI.result: 在33种材料的主要正例子集上，领域感知配对准确率达45.5%，正则基线仅9.1%；BM25取得最高来源召回（Recall@5为47%），混合检索加元数据未带来提升（39% vs 41%），归因于抽取字段噪声，主要瓶颈是正确定位论文内的支撑片段。文献推导温度与独立理论参考集匹配：200种材料同时出现，其中20种实验中位临界温度高于理论值。
AI.conclusion: 领域感知抽取能显著提升材料-温度配对精度，但结构化元数据对检索召回帮助有限；未来改进重点应放在支撑片段定位与抽取噪声控制上。

title: SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. We present SLICE-Mem, a lightweight memory framework that combines salience-guided admission and predicate-centered information extraction. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. This online pipeline requires no generative LLM calls, while cross-entry reconciliation is deferred to an offline consolidation stage. We evaluate SLICE-Mem on the weekly subset of Memora and LongMemEval-S using 8B and 30B Qwen backbones for memory construction and consolidation on both benchmarks. Compared with the generative-memory baseline MemOS under the Qwen3-30B configuration, SLICE-Mem's online pipeline achieves 46.60 versus 46.68 FAMA (Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy) on Memora Weekly and 56.8% versus 59.3% accuracy on LongMemEval-S, while reducing total LLM token consumption by 92.4% and 99.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate that SLICE-Mem can preserve useful evidence for long-term memory with substantially less reliance on LLM-based memory construction.

AI.tldr: SLICE-Mem：一种轻量级记忆框架，用显著性引导的准入+谓词中心抽取替代生成式LLM记忆构建，在线管线几乎不调LLM，用极小性能代价换取90%以上的token节省。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的长期记忆需在准入、抽取、组织阶段反复调用LLM，成本与延迟高。作者希望在不牺牲长期记忆可用证据的前提下，大幅减少LLM依赖。
AI.method: 两阶段设计：(1) 在线管线——紧凑分类器判断用户轮次是否值得保留（显著性引导准入），再用基于语义依存的分析器把准入轮次转成简洁记忆条目（谓词中心抽取），全程无生成式LLM调用；(2) 离线整合——将跨条目的一致性/调和（reconciliation）延后处理。在Memora周度子集与LongMemEval-S上，用Qwen 8B与30B骨干做记忆构建与整合评估。
AI.result: Qwen3-30B配置下对比生成式基线MemOS：Memora Weekly上FAMA为46.60 vs 46.68（基本持平）；LongMemEval-S准确率56.8% vs 59.3%（略有下降）；但LLM token消耗分别降低92.4%与99.5%。
AI.conclusion: 在线记忆构建不必依赖生成式LLM：轻量分类器+依存句法抽取即可保留有用证据，把昂贵的一致性整合离线化，可在几乎不损失效果的情况下实现数量级的成本下降。

title: Pricing Information in Search with Nonobligatory Inspection
summary: As AI agents reshape Web search and advertising, platforms can monetize information that improves decisions. We study information pricing for sequential search among independent alternatives with nonobligatory inspection: the buyer may select any alternative without buying its report. We show that a common fee maximizes static revenue for identical priors, resolving a uniform-pricing conjecture. Our results also establish that exact optimization is NP-hard for heterogeneous binary priors. Despite this hardness, our polynomial-time static pricing algorithm achieves a $3$-approximation to the information surplus. More generally, a common static fee approximates optimal adaptive revenue within a logarithmic factor in the number of alternatives. This guarantee is asymptotically tight.

AI.tldr: 研究"非强制性检查"下的顺序搜索信息定价：买家可不买报告直接选择方案。证明相同先验下统一费率即可最大化静态收益，异构二元先验下精确优化是NP-hard，但给出多项式时间静态定价算法达到信息剩余的3-近似，且统一静态费率对最优自适应收益达到对数级近似（渐近紧）。
AI.motivation: AI智能体重塑网络搜索与广告，平台可对"改善决策的信息"进行变现；需要理解在顺序搜索场景中如何为信息定价，尤其是买家可以不购买报告就直接选择某方案（非强制性检查）时，平台能获得多少收益。
AI.method: 建立独立备选项顺序搜索、非强制性检查的信息定价模型；分析相同先验情形下的静态收益最优结构；研究异构二元先验下的计算复杂度；设计多项式时间静态定价算法，并与最优自适应收益作近似比分析。
AI.result: 证明相同先验下统一费率（common fee）可最大化静态收益，从而解决统一定价猜想；证明异构二元先验下精确优化为NP-hard；给出多项式时间静态定价算法，达到信息剩余的3-近似；更一般地，统一静态费率对最优自适应收益实现关于备选项数量的对数级近似，且该保证渐近紧。
AI.conclusion: 存在简单而近似最优的统一静态定价机制：在相同先验下甚至最优，在一般情形下仅以对数因子劣于自适应最优，且不可进一步改进；但精确最优在异构二元先验下不可多项式时间求得，凸显静态定价在信息变现中的实用价值。

title: Scaling Qualitative Analysis with Large Language Models: Development and Validation of the Smart Coder Framework for Human-LLM Collaborative Coding
summary: Current uses of large language models (LLMs) for qualitative coding often rely on ad hoc prompting with limited guidance for reliability and human oversight. To address these limitations, we propose the Smart Coder Framework, a three-phase approach structuring human-LLM collaborative coding through Instruction, Prompt Strategy, and Reliability Check. We evaluated the framework using 72 middle-school mathematics teacher interview transcripts and a human-consensus benchmark. A factorial design compared instructed versus uninstructed prompts, few-shot versus few-shot plus chain-of-thought prompting, and single-pass versus self-consistency coding. Twelve transcripts were used for prompt development and calibration, and 60 for the formal evaluation. In the results, instruction consistently improved agreement. Chain-of-thought further improved agreement under adequate instruction, and self-consistency produced smaller, theme-dependent gains but helped identify unstable decisions for human review. Performance also varied by transcript characteristics. Overall, the framework systematically structures and monitors LLM-assisted qualitative coding while preserving human authority over coding decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Smart Coder框架"，通过"指令—提示策略—可靠性检验"三阶段结构化人机协同质性编码流程，并以72份中学数学教师访谈转录本及人类共识基准进行因子实验评估。
AI.motivation: 现有将大语言模型用于质性编码的做法多为临时性提示（ad hoc prompting），缺乏对可靠性和人类监督的指导，导致结果难以评估与人机权责不清。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架（Instruction、Prompt Strategy、Reliability Check）。采用因子设计，比较有指令 vs 无指令提示、few-shot vs few-shot+思维链（CoT）、单次编码 vs 自一致性（self-consistency）编码；12份转录本用于提示开发与校准，60份用于正式评估，以人类共识为基准衡量一致性。
AI.result: 指令一致性地提升一致性；在充分指令下CoT进一步提升一致性；自一致性带来较小且依赖主题的增益，但有助于识别人工复核所需的不稳定决策；性能亦随转录本特征而变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架系统化地组织并监控大模型辅助的质性编码，同时保留人类对编码决策的最终权威。

title: Model-agnostic predictability quantification of multivariable time series
comment: The code is available at https://github.com/ClaudiaShu/MAPS
summary: Multivariable time series forecasting plays an important role in various domains, where predictions depend on complex interactions among covariates. Forecasting models are commonly evaluated across numerous benchmark datasets. However, forecasting accuracy reflects both model capability and task predictability, making it difficult to characterise the difficulty of a task independently of the model used. Existing predictability measures often fail to capture nonlinear dependencies or are limited to univariate series. In this work, we propose Multivariable Predictability Score (MAPS), a model-agnostic metric for measuring the intrinsic predictability of multivariable time series forecasting tasks. MAPS uses covariate information to assess predictability across different lookback windows and forecasting horizons, and provides a quantitative assessment of the predictive information available for forecasting. We evaluate MAPS across synthetic and real-world forecasting datasets against 6 baseline predictability measures. The former confirms that our method closely aligns with the expected reference predictability (r=0.963). Empirical results further corroborate that MAPS yields more reliable projections in the majority of experimental configurations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多变量可预测性评分MAPS，一种与模型无关的指标，用于衡量多变量时间序列预测任务的内在可预测性。
AI.motivation: 预测精度同时反映模型能力与任务可预测性，难以在脱离模型的情况下刻画任务难度；现有可预测性度量难以捕捉非线性依赖，或局限于单变量序列。
AI.method: MAPS利用协变量信息，在不同回看窗口与预测步长上评估可预测性，定量刻画可用于预测的预测信息量。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实数据集上与6个基线可预测性度量比较；合成实验中MAPS与预期参考可预测性高度一致（r=0.963），多数实验配置下投影更可靠。
AI.conclusion: MAPS提供模型无关、可量化的多变量任务可预测性评估，优于现有基线度量。

title: ProtoEEG: Structured Prototype Alignment for EEG Visual Decoding
summary: EEG visual decoding remains difficult because scalp recordings are noisy, spatially coarse, and variable across trials and subjects. Most systems align each trial with a dense image embedding, although that embedding mixes semantic content with instance-specific texture, pose, and background. This target can demand details absent from EEG and provides no explicit account of the visual factors supporting a prediction. We propose \textbf{ProtoEEG}, a prototype-mediated framework that reformulates EEG--image alignment as soft composition over a shared learnable visual codebook. A trainable EEG encoder and a frozen visual teacher produce assignment distributions over the same $K=64$ prototypes. Their weighted reconstructions form a structured representation for retrieval and image generation. Prototype contrast supplies the main cross-modal training signal, distribution alignment coordinates codebook use across modalities, an instance anchor preserves fine-grained discrimination, and diversity regularization prevents redundant prototypes. The shared assignment profile also makes the learned bottleneck directly testable through prototype retention, random selection, and identity shuffling. Across five seeds, ProtoEEG reaches 64.0\% Top-1 and 91.5\% Top-5 on THINGS-EEG2 200-way retrieval. After retraining on EEG-ImageNet, it obtains 44.8\% Top-1 and 73.8\% Top-5 in 80-way retrieval. ProtoEEG also ranks first on all seven reconstruction metrics. Removing prototype contrast lowers Top-1 by 56.9 percentage points, while shuffling prototype identities reduces it to 0.5\%. Prototype analyses further show distributed assignments and broad codebook use rather than one-prototype routing. These results support structured alignment targets as a practical alternative to increasing encoder or teacher capacity alone.

AI.tldr: 提出ProtoEEG，用原型介导的软组合替代密集图像嵌入作为EEG-图像对齐目标，在THINGS-EEG2上达到64.0% Top-1。
AI.motivation: EEG视觉解码受头皮记录噪声大、空间分辨率粗、跨试次与跨被试变异影响；现有方法让每个试次对齐密集图像嵌入，但该嵌入混杂语义与实例纹理、姿态、背景，要求EEG中不存在的信息，也无法解释预测所依据的视觉因素。
AI.method: ProtoEEG将EEG-图像对齐重构为在共享可学习视觉码本（K=64原型）上的软组合。可训练EEG编码器与冻结视觉教师输出同一组原型的分配分布，加权重建形成结构化表征用于检索与图像生成。训练信号包括原型对比（主信号）、跨模态分布对齐、实例锚点保留细粒度判别、多样性正则防冗余；共享分配剖面还可通过原型保留、随机选择与身份打乱进行检验。
AI.result: 五个随机种子下，THINGS-EEG2 200类检索达64.0% Top-1、91.5% Top-5；在EEG-ImageNet重训后80类检索达44.8% Top-1、73.8% Top-5；七项重建指标均排名第一。移除原型对比使Top-1下降56.9个百分点，打乱原型身份后降至0.5%。原型分析显示分配是分布式而非单原型路由。
AI.conclusion: 结构化对齐目标可作为单纯增大编码器或教师容量的实用替代方案。

title: OneCodeReviewBench: Typed Decisions for Code Review and Search
comment: 6 pages, 6 tables. Dataset and reproduction artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23604731
summary: Code review requires finding functional bugs, memory-safety errors, security weaknesses, and performance problems across languages and software stacks. Tools can express bounded parts of this work as decisions about supplied code. We present OneCodeReviewBench, 1,968 synthetic cases across 12 programming languages and YAML, with Boolean, categorical, and ordered answers. Explicit contracts specify runtime assumptions, source scope, and answer criteria; separate evidence records support reference review. One author reviewed 150 cases; two additional engineers reviewed 100 of those cases. We compare ten model--adapter systems on the same cases and contracts: OpenAI Decisions reaches 81.3% Boolean balanced accuracy; Kev-27B reaches 76.8% Choice accuracy and Score mean absolute error of 0.367. Excluding two families with incomplete contracts preserves these leaders. Additional comparisons cover 586 cases with raw symbol search and 40 with a bounded Python import resolver; the resolver matches all 40 references within its supported profile. A versioned artifact reproduces these analyses and retains the 85 cases with matching engineer answers; the reported review subset excludes two incomplete-contract cases. Remaining reviewer disagreements and repaired inputs require resolution; repository-scale transfer and matched latency/cost evaluation remain future work.

AI.tldr: 提出 OneCodeReviewBench：覆盖12种语言及YAML的1,968个合成代码审查案例，含布尔/分类/有序答案与显式契约、证据记录，评测10个模型-适配器系统。
AI.motivation: 代码审查涉及功能缺陷、内存安全、安全弱点与性能问题，跨语言跨栈难以统一评估；现有工具只能表达其中有限部分，缺乏带明确契约与可复现证据的基准。
AI.method: 构建1,968个合成案例，明确运行时假设、源码范围与答案判定标准，并配独立证据记录支持参考审查；人工标注：1名作者审150例，另2名工程师复审其中100例；在同一案例与契约下比较10个模型-适配器系统（布尔/Choice/Score三类任务），并做原始符号检索（586例）与受限Python import解析器（40例）的补充对比；发布版本化工件复现分析。
AI.result: OpenAI Decisions 布尔平衡准确率81.3%；Kev-27B Choice准确率76.8%、Score MAE 0.367；剔除两个契约不完整的模型族后领先者不变；import解析器在其支持范围内40/40全部匹配参考；工件保留85例工程师答案一致的案例，报告子集剔除2个契约不完整案例。
AI.conclusion: 基准提供了带契约与证据、可复现的代码审查评测框架，但审阅者分歧与需修正输入仍待解决，仓库级迁移与匹配延迟/成本评估为未来工作。

title: One Mean Log-Mel Vector per Phoneme: Simple and Fast Text Injection for Speech Recognition
summary: Text injection trains speech recognition models on unpaired text alongside paired audio. We feed the speech encoder synthetic input derived from text so the whole model learns from it. Previously, we synthesized this input with a frozen text-to-speech (TTS) model. Here, a simple lookup table replaces the TTS model: a mean log-mel vector (or one-hot encoding) per phoneme, repeated for a random duration drawn from alignment statistics, with silence between words. Training is 1.8 times faster than with the neural TTS, achieving comparable word error rates. With an external language model, our system reaches 1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 % WER on LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}, to our knowledge state-of-the-art using only LibriSpeech paired data, text, and lexicon. We analyze components of synthetic input (durations, acoustic features), compare different HMM aligners, evaluate scaling on the 25 000 h Loquacious dataset, and show that full-encoder injection yields strong relative improvements compared to partial-encoder and decoder methods. The code of the whole pipeline behind every number in this paper is public: github.com/rwth-i6/returnn-experiments/tree/master/2026-text-injection

AI.tldr: 用查找表（每音素均值log-mel向量，按对齐统计的随机时长重复，词间插静音）替代神经TTS生成合成输入做文本注入，训练提速1.8倍且WER相当，在LibriSpeech上达SOTA，并全面分析了合成输入各组件。
AI.motivation: 文本注入需将无配对文本喂入语音识别模型，此前用冻结的神经TTS合成输入，但TTS推理耗时、成本高，影响训练效率。
AI.method: 以简单查找表取代TTS：每音素一个均值log-mel向量（或one-hot编码），时长从对齐统计中随机采样后重复，词间加静音；分析了时长与声学特征等合成输入组件，比较不同HMM对齐器，在25000小时Loquacious数据集上评估扩展性，并对比全编码器注入与部分编码器、解码器注入。
AI.result: 训练比神经TTS快1.8倍，WER相当；搭配外部语言模型在LibriSpeech dev/test-clean/other上为1.36/2.90/1.52/3.24% WER，据称是仅用LibriSpeech配对数据、文本和词典的SOTA；全编码器注入相对部分编码器和解码器方法有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 简单查找表可作为神经TTS的有效替代实现文本注入，效率更高、效果不降，且全编码器注入优于部分注入；完整流水线代码已开源。

title: Theoretically Sound Item Similarity Measures for Recommender Systems
summary:
Quantifying the similarity between items is fundamental to neighborhood-based collaborative filtering, yet many commonly used similarity measures are heuristics that lack theoretical justification. The use of heuristics forces practitioners to rely on empirical trial-and-error, offering little insight into why certain measures outperform others or how they might be improved. In this paper, we present a principled approach for designing item similarity measures grounded in probabilistic modeling and parameter estimation.
  By adopting this formal perspective, we derive two previously overlooked similarity measures based on the Bernoulli and multinomial distributions. Through an extensive ablation study we highlight the critical role of bias, probabilistic smoothing, treating the unknowns correctly, and choosing appropriate probability distributions. Finally, we show that the commonly used cosine similarity can be interpreted as the solution to a specific optimization problem, thereby providing a novel perspective on this decades-old heuristic.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以概率建模与参数估计为原则来设计item相似度度量，据此导出基于Bernoulli与多项分布的两种被忽视的相似度，并通过消融实验揭示bias、概率平滑、正确处理未知量及分布选择的关键作用，同时证明余弦相似度可视为某优化问题的解。
AI.motivation: 邻域协同过滤中相似度度量多为启发式，缺乏理论依据，导致从业者只能靠试错，难以解释为何某些度量更优或如何改进。
AI.method: 从概率建模与参数估计的形式化视角推导item相似度，基于Bernoulli分布与多项分布推导出两种新的相似度度量，并进行广泛的消融实验分析各设计要素（bias、概率平滑、未知量处理、分布选择）的影响。
AI.result: 得到Bernoulli与multinomial两种此前被忽视的相似度度量；消融实验表明bias、概率平滑、正确处理未知量和选择合适概率分布至关重要；并证明常用余弦相似度是某特定优化问题的解。
AI.conclusion: 为item相似度提供了有原则的设计框架，统一解释了启发式度量并为余弦相似度提供新视角，指明改进方向。

title: Merge-Based Vocabulary Extension Stalls at the Pre-Tokenizer: An English-Preserving Repair for Nepali, Tested in Continued Pretraining
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code and tokenizers: https://github.com/arjanchaudharyy/nepali-pretokenizer-repair
summary: Llama-3, Qwen3 and many other open LLMs pre-tokenize text with a regular expression whose word class admits only Unicode letters. Devanagari vowel signs are combining marks, so this regex splits Nepali words at every vowel sign, and models that use it spend 2.6 to 5.8 times as many tokens on Nepali as on the same English text. Merge-based vocabulary extension cannot join the split pieces: for Llama-3 and Qwen3 no number of new merges brings this premium below about 2.2, and ten released extensions already end within 4% of this pre-token floor. We give a small edit to the deployed regex that provably keeps every token id of text without combining marks or Devanagari characters. With 32,000 new merges it brings Nepali to 1.01 times English, about 54% fewer Nepali tokens than standard extension. In small-budget continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen3-0.6B, the original tokenizer gave the lowest held-out Nepali bits per byte under every recipe we tested. Matching the repair's training steps to standard extension, with about 35% of the data repeated, reversed their order on Qwen but not on Llama. Whether the token savings give a favourable latency and quality trade-off in generation remains untested. We release the tokenizers and code.

AI.tldr: Llama-3/Qwen3等开源LLM的分词正则只允许Unicode字母，把天城文元音符号切碎，导致尼泊尔语token量偏高2.6-5.8倍；作者提出对部署正则的小改动+32k新merge，可降到1.01倍且基本不改变原有token id。
AI.motivation: 主流开源LLM的分词预切分正则字类只包含Unicode字母(Letter)，而天城文元音符号属于组合标记(Combining Marks)，因此尼泊尔语单词在每个元音符号处被切开，同等内容的尼泊尔语token数是英语的2.6–5.8倍；且基于merge的词表扩展无法把被切开的部分重新合并，存在约2.2倍的下限。
AI.method: (1)诊断：量化现有分词器在尼泊尔语上的token溢价并给出merge扩展的“预切分下限”，指出已有10个扩展方案距该下限仅4%以内。(2)修复：对已部署正则在字类中加入组合标记（小改动），并证明对不含组合标记/天城文字符的文本保持全部token id不变。(3)用32,000次新merge进行词表扩展。(4)在Llama-3.2-1B与Qwen3-0.6B上做小预算持续预训练，比较原始、标准扩展与修复扩展三种分词器的held-out尼泊尔语bits per byte。
AI.result: 修复后尼泊尔语与英语token比降至1.01（标准扩展下约2.2+），尼泊尔语token比标准扩展少约54%。持续预训练中，所有测试配方下原始分词器的held-out尼泊尔语bits per byte最低；当把修复方案的训练步数与标准扩展对齐、并重复约35%数据时，在Qwen上顺序反转，而Llama上没有。
AI.conclusion: 分词层面的语言不平衡可通过一处正则小修有效修复，并在几乎零代价下兼容原有token id；但token节省能否转化为生成时的延迟与质量收益尚未验证，需后续实验。

title: Envy-Free Allocations for Random Non-Additive Valuations
summary:
Benade et al. (EC 2024) introduced a semi-random model for non-additive fair division in which each agent starts with an arbitrary base valuation over bundles of items and independently permutes the item names uniformly at random. While they proved that envy-free allocations exist with high probability as the number of items grows for $n = 2$ agents, they left open whether the same holds for $n > 2$ agents. We resolve this open question in the affirmative: for any fixed number of agents $n$ and any number of items $m$ divisible by $n$, an envy-free allocation exists with probability $1 - o(1)$ as $m \to \infty$.
  Our proof combines the second moment method with a connection to the (small-set) expansion of generalized Johnson graphs, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文在Benade等人提出的半随机非可加公平分配模型中，证明对任意固定代理数n，当物品数m足够大（且m可被n整除）时，无嫉妒分配以1-o(1)的概率存在，从而解决了他们留下的n>2的公开问题。
AI.motivation: Benade等（EC 2024）引入半随机模型：每个代理有任意基础估值，但物品名被独立均匀随机置换。他们只证明了n=2时无嫉妒分配以高概率存在，n>2是否成立仍为公开问题。本文旨在解决这一悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 证明结合二阶矩方法与广义Johnson图的（小集合）扩张性质。将无嫉妒分配的存在性转化为随机置换下的计数问题，用二阶矩方法估计满足条件的分配数量的方差，并借助广义Johnson图的小集合扩张性来控制相关性。
AI.result: 对任意固定的代理数n及任意可被n整除的物品数m，当m→∞时，无嫉妒分配存在的概率为1-o(1)。这正面回答了Benade等提出的公开问题。
AI.conclusion: n个代理的半随机非可加公平分配中，无嫉妒分配以高概率存在，该结论对任意固定n成立。证明中建立的二阶矩与广义Johnson图扩张性质的连接可能具有独立的研究价值。

title: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
summary: Frontier AI models are increasingly deployed on topics where the stakes are high and expert judgment is required, including healthcare, defense, finance, governance, and politics. We present a general methodology for distilling expert human judgment into automated evaluation systems that operate at scale. Our approach assembles networks of domain experts and develops techniques for extracting not just their conclusions but their reasoning processes, encoding those processes into structured editorial standards that automated judges can apply continuously. We ground our approach in a long tradition of research on the nature of expertise and the conditions under which expert judgment is reliable and more effective than other approaches, and argue that independent, expert-calibrated evaluation is necessary not only on epistemic grounds but as a matter of accountability and public trust. We validate the methodology on AI news reporting as a first application domain. On source quality, two independent domain experts achieve Krippendorff's $α= 0.83/0.69$ on a held-out test set when applying the editorial standards, and our automated judge reaches $F1 = 0.81/0.97$ against expert consensus. On neutrality, experts achieve $α= .72$ on the test set, and the automated judge reaches $F1 = 0.86$ against expert consensus. Additionally, a controlled comparison shows that expert-calibrated judges substantially outperform uncalibrated frontier models on every source-quality metric, demonstrating that encoding expert reasoning is the critical step that prompt engineering alone cannot replace. We present this benchmark as a proof of concept for a broader evaluation infrastructure applicable to any domain where judgment matters and expertise is scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出将专家判断（含推理过程）蒸馏为可规模化自动评测系统的方法，并在AI新闻报道的信源质量与中立性维度验证有效。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型越来越多用于高风险、需专家判断的领域（医疗、国防、金融、治理、政治），而现有评测缺乏独立、经专家校准的可靠标准，既关乎认识论可靠性也关乎问责与公众信任。
AI.method: 组建领域专家网络，开发不仅提取专家结论、还提取其推理过程的技术，将推理过程编码为结构化编辑标准，供自动评判器持续应用；以AI新闻报道为首个应用域，用Krippendorff's α衡量专家一致性、F1衡量自动评判器与专家共识的一致性，并做受控对比实验。
AI.result: 信源质量：两名独立专家在留出测试集上α=0.83/0.69，自动评判器对专家共识F1=0.81/0.97；中立性：专家α=0.72，自动评判器F1=0.86。受控对比显示专家校准评判器在全部信源质量指标上显著优于未校准的前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 编码专家推理是关键步骤，单靠提示工程无法替代；该基准可作为可推广评测基础设施的概念验证，适用于任何判断重要而专业知识稀缺的领域。

title: Vision Token Pruning via Query-Vision Interaction Decomposition
comment: 10 pages for the main paper, 8 figures including supplementary material, accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs), which process both visual inputs and text queries, incur high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens, making visual token pruning a natural approach for improving efficiency. Recent work has leveraged query information to guide token selection, often through heuristics derived from attention patterns or token dynamics. However, these approaches do not explicitly exploit the underlying structure of query-vision interactions. We address this gap by observing that the query-vision interaction matrix, naturally induced by the query and key projections already present in transformer attention, is effectively low-rank, with a small number of dominant latent interaction modes capturing query-relevant semantics. Motivated by this observation, we propose Query-Vision Decomposition (QViD), a novel training-free query-aware visual token pruning method that exploits this structure. Extensive experiments on both image and video understanding benchmarks show that QViD consistently improves performance under matched token budgets, with the largest gains appearing under aggressive compression regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出 QViD，一种无需训练的查询感知视觉 token 剪枝方法，利用查询-视觉交互矩阵的低秩结构提升效率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型因视觉 token 数量多导致推理成本高；现有基于查询的 token 选择方法依赖启发式（注意力模式、token 动态），未显式利用查询-视觉交互的内在结构。
AI.method: 观察到 transformer 注意力中 query/key 投影自然诱导的查询-视觉交互矩阵本质低秩，少数主导潜在交互模式即可捕捉查询相关语义；据此提出 QViD，基于该低秩分解进行无需训练、查询感知的视觉 token 剪枝。
AI.result: 在图像与视频理解基准上，相同 token 预算下 QViD 一致提升性能，激进压缩时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用查询-视觉交互的低秩结构是有效的视觉 token 剪枝原则，无需训练即可在高效推理中取得更优效果。

title: OvisOCR3 Technical Report
summary: We introduce OvisOCR3, a 0.8B model for a broad range of OCR-related tasks. OvisOCR3 unifies document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction (KIE), document figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction in a single model. We train the model on real and synthetic data through continued pretraining and use domain-balanced mid-training to balance supervision across tasks with different data volumes and response lengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation transfers expertise from five domain-specific 4B teachers into the shared model, followed by mixed-task reinforcement learning with domain-specific rewards. We compare OvisOCR3 with general-purpose vision-language models and specialized OCR models on public and in-house benchmarks covering all five task families. In these comparisons, it achieves an overall score of 96.74 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and the highest overall scores on PureDocBench, Real5-OmniDocBench, and MDPBench. On OCRBench v2, it ranks first, scoring 65.9 and 61.3 on the English and Chinese splits, respectively. It also outperforms the baselines on OCRBench and all four KIE benchmarks. On DocFigCapBench, it achieves the highest localization F1 and a caption score close to that of Qwen3.8-Max. For cross-page tables, it leads in Relation F1 on CrossTabBench and truncated-table TEDS on MPDocBench-Parse. These results demonstrate that a compact 0.8B model can achieve strong performance across diverse OCR-related tasks. OvisOCR3 is available at https://huggingface.co/ATH-MaaS/OvisOCR3.

AI.tldr: OvisOCR3 是一个 0.8B 的统一 OCR 模型，覆盖文档解析、通用 OCR、关键信息抽取、文档图表描述和跨页表格重建五大任务，通过中训练、多教师蒸馏和强化学习训练，在多个基准上达到最优或领先水平。
AI.motivation: OCR 相关任务种类繁多（文档解析、通用识别、KIE、图表描述、跨页表格），现有通用视觉语言模型或专用模型通常只擅长部分任务，缺少一个紧凑且能统一覆盖多任务的高性能模型。
AI.method: 以 0.8B 模型为基础，使用真实与合成数据做继续预训练；用领域均衡的中训练平衡不同任务的数据量和响应长度差异；通过多教师 on-policy 蒸馏把五个领域专用 4B 教师的能力迁移到共享模型中；最后进行带领域特定奖励的混合任务强化学习。
AI.result: 在公开与内部基准上与通用 VLM 和专用 OCR 模型对比：OmniDocBench v1.6 总分 96.74；PureDocBench、Real5-OmniDocBench、MDPBench 综合分最高；OCRBench v2 英/中分列第一（65.9 / 61.3）；OCRBench 及四个 KIE 基准均优于基线；DocFigCapBench 定位 F1 最高、描述分接近 Qwen3.8-Max；CrossTabBench 的关系 F1 与 MPDocBench-Parse 的截断表格 TEDS 领先。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的 0.8B 模型也能在多样化 OCR 相关任务上取得强性能，说明多任务统一架构结合蒸馏与强化学习是可行且高效的路线。模型已在 HuggingFace 开放。

title: Can Agentic Code Review Catch Vulnerabilities Before They Are Merged?
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/secprbench/secprbench Results website: https://secprbench.github.io
summary: LLM agents have been increasingly adopted for security-focused code review, but existing benchmarks mostly derive the reviewed changes from their later fixes instead of the real-world bug-introducing commits. In this paper, we present SecPRBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating agentic security review on validated real-world code changes. More specifically, we have built an automated agentic pipeline to autonomously harvest, build, and validate massive real-world bug-introducing commits for popular software systems. To ensure precise evaluation, we also adopt LLM-as-a-judge to credit the findings matching ground-truth vulnerabilities. To date, we have collected 265 tasks from nine critical systems, including Firefox, V8, and OpenSSL with millions of lines of code. Across eight frontier models, recall ranges from 32.5% to 78.1%, with Grok 4.6 and GPT-6 sol ranking at the top. Our study also shows that most misses are not simply oversights: in 68% of them, the agent reports on a file that holds the flaw but argues for a different mechanism. Security-focused harnesses also behave differently: OpenAI's Codex Security lowers recall by 8.3 points, mostly by abstaining, while Anthropic's Defending Code harness raises it by 7.7 points, at a higher cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 SecPRBench，首个基于真实验证过的"引入缺陷提交"（bug-introducing commits）的智能体式安全代码审查基准，涵盖9个关键系统265个任务，并揭示前沿模型召回率32.5%–78.1%及失败模式。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体被广泛用于安全代码审查，但现有基准多从"后续修复"反推被审改动，而非真实引入缺陷的提交，导致评估偏离真实场景。
AI.method: 构建自动化智能体流水线，自主采集、构建并验证大型真实软件系统中的引入缺陷提交；采用LLM-as-a-judge判定发现是否匹配真实漏洞；在Firefox、V8、OpenSSL等9个关键系统上收集265个任务，评测8个前沿模型及不同安全框架。
AI.result: 8个前沿模型召回率32.5%–78.1%，Grok 4.6与GPT-6 sol居首；68%的漏报并非简单疏忽，而是定位到含缺陷文件却论证了错误机制；OpenAI Codex Security使召回下降8.3点（多为弃答），Anthropic Defending Code提升7.7点但成本更高。
AI.conclusion: SecPRBench 提供更贴近真实的安全审查评测，表明当前智能体安全审查仍有明显差距，失败主要源于机制推理偏差，且不同安全框架影响差异显著。

title: Agentic Algorithm Design: LLMs that Propose, Formalise, and Prove Runtime Bounds for Evolutionary Algorithms in Lean
comment: A github repository with source code will be published later
summary: LLMs now prove hard theorems in Lean. Can they also design algorithms and prove their correctness and efficiency? LLM-guided design of optimisation heuristics (such as AlphaEvolve) is purely empirical. Automated theorem provers with LLMs prove given statements. So far, there has been little evidence that LLMs can do both: design an algorithm and guarantee its efficiency by a mathematical proof. We present a staged pipeline modelled after research methodology in design and analysis of evolutionary algorithms. The agent proposes black-box optimisation algorithms, and Lean guards filter out flawed designs. The agent then defines a potential function and proves drift bounds that guarantee an expected runtime improvement over the baseline algorithm. At no point in the pipeline are the algorithms compared empirically. The agent generates a black-box optimisation algorithm with expected runtime $O(n^2)$ on a CycleUncover problem, where the classical (1+1) EA needs runtime $e^{Ω(n)}$. The pipeline also designs and analyses a black-box optimisation algorithm for integer-valued submodular minimisation with expected runtime $O(n^{2+2c})$, and it matches the optimal order $O(n^2)$ on LeadingOnes. Across 8 problem classes, 12 of 15 runs with frontier models complete the pipeline with a machine-checked expected-runtime bound. An ablation study shows that removing the staging and asking the agent to zero-shot an algorithmic design with a runtime guarantee leads to a copy of the seeded baseline algorithm (random search) or to incomplete proofs. Our study suggests that machine-checked specifications in Lean can replace empirical evaluation in open-ended algorithm discovery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first example of an automated pipeline that designs efficient black-box optimisation algorithms with machine-checked runtime bounds in Lean.

AI.tldr: 首个自动流水线：LLM 设计黑箱优化算法，并在 Lean 中机器验证其期望运行时上界，无需经验评测。
AI.motivation: LLM 已能在 Lean 中证明困难定理，LLM 引导的启发式设计（如 AlphaEvolve）却是纯经验性的，自动定理证明只能验证给定命题。尚缺证据表明 LLM 能同时设计算法并用数学证明保证其效率。
AI.method: 仿照进化算法设计与分析的研究范式搭建分阶段流水线：智能体提出黑箱优化算法，Lean 守卫过滤有缺陷的设计；随后智能体定义势函数并证明漂移界，以保证相对基线算法的期望运行时改进。全程不做算法间的经验比较。
AI.result: 在 CycleUncover 上生成期望运行时 O(n²) 的算法，而经典 (1+1) EA 需 e^{Ω(n)}；为整数子模最小化设计并分析出 O(n^{2+2c}) 的算法；在 LeadingOnes 上达到最优阶 O(n²)。8 个问题类中，前沿模型 15 次运行有 12 次完成流水线并给出机器验证的期望运行时界。消融实验显示零样本直接设计会退化为随机搜索的复制品或证明不完整。
AI.conclusion: Lean 中的机器可检验规范可替代开放式算法发现中的经验评测；据作者所知，这是首个自动设计高效黑箱优化算法并给出 Lean 机器验证运行时界的流水线。

title: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that serve users across many sessions must choose, for every request, the few stored memories that enter a limited context window. This choice largely decides whether the agent answers correctly, and it runs on every request at Web scale. This selection faces three challenges: a large and growing store, a per-request cost budget, and multi-session questions that need all of their evidence. Many memory systems build notes or graphs with hundreds to thousands of LLM calls per history, and each is designed on its own, so it is unclear which component yields the accuracy. These challenges mirror the properties of recommendation, so we formalize agent memory as budgeted slate recommendation, with the request as the user, stored memories as items and the context window as a slate. The formalization places memory systems in one design space of recommender cascades and factorizes accuracy into the completeness that each stage controls. Guided by it, we propose AgentMemRec, which adapts candidate generation, learning to rank and slate construction from recommender systems and selects memories without any LLM call. On multi-session questions of LongMemEval, AgentMemRec outperforms memory and context-selection methods, including A-Mem, HippoRAG 2, DynamicRAG and T-Mem, by 10 to 31 points of accuracy. It matches an LLM reranker that makes 64 calls per query at 3.2 times lower serving cost, and on LoCoMo it outperforms Mem0 and Zep without any LLM call at write time. The factorization attributes the gains to slates that more often hold all of the evidence, so recommender-system design offers an effective and efficient foundation for the long-term memory of LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 将LLM智能体的记忆选择形式化为"有预算的集合推荐"问题，提出无需LLM调用的AgentMemRec，在LongMemEval上比A-Mem、HippoRAG 2等提升10-31个准确率点。
AI.motivation: 多会话LLM智能体每次请求都要从不断增长的存储中挑选少量记忆进入有限上下文窗口，该选择直接决定答案正确性且需在Web规模下运行。三大挑战：存储量大且增长、每请求成本预算、多会话问题需全部证据。现有记忆系统需数百至数千次LLM调用且各自设计，难以判断哪个组件带来准确率。
AI.method: 把智能体记忆形式化为有预算的slate推荐（请求=用户，记忆=物品，上下文窗口=slate），将各类记忆系统统一到一个推荐级联设计空间，并把准确率分解为各阶段控制的完整性。据此提出AgentMemRec，从推荐系统移植候选生成、learning-to-rank与slate构建，且选择记忆时不调用任何LLM。
AI.result: LongMemEval多会话问题上的准确率比A-Mem、HippoRAG 2、DynamicRAG、T-Mem高10至31点；以3.2倍更低服务成本匹敌每查询64次调用的LLM重排器；在LoCoMo上优于Mem0与Zep，且写入时无LLM调用。
AI.conclusion: 分解归因表明增益主要来自slate更常包含全部证据，说明推荐系统设计可作为LLM智能体长期记忆的有效且高效的基础。

title: AdaptTok-Indic: Script-Aware Adaptive Tokenization for Indic Languages
summary: Multilingual tokenizers trained on English-dominated corpora often over-segment Indic languages, resulting in longer token sequences and increased tokenization disparity across scripts. We present AdaptTok-Indic, an Indic-specialized extension of adaptive tokenization that combines Unicode-normalized preprocessing with explicit Indic conjunct handling, script-aware routing, and learned byte-level boundary prediction jointly trained with a small Transformer language model. Evaluated on Bengali and Hindi, with additional evaluation on Gujarati, Tamil, and Telugu, AdaptTok-Indic achieves lower token fertility than SentencePiece BPE, an Indic-oriented tokenizer baseline, and an independently implemented MAGNET-style baseline. Across five recorded seeds, mean fertility is 1.432 for Bengali and 1.388 for Hindi, compared with 2.156 and 2.085 for SentencePiece BPE. Recorded downstream scores average 57.69 on evaluated Indic settings versus 50.82 for the SentencePiece BPE configuration. Independent verification runs using the released prototype confirm the same directional trends. The current implementation is a small-scale prototype with documented simplifications, and no statistical significance testing, released-MAGNET comparison, or code-mixed evaluation is performed. These results suggest that Indic-specialized adaptive segmentation can reduce tokenization disparity while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

AI.tldr: AdaptTok-Indic：面向印度语系的专用自适应分词器，通过Unicode规范化、连字处理与脚本感知路由降低分词过度切分问题，在孟加拉语/印地语上词元生育率显著低于SentencePiece BPE，下游分数亦有提升。
AI.motivation: 主流分词器在英语主导语料上训练，对印度语系过度切分，导致词元序列变长、跨脚本分词不一致（分词差异大）。
AI.method: 提出AdaptTok-Indic，在自适应分词基础上加入Unicode规范化预处理、印度语连字显式处理、脚本感知路由，以及与小型Transformer语言模型联合训练的字节级边界预测。
AI.result: 孟加拉语与印地语（另评古吉拉特语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语）：五个随机种子下平均生育率孟加拉语1.432、印地语1.388，对比SentencePiece BPE的2.156与2.085；下游平均分57.69 vs 50.82。独立复现验证趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: 印度语系专用自适应分词可降低分词差异并保持有竞争力的下游性能；但当前为小规模原型，存在简化，未做显著性检验、未与正式发布MAGNET对比，也未评估代码混用（code-mixed）场景。

title: Online Fair Division with Frequency Predictions
summary: We study online fair division of indivisible goods among $n$ agents with frequency predictions: before any good arrives, the algorithm learns the multiset of each agent's values for the goods, but neither the arrival order nor which values of different agents belong to the same good. Neoh et al. (ICML 2026) showed that such predictions allow every share-based guarantee that is achievable offline, and left open whether a positive approximation of envy-freeness up to one good (EF1) is possible. We show that deterministic online algorithms can guarantee $1/2$-EF1 for three agents and $(3-\sqrt5)/2$-EF1 for four agents, whereas for five or more agents, no online algorithm can guarantee any positive approximation of EF1, even with $n+1$ goods and identical predictions. Together with the known result for two agents, a positive approximation of EF1 is therefore possible if and only if $n\leq4$. We also rule out any positive approximation of EFX for three or more agents, even when the valuations take only two distinct positive values. Next, we use the meta-algorithm of Neoh et al. (ICML 2026) to compute an epistemic EFX (EEFX) allocation in polynomial time for any $n$, and hence a $1/(n-1)$-EF$(n-2)$ allocation for $n\geq3$, whereas algorithms that fix a picking sequence in advance can guarantee a positive approximation of EF$k$ if and only if $n\leq k+2$. Finally, for noisy predictions, we give algorithms that return EEFX allocations when the predictions are exact, and guarantee $(1-2\varepsilon+O(\varepsilon^2))$-EEFX under underestimates and, for $n\geq3$, $(1-2(n-1)\varepsilon+O(\varepsilon^2))$-EEFX under overestimates; the linear terms are the best possible, and larger overestimates rule out any positive approximation for such algorithms.

title: NewsBench: Expert-Grounded Evaluation of Epistemic Quality in AI News Reporting
summary: As frontier AI systems increasingly serve as sources of political and current-events information, evaluating the epistemic quality of their responses is now especially consequential. Existing evaluations often focus narrowly on ideological alignment, rely on measures not validated for this setting, or depend on reference labels derived from public opinion or non-expert annotation, potentially producing misleading or miscalibrated results. To address these limitations, we introduce NewsBench, an expert-grounded benchmark that reframes evaluation around editorial standards developed by senior practitioners in journalism, policy, and intelligence analysis. NewsBench operationalizes quality across three dimensions, source quality, factuality, and neutrality, using a two-phase pipeline in which domain experts first define and calibrate evaluation guidelines, which are then transferred to automated AI judges validated against expert-adjudicated gold labels. The benchmark includes approximately $3,000$ evaluation prompts, with roughly $500$ refreshed monthly to capture emerging current events, roughly $2,500$ human expert-annotated items for calibration and validation, and a suite of AI judges designed to enable scalable evaluation. To validate our methodology, we report both inter-rater reliability among human experts and AI judge--human agreement across all three dimensions. Finally, we apply NewsBench to four frontier models, revealing distinct and non-overlapping failure profiles in sourcing, factuality, and neutrality.

AI.tldr: NewsBench：以专家编辑标准重构前沿模型新闻类回答的认知质量评测，覆盖信源质量、真实性与中立性三维度，约3000条提示并月度更新，配套经专家金标验证的AI评审。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI成为政治与时事信息的重要来源，其回答的认知质量评测意义重大；但现有评测存在三大缺陷：只关注意识形态对齐、所用度量未在该场景下验证、依赖民意或非专家标注的参考标签，易产生误导或失准的结果。
AI.method: 提出NewsBench专家锚定基准，围绕新闻、政策与情报分析资深从业者的编辑标准，将质量操作化为信源质量、真实性与中立性三维；采用两阶段流水线：先由领域专家定义并校准评测指南，再迁移给自动化AI评审，并用专家裁定金标验证。规模约3000条评测提示（每月约500条更新以覆盖时事），约2500条专家人工标注用于校准与验证。
AI.result: 报告了专家间评分者信度以及三个维度上AI评审与人类的一致性以验证方法；将NewsBench用于四个前沿模型，揭示出在信源、真实性与中立性方面互不重叠的差异化失败画像。
AI.conclusion: 以专家编辑标准而非民意或非专家标签作为评测锚点，可在保证可扩展性的同时提高新闻类回答质量评测的有效性与校准度；不同模型的失败模式具有维度特异性，单一指标评测不足以刻画其认知质量。

title: Neyman Orthogonal Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering is a popular approach for shifting LLM output toward a desired behavior, and increasingly for generating realistic synthetic data. The standard recipe estimates a steering direction by contrasting LLM activations on prompts with and without a target concept, such as truthfulness. In this paper, we separate the estimand (the steering direction these methods target) from the estimator used to recover it, two notions the literature often conflates. We frame nearly all existing methods as plug-in estimators of the average gradient of an outcome regression, with the binary contrastive label fixed as the outcome. Using this framing, we can immediately incorporate flexible modeling approaches and extend existing methods to allow for continuous outcomes such as log-probabilities or oracle ratings. Flexible ML models that fit the outcome well, however, might not estimate the gradient well, which motivates estimators that target the gradient directly. Drawing on the debiased machine learning literature, we develop a complementary estimator built on the Stein score, the Riesz representer of the gradient functional. Combining the two routes gives an orthogonalized estimator with classical double-robustness properties. We illustrate the framework on activation steering applied to a number of benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文区分"激活引导方向的估计目标(estimand)"与"估计器(estimator)"，将现有方法统一为结果回归平均梯度的plug-in估计，并引入去偏机器学习(Stein score/Riesz表示)构建正交化双稳健估计器。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法混淆了估计目标与估计器，且标准做法只用二元对比标签作为结果，难以利用连续结果（如对数概率、oracle评分）；同时拟合良好的ML模型未必能准确估计梯度，需要直接针对梯度功能的估计器。
AI.method: 将几乎所有现有方法框定为结果回归平均梯度的plug-in估计（二元对比标签固定为结果），借此支持灵活建模与连续结果扩展；再用Stein score（梯度泛函的Riesz表示）构建直接针对梯度的补充估计器，并将两条路线结合成正交化、具双稳健性的估计器。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上以激活引导为例验证框架，展示了统一框架与正交化估计器的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 区分估计目标与估计器可澄清激活引导方法学；所提正交化双稳健估计器兼容灵活建模与连续结果，为激活引导方向估计提供更严谨的统计基础。

title: Decentralized Multi-View, Multi-Zone Tracking for Scalable Camera Networks
summary: We present a decentralized multi-view tracking system for scalable camera networks. Single-view detections are projected to bird's-eye-view (BEV) coordinates and fused by independent multi-view trackers, each managing a dynamic spatial zone. To support scalability across spatially partitioned camera networks, we introduce a decentralized layer for trajectory unification, utilizing a locking protocol and periodic track-merging operations termed global collate. This process is supported by a delayed-output buffering mechanism that retroactively applies history corrections. The configurable delay window absorbs asynchronous coordination latency and helps stabilize cross-zone identity consistency. We detail the design of dynamic zone polygons, consensus-based coordination, and the validation framework, which together maintain global ID consistency with minimal accuracy loss compared to a single-instance baseline in the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出去中心化多视角跟踪系统：单视角检测投影到BEV融合，独立跟踪器管理动态空间区域，并用去中心化层（锁定协议+周期性global collate）实现轨迹统一。
AI.motivation: 面向大规模、空间上分区的相机网络，需要可扩展的多视角跟踪，同时保持跨区域全局ID一致，并吸收异步协调带来的延迟。
AI.method: 单视角检测投影到BEV坐标并由独立多视角跟踪器融合，每个跟踪器管理动态区域多边形；引入去中心化轨迹统一层，采用锁定协议与周期性track-merging（global collate）；配合延迟输出缓冲机制回溯修正历史；并设计动态区域多边形、基于共识的协调与验证框架。
AI.result: 可配置延迟窗口吸收异步协调时延、稳定跨区域ID一致性；在所评估配置下，相比单实例基线仅有极小精度损失即可维持全局ID一致。
AI.conclusion: 该去中心化架构在保持跟踪精度的同时实现可扩展的跨区域ID一致，适合分区式大规模相机网络部署。

title: Developers as Managers of AI Agents: A Workplace Shadowing Study
summary:
As AI coding agents become more autonomous, developers increasingly direct, coordinate, and check their work. Yet little is known about these practices in everyday professional development. We shadowed 11 professional developers across approximately 15 hours of work, coded their activities and task transitions, analyzed 255 submitted prompts, and conducted 4.6 hours of follow-up interviews.
  Developers spent an average of 33.4% of observed time formulating prompts or checking AI responses, with task-switching rates ranging from 0 to 101.6 switches per hour. Beyond producing artifacts, prompts supported understanding, requirements clarification, agent configuration, and coordination. We identified three recurring patterns: \textit{Supervisor}, involving direct artifact inspection; \textit{Delegator}, involving dialogue-based coordination and delegated implementation and checking; and \textit{Learner}, involving agents primarily to build understanding. Developers sought technical information from agents and organizational context, authority, and alignment from colleagues. Our findings suggest future studies of how developers manage attention across concurrent agent tasks and tools that support verification, coordination, and learning.

AI.tldr: 通过对11名专业开发者约15小时的实地跟踪、255条prompt分析及4.6小时访谈，揭示了开发者与AI编码智能体的日常协作实践，归纳出Supervisor、Delegator、Learner三种模式。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体日益自主，开发者转向指导、协调和检查其工作，但这类日常专业开发实践鲜有研究。
AI.method: 对11名专业开发者进行约15小时工作跟踪（shadowing），编码其活动与任务切换，分析255条提交的prompt，并开展4.6小时后续访谈。
AI.result: 开发者平均33.4%的观察时间用于构造prompt或检查AI响应，任务切换率为每小时0–101.6次；prompt除产出工件外还支持理解、需求澄清、智能体配置与协调；识别出Supervisor（直接检查工件）、Delegator（对话协调、委托实现与检查）、Learner（借助智能体建立理解）三种模式；技术信息求诸智能体，组织背景、权责与对齐求诸同事。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究应关注开发者如何在并发智能体任务与工具间管理注意力，并设计支持验证、协调与学习的工具。

title: Knowing When the Evidence Is Enough: Requirement-Directed Search with Horn-Closure Certificates
summary: After each Web search, a search-augmented model must decide whether its evidence suffices: answer, search again, or abstain. Prevailing systems leave this to holistic model judgement, which can accept a context naming every entity yet lacking one required fact. We instead make sufficiency structural: a per-query requirement hypergraph states which facts jointly yield another fact. This raises two challenges: deriving requirements from the question alone, and linking each requirement to passages about the right entity. Certify therefore decomposes the question, searches per requirement, and accepts links only after entity checks. Horn closure over the links yields a certificate, the minimal sufficient passages and their derivation, or an abstention naming open requirements. Given correct retrieval, requirements and links, the decision is sound, and complete up to the entity check. Pooled over three corpora with unanswerable twins, Certify decides significantly more accurately than search agents, graph retrieval and sufficiency judges in default configurations. On the same evidence, it matches a proprietary model's sufficiency label without an additional model call. Over 21M Wikipedia passages, entity checks add 4 to 13 points of decision accuracy where gold evidence exists. Finally, answers from its certificate are 80% correct, against 57% from all retrieved passages.

AI.tldr: 提出 Certify，将"证据是否充分"结构化：用逐查询的需求超图表示哪些事实联合推出另一事实，通过 Horn 闭包生成证书（最简充分段落及其推导）或带未满足需求的中止。
AI.motivation: 搜索增强模型在检索后需判断证据是否足够（作答/再搜/中止），现有系统依赖整体模型判断，容易接受"覆盖所有实体但缺少某个必要事实"的上下文。
AI.method: 两个挑战：仅凭问题推导需求、将每个需求链接到正确实体的段落。Certify 分解问题、按需求分别检索，仅通过实体检查后才接受链接；对链接做 Horn 闭包得到证书或中止。
AI.result: 在检索、需求和链接正确时决策可靠，且在实体检查范围内完备。在三个含不可回答孪生问题的语料上池化，默认配置下显著优于搜索智能体、图检索与充分性判别器；相同证据下无需额外模型调用即可匹配专有模型的充分性标签；2100万维基段落上实体检查带来4–13个点提升；基于证书的答案正确率80% vs 全部检索段落57%。
AI.conclusion: 把充分性判断结构化为需求超图与 Horn 闭包是可解释且更准确的方案，实体检查对决策准确率关键，证书式证据还能提升答案质量。

title: SUDO: From Scientific Publications to Global Scholarly Discourse
summary: Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) support literature search, scientific discovery, and agent-assisted research. Yet, most approaches to SKG construction pre-specify the knowledge unit to be represented, typically named scholarly entities or contribution-level statements, and retain only the publication content expressible through that unit. This choice produces two dominant yet distinct paradigms: concept-centric SKGs that preserve entities and local relations, and statement-centric SKGs that capture high-level discourse in sentences. In both cases, the graph reflects a chosen extraction target rather than how a paper constructs and communicates knowledge. We introduce SUDO, the Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology, which defines how knowledge elements are organized and related to form a paper's research narrative, namely its scholarly discourse. Using linguistic principles that generalize across fields and tasks, SUDO enables each publication's scholarly discourse to be constructed from the bottom up as a coherent, source-grounded representation. Applied consistently across papers, the same structure connects their research narratives into a global scholarly discourse without discarding local context or provenance. We demonstrate SUDO's capabilities across a comprehensive suite of scholarly knowledge-modeling use cases and performance improvements on a downstream Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific QA task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUDO（学术上层话语本体），从语言学原则出发自底向上刻画论文的研究叙事话语结构，统一了概念中心与陈述中心两类学术知识图谱范式，并在多个知识建模用例及LLM科学问答任务上验证其能力。
AI.motivation: 现有学术知识图谱构建大多预先设定知识单元（如命名实体或贡献级陈述），仅保留可用该单元表达的内容，导致概念中心与陈述中心两种范式割裂，图谱反映的是抽取目标而非论文如何构建与传达知识。
AI.method: 提出SUDO（Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology），基于跨领域、跨任务通用的语言学原则，定义知识元素如何组织并相互关联以构成论文的研究叙事，使每篇论文的学术话语可自底向上构建为连贯、有源可溯的表示。
AI.result: 在覆盖广泛的学术知识建模用例中展示了SUDO的能力，并在基于LLM的科学问答下游任务上取得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以一致的SUDO结构贯穿各篇论文，可将研究叙事连接为全局学术话语，同时不丢弃局部语境与溯源信息，为统一学术知识图谱构建提供新路径。

title: Fair Division of Lotteries
summary: We study fair division of uncertain items, where the utility of each item is a random variable whose realization is observed only after the allocation is determined. This uncertainty creates a distinction between ex-ante fairness, evaluated before utilities are realized, and ex-post fairness, evaluated after realization. We examine to what extent these two notions are compatible. We first identify conditions under which ex-ante envy-free allocations maximize ex-post envy-freeness probability. These include two-agent instances where utilities toward the same item follow the same distribution from a convolution-power family. For an arbitrary number of agents, we establish analogous optimality results when the common generator is non-atomic or log-concave. Beyond convolution-power families, we derive approximation guarantees for ex-ante envy-free allocations relative to the optimal ex-post envy-freeness probability under log-concave or symmetric utilities. We also study the computational complexity of evaluating ex-post envy-freeness probabilities, establishing hardness results as well as pseudo-polynomial-time algorithms.

AI.tldr: 研究不确定物品的公平分配问题，探讨事前无嫉妒（ex-ante envy-free）与事后无嫉妒（ex-post envy-free）两种公平概念的兼容性。
AI.motivation: 物品效用为随机变量，且仅在分配确定后才实现，因此产生事前公平与事后公平的区分；论文关注这两者能否兼容及其程度。
AI.method: 识别使事前无嫉妒分配最大化事后无嫉妒概率的条件，包括同物品效用服从卷积幂族分布的两智能体情形；对任意智能体数，在公共生成元为非原子或对数凹时给出类似最优性结果；在卷积幂族之外，对对数凹或对称效用给出事前无嫉妒分配相对最优事后无嫉妒概率的近似保证；并分析计算事后无嫉妒概率的复杂度。
AI.result: 得到若干条件下事前无嫉妒分配最大化事后无嫉妒概率的最优性结论，以及在更一般分布下的近似保证；同时给出评估事后无嫉妒概率的困难性结果与伪多项式时间算法。
AI.conclusion: 在某些分布结构下事前公平与事后公平可兼容并实现最优，而一般情况下可近似，且精确计算事后无嫉妒概率具有计算困难性。

title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
summary: Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards. Agents make process errors such as insufficient exploration, unsound validation, coding bugs, and poor use of a fixed budget (re-running the same exploratory data analysis and baseline models in every attempt). We propose AdaPRA to address these issues: a persistent coding agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same task, with rubric-guided process supervision that identifies and corrects errors. Our process reward agent audits the agent's trajectory and workspace by executing checks, and adapts its rubrics to each task. We find that rubrics seeded from easier tasks generalize to harder tasks, with rubric adaptation further improving performance. With five attempts per task, AdaPRA improves an 80B Qwen model's leaderboard percentile by 24.5 points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 points on DSPredict-Hard while reducing process errors. We also show that supervision with rubrics mined from one base model's runs improves another (DeepSeek-V3.2), and that AdaPRA beats DataPRM, a competitive PRM for data science. We also share our code for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaPRA：一种持久化 coding agent 框架，跨尝试积累知识，并用可自适应、rubric 引导的过程奖励代理审计轨迹与工作区，在 DSPredict 上显著提升排行榜百分位并减少过程错误。
AI.motivation: 数据科学 agent 虽能自动化端到端 ML 流程，但在人类排行榜上仍缺乏竞争力，常出现探索不足、验证不可靠、代码 bug、在固定预算下重复做相同的 EDA 与基线模型等过程性错误。
AI.method: AdaPRA 采用持久化 agent harness，在同一任务的多次尝试间累积知识；过程奖励代理通过执行检查来审计轨迹与工作区，并为每个任务自适应调整 rubric。rubric 由较简单任务播种，可泛化到更难任务，且自适应进一步提升效果。
AI.result: 每个任务五次尝试下，80B Qwen 模型在 DSPredict-Easy 上排行榜百分位提升 24.5 点，DSPredict-Hard 提升 14.8 点，同时减少过程错误；从一个基模型运行中挖掘的 rubric 也能改进另一模型（DeepSeek-V3.2），且优于竞争性 PRM 方法 DataPRM。
AI.conclusion: 跨尝试知识累积与自适应 rubric 过程监督能有效提升数据科学 agent 的竞赛表现并抑制过程错误，且 rubric 具可迁移性，代码已开源以支持复现。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Controller Parameters in the Auto-Bidding System at Pinterest
summary: Auto-bidding systems in online advertising must balance competing objectives-maximizing budget delivery while minimizing cost per action-across heterogeneous campaigns under non-stationary market conditions. This trade-off evolves over campaign lifespans: early on, cost optimization dominates when budgets roll over; near deadlines, budget delivery becomes urgent. While PID controllers are widely used in production for their stability and interpretability, fixed tunings cannot adapt to diverse campaigns and shifting traffic patterns. We present RLBP (Reinforcement Learning for Bidding Parameters), a hybrid architecture deployed at Pinterest that uses RL as a meta-controller to select campaign-specific PID parameters daily while retaining PID for high-frequency bid adjustments. RLBP trains a multi-head Q-network using a relative-lift reward formulation normalized against the production baseline, and performs inference-time fusion that adapts the cost-delivery trade-off to campaign states without retraining.
