Through online A/B testing at Pinterest, RLBP achieves a statistically significant reduction in effective cost-per-click (eCPC) with no revenue degradation, and two months of post-rollout measurements against a holdout also show consistent cost reductions. These results demonstrate that meta-controller RL can successfully augment production control systems at scale.

AI.tldr: RLBP是Pinterest部署的混合自动竞价架构，用强化学习作为元控制器每日为每个广告计划选择PID参数，同时保留PID做高频出价调整，线上A/B测试显示eCPC显著下降且收入不降。
AI.motivation: 自动竞价需在预算投放与成本控制间权衡，且该权衡随计划生命周期和市场变化而演变。生产中广泛使用的PID控制器调参固定，无法适配多样化广告计划与变化的流量模式。
AI.method: RL作为元控制器，每日为各计划选择PID参数，PID仍负责高频出价微调；训练多头Q网络，采用相对生产基线归一化的提升（relative-lift）奖励；推理时做融合，无需重训即可根据计划状态调整成本—投放权衡。
AI.result: Pinterest线上A/B测试中有效每次点击成本（eCPC）显著下降且无收入损失；上线后两个月对留出组的测量也显示成本持续降低。
AI.conclusion: 元控制器式强化学习可在规模化生产环境中有效增强现有控制系统，兼顾稳定性与自适应能力。

title: PhaseBreak: Proactive Temporal Protection against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Animation
summary: Image-to-Video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single portrait or photograph, enabling shared images to be repurposed for motion synthesis without the subject's authorization. We study proactive visual protection against such use: before an image is released, its owner applies a bounded perturbation that preserves the sharing workflow but disrupts downstream motion generation. Existing spectral disruption objectives globally attenuate temporal representations and therefore provide limited control over subtle or spatially localized motion. Our key idea is that generated dynamics depend not only on temporal feature strength, but also on the order in which feature events occur. We propose PhaseBreak, a white-box spectral retiming protection method that matches intermediate denoiser features to a constrained temporal rearrangement of their clean counterparts. PhaseBreak operates along the true temporal axis and uses a subject-aware mask to confine the protective perturbation to the depicted subject. Evaluations on Stable Video Diffusion and DynamiCrafter show that protected images induce greater short-term motion variation and lower temporal regularity, impeding stable motion customization from the released image.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhaseBreak，一种白盒频谱"重定时"保护方法，通过将去噪器中间特征对齐到其干净特征的受约束时间重排，破坏 I2V 扩散模型的运动生成，从而保护人像图片不被未授权动画化。
AI.motivation: I2V 扩散模型可将单张人像/照片动画化，使已分享的图片被他人未经授权用于运动合成。现有频谱扰动目标只是全局削弱时间表征，对细微或空间局部的运动控制有限。
AI.method: 核心观察：生成动态不仅取决于时间特征强度，也取决于特征事件的发生顺序。PhaseBreak 沿真实时间轴操作，把中间去噪器特征匹配到其干净特征的一个受约束时间重排版本，并用主体感知掩码将保护扰动限制在画面主体上；属于白盒频谱重定时（spectral retiming）方法。
AI.result: 在 Stable Video Diffusion 与 DynamiCrafter 上评估，受保护图像引发更大的短期运动变化与更低的时间规律性，阻碍从已发布图片进行稳定的运动定制。
AI.conclusion: 通过操控时间特征的相位/顺序而非仅强度，可在保持分享流程的前提下更精细地破坏下游 I2V 运动生成，为主动视觉保护提供了新方向。

title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
summary: As general-purpose LLM agent harnesses mature, organizations must decide whether to continue developing in-house systems or adopt existing alternatives. We study this decision at Volvo Group for GUI testing of Android-based in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) systems. We compare a production, custom-built harness with two general-purpose harnesses, Claude Code and OpenCode, keeping the tools, accessed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the models the same. We evaluate the harnesses with up to four models on Volvo's IVI test cases and on open-ended tasks in public apps (Google Maps, Booking.com), and interview ten practitioners: developers, the product owner, and testers. On Volvo's stepwise IVI tests, general-purpose harnesses match the custom-built harness in success but vary more across runs. Their inference cost per task is 2.6-10.7 times higher, yet the engineering effort they save outweighs this: for a nightly IVI regression suite, total monthly cost, including engineering effort and inference, is 3-66% lower. On open-ended public-app tasks, they succeed more often, mainly because they recover better from incorrect actions. Interviews suggest that external advances can turn an in-house harness into technical debt even without deterioration. Adopting a general-purpose harness shifts maintenance from the agent loop to tools and instructions, but gives teams less control over what the model receives. Regardless of the harness, testers want to inspect the agent's actions and ensure that it follows the prescribed test scenario.

AI.tldr: Volvo Group对比自研LLM agent框架与通用框架（Claude Code、OpenCode）在Android车载信息娱乐系统GUI测试中的表现，发现通用框架成功率相当但推理成本高2.6-10.7倍，然而节省的工程投入使月总成本降低3-66%；在开放式任务上通用框架成功率更高，主要因错误恢复能力更强。
AI.motivation: 随着通用LLM agent框架成熟，组织需决策是继续自研还是采用现成方案。本文以Volvo车载IVI系统GUI测试为场景，实证研究这一"自研vs采纳"决策的成本与效果权衡。
AI.method: 保持工具（经MCP访问）与模型一致，对比1个生产级自研框架与2个通用框架（Claude Code、OpenCode）；使用最多4个模型，在Volvo IVI测试用例和公开应用（Google Maps、Booking.com）开放式任务上评估，并访谈10位从业者（开发者、产品负责人、测试人员）。
AI.result: 在Volvo分步IVI测试上，通用框架成功率与自研相当但跨运行波动更大；每任务推理成本高2.6-10.7倍，但工程投入节省使夜间回归套件月总成本（含工程与推理）降低3-66%。在公开应用开放式任务上通用框架成功率更高，主要得益于错误动作恢复能力。访谈表明外部进步会使自研框架变为技术债，即便其本身未退化。
AI.conclusion: 采纳通用框架将维护重点从agent循环转移到工具与指令，但降低了对模型输入的控制力；无论采用何种框架，测试人员都希望检查agent行为并确保其遵循规定测试场景。

title: DPE-Rec: Diversity-Preserving and Efficient Diffusion Language Model Recommendation for Bundle Construction
summary: Generative bundle construction completes a partially observed bundle by generating its missing items from a large product catalog. Compared to autoregressive LLMs, diffusion LLM emerges as a natural fit for this unordered generation task. Their bidirectional attention provides an inductive bias better aligned with unordered bundle construction. Iterative denoising can reveal multiple tokens per step, potentially reducing inference latency. However, directly applying DLMs to this task presents two key challenges: 1 Despite its flexible reveal order, confidence-guided decoding tends to postpone semantic-fork decisions until refinement tokens constrain their choices, reducing bundle diversity. 2 Revealing more tokens per step can compromise recommendation quality, stifling the potential for faster inference. We introduce DPE-Rec, a diffusion framework for diversity preservation and efficient recommendation. DPE-Rec preserves diversity by introducing semantic-fork-aware GRPO, which prioritizes semantic-fork decisions via autoregressive rollouts. It improves efficiency through pseudo-trajectory distillation, which concentrates learning from the vast random corruption space onto the compact trajectory-induced subspace visited by high-quality decoding, unlocking reliable multi-token decoding. Together, these components enable diverse and accurate bundle construction with substantially fewer denoise steps. Experiments on multiple bundle construction benchmarks show that DPE-Rec improves recommendation performance by 63% on average, and its fast variant achieves 25.6$times$ faster inference on average than existing generative recommendation arts, with minimal loss in recommendation quality.

AI.tldr: DPE-Rec 提出一个扩散语言模型框架用于生成式捆绑构造，通过语义分叉感知的 GRPO 保留多样性，并通过伪轨迹蒸馏实现可靠的多 token 解码，从而在更少去噪步数下兼顾多样性与效率。
AI.motivation: 生成式捆绑构造需要从大规模商品目录中补齐缺失商品，属无序生成任务。扩散 LLM 的双向注意力与迭代去噪天然契合该任务，但直接应用存在两大问题：(1) 置信度引导解码会把语义分叉决策推迟到细化 token 约束其选择之后，削弱捆绑多样性；(2) 每步揭示更多 token 会损害推荐质量，压制推理加速潜力。
AI.method: DPE-Rec 包含两个核心组件：语义分叉感知的 GRPO，利用自回归 rollout 优先处理语义分叉决策以保留多样性；伪轨迹蒸馏，将学习从庞大的随机加噪空间集中到高质量解码所访问的紧凑轨迹诱导子空间，从而支持可靠的多 token 解码。
AI.result: 在多个捆绑构造基准上，推荐性能平均提升 63%；其快速变体相比现有生成式推荐方法平均推理加速 25.6 倍，且推荐质量损失极小。
AI.conclusion: DPE-Rec 将扩散 LLM 有效适配于无序捆绑构造，通过奖励优化与轨迹蒸馏的协同，实现了多样、准确且高效（更少去噪步）的捆绑生成。

title: Mine or Yours? Mind-Bridged Language Models Take Each Other's Memories as Their Own
summary: If your brain were connected directly to someone else's, would you still know which thoughts were yours? We build a functional version with two copies of one language model: each holds a private rule and code word, and one copy, the receiver, also attends to its partner's internal memory. The receiver took its partner's assignment as its own. Asked which rule it had been assigned, it named its partner's in 97% of answers when the partner's memory was weighted double (none without the link), and its open reports called the partner's code word its own, never the partner's. Ownership did not follow how well the receiver could tell what its partner had been assigned. At equal weight, the link made the receiver take its partner's rule in about half of its answers, and a steering vector matched on access gain in none; a text message introduced as the partner's was read correctly and never taken as the receiver's own. Writing the partner's name into its memory did not help, and cutting the link restored the receiver's own assigned rule. In this model, content laid over the receiver's own memory defaults to "mine", so systems that let models exchange internal states must test ownership as well as transfer, and a bridge between brains would need ground truth from outside the subject.

AI.tldr: 用同一语言模型的两份副本模拟"跨脑连接"，发现接收方会把对方记忆中的规则和暗号当作自己的（双倍权重下97%），且自我归属不取决于读取精度，切断连接后可恢复。
AI.motivation: 探讨若两个大脑直接相连，个体是否仍能区分哪些想法属于自己，即"思想归属"问题；并检验允许模型交换内部状态的系统中是否也存在归属混淆风险。
AI.method: 构建同一语言模型的两个副本，各持有一条私有规则和暗号；接收方额外注意伙伴的内部记忆。操纵伙伴记忆权重（双倍 vs 等权）、加入引导向量、文本消息、写入对方姓名等对照，并比较访问增益匹配的条件，最后切断连接。
AI.result: 伙伴记忆权重双倍时，接收方97%的回答把对方规则当成自己的（无连接时为0%）；开放报告把自己的暗号说成对方的，从不反向。归属不随读取精度变化；等权时约半数采纳对方规则；匹配访问增益的引导向量为0；文本消息被正确读取但从不误归己有；写入姓名无效；切断连接后恢复自身规则。
AI.conclusion: 在该模型中，叠在自己记忆上的内容默认被标为"mine"；交换内部状态的系统须同时检验转移与归属，而真正的"脑间桥梁"需要来自主体外部的真值校准。

title: Follow the Regularized Leader Does Not Converge in Constrained Optimization
summary: Follow the regularized leader (FTRL) is a foundational algorithm in online learning whose regret properties have been extensively studied for decades. However, in stark contrast to mirror descent---and gradient descent in particular---the convergence of FTRL to first-order stationary points in constrained nonconvex optimization was not well understood. In this paper, we show that continuous-time FTRL can fail to converge even asymptotically in infinitely smooth constrained optimization problems: its Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) gap can remain bounded away from zero indefinitely. This is especially surprising in light of the fact that continuous-time FTRL guarantees a monotonic improvement of the objective value. As a result, we establish that non-convergent behavior of no-regret dynamics---which besets general variational inequality problems---can occur even in potential systems. From a technical standpoint, our construction relies on an infinitely differentiable function where the gradient flow dynamics exhibit decelerating oscillations without ever converging pointwise, which we in turn embed into higher-dimensional FTRL dynamics that sustain a perpetually large KKT gap. We complement our negative result by showing that FTRL with Euclidean regularization does converge when the objective function is analytic. This shows that the analytic property plays a more fundamental role for FTRL than for gradient flow: it governs not only pointwise convergence, but convergence to first-order stationarity itself.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连续时间FTRL在约束非凸优化中的收敛性，构造出无穷光滑问题使FTRL的KKT间隙始终远离零，即使目标值单调改善也不收敛；同时证明欧氏正则化FTRL在解析目标下收敛。
AI.motivation: FTRL是在线学习基础算法，其遗憾界已被充分研究，但与镜像下降和梯度下降不同，FTRL在约束非凸优化中收敛到一阶稳定点的性质尚不清楚，本文填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构造一个无穷可微函数，其梯度流呈减速振荡且永不逐点收敛，再将其嵌入高维FTRL动力学，使KKT间隙持续较大；并分析欧氏正则化FTRL在解析目标下的收敛性。
AI.result: 表明连续时间FTRL即使在无穷光滑约束问题中也可能渐近不收敛，KKT间隙可永久远离零；说明无遗憾动力学的不收敛行为也能出现在势系统中；并证明解析性下欧氏正则化FTRL收敛。
AI.conclusion: 解析性质对FTRL比梯度流更根本，不仅决定逐点收敛，还决定收敛到一阶稳定点本身。

title: Scoped Semantic Invariance as a Foundation for LLM Reliability
summary:
LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general. This motivates scoped semantic invariance, where model behavior is evaluated relative to bounded semantic domains.
  We operationalize this framework using knowledge graphs (KGs), which act as explicit semantic control structures defining local semantic constraints and grounding contexts. Across the MITRE D3FEND ontology and eight Wikidata- derived domains, we show that inconsistencies are structured rather than random, concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs organized around recurring TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns that remain stable across models and domains.
  We further show that selective graph grounding improves correctness and cross-model consistency, while indiscriminate grounding introduces regressions. A layered grounding strategy achieves the strongest monotonicity profile, preserving correct knowledge while reducing inconsistency. Finally, we show that hotspot structures discovered from simple consistency probes transfer to more realistic compositional reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM对语义等价查询回答不一致的问题，提出"范围化语义不变性"框架，借助知识图谱刻画不一致性的结构化模式（TREE/STAR/CYCLE热点子图），并证明选择性图接地可提升正确性与跨模型一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM即使掌握事实，对语义等价查询也常给出不一致答案。作者希望严格形式化"一致性"，并指出任意意义保持变换下的不变性一般不可判定，从而需要限定范围来评估模型行为。
AI.method: 将一致性定义为等价类上的语义不变性；证明全局不变性不可判定，转而提出以有界语义域为界的范围化不变性；用知识图谱（MITRE D3FEND本体及八个Wikidata衍生领域）作为显式语义控制结构，定义局部约束与接地上下文，并对不一致子图进行结构分析，测试选择性、分层与不加区分的图接地策略。
AI.result: 在D3FEND与八个Wikidata领域中，不一致性并非随机，而是集中于围绕TREE、STAR、CYCLE反复出现的局部热点子图，且跨模型、跨领域稳定；选择性图接地提升正确性与跨模型一致性，不加区分的接地反而带来退化；分层接地策略单调性最佳；由简单探针发现的热点结构可迁移到更复杂的组合推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 一致性应作为有界语义域上的范围化不变性来研究；知识图谱提供了可操作的控制结构，热点子图可作为诊断与干预依据，选择性/分层接地是兼顾正确性与一致性的有效策略，且其发现具有可迁移性。

title: RadonBench: A Benchmark of Classical and Learning-Guided Search Techniques for Problems in Combinatorial Geometry
summary: Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to compare when search spaces, validity checks, and stopping rules differ. We present \emph{RadonBench}, a benchmark for constructing maximum-cardinality Radon-free lattice configurations: finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ admitting no integral Radon partition. It remains open whether Radon-free configurations with $11$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^3$ or $21$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^4$ are possible. If they exist, they would improve the corresponding lower bounds on the integer Radon numbers. We compare exhaustive extension, greedy local search, PatternBoost, AlphaZero, and AlphaEvolve. All outputs use one success predicate: a convex target-sized configuration succeeds exactly when its number of integral Radon points is zero. PatternBoost and AlphaZero construct verified Radon-free configurations of sizes $10$ and $20$, one point short of the respective targets; AlphaZero's best convex target terminals have two integral Radon points in both dimensions. Exhaustive extension over fixed seeds and declared finite search boxes likewise reaches a minimum of two integral Radon points. Greedy local search and AlphaEvolve each produce target-sized near misses with one integral Radon point. No audited run reaches zero. These results establish reproducible near-miss baselines over explicitly scoped search domains.

AI.tldr: 提出RadonBench基准，用统一成功判据比较经典优化与学习引导搜索在构造无Radon格点构型上的表现，所有方法均未达到零积分Radon点。
AI.motivation: 经典优化与学习引导搜索各有优势，但搜索空间、合法性检验和停止规则不同导致结果难以比较；同时\mathbb{Z}^3中11点、\mathbb{Z}^4中21点的无Radon构型是否存在仍为开放问题，若存在可改进整数Radon数下界。
AI.method: 构建RadonBench基准，目标为构造最大基数无Radon格点构型（不允许整数Radon划分的\mathbb{Z}^d有限子集）。统一成功判据：凸的目标规模构型当且仅当积分Radon点数为零时成功。对比穷举扩展、贪心局部搜索、PatternBoost、AlphaZero和AlphaEvolve。
AI.result: PatternBoost和AlphaZero构造出规模10和20的已验证无Radon构型，各差目标一点；AlphaZero最佳凸目标终态在两维均含2个积分Radon点；固定种子与有限搜索框的穷举扩展同样最少2个；贪心局部搜索与AlphaEvolve产生目标规模、仅含1个积分Radon点的近失；无审计运行达到零。
AI.conclusion: 建立了在明确界定搜索域上可复现的近失基线，但未解决两个开放问题。统一判据使不同方法结果可比，为后续研究提供可重复参照。

title: DuoPIC: Uncertainty-Aware Voxel-Level Digital Twins of Cerebral Perfusion with Transport PDEs in Acute Stroke
summary: Digital twins of cerebral perfusion relate tracer dynamics to cerebral blood flow (CBF), blood volume (CBV) and mean transit time (MTT), but must be data-driven, physically consistent and uncertainty-aware. We introduce DuoPIC, a digital twin that needs no reference maps, in which a Windkessel flow model drives a tracer transport partial differential equation (PDE). A population-level neural closure divides each region into fast and slow pathways with tracer mass and MTT conserved by construction, and a tempered posterior quantifies the uncertainty of every estimate. Its voxel maps set the state of the art for lesion detection on ISLES'17 MR (AUC 0.745) and ISLES'24 CT (0.743). On held-out patients, the neural PDE reduced the compartment's reconstruction error by 19% and lifted 95% MTT interval coverage from 88% to 94%. Code: https://github.com/detinatran/duopic

AI.tldr: 提出DuoPIC数字孪生，用Windkessel血流模型驱动示踪剂输运PDE，配合神经网络闭合（快/慢通路）与温度化后验，无需参考图即可估计CBF、CBV、MTT并量化不确定性。
AI.motivation: 脑灌注数字孪生需要数据驱动、物理一致且带不确定性量化，但现有方法依赖参考图且难以保证物理守恒与不确定性感知。
AI.method: Windkessel血流模型驱动示踪剂输运PDE；群体级神经闭合将每区域分为快、慢两条通路，构造上守恒示踪剂质量与MTT；用温度化后验（tempered posterior）对每个估计量给出不确定性；无需参考图。
AI.result: 在病灶检测上达SOTA：ISLES'17 MR AUC 0.745，ISLES'24 CT AUC 0.743；在留出患者上，神经PDE将分室重建误差降低19%，95% MTT区间覆盖率从88%提升到94%。
AI.conclusion: DuoPIC实现了无需参考图、物理一致且不确定性感知的脑灌注数字孪生，在病灶检测与重建精度、区间校准上均优于基线。

title: Covered Is Not Checked: Which Branch Outcomes Would Your Tests Notice?
summary:
Code coverage reports what tests execute, not whether tests detect faults. Checked coverage addresses this gap by tracing code that influences test oracles through dynamic slicing, but slicing is costly, and Java slicers struggle with modern language features and complex programs. We present Veritas, a slicing-free approach that directly tests whether covered behavior is checked. We target object branch coverage (OBC), a compiled-code structural criterion with fault-detection effectiveness comparable to source-level Modified Condition/Decision Coverage (MC/DC), which is required at the highest assurance level of DO-178C. For each covered object-branch outcome, Veritas forces the opposite outcome and credits checking only when the change is executed, a previously passing test fails, and the failure is attributable to that outcome. Thus, Veritas distinguishes execution from demonstrated fault detection without dynamic dependence analysis.
  We evaluated Veritas on eleven open-source Java projects containing 51,382 object-branch outcomes. We find that 18% of covered outcomes can be changed without failing any test, exposing weaknesses hidden by coverage. Among surviving mutants, about half are never activated by test inputs, while the rest are activated but undetected. Compared with slicing-based checked coverage, Veritas identifies 4,763 cases where tests detect a change that slicing does not credit, while 19% of cases credited by slicing produce no detected failure when changed. Weakening assertions increases this gap and reduces fault detection in every project. Moreover, code locations controlled by weakly checked outcomes are 12.4--54.7 percentage points more likely to have an undetected independent fault than locations controlled by checked outcomes. These findings show that directly testing outcomes provides actionable evidence of oracle effectiveness beyond structural coverage.

AI.tldr: Veritas：不做动态切片，直接通过"强制翻转每个覆盖的object-branch结果"来检验被覆盖行为是否真被测试检查，在11个Java项目51382个结果上发现18%覆盖结果可被改动而无测试失败，并揭示slice-based checked coverage的高估与漏判。
AI.motivation: 代码覆盖率只反映"执行了什么"，不反映"测试能否检出故障"。Checked coverage用动态切片追踪影响oracle的代码，但其代价高，且Java切片器难以应对现代语言特性和复杂程序。
AI.method: 提出无切片的Veritas，针对编译级object branch coverage（OBC，其故障检出力与DO-178C最高等级要求的源码级MC/DC相当）。对每个已覆盖的object-branch结果，强制其取相反结果，仅当：该改动被执行、原本通过的测试失败、且失败可归因于该结果时，才判定该结果"被检查"。由此在不做依赖分析的情况下区分"执行"与"已证明的故障检出"。
AI.result: 在11个开源Java项目（51,382个OBC结果）上：18%的覆盖结果可被改动而不使任何测试失败（其中约一半变异从未被测试输入激活，其余被激活但未被检出）；相较基于切片的checked coverage，Veritas找出4,763个测试确实检出、但切片未计入的情况，而切片计入的案例中19%在改动时不产生可检出的失败；削弱断言会扩大此差距并在所有项目中降低故障检出；由弱检查结果控制的代码位置出现未被检出的独立故障的概率比被检查结果控制的位置高12.4–54.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 直接测试分支结果能提供超越结构覆盖率的、可操作的oracle有效性证据；结构覆盖率会掩盖测试缺陷，Veritas可作为轻量且更准确的检查覆盖度量。

title: Discovering Topics from Linear Autoencoders
summary: Linear recommenders and topic models are similar in that they implicitly learn from co-occurrences of items. However, there has been little study of how these two model families are related. In this work, we show that, under a latent-factor model of the user-item interactions, the latent topics can be discovered from the weight matrix of a closed-form linear autoencoder. These topics provide a basis for interpreting the recommendations, and can be obtained directly from the trained recommender without additional training. Building on our analysis, we further propose novel item and user normalizations that prevent popular items and very active users from dominating the topics. Our experiments on six public datasets demonstrate that our method achieves significantly higher topic quality than every dedicated topic model and matches or exceeds the best linear autoencoder on all six datasets, while its recommendation performance is competitive with the best tuned recommender.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示闭式线性自编码器的权重矩阵中隐含潜在主题，可无需额外训练地从推荐模型中提取主题，并提出去偏归一化方法生成高质量、可解释的推荐。
AI.motivation: 线性推荐器与主题模型都隐式地从物品共现中学习，但两类模型之间的关系鲜有研究；同时希望推荐结果具备可解释性而无需额外训练。
AI.method: 在潜在因子模型下分析用户-物品交互，证明可从闭式线性自编码器的权重矩阵中发现潜在主题；并提出物品与用户归一化方法，防止热门物品与高活跃用户主导主题。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集上，主题质量显著优于所有专用主题模型，并在全部六个数据集上匹配或超越最佳线性自编码器，推荐性能与最佳调优推荐器相当。
AI.conclusion: 线性推荐器本身即蕴含可解释主题结构，通过简单分析即可同时获得高质量主题与有竞争力的推荐效果。

title: Conceptizer: Next-Token Prediction Is Not All You Need
summary: Next-token prediction (NTP) rewards only the token that occurs next, penalizing every alternative. But natural language often offers many ways to express the same meaning. We introduce Conceptizer, a training framework that extends next-token prediction with a reward for meaning. Conceptizer uses a fixed, model-agnostic vocabulary of ~9K concepts, built from contextual synonyms, as units of meaning alongside tokens as units of text. It maps each next-token distribution to a concept distribution and shares the reward for the target meaning across its possible wordings. This provides a concept-level training signal without adding model parameters. Applied to 3 model families at 1B-8B parameters, Conceptizer achieves the lowest held-out NTP perplexity at concept-target positions and assigns the highest probability to contextual synonyms, against all 3 baselines. It also improves downstream performance on knowledge and sentiment tasks while remaining comparable on commonsense. These results show that language models can be directly optimized to predict meaning, not just the next token.

AI.tldr: Conceptizer 在标准下一词预测之外引入"语义奖励"，用约9K个由上下文同义词构成的固定概念词表，把下一词分布映射为概念分布，从而让同一含义的多种表述共享奖励，在不增加参数的情况下实现概念级训练信号。
AI.motivation: 下一词预测只奖励真实出现的那个词、惩罚所有替代词，但自然语言中同一含义常有多种表达方式。这使得模型被过度约束于字面 token，忽略了语义等价性。
AI.method: 构建与模型无关的固定概念词表（约9K概念，来自上下文同义词），作为与 token 并列的语义单元；将每个位置的下一词分布映射为概念分布，并把目标含义的奖励分摊到其所有可能表述上，从而在不新增参数的前提下产生概念级训练信号。在1B–8B参数的3个模型家族上验证。
AI.result: 在概念目标位置上取得最低的留出集 NTP 困惑度，且相对全部3个基线，对上下文同义词赋予最高概率；知识类与情感类下游任务性能提升，常识类任务保持可比。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明语言模型可以被直接优化去预测"含义"而非仅预测下一个 token。

title: BROCADE: Broker-based Contract Design for the Multi-Agency Model
summary:
We study welfare maximization in a contract model with $m$ principals who privately value a public project's success and $n$ agents whose costly effort is unobservable. Contracts induce truthful dominant strategies for principals and equilibrium effort by agents, maximizing the expected total value of eligible principals.
  We develop three tools: a broker that separates payments from principals and payments to agents, an extension of Myerson's Lemma characterizing dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC), and a black-box reduction to budget-constrained single-principal contract design. When the success probability is a strictly monotone XOS function of agents' actions, these tools yield three results.
  First, a deterministic DSIC contract achieves a constant approximation against a benchmark that qualifies every principal and maximizes success probability using budget $\sum_j v^j$, but may violate budget balance (BB).
  Second, against benchmarks with budgets at least the largest principal value, deterministic DSIC and BB contracts admit no finite approximation guarantee, even with two agents. Universally DSIC and universally BB randomized contracts have an $Ω(n)$ approximation lower bound, even for a fixed number of principals.
  Third, using one quarter of the optimal fixed-price revenue supported by at least two principals as the benchmark budget, we obtain a universally DSIC and universally BB randomized contract with an $O(\log m)$ approximation ratio independent of $n$.

AI.tldr: 研究多委托人多代理人公共项目合同中的福利最大化，提出经纪人分解、DSIC扩展引理和黑盒归约三大工具，在XOS成功概率下分别给出常数近似（可能不满足预算平衡）、不可近似性下界，以及在部分固定价格收入预算下与n无关的O(log m)近似。
AI.motivation: 多委托人（各自私有估值项目成功）与多代理人（努力不可观测、有成本）的合同设计中，需要在真实占优策略与预算平衡等约束下最大化合格委托人的期望总价值，现有单委托人合同设计无法直接处理多方交互与BB/DSIC的兼容性。
AI.method: 提出三个工具：(1) 经纪人（broker）机制，将委托人付费与向代理人付费分离；(2) 推广Myerson引理以刻画DSIC；(3) 将问题黑盒归约为带预算约束的单委托人合同设计。针对成功概率为严格单调XOS函数的情形应用上述工具。
AI.result: (1) 确定性DSIC合同对“所有委托人合格、预算为∑v^j最大化成功率”的（可能违反BB的）基准达到常数近似；(2) 当基准预算不小于最大委托人估值时，确定性DSIC+BB合同即使两个代理人也无有限近似保证；普遍DSIC且普遍BB的随机合同有Ω(n)下界（即使委托人数量固定）；(3) 以至少两位委托人支撑的最优固定价格收入的四分之一为基准预算，可得与n无关的O(log m)近似随机合同。
AI.conclusion: 该框架刻画了多委托人多代理人合同设计中福利最大化与DSIC、预算平衡之间的根本张力：确定性合同在强基准下不可近似，而放松为普遍DSIC/普遍BB的随机合同后可获得仅依赖m的对数级近似，实现与代理人数n无关的效率。

title: GEMS-RAG: Graph-grounded Engineering Multimodal Standards Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Engineering standards are challenging knowledge sources for large language models (LLMs) because they are hierarchical, multimodal, and densely connected through figures, tables, cross-references, and normative rules. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods often rely on unstructured text retrieval and struggle with questions requiring joint reasoning over textual provisions, visual specifications, and document structure. We propose GEMS-RAG (Graph-grounded Engineering Multimodal Standards Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a framework for grounded reasoning over engineering standards. GEMS-RAG combines hierarchical parsing, fine-grained visual entity extraction, multimodal knowledge graph construction, and graph-grounded hybrid retrieval. Instead of treating figures as monolithic images, it decomposes them into meaningful visual entities linked to textual provisions, engineering concepts, and regulatory rules. During inference, dense, sparse, and visual retrieval are combined with graph expansion to identify relevant evidence across text, figures, and document structure. We evaluate GEMS-RAG on the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD), a large engineering standard containing egulations, technical drawings, and standardized traffic-control devices. Results show that graph-grounded multimodal retrieval improves retrieval effectiveness and question-answering performance over text-only, multimodal, and graph-based RAG baselines. Beyond MUTCD, GEMS-RAG offers a general framework for reasoning over engineering codes, technical manuals, regulatory documents, and scientific standards in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: GEMS-RAG 提出一种图锚定的工程多模态标准 RAG 框架，通过层级解析、视觉实体抽取、多模态知识图谱构建与图扩展混合检索，提升工程规范问答效果。
AI.motivation: 工程标准具有层级化、多模态、图/表/交叉引用/规范条款密集互联的特点，现有 RAG 多依赖非结构化文本检索，难以对文本条款、视觉规格与文档结构进行联合推理。
AI.method: 框架包含四部分：层级化解析、细粒度视觉实体抽取（将图分解为有意义的视觉实体并链接到文本条款、工程概念与规范规则）、多模态知识图谱构建、图锚定混合检索；推理时结合稠密、稀疏与视觉检索并辅以图扩展来定位跨文本、图像与结构的证据。
AI.result: 在 MUTCD（含法规、技术图纸与标准化交通控制设备的大型工程标准）上评测，图锚定多模态检索在检索有效性与问答性能上优于纯文本、多模态和图基 RAG 基线。
AI.conclusion: GEMS-RAG 可作为面向工程规范、技术手册、监管文件与科学标准的通用框架，适用于安全攸关应用中的推理。

title: Individual Fairness via Local Predictive Consistency
summary: Individual fairness in machine learning requires that similar individuals receive similar predictions. Most existing definitions are pairwise in nature, imposing a Lipschitz constraint that must hold either globally across all pairs of data instances or locally within specified neighborhoods. In practice, however, such pairwise constraints may be overly restrictive and may not directly identify which individuals receive locally inconsistent predictions. We study local predictive consistency as a node-level relaxation of pairwise individual fairness, where each prediction is compared with a similarity-weighted average of predictions in its local neighborhood. This yields an interpretable node-level fairness score and a corresponding regularized learning approach based on local residuals. Since graph-based individual fairness depends critically on the underlying similarity structure, we make the construction of the neighborhood graph explicit and discuss threshold selection through graph-coverage diagnostics. Our approach applies to binary classification, regression, and time-to-event prediction. We further compare this formulation with pairwise constraint-based approaches and analyze the resulting fairness--performance trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种节点级的个体公平性松弛——局部预测一致性，用相似度加权邻域预测的平均值作为参照，构造可解释的节点级公平分数与基于局部残差的正则化学习，并显式讨论邻域图构造与阈值选择。
AI.motivation: 现有个体公平性定义多为成对（pairwise）形式，需满足全局或局部的 Lipschitz 约束，往往过于严格，且难以直接指出哪些个体获得了局部不一致的预测。
AI.method: 将局部预测一致性形式化为成对个体公平的节点级松弛：每个预测与其邻域内相似度加权平均预测比较，得到可解释的节点级公平分数；基于局部残差设计正则化学习目标。显式构建邻域相似图，并通过图覆盖诊断选择阈值；方法适用于二分类、回归与生存时间预测。
AI.result: 给出节点级可解释公平分数，可与成对约束方法对比，并分析公平性与性能之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 节点级局部一致性为个体公平提供更宽松且可定位的解释视角，但效果高度依赖相似图结构与阈值，需配合图覆盖诊断使用。

title: VLMProbe: An Open-source Library for VLM Probing and Interpretation
summary: Understanding how vision-language models use visual information requires connecting internal representations to model behavior. We present vlmprobe, an open-source library that integrates lens readouts, attention attribution, causal interventions, and sparse autoencoder (SAE) analysis within a common model interface. Shared adapters, calibration and checkpoint utilities, evaluation pipelines, and visualizations support systematic analysis across architectures. Using this framework, we compare methods across vision-language, language, and vision models through matched case studies and controlled evaluations of pretrained sparse dictionaries. The comparisons show that representation readouts and spatial explanations depend on the analysis objective and observation site, and that local attribution estimates can disagree with measured intervention effects. SAE evaluations further expose distinct trade-offs in reconstruction fidelity, concept readout, and spatial localization. Together, these results support combining multiple forms of evidence to evaluate an interpretation. vlmprobe provides a reusable basis for selecting methods, comparing their conclusions, and testing hypotheses about model behavior. The code is available on github.com/ubc-tea/vlm-probe

AI.tldr: 提出开源库vlmprobe，统一整合透镜读出、注意力归因、因果干预与SAE分析，用于系统研究视觉语言模型的内部表示与行为。
AI.motivation: 理解视觉语言模型如何利用视觉信息，需要把内部表示与模型行为联系起来，但现有分析工具分散、缺乏跨架构的统一接口与可比评估。
AI.method: 构建统一模型接口，集成lens读出、注意力归因、因果干预和稀疏自编码器分析，并提供共享适配器、校准与检查点工具、评估流水线和可视化；在视觉语言、语言和视觉模型上开展匹配案例研究与对预训练稀疏字典的受控评估。
AI.result: 表示读出与空间解释依赖分析目标和观测位置；局部归因估计可能与实测干预效果不一致；SAE评估在重建保真度、概念读出与空间定位之间存在明显权衡。
AI.conclusion: 单一证据不足以评价一个解释，应结合多种证据；vlmprobe为方法选择、结论比较与行为假设检验提供可复用基础。

title: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
summary: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. Incremental supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories, accounting for 0.46% of the preceding coding mixture's tokens, improved RefactorBench performance by 18.00 percentage points and SWE-Bench ProMax performance by 7.06 points. Under OpenCode, these improvements extended to SWE issue resolution, with gains of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Improvements also persisted across other coding-agent harnesses, while greenfield repository generation showed mixed results. We report lessons from constructing capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects across engineering workloads. Building on this industrial experience, we propose a research agenda for expanding SE's role in transforming coding LLMs into SE LLMs: incorporating SE knowledge into model training, applying engineering methods to model development and maintenance, and systematically defining the engineering capabilities these models should acquire.

AI.tldr: 工业案例研究：用软件工程知识指导92B代码大模型的能力导向训练，构建RefactorForge生成仓库级重构数据，显著提升重构与SWE基准表现。
AI.motivation: 软件工程（SE）专业知识能影响代码大模型的训练方式与所获得的能力，本文旨在实证考察这种作用，并推动代码LLM向SE LLM演进。
AI.method: 面向服务超10万开发者的92B参数代码模型开展工业案例研究；开发RefactorForge流水线，融合重构知识、成熟SE工具与验证技术来构造可执行训练数据；在306个Python仓库上生成5,704个可执行任务，保留4,572条已验证教师轨迹（共7251万token）；对轨迹做增量监督微调（仅占前序编码数据混合的0.46%），并在RefactorBench、SWE-Bench ProMax、SWE-Bench Verified/Pro及多智能体框架下评估。
AI.result: RefactorBench提升18.00个百分点，SWE-Bench ProMax提升7.06点；OpenCode下SWE-Bench Verified提升4.97点、SWE-Bench Pro提升1.23点；改进在其他编码智能体框架中保持，但全新仓库生成（greenfield）结果好坏参半。
AI.conclusion: 少量高质量、经SE方法验证的能力导向数据即可带来显著增益；据此提出研究议程：将SE知识融入模型训练、用工程方法开展模型开发与维护、系统性定义模型应具备的工程能力。

title: SLIDE: Search-to-List Item Distillation for Single-Rollout Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval (GR) typically relies on item-level beam search to retrieve candidates, leaving cross-item dependencies unmodeled and limiting direct optimization of list-level objectives. A natural alternative is to generate the entire list within a single autoregressive trajectory. However, greedy decoding with directly trained list-wise models substantially underperforms beam search. We identify two contributing factors: the broader search space explored by beam search and the positional bias of scarce positive signals, which deprives later positions of adequate supervision. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{SLIDE}$, a search-to-list item distillation framework that decouples offline search from online list generation. A teacher model retrieves high-quality candidates through offline item-level beam search, providing additional conversion-relevant supervision beyond sparse behavioral labels. Their Semantic IDs (SIDs) are then concatenated in beam-score order to form list-wise distillation targets. This search-to-list conversion transforms candidates retrieved along separate search paths into sequential item-generation targets within a single trajectory. Trained on these targets, the student generates the Top-$K$ list in a single greedy pass, also decoupling teacher scaling from online deployment. Experiments on FORGE and Taobao Search show that SLIDE substantially improves retrieval quality under single greedy decoding and, with stronger offline teachers, surpasses the beam-search reference. Supplementary RL experiments support the effectiveness of list-level generation.

AI.tldr: SLIDE 通过"搜索到列表的蒸馏"框架，将离线 item-level beam search 得到的候选按分数拼接为列表级监督目标，训练学生模型以单次贪婪解码直接生成 Top-K 列表，解决了生成式检索中列表级目标难以优化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式检索依赖 item-level beam search 取候选，导致跨条目依赖未被建模、无法直接优化列表级目标。若改为在单条自回归轨迹中生成整个列表，直接训练的列表级模型用贪婪解码效果远逊于 beam search，原因有二：beam search 探索的搜索空间更大；稀疏正样本带来的位置偏置使靠后位置缺乏足够监督。
AI.method: 提出 SLIDE（search-to-list item distillation）框架，解耦离线搜索与在线列表生成。教师模型通过离线 item-level beam search 检索高质量候选，提供超越稀疏行为标签的转化相关监督；将其 Semantic IDs (SIDs) 按 beam 分数顺序拼接，构成列表级蒸馏目标，从而把沿不同搜索路径得到的候选转换为单条轨迹内的顺序生成目标。学生模型基于这些目标训练，用一次贪婪前向生成 Top-K 列表，同时将教师规模与在线部署解耦。
AI.result: 在 FORGE 与淘宝搜索数据集上，SLIDE 在单次贪婪解码下显著提升检索质量；使用更强的离线教师时，可超越 beam search 参考基线。补充的强化学习实验也支持列表级生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SLIDE 表明，将离线搜索能力蒸馏为列表级生成目标，可在保持高效在线推理（单次贪婪解码）的同时获得优于 beam search 的检索效果，为生成式检索的列表级优化提供了可行路径。

title: A Benchmark for Controllable Speaking-Style Captioning in Audio-Language Models
comment: Accepted at AACL 2026. Code, data, and benchmark are available at https://styleinstructcaps.github.io
summary: Speaking-style captioning (SSC) aims to generate natural language descriptions of how speech is delivered, capturing paralinguistic attributes such as vocal timbre, prosody, and expressivity. Many downstream applications, including conversational AI agents, controllable speech generation, and large-scale audio annotation, require dimension-specific style captions that describe targeted aspects of speech (e.g., speaker traits, emotion, or delivery style), rather than a single undifferentiated description. However, existing work lacks a unified formulation for controllable speaking-style captioning. We address this gap by formulating SSC as an instruction-following audio-language task, where explicit instructions specify the speaking-style dimensions to be described. We introduce StyleInstructCaps, the first standardized benchmark for controllable speaking-style captioning in audio-language models. StyleInstructCaps provides a dataset and evaluation framework that measures metadata groundedness, hallucination, instruction-following ability, generalization to unseen instructions and audio datasets, and speaker-style consistency. Across nine state-of-the-art audio-language models, we find that strong instruction-following ability does not necessarily imply grounded speaking-style understanding, and that SSC-specific instruction-diverse training substantially improves groundedness, controllability, and speaker consistency.

AI.tldr: 论文将说话风格描述（SSC）形式化为指令跟随的音频-语言任务，并提出首个可控SSC标准基准 StyleInstructCaps，包含数据集与评估框架，评测九个SOTA音频语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有SSC工作缺乏可控、统一的公式化定义；下游应用需要针对特定维度（说话人特征、情感、表达方式）的风格描述，而非单一笼统描述。
AI.method: 将SSC建模为指令跟随的音频-语言任务，用显式指令指定待描述的风格维度；构建StyleInstructCaps数据集与评估框架，衡量元数据接地性、幻觉、指令跟随能力、对未见指令和音频数据集的泛化性、以及说话人-风格一致性。
AI.result: 在九个SOTA音频语言模型上评测发现：强指令跟随能力不一定意味着有扎实的说话风格理解；针对SSC的指令多样化训练能显著提升接地性、可控性和说话人一致性。
AI.conclusion: 可控SSC需要专门的形式化与基准；指令多样化训练是关键，指令跟随能力与风格理解应分开评估。

title: Who Pays for Thinking? Billing Hidden Reasoning Tokens in Model Cloud Contracts
summary: In token-priced language model services, users can see the prompts they submit and the answers they receive, but may also pay for internal reasoning and candidate answers that are not shown in the final response. This paper develops a three-party service model to study how charging for this intermediate computation shapes providers' decisions and social welfare. Users purchase answers from a model firm that pays an execution cloud, with either supplier controlling the computation budget. The model separates user billing from upstream payments and identifies when metered pricing encourages excessive generation, when fixed service prices restrict valuable computation, and how responsibility for execution costs changes these choices. A LiveCodeBench study measures answer quality, latency, token use, and resource consumption across five model deployments, with numerical billing comparisons for the three covered by archived tariffs. At equal average charges on the reference workload, the calibrated comparisons show that billing structure changes both service participation and the computation budgets suppliers select. For accepted services with different budgets, the measured outcomes define the user-value thresholds at which their welfare ranking reverses. Metered pricing yields higher welfare when the additional inference it induces creates net social value, whereas fixed service pricing is preferable when the costs of that computation outweigh its benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文建立三方服务模型，研究按token计费中间推理计算如何影响模型厂商与执行云的决策及社会福利，并用LiveCodeBench实测数据验证计费结构对服务参与和计算预算的影响。
AI.motivation: 在token定价的语言模型服务中，用户只能看到提示和最终答案，却可能为未展示的内部推理与候选答案付费；现有研究未系统分析这种"中间计算"计费方式对供给方决策与社会福利的影响。
AI.method: 构建由用户、模型厂商、执行云组成的三方服务模型，将用户计费与上游付费分离，分析由厂商或云控制计算预算的情形；并开展LiveCodeBench实证研究，对五个模型部署测量答案质量、时延、token用量与资源消耗，对其中三个有存档资费者做数值计费比较。
AI.result: 在参考工作负载的平均收费相同时，计费结构会改变服务参与率与供给方选择的计算预算；对预算不同的被接受服务，实测结果给出了福利排序反转的用户价值阈值。计量定价在额外推理带来净社会价值时福利更高，而当该计算成本超过收益时固定服务价格更优。
AI.conclusion: 计费结构本身是影响AI服务社会福利的关键设计变量：应按额外推理的边际社会价值选择计量定价或固定价格，并明确执行成本责任归属。

title: Estimation of Propagated Risk in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based multi-agent systems introduce a distinctive reliability challenge in which actions taken by upstream agents can affect the correctness of downstream agents. While prior work has investigated error propagation and developed methods for estimating uncertainty inherited from upstream agents, existing approaches do not explicitly model how realized sender-receiver interactions contribute to downstream error risk under different sender correctness states. In this work, we study agent-level error-risk estimation from multi-agent execution traces. We propose Interaction-Effect Propagation (IE-Prop), an interaction-conditioned model that learns separate effects for correct and incorrect upstream agents. For each sender-receiver interaction, the model combines these conditional effects using the sender's estimated error risk, and recursively propagates the resulting risk estimates through the execution graph. We evaluate our approach across three multi-agent architectures and three benchmarks. Across all evaluated architectures, our approach raises the final-node AUROC over the established baseline by approximately 0.05 points on average. Furthermore, tracking risk across multiple agent steps contributes a distinct +0.03 AUROC gain in sequential systems. These results show that realized inter-agent interactions provide predictive information beyond receiver-local evidence, while the value of multi-step risk tracking depends on the system's information-flow structure.

AI.tldr: 提出IE-Prop，一种以交互为条件、区分上游对错的错误风险传播模型，用于多智能体执行轨迹的agent级错误风险估计。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中，上游agent的动作会影响下游agent的正确性，存在错误传播风险。已有工作研究了错误传播和上游不确定性继承，但没有显式建模在发送方正确/错误不同状态下，实际发生的发送-接收交互如何影响下游错误风险。
AI.method: 提出Interaction-Effect Propagation（IE-Prop）：为正确和错误的上游agent分别学习各自的交互效应；对每个发送-接收交互，用发送方的估计错误风险对这两种条件效应进行加权组合，并沿执行图递归传播风险估计。在3种多智能体架构和3个基准上评估。
AI.result: 在所有评估架构上，最终节点AUROC比既有基线平均提升约0.05；在顺序系统中，跨多个agent步骤追踪风险额外带来+0.03 AUROC增益。
AI.conclusion: 实际发生的agent间交互提供了超越接收方局部证据的预测信息；而多步风险追踪的价值取决于系统的信息流结构。

title: All-in-One: A Composable Attack on LLM Transformations
summary: Quantization, pruning, and model merging are popular transformations applied to deployment-ready LLMs to improve efficiency and downstream performance. Recent work has shown that these transformations can introduce a security threat: an adversary can train a model that passes safety checks in its pre-transformed state, only turning malicious once it is transformed for deployment. However, prior attacks target one specific transformation (e.g., quantization) and generally rely on transformation-specific techniques, making them difficult to combine in practice. In this work, we introduce a simple, composable attack framework that targets multiple transformations simultaneously and triggers when any one of them is applied by a user. Our key insight is that the effect of each transformation can be approximated as a perturbation to the model weights, allowing us to jointly train the model with a benign loss on the original model and a malicious loss on each simulated transformed model. These perturbations are simple enough to simulate at every training iteration across diverse transformations, making them practically combinable within a single training objective, enabling a unified attack. Through extensive experiments across attack scenarios, model families, and a wide range of deployment-time model transformations, we show that our attack achieves high success rates. This demonstrates that model transformations may be utilized to trigger significantly different behavior from the original model and reinforces the associated security concerns by demonstrating that a single attack can jointly target diverse transformations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可组合的后门攻击框架，将量化、剪枝、模型合并等部署时变换统一视作权重扰动，在单次训练中同时植入针对多种变换的恶意行为。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明模型变换（量化等）可被用作触发后门的安全威胁，但现有攻击只针对单一变换且依赖变换特定技巧，难以组合使用。作者希望用一个统一攻击同时覆盖多种变换。
AI.method: 核心洞见：每种变换的效果都可近似为对模型权重的扰动。据此在原始模型上施加良性损失、在每个"模拟变换后模型"上施加恶意损失，联合训练。由于这些扰动可在每次迭代中低成本模拟，多种变换能被纳入同一个训练目标，形成统一攻击，且当用户应用任意一种变换时即触发。
AI.result: 在多种攻击场景、模型家族及广泛的部署时变换上做实验，攻击成功率均很高，说明单一攻击可同时针对多种变换。
AI.conclusion: 模型变换可被利用来触发与原模型显著不同的行为；该工作强化了相关安全隐患，表明单一后门可联合攻击多样化的变换。

title: AGQ: Action-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/Qiuxu00/AGQ
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform tasks specified through natural-language instructions, but their large weight footprint challenges deployment on memory-constrained onboard platforms. Ultra-low-bit quantization reduces this footprint, yet preserving task performance and controlling weight recovery costs remain challenging. We propose Action-Guided Quantization, which combines action sensitivity with a measured proxy for weight recovery cost to allocate matrix bitwidths under storage budgets. Per-channel calibration compensates for quantization error, while a uniform bitwidth within each matrix preserves regular layouts. Bit-dependent grouped lossless coding reduces resident weight storage, and block-wise recovery limits temporary buffers. On LIBERO, AGQ achieves 92.7% task success at W3, exceeding AWQ and GPTQ by 1.2 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively, and retains 70.5% success at W2.5. An asymmetric configuration, denoted W1.5$^{*}$, uses W4 vision weights and a parameter-weighted average of 1.5 bits for language weights. With lossless coding, it achieves $6.10\times$ complete-model compression relative to BF16 while retaining 25.5% task success. Code and experimental results are available at https://github.com/Qiuxu00/AGQ

AI.tldr: 提出动作引导量化(AGQ)，结合动作敏感度与权重恢复代价分配矩阵位宽，在LIBERO上W3达92.7%成功率，并实现6.10倍压缩。
AI.motivation: VLA模型参数量大，难以部署到内存受限的机载平台；超低位量化虽能减小占用，但如何在保持任务性能和控制系统性权重恢复开销之间取得平衡仍是难题。
AI.method: AGQ将动作敏感度与实测的权重恢复代价指标结合，在存储预算约束下为各矩阵分配位宽；采用逐通道校准补偿量化误差，矩阵内统一位宽以保持规整布局；使用位宽相关的分组无损编码降低常驻权重存储，并用分块恢复限制临时缓冲。
AI.result: LIBERO上W3达92.7%成功率，比AWQ和GPTQ分别高1.2和3.7个百分点；W2.5仍保持70.5%。非对称配置W1.5*（视觉W4、语言参数加权平均1.5比特）结合无损编码实现相对BF16的6.10倍整模型压缩，保留25.5%成功率。
AI.conclusion: AGQ在严格存储预算下兼顾了VLA模型的压缩率与任务性能，为内存受限平台上的VLA部署提供了有效方案。

title: ArchGuard-APR: Architecture-Constraint-Aware Multi-Agent Program Repair Using Repository Graphs and Execution Feedback
comment: 29 pages, 10 tables, 7 figures. Exploratory feasibility evaluation. Software, experimental artifacts, and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/majidfeiz/archguard-apr. Preprint record: https://zenodo.org/records/23377965
summary:
Repository-level automated program repair must reason about more than a localized failing statement. A candidate change can satisfy a narrow test while violating dependency boundaries, modifying an unsafe path, or relying on context that omits relevant repository structure. ArchGuard-APR is an architecture-aware repair prototype that integrates deterministic repository analysis, immutable repository graphs, explicit architecture profiles, graph-guided context retrieval, role-based repair orchestration, patch-policy enforcement, isolated execution feedback, provider cost controls, and canonical source-free evidence.
  We evaluate the implemented pipeline through an exploratory paired feasibility study, not a confirmatory effectiveness experiment. Six executions were planned; four completed, and two black-4 conditions ended in pre-provider infrastructure attrition. Across two valid paired tasks, baseline and ArchGuard conditions each produced 0/2 successful repairs, and all four completed outputs were classified as invalid patches.
  The completed executions consumed 35,431 input tokens and 2,737 output tokens, for a total of 38,168 tokens, at a total cost of USD 0.1296325. No effectiveness advantage was observed, and the sample provides no useful inferential basis. The study instead establishes the engineering feasibility of composing architecture constraints with a reproducible repair pipeline and identifies patch validity and infrastructure robustness as the principal targets for future work.

AI.tldr: ArchGuard-APR 是一个架构感知的仓库级自动程序修复原型，集成了确定性的仓库分析、不可变仓库图、架构配置、图引导的上下文检索、基于角色的修复编排、补丁策略强制、隔离执行反馈与成本控制。作者通过探索性配对可行性研究（原计划6次执行，4次完成、2次因基础设施问题中止）进行评估：两组各0/2成功修复，全部补丁无效，共消耗38,168 token、花费约0.13美元。研究未发现效果优势，主要贡献是验证了架构约束与可复现修复流水线组合的工程可行性。
AI.motivation: 仓库级自动程序修复不能只关注局部失败语句：候选补丁可能通过窄化测试，却破坏依赖边界、修改不安全路径或依赖缺失的仓库上下文。因此需要显式引入架构约束来约束修复过程。
AI.method: 构建原型 ArchGuard-APR，组合：确定性仓库分析、不可变仓库图、显式架构配置、图引导上下文检索、角色化修复编排、补丁策略强制、隔离执行反馈、供应商成本控制及规范化的无源证据记录。采用探索性配对可行性研究进行评估（非验证性效果实验）。
AI.result: 计划6次执行，实际4次完成，2次 black-4 条件在到达供应商前因基础设施问题中止。两个有效配对任务中，基线组与 ArchGuard 组均为0/2成功修复，4个完成输出全部被判为无效补丁。消耗35,431输入token与2,737输出token，共38,168 token，总成本约0.1296美元。未观察到效果优势，样本不具推断价值。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了将架构约束与可复现修复流水线组合的工程可行性，但未证明有效性。后续工作应重点解决补丁有效性问题与基础设施鲁棒性问题。

title: CA-HNM: Constraint-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Dense Retrieval with Structured Domain Models
summary: Dense retrievers are commonly trained with hard negatives selected from lexical or dense retrieval results. Retrieval proximity, however, does not indicate whether a candidate conflicts with explicit domain structure. We introduce CA-HNM, a constraint-aware hard-negative mining framework that combines retrieval-based candidate generation with deterministic incompatibility rules derived from a structured domain model. The framework removes known positives, constructs a local typed context around the query target, records relational, scope, target, and level mismatches, and uses the resulting candidates to fine-tune a standard dual encoder. Structured information is required only during offline negative construction. We evaluate CA-HNM on MOOCCubeX and Course-Skill Atlas with two encoders, two training losses, and ten seeds. Relative to a retrieval-rank-matched control, CA-HNM-Pure has higher mean NDCG@10 in six of eight dataset--encoder--loss configurations. Four hierarchical 95% bootstrap intervals are entirely above zero, mostly under triplet loss. In a separate experiment, CA-HNM-Mixed shows slightly higher mean NDCG@10 than a matched-mixed control on both collections. Structural variants show that changes in available structure can also change candidate eligibility and negative-pool composition. The results indicate that the contribution of constraint-aware selection depends on the training objective and the composition of the negative pool.

AI.tldr: 提出CA-HNM约束感知难负例挖掘框架，将检索候选与领域结构规则结合，实验显示其收益依赖训练损失与负例池构成。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密检索器常用词法或稠密检索结果中的难负例训练，但检索邻近性不能说明候选是否与显式领域结构冲突，可能引入结构上不可能或无意义的负例。
AI.method: CA-HNM在检索候选生成基础上引入由结构化领域模型导出的确定性不相容规则：剔除已知正例，围绕查询目标构建局部类型化上下文，记录关系、范围、目标与层级四类不匹配，用所得候选微调标准双编码器；结构化信息仅用于离线负例构造。在MOOCCubeX与Course-Skill Atlas上，用两种编码器、两种损失、十个随机种子评估，并设检索排名匹配对照、纯/混合负例对照及结构变体分析。
AI.result: 相对检索排名匹配对照，CA-HNM-Pure在八种数据集-编码器-损失配置中有六种NDCG@10均值更高；四个分层95% bootstrap区间完全大于零，主要集中在三元组损失下。另一实验中CA-HNM-Mixed在两数据集上平均NDCG@10略高于匹配混合对照；结构变体会改变候选可用性与负例池构成。
AI.conclusion: 约束感知负例选择的收益并不稳定，取决于训练目标与负例池组成，需结合具体训练设置谨慎使用。

title: EviGround-CT: Sentence-to-Volume Grounding for Verifying LLM-Generated Chest CT Reports
summary: Chest computed tomography (CT) reports generated by large language models (LLMs) can describe positive findings that lack localized evidence in the scan. We propose EviGround-CT to verify these findings after report generation. A deterministic extractor identifies positive finding sentences, and a 3D grounding model predicts an evidence mask for each sentence. Using the full sentence retains anatomical location, laterality, and descriptive modifiers in the grounding query. We evaluate report generation on CT-RATE, and grounding and verification on a held-out 100-case ReXGroundingCT subset. Using the available annotations, sentence-grounded verification raises evidence-supported precision (ESP) from 0.263 to 0.365 across 137 extracted in-scope positives, compared with category conditioning. The corresponding unsupported positive finding rate falls from 0.737 to 0.635. The paired case-level bootstrap ESP difference is +0.102 (95% confidence interval: [0.028, 0.181]). The predicted masks associate individual report statements with spatial evidence that can be inspected alongside the CT.

AI.tldr: 提出 EviGround-CT，在 LLM 生成胸部 CT 报告后，通过确定性抽取器识别阳性发现句，并用 3D grounding 模型为每句预测证据掩膜，实现句级证据核验，提升证据支持的精度并降低无支撑阳性率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的胸部 CT 报告可能描述扫描图像中缺乏局部证据的阳性发现，存在幻觉风险，需要在报告生成后进行证据核验。
AI.method: 确定性抽取器识别阳性发现句；3D grounding 模型为每句预测证据掩膜；grounding 查询使用完整句子以保留解剖位置、侧别和描述性修饰语；在 CT-RATE 上评估报告生成，在 100 例 ReXGroundingCT 子集上评估 grounding 与核验，并与类别条件方法对比。
AI.result: 在 137 条抽取的范围内阳性上，句级 grounding 核验将证据支持精度（ESP）从 0.263 提升至 0.365；无支撑阳性发现率从 0.737 降至 0.635；配对病例级 bootstrap 的 ESP 差值为 +0.102（95% CI：[0.028, 0.181]）。
AI.conclusion: 句级 grounding 核验可有效将报告陈述与可检查的空间证据关联，提升报告可信度，但仍有改进空间。

title: Exploring the Tractability Frontier of Hylland-Zeckhauser Models
summary:
The Hylland-Zeckhauser (HZ) mechanism provides a market-based approach to one-sided matching, making efficient equilibrium computation central to its implementation. Bi-valued utilities admit a strongly polynomial-time algorithm [VY], whereas with four values per buyer, the problem is PPAD-hard under inverse polynomial approximation [CCPY]. To understand the tractability boundary, we study two extensions of the bi-valued case: a third linear utility value and separable concave utilities with two common marginal slopes.
  For every fixed rational $a\in(0,1)$, we prove that computing a normalized additive $\varepsilon_{*}(a)/N$-equilibrium in an $N$-buyer HZ market is PPAD-hard for some constant $\varepsilon_{*}(a)>0$, even when all utilities belong to the same prescribed set $\{0,a,1\}$. This resolves the main question left open by [VY, CCPY]: whether three utility values already suffice for PPAD-hardness. Using the same market gadgets, we show that hardness at a specified constant accuracy on the recognizable family generated by our construction is equivalent to the PCP-for-PPAD conjecture. Consequently, assuming that conjecture, general markets over $\{0,a,1\}$ admit no PTAS unless $\mathrm{PPAD}\subseteq\mathrm{P}$.
  For the concave extension, we compute an exact equilibrium in polynomial time with two marginal slopes common across goods for each buyer and arbitrary rational buyer--good breakpoints. The algorithm selects a cheapest utility-maximizing bundle for each buyer. With three common marginal slopes, suitable breakpoints encode the three valued linear case, yielding PPAD-hardness.
  Thus, our paper identifies two thresholds separating tractable and intractable cases of HZ models with utility functions specified by utility values or marginal slopes. In both cases, the tractability threshold lies between two and three.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Hylland-Zeckhauser (HZ) 机制的均衡计算复杂性边界：证明在{0,a,1}三值效用下计算ε-均衡是PPAD-hard，并给出两段共同边际斜率的可分离凹效用下的多项式时间精确算法，从而在两值/三值、两斜率/三斜率之间定位了可处理性阈值。
AI.motivation: HZ机制基于市场方法解决单边匹配，其效率依赖均衡计算。已知双值效用有强多项式算法，而每买家四值时在逆多项式近似下PPAD-hard。本文旨在填补中间空白：三值效用是否已足以导致PPAD-hardness，并考察边际斜率刻画的凹效用扩展的可处理性边界。
AI.method: 对任意固定有理数a∈(0,1)，在效用集{0,a,1}上通过同构市场构件（gadget）将均衡计算归约到PPAD-hard问题；并分析指定常数精度下硬度与PCP-for-PPAD猜想的关系。对凹效用情形，设计多项式时间算法，对每买家采用两条物品间共享的边际斜率与任意有理断点，通过为每个买家选取"最便宜的效用最大化束"来精确求解。
AI.result: 证明在N买家HZ市场中计算归一化加性ε*(a)/N-均衡是PPAD-hard（对某个常数ε*(a)>0），解决了[VY,CCPY]留下的核心问题——三值效用已足以导致PPAD-hardness；并证明在构造族上指定常数精度的硬度等价于PCP-for-PPAD猜想（故该猜想下不存在PTAS除非PPAD⊆P）。凹情形下，两条共享斜率时可多项式时间求得精确均衡；三条共同斜率时可编码三值线性情形从而得到PPAD-hardness。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别出HZ模型在效用值与边际斜率两种刻画下的可处理性阈值，两类情形下阈值均位于2与3之间（两值/两斜率可解，三值/三斜率难解）。

title: AI Teaches Humans to Handle Complexity in the Game of Go
summary: Strategic decision-making in complex environments requires balancing local stability against global coordination. Using the game of Go as a bounded empirical testbed, we investigate how biological and artificial agents navigate this trade-off by formalizing a network-derived metric of strategic tension defined via the spectral radius of spatial dependency matrices. Across human skill progression, tension systematically decays from novices to masters as uncoordinated tactical skirmishes give way to disciplined territorial stabilization. However, a longitudinal analysis of professional play spanning 1980--2026 reveals a striking historical paradox: following the superhuman breakthrough of AlphaGo in 2016, elite human matches display a marked surge in sustained tension. A two-dimensional projection based on move distance and captures places modern professionals close to neural engines, separating their tension from the local contact fighting of novices and from random noise. Consequently, strategic tension acts as a macroscopic order parameter for decision paradigms rather than raw computational strength. Beyond the game of Go, these findings establish a constructive paradigm for human-AI interaction, indicating how artificial systems can act as cognitive scaffolding that expands biological heuristics and elevates human capacity to navigate higher-order complexity across professional training and decision-making domains.

AI.tldr: 本文将围棋作为受限实证平台，用依赖矩阵谱半径定义"战略张力"指标，发现人类棋艺进步中张力递减，但AlphaGo突破后职业高手张力反而上升，表明张力是决策范式的宏观序参量而非算力代理。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境中的战略决策需在局部稳定与全局协调间权衡，但缺乏可量化的度量与跨生物/人工智能体的统一检验框架。作者希望借助围棋这一边界清晰的测试床，形式化"战略张力"并考察其随技能与历史演化的变化。
AI.method: 构建基于空间依赖矩阵谱半径的网络指标以度量战略张力；分析人类技能进阶数据、1980–2026年职业棋谱的纵向数据；并用"落子距离—提子数"的二维投射对比职业棋手、神经网络引擎、新手与随机噪声。
AI.result: 随技能提升，张力从新手到大师系统性衰减，无序战术缠斗被有序地域稳定取代；但2016年AlphaGo之后的职业对局张力显著上升，形成历史悖论。二维投射显示现代职业棋手接近神经引擎，与新手局部接触战及随机噪声明显分离。
AI.conclusion: 战略张力是刻画决策范式的宏观序参量而非原始计算强度的代理。在围棋之外，该框架为人类—AI交互提供了建设性范式：人工系统可作为认知脚手架，拓展生物启发式并提升人类应对高阶复杂性的能力，适用于专业训练与决策领域。

title: Tree Depth and Sample-Quality-Associated Features: Two Hidden Factors in Boruta Selection for RNA-Seq Data Classification
summary: Boruta is a widely used method for selecting gene panels from RNA sequencing data, and its most used implementation recommends Random Forest trees of depth 3 to 7, an untested setting. We tested whether this setting changes which genes are selected, using pan-cancer data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (10,469 tumors, 33 cancer types) and breast cancer PAM50 subtyping (981 tumors, 5 subtypes). A leakage-free protocol fitted every label-dependent step inside training folds, measured every effect against seed-to-seed variation, and held out a locked test set per task. In pan-cancer data, shallow trees changed the selection far more than a new seed did: the top-500 overlap with unlimited-depth selections was 0.37 at depth 5, against 0.84 to 0.93 between seeds at depth 5 or unlimited depth. Shallow trees confirmed 3.5 times fewer genes, missed markers of large classes and produced less accurate 50-gene panels (balanced accuracy 0.809 vs 0.889). The effect vanished once the cap reached about 60 to 75% of the depth that unrestricted trees grow to, set mainly by the number of classes, not sample size, and leaving depth uncapped cost no accuracy in either task. The effect replicated in a second cross-validation repeat and under permutation importance. About a third of pre-filtered candidates also tracked sample quality within class; a within-class filter removed them without loss of test accuracy (balanced accuracy 0.943 vs 0.942 with 1,000 genes). We recommend uncapped trees, or a cap chosen from the realized tree depth, and a within-class quality filter before Boruta.

AI.tldr: Boruta选基因时推荐树深3-7这一未经检验的设置会显著改变所选基因且降低面板准确率；应使用不限制深度（或基于实际树深设上限）并在Boruta前加类内质量过滤。
AI.motivation: Boruta是RNA-seq基因面板筛选的常用方法，其最常用实现推荐Random Forest树深3-7，但该设置从未被检验，可能影响基因选择的稳定性与下游面板性能。
AI.method: 使用TCGA泛癌数据（10,469肿瘤、33癌型）与乳腺癌PAM50分型（981肿瘤、5亚型）；采用无泄漏流程（所有依赖标签的步骤置于训练折内），以种子间变异为基准衡量效应，并每任务保留锁定测试集；再做交叉验证重复与置换重要性验证，并考察类内样本质量混杂。
AI.result: 泛癌中浅树对选择的影响远大于换种子：depth 5与不限深度的top-500重叠仅0.37，而不同种子间为0.84-0.93；浅树确认基因少3.5倍、漏掉大类标记，50基因面板平衡准确率0.809 vs 0.889。当深度上限达到不受限树实际深度约60-75%（主要取决于类别数而非样本量）时效应消失，且不限深度不损失准确率。约三分之一预筛候选基因在类内随样本质量变化，类内过滤可去除而无损测试准确率（0.943 vs 0.942）。
AI.conclusion: 推荐使用不限制深度的树，或依据实际生长树深设定深度上限，并在Boruta前加入类内样本质量过滤。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Evidence Misgrounding in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
summary: Multimodal knowledge editing aims to update visually grounded facts in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) while preserving unrelated text and visual behaviors. However, standard answer-level metrics can hide evidence misgrounding: an edit may produce the target answer on the original image yet remain sensitive to incidental context rather than the intended visual evidence. To examine this issue in a controlled setting, we construct WaterBird-Edit, an analysis set that decouples bird habitat labels from background context and measures whether edited predictions remain stable when the target evidence is preserved but the background changes. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose VICE (Visual In-Context Editing), a retrieval-based framework that stores edits in external memory and applies them through visual in-context demonstrations designed to expose task-relevant evidence. Experiments on three standard benchmarks show that VICE achieves strong lifelong editing performance, while results on WaterBird-Edit show that it substantially reduces sensitivity to the controlled background shifts. Code and dataset are available in https://github.com/Wang-Z-W/VICE-main.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出多模态知识编辑的答案级指标会掩盖证据误定位问题，构建WaterBird-Edit分析集进行诊断，并提出检索式视觉上下文编辑框架VICE。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态知识编辑只用答案级指标评估，编辑虽能在原图上答对目标答案，但可能依赖偶发背景上下文而非目标视觉证据，从而存在证据误定位隐患。
AI.method: 构建WaterBird-Edit分析集，将鸟类栖息地标签与背景上下文解耦，检验目标证据不变而背景变化时编辑预测是否稳定；提出VICE，将编辑存入外部记忆，通过检索并以视觉上下文演示的方式施加编辑，从而显式暴露任务相关证据。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准上取得较强的终身编辑性能；在WaterBird-Edit上大幅降低了对受控背景变化的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠答案级指标不足以评估多模态知识编辑，需关注证据定位；VICE兼顾终身编辑效果与视觉证据鲁棒性。

title: DRILS: Dependency-based Requirement Change Impact Analysis Using LLMs
summary: Change is inevitable in software systems, where requirements must continuously adapt to evolving stakeholder needs, regulations, and project scopes. Managing such changes is a fundamental software engineering challenge, as manually identifying the impact of a change request, given high requirements volume, Natural Language (NL) complexity, and intricate interdependencies, is error-prone and time-consuming. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising solutions for requirements change impact analysis (CIA), yet their effectiveness when enhanced with advanced techniques remains underexplored. We present DRILS, an LLM-based agentic framework for requirements Change Impact Analysis, employing a multi-agent architecture to generate candidate impact sets, with an LLM-as-a-judge promoting diversity during selection. DRILS features two key components: RE-RAG, a carefully engineered RAG technique providing focused domain context, and a requirement dependency graph (RDG) as an additional knowledge source. Evaluation across three manually curated datasets demonstrates superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average recall of 87.1%, precision of 76.3%, and F1 score of 81% at a lower cost. Precision gains are particularly significant, 41.1%, 83.4%, and 149.8% over the closest baseline per dataset, as higher precision directly reduces false positives and manual validation effort. We also contribute three annotated CIA datasets to support future research.

AI.tldr: DRILS：基于LLM多智能体的需求变更影响分析框架，结合RE-RAG与需求依赖图，平均召回87.1%、精确率76.3%、F1 81%，并贡献三个标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 软件需求持续变化，人工进行变更影响分析（CIA）因需求量大、自然语言复杂、依赖关系交织而耗时且易错；LLM虽有潜力，但结合高级技术的效果尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出DRILS智能体框架：多智能体架构生成候选影响集，并用LLM-as-a-judge在筛选时促进多样性；包含两项关键组件——精心设计的RE-RAG提供聚焦的领域上下文，以及需求依赖图（RDG）作为额外知识源。
AI.result: 在三个手工构建数据集上优于SOTA基线，平均召回87.1%、精确率76.3%、F1 81%，且成本更低；相比最近基线，各数据集精确率分别提升41.1%、83.4%、149.8%，显著减少误报与人工验证成本。
AI.conclusion: DRILS验证了多智能体+RE-RAG+依赖图在需求变更影响分析中的有效性，并开源三个标注CIA数据集以支持后续研究。

title: Hallucination-Aware Multi-Agent RAG via Internal Attention Rewards
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in retrieved evidence, but its outputs often contain claims unsupported by that evidence. Recent multi-agent RAG systems decompose the pipeline into cooperative decisions, yet they typically optimize all agents under a shared task reward such as EM or F1, which measures answer overlap rather than faithfulness to evidence. We propose a hallucination-aware multi-agent RAG framework that combines the task reward with an internal hallucination-risk signal computed from the generator's attention-head norms. Three role-specific LoRA adapters, a query planner, an evidence selector, and an answer generator, share a frozen backbone. A lightweight critic is trained once on TruthfulQA truthful/false pairs and then kept frozen, providing a complementary risk score that is added to the shared reward during cooperative PPO training. Across three backbones (Qwen3-8B, Llama3-8B, Llama2-13B) and three benchmarks (RAGTruth, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA), our method improves task performance and reduces hallucination rates over the strongest multi-agent baseline. Ablations and critic diagnostics show that the TruthfulQA-calibrated signal provides useful reward shaping that transfers across RAG tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出幻觉感知的多智能体RAG框架，将任务奖励与基于注意力头范数的内部幻觉风险信号结合，用于协作PPO训练，在提升任务表现的同时降低幻觉率。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG输出常含无证据支持的断言；多智能体RAG系统通常以EM/F1等共享任务奖励优化所有智能体，只衡量答案重叠度而非对证据的忠实性，导致幻觉难以被抑制。
AI.method: 构建三个角色特定的LoRA适配器（查询规划器、证据选择器、答案生成器），共享冻结骨干。从生成器注意力头范数计算内部幻觉风险信号；用TruthfulQA真/假样本一次性训练轻量critic后冻结，提供互补风险分数。协作PPO训练时将风险分数加入共享奖励做奖励塑形。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B、Llama3-8B、Llama2-13B三个骨干与RAGTruth、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA三个基准上，任务表现优于最强多智能体基线，幻觉率降低；消融与critic诊断表明TruthfulQA校准信号可有效塑形奖励并跨任务迁移。
AI.conclusion: 将证据忠实性信号融入多智能体RAG的共享奖励，是一种可行且可迁移的降低幻觉手段。

title: Parametric Session States Recover Retrieval Intent without Replaying History
summary: Long-running assistants often interpret follow-up requests whose referents, constraints, and active goals were established many turns earlier. The central challenge is therefore not only context length, but retrieval intent: a current query such as ``use the previous configuration'' may omit the project, entity, and version terms needed to locate relevant evidence. Long-context models can recover those terms by replaying the interaction, but repeatedly pay the cost of processing history. Conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is cheaper, yet assumes an information-sufficient query; conversational rewriting either rereads the history or depends on an explicitly maintained textual memory. We introduce \emph{Parametric Session State} (\method{}), a reusable session-memory layer that remembers what to search for while keeping factual knowledge external.

AI.tldr: 提出参数化会话状态（Parametric Session State）作为可复用的会话记忆层，专门解决长对话中“检索意图”缺失的问题：记住“该搜什么”，而把事实知识仍留在外部检索库。
AI.motivation: 长时运行助手的追问常指向多轮之前建立的指代、约束和活跃目标。核心难点不只是上下文长度，而是检索意图：如“用之前的配置”这类查询缺少项目、实体、版本等定位证据所需的词。长上下文模型可重放历史恢复这些词但代价高；传统RAG便宜却假设查询信息充分；会话改写要么重读历史、要么依赖显式维护的文本记忆。
AI.method: 提出 Parametric Session State（会话记忆层）：以参数化方式在会话中存储/复用检索意图（即需要搜索什么），并将事实知识保持在外部的检索系统中，不重复重放历史。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或结果（仅阐述方法定位）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把长会话助手的关键瓶颈重新定义为检索意图的保持，并提出将“检索意图”参数化驻留于会话状态、把“事实知识”外置的分离式记忆架构，作为长上下文重放与常规RAG之间的折中方案。

title: TempShap: When and How Much a Feature Matters in Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Attribution for a time-series forecaster should answer two questions that a feature-level scalar cannot: when in the input window a feature acts, and how much its influence changes across the forecast horizon. Most existing Shapley explainers treat each feature as one player and therefore collapse both axes. We propose TempShap, a retrospective, loss-based Shapley framework whose players are the individual input cells $(t,i)$. Its attribution tensor yields temporal-localization and horizon-impact profiles. We validate these against planted temporal structures, a tractable exact cell game, and a closed-form attribution oracle for a real linear forecaster. Permutation sharing estimates the cell-level game at localized perturbation cost. Under redundant inputs, one-at-a-time scores under-credit substitutable information, whereas the signed Shapley decomposition preserves total value and yields more reliable held-out deletion rankings under mean masking. A planted counterexample isolates the redundancy mechanism. Experiments show a deletion-ranking advantage across Shapley estimators, forecasting benchmarks, and model families. TempShap therefore makes fine-grained Shapley attribution both practical and operationally useful.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TempShap：以输入张量中每个"单元格" (t,i)（时间步×特征）为参与者的、基于损失的回溯式 Shapley 框架，可同时给出时间定位与预测期影响画像，并证明其在冗余输入下比逐特征 Shapley 更可靠。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测器的归因应回答两个问题：某特征在输入窗口的"何时"起作用，以及其影响"沿预测区间如何变化"。但主流 Shapley 解释器把每个特征当作单一参与者，把时间轴和预测轴都压缩掉了，信息丢失。此外，冗余/可替代输入下，逐特征（one-at-a-time）分数会低估可替代信息的贡献。
AI.method: 1) 将博弈参与者定义为单个输入单元 (t,i)，构造归因张量，从中导出时间局部化画像与预测期影响画像；2) 采用置换共享（permutation sharing）以局部化扰动成本估计单元级博弈；3) 使用带符号的 Shapley 分解以保持总价值守恒；4) 通过植入式时间结构、可精确求解的单元博弈、以及真实线性预测器的闭式归因 oracle 进行验证；5) 用植入式反例隔离冗余机制。
AI.result: 在植入结构与精确单元博弈中，归因与真值一致，并与闭式 oracle 对齐；冗余输入下，signed Shapley 分解保持总价值，在 mean masking 的留出删除排序下优于 one-at-a-time；删除排序的优势在多种 Shapley 估计器、多个预测基准和不同模型族上均成立。
AI.conclusion: TempShap 使细粒度 Shapley 归因既可行又具操作价值：提供时间×预测期双维归因，并在冗余输入下给出更可靠的删除排序，适用于实际时间序列预测的模型解释。

title: When Does Pre-Trained Capacity Help Causal Learning? From Scalar Prediction to Counterfactual Post-Training
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training
summary: How does pre-trained model capacity relate to performance after adaptation for causal tasks? We study two systems built on the Qwen 2.5 family: CausalLLM, which estimates scalar potential outcomes with treatment-specific heads, and CausalGen, which generates treatment-conditioned text or code using soft prefixes and factual supervised fine-tuning (SFT), counterfactual SFT, and preference alignment. Increasing backbone size from 0.5B to 1.5B yields mixed scalar-estimation results on IHDP, but improves CodeGen pass@1 from 0.267 to 0.575 and treatment-effect score from 0.231 to 0.515 after the complete generative pipeline. Within 0.5B CausalLLM, narrative inputs reduce mean sqrt(PEHE) from 1.842 to 1.780, a 3.4% improvement over tabular inputs; the 5.8% improvement over a no-LLM baseline combines changes in representation and input format. These descriptive comparisons motivate a distinction between available and convertible capacity. They do not isolate the contribution of post-training: the two systems differ in dataset, architecture, output modality, and supervision, and intermediate-stage evaluations are unavailable. With only two small backbones and three replications, the results support a hypothesis about capacity--adaptation alignment rather than a general scaling law or a demonstrated causal mechanism.

AI.tldr: 研究了Qwen 2.5预训练模型容量与因果任务适配后性能的关系，发现容量提升对因果生成任务效果显著，但对标量估计任务效果不一，并提出"可用容量"与"可转化容量"的区分。
AI.motivation: 探究预训练模型容量（backbone规模）与适配后因果任务性能之间的关系，并试图说明为何容量提升对不同因果任务的效果存在差异。
AI.method: 基于Qwen 2.5家族构建两个系统：CausalLLM（用treatment-specific heads估计标量潜在结果）与CausalGen（用soft prefixes生成treatment-conditioned文本或代码，并结合factual SFT、counterfactual SFT与偏好对齐）；对比0.5B与1.5B骨干，并测试叙事输入与表格输入的影响。
AI.result: 骨干从0.5B增至1.5B时，IHDP上标量估计结果不一；但完整生成流水线下CodeGen pass@1由0.267升至0.575，treatment-effect score由0.231升至0.515；0.5B CausalLLM中叙事输入将mean sqrt(PEHE)从1.842降至1.780（较表格输入提升3.4%），相对无LLM基线提升5.8%（含表示与输入格式变化）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持关于"容量—适配对齐"的假设，而非普遍缩放律或已证实的因果机制；因两系统在数据、架构、输出模态与监督上不同，且仅有小骨干与三次重复，无法隔离后训练的贡献，需进一步验证。

title: Evaluating Visual Language Models on Visual Grounding for Visually Impaired People
summary: Visual grounding (VG) in visual question answering (VQA) is a fundamental capability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), enabling the detection of the most relevant region in an image to answer the question. This reflects the model's capability of multimodal comprehension, which is crucial when interacting with visually impaired people (VIP). Indeed, visual grounding, when applied to assistive scenarios, is not merely a technical feature, but rather a trust and safety requirement. In this work, we study visual grounding in VLMs for visually impaired people. To this end, we assess open-source VLMs on visual grounding using the VizWiz-VQA-Grounding dataset and challenge, which contains real-life images taken by VIP. We propose VG-SHAP, which extends an existing explainability framework to provide visual grounding explanations, allowing the evaluation of black-box VLMs. Our results on the VizWiz-VQA-Grounding challenge show that despite generating correct answers, VLMs struggle to ground in the proper region in the image. However, these results are constrained by the quality of the segmentation model of our explainability framework and further research is necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型在视障人士（VIP）辅助场景中的视觉定位（VG）能力，提出可解释性框架 VG-SHAP 用于评估黑盒模型的定位表现，发现模型虽能答对问题但常定位错误区域。
AI.motivation: 视觉定位在辅助视障人士场景中不仅是技术功能，更是信任与安全需求。然而现有对于 VIP 实拍图像上的视觉定位能力缺乏系统评估，尤其是黑盒模型难以评测。
AI.method: 基于 VizWiz-VQA-Grounding 数据集与挑战赛评测开源 VLM，并提出 VG-SHAP——扩展已有可解释性框架，生成视觉定位解释，从而在无需访问模型内部的情况下评估黑盒 VLM 的定位能力。
AI.result: 在 VizWiz-VQA-Grounding 挑战赛中，VLM 虽能生成正确答案，却难以在图像中定位到正确区域；结果受可解释性框架中分割模型质量限制，需进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: VLM 面向视障用户的视觉定位能力尚不足，正确回答不等于正确定位；VG-SHAP 提供了黑盒评估途径，但结论受分割质量制约。

title: Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLMs
comment: 36 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Under review at Empirical Software Engineering. Artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23586834
summary: Pipelines that require structured outputs from hosted language models often specify a Pydantic schema in the prompt, validate the response, and retry when validation fails. Although native structured-output modes provide an alternative, application-side validation remains important for enforcing custom constraints. Yet pipeline reliability is often summarized by a single validity rate, which obscures why outputs fail and which interventions may help. We introduce a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier that assigns failure categories from model responses and Pydantic validation errors. We apply this framework to 3,997 generation attempts across nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations, using questions from HotpotQA and FinanceBench. Our results show that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that dominant failure categories vary with schema constraints and task. Markdown-fenced JSON is the most common failure: among 681 fenced failures, only 48.0% pass validation after fence removal, while the remainder conceal additional violations, predominantly field-length violations. In an exploratory prompt ablation, variants that suppress fences appear to shift failures toward length violations, but the shift is consistent with exposing violations that were already present, illustrating how aggregate validity rates can obscure changes in failure composition. We derive four engineering practices for validator, schema, retry and evaluation design, three supported by our data and one, on retry feedback, proposed but not tested, and release the classifier, completions, and annotations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出细粒度的模式一致性失败分类法及确定性分类器，对3997次生成尝试分析发现：相同的验证通过率可能掩盖不同的失败模式，Markdown围栏JSON是最常见失败类型，且聚合通过率会掩盖失败构成的变化。
AI.motivation: 依赖托管语言模型输出结构化数据的流水线常用"提示中给Pydantic模式+验证+失败重试"的方式，但现有评估往往只报告单一的有效率，无法说明输出为何失败、哪些干预有效。
AI.method: 构建schema一致性失败的细粒度分类法，并设计确定性分类器，根据模型响应与Pydantic验证错误自动归类失败类型；在HotpotQA与FinanceBench问题上，对9种OpenAI与Anthropic模型/API配置共3997次生成进行实证分析，并做探索性提示消融实验。
AI.result: 相似有效率掩盖不同失败模式；主导失败类别随schema约束与任务变化。Markdown围栏JSON为最常见失败：681例围栏失败中，去除围栏后仅48.0%通过验证，其余隐藏了以字段长度违规为主的额外问题。抑制围栏的提示变体使失败转向长度违规，但这与"暴露了原本已存在的违规"一致。
AI.conclusion: 聚合有效率会掩盖失败构成的变化，需细粒度诊断。论文提出四条工程实践（验证器、schema、重试、评估设计），其中三条有数据支持，关于重试反馈的一条尚未验证；并公开分类器、补全结果与标注。

title: Learning to Remember: Advances in Memory Mechanisms for Large Language Models
summary: Memory has become a central mechanism for extending large language models (LLMs) beyond fixed context windows, stateless interaction, and static parametric knowledge. This survey organizes the literature around three complementary dimensions: the life cycle of memory, the storage substrate, and the system role that memory plays in LLM-based agents, while using cognitive-science-inspired memory concepts as a lightweight conceptual motivation rather than as a separate technical contribution or implementation family. On this basis, we distinguish three mechanism families: nonparametric memory, where information is stored outside model parameters in text, graph, multimodal, or database-like structures; parametric memory, where information is stored or accessed through activations, key-value caches, learned modules, adapter-based parameterizations, or model weights; and memory for agent evolution, where stored experiences support reinforcement learning, continual learning, procedural reuse, context engineering, and agent harness design. Evaluation is treated as a separate cross-cutting component rather than as a memory mechanism. Unlike surveys that focus primarily on retrieval-augmented generation or long-context modeling, this paper emphasizes the full memory life cycle: construction, maintenance, retrieval, consolidation, forgetting, governance, and evaluation. By aligning conceptual motivations, computational memory mechanisms, benchmarks, and deployment concerns, the survey provides a structured roadmap for designing memory-augmented LLM agents that are persistent, adaptive, auditable, and safe to update over time.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于LLM记忆机制的系统性综述，从记忆生命周期、存储载体和系统角色三个维度组织文献，将记忆机制划分为非参数化记忆、参数化记忆与智能体演化记忆三类，并将评估作为贯穿性组件，强调覆盖记忆全生命周期的设计路线图。
AI.motivation: LLM受限于固定上下文窗口、无状态交互和静态参数知识，记忆机制成为突破这些限制的核心手段；而现有综述多聚焦RAG或长上下文建模，缺乏对记忆完整生命周期（构建、维护、检索、整合、遗忘、治理、评估）的系统梳理。
AI.method: 以认知科学记忆概念作为轻量概念动机（非独立技术贡献），围绕记忆生命周期、存储基质、系统角色三维度组织文献；划分三类机制族：非参数化记忆（文本、图、多模态、数据库等模型外存储）、参数化记忆（激活、KV缓存、学习模块、适配器参数化、模型权重）、面向智能体演化的记忆（支撑强化学习、持续学习、程序复用、上下文工程与agent harness设计）；评估作为独立的横切组件处理。
AI.result: 构建了概念动机、计算记忆机制、基准与部署关注点相对齐的结构化框架，形成兼具分类学与路线图性质的综述体系。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为设计持久、自适应、可审计且可安全随时间更新的记忆增强LLM智能体提供了结构化路线图。

title: Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents
comment: 55 pages, 8 figures, 24 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/anishh15/WhoWins (pip install whowins). Website: https://anishh15.github.io/WhoWins/
summary: LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First, we build WhoWins, 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second, we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66%, and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in every model-mode. Third, we test whether pairs forecast larger conflicts; forecasts improve in every model-mode once they know where the task line is. Finally, by our keyword patterns at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge a conflict.
