Instead of per-head keys and values, MLA caches a compressed KV latent that is up-projected into keys and values at decode time, together with a narrow positional key that carries position information into the attention score. Existing KV-cache quantization methods are designed around the keys and values of standard attention and do not account for what MLA actually caches, which costs accuracy at low bit widths. We analyze the MLA cache both in activation distribution and in how quantization error propagates to the attention output, and show that the two cached tensors play different roles: the latent mainly supplies the values, whereas the positional key dominates the attention score. We therefore propose RAQ-MLA (Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches), which fits an invertible transform to each cached tensor against the error that tensor delivers to the attention output: attention-weighted value error for the latent and score perturbation for the positional key. Without training, RAQ-MLA quantizes the full MLA cache to about 2.5 bits per element, a 6.5x increase in theoretical KV-cache capacity, while remaining nearly lossless on reasoning and coding tasks across four MLA models.

AI.tldr: 提出RAQ-MLA，一种角色感知的无训练MLA KV缓存量化方法，将MLA缓存压缩到约2.5比特/元素（理论容量提升6.5倍），在四个MLA模型上于推理与编程任务近乎无损。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存量化方法针对标准注意力的key/value设计，未考虑MLA实际缓存的内容（压缩的KV潜向量+窄位置键），导致低比特位下精度损失。作者需分析MLA两类缓存张量的不同角色并针对性量化。
AI.method: 对MLA缓存做激活分布分析与量化误差向注意力输出传播的分析，发现潜向量主要提供value信息、位置键主导注意力分数。据此为每个缓存张量拟合一个可逆变换：潜向量对齐到注意力加权的value误差，位置键对齐到分数扰动误差。方法无需训练。
AI.result: 将完整MLA缓存量化至约2.5比特/元素，理论上KV缓存容量提升6.5倍，并在四个MLA模型的推理和编程任务上保持近乎无损性能。
AI.conclusion: 针对MLA缓存结构角色差异的定制化量化优于通用KV量化，可在极低比特下实现近乎无损的缓存压缩，为MLA模型的高效推理提供实用方案。

title: RBGA: Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration for Offline-to-Online Safe Reinforcement Learning in Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires robots to leverage existing datasets for rapid skill acquisition while maintaining safety during real-world deployment to prevent damage to the robot or its surroundings. Offline-to-online safe reinforcement learning (O2O safe RL) provides a promising solution for this problem by leveraging prior experience for online improvement under safety constraints, thereby mitigating the sample inefficiency and exploration risk of learning safe policies from scratch. However, existing O2O safe RL approaches do not explicitly account for the safety budget already consumed when making decisions within an episode. Excessive cost incurred early can therefore leave little room for subsequent exploration and policy improvement. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{R}esidual-\textbf{B}udget \textbf{G}uide \textbf{A}rbitration (RBGA), an algorithm that explicitly tracks the remaining episode safety budget and uses it to adaptively select between offline guidance and the evolving online policy. At each step, RBGA compares the cost-to-go estimates of the guide and online actions against the remaining budget, enabling step-wise action arbitration throughout the episode. We provide theoretical analysis characterizing the safety implications of residual-budget-based selection and its effect on guide-assisted exploration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RBGA enables effective online policy improvement while maintaining strong safety performance. Our code is available at this \href{https://github.com/sii-pilab}{link}.

AI.tldr: RBGA提出显式跟踪回合剩余安全预算，并在离线引导与在线策略之间逐步仲裁动作选择，以提升离线到在线安全RL的技能习得与安全性。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作要求机器人借助已有数据快速学会技能，同时部署中需保证安全。离线到在线安全RL（O2O safe RL）可利用先验经验在安全约束下在线改进，避免从零学习的样本低效和探索风险。但现有方法在回合内决策时未显式考虑已消耗的安全预算，早期成本过高会导致后续探索与策略改进空间不足。
AI.method: 提出Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration（RBGA）。算法显式追踪回合剩余安全预算，每一步比较引导动作与在线动作的cost-to-go估计与剩余预算，从而自适应地在离线引导和演化的在线策略之间进行逐步动作仲裁；并给出理论分析刻画基于剩余预算的选择对安全性及引导辅助探索的影响。
AI.result: 大量实验表明RBGA在保持较强安全性能的同时实现了有效的在线策略改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过剩余预算驱动的逐步仲裁，RBGA弥补了现有O2O safe RL忽视回合内已消耗预算的缺陷，兼顾安全约束与在线技能提升。

title: Fast Instinct, Slow Reason: A Dual-Speed Agentic Framework for Self-Configuring Multi-Object Tracking in Satellite Video
summary: Multi-object tracking in satellite video underpins persistent monitoring, yet offline-tuned trackers lack the onboard intelligence and efficiency to adapt within an observation of tens of seconds. The root is that adaptation still means relabelling and retraining the detector, which cannot run on board in time. Tuning the tracker configuration strongly controls accuracy without touching the network, yet search needs labelled or proxy evaluations, and a language agent costs seconds and tokens per decision. We propose a dual-speed agentic framework pairing a fast instinct compiled offline with a slow reason serving the mission. Its algorithm, Arbitration of Unlabelled Shortlists from Prior Experience, or AUSPEX, learns a covering shortlist and a label-free ranker from labelled source tasks and commits one configuration per sequence. Its system, a Cascaded Onboard Runtime with Verified Uplinked Skills, or CORVUS, cascades reflex, skill, and agent layers, so that a verified skill commits 2.5 s into each observation while a language agent serves natural- language missions. On SatMTB and SatVideoDT with three recent detectors, AUSPEX raises IDF1 by 2.84 to 2.94 points and MOTA by 3.21 to 3.29 points on average without target labels, balances accuracy and labels best among sixteen methods, and loses at most 0.28 IDF1 points at 1.25 tracking passes. CORVUS executes four missions with execution accuracy up to 0.99 and target recall at the perception ceiling, spends no token on the routine decision, runs on Jetson Xavier NX, and hosts fifteen language models from six families without altering any commitment, demonstrating its extensibility and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出双速智能体框架（AUSPEX算法 + CORVUS系统），在星上不重训检测器的前提下自适应调优跟踪配置，提升卫星视频多目标跟踪精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 卫星视频多目标跟踪需持续监测，但在数十秒观测内离线调优的跟踪器缺乏星上自适应智能与效率。根源在于自适应仍依赖重标注与重训检测器，无法及时在星上运行；而调优跟踪器配置虽可控制精度却需标注或代理评估，语言智能体每秒决策又耗费时间与token。
AI.method: AUSPEX：从有标注源任务学习覆盖型候选短列表与无标签排序器，每条序列提交一个配置，无需目标标签。CORVUS：级联式星上运行时，含反射、技能、智能体三层，已验证技能在观测2.5秒内提交决策，语言智能体负责自然语言任务；含经验证可上行的技能。
AI.result: 在SatMTB与SatVideoDT上配合三种近期检测器，AUSPEX无目标标签下IDF1平均提升2.84–2.94点、MOTA提升3.21–3.29点；在十六种方法中精度与标注平衡最佳，1.25次跟踪通过时IDF1损失≤0.28。CORVUS四任务执行准确率达0.99，目标召回达感知上限，常规决策零token，运行于Jetson Xavier NX，支持六族十五个语言模型且不改变任何提交。
AI.conclusion: 通过算法与系统的双速协同设计，实现了无需标注、低成本、可星上部署的卫星视频跟踪自适应，并具备良好的可扩展性与泛化能力。

title: Thinking-in-Bets at Test Time Reduces Sycophantic Revisions in LLM Agents
summary: Language model agents often abandon correct work when a user challenges it, yet simply telling them to stand firm makes them ignore real mistakes. Once an agent reads a complaint, it tends to discount its own earlier checks in order to agree with the user. We introduce Thinking-in-Bets, a training-free method in which an agent writes a short private record of its main claims, the checks supporting them, and its confidence before reading user feedback. When challenged, the agent consults this Claim Checklist to keep verified work intact while investigating uncertain or newly challenged parts. We evaluate five Gemini models (3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.5 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.8 Flash, and 4.0 Argon) across eight benchmarks: SWE-Together, SWE-Interact, and DeepSWE for software engineering, Agents' Last Exam for professional reports, Humanity's Last Exam and SycEval for academic reasoning, Vals Finance for financial analysis, and Terminal-Bench for command-line tasks. Recording claims before criticism nearly eliminates false reversals in patch review and protects passing report drafts under mistaken pushback, whereas writing the same record after reading the complaint recovers very little of the gain. In multi-turn coding, pre-reply claim records substantially reduce unnecessary file edits after mistaken complaints, and gating the record so it is written only when the agent is uncertain lowers token overhead while fixing more real bugs than the baseline. Even in non-interactive tasks without user feedback, listing the key claims in a draft and re-checking the weakest one before submission improves both answer accuracy and confidence estimates across all tested models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 Thinking-in-Bets：让智能体在读取用户反馈前，先私密记录核心主张、支撑检查与置信度（Claim Checklist），从而在被质疑时既不被错误投诉带偏，也不固执己见。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体在被用户质疑时常放弃原本正确的结论；而简单命令其"坚持己见"又会让它无视真实错误。根源在于读到投诉后，模型会贬低自己先前的核查结果以迎合用户。
AI.method: 免训练方案：在接触用户反馈之前，写下简短私密的"主张清单"（主要声明、支持性检查、置信度）。受到质疑时据此清单保留已验证工作，同时排查不确定或新被质疑的部分；并可加门控，仅在不确定时才写清单。
AI.result: 在五个 Gemini 模型（3.5 Flash-Lite 至 4.0 Argon）与八个基准（SWE-Together、SWE-Interact、DeepSWE、Agents' Last Exam、HLE、SycEval、Vals Finance、Terminal-Bench）上：事前记录几乎消除补丁评审中的错误反转，并在误投诉下保住通过的报告草稿；事后补记几乎无收益；多轮编程中显著减少无谓改文件，门控版降低 token 开销且修复更多真实 bug；无反馈的单轮任务中，列出关键主张并复核最弱一环也提升准确率与置信度校准。
AI.conclusion: 关键不在"是否写清单"，而在"何时写"——在接触批评前固化自我核查可同时抑制谄媚式反转与盲目固执，且无需训练即可推广到交互式与非交互式任务。

title: RefinedGAW: A Refined German Academic Web Dataset
comment: 26 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 13th Web as Corpus Workshop (WaC-13), 2026 (non-archival)
summary: The largest open German text datasets are built from broad web crawls, which provide scale but limited coverage of specific domains. We introduce RefinedGAW, a processed and annotated resource derived from 26 semi-annual crawls of the German Academic Web, totaling 122 million documents and 314 billion tokens, with full crawl and capture history of every text. Documents labeled as academic research account for 84% of German RefinedGAW tokens across HTML and PDF. At 87.6 billion tokens, this exceeds the 64.9 billion tokens in the German subsets of FineWeb2 and FinePDFs, despite their almost five-times-larger combined size. RefinedGAW also contains substantial amounts of educational, math-heavy, and expert-oriented content with minimal commercial bias. Across HTML and PDF, 88% of German RefinedGAW documents have no near-duplicate candidate match in the three evaluated reference datasets, supporting complementary coverage. We release a queryable metadata index for fine-grained data selection and a rehydration tool for retrieving and processing source documents.

AI.tldr: RefinedGAW 是基于德国学术网络26次半年爬取构建的高质量德语语料（1.22亿文档、3140亿token），标注为学术研究的内容达876亿token，超过FineWeb2与FinePDFs德语子集之和，且88%文档在参考数据集中无近重复。
AI.motivation: 现有最大德语开放文本数据集来自广泛网络爬取，规模大但特定领域（尤其学术、教育、专业内容）覆盖不足，且商业偏置明显。作者希望构建一个领域聚焦、可追溯、可细粒度筛选的德语学术资源以弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 从德国学术网络（German Academic Web）的26次半年度爬取中构建 RefinedGAW，涵盖HTML与PDF，共1.22亿文档、3140亿token，保留每篇文本的完整爬取与快照历史；进行清洗与标注（含"学术研究"等标签），并提供可查询元数据索引与再水化（rehydration）工具以检索和处理源文档。
AI.result: 标注为学术研究的文档占德语 RefinedGAW token 的84%（HTML与PDF合计），达876亿token，超过 FineWeb2 与 FinePDFs 德语子集合计的649亿token，尽管后者总体规模约为其五倍；数据集中还富含教育性、数学密集型与专家导向内容，商业偏置极低；88%的文档在三份参考数据集中无近重复匹配，体现出互补性覆盖。
AI.conclusion: RefinedGAW 表明领域聚焦的学术网络爬取能以更小总规模提供更高密度的优质德语学术内容，并与通用大规模语料形成互补。其元数据索引与再水化工具支持细粒度数据选择与可复现的数据溯源，为德语LLM训练与学术研究提供高质量资源。

title: One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models
summary: Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.

AI.tldr: 通过加权联合损失并以冻结原模型作引导，可在共享权重的单遍与循环推理间取得平衡，在保持单遍性能不降的同时提升循环预测。
AI.motivation: 重复使用Transformer中间层可在不增加参数的情况下提升语言模型性能，但单遍与循环推理共享权重，仅训练循环输出会导致单遍质量下降，需研究联合训练策略。
AI.method: 对单遍和循环两种输出施加加权联合损失进行联合训练，并引入冻结原始模型的引导信号；系统分析各损失权重的作用。
AI.result: 联合监督显著减少单遍性能退化，同时保留相对普通继续训练的循环增益；大部分收益来自调整单遍损失权重，冻结模型引导进一步改善循环输出。
AI.conclusion: 采用验证集选择的权重，本方法在预设容差内保持单遍质量不逊于普通继续训练，并提升循环预测。

title: AlphaIdeaBench: Benchmarking Automated Research Idea Generation under Feasibility Constraints with Peer Review Alignment
summary: Research ideas are always proposed under resource constraints: a plan must fit the available compute, API credit, and time. Yet evaluations of research-ideation agents mostly score unconstrained novelty or overlap with a published paper, and their LLM judges are rarely checked against peer review. We introduce AlphaIdeaBench, a benchmark of 100 ideation tasks (50 workshop calls for papers and 50 open problems stated in surveys), each paired with an explicit resource budget and a shared proposal schema. An LLM judge scores each proposal on 12 dimensions covering validity, novelty, and feasibility. To validate the judge, we compare its scores on four novelty axes (problem, method, scenario, and insight) with scores derived from reviewer comments on 600 papers from ICLR 2026, NeurIPS 2025, and ICML 2025. For problem and method novelty, Gemini 3.7 Flash is within one point of the reviewer-derived score on 94-97% of papers; agreement on scenario novelty is relatively lower. We evaluate eight published harnesses on a shared backbone and, within one harness, eight backbone LLMs. CoI-Agent obtains the highest overall score, narrowly ahead of SciMON, which leads on method and insight novelty. All harnesses score low on scenario novelty and rarely change the problem setting. The backbone largely determines which open problem a proposal targets, whereas the harness determines whether a proposal addresses one problem or combines several. Weaker backbones such as Llama 4 Scout fail to carry out that harness's strategy and score low on budget feasibility. Finally, when only the budget is varied on three topics, a larger budget changes the experimental setting on compute-intensive topics but only adds tests on an inexpensive one. We release the tasks, rubrics, and scores to foster standardized, reproducible benchmarking of future research-ideation agents under constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 AlphaIdeaBench，一个含 100 个带显式资源预算的研究构思任务基准，用经同行评审数据校验的 LLM 评审在 12 个维度打分，并系统评测 8 个框架与 8 个基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有研究构思智能体的评测多只测无约束的新颖性或与已发表论文的重合度，忽略了现实中算力、API 额度、时间等资源约束，且其 LLM 评审很少与真实同行评审对照验证。
AI.method: 构建 100 个任务（50 个 workshop 征稿 + 50 个综述中的开放问题），每个任务配显式预算与统一提案 schema；LLM 评审按有效性、新颖性、可行性共 12 维打分；用 ICLR 2026、NeurIPS 2025、ICML 2025 共 600 篇论文的审稿意见导出分数，在问题/方法/场景/洞见四个新颖性轴上校验评审；在共享 backbone 上评测 8 个 harness，并在单一 harness 内比较 8 个 LLM；另做仅改变预算的消融。
AI.result: Gemini 3.7 Flash 与审稿导出分在问题与方法新颖性上 94–97% 论文相差 1 分以内，场景新颖性一致性较低；CoI-Agent 总分最高，略胜 SciMON（后者在方法与洞见新颖性领先）；所有 harness 场景新颖性均低、很少改变问题设定；backbone 决定瞄准哪个开放问题，harness 决定单一还是多问题组合；Llama 4 Scout 等弱 backbone 无法执行 harness 策略，预算可行性得分低；仅变动预算时，算力密集型主题改变实验设定，便宜主题只增加测试。
AI.conclusion: 首次将资源约束与经同行评审校验的评审纳入研究构思智能体评测，揭示 harness 与 backbone 的分工及场景新颖性的系统性短板；开源任务、评分细则与分数以促进标准化可复现评测。

title: FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging
summary: Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. On the server, Subspace Expert Agreement Merging (SEAM) compares client updates as subspaces and moves each client towards consensus only along agreed-upon directions, leaving the rest of its update unchanged. We identify two remaining sources of forgetting, routing drift and merge erasure, and address them with three protections, one of which exactly preserves tile components in a selected prior-overlap subspace at every merge. We evaluate FedSEAM on TRACE using Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.2-3B, with component-wise ablations and studies of data size to assess its balance between learning new tasks and retaining prior knowledge.

AI.tldr: FedSEAM：一个联邦持续学习框架，将任务知识组织为稀疏专家并跨任务/客户端选择性共享内容，通过子空间兼容性测试与SEAM合并缓解遗忘。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE可在冻结骨干上适配参数以支持联邦持续学习，但任务演进使客户端学到不同专家内容，难以在不破坏任务/客户端特化的前提下共享知识；仅匹配tile坐标不足以判断内容是否兼容。
AI.method: 客户端：任务感知tile选择为新任务分配容量，基于子空间的兼容性测试决定复用哪些专家tile及何处引入新容量。服务器：SEAM以子空间比较客户端更新，仅沿共识方向聚合，其余保持不变；识别路由漂移与合并擦除两类遗忘来源，并用三项保护机制应对（其一在每次合并时精确保留选定先验重叠子空间的tile分量）。
AI.result: 在TRACE上使用Qwen3-4B与Llama-3.2-3B评估，含组件级消融与数据规模研究，权衡新任务学习与旧知识保留。
AI.conclusion: FedSEAM通过内容感知的专家选择与子空间共识合并，在联邦持续学习中兼顾特化与知识共享并缓解遗忘。

title: Rethinking Microscopy Generation: Co-Designed Diffusion for Biologically Interpretable Single-Cell Synthesis
summary: Generative models for microscopy can already produce realistic whole-image fields of view, but offer no principled way to control how each individual cell looks. We address this gap by recasting microscopy generation at the single-cell level and designing the input controls and the model's internal representation jointly, so that both are organized along the same biologically meaningful directions. On the input side, we aggregate a long list of standard cell measurements into a small set of semantic axes (size, elongation, brightness, texture, etc.) that are each named, measurable, and traversable. On the model side, we introduce BioVAE, an encoder-decoder whose latent space is explicitly aligned with the same set of measurements. A key finding is that the benefit of biologically structuring the latent emerges only when conditioning is also moved to the semantic axes, showing that the two ends must be designed jointly. Experiments on LIVECell show that semantic-axis conditioning substantially improves generative fidelity over high-dimensional conditioning, a blind study with biologists confirms the realism of generated cells, and per-axis traversals produce stable and interpretable phenotypic changes.

AI.tldr: 提出单细胞层面的显微图像生成框架BioVAE，将输入条件与潜空间表示共同对齐到语义化细胞测量轴，实现可控、可解释的细胞表型生成。
AI.motivation: 现有显微镜生成模型能生成逼真的整图视野，但无法有原则地控制单个细胞的外观；高维条件缺乏生物学可解释性。
AI.method: 将生成粒度改为单细胞，并把一长串标准细胞测量聚合为少数语义轴（大小、伸长、亮度、纹理等，均可命名、可测量、可遍历）；同时设计BioVAE，使编码器-解码器潜空间显式对齐同一组测量；关键发现是只有条件也迁移到语义轴时，潜空间生物学结构化才有效，两端必须协同设计。
AI.result: 在LIVECell上，语义轴条件相比高维条件显著提升生成保真度；生物学家盲测确认生成细胞真实；逐轴遍历产生稳定、可解释的表型变化。
AI.conclusion: 单细胞级、语义轴对齐的联合设计为显微生成提供了可控且可解释的原则化方案，凸显条件与潜表示协同对齐的必要性。

title: The Physical Cost of Context: Quality-Constrained Resource Accounting for Coding Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI). 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: Coding agents resend a growing context on every model call, and context policies are usually judged by the prompt tokens they save. Executed work also depends on call count and prefix reuse: a caching runtime prefills only the tokens after the longest cached prefix. A shorter prompt can therefore cost more if it rewrites cached history. Our quality-gated protocol splits executed prefill into logical prompt minus reused prefix and measures KV residency, time, and energy. On 450 localization cases derived from SWE-rebench V2, preloading ten retrieved blocks (Eager) and adding anchored history compaction (Compact) both pass a five-point non-inferiority gate. In a separate 900-cell study, Eager cuts model calls by 35.7% and the GPU-energy proxy by 33.2% against on-demand search (Grep); Compact saves nothing further. Enabling prefix caching leaves Eager's prompt volume similar (+8.3%; its 95% CI spans zero) but cuts its uncached prefill by 67.7%. Deleting history can turn a token saving into extra work. With mini-SWE-agent on 100 SWE-bench Verified instances, keeping only the last five observations (Mask-5) cuts Eager's prompt volume by 33.3% but loses 135.9k reusable tokens per task. Uncached prefill rises by 608.5%, the energy proxy by 125.6%, and the policy misses the quality gate. Policies thus save physical work by shortening the trajectory and can multiply it by editing reusable history.

AI.tldr: 上下文策略不应只以节省的提示词 token 数衡量，而应看物理执行开销（未缓存 prefill、调用数、时间与能耗）。实验表明：Eager 预加载与 Compact 压缩在质量门控下均达标并能显著降低调用数与能耗，而删除历史的 Mask-5 虽减少 prompt volume 却大幅增加未缓存 prefill 与能耗，且未通过质量门控。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体每次模型调用都重发不断增长的上下文，而现有上下文策略通常只用节省的提示词 token 来评估。但实际执行工作量还取决于调用次数与前缀复用：带缓存的运行时只 prefill 最长缓存前缀之后的部分。因此更短的提示词若改写了已缓存历史，反而可能更贵。作者需要一套基于质量门控的协议，将执行 prefill 拆分为"逻辑提示词减去复用前缀"，并测量 KV 驻留、时间与能耗，以正确评估策略的真实物理代价。
AI.method: 提出质量门控协议：将执行 prefill 分解为逻辑 prompt 减复用前缀，测量 KV residency、时间与能耗。在两个实验设置下对比 Eager（预加载十个检索块）、Compact（叠加锚定历史压缩）、Grep（按需搜索）与 Mask-5（仅保留最近五条观察，基于 mini-SWE-agent）。实验1：450 个来自 SWE-rebench V2 的定位任务，采用五点非劣性门控；实验2：900 单元的独立研究评估调用数与 GPU 能耗代理；另在 100 个 SWE-bench Verified 实例上测试 Mask-5。
AI.result: 1) Eager 与 Compact 均通过五点非劣性门控。2) 在 900 单元研究中，Eager 相对 Grep 减少调用数 35.7%、GPU 能耗代理 33.2%，Compact 无进一步收益。3) 开启前缀缓存后 Eager 的 prompt volume 相近（+8.3%，95% CI 跨零），但未缓存 prefill 降低 67.7%。4) Mask-5 将 Eager 的 prompt volume 削减 33.3%，但每任务损失 135.9k 可复用 token，未缓存 prefill 上升 608.5%，能耗代理上升 125.6%，且未通过质量门控。
AI.conclusion: 策略通过缩短轨迹来节省物理工作量，但通过编辑可复用历史可能成倍放大工作量。评估编码智能体上下文策略时，必须纳入调用次数、前缀复用与未缓存 prefill 等物理执行指标，而非仅看 prompt token 节省。

title: HARP-LoRA: Hierarchy-Conditioned Rank Projection for Low-Rank Adaptation in Scientific Table Understanding
summary: Tabular data is widely used in scientific applications, where complex layouts, including multi-level headers, merged cells, captions, and footnotes, make information extraction difficult. This is particularly important in pharmacokinetics (PK), where values must be correctly associated with the drug, species, dose, administration route, unit, and experimental condition. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduce adaptation cost but do not explicitly incorporate relationships between table values and surrounding headers. We introduce HARP-LoRA, a hierarchy-conditioned rank projection method for low-rank adaptation in scientific table understanding. HARP-LoRA extends projected LoRA by constructing token-specific intrinsic representations from the row- and column-header hierarchies of each data token. These representations condition the low-rank down-projection, incorporating hierarchical context while keeping the pretrained model and random projection tensors frozen. We evaluate HARP-LoRA on 950 manually annotated PK tables from 587 scientific articles and on WikiTableQuestions (WikiTQ) using Llama~3.2 3B, Llama~3.1 8B, and Gemma~3 27B. With Llama~3.1 8B, HARP-LoRA achieves a PK F1-score of 57.64\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 53.15\%, improving over LoRA by 1.42 and 6.56 points, respectively. With Gemma~3 27B, it achieves the best PK F1-score of 70.63\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 56.87\%. These results use only 172K, 197K, and 547K trainable parameters, far fewer than LoRA and TableLoRA. Overall, conditioning lightweight adapters on table-header hierarchies improves extraction from scientific tables and reasoning over flatter general-domain tables while maintaining parameter efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/hosseinsholehrasa/HARP-LoRA

AI.tldr: HARP-LoRA 提出一种层次条件化低秩投影方法，用表头层次结构构造 token 专属内在表示来条件化 LoRA 的下投影，从而在极少可训练参数下提升科学表格信息抽取。
AI.motivation: 科学表格（尤其药代动力学 PK 表格）含多级表头、合并单元格、标题与脚注，信息与药物、物种、剂量、给药途径、单位、实验条件等属性的正确关联困难；LoRA 等参数高效微调方法虽降低适配成本，却未显式建模表值与周围表头的关系。
AI.method: HARP-LoRA 扩展 projected LoRA：基于每个数据 token 的行/列表头层次构造 token 专属内在表示，用于条件化低秩下投影，注入层次上下文，同时保持预训练模型与随机投影张量冻结。在 950 张人工标注 PK 表格（来自 587 篇论文）及 WikiTableQuestions 上，用 Llama 3.2 3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma 3 27B 评估。
AI.result: Llama 3.1 8B 下 PK F1 57.64%、WikiTQ 准确率 53.15%，较 LoRA 分别提升 1.42 与 6.56 分；Gemma 3 27B 下取得最佳 PK F1 70.63%、WikiTQ 56.87%。可训练参数仅 172K、197K、547K，远少于 LoRA 与 TableLoRA。
AI.conclusion: 将轻量适配器条件化于表格表头层次，可在保持参数高效的同时提升科学表格抽取与扁平通用领域表格推理效果。代码已开源。

title: SEDATE: Do Large Language Models Share an Aggression Circuit Across Languages?
summary: As the applications of AI continue to expand across various multimodal and multilingual domains, ensuring safe and responsible deployment of these systems has become an important concern. A wide-range of interventions have been proposed to make AI responses safer and more reliable. They often incur substantial computational or annotation costs, or cannot be extended to multilingual settings. In this work, we propose Selective Detection And Targeted Editing (SEDATE), a training-free approach based on detect-edit-verify strategy. SEDATE first detects the responsible neurons, edits them as and when necessary and finally verifies the model responses; all without any additional model training. We evaluate SEDATE across 7 languages and 4 model families. We further evaluate its effectiveness across 4 out-of-distribution languages and 4 additional datasets. We show that SEDATE achieves substantially superior safety scores across all languages and models over the best-performing baseline while retaining the general capabilities and incurring negligible overhead. Our results are robust, with the trends remaining similar for out-of-distribution languages and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的SEDATE方法（检测-编辑-验证），检测并编辑责任神经元以提升AI安全性，在7种语言4个模型家族上显著优于基线且保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: AI在多模态多语言场景快速部署，安全可靠性至关重要；现有干预方法存在计算/标注成本高、难以扩展到多语言的问题。
AI.method: SEDATE采用detect-edit-verify策略：先定位负责安全性的神经元，必要时对其编辑，再验证模型响应；全程无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在7种语言、4个模型家族上评测，另在4种分布外语言和4个额外数据集上测试；所有语言与模型上安全得分显著超过最佳基线，同时保留通用能力，额外开销可忽略，趋势在OOD语言与数据集上保持一致。
AI.conclusion: SEDATE是一种低成本、可跨语言迁移、鲁棒的免训练安全增强方案，具备良好泛化性。

title: TAD: Distilling Vision-Language-Action Policies from Teacher Trajectories Alone
summary: Online distillation of vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly relies on teacher action scores that an inference-only interface may not expose. Trajectory-only Adversarial Distillation (\gad{}) instead turns a fixed bank of teacher joint-position features into adaptive feedback: a discriminator compares feature marginals from teacher and student rollouts and supplies rewards for on-policy learning. The student interacts with the environment without online teacher queries or environment task rewards. On ManiSkill \texttt{PutOnPlateInScene25Main}, \gad{} improves OpenVLA-OFT (7B) from $26.2\%$ to $76.6\%$ \successonce{} ($+50.4$ percentage points) and from $20.3\%$ to $58.6\%$ \successend{}. It trails white-box on-policy distillation (OPD) at $81.6\%$ / $59.4\%$ by $5.0$ / $0.8$ percentage points ($n{=}256$ evaluation trajectories per checkpoint). The tested four-epoch continuation achieves the highest \gad{} result without additional teacher data. This best run uses $5\times$ OPD's student interaction budget and $12.5\times$ its complete-rollout batch-passes. The comparison demonstrates online VLA improvement without teacher scoring while quantifying unequal interaction and optimization budgets.

AI.tldr: GAD（Trajectory-only Adversarial Distillation）仅用教师轨迹中的关节位置特征训练判别器，为在线策略学习提供奖励，无需教师动作分数或环境任务奖励，在 ManiSkill 上将 OpenVLA-OFT 成功率从 26.2% 提升到 76.6%。
AI.motivation: 在线视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略蒸馏通常依赖教师的动作分数，但纯推理接口可能不暴露这些分数，限制了黑盒场景下的在线蒸馏。
AI.method: 构建固定教师关节位置特征库，训练判别器对比教师与学生 rollout 的特征边缘分布，据此生成奖励用于学生策略的 on-policy 学习；学生与环境交互时既不查询在线教师，也不使用环境任务奖励。
AI.result: 在 ManiSkill PutOnPlateInScene25Main 上，OpenVLA-OFT (7B) 的 success_once 从 26.2% 升至 76.6%（+50.4 个百分点），success_end 从 20.3% 升至 58.6%；相比白盒 OPD 的 81.6%/59.4% 分别低 5.0/0.8 个百分点（每检查点 n=256 条评估轨迹）。四轮续训取得最佳 GAD 结果。
AI.conclusion: 该比较表明可在无教师评分条件下实现在线 VLA 性能提升，但其最佳结果使用了 5 倍于 OPD 的学生交互预算和 12.5 倍的完整 rollout 批次数，交互与优化预算并不对等，需谨慎解读差距。

title: Overlap-Aware Sub-hypergraph Pattern Frequencies for Hypergraph-Level Classification
summary: Classifying whole hypergraphs requires a fixed-length description of inputs whose numbers of vertices and hyperedges vary. Frequent sub-hypergraph patterns provide such a description, but previous work records only whether each pattern is present, which loses two kinds of information: how large the overlap between two hyperedges is, and how much of a hypergraph each pattern makes up. We extend frequent sub-hypergraph mining with overlap labels, the binned intersection size of two pattern hyperedges inherited from the target hypergraph, and represent each hypergraph by the relative frequency of each mined pattern. The vocabulary is mined from training hypergraphs only and then frozen, and validation and test hypergraphs are matched against it. A support rule that depends on pattern size keeps the vocabulary small. On the six hypergraph-classification datasets of DHG-Bench, with a single configuration chosen on validation scores, the method has a higher mean Macro-F1 than the best published mean on five datasets, by 18.67 points on Twitter-Friend and 10.02 points on Steam-Player; on RHG-3 it is 0.21 points lower. Ablations show that on Steam-Player and Twitter-Friend, replacing relative frequencies with presence lowers Macro-F1 by about 18 points, and that removing overlap labels lowers it by 4 to 9 points.

AI.tldr: 将频繁子超图模式挖掘扩展为带"重叠标签"和"相对频率"的表示，构建固定长度超图特征，在DHG-Bench六个数据集上五个超越已发表最好均值。
AI.motivation: 整图超图分类需要固定长度输入描述，而顶点与超边数量可变。既有方法用频繁子超图模式作为描述，但只记录模式"是否出现"，丢失了两类信息：两超边间重叠程度，以及该模式在超图中所占比例。
AI.method: 在频繁子超图挖掘中引入重叠标签（继承自目标超图的模式超边对交集大小分箱），并用每个挖掘模式的相对频率表示超图。词表仅在训练集挖掘后冻结，验证/测试图与之匹配；采用依赖模式大小的支持度规则控制词表规模。
AI.result: 在DHG-Bench六个超图分类数据集上，用验证集选定单一配置：五个数据集平均Macro-F1超过已发表最佳均值，Twitter-Friend高18.67点，Steam-Player高10.02点，RHG-3低0.21点。消融显示用"是否出现"替代相对频率使Macro-F1降约18点，去掉重叠标签降4–9点。
AI.conclusion: 相对频率与重叠标签是互补且关键的表示信息，二者带来的提升显著且一致，方法简单通用、配置单一。

title: Bidirectional Cross-frequency Domain Interaction Network for UHD Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods typically rely on either spatial- or frequency-domain modeling, or independently process different frequency components for efficient restoration. However, they often fail to jointly exploit complementary spatial--frequency information and the inherent relationship between illumination and structural information across frequencies, leading to inconsistent illumination, residual noise, and detail artifacts. In this paper, we propose a novel Bidirectional Cross-frequency Domain Interaction Network (BiFreqNet) for UHD LLIE. Specifically, BiFreqNet incorporates a Dual-domain Feature Interaction (DFI) module into the multi-scale representations of a pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) to perform reciprocal enhancement between low- and high-frequency features. DFI consists of a Spatial and Spectral-Aware Low-Frequency Enhancement (S$^2$LFE) block and a Cross-Frequency Enhancement (CFE) block. S$^2$LFE exploits high-frequency structural cues to guide low-frequency restoration and jointly models spatial and spectral information to recover global exposure and spatially varying illumination while suppressing sensor noise. CFE further leverages the enhanced low-frequency contextual information to guide adaptive high-frequency refinement, enabling faithful reconstruction of structures and fine details. Extensive experiments on four general and UHD LLIE benchmarks demonstrate that BiFreqNet achieves competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出BiFreqNet，一种面向超高清（UHD）低光照图像增强的双向跨频域交互网络，通过双域特征交互模块实现低频与高频特征的相互增强。
AI.motivation: 现有UHD低光照增强方法通常只依赖空间域或频率域建模，或独立处理不同频率分量，未能联合利用空间-频率互补信息及跨频率的光照与结构信息间的内在关系，导致光照不一致、残余噪声和细节伪影。
AI.method: BiFreqNet在预训练VAE的多尺度表示中引入双域特征交互（DFI）模块，实现低频与高频特征的双向增强。DFI包含：S²LFE块（利用高频结构线索引导低频恢复，并联合建模空间与频谱信息以恢复全局曝光和空间变化光照，同时抑制传感器噪声）与CFE块（利用增强后的低频上下文引导高频自适应细化，忠实重建结构与细节）。
AI.result: 在四个通用及UHD低光照增强基准上的大量实验表明，BiFreqNet相比现有最先进方法取得了具有竞争力或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过双向跨频域交互联合利用空间-频率及光照-结构信息，可有效改善UHD低光照增强的光照一致性与细节保真度。

title: Silent and Costly: Characterizing and Detecting Prompt-Caching Mis-Integration in LLM Agents
summary:
Large language model (LLM) services process massive volumes of user requests, resulting in substantial inference costs. To reduce both cost and latency, providers have introduced prompt caching. However, correctly integrating prompt caching is non-trivial due to heterogeneous provider-specific APIs and continuously evolving caching semantics. To understand prompt-caching mis-integration in downstream applications, we conduct the first empirical study of 120 prompt-caching-related pull requests from 10 popular open-source agent systems. Our findings show that prompt-caching mis-integrations arise in both request-side misconfiguration and read-side usage miscount. More importantly, most mis-integrations fail silently without causing observable runtime failures.
  Motivated by these findings, we design CACHELINT, which models a prompt-caching mis-integration as an invocation site together with the preconditions required for correct cache integration. CACHELINT locates caching invocation sites with CodeQL and discharges each precondition either against a dated provider capability oracle or with an LLM guard check. CACHELINT achieves 0.71 precision and 0.78 recall in identifying the 120 labeled mis-integrations across the 10 studied agent systems. Our evaluation further demonstrates the effectiveness of CACHELINT in real-world settings, identifying 32 mis-integrations across 571 agent projects with 0.86 precision. These findings have received 21 developer confirmations and led to 18 upstream fixes, including one in Anthropic's official SDK.

AI.tldr: 首个针对提示缓存误集成的实证研究，发现请求侧配置错误与读取侧用量误算两类问题且多为静默失败，据此提出CACHELINT检测工具，精度0.71/召回0.78，并在真实项目中获21次开发者确认、18个上游修复。
AI.motivation: LLM服务请求量巨大导致推理成本高，厂商引入提示缓存以降本提速；但各厂商API异构且缓存语义持续演进，正确集成提示缓存并非易事，且误集成往往不产生可观察的运行时失败，因此需要系统性地理解并检测此类问题。
AI.method: 对10个主流开源Agent系统中的120个提示缓存相关PR做首个实证研究；将误集成建模为"调用点+正确缓存集成所需前置条件"，用CodeQL定位缓存调用点，前置条件则通过带日期的厂商能力预言机或LLM守护检查来验证。
AI.result: 在120个标注误集成上达到0.71精度与0.78召回；在571个真实Agent项目中识别出32个误集成，精度0.86，获21次开发者确认并促成18个上游修复（含Anthropic官方SDK中的一处）。
AI.conclusion: 提示缓存误集成普遍存在且静默难察，CACHELINT通过调用点定位与前置条件验证的组合可有效检测，并在真实生态中产生实际修复影响。

title: Reading the Registers of Honorius III without Manual Line Transcription: Forced-Aligned HTR, End to End, Modular or Hybrid
summary: Unlocking medieval archives at scale is bottlenecked by the cost of line-level diplomatic transcriptions and manual abbreviation expansion. Focusing on the registers of Pope Honorius III (1216-1227) over 5,000 letters surviving in full only as manuscript images - we show that existing, line-break-free expert transcriptions (edition drafts) suffice to train end-to-end hand-written text recognition (HTR) that jointly transcribes and expands heavily abbreviated Latin. Using forced alignment on 860 unaligned edition entries across 394 pages of Reg. Vat. 9, we automatically bootstrap 13,122 training lines without manual alignment of segmented lines. While the generic CATMuS baseline struggles on this domain (18.9% CER) and a modular space-free HTR + word-segmentation pipeline (cf. Camps et al. 2021) plateaus at 15.6% WER, our from-scratch hybrid Conformer - combining CTC with bidirectional subword attention decoders, iterative self-realignment and n-best LM rescoring - achieves 4.7% CER and 8.7% WER (8.4% WER with ROVER system combination), nearly halving errors on clause-final words (22.7% to 12.2% WER). These figures are measured on the test lines that align with the transcription (86% of all test lines for the best hybrid). Furthermore, we address a tension between paleographic fidelity and editorial normalization: training on targets that preserve scribal name initials reduces the WER against the manuscript text on the 31 affected test lines from 13.3% to 9.2%, at a small cost against the expanded transcription (WER +0.3 points, CER +0.4). Finally, extensive ablations show that none of an auxiliary diplomatic CTC head, a copy mechanism, a permutation decoder or masked-image pretraining improves on direct end-to-end supervision, while strict padding-mask propagation and per-line beam termination make inference batch-invariant.

AI.tldr: 利用无行对齐的专家版本草稿，通过强制对齐自举训练数据，提出混合Conformer端到端HTR模型，联合转写并展开中世纪拉丁缩写，在Honorius III登记簿上大幅降低错误率。
AI.motivation: 大规模解锁中世纪档案受限于逐行外交式转写与人工缩写展开的高成本。教皇Honorius III登记簿（1216-1227）逾5000封信仅存手稿图像，现有专家版本草稿无换行标注，亟需高效的低成本方案。
AI.method: 对Reg. Vat. 9的394页860条未对齐版本条目做强制对齐，自动自举13,122训练行；采用从零训练的混合Conformer（CTC+双向子词注意力解码器），结合迭代自对齐与n-best语言模型重打分，并加入ROVER系统融合、严格padding-mask传播与逐行beam终止。
AI.result: CATMuS基线CER 18.9%，无空格HTR+分词流水线WER 15.6%；本文模型CER 4.7%、WER 8.7%（ROVER后8.4%），分句末词错误率从22.7%降至12.2%。保留抄写员姓名首字母的目标使相关31行WER由13.3%降至9.2%，仅以展开转写WER+0.3/CER+0.4为代价。
AI.conclusion: 端到端直接监督优于辅助外交CTC头、copy机制、置换解码器与掩码图像预训练等消融方案；该方法证明无对齐版本草稿足以训练高质量联合转写-展开HTR，并实现批量不变推理。

title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
summary: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.

AI.tldr: 成功的工具使用轨迹不一定是有用的监督；论文提出Trajectory2Gym，通过"组合覆盖"与"决策接地"两条原则构造可学习的交互经验，在五个Qwen3规模上显著提升Tau1、Tau2和BFCL。
AI.motivation: 成功轨迹存在两类问题：可能低估多步依赖关系（组合覆盖不足），也可能包含在决策时刻对智能体可见信息而言缺乏依据的动作（决策缺乏接地）。因此"收集成功轨迹"这一范式本身不足。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory2Gym：围绕支撑不足的组合结构构造可执行交互，并只从已实现执行中的"接地决策"派生监督；采用结构支撑选择（structural-support selection）分配经验，并用父级归一化监督微调（parent-normalized SFT）以语义交互为训练权重单位。
AI.result: 在五个Qwen3规模上，Tau1、Tau2、BFCL三项基准均提升，等权三项均值提升16.9–29.8个百分点；在有状态、多轮交互中增益最强。
AI.conclusion: 扩展工具使用智能体不仅依赖收集更多成功轨迹，而需构造依赖被覆盖、决策可从可见历史中学习的交互经验。

title: Collective Collaboration of Recursive Autonomous Agents
summary: Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. Composite units can therefore participate in higher-level organizations as agents of the same kind. We formulate organizational models for leaf and composite units, specify interface closure under composition and conditions for finite task expansion, and develop operational mechanisms linking task decomposition, resource commitments, result aggregation, and coordination within the scope affected by change. A production network integrating machining, inspection, and logistics across multiple workshops illustrates how a common organizational kernel is instantiated at the equipment-service, workshop, and factory scales. The framework connects recursive organization with explicit task responsibilities, capability conditions, and execution interfaces for manufacturing systems.

AI.tldr: 提出递归自主智能体（RAA）集体协作框架，用统一任务/能力接口实现自上而下任务分解与自下而上能力聚合，支持设备-车间-工厂多尺度组织。
AI.motivation: 智能工厂需将订单级目标转化为多尺度生产任务，并将单元能力组合为整体交付能力；现有组织机制在设备、车间、工厂间需反复适配，且动态生产条件下的跨层级协调困难。
AI.method: 构建叶子单元与复合单元的组织模型；设计统一任务与能力接口，保证组合下的接口闭合与有限任务展开条件；提出连接任务分解、资源承诺、结果聚合与变更影响域内协调的运行机制；以跨多车间的加工-检测-物流生产网络进行实例化验证。
AI.result: 复合单元可作为同类智能体参与更高层组织；统一组织内核可在设备服务、车间、工厂三个尺度实例化，形成含加工、检测、物流的生产网络示例。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将递归组织与明确的任务职责、能力条件和执行接口相连接，为制造系统提供可跨层级复用的组织机制。

title: Large Language Models for Quantum Code Translation: An Exploratory Study
summary: Quantum software development is challenged by quantum-mechanical semantics and fragmented software development kits (SDKs), which complicate cross-SDK code translation and execution. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based approach for translating executable programs between high-level quantum SDKs. We develop a quantum-aware translation workflow whose prompt design and validation reflect quantum semantics and accommodate the version evolution of quantum ecosystems. We conduct a preliminary evaluation of 4 LLM configurations on 43 tasks, translating Qiskit programs to PennyLane and Q#. LLMs achieve a zero-shot Pass@1 of up to 72.33%, while one-shot prompting further improves the translation effectiveness. These results suggest potential for quantum code translation by LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的量子程序跨SDK翻译方法，构建了融合量子语义与版本演化的翻译工作流，并在43个任务上将Qiskit程序翻译为PennyLane和Q#，零样本Pass@1最高达72.33%，单样本提示可进一步提升效果。
AI.motivation: 量子软件开发受困于量子力学语义的复杂性与碎片化的软件开发工具包（SDK），导致跨SDK的代码翻译与执行困难，亟需有效的自动化翻译手段。
AI.method: 提出一个量子感知（quantum-aware）的翻译工作流，其提示设计与验证过程反映量子语义，并兼顾量子生态系统的版本演进；对4种LLM配置在43个翻译任务（Qiskit→PennyLane、Qiskit→Q#）上进行初步评估，比较零样本与单样本提示效果。
AI.result: LLM零样本Pass@1最高达到72.33%，单样本提示进一步提升了翻译有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明LLM在量子代码跨SDK翻译方面具有潜力，为量子软件的可移植性与开发效率提供了新思路。

title: Useful Diversity or Hallucinated Variety? Persona-Conditioned Synthetic Query Generation for E-Commerce Search
comment: Accepted at IJCNLP-AACL 2026 (Findings). 20 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables
summary: Synthetic supervision can bootstrap semantic parsers in new search domains, but prompt-induced diversity is useful only when generations are faithful to the structured intent. We explore this for cold-start e-commerce search: 118,098 synthetic pairs produced by 6 LLMs with 9 persona-conditioned prompt families on a 47-field UK automotive schema, against 1,214 human-annotated and 15,304 production queries. We show that the IPIP personality bundle improves parser F1 in all four matched contrasts (Holm-corrected $p<.001$), and all three bundles have a positive main effect over the complete $2^3$ grid. Syntax conditioning is the axis that moves generations towards real traffic. It also induces lexical diversity. Alignment sKL, the divergence between von Mises-Fisher distributions fitted to synthetic and human-annotated queries, is an unlabelled proxy for parser F1 ($ρ=-0.917$ against human queries written for simulated shopper scenarios, lower is closer). An LLM committee, checked against a blinded author pass, triages the 927 queries missed by every parser and labels 37% as hallucinated. Dropped constraints dominate. The four syntax-bearing families have the largest hallucinated shares, 38 to 42%, while IPIP alone has the lowest at 28%.

AI.tldr: 研究在冷启动电商搜索中利用合成监督训练语义解析器，发现IPIP人格提示族提升F1、句法条件化使生成更贴近真实流量，并提出对齐sKL作为无标注的F1代理指标。
AI.motivation: 冷启动电商搜索缺乏标注数据，需用LLM合成数据引导语义解析器；但提示诱导的多样性只有在生成忠实于结构化意图时才有用，需探究哪些提示维度真正有效并可被无标注评估。
AI.method: 基于47字段的英国汽车schema，用6个LLM、9种人格化提示族共生成118,098对合成查询-意图，对照1,214条人工标注和15,304条生产查询；在完整2^3提示族网格上做匹配对比（Holm校正），拟合von Mises-Fisher分布计算合成与人工查询的对齐sKL；并用LLM委员会（对盲审作者复核）对927条所有解析器均失败的查询进行幻觉归因。
AI.result: IPIP人格组合在全部四个匹配对比中提升解析器F1（Holm校正p<.001），三种组合对完整网格均有正向主效应；句法条件化是推动生成向真实流量靠拢的轴，并带来词汇多样性；对齐sKL与解析器F1高度相关（ρ=-0.917，越低越接近）；被漏检查询中37%被判为幻觉，其中约束缺失占主导，四个含句法族幻觉率最高（38-42%），仅IPIP族最低（28%）。
AI.conclusion: 人格与句法条件化的提示设计可显著提升合成数据质量，对齐sKL可作为无需标注的解析器性能代理；但句法多样性伴随更高的幻觉（多为约束丢失），提示设计需在多样性与忠实度间权衡。

title: When the Weakest Language Keeps Moving: ARMOR-DP for Multilingual BabyLM
comment: Accepted to the BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Multilingual BabyLM systems usually fix language sampling proportions even though the weakest language can change during training. We present ARMOR-DP, a modular framework that diagnoses imbalance arising from representation, exposure, capacity, and objective pressure, and uses per-language validation loss to update sampling. Controlled experiments show that equal character budgets create a severe representation artifact for Chinese; byte-level encoding removes much of it, while static Chinese protection can subsequently make English the weakest language. The dynamic controller tracks these transitions and achieves a better score--balance tradeoff than fixed protection. On official evaluation, curriculum-dynamic checkpoints outperform a matched static Chinese-protective baseline while using fewer Chinese epochs; scaling capacity yields the strongest internal ARMOR-DP system. These results support a simple conclusion: multilingual weakness is a training-time state rather than a fixed property of a language. ARMOR-DP therefore separates diagnosis from intervention, allowing protection to follow the current bottleneck instead of a predetermined language label.

AI.tldr: 提出ARMOR-DP框架，用动态语言采样替代固定采样比例，发现多语言婴儿语言模型中的"最弱语言"会随训练变化，需按当前瓶颈动态调整保护。
AI.motivation: 多语言BabyLM通常固定语言采样比例，但最弱语言在训练中会变化；且不平衡可能来自表示、曝光、容量、目标压力多个来源，需先诊断再干预。
AI.method: 模块化框架ARMOR-DP：诊断表示/曝光/容量/目标压力四类不平衡来源，并以各语言验证损失为信号动态更新采样比例；另用字节级编码缓解等字符预算带来的表示偏差。
AI.result: 等字符预算对中文产生严重表示伪影，字节级编码可大部分消除；静态中文保护会转而令英语成为最弱语言；动态控制器能跟踪语言弱项转移，得分-平衡权衡优于固定保护；官方评测中课程动态检查点优于匹配的静态中文保护基线且中文轮次更少；增大容量得到最强的内部系统。
AI.conclusion: 多语言弱项是训练期状态而非语言的固定属性；ARMOR-DP将诊断与干预分离，使保护跟随当前瓶颈而非预设语言标签。

title: Physics-Informed Graph-Based Safe RL with Constraint-Specific Critics for Community Battery Coordination in Distribution Network
summary: High penetrations of distributed energy resources (DERs) and fast-varying electric vehicle (EV) charging intensify voltage and line-limit violations in distribution networks (DNs), making safe, low-cost operation increasingly challenging. This paper proposes a physics-informed safe deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for coordinating community battery energy storage systems to mitigate constraint violations while minimizing operating cost. To represent nonlocal spatiotemporal interactions, we develop a dual-level physics-informed graph representation in which line impedance and capacity shape spatial information propagation, while power-balance, voltage-profile, and flow-reconstruction losses regularize the latent state toward control-relevant physical consistency. Building on this representation, we develop Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO (LDCPPO), which implements constraint-specific value decomposition: independent reward and cost critics preserve heterogeneous voltage- and line-loading-related learning signals and combine their advantages only during the Lagrangian policy update. Case studies on DNs with high rooftop photovoltaic penetration and EV charging demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the key voltage-violation degree by up to 80.5% compared with the tested baselines, while also achieving the lowest voltage-violation count and line-overload degree with competitive operating cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理信息驱动的安全深度强化学习框架，用于协调社区储能以在保证配电网电压与线路约束的前提下最小化运行成本。
AI.motivation: 分布式能源与快速变化的电动汽车充电高渗透，加剧配电网电压与线路限值越限，安全低成本运行日益困难。
AI.method: 构建双层物理信息图表示（线路阻抗与容量塑造空间信息传播，功率平衡/电压分布/潮流重构损失正则化隐状态）；并设计Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO（LDCPPO），用独立的奖励与成本critic分别保留电压和线路负载信号，仅在Lagrangian策略更新时融合。
AI.result: 在高屋顶光伏与EV充电渗透的配电网案例中，相比基线将关键电压越限程度最高降低80.5%，同时电压越限次数和线路过载程度最低，运行成本具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息图表示与约束专用critic分解相结合，可有效提升社区储能在多约束配电网中的安全与经济协调控制性能。

title: Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation)
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn strategic persuasion faces two coupled obstacles: (i) realistic simulation of psychologically grounded persuadees, and (ii) dense, faithful supervision for credit assignment in strategic dialogues. Outcome-only rewards are sparse and uninformative about which conversational moves drove success, while LLM-judge process rewards are expensive and decoupled from the underlying interaction dynamics. We address both challenges with a unified framework. First, we introduce PersuArena, a persuasion simulation environment that produces realistic, non-monotonic trajectories. Second, building directly on this environment, we propose Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization (Probe-RPO), an online RL framework that converts the persuadee's internal state into dense process rewards. At each turn, three introspective probes are read from the frozen persuadee's logits, yielding a multi-dimensional reward signal that is faithfully aligned with persuasion dynamics. With extensive experiments on PersuArena spanning healthcare, financial advising, workplace management, education, and personal relationships, we demonstrate that our Probe-RPO achieves the full acceptance rate of 52.5%, compared with the 35.8% for the strongest GRPO ablation and 25.8% for the best off-the-shelf LLM. We also conduct comprehensive analyses on the generalization across persuadee models and the persuasion dynamics across conversations. Our work offers a promising paradigm that can provide effective process supervision for strategic dialogue.

AI.tldr: 提出 PersuArena 说服模拟环境与 Probe-RPO 在线强化学习框架，通过从冻结被说服者 logits 中读取内省探针得到稠密过程奖励，在多个领域将接受率提升至 52.5%。
AI.motivation: 多轮策略性说服训练 LLM 面临两个耦合难题：一是缺乏具有心理学依据的真实被说服者模拟，二是战略对话中信用分配缺少稠密且忠实的监督信号。仅结果奖励稀疏、无法指示哪一步对话动作带来成功；LLM 评判的过程奖励昂贵且与交互动态脱节。
AI.method: 统一框架包含两部分：(1) PersuArena 说服模拟环境，生成真实、非单调的说服轨迹；(2) Probe-RPO，基于该环境的在线 RL 框架，将说服者内部状态转化为稠密过程奖励——每轮从冻结被说服者的 logits 中读取三个内省探针，构成与说服动态忠实对齐的多维奖励信号，用于相对策略优化。
AI.result: 在覆盖医疗、理财、职场管理、教育、人际关系的 PersuArena 实验中，Probe-RPO 达到 52.5% 的完全接受率，最强 GRPO 消融为 35.8%，最佳现成 LLM 为 25.8%。并分析了跨被说服者模型的泛化性与对话中的说服动态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为策略性对话提供了有效的过程监督范式，表明从被说服者内部状态在线提取奖励是可行且高效的路径。

title: How Robust Are CNNs and Vision Transformers for Alzheimer's MRI Classification Across Datasets?
comment: 12 pages, 9 tables, 3 figures. Submitted to Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
summary: Accurate assessment of Alzheimer's disease stages from MRI is important for understanding disease progression and supporting the development of computer-aided analysis tools. Deep learning models have shown promising results for Alzheimer's disease classification from MRI. However, when evaluated on single datasets, it is difficult to determine whether the observed performance reflects consistent architectural behavior or dataset-specific effects. In this work, we present a multi-dataset benchmarking framework with standardized preprocessing and evaluation. We compare five architectures: ResNet-50, ReXNet-150, Swin Transformer, ViT-Base, and ViT-Large. The models are evaluated across three MRI datasets representing severe class imbalance, train-test distribution mismatch, and large-scale augmentation. The results show broadly consistent performance patterns across datasets, with ViT-Large achieving the best performance on all three datasets and reaching up to 99.84% accuracy and 99.86% macro F1. Performance differences between architectures are most pronounced under distribution mismatch and considerably smaller in the augmented-data setting. Across datasets, lower class-level performance is observed primarily among adjacent early-stage categories, particularly Very Mild and Mild impairment. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating deep learning architectures across multiple data conditions rather than relying on single-dataset performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建多数据集基准框架，统一预处理与评估，比较五种架构在三种MRI数据条件下对阿尔茨海默病分期的表现，发现ViT-Large在三数据集上均最优（最高99.84%准确率、99.86%宏F1）。
AI.motivation: 单数据集评估难以区分性能差异是来自架构本身还是数据集特定效应，因此需要跨多数据条件的公平比较。
AI.method: 提出标准化预处理与评估的多数据集基准框架，对比ResNet-50、ReXNet-150、Swin Transformer、ViT-Base、ViT-Large五种架构，在分别代表严重类别不平衡、训练-测试分布不匹配、大规模数据增强的三个MRI数据集上评估。
AI.result: 各数据集上性能排序总体一致，ViT-Large全部最优，最高99.84%准确率与99.86%宏F1；架构间差异在分布不匹配时最明显，在增强数据设置下明显缩小；类别层面主要表现为相邻早期阶段（Very Mild与Mild）区分困难。
AI.conclusion: 应基于多种数据条件评估深度学习架构，而非依赖单数据集性能；早期相邻阶段的分类仍是主要难点。

title: Ethics by Configuration: AI Ethics Principles in Coding Agent Instructions
summary: As AI coding agents become integral to software development, projects increasingly utilise configuration files, such as context files and skills, to govern agent behaviour. While AI ethics principles are widely used in research and policy, little is known about whether and how they are reflected when developers configure coding agents. We studied ethics principles in 40,079 configuration files across 8,893 GitHub repositories. Using a validated large language model (LLM) classification, we measured the prevalence of ethics-related statements, and qualitatively analysed 702 stratified samples across 679 files to uncover the ethical considerations reflected in these files and the parties they concern. Ethics-related statements appeared in 39.4% of files and 61.5% of repositories; concentrated on accountability, transparency, privacy protection, and reliability; and occurred more often in task-specific files such as skills than in project-wide context files. Our qualitative analysis identified 30 categories of ethical considerations, which take the form of concrete rules for the agent. Accountability appeared mainly as requirements for human approval, transparency as explain and honestly report the agent's work, and fairness as accessibility and localisation. These considerations reveal a difference in focus. Whereas public ethics frameworks aim to protect society and end users, configuration files mainly concern developers, maintainers, and community members in the development workflow. Ethics-related content appeared mainly in prose-based files, and whether agents follow these instructions remains untested. We discuss the implications for practitioners, researchers, and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 该论文对8,893个GitHub仓库中的40,079个AI编码代理配置文件进行LLM分类与定性分析，发现39.4%文件含伦理相关内容，主要集中于问责、透明、隐私与可靠性，且多聚焦开发者而非终端用户。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理已被广泛用于软件开发，开发者常通过上下文文件、技能等配置文件约束代理行为；然而现有AI伦理原则多停留在研究政策层面，尚不清楚开发者在实际配置代理时是否、以及如何体现这些伦理原则。
AI.method: 在8,893个GitHub仓库的40,079个配置文件中，使用经校验的LLM分类统计伦理相关陈述的普遍程度，并对来自679个文件的702条分层样本进行定性分析，归纳伦理考量类别及其涉及的相关方。
AI.result: 伦理相关陈述出现在39.4%的文件和61.5%的仓库中，集中于问责、透明、隐私保护与可靠性，且技能等任务特定文件比项目级上下文文件更常出现。定性分析识别出30类伦理考量，多以对代理的具体规则形式呈现：问责表现为要求人工审批，透明表现为解释并如实报告代理工作，公平表现为可访问性与本地化。
AI.conclusion: 公共伦理框架以保护社会与终端用户为目标，而配置文件主要关心开发者、维护者与社区成员等开发流程相关方，二者关注点存在明显差异。伦理内容主要出现在散文式文件中，且代理是否真正遵循这些指令尚未验证。作者据此为从业者、研究者与政策制定者提出启示。

title: When Fusion Order Matters: Insights on Progressive Multimodal Representation Learning for Cross-modal Retrieval
summary: Multimodal video retrieval combines visual, acoustic, and speech information, yet how their fusion order should depend on the data and the retrieval query remains unclear. We introduce Unified Progressive Representation Learning for Order Analysis, or UniPRO, to investigate this question through configurable fusion schedules with matched model components and training settings. Starting from text-to-video retrieval, we find that the tested one-by-one schedules outperform stacked fusion, while changing the order within one-by-one fusion also changes performance. To guide order selection, we examine two complementary considerations: learning difficulty under unequal modality availability and preservation of information relevant to the query. Complete-modality controls show that missing inputs alone cannot explain order sensitivity. At R@1, text and audio retrieval favor schedules that introduce the modality matching the query last. Controlled speech missingness during training and testing reverses the preferred order in both R@1 and SumR, with different crossover points. These findings motivate balancing the two considerations when selecting a fusion path. We then use them to predict a visual-last schedule for image queries, which achieves 97.9 R@1, the highest among the evaluated orders on MSR-VTT-9k. Main experiments on four text-to-video benchmarks establish the effectiveness of UniPRO, with component ablations assessing its supporting design. Together, the results identify fusion order as a task-dependent choice that should account jointly for modality availability and the retrieval query.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniPRO 框架，用可控融合顺序研究多模态视频检索中"模态融合顺序"对性能的影响，发现顺序是任务依赖的选择，应同时考虑模态可用性与检索查询。
AI.motivation: 多模态视频检索融合视觉、声学与语音信息，但融合顺序应如何随数据和查询变化尚不清楚，缺乏受控对比研究。
AI.method: 构建 UniPRO（统一渐进表示学习），在匹配的模型组件与训练设置下配置不同融合计划；从文本检索视频出发比较逐一式与堆叠式融合及逐一式内部顺序，并从"模态可得性不均下的学习难度"与"查询相关信息保留"两个互补角度分析顺序选择。
AI.result: 逐一式融合优于堆叠式，且顺序改变会影响性能；完整模态对照表明缺失输入本身不能解释顺序敏感性；R@1 下文本与音频检索偏好"将匹配查询的模态最后引入"；训练与测试中受控语音缺失会反转偏好顺序（R@1 与 SumR 交叉点不同）；据此预测图像查询应"视觉最后"，在 MSR-VTT-9k 上达 97.9 R@1。
AI.conclusion: 融合顺序是任务依赖的选择，应联合考虑模态可用性与检索查询；UniPRO 在四个文本-视频基准上有效，组件消融验证了设计。

title: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
summary: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出UMer框架，通过用户特定心理先验蒸馏、量表引导多查询检索和由粗到细的证据推理，从社交媒体痕迹估计抑郁严重程度。
AI.motivation: 传统抑郁评估依赖临床访谈或自评问卷，需用户主动参与；现有社交媒体方法在用户特定心理先验建模、多样化语义检索和细粒度证据推理方面存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 从历史社交痕迹中蒸馏用户特定心理先验，刻画心理倾向、行为模式与自我表达风格；2) 量表引导的多查询检索，基于与题目相关的帖子构建证据记忆；3) 由粗到细的证据感知推理，区分直接证据与间接证据，并给出可解释理由的题项级得分预测。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准上取得优于现有基线的竞争性表现，并提供基于证据的可解释性，且可泛化到其他基于量表的任务。
AI.conclusion: UMer通过融合用户先验、检索式证据与层次化推理，为社交媒体抑郁严重度估计提供了有效且可解释的方案。

title: Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neurons for Event-Driven Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on dense, continuous-valued computation presents a fundamental challenge for energy-constrained deployment. Inspired by the sparse, event-driven signaling and temporal integration mechanisms of biological neurons, a promising alternative is to introduce spiking computation into VLA models. However, enabling such computation without restructuring pretrained policies or compromising closed-loop control remains an open challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (PoT-LIF) neuron, which emits signed spikes with power-of-two amplitudes. By combining magnitude-coded spike events with residual-preserving membrane dynamics, PoT-LIF enables continuous information to be progressively represented through discrete spikes. The Heartbeat formulation further localizes this process within weighted projections, bridging biologically inspired spiking computation and pretrained VLA architectures without modifying their external inference interfaces. We integrate PoT-LIF into the vision projection, vision-language projection, and action projection of $π_{0.5}$ and evaluate both operating modes over 2,000 paired closed-loop LIBERO episodes per configuration. Standard-mode PoT-LIF VLA achieves success rates of 96.90% and 96.35% at $T = 1$ and $T = 2$, respectively, while Heartbeat mode achieves 97.25% and 96.90% at $T = 2$ and $T = 4$, compared with 96.70% for the original continuous-activation $π_{0.5}$ baseline. At $T = 1$ with a 60.01% firing rate, PoT-LIF uses approximately 1/7.67 of the dense-reference arithmetic energy, corresponding to a modeled reduction of 86.95%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoT-LIF脉冲神经元与Heartbeat机制，将稀疏脉冲计算注入预训练VLA模型（π0.5），在不改变外部推理接口的前提下保持闭环操作性能并大幅降低算术能耗。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作中表现优异，但依赖稠密连续值计算，难以部署于能耗受限场景。生物神经元的稀疏、事件驱动与时间积分机制提供了启示，但如何在重构预训练策略或损害闭环控制之外引入脉冲计算仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出Power-of-Two LIF神经元，发放幅度为2的幂的有符号脉冲；结合幅值编码脉冲事件与残差保持的膜动态，使连续信息可通过离散脉冲渐进表示。Heartbeat公式将该过程局部化于加权投影内部，桥接脉冲计算与预训练VLA架构，且不改变外部推理接口。将PoT-LIF集成到π0.5的视觉投影、视觉-语言投影与动作投影中。
AI.result: 在LIBERO闭环任务上，每种配置评估2000对配对episode。Standard模式在T=1、T=2成功率96.90%/96.35%；Heartbeat模式在T=2、T=4为97.25%/96.90%；原始连续激活π0.5基线为96.70%。T=1、发放率60.01%时，算术能耗约为稠密参考的1/7.67，建模降幅86.95%。
AI.conclusion: PoT-LIF与Heartbeat可在不重训策略、不改推理接口的情况下将脉冲计算嵌入预训练VLA，实现与稠密基线相当甚至略优的闭环成功率，同时显著降低算术能耗，为能耗受限机器人部署提供可行路径。

title: Clustering of High-Dimensional Human Gene Score Data for Target Cell Classification
summary: The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when analysed using the same set of 769 features. Two datasets were considered: the complete gene score dataset and a subset containing selected kinase genes. Two missing-data strategies were investigated. In Case I, rows containing missing gene-score values were removed. In Case II, rows with more than 20% missing values were excluded and the other missing values were replaced by the corresponding column mean. For each case, the data were scaled and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed before clustering. Four clustering approaches were considered: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based Clustering. Across both datasets and both missing-data treatments, the optimal number of clusters was found to be two. In the absence of an optimal number of clusters, the quality of clustering was assessed using the Silhouette score. Relatively high Silhouette scores were obtained in all cases.

AI.tldr: 研究比较完整人类基因评分数据集与筛选的激酶基因子集在相同769个特征下是否具有相同的最优聚类数。两种缺失值处理、PCA降维后使用K-Means、层次聚类、Fuzzy C-Means和基于图的聚类四种方法分析，所有情形下最优聚类数均为2。
AI.motivation: 探究完整人类基因评分数据集与筛选的人类激酶基因数据集在相同特征体系下是否呈现一致的聚类结构，并考察不同缺失值处理策略对聚类结果的影响。
AI.method: 使用769个特征对完整基因评分数据集与激酶基因子集进行分析。设计两种缺失值处理：Case I删除含缺失值的行；Case II剔除缺失超20%的行，其余用列均值填补。数据标准化后先做PCA，再采用K-Means、层次聚类、Fuzzy C-Means和基于图的聚类四种方法确定最优聚类数。
AI.result: 在两种数据集与两种缺失值处理的全部组合下，最优聚类数均为2；在缺乏明确最优解时以Silhouette分数评估聚类质量，各情形均获得相对较高的Silhouette分数。
AI.conclusion: 完整基因评分数据集与激酶基因子集在相同特征下呈现一致的二聚类结构，且结果对缺失值处理策略与聚类算法均较稳健。

title: Dynamic Query as Budgeting for Tiny Object Detection
summary: Recent DETR-based tiny object detectors adopt dynamic query mechanisms to handle severe density imbalance. However, existing designs entangle two effects: how many and which queries are decoded. This entanglement obscures what drives the gains and complicates dynamic-query design; additional learned predictors and heuristic filtering also introduce overhead and potential selection errors. We disentangle these effects and show that dynamic query primarily acts as \emph{budgeting}---allocating decoder query capacity according to object density---rather than intricate query selection.Motivated by this view, we formulate a monotonic and conservative budgeting principle and propose a budgeting-based DETR (BUTR), a streamlined framework that uses a lightweight, non-learned budgeter to estimate an input-dependent query budget $K(x)$ from encoder confidences. BUTR retains standard Top-$K(x)$ query initialization without additional learned modules or heuristic filtering in the budgeter.At $800\times800$ resolution, BUTR-L achieves 35.7 AP at 47.8 FPS on AI-TOD-v2 and 29.8 AP at 42.1 FPS on VisDrone on an NVIDIA T4 GPU. Inference-time integration on COCO further demonstrates its applicability to general scenario detection. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangyi-magic/BUTR.

AI.tldr: 本文解耦动态查询机制中的"数量"与"选择"两种效应，发现动态查询主要起"预算分配"作用，据此提出BUTR框架。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DETR的小目标检测器用动态查询机制应对密度不平衡，但将"解码多少查询"与"选择哪些查询"两效应纠缠，掩盖了性能增益的真正来源，且引入额外学习预测器与启发式过滤带来开销和选择误差。
AI.method: 解耦两类效应揭示动态查询本质是预算分配，随后提出单调保守的预算原则，设计轻量非学习的预算器，从编码器置信度估计输入相关查询预算K(x)，并保留标准Top-K(x)查询初始化，无需额外学习模块或启发式过滤。
AI.result: 在800×800分辨率下，BUTR-L在AI-TOD-v2达35.7 AP@47.8 FPS，VisDrone达29.8 AP@42.1 FPS（NVIDIA T4）；在COCO上的推理时集成也验证了对通用场景检测的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 动态查询的核心价值在于按目标密度分配解码器容量而非复杂查询选择，基于此的简化BUTR在精度与效率上兼具优势并具通用性。

title: AIPC: Evidence-Guided Agent Workflows for PyTorch Project Deployment
summary:
Deploying and optimizing a PyTorch inference project on a dedicated accelerator, especially an on-device NPU, requires more than using a framework device API as with CUDA. The project must be converted into hardware-runtime artifacts and adapted to the target toolchain and application interface. Differences in model formats, quantization flows, operator support, and toolchain interfaces create cross-layer problems spanning PyTorch/ONNX models, toolchains, runtimes, and device execution. LLM Agents can invoke tools to address such problems, but may drift because of insufficient domain knowledge, large configuration and repair spaces, or poor path selection.
  We propose AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion), an Agent method for deploying PyTorch inference projects. AIPC combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to drive cross-layer diagnosis and repair, organizing model adaptation, artifact building, on-target execution, accuracy repair, and performance optimization into one deployment flow. We evaluate AIPC on the on-device NPU path of Qualcomm QAIRT across vision, speech, LLM, and diffusion models. In two optimization cases, 6/7 Skill-arm Whisper-Small runs meet predefined accuracy and latency criteria versus 0/6 control runs, while YOLO-Worldv2 achieves a 2.791x end-to-end speedup versus 1.599x for the control. Under a pre-fixed deployment contract, Skill, tool permissions, and check conditions, some runs achieve zero in-run human intervention (0-HITL). We also examine Qwen3.8-27B as a locally deployable model for driving an Agent workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出 AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion），一种基于结构化 Skills 并结合工具链、运行时与 profiling 证据驱动的 Agent 方法，将 PyTorch 推理项目在端侧 NPU（Qualcomm QAIRT）上的模型适配、产物构建、上机执行、精度修复与性能优化统一为一个部署流程，在视觉、语音、LLM、扩散模型上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在专用加速器（尤其是端侧 NPU）上部署与优化 PyTorch 推理项目远比 CUDA 用 framework device API 复杂：需转换为硬件运行时产物并适配目标工具链与应用接口。模型格式、量化流程、算子支持、工具链接口的差异导致跨越 PyTorch/ONNX 模型、工具链、运行时与设备执行的跨层问题。LLM Agent 虽可调用工具应对，但因领域知识不足、配置与修复空间大、路径选择差而易偏离。
AI.method: AIPC 将结构化 Skills 与工具链、运行时、profiling 证据结合，驱动跨层诊断与修复，把模型适配、产物构建、上机执行、精度修复、性能优化组织为单一部署流程；在 Qualcomm QAIRT 端侧 NPU 路径上跨视觉、语音、LLM、扩散模型评测，并考察 Qwen3.8-27B 作为本地可部署模型驱动 Agent 工作流。
AI.result: 两个优化案例中，Skill 组 Whisper-Small 有 6/7 次运行达到预设精度与延迟标准，对照组为 0/6；YOLO-Worldv2 端到端加速 2.791x，对照组为 1.599x。在预固定部署契约、Skill、工具权限与检查条件下，部分运行实现零人工干预（0-HITL）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化 Skills 加证据驱动的 Agent 流程能显著提升跨层部署与优化的成功率与自动化程度，优于无 Skill 的对照；但 0-HITL 依赖预固定的部署契约与权限设置，且部分运行仍需人工介入，说明全自动仍需条件保障。

title: Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives
summary: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端到端框架，将视觉版面分割、多文字OCR与智能体RAG结合，应对印度历史公共档案的退化扫描页与OCR失败问题，并在20万页旁遮普邦议会档案上优于纯文本基线。
AI.motivation: 印度历史公共档案仅有退化、多栏、多文字、含噪的扫描件，OCR失败成为信息检索的首要障碍，视觉退化与版面碎片化会传播为文本抽取错误，需要专门框架来解决。
AI.method: 构建端到端框架：视觉版面分割 + 多文字OCR + 智能体化RAG流程；通过迭代式智能体循环，在生成答案前规避OCR噪声与版面歧义。
AI.result: 在20万页旁遮普邦议会（Punjab Vidhan Sabha）档案上评估，系统对历史文档退化具有鲁棒性，性能优于标准纯文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉版面理解、多文字OCR与智能体检索生成相耦合，是处理退化历史档案检索的有效路径。

title: Mycelium: A Meta-Study of Hallucination Detection Across Provenance, Typology, and Granularities
summary: Hallucination detection is increasingly important for evaluating and deploying large language models. However, existing methods are often compared across benchmarks that define and measure hallucination in substantially different ways, making reported scores difficult to interpret across settings. We study hallucination detection as a benchmark-conditioned measurement problem and organize existing benchmarks along three axes: provenance, which describes how model outputs and evidence conditions are obtained; typology, which captures the factuality and faithfulness failures represented by benchmark labels; and granularity, which specifies the unit at which hallucinations are annotated, predicted, and evaluated. Using this framework, we analyze how benchmark construction, annotation, and evaluation choices shape the underlying prediction task, and relate detector mechanisms and assumptions to the settings in which their performance is measured. We also examine span-level evaluation, where variation in annotation boundaries can substantially affect reported results, and propose Span Coverage F1 as a complementary containment-based metric. Our analysis clarifies what detector scores capture, highlights limitations of cross-benchmark comparisons, and motivates more explicit evaluation of generalization across benchmark conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文将幻觉检测视为"基准条件化的测量问题"，提出来源(provenance)、类型学(typology)、粒度(granularity)三轴框架，用于分析基准构建与评估如何塑造检测任务，并提出Span Coverage F1作为区间级补充指标。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法常在不同基准上比较，而这些基准对幻觉的定义与度量方式差异很大，导致分数难以跨情境解读；跨基准比较的有效性也缺乏系统说明。
AI.method: 提出三轴分类框架：来源（模型输出与证据条件如何获得）、类型学（基准标签代表的事实性与忠实性失败类型）、粒度（幻觉标注、预测与评估的单位）。据此分析基准的构建、标注与评估选择如何改变底层预测任务，并将检测器机制与假设同其性能测量情境对应。针对span级评估，提出基于包含关系的互补指标Span Coverage F1。
AI.result: 分析表明span级评估中标注边界的变化会显著影响报告结果；Span Coverage F1可缓解这一问题。框架同时揭示了检测器分数实际反映的内容及跨基准比较的局限。
AI.conclusion: 检测器分数受基准条件强烈影响，跨基准比较需谨慎；应更显式地评估跨基准条件的泛化能力，并采用边界不敏感的补充指标。

title: SWE-Ladder: Learning to Localize, Reproduce, and Patch via Progressive Privileged Self-Distillation
summary: Resolving a repository-level issue typically requires a software-engineering (SWE) agent to localize the faulty code, reproduce the failure, and patch the code. Reinforcement learning trains such agents from a single test result on the final patch, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adds token-level supervision from a teacher with privileged evidence, exposing the full reference patch at every step. Neither provides stage-specific guidance for localization or reproduction. We propose SWE-Ladder, which turns the verified repair of each training instance into stage-specific evidence: the changed files and lines for localization, the fail-to-pass tests for reproduction, and the diff for patching. A rule-based router assigns each step of an end-to-end rollout to a stage based on its tool call, a frozen teacher sees only the matching evidence, and the stages are distilled in repair order while GRPO optimizes the full trajectory. With Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on SWE-bench Verified under the R2E-Gym scaffold, SWE-Ladder improves pass@1 from 9.6% to 16.4%, compared with 10.4% for GRPO and 12.4% for OPSD with the full patch. Under the OpenHands scaffold, it improves pass@1 from 13.0% to 17.6%. Reversing the stage order under R2E-Gym reduces pass@1 to 11.4%.

AI.tldr: SWE-Ladder 将已验证的修复拆解为定位、复现、打补丁三阶段的证据，用规则路由器把轨迹步骤分阶段，并由冻结教师只看到对应阶段证据进行分阶段蒸馏，同时用 GRPO 优化整条轨迹，显著提升 SWE agent 的 pass@1。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 只用最终补丁的单一测试结果做奖励，OPSD 则每步都暴露完整参考补丁，二者都无法为"定位故障代码"和"复现失败"这些中间阶段提供针对性指导。
AI.method: 把每个训练实例的已验证修复转成阶段专属证据：定位用改动文件与行，复现用 fail-to-pass 测试，打补丁用 diff。基于工具调用的规则路由器将端到端 rollout 的每一步归入某阶段；冻结教师仅可见匹配阶段证据；按修复顺序做分阶段蒸馏，并用 GRPO 优化完整轨迹。
AI.result: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 + SWE-bench Verified：R2E-Gym 脚手架下 pass@1 从 9.6% 提升到 16.4%（GRPO 10.4%，全补丁 OPSD 12.4%）；OpenHands 脚手架下从 13.0% 提升到 17.6%。R2E-Gym 中颠倒阶段顺序则降至 11.4%。
AI.conclusion: 阶段特定的教师证据与按修复顺序的蒸馏优于全局奖励或全补丁监督，且顺序本身有实质影响，说明细粒度阶段化监督是提升仓库级 SWE agent 的有效途径。

title: Nowcasting aerosol particle size distributions from PM2.5 with physics-regularized flow matching
summary: The mass concentration of particles smaller than 2.5um (PM2.5) is cheap to measure and widely monitored, whereas the particle number size distribution (PSD) requires costly instruments and is measured at only a few research stations. Yet many aerosol effects, such as vapor uptake, cloud droplet formation and deposition in the human respiratory tract, depend on the PSD rather than on mass. We explore whether recent generative deep learning models can nowcast the PSD: from the PM2.5 record and eight meteorological parameters over a 24h window, a model generates an ensemble of plausible hourly size distributions for the same window, reflecting that one mass can arise from many size distributions. Rather than proposing a single best model, we use two contrasting Finnish stations, the boreal forest site Hyytiälä and the urban site Kumpula, as a controlled testbed. On it, we benchmark six generative models against deterministic and climatological baselines, locally and after transfer between sites, and test physical constraints for neural network training. Flow matching performs best overall; its guided variant has the lowest continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) at both sites. A constraint based on a reduced aerosol general dynamic equation (GDE) lowers the CRPS by 5.5-11.5% at the training site and reduces errors after transfer between sites. Transfer remains harder than local estimation, identifying training on large multi-station data sets as the next step towards PSD estimates at unmonitored locations. This benchmark establishes physics-informed generative models as a promising route from routine air-quality monitoring to size-resolved aerosol information.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索用生成式深度学习从PM2.5记录和气象参数"临近预报"粒径分布(PSD)，在两个芬兰站点上基准测试六种生成模型，发现Flow matching（引导变体）表现最佳，且基于简化GDE的物理约束能显著降低CRPS并改善跨站点迁移。
AI.motivation: PM2.5质量浓度测量便宜且广泛监测，而粒径分布(PSD)需昂贵仪器、仅在少数科研站测量；但气溶胶的诸多效应（蒸汽吸收、云滴形成、呼吸道沉积）取决于PSD而非质量浓度。作者希望利用现有廉价监测数据推断PSD。
AI.method: 任务设定：以24h窗口内的PM2.5记录和8个气象参数为输入，生成同一窗口逐小时PSD的合理集合（体现一种质量浓度可对应多种粒径分布）。以芬兰两个对比站点（北方森林Hyytiälä与城市Kumpula）作为受控测试平台，将六种生成模型与确定性和气候态基线比较，覆盖本地估计与跨站点迁移，并测试用于神经网络训练的物理约束（基于简化气溶胶通用动力学方程GDE的约束）。
AI.result: Flow matching综合表现最佳，其引导变体在两站点均取得最低CRPS。基于简化GDE的物理约束在训练站点使CRPS降低5.5–11.5%，并减少跨站点迁移后的误差。跨站点迁移仍比本地估计困难。
AI.conclusion: 该基准表明物理信息生成模型是从常规空气质量监测走向粒径分辨气溶胶信息的有前景途径；下一步应在大型多站点数据集上训练，以将PSD估计推广到未监测地点。

title: Semantic-First MixGRPO: Reliable Emotional Image Generation via Temporal Decoupling
summary: Controllable image synthesis should modify visual affect without replacing the objects, layout, or relations specified by a prompt. Existing methods address this tension through conditioning architectures or auxiliary losses, while mixed ordinary differential equation (ODE) and stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling has mainly been used to accelerate group relative policy optimization (GRPO). We instead study stochastic-window position as an attribute-control variable for flow-based image generation. Using FLUX.1-dev with EmotiCrafter-style valence-arousal conditioning, we compare fixed early, middle, and late four-transition SDE windows, progressive MixGRPO, and full-path Flow-GRPO under matched settings. Because step 0 has the highest noise, our semantic-first schedule uses deterministic ODE sampling at steps 0-19 to establish content, then confines stochastic exploration and policy updates to steps 20-23. Across three seeds, it achieves a CLIPScore of $29.662\pm0.276$, cross-affect DINO consistency of $80.1\pm0.9$, and semantic drift of 2.9%, while reducing training cost by 33.5% relative to full-path Flow-GRPO. Full-path stochastic training remains more accurate on valence-arousal targets, revealing a genuine trade-off. Semantic-first nevertheless improves both affect and semantic metrics over progressive scheduling, preserves the principal subject in 95.98% of images at five extreme or neutral targets, and receives the highest semantic-preservation and overall-preference ratings in a 30-participant study. These results identify probability-flow time as a practical graphics control dimension for reliable affective appearance manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究随机窗口位置作为流式图像生成的属性控制变量，提出“语义优先”调度：前20步用确定性ODE建立内容，后4步限定SDE探索与策略更新，在情感控制上兼顾语义保真并降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: 可控情感图像合成需在修改视觉情感的同时保持提示指定的物体、布局与关系不变，二者存在张力；现有方法依赖条件架构或辅助损失，混合ODE/SDE采样主要用于加速GRPO，随机窗口位置本身作为控制维度尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 基于FLUX.1-dev与EmotiCrafter式价-唤醒度条件，在匹配设置下比较固定早/中/晚四步SDE窗口、渐进式MixGRPO与全路径Flow-GRPO；据此提出语义优先调度：0-19步确定性ODE采样确立内容（步0噪声最高），20-23步才施加随机探索与策略更新。
AI.result: 三个种子下CLIPScore 29.662±0.276、跨情感DINO一致性80.1±0.9、语义漂移2.9%，训练成本较全路径Flow-GRPO降低33.5%；全路径随机训练在价-唤醒度目标上更准确，体现真实权衡；语义优先在情感与语义指标上均优于渐进调度，在五个极端/中性目标下95.98%图像保留主体，30人用户研究中语义保持与整体偏好评分最高。
AI.conclusion: 概率流时间可作为实用的图形学控制维度，用于可靠的情感外观操控；随机窗口位置是控制情感编辑强度与语义保持平衡的关键杠杆，但精度与效率间仍存在可量化的权衡。

title: SemWeaver: Refining LLM-Generated Static Vulnerability Checkers with Analyzer-Internal Evidence
summary: Recent work shows that LLMs can synthesize static-analysis checkers from security patches, but a compilable checker is not necessarily a correct one. A patch reveals what changed, not why the change is safe, so generated checkers often match only the surface edit and miss the deeper semantic condition. Existing refinement loops feed back compilation errors and validation reports, yet these signals describe symptoms without explaining what the checker misunderstands about the code. We observe that the analysis framework itself already computes the information needed to close this gap. Control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions and checker callbacks are available inside the analyzer but unused by current refinement strategies. SemWeaver is a plug-in refinement layer that extracts patch-relevant analyzer evidence and assembles it with source context and validation feedback into a structured, provenance-labelled bundle.
