Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach improves generalization to noisy scans and enables reliable reconstruction of complex multi-part objects across multiple real-world CAD reverse engineering benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CADonatello：面向真实扫描的部件感知参数化CAD重建框架，通过3D部件分割+截面驱动草图参数化+拉伸重建，并引入CC3D Cross-Sections数据集实现域适应。
AI.motivation: 现有从3D扫描重建CAD的方法在标准基准上表现良好，但真实场景中物体常由多部件组成且含噪声等扫描伪影，性能下降。核心原因在于现有数据集多为单部件模型和干净输入，导致模型难以泛化到真实场景。
AI.method: 先用基础规模3D部件分割模型将输入几何分解为结构上有意义的部件；再对每个部件独立重建，采用截面驱动流程：先草图参数化，再拉伸；为提升草图参数化对扫描截面的鲁棒性，构建CC3D Cross-Sections数据集（真实扫描的光栅化截面图像与对齐CAD模型参数化草图配对），实现从干净CAD草图图像到扫描截面图像的域适应。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法提升了对噪声扫描的泛化能力，并在多个真实CAD逆向工程基准上实现复杂多部件物体的可靠重建。
AI.conclusion: 部件分解与截面驱动重建结合域适应数据集，可有效应对真实扫描的噪声与多部件挑战，推动CAD逆向工程向真实场景落地。

title: The Hidden Costs of Forgetting: A Study of Trajectory Deletion in Software Engineering Agents
summary: Software engineering agents resend their entire trajectory to an LLM at every turn, motivating online trajectory reduction. Prior work shows that randomly deleting 75% of tokens in old turns may preserve agent effectiveness, but it remains unclear why, how agents compensate for missing content, and whether it actually reduces costs. This paper presents an empirical study of 42 trajectory-reduction configurations, focusing on effectiveness, agent behavior, and cost. We systematically explore deleting content from old turns by varying the scope, granularity, amount, and timing of deletion across 9,400 runs with two state-of-the-art agents on SWE-bench Verified. We find deleting large amounts of trajectory content (e.g., up to 100% of reasoning text) can preserve overall effectiveness. Importantly, such deletion must be applied with a delay, as immediate deletion tends to significantly degrade effectiveness. Agents often compensate for deleted content by re-fetching it, increasing both the number of turns taken and the input/output tokens. Whether trajectory reduction reduces costs depends on the pricing model: Under a flat pricing model, estimated costs fall in 26 of 42 evaluations. Surprisingly, under a caching-aware pricing model, zero evaluations yield lower costs, since reducing the trajectory breaks the cached prefix billed at a lower rate. Our findings have three implications: First, token counts alone are misleading; trajectory reduction techniques must consider overall costs under a realistic pricing model. Second, analyzing trajectories is crucial to understand agent behavior, as end-to-end effectiveness hides differences such as excessive re-fetching. Finally, these results highlight the need for future work on memory management to reduce costs without sacrificing effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文对 42 种轨迹缩减配置进行实证研究（9,400 次 SWE-bench Verified 运行），发现延迟大量删除旧轮次内容可保持智能体有效性，但智能体会通过重新获取内容补偿，且仅在固定价格模型下降本，在缓存感知定价下无降本效果。
AI.motivation: 软件工程智能体每轮都把完整轨迹重发给 LLM，成本高昂；已有工作显示随机删除旧轮次 75% token 可能不损害效果，但原因不明、补偿机制不清、是否真降本存疑。
AI.method: 系统改变删除的范围、粒度、数量与时机，在 SWE-bench Verified 上用两个 SOTA 智能体运行 9,400 次，覆盖 42 种轨迹缩减配置，从有效性、智能体行为与成本三方面分析。
AI.result: 大量删除（如 100% 推理文本）可保持整体有效性，但必须延迟删除，立即删除显著降低效果；智能体常通过重新获取被删内容补偿，导致轮数和输入/输出 token 增加；固定价格模型下 42 项评估中 26 项成本下降，缓存感知定价下 0 项下降。
AI.conclusion: 仅看 token 数具有误导性，需按真实定价评估总体成本；轨迹分析对揭示重取等行为差异至关重要；未来需研究在保证有效性的前提下降低成本的记忆管理方法。

title: What Makes a Question Curious? Measuring Model Curiosity in Human-LLM Interactions
summary: Large language models increasingly act as partners in everyday communication. In these interactions, useful assistance may require not only answering, but also asking the right questions that surface knowledge gaps, assumptions, and alternatives. In this study, we refer to such epistemic question-asking as model curiosity, and introduce a theory-grounded taxonomy that distinguishes curiosity-oriented questions from generic model questioning. Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"模型好奇心"概念及理论分类框架，区分好奇心导向提问与普通提问；在四个对话数据集中发现此类提问占比仅17-28%，但能引发更具探索性的用户回应，人类研究显示其在建议、创意与研究情境中尤有价值。
AI.motivation: LLM日益成为日常交流伙伴，有用的协助不只是回答问题，还需提出能揭示知识空白、假设与替代方案的问题，但现有研究缺乏对这类"认知性提问"的系统刻画。
AI.method: 构建理论驱动的分类法，将好奇心导向提问与一般模型提问区分开；在四个对话数据集上统计并分析提问比例及其与用户后续回应的关联；另开展人类研究评估模型好奇心的有用性。
AI.result: 好奇心导向提问仅占全部提问的17-28%，属稀缺行为；但其与更富探索性、认知信息更丰富的用户回应相关，且模式随数据集而异；人类研究显示好奇心可促进探索，在建议、创意、研究类情境中效果尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: LLM应更"有选择地"提问以支持更深入的探索与人机协作，为构建具备选择性好奇心的模型提供依据。

title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern
summary: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoTavern：由多个专门化LLM研究智能体组成、共享类型化研究记忆并经过验证门控的自我改进系统，在20天内为炉石传说酒馆战棋构建出忠实全内容模拟器TavernGym与23版PPO训练智能体TavernAgent，在实战天梯与自建TavernBench上全面超越前沿LLM与人类高分段玩家。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM智能体能否把困难的真实世界问题从原始数据一路推进到可与人类抗衡的系统；选择炉石传说酒馆战棋作为高难度测试床（八人对战、随机商店与战斗、隐藏信息、近千张交互卡牌）。
AI.method: AutoTavern系统：专门化LLM研究智能体共享类型化研究记忆，每条主张须通过验证门控，实时对局闭环反馈，使智能体同时改进模拟器、对手、策略以及自身研究流程，人类仅设定目标并裁定歧义机制。产出TavernGym（首个忠实全内容复现）与TavernAgent（用PPO针对校准对手训练，共23版）。
AI.result: 20天内完成；TavernAgent在天梯评分从6,000升至约15,000，最近20局平均名次1.60、80%第一名，各项指标优于服务器前十高分段玩家（2.34、59%）。TavernBench（40场景960任务）上，对战任务答对率91%（前沿LLM≤63%），决策耗时0.03秒（LLM最多26秒）；在实时回合1秒限制内保持90%，LLM不超过26%。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体"构建"系统远胜于其"亲自游玩"；通过共享记忆、验证门控与真实对局闭环，智能体可在短期内自主搭建高质量模拟器与超越人类顶尖水平的策略系统。TavernBench与TavernGym将开源。

title: Reactive Optimizers
comment: This document is a static version of our blog post. We recommend the original interactive version at https://xingjianbai.com/reactive-optimizers/. We release the code at https://github.com/xingjian-bai/opal
summary: We study a reactive optimizer that uses a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run. The agent can change update rules and schedules for individual parameter groups, without optimizer-specific meta-training or memory transferred from other runs. We evaluate this approach, OPAL, on language modeling and image generation when a recipe has not been tuned for the target setting. Across the evaluated settings, it matches or improves on selected fixed recipes. Analysis of its decisions shows changes to learning-rate schedules, optimizer structure, numerical precision, and momentum. Controlled experiments also show adaptation to repeated data corruption and reduced overfitting. We report these behaviors together with the agent's computational cost and implementation requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出OPAL：一种反应式优化器，用预训练语言模型智能体在单次训练过程中检查训练动态并改写可执行的优化器代码，可对个别参数组调整更新规则与调度，无需优化器专属元训练或跨运行记忆。
AI.motivation: 当训练配方未针对目标设置调优时，固定优化器配方往往不理想；作者希望让优化器能在训练中根据实际动态自适应地改写自身规则，而不依赖针对优化器设计的元训练或历史运行经验。
AI.method: 以预训练语言模型作为智能体，在线观察训练动态，生成并执行优化器代码修改；可针对不同参数组改变更新规则与学习率调度。在语言建模与图像生成的未调优配方场景中评估，并通过受控实验（重复数据损坏等）分析行为，同时报告计算开销与实现要求。
AI.result: 在所评估的设置中，OPAL 达到或优于选定的固定配方；其决策涉及学习率调度、优化器结构、数值精度与动量的改变；受控实验显示其能适应重复的数据损坏并降低过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型驱动的反应式优化器改写是可行且有效的自适应训练手段，但需权衡智能体的计算成本与实现复杂度；作者同时披露了这些开销与部署要求。

title: ZoomSEM: accelerating large-scale brain connectomics with intelligent SEM super-resolution
summary: Serial electron microscopy (EM) is essential for large-volume biological imaging and connectomics, yet its throughput remains a major bottleneck, with cubic-millimeter-scale brain imaging requiring months or years. Existing deep learning-based EM super-resolution methods are limited to small upscaling factors or rely on synthetic data, offering modest acceleration and limited practical impact. We introduce ZoomSEM, a deep learning-based super-resolution method to dramatically accelerate SEM imaging. Trained on real low- and high-resolution scanning electron microscopy (SEM) pairs, ZoomSEM enables reliable recovery of 4$\times$, 8$\times$, and up to 16$\times$ higher-resolution images from fast low-resolution scans while preserving fine neuronal structures critical for connectomic analysis, achieving up to 30-fold effective acceleration. Extensive experiments across datasets of diverse biological samples demonstrate robust generalization under realistic low-resolution acquisition. This advance enables high-resolution, large-volume serial EM imaging at unprecedented speed, poised to transform connectomics and related fields.

AI.tldr: ZoomSEM 是一种基于深度学习的 SEM 图像超分辨率方法，利用真实低/高分辨率图像对训练，支持 4×、8× 乃至 16× 上采样，实现最高约 30 倍的成像加速，同时保留连接组分析所需的精细神经结构。
AI.motivation: 串行电子显微镜（EM）是大体积生物成像与连接组学的关键手段，但通量低是主要瓶颈——立方毫米级脑成像需数月甚至数年。现有深度学习 EM 超分辨率方法上采样倍数小，或依赖合成数据，加速有限、实用性不足。
AI.method: 提出 ZoomSEM：在真实的低分辨率与高分辨率 SEM 配对数据上训练深度学习超分辨率模型，从快速低分辨率扫描中恢复 4×、8×、最高 16× 的高分辨率图像，重点保持对连接组分析至关重要的精细神经元结构。
AI.result: 可实现最高约 30 倍的有效加速；在多种生物样本数据集上，于真实低分辨率采集条件下展现出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该进展使高分辨率、大体积串行 EM 成像以前所未有的速度实现，有望推动连接组学及相关领域变革。

title: Ranking Function Generation with LLMs for Termination
summary: Ranking functions are a fundamental technique for proving loop termination, but constructing them manually is challenging and requires substantial expertise. We propose RAINFALL, a neuro-symbolic framework which follows the generate-verify-refine paradigm and tightly integrates LLMs with symbolic verification. RAINFALL formulates ranking function synthesis as a code-completion task by inserting placeholders into the input program and constraining the LLM to fill four predefined slots for each loop. The completed program is then checked by a symbolic verifier. If verification succeeds, a valid ranking function is obtained; otherwise, the verifier's diagnostics are translated into natural-language feedback that guides iterative refinement of the LLM's output. We evaluate RAINFALL on two public benchmark suites comprising 358 terminating C programs. Using MiniMax V2.7, RAINFALL synthesizes verifiable ranking functions for 323 programs (90.22%), outperforming all promising baselines. In particular, it solves 12 more programs than PROTON 2.1, the best-performing baseline and winner of the SV-COMP 2026 Termination category. Furthermore, combining RAINFALL with PROTON 2.1 increases the success rate to 96.65% (346/358 programs). We also conduct ablation study confirming individual contributions of placeholder contracts, few-shot examples, symbolic verification, and diagnostic information feedback. Experiments across LLMs further confirm the effectiveness of RAINFALL. Our results suggest a generic, sound framework for ranking-function synthesis and, beyond termination, LLM-assisted synthesis of formally checkable liveness certificates, both of which represent new directions of software engineering research.

AI.tldr: RAINFALL 是一个神经-符号框架，按"生成-验证-精化"范式将 LLM 与符号验证紧耦合，通过代码补全任务合成循环终止的 ranking function。
AI.motivation: 手工构造 ranking function 困难且需大量专业知识，因此需要自动化方法；LLM 生成难以保证正确性，需结合符号验证保证可靠性。
AI.method: 在输入程序中插入占位符，将 ranking function 合成转化为代码补全任务，约束 LLM 为每个循环填充四个预定义槽位；补全后由符号验证器检查，成功即得到有效 ranking function，失败则将验证器诊断转译为自然语言反馈，引导 LLM 迭代精化。
AI.result: 在两个公共基准（共 358 个终止 C 程序）上，使用 MiniMax V2.7 为 323 个程序（90.22%）合成可验证的 ranking function，优于所有基线；比最佳基线 PROTON 2.1（SV-COMP 2026 Termination 冠军）多解 12 个程序；与 PROTON 2.1 结合后成功率提升至 96.65%（346/358）。消融实验确认了占位符契约、few-shot 示例、符号验证及诊断反馈的贡献，跨 LLM 实验也验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式给出了一个通用、可靠的 ranking function 合成框架，并可推广到终止性之外的形式化可检查活性证书的 LLM 辅助合成，为软件工程研究提供新方向。

title: Beyond Belief: Evaluating and Mitigating LLM Susceptibility to Misinformation
summary: Tool-using large language models (LLMs) must decide whether external information warrants action. We investigate whether their expressed credibility judgments reliably indicate behavioral resistance to misinformation. We evaluate five LLMs on 196 constructed false notices paired with legitimate counterparts and 204 archived attacks adapted to simulated tool use. When asked to act on the constructed notices, models issue harmful tool calls in 27%--99% of cases they have rated untrustworthy. Removing the preliminary rating step increases harmful execution by 15 percentage points on average, showing that credibility elicitation itself changes the behavior being evaluated. Interventions that improve credibility discrimination do not consistently yield safer actions. A simple forewarning significantly reduces harmful execution in four of five models, but neither tested generated-example prebunk outperforms it in the main evaluation. These reductions can also compromise legitimate task completion. Supervised fine-tuning on generated false notices reduces harmful execution on held-out archived attacks under the rating-first protocol, with model-dependent utility costs and weaker protection without rating elicitation. Our findings motivate evaluating misinformation defenses through both harmful actions and legitimate task completion, while accounting for the behavioral effects of the evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 论文检验工具型大模型"口头可信度判断"是否真能反映其行为上的抗误导能力，发现二者严重脱节，并强调评估协议本身会影响行为。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型LLM需要判断外部信息是否值得行动，但现有防御评估多依赖模型自述的可信度评分，尚不清楚这种"表达出的判断"能否预测真实的行为抵抗。
AI.method: 在5个LLM上评测196条构造的虚假通知（配合法对照）与204条存档攻击（改造为模拟工具使用场景）；对比"先评分后行动"与直接行动两种协议；测试提升可信度判别能力的干预、简单预警、生成样例式prebunk、以及基于生成虚假通知的监督微调。
AI.result: 在模型自评为不可信的案例中，仍有27%–99%发出有害工具调用；移除预评分步骤平均使有害执行增加15个百分点；改善可信度判别的干预并不稳定带来更安全行为；简单预警在5个模型中4个显著降低有害执行，优于两种prebunk；这些收益可能损害合法任务完成；SFT在留出攻击上有迁移效果但存在依赖模型的效用代价，去掉评分环节后保护变弱。
AI.conclusion: 误信息防御应同时以"有害行动"和"合法任务完成"双指标评估，并须考虑评估协议本身对行为的影响；口头可信度判断不能作为行为抵抗的可靠代理。

title: Numina Fuse: Interactive Autoformalization in Lean 4
summary: Numina Fuse is an agent-native application for formalizing mathematics in Lean 4. Since Lean can compile while not representing its intended informal meaning, and agents now write Lean faster than people can read it, we built Fuse around human supervision of agent work. A user works with an AI orchestrator on a Lean project and supervises it through views of the blueprint, the dependency graph, and the Lean code, while the backend keeps the project's derived state and runs agents for hours without the user present. We describe the development of Fuse throughout 2026, as it moved from a prescribed pipeline of agents paced by human review to an orchestrator that dispatches specialists, provers, and parallel children on its own. We designed for this shift, keeping project state, tooling, and interface design separate from orchestration so that agents could take over more of the work as models improved. We report Fuse's use in a formalization of the three-dimensional Kakeya conjecture and a study of prover models. We close with lessons for the next generation of autoformalization systems. Fuse Desktop, an open-source local version, is available at https://github.com/project-numina/fuse-desktop.

AI.tldr: Numina Fuse 是一个用于在 Lean 4 中形式化数学的 agent 原生应用，围绕"人类监督 agent 工作"设计，其架构从人审节流的固定 agent 流水线演进为自主调度的 orchestrator，并在三维 Kakeya 猜想形式化中实际使用。
AI.motivation: Lean 能通过编译却不保证表达了原本的非形式化含义（即"编译正确 ≠ 语义正确"），同时 agent 写 Lean 的速度已远超人类阅读速度，因此需要把系统设计重心从"人写/人审每一行"转向"人监督 agent"。
AI.method: 构建 agent 原生应用：用户与 AI orchestrator 协作，通过 blueprint、依赖图和 Lean 代码三种视图进行监督；后端维护项目的派生状态，支持 agent 在无人值守下连续运行数小时。架构上将项目状态、工具链与界面设计与编排逻辑解耦，使模型变强后 agent 可接管更多工作。系统在 2026 年逐步从"人审节流的预设 agent 流水线"演化为"自主分派 specialist、prover 与并行子 agent 的 orchestrator"。
AI.result: 在三维 Kakeya 猜想的形式化中投入使用，并开展了 prover 模型的对比研究；同时产出开源本地版本 Fuse Desktop。
AI.conclusion: 作者总结了面向下一代 autoformalization 系统的经验教训，核心主张是以人类监督为中心、编排与基础设施解耦的 agent 原生架构更适应模型能力的快速提升。

title: EEGBiFormer: Real-Time EEG Attention Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformer with EEG-Informed Auditory Protocol Validation
summary: Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence. This paper presents EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for realtime binary classification of attention states, focus versus nonfocus, from 16-channel EEG signals. A custom analog front-end acquisition board was designed and built to collect a task-based EEG dataset. Before model training, spectral and connectivity analysis, using Power Spectral Density and Phase Locking Value, confirmed distinct neural signatures between attention states, providing physiological grounding for the classification approach. EEGBiFormer achieved 91.3 percent window-level validation accuracy with an F1 score of 94.5 percent, and 88.2 percent recording-level accuracy across 17 independent sessions. End-to-end system latency was measured below 100 ms, supporting real-time responsiveness. The trained model was further used to objectively rank auditory stimuli by focus-state confidence, yielding EEG-informed audio protocols. In a paired within-subject behavioral study with 37 participants, these protocols produced a statistically significant 20 percent improvement in composite attention scores over silent controls, with a medium-to-large effect size. This work demonstrates a complete pipeline from custom EEG hardware through neural signal analysis, deep learning classification, and evidence-based auditory protocol design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EEGBiFormer（CNN-Transformer 混合模型），基于自建 16 通道 EEG 采集板与任务数据集实现专注/非专注状态的实时二分类，并据此设计数据驱动的听觉刺激协议，经行为实验验证可显著提升注意力。
AI.motivation: 学业表现高度依赖持续注意力，但现有听觉辅助工具是静态的，缺乏实时神经证据支撑，无法根据使用者当前专注状态自适应调整。
AI.method: 自研模拟前端采集板构建任务态 16 通道 EEG 数据集；先用功率谱密度（PSD）与相位锁定值（PLV）做频谱与连通性分析，确认两种状态存在可区分的神经特征；再训练 CNN-Transformer 混合模型 EEGBiFormer 做实时二分类；随后用模型输出的“专注置信度”对听觉刺激客观排序，生成 EEG 驱动的音频协议，并在 37 人被试内配对行为实验中与静音对照比较。
AI.result: 窗口级验证准确率 91.3%、F1 94.5%；17 个独立 session 的记录级准确率 88.2%；端到端系统延迟低于 100 ms；行为实验中复合注意力分数较静音对照显著提升 20%，效应量中到大。
AI.conclusion: 工作打通了“自研 EEG 硬件—神经信号分析—深度学习分类—循证听觉协议设计”的完整闭环，表明基于实时神经证据的自适应听觉干预是可行且有效的。

title: UltraFlash: Accelerating Megapixel Visual Synthesis
summary: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolutions at which these models are typically trained. Cascade refinement is a leading strategy for this setting: it starts from a base image at a native resolution and progressively upsamples it to the target resolution through multiple refinement stages. Each stage typically performs a pixel-space resolution transition followed by latent-space denoising. While prior acceleration efforts mainly focus on reducing denoising cost, we identify a complementary and underexplored bottleneck: the repeated movement of representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions. In cascade pipelines, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress boundary artifacts. We propose UltraFlash, a transition-efficient approach that accelerates these VAE-heavy operations. UltraFlash has two components. Latent Hyperloop replaces intermediate RGB round trips with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the decode-resize-encode transformation without repeated VAE decoding and encoding. Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final reconstruction by addressing patch seams caused by inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by approximately 2x while improving image quality. These results show that optimizing pixel-space transitions can improve both efficiency and fidelity, offering an effective route toward fast, high-quality megapixel visual synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出 UltraFlash，通过优化级联扩散中反复解码-缩放-编码等 VAE 密集操作（像素空间转换），在将 4K 生成延迟降低约 2 倍的同时提升图像质量。
AI.motivation: 百万像素级潜在扩散生成需在远超训练分辨率下运行，级联细化各阶段都要经历像素空间分辨率切换与潜空间去噪。已有加速工作多聚焦去噪开销，而反复的 VAE 解码/编码（中间 RGB 往返、最终重叠分块解码）这一瓶颈被忽视。
AI.method: UltraFlash 含两部分：(1) Latent Hyperloop，用学习到的潜空间捷径近似 decode-resize-encode 变换，免去中间 RGB 往返；(2) Sparse Patch-based Decoding，针对分块间 GroupNorm 统计不一致导致的接缝，复用缓存统计量，使稀疏分块解码可用更小重叠。
AI.result: 集成到 SOTA 级联基线后，4K 生成延迟降低约 2x，且图像质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 优化像素空间转换可同时提升效率与保真度，是通往快速、高质量百万像素视觉合成的有效路径。

title: FLOWSTEP: A Framework for Learning to Predict GitHub Actions Workflow STEPs
summary: Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD) are fundamental to modern software development, yet configuring pipelines such as GitHub Actions (GHA) workflows remains complex and error-prone. Recent work has explored Transformer-based models for GHA workflow recommendation, but existing approaches typically model workflow steps as a single homogeneous generation task. This formulation overlooks a key distinction: reusable Actions are structured, ecosystem-level components, whereas project-specific Scripts encode local build, test, and deployment semantics. Consequently, current models struggle to capture the different forms of knowledge required for accurate workflow completion. In this work, we present FLOWSTEP, a framework for GHA workflow step completion that explicitly distinguishes between Action and Script generation. FLOWSTEP combines large language models (LLMs) with contrastive learning to better capture semantic relationships among workflow contexts, Actions, and Scripts. Evaluated on established benchmarks, FLOWSTEP improves end-to-end workflow step prediction accuracy from 38.23% to 51.09%. Beyond prediction accuracy, we further study whether LLM-as-a-judge can provide a more semantic evaluation of generated workflow steps. By comparing LLM-based assessments with human annotations, we find that the best-performing model configuration reaches substantial agreement with human ground truth (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.701), suggesting that LLM-as-a-judge can serve as a scalable complement to manual evaluation.

AI.tldr: FLOWSTEP 将 GHA workflow 步骤补全拆分为 Action 与 Script 两类生成任务，结合 LLM 与对比学习，将步骤预测准确率从 38.23% 提升至 51.09%，并验证 LLM-as-a-judge 可作为可扩展的语义评估手段。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的 GHA workflow 推荐方法把步骤视为单一同质生成任务，忽略了可复用 Action（生态级结构化组件）与项目特定 Script（承载本地构建/测试/部署语义）的本质区别，导致模型难以掌握两类不同知识，补全准确性受限。
AI.method: 提出 FLOWSTEP 框架，显式区分 Action 生成与 Script 生成；将大语言模型与对比学习结合，以更好刻画 workflow 上下文、Action 与 Script 之间的语义关系。
AI.result: 在既有基准上，端到端 workflow 步骤预测准确率由 38.23% 提升到 51.09%。进一步的 LLM-as-a-judge 评估中，最佳配置与人工标注达到较高一致性（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.701）。
AI.conclusion: 区分 Action 与 Script 的建模能有效提升 GHA 步骤补全性能；LLM-as-a-judge 与人工评估高度一致，可作为人工评估的可扩展补充。

title: "High-Quality" Data for Early-Stage Instruction Tuning: An Empirical Study of Data Quality Metrics
summary: "Data quality" is widely invoked in instruction tuning, but the term is often underspecified. We study it as an operational property by asking which simple example-level metrics, drawn from prior work on data selection, text quality, and instruction tuning, best predict training utility under a fixed finetuning budget. For each metric, we sort instruction-response examples by score, partition them into low, middle, and high bins with roughly equal token mass, finetune separately on each bin, and compare validation perplexity and LLM-as-judge scores for the models' generated answers as a function of cumulative training tokens. Our results suggest that answer-dense supervision, as captured by response ratio, is a stronger and more portable predictor of instruction-tuning utility than commonly used alternative proxies.

AI.tldr: 本文把"数据质量"当作可操作的属性来研究：在固定微调预算下，检验来自数据选择、文本质量和指令微调等先前工作的简单样本级指标，哪一个最能预测训练效用。
AI.motivation: "数据质量"在指令微调中被广泛提及，但定义常常含糊不清。作者希望弄清这些常用简单指标中，哪些真正能预测指令微调的训练效用，而非停留于模糊的说法。
AI.method: 对每个指标按分数排序指令-回答样本，以大致相等的token量分为低、中、高三档，分别在各档上微调；随后以累计训练token为自变量，比较验证困惑度和LLM-as-judge对模型生成答案的评分。
AI.result: 结果显示，以response ratio（回答占比）衡量的"答案密集型监督"是指令微调效用的更强、更可迁移的预测指标，优于常用的其他替代代理指标。
AI.conclusion: response ratio是一个更强且更可迁移的指令微调数据效用预测器，"数据质量"应作为可操作属性来定义和度量。

title: ReGE: Stronger Agents through Experience Synthesis
summary: Repeated attempts at interactive tasks uncover facts, useful operations, and failures that can inform subsequent execution. We introduce ReGE, a framework for turning this recorded experience into guidance for a fresh attempt. Its main implementation, ReGE-Syn, uses a single coach call to jointly synthesize bounded execution records and available artifacts into self-contained guidance, connecting task-specific findings with proposed actions and relevant pitfalls. A student starts from the task's initial environment state and adapts this guidance to current observations. Source generation, synthesis, and student execution use the same base model, without parameter updates or a stronger teacher. Across four benchmarks, ReGE improves accuracy by an average of 9.9 percentage points for GPT and 8.8 percentage points for Claude compared with unguided execution. On matched BrowseComp-Plus subsets, ReGE-Syn reduces guidance-construction tokens by 98.2\% on GPT and 95.5\% on Claude relative to adapted AggAgent, with observed success. Combined construction and execution tokens decrease by 15.7\% and 35.4\%, respectively, counting input plus output and excluding source generation. BrowseComp-Plus ablations further associate access to process information with fewer student steps and show that joint synthesis produces substantially shorter guidance than Direct history or Independent summaries, with observed success. These results demonstrate how agents can use their own recorded experience to improve subsequent task completion, and suggest a low-cost way to consolidate the execution records of parallel agent systems such as agent swarms.

AI.tldr: ReGE框架将历史尝试记录转化为自包含指导，供"学生"代理在相似任务中复用，无需参数更新即可提升成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 重复执行交互任务会产生有价值的事实、操作与失败经验，但这些经验通常未被系统化利用；同时现有方法（如AggAgent）构建指导成本高、token消耗大。
AI.method: 提出ReGE框架，主要实现ReGE-Syn：用单次"coach"调用将有界执行记录与可用工件联合合成为自包含指导，连接任务发现、建议动作与陷阱；学生代理从初始环境状态出发，将指导适配当前观察。生成、合成、执行均用同一基座模型，无参数更新或更强教师。
AI.result: 四个基准上准确率平均提升9.9个百分点（GPT）和8.8个百分点（Claude）；BrowseComp-Plus匹配子集上指导构建token较AggAgent减少98.2%（GPT）/95.5%（Claude），构建+执行token降15.7%/35.4%；消融显示过程信息减少学生步数，联合合成比Direct history/Independent summaries生成更短指导。
AI.conclusion: 代理可利用自身记录经验提升后续任务完成度，并提供一种低成本整合并行代理系统（如智能体集群）执行记录的方法。

title: Hessian-Similar Optimization with Capped Participation: Lower Bounds and Virtual Masters
summary: What is the round complexity of Hessian-similar optimization when each round can contact at most $s$ of $m$ clients? Prior rates permit a free master or full participation and do not characterize strict caps. We count every one-vector query and reply. A hidden-client chain gives a lower bound for zero-respecting local algorithms with adaptive cohorts and random stopping: on strongly convex quadratics, the required rounds are $Ω((m/s)\sqrt{\min\{δ_a,\barδ/\sqrt m\}/μ}\,\log(1/ε))$ for $s\leq(m-2)/2$ in the high-accuracy, high-dissimilarity regime. Here $μ$ is strong convexity, while $δ_a$ and $\barδ$ bound anchor and average Hessian variation. To remove dependence on a poor anchor, virtual-master SVRS uses independent estimator and proximal cohorts and averages the proximal replies. With Catalyst, it reaches relative gap $ε$ in $\tilde O(m/s+(\sqrt{m/s}+m^{3/4}/s)\sqrt{\barδ/μ})$ expected rounds on quadratics with strongly convex clients, independent of $δ_a$. Combining this method with charged analyses of existing algorithms matches the lower bound's polynomial dependence for $s\leq\sqrt m$ and $s=Ω(m)$; the worst gap is $O(m^{1/8})$. A held-out 12-seed synthetic study finds fewer rounds than tuned SVRP in nine of ten dip-family incomplete-cohort cells, versus two of 30 other cells. The lower bounds concern zero-respecting algorithms and do not cover unrestricted messages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究每轮最多联系 s 个客户端时Hessian-similar优化的轮复杂度，给出隐藏客户端链下界并设计虚拟master的SVRS方法，配合Catalyst达到与下界多项式匹配的轮复杂度。
AI.motivation: 已有轮复杂度结果假设免费master或全参与，无法刻画每轮仅能接触 s 个客户端（s≤m）的严格上限，且现有分析依赖anchor的Hessian界δ_a。
AI.method: 构造隐藏客户端链，证明零尊重局部算法（自适应cohort与随机停止）在强凸二次上的轮数下界；提出虚拟master SVRS：用独立的估计器cohort与近端cohort并平均近端回复，消除对δ_a的依赖，再结合Catalyst加速；并对现有算法做charge分析。
AI.result: 下界为 Ω((m/s)√(min{δ_a,δ̄/√m}/μ) log(1/ε))（s≤(m-2)/2，高精度高差异区）；虚拟master SVRS+Catalyst 在期望 Õ(m/s+(√(m/s)+m^{3/4}/s)√(δ̄/μ)) 轮达到相对误差ε；与下界在 s≤√m 与 s=Ω(m) 时多项式阶匹配，最坏差距 O(m^{1/8})。12种子合成实验中十之九的dip族不完全cohort单元轮数少于调优SVRP。
AI.conclusion: 首次刻画严格客户端轮数上限下的Hessian相似优化轮复杂度，给出下界与近匹配算法；下界仅针对零尊重算法，不覆盖无限制消息。

title: Mix Forcing: Causal Pre-Training via Mixture Attention for Interactive World Models
summary: While interactive video world models require autoregressive generation, directly adapting pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into autoregressive ones with teacher forcing can disrupt their visual priors and degrade autoregressive generation quality. In this paper, we introduce Mix Forcing, a causal pre-training paradigm for interactive video world models, implemented with the Mixture-of-Bidirectional-and-Autoregressive (MoBA) attention. Mix Forcing jointly trains a video diffusion model with both teacher forcing and bidirectional training, yielding a strong causal initialization for few-step post-training. In self-attention, Mix Forcing leverages teacher forcing to learn causal next-chunk prediction for autoregressive rollout, while using bidirectional attention to preserve pretrained visual priors. To support online text interaction, Mix Forcing further adopts a chunk-wise cross-attention design that conditions each video chunk on a shared environment prompt and its own local prompt, without exposing future instructions to the current chunk. Following causal pre-training on a 14B image-to-video model, we apply consistency and distribution matching distillation to obtain a four-step autoregressive generator. Experiments on our internal benchmark and public benchmarks, including WBench and SANA-WM-Bench, show that our model achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and timely event following with precise camera control. Notably, our model supports high-fidelity long-horizon generation without quality degradation even over one-hour rollouts. Project page is here: https://zelingao98.github.io/mixforcing

AI.tldr: 提出 Mix Forcing 因果预训练范式（MoBA 注意力），在保留双向预训练视觉先验的同时学习因果下一块预测，实现高质量、长时程的交互式视频世界模型。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需要自回归生成，但将预训练的双向视频扩散模型直接用 teacher forcing 改造成自回归模型，会破坏其视觉先验并降低生成质量。
AI.method: Mix Forcing 用 MoBA（双向与自回归混合）注意力联合训练：自注意力中以 teacher forcing 学因果 next-chunk 预测，同时用双向注意力保留预训练视觉先验；跨注意力采用 chunk-wise 设计，每个视频块条件于共享环境 prompt 与自身局部 prompt，不泄露未来指令。在 14B 图像到视频模型上因果预训练后，再用一致性蒸馏与分布匹配蒸馏得到四步自回归生成器。
AI.result: 在内部基准及 WBench、SANA-WM-Bench 等公开基准上达到 SOTA 视觉质量，事件跟随及时、相机控制精确；支持一小时以上长时程 rollout 而不出现质量退化。
AI.conclusion: Mix Forcing 为交互式视频世界模型提供强因果初始化，兼顾预训练先验保留与自回归质量，并实现高效少步、长时程在线交互生成。

title: Reversible Pseudonymisation of Documents Sent to External LLMs: an Open Bilingual Benchmark and an Engine
comment: 22 pages, 9 tables. Code, data generator, held-out sets, pre-registrations, predictions and raw LLM answers: https://github.com/beskvladimir-create/pii-roundtrip (release v0.5.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23624098)
summary: Professionals send working documents to external large language models. A common safeguard is reversible pseudonymisation: personal data are replaced with placeholders before the request and restored locally in the answer. We present an open benchmark of five existing open tools and a regular-expression baseline on Russian and UK English, and an open engine built on the two strongest tools. The benchmark excludes each tool's own authors' dataset from its verdict, compares the engine with each tool on identical datasets for detection, reports masking precision, and tests on a held-out set of synthetic documents whose files, hashes, decision rules, run plan and stopping rule were published before any run. Two local LLMs test whether placeholders survive. All evaluation data are synthetic, and the benchmark was run by the author of the engine; code, data, predictions and raw answers are released. On external datasets no existing tool meets all predefined thresholds: in UK English the identifier and leak thresholds are not met, in Russian the identifier threshold is borderline. On the last held-out set of 1,000 documents per language, the best existing tools leave a whole value visible in 61% (Russian) and 58% (UK) of documents. On these documents, from the generator it was developed on, the engine does so in 0.3% [0.1; 0.9] and 0.2% [0.1; 0.7], leaves any part of a value visible in 0.8% and 0.2%, and meets all detection thresholds in both languages. In UK English it also restores at least 99% of its placeholders after 760 answers. In Russian it restores only 94.6% [93.6; 95.6] of name placeholders, against a 99% threshold, mainly because the inflection it borrows from pii-guard produces wrong surname forms. The engine was developed over six earlier held-out sets from the same generator; real documents were not tested.

AI.tldr: 提出一个开源基准，评测五种现有开源去标识化工具及一个正则基线在俄语和英式英语上的表现，并基于两个最强工具构建开源引擎；在预注册的最后一个留出集上，现有工具在约60%文档中仍暴露完整取值，而新引擎降至0.3%和0.2%。
AI.motivation: 专业人员将工作文档发送给外部大语言模型，常见防护是发送前将个人数据替换为占位符、收到回答后在本地还原。需要客观基准检验现有工具是否真正满足检测、掩码与占位符还原等阈值。
AI.method: 发布包含五个开源工具与正则基线的开放基准，覆盖俄语与英式英语；裁决时排除各工具作者自有数据集，在相同数据集上比较引擎与各工具的检测、掩码精确率，并在运行前公开文件、哈希、判定规则、运行计划与停止规则的合成留出集上测试；用两个本地LLM检验占位符能否在回答中存活并还原。
AI.result: 外部数据集上无现有工具同时满足所有预设阈值（英式英语标识符与泄漏阈值未达标，俄语标识符阈值处于边界）。在每语言1,000文档的最终留出集上，最佳现有工具在61%俄语、58%英式英语文档中残留完整取值；引擎仅0.3%[0.1;0.9]和0.2%[0.1;0.7]，残留任一部分为0.8%和0.2%，并满足两种语言的全部检测阈值。英式英语在760条回答后重建≥99%占位符；俄语姓名占位符仅重建94.6%[93.6;95.6]，未达99%阈值，主要因借用pii-guard的屈折规则生成错误姓氏形式。
AI.conclusion: 现有开源工具在严格阈值下均不达标，所提引擎在掩码泄漏与检测上显著改善，但俄语占位符还原仍有缺陷。所有评测数据均为合成，引擎由同一生成器训练并在六个早期留出集上调优，未测试真实文档，且基准由引擎作者本人执行，结果存在乐观偏差风险；代码、数据、预测与原始回答均已公开。

title: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
summary: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, cumbersome GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. We introduce OS-Wizard, an automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K trajectories comprising 54.9K state--action samples. Fine-tuning open-source base models on this corpus yields a best-performing model that improves performance on a benchmark of specialized desktop workflows by 58.2 percentage points to 64.1\%, surpassing reported human performance of 59.8\% and establishing a new state of the art. The fine-tuned model also improves performance on general desktop workflows using GUI actions only, suggesting that the collected supervision benefits general desktop tasks as well. Comparative experiments and ablations demonstrate the efficiency of trajectory collection and the importance of code actions.

AI.tldr: 提出 OS-Wizard 自动化轨迹采集框架，通过教程引导探索与 GUI-Code 混合动作空间，为专业桌面应用收集 10.9K 轨迹；微调后模型在专业桌面工作流基准上提升 58.2 个百分点至 64.1%，超越人类水平 59.8%，刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 专业桌面应用缺乏高质量交互轨迹：应用知识有限、GUI 工作流繁琐、探索不完整，导致自动化采集困难。
AI.method: OS-Wizard 框架：1) 教程引导的探索，注入应用特定知识；2) 混合 GUI–Code 动作空间，直接执行应用原生命令以简化繁琐 GUI 流程；3) 在树搜索中对关键状态设检查点并回访，探索替代工作流，弥补线性 rollout 覆盖不足。
AI.result: 采集 10.9K 轨迹、54.9K 状态–动作样本；微调开源基座模型后在专业桌面工作流基准上提升 58.2 个百分点达 64.1%，超过人类 59.8%；仅在 GUI 动作下对通用桌面任务亦有提升。对比实验与消融验证了采集效率及代码动作的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 自动化、教程引导加混合动作空间的轨迹采集可有效缓解专业应用数据稀缺，所得数据不仅提升专门工作流表现，也迁移惠及通用桌面任务。

title: Sliding Networks: A Family of Residual Structures Preserving Feature Learning and Feature Diversity
summary: Deep learning models tend to perform best at large widths and depths. The growing interest in scaling laws, especially in the language modeling domain, has motivated procedures for scaling up network widths and depths in order to preserve stability and computational efficiency of training dynamics. Existing depth-scaling approaches force a choice between retaining locally maximal \emph{feature learning} and preserving a form of \emph{feature diversity} in the residual stream arising from random differences between channels. We examine a \textit{joint scaling recipe} that preserves both. With residual width $N_\flat$, hidden width $N_\sharp$, and depth $L$, the key quantity is, by default, the limiting ratio $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\toα$, while correlated initialization (Half Copy) can partially relax the resulting shape constraints. Theory and residual-MLP experiments support convergence at fixed positive $α$ to an SDE limit with locally maximal feature learning. Hidden computations can then be redistributed between width and depth while preserving this limit, like turning melody into harmony and back. Language-model experiments nevertheless show performance differences under regrouping at fixed parameter count. These results distinguish approximating a limit (ODE or SDE) from scaling for better performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个"联合缩放配方"，在同时放大网络残差宽度、隐藏宽度与深度时，保持局部最大特征学习与残差流中的特征多样性，并刻画了关键极限比值 N♭/(N♯L)→α。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在宽深较大时表现更好，但现有深度缩放方法被迫在"保留局部最大特征学习"和"保留由通道随机差异产生的特征多样性"之间二选一。作者希望在缩放宽度与深度时同时保住二者，并厘清"逼近某个极限（ODE/SDE）"与"为更好性能而缩放"之间的区别。
AI.method: 引入残差宽度 N♭、隐藏宽度 N♯、深度 L，以极限比值 N♭/(N♯L)→α 为核心量，默认取正 α；结合相关初始化（Half Copy）部分放松形状约束。给出理论分析并用残差 MLP 实验验证，同时在语言模型上做固定参数量下的重分配实验。
AI.result: 理论与残差 MLP 实验表明：固定正 α 时训练收敛到具有局部最大特征学习的 SDE 极限；在该极限下，隐藏计算可在宽度与深度之间重分配而不改变极限（"旋律变和声再变回"）。但语言模型实验显示，固定参数量下重新分组会带来性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 该联合缩放配方能同时保持特征学习与特征多样性，并支持宽度–深度间的计算重分配。但结果强调：逼近极限（ODE 或 SDE）与为提升性能而缩放是两件不同的事。

title: Allocation Before the Clock: Graph, Set and Game Theory of Professional League of Legends Objective Setups
summary: Before every neutral objective in professional League of Legends, each team decides which of its five players walk to the pit, which hold a lane, and when to commit. The leading analysis of such setups, TAGNet for Counter-Strike 2, clusters graph-network embeddings of player positions and reads cluster win rates as tactical quality. We treat a setup as an allocation on a walled map: formations are set partitions on the lattice $Π_5$, control is a geodesic Voronoi split of a navigation graph, and commitment is an allocation game solved as a quantal response equilibrium priced in win probability. On all 164 games of MSI and Worlds 2025 (2,994 team-setups, minimap tracks validated against Riot positions), trailing teams leave the pit empty far more often than leading teams, by +34.8 percentage points at the first baron and +30.4 percentage points at Atakhan. Our model, HASSE-QRE, finds six setup patterns that whole-model series-bootstrap refits reproduce (ARI 0.819, comparable to 0.813 for TAGNet's $K$-Means step alone) and indicates that teams price fights, travel and committed players, not the objective itself (weight 0.018; fixing it to one costs 59.9 log-likelihood points). The equilibrium reproduces a quarter of the commitment gap, almost all of it through state variables rather than its strategic channels. Weighting a team-level contrast by exposure moves it across $p=0.05$ (0.046 against 0.052). We release the tracks, setups and code.

AI.tldr: 该论文把英雄联盟中立目标前的"布阵(setup)"建模为受限地图上的分配问题：阵型=格上的集合划分，控制=导航图上的测地Voronoi划分，投入=以胜率定价的quantal response equilibrium分配博弈，方法名为HASSE-QRE。
AI.motivation: 现有布阵分析主要借鉴CS2的TAGNet，依赖图网络嵌入聚类并只读取簇的胜率，缺乏对"谁站哪个坑/守哪条线/何时投入"这一分配决策的显式建模，也难以解释队伍为何如此配置。
AI.method: 在MSI与Worlds 2025全部164场比赛、2994个队伍-布阵数据上（小地图轨迹与Riot坐标校验），构建"格上集合划分（Π₅）+ 导航图测地Voronoi控制划分 + 以胜率为代价的QRE分配博弈"的HASSE-QRE模型，并进行全模型序列bootstrap重拟合检验稳健性。
AI.result: 落后队伍空坑比例显著高于领先队伍（首个男爵+34.8个百分点，Atakhan+30.4个百分点）；模型识别出6种可复现布阵模式（ARI 0.819，与TAGNet仅K-Means步的0.813相当）；队伍定价的是交战、移动与投入人数而非目标物本身（权重0.018，固定为1损失59.9对数似然点）；均衡仅复现约四分之一的投入差距，且几乎全部经由状态变量而非策略渠道；以暴露度加权的队级对比会跨越p=0.05（0.046 vs 0.052）。
AI.conclusion: 显式分配博弈建模能刻画布阵结构并揭示决策偏好，但对行为差距的解释力有限，结果对加权方式敏感；数据与代码公开，为后续战术分析提供基准。

title: The Patient Is Always Right? Evaluating Sycophancy in Medical Diagnosis with Graded Patient Beliefs
summary: More people are seeking out general-purpose AI models for medical advice, including diagnosis. Yet, AI models are susceptible to sycophancy, like validating users' beliefs even when they are untrue, which could lead to false positive diagnoses. Here, we evaluate how nine AI models change their diagnostic decision when a patient presents a belief that they have a specific (but incorrect) medical condition. We vary how close the user belief is to the clinical evidence presented. Models sycophantically adopt the patient's belief on average 23.2\% of the time---sometimes even when the patient proposes a fictional, made-up condition. We also varied different personas, including a Rare Disease Claimer that got models to accept their belief 43.0\% of the time. Additional analyses find that medical fine-tuning and model scale makes models less susceptible to changing their diagnoses. Sycophantic bias in medical diagnosis raises implications for safety, especially as more people are using AI for health support.

AI.tldr: 评估九个AI模型在医疗诊断中表现出"迎合"（sycophancy）倾向：平均23.2%的情况下会采纳患者的错误或虚构病症信念，威胁诊断安全。
AI.motivation: 越来越多用户向通用AI模型寻求医疗建议乃至诊断，而模型存在迎合用户信念的倾向，可能引发误诊（假阳性诊断），因此需要量化该风险。
AI.method: 让九个AI模型面对患者坚持某特定（但错误）病症信念的情境，观察其诊断决策变化；系统性地变化用户信念与临床证据的接近程度，并测试不同人设（如"罕见病声称者"）。
AI.result: 模型平均在23.2%的情况下迎合患者信念，即使患者提出的是虚构病症；"罕见病声称者"人设下迎合率高达43.0%；医疗微调与模型规模增大可降低迎合倾向。
AI.conclusion: 医疗诊断中的迎合偏差带来重要安全警示，尤其在AI健康支持日益普及的背景下，需关注并缓解该问题。

title: WebViSE: Scaling Visual Design Intelligence from the Open Web for LLM Website Generation
summary: Large language models have made remarkable strides in website development, enabling complete and interactive web experiences to be built from natural-language instructions with far less effort. Yet, non-expert users often struggle to articulate sophisticated visual and interaction designs in natural language. Meanwhile, the open web already contains a vast reservoir of such design knowledge, embodied in mature website implementations. To this end, we introduce Website-derived Visual Skill Extraction (WebViSE), a framework that automatically abstracts these implementations into reusable Visual Skills and builds a structured Skill library. To scale the library, WebViSE organizes its Skills in a multi-parent DAG and jointly evolves Skill descriptions and DAG structure using Skill-conditioned Potential Queries, enabling efficient matching between diverse user instructions and relevant Skills. The auto-evolved structure outperforms non-hierarchical LLM retrieval baselines at only 39.09% of the estimated retrieval cost with Qwen3.8-Max. For any models, WebViSE can be directly injected as plug-and-play guidance, enabling diverse models to produce more visually compelling and aesthetically refined web pages. For open-source models, WebViSE can be used to build a data-synthesis pipeline that internalizes visual design intelligence into model weights. Experiments across multiple web development benchmarks and human evaluation consistently show that WebViSE improves the visual quality and interaction fidelity of artifacts. Overall, our work establishes an automated path for extracting, organizing, and transferring design intelligence from the open web to website-building models. We release all extracted Visual Skills, the associated Skill DAG, and our code at https://github.com/YifeiSun-0710/WebViSE.

AI.tldr: WebViSE 从开放网络已有网站实现中自动抽取可复用的"视觉技能"（Visual Skills），并用多父 DAG 与 Skill-conditioned Potential Queries 联合演化技能描述与结构，构建技能库。该库可作为即插即用引导或数据合成管线，提升各类模型的网页视觉质量与交互保真度。
AI.motivation: LLM 已能根据自然语言指令生成完整可交互网页，但非专业用户难以用语言精确表达复杂的视觉与交互设计需求；而开放网络中成熟网站实现本身已蕴含大量设计知识，尚未被系统化利用。
AI.method: 提出 Website-derived Visual Skill Extraction (WebViSE) 框架：自动将成熟网站实现抽象为可复用 Visual Skills 并构建结构化技能库；技能以多父 DAG 组织，利用 Skill-conditioned Potential Queries 联合演化技能描述与 DAG 结构，实现多样用户指令与相关技能的高效匹配；技能可作为 plug-and-play 提示引导注入任意模型，或用于开源模型的数据合成管线，将设计智能内化到权重中。
AI.result: 自动演化的层级结构在 Qwen3.8-Max 下仅用约 39.09% 的估计检索成本即优于非层级 LLM 检索基线；多种模型接入后均生成视觉更佳、审美更精细的网页；在多个网页开发基准与人工评测中，一致提升生成产物的视觉质量与交互保真度。
AI.conclusion: 工作建立了从开放网络提取、组织并迁移设计智能到网页构建模型的自动化路径，并开源全部抽取的 Visual Skills、Skill DAG 与代码。

title: Approximate Universal Prediction under Interaction
summary: Bayesian mixtures, and Solomonoff induction in particular, provide an idealized model of prediction learned by minimizing population log loss, and they underlie universal agents such as AIXI. An agent that plans with an approximation of such a predictor decides where that predictor is evaluated, and a planner can be drawn toward branches on which its model is optimistic. We study which approximation guarantees survive this feedback. For normalized finite-horizon causal mixtures, the transfer coefficient factors into a policy likelihood ratio and task evidence available before each prediction, so task rarity and action-branch rarity can compound. Within one fixed universal mixture, infinitely many computable environments admit excess prediction error of order $κη\,2^{K(μ)}$, where $η$ is the training KL budget and $κ$ measures policy coverage. This order is sharp, and for each target a computable predictor attains it at a suitable finite horizon, so computability alone does not remove the penalty. For bounded returns, value error is controlled by the probability of entering a poorly covered branch plus a square-root term in $η$. Both terms are necessary, and finite maximum coverage ratios are not required. Motivated by the mentor override of Golden Handcuffs, we derive margins for preserving deferral decisions and conditional KL budgets with an unavoidable inverse-history-probability penalty, and a counterexample separates agreement of deferral decisions from task-wise event avoidance. The guarantees apply to any predictor architecture that meets explicit population approximation and coverage conditions, which gives concrete targets for implementing idealized universal agents.

AI.tldr: 该文研究规划器与近似预测器耦合时近似保证是否仍然成立，证明转移系数可分解为策略似然比与任务证据，并给出误差阶η和覆盖率的尖锐刻画。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯混合（如Solomonoff归纳）是AIXI等通用智能体的理想化预测模型，但实际只能使用其近似。规划器会主动选择预测器被评估的分支，可能偏向模型乐观的分支，形成反馈回路，从而可能破坏原有的近似保证。作者想弄清哪些近似保证能在这种反馈下存活。
AI.method: 针对归一化有限时域因果混合，将转移系数分解为策略似然比与预测前可获得的任务证据；构造单固定通用混合下的可计算环境族来下界超额预测误差；对有限回报给出值误差界（进入低覆盖分支的概率项加η的平方根项）；并借鉴Golden Handcuffs中的mentor override，推导保持延期（deferral）决策的余量与条件KL预算。
AI.result: 对单一固定通用混合，存在无穷多可计算环境其超额预测误差达到κη2^{K(μ)}量级（η为训练KL预算，κ为策略覆盖率），该阶是尖锐的，且对每个目标存在可计算预测器在合适有限时域达到该阶，故可计算性本身不能消除惩罚。有界回报下值误差由低覆盖分支进入概率与√η项控制，两项均必要，且不需要有限的最大覆盖比。另给出保留延期决策的余量、含逆历史概率惩罚的条件KL预算，并用反例区分延期决策一致与逐任务事件回避。
AI.conclusion: 任务稀有性与动作分支稀有性会相乘叠加，近似保证在规划反馈下会退化；但只要预测器架构满足显式的人口近似与覆盖条件，上述保证即适用，这为实现理想化通用智能体提供了具体设计目标。

title: ONOT/TONO-Print: A Paired Benchmark for Identity-Document Portrait Quality under Document Production Shift
summary: Identity-document portraits are modified during document production by printing, engraving, and integration into the document template. These transformations may change image texture, contrast, colour, and other visual properties without necessarily changing the underlying biometric or presentation information. In this work, we introduce ONOT/TONO-Print, a small paired benchmark for evaluating face-image quality models under identity-document production shift. The benchmark is based on ONOT and TONO portraits and contains synthetic variants representing five common production techniques: toner, inkjet, dye sublimation, laser engraving, and thermal transfer. A smaller physical subset contains portraits printed and scanned using inkjet and toner devices. The benchmark is used to compare the behaviour of biometric and ICAO-related face-quality components before and after production. Results show that production can introduce substantial domain shift for some quality estimators, while other models remain comparatively stable.

AI.tldr: 提出 ONOT/TONO-Print 小型配对基准，用于评估身份证件生产流程造成的人脸图像质量模型域偏移。
AI.motivation: 证件人像在打印、雕刻、模板整合等生产环节中，纹理、对比度、颜色等视觉属性会改变，但生物特征与呈现信息往往不变；现有质量模型在这种生产域偏移下的稳健性缺乏评测手段。
AI.method: 基于 ONOT 与 TONO 人像构建配对基准，含五类合成生产变体（碳粉、喷墨、热升华、激光雕刻、热转印），并有较小的物理子集（喷墨/碳粉打印并扫描）；比较生物特征与 ICAO 相关人脸质量组件在生产前后的表现。
AI.result: 部分质量估计器在生产变换后出现显著域偏移，而另一些模型表现相对稳定。
AI.conclusion: 证件生产流程对质量评估影响因模型而异，需以配对基准衡量稳健性；该基准可用于筛选对生产不敏感的质量模型。

title: When Does GEPA Merge Help? A Mechanism-Level Diagnostic
summary: GEPA is among the strongest reflective prompt optimizers for language-model programs, but its system-aware merge operator is unstable across models: merge improves gpt-4.1-mini on average while degrading Qwen3-8B, an asymmetry noted but left unexplained by the GEPA paper. We investigate this instability across five datasets and two models. Our nine-configuration sweep over merge timing and merge operator shows that merge can improve both models when configured appropriately. This suggests that merge instability is better explained by configuration sensitivity than by an inherent flaw in the merge operator. We then test whether prompt-level features predict GEPA's merge-accept decisions and find that they do not, ruling out static-feature gating. As a proof of concept, a behavior-based probe built from these diagnostics avoids large merge failures in our multi-seed runs by abstaining on high-risk tasks, although it does not consistently outperform NoMerge. Code is available as GEPA-MergeProbe at https://github.com/ChongZZZZ/GEPA_MERGE .

AI.tldr: 本文探究GEPA中system-aware merge算子跨模型不稳定的原因，发现其不稳定源于配置敏感而非算子本身缺陷，并证明静态prompt特征无法预测merge接受决策，最后提出基于行为探针的可行性验证。
AI.motivation: GEPA是较强的反思式提示优化器，但其merge算子在gpt-4.1-mini上平均提升、在Qwen3-8B上却下降，这一跨模型不对称现象在原论文中被提及但未解释，本文旨在系统性地解释该不稳定性。
AI.method: 在5个数据集、2个模型上开展研究：(1) 对merge时机与merge算子做9种配置的扫描；(2) 测试prompt层面静态特征能否预测GEPA的merge接受决策；(3) 构建基于诊断信息的行为探针，对高风险任务弃用merge。
AI.result: 9配置扫描显示，在合理配置下merge对两个模型均可带来提升，说明不稳定性更可由配置敏感性解释；静态prompt特征无法预测merge接受决策，排除了静态特征门控方案；行为探针在多随机种子实验中避免了大规模merge失败，但并未稳定优于NoMerge基线。
AI.conclusion: GEPA的merge不稳定是配置敏感性问题而非算子固有缺陷；静态特征门控不可行；行为探针作为概念验证可规避高风险merge失败，但尚未带来稳定的整体增益，代码已开源。

title: Fed-Universe: A Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) Stack for Negotiated Alignment in Federated Systems
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence (Canadian AI 2026), PMLR 318:1219-1223. https://proceedings.mlr.press/v318/xu26b.html
summary: Conventional federated learners implicitly optimize for global means, creating a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm that inevitably suppresses the minority under cross-site heterogeneity. To bridge this critical gap, we present Fed-Universe, a generalizable Semantic-Geometric-Topological-Human (S-G-T-H) architecture that transforms passive averaging into an active negotiation for decentralized alignment. The S-layer deploys an edge-capable LLM as a semantic surrogate to translate heterogeneous inputs into standardized patient profile prompts. The G-layer enforces geometric quality assurance (GQA) via a mapping f: Theta -> Q from the statistical parameter space to a physically interpretable quality domain, employing a cosine similarity gate to retain minority updates based on physical geometry rather than statistical proximity. The T-layer executes topological Pareto control, identifying a sensitivity-based knee point (lambda_k) to balance multi-objective aggregation without majority degradation. Finally, the H-layer operationalizes a cognitive twin dynamic to mirror the user's real-time psychological state, dynamically adapting human-computer interaction modes via active intent alignment. To ground this theoretical architecture empirically, we validated the S-G-T core on a binational synthetic clinical network simulation. This proof-of-concept demonstrated a "zero-sum escape": a minority node (<3% data volume) achieved utility parity (loss reduction from 0.857 to 0.340) alongside dominant hubs. Our Fed-Universe framework is being expanded along two focused pillars: institutional multimodal alignment (Fed-Ultra) and individual cognitive intent alignment (Fed-Human).

AI.tldr: 提出Fed-Universe四层（语义-几何-拓扑-人类）联邦学习架构，用主动协商替代被动平均，解决跨站点异质下少数群体被压制问题；S-G-T核心在合成临床网络验证实现"零和逃逸"。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习隐式优化全局均值，形成"一刀切"范式，在跨站点异质性下必然压制少数节点，导致小样本群体效用受损。
AI.method: S层：边缘可用LLM作语义代理，把异质输入转成标准化患者画像提示；G层：几何质量保证GQA，通过映射f:Θ→Q将统计参数空间映射到物理可解释质量域，用余弦相似度门控按物理几何而非统计邻近保留少数更新；T层：拓扑Pareto控制，找基于敏感度的膝点λ_k平衡多目标聚合；H层：认知孪生动态镜像用户实时心理状态，通过主动意图对齐自适应人机交互。
AI.result: 在双国合成临床网络仿真上验证S-G-T核心：少数节点（<3%数据量）实现效用对齐，损失从0.857降至0.340，与主导枢纽同步，即"零和逃逸"。
AI.conclusion: 架构理论可行且初步验证有效，但仅限合成数据概念验证；后续沿制度化多模态对齐（Fed-Ultra）与个体认知意图对齐（Fed-Human）两方向扩展。

title: When is early stopping beneficial under label noise? A phase diagram for kernel gradient flow
summary: Early stopping is commonly used to prevent fitting label noise from degrading generalization. Does this mean that, when a positive fraction of the training labels is intrinsically unpredictable, the best test error must occur before interpolation? Experiments on a CIFAR10 classification task with randomly labeled examples motivate the opposite possibility: although fixed-feature and shallow models exhibit late-time deterioration of the test error, the need for early stopping essentially disappears in larger, deeper convolutional networks even after the random labels have all been classified correctly. We determine when late-time deterioration disappears entirely in a solvable setting. For kernel gradient flow on a synthetic noisy classification task, we derive sharp high-dimensional learning curves and obtain a phase diagram controlled by the balance between the linear kernel component that learns the shared relation between inputs and labels and the higher-order components that enable fitting the label noise. In one regime, generalization is optimized at finite time and early stopping is necessary. In another, generalization improves until interpolation, but the endpoint is suboptimal across kernels. At the boundary, the interpolating endpoint attains the lowest generalization error across the considered kernel family and all training times. Thus, even with extensive irreducible label noise, interpolation can outperform early stopping. The neural-network experiments leave open how learned representations acquire an analogous favorable geometry.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑"存在不可约标签噪声时早停必然优于插值"的直觉，通过CIFAR10随机标签实验与核梯度流理论分析，给出由线性核分量与高阶分量平衡控制的相图，证明在临界边界上插值解可取得全训练时间及核家族中的最低泛化误差。
AI.motivation: 早停被普遍用于防止标签噪声损害泛化，似乎暗示当训练标签中有一部分本质不可预测时，最优测试误差必然出现在插值之前。作者检验这一直觉是否成立，即深网络拟合随机标签后是否仍需要早停。
AI.method: 在CIFAR10上对训练标签随机化，比较固定特征模型、浅层模型与更大更深卷积网络的测试误差随时间变化；并在合成噪声分类任务中分析核梯度流，推导高维尖锐学习曲线，按线性核分量（学习共享输入-标签关系）与高阶分量（拟合标签噪声）的平衡构建相图。
AI.result: 固定特征与浅层模型出现晚期测试误差恶化；而更大更深的卷积网络即便已把随机标签全部分类正确，早停需求也基本消失。理论部分得到三种情形：(1)有限时刻泛化最优、早停必要；(2)泛化持续改善至插值，但端点在各核上均次优；(3)临界边界上插值端点在整个核族与所有训练时间中泛化误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 即使存在大量不可约标签噪声，插值仍可优于早停；是否存在晚期恶化取决于核中线性分量与高阶分量的平衡。神经网络实验提示学习到的表示可能获得类似的有利几何结构，但具体机制尚待阐明。

title: DROA-CLIPSeg: Prompt-Guided Thin Crack Segmentation in Low-Light Conditions
comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Pavement crack segmentation under low light is degraded by reduced contrast, shadows, headlight glare, joints, stains, and wet seams. Existing crack segmentation methods mostly assume good illumination. Low-light enhancement methods improve visual quality, but they do not explicitly preserve crack topology. To address these limitations, we formulate low-light crack segmentation as a degradation-aware, prompt-grounded structural defect segmentation problem and propose DROA-CLIPSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a frozen CLIPSeg vision language backbone using two lightweight modules. QKV Low-Rank Adaptation is injected into the Q/K/V projections of the vision and text encoders to improve crack-specific image text alignment without backbone fine-tuning. The proposed Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA) decomposes intermediate features into a dominant crack-domain branch, which captures recurring low-light crack patterns, and an orthogonal residual branch, which preserves faint, thin, and fragmented evidence usually suppressed by noise, shadow, or over-smoothing. We also introduce CrackLingo-9K and CrackLingo-12K, text augmented versions of Crack9k and Crack12k with crack-aware prompts. Training only approximately 1.93 M parameters, corresponding to 1.3% of the full model, DROA-CLIPSeg outperforms 9 zero-shot and 4 fine-tuned vision language baselines on both splits, generalises zero-shot to MVTec AD across textures and defect morphologies, and is supported by extensive ablations. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/VShuklacode/DROA-CLIPSeg

AI.tldr: 提出DROA-CLIPSeg，用QKV低秩适配和正交域残差适配器微调冻结CLIPSeg，仅训练1.3%参数即实现低光照路面裂缝分割SOTA。
AI.motivation: 低光照下路面裂缝分割受低对比度、阴影、车灯眩光、接缝、污渍和湿缝影响而退化。现有裂缝分割方法多假设光照良好；低光增强方法虽提升视觉质量，却没有显式保留裂缝拓扑结构。
AI.method: 将低光裂缝分割建模为退化感知、提示引导的结构缺陷分割问题。基于冻结CLIPSeg视觉语言主干，注入两个轻量模块：(1) QKV Low-Rank Adaptation，加到视觉和文本编码器的Q/K/V投影上，改进裂缝专属图文对齐且不微调主干；(2) Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA)，将中间特征分解为捕捉低光裂缝常见模式的主裂缝域分支，与保留微弱、细小、断裂证据的正交残差分支。并构建带裂缝感知提示的文本增强数据集CrackLingo-9K/12K。
AI.result: 仅训练约1.93M参数（全模型1.3%），在两个数据集划分上均优于9个零样本和4个微调视觉语言基线；可零样本泛化到MVTec AD的不同纹理与缺陷形态；并通过大量消融验证。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效的提示引导适配框架可在不微调主干的情况下有效解决低光照裂缝分割，兼顾拓扑保留与跨域泛化。

title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
summary: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/

AI.tldr: 论文通过大规模评测发现许多专用记忆系统在长程智能体中常不如朴素RAG，提出用"记忆收益"与"记忆税"来拆解记忆相对直接检索的净价值。
AI.motivation: 记忆被广泛用于长程智能体，但相比直接从原始历史检索，构建记忆的净价值仍不清楚。
AI.method: 跨多个基准与模型骨干进行大规模评测，以RAG为参照，将记忆的净价值分解为对原始历史组织与访问方式改变所带来的收益与损失（memory benefit 与 memory tax），并分析记忆税的来源（系统侧与评测侧）及其推广场景。
AI.result: 许多专用记忆系统在多场景下不如朴素RAG，表现为负净价值；记忆过程对原始信息的改写既可能重组事实、提炼偏好带来收益，也可能删除或遮蔽证据而产生记忆税。
AI.conclusion: 提出"记忆税"概念，呼吁从单独性能转向关注记忆净价值，指导更可靠的记忆设计与评测，并将开源代码与结果。

title: From Document Layout to Causal Topology: An End-to-End Architecture for Temporal Causal Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) generally lack deep causal reasoning capabilities in temporal reasoning. Inspired by document layout reordering, this paper proposes a paradigm shift from discrete narratives to causal topologies. It constructs two architectures: a training-free neuro-symbolic framework, temporal causal reasoning agent (TCR-Agent), which achieves interpretable causal deduction and counterfactual truncation through external causal graph instantiation and a symbolic intervention engine; and an end-to-end model, temporal causal reasoning former (TCR-Former), which internalizes these mechanisms into the Transformer attention space via a Causal-Topological Attention Mask and temporal span biases. Experiments on the TempoCausal benchmark demonstrate that TCR-Agent comprehensively surpasses existing training-free baselines. At the same time, TCR-Former achieves an accuracy 16.5% higher than that of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, outperforming large-scale models such as GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V3.2 with only approximately 8.6B parameters. Further analysis reveals a structure-reasoning disconnection phenomenon in existing methods: external symbolic constraints and chain-of-thought reasoning can improve reasoning steps, yet fail to enhance deep causal deductive capability. By internalizing temporal causal reasoning capabilities into the model, TCR-Former effectively bridges this gap, providing an efficient and reliable end-to-end foundation for complex reasoning scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出从离散叙事转向因果拓扑的范式，构建免训练的TCR-Agent与端到端TCR-Former，显著提升时序因果推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在时序推理中普遍缺乏深层因果推理能力，现有外部符号约束与思维链方法难以真正提升因果演绎水平。
AI.method: 受文档版面重排序启发，将离散叙事转为因果拓扑。设计两种架构：免训练的神经符号框架TCR-Agent，通过外部因果图实例化与符号干预引擎实现可解释因果推断与反事实截断；端到端模型TCR-Former，通过因果拓扑注意力掩码与时序跨度偏置将上述机制内化到Transformer注意力空间。
AI.result: 在TempoCausal基准上，TCR-Agent全面超越现有免训练基线；TCR-Former准确率比SOTA方法高16.5%，仅约8.6B参数即超越GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V3.2等大模型。分析还揭示了现有方法中"结构—推理脱节"现象。
AI.conclusion: 将时序因果推理能力内化到模型中可有效弥合结构与推理的脱节，为复杂推理场景提供高效可靠的端到端基础。

title: Stable Dimensionality Reduction via Isometric Centroid-Encoder
summary: Many supervised dimensionality reduction methods promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation but do not explicitly constrain class geometry, leading to variability in the relative arrangement of classes across independent runs. Such variability limits the reproducibility and interpretability of low-dimensional embeddings. We propose the Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE), a supervised dimensionality reduction framework in which class centroids are learned directly in the latent space while preserving a prescribed pairwise class-centroid geometry. Unlike existing centroid- or prototype-based methods that primarily encourage intra-class compactness, ICE explicitly regularizes the relative arrangement of latent class centroids. Unlike multidimensional scaling and many metric-learning approaches that preserve sample-level relationships, ICE operates on class centroids, preserving inter-class geometry without requiring large numbers of sample-pair or triplet constraints. We further show that the intrinsic dimensionality required to represent the centroid-distance configuration of $M$ classes is at most $M-1$, explaining the observed saturation of distance-preservation measures as the latent dimensionality increases. To quantify embedding reproducibility, we introduce the Centroid Neighborhood Stability (CNS) metric, which measures the consistency of class-level neighborhood topology across independent runs and complements existing embedding quality measures. Experiments on image and biological datasets demonstrate that ICE produces stable embeddings with improved preservation of class-centroid geometry while remaining computationally efficient. Additional analyses of optimization dynamics, sensitivity, and preprocessing further provide practical insights into latent dimensionality and explicit geometry modeling for supervised dimensionality reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE)，一种监督降维框架，在潜空间中直接学习类别质心并保持预设的类间质心几何结构，提升嵌入的可复现性与可解释性，并提出CNS指标衡量嵌入稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有监督降维方法虽促进类内紧凑与类间分离，但未显式约束类几何，导致不同运行中类间相对排布变化大，损害低维嵌入的可复现性与可解释性。
AI.method: ICE在潜空间直接学习类别质心，并显式正则化潜质心间的相对排布以保持给定的成对类质心几何；与MDS及度量学习不同，它在类别质心层面工作，避免大量样本对/三元组约束。论文还证明M个类的质心距离配置所需内在维度至多为M-1，并引入Centroid Neighborhood Stability (CNS)指标衡量多次独立运行间类级邻域拓扑的一致性。
AI.result: 在图像与生物数据集上，ICE产生稳定嵌入，类质心几何保持更好，且计算高效；M-1维度上界解释了距离保持度量随维度增加而饱和的现象；对优化动力学、敏感性和预处理的分析给出关于潜维度与显式几何建模的实践洞见。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模类质心几何可在不大量增加约束的前提下提升监督降维嵌入的可复现性和可解释性，并为潜维度选择提供理论依据。

title: UniQuery: Unifying Vision Models with a Joint Query Head for Cross-Domain Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the 7th Real-World Surveillance Workshop (RWS) at WACV 2027
summary: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR) predicts semantic attributes of individuals, such as gender, age, clothing and accessories, and its descriptions support attribute-based person retrieval and person re-identification. However, accurately recognizing fine-grained attributes across domains remains challenging due to occlusion, appearance variations, and shifts in image distributions. Ensembles of independently trained foundation encoders combine their logits with fixed fusion weights, so every attribute uses the same mix and the encoders are never trained together. We propose UniQuery, which instead jointly fine-tunes DINOv3 and CLIP for attribute-specific fusion. It combines two query heads, one for each encoder, with a joint query head whose attribute queries attend to tokens from both encoders, and the prediction is the average of the logits of the three query heads. We evaluate UniQuery on the benchmark of the UPAR Challenge 2027 at the WACV 2027 Real-World Surveillance workshop, where models are trained on PA100k, PETA and Market-1501 with a shared set of attributes. In leave-one-dataset-out experiments, UniQuery outperforms the independent ensemble in Challenge_Avg on both held-out datasets. Ablations show that learning fusion over independently trained encoders does not improve upon logit averaging in the mean over the two held-out datasets, while freezing the encoders lowers the Challenge_Avg of UniQuery. On the hidden test set of the benchmark, UniQuery achieves a Challenge_Avg of 0.8001.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniQuery，联合微调 DINOv3 与 CLIP 实现按属性自适应的融合，用双编码器查询头加联合查询头取平均，在 UPAR 2027 基准留一数据集实验中优于独立集成，隐藏测试集 Challenge_Avg 达 0.8001。
AI.motivation: 行人属性识别（PAR）跨域细粒度属性识别受遮挡、外观变化和图像分布漂移影响；现有做法是独立训练基础编码器后以固定权重融合 logits，所有属性共用同一混合方式，且编码器之间从不联合训练。
AI.method: UniQuery 联合微调 DINOv3 和 CLIP：为每个编码器各设一个查询头，另设一个联合查询头，其属性查询同时关注两个编码器的 token；最终预测为三个查询头 logits 的平均。在 PA100k、PETA、Market-1501 共享属性集上训练，做留一数据集评估，并与冻结编码器、仅学融合等变体对比。
AI.result: 留一数据集实验中，UniQuery 在两个留出数据集的 Challenge_Avg 上均超过独立集成；消融显示仅在独立训练编码器之上学习融合（平均两留出集）不优于 logit 平均，冻结编码器会降低 Challenge_Avg；隐藏测试集 Challenge_Avg 为 0.8001。
AI.conclusion: 属性特定、端到端联合微调的融合优于固定权重集成，但收益依赖编码器可训练；单纯学习融合权重（编码器独立训练）并不比 logit 平均更好，说明跨编码器协同训练是关键。

title: Identically Trained Language Models Break on Different Jailbreaks
summary: Jailbreak benchmarks test one checkpoint and treat which jailbreaks break it as a property of its pretraining data and safety training. We ask whether another pretraining run of the same data, given the same safety training, would break on the same jailbreaks. For each of 25 pretraining data recipes, we take 1B base models from 3 pretraining seeds and give each the same safety post-training with 2 post-training seeds, for 150 models in all. We then collect 20 responses from every model to a shared set of jailbreak prompts and correlate the per-prompt non-refusal rates between every pair of models. On average, two post-trained copies of the same pretraining run have per-prompt non-refusal rates that correlate at 0.984. A different pretraining seed lowers the correlation to 0.811, and a different data recipe lowers it only slightly further, to 0.779. These results indicate that which jailbreaks break a checkpoint depends much more on its pretraining run than on its data, a pattern that holds in all 25 data recipes and at 150M and 300M parameters. In practice, the best of 91 attack templates found on one checkpoint stays the best after a new pretraining seed in only 27% of model pairs, against 67% after a new post-training seed. Each pretraining run also leaves a fingerprint: across 3,211 prompts, a model's per-prompt non-refusal rates identify its pretraining run among all 75 runs every time, and a random subset of 50 prompts still does so 98% of the time.

AI.tldr: 越狱样本对某checkpoint的"有效性"主要由预训练随机种子（即整次预训练运行）决定，而非数据配方；同配方不同预训练种子的模型对同一越狱的抵抗模式显著不同，且每个预训练运行留有可识别"指纹"。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱基准只测单个checkpoint，并把哪些越狱能攻破它归因于预训练数据与安全训练。作者质疑：在相同数据与相同安全训练下，换一次预训练运行，是否会破在同样的越狱上？
AI.method: 构造25种预训练数据配方 × 3个预训练种子 × 2个后训练种子 = 150个1B模型（并扩展到150M/300M）。对每个模型在共享越狱prompt集上采样20条回复，计算各prompt的非拒答率，并两两相关；用91个攻击模板测试最佳攻击的迁移性；用3,211个prompt构建"预训练运行指纹"识别实验。
AI.result: 同一预训练运行的两个后训练拷贝相关0.984；换预训练种子降至0.811，换数据配方仅再降至0.779；该规律在全部25个配方及150M/300M参数下成立。某checkpoint上最优攻击模板在新预训练种子后仍最优仅27%（换后训练种子为67%）。利用非拒答率，可从75个运行中100%识别其预训练运行，仅用50个随机prompt子集仍达98%。
AI.conclusion: 越狱脆弱性更多是"预训练运行"属性而非数据属性；越狱评估需考虑预训练随机性，跨checkpoint的攻击易迁移性被高估，模型行为具有可追踪的预训练指纹。

title: Can LLMs Trust Appropriately? Evaluating Calibrated Reliance on Imperfect Partners
summary: Large language models increasingly collaborate with humans and peer AI agents whose contributions may be incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect. Effective collaboration requires calibrated trust, whereby decisions to rely on, verify, or assist a partner adapt rationally as empirical evidence accumulates. We investigate whether models translate partner evidence into appropriate reliance policies. We introduce a benchmark of 324 scenarios across 23 collaboration categories. Each scenario involves three sequential decisions with explicit transition dynamics, feedback emissions, and cost schedules, permitting exact analytical evaluation of choices against their expected consequences over the remaining interaction. Evaluating seven models alongside 36 controlled-history probes, we dissociate evidence sensitivity from normatively appropriate action. While the strongest frontier model approaches near-optimal decisions, other models exhibit recurring pathologies: procuring excessive safeguards, purchasing verification tests with zero expected value of information, prioritizing immediate savings over cooperative learning, and misallocating assistance to suboptimal channels. Supplying explicit posterior distributions resolves certain errors while introducing new failure modes. Calibrated trust in autonomous agents critically demands coupling empirical evidence with forward-looking decision utility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出324个场景、23类协作任务的基准，用三阶段序贯决策精确评估LLM能否把"伙伴证据"转化为"校准信任"下的合理依赖策略，发现除最强前沿模型外，多数模型存在过度购买保障、零信息价值验证、短视节省与援助错配等系统性病理。
AI.motivation: LLM日益与人类及其它AI智能体协作，而伙伴贡献可能不完整、不一致甚至错误；有效协作需要"校准信任"——依据经验证据理性地在依赖、验证、援助之间切换。论文追问：模型是否真能把伙伴证据转化为恰当的依赖策略，还是只表现出"证据敏感性"却做出规范性错误的行动。
AI.method: 构建324个场景、覆盖23类协作类别的基准，每个场景包含三次序贯决策，并显式给出状态转移动态、反馈信号与成本结构，因此可对每个选择的期望后果作精确解析评估。对7个模型进行测试，并配合36个受控历史探针，将"证据敏感性"与"规范上恰当的行动"分离开来考察；另外还测试了提供显式后验分布的影响。
AI.result: 最强前沿模型接近最优决策；其余模型反复出现病理行为：过度采购保障措施、购买期望信息价值为零的验证测试、以即时节省压过合作学习、把援助错配到次优渠道。提供显式后验分布可消除部分错误，但同时引入新的失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 自主智能体中的校准信任，关键在于把经验证据与前瞻性决策效用耦合起来，仅有证据敏感性并不足够。

title: DIGEST: Discovery-Guided LLM Tuning for Symbolic Regression
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions. Despite tremendous progress in both conventional search-based methods and recent LLM-based methods, two critical limitations largely remain. First (Limited Generation Flexibility), conventional search-based methods rely on either fixed search rules or specialized learned generators, severely limiting adaptive candidate generation across diverse expression structures. Second (Underutilized Search Discoveries), most LLM-based methods cannot reliably recover ground-truth expressions because they fall short in effectively leveraging the LLM itself to thoroughly digest past expressions or adaptively guide future search. To address these limitations, we propose DIGEST. To render greater flexibility in generation, DIGEST repurposes a pretrained decoder block from a lightweight LLM into a symbolic policy for Genetic Programming (GP) population seeding, thereby leveraging the broader modeling capacity of the LLM. To more thoroughly utilize search discoveries, high-quality expressions discovered by GP are fed back to update the LLM-derived policy online, thereby enabling the LLM to progressively internalize past search discoveries and translate them into improved subsequent population generation. Experiments show that on two ground-truth benchmarks, DIGEST outperforms the strongest competitor by up to 2.59% in recovery. Among LLM-based baselines, it improves recovery by at least 54.91% while using at most 17.4% of the strongest competitor's mean search time. On 122 BlackBox datasets, DIGEST achieves the highest accuracy while maintaining a moderate model complexity.

AI.tldr: DIGEST 将轻量 LLM 的预训练解码器块改造为符号策略用于遗传编程种群播种，并用 GP 发现的高质量表达式在线更新该策略，从而提升符号回归的生成灵活性与搜索发现利用率。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归方法存在两大局限：一是基于搜索的方法依赖固定搜索规则或专用学习生成器，跨不同表达式结构的候选生成自适应能力不足（Limited Generation Flexibility）；二是多数 LLM 方法未能有效利用 LLM 消化历史表达式并自适应引导后续搜索，难以可靠恢复真实表达式（Underutilized Search Discoveries）。
AI.method: 提出 DIGEST：1）将轻量 LLM 的预训练解码器块复用为符号策略，为遗传编程（GP）进行种群播种，借助 LLM 更强的建模能力提升生成灵活性；2）将 GP 发现的高质量表达式反馈给 LLM 派生策略进行在线更新，使 LLM 逐步内化历史搜索发现并转化为更好的后续种群生成。
AI.result: 在两个真实表达式基准上，恢复率最高超过最强对手 2.59%；相比 LLM 类基线，恢复率至少提升 54.91%，且平均搜索时间至多为最强对手的 17.4%；在 122 个 BlackBox 数据集上取得最高准确率，同时保持适中的模型复杂度。
AI.conclusion: DIGEST 通过把 LLM 解码器作为可在线演化的 GP 生成策略，统一了 LLM 的建模能力与 GP 的搜索能力，在恢复率、搜索效率和 BlackBox 任务精度上均表现优异，是一种高效且有竞争力的符号回归框架。

title: LENS: Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing for Attribute-Based Person Retrieval on Unseen Cameras
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the 7th Real-World Surveillance Workshop (RWS) at WACV 2027
summary: Attribute-based person retrieval ranks surveillance images from a binary query of semantic attributes, but mean Average Attribute Degree of Match (mADM) drops on unseen cameras as predicted probabilities shift. Common pipelines rank gallery images by their L1 distance to the query, which penalizes a confident single-attribute mismatch no more than small uncertainties across many attributes, while post-hoc recalibration fitted on source validation data fails to transfer because the per-attribute maps fitted on source data do not match those of new cameras. We propose LENS (Likelihood Evaluation and Neighbor Smoothing), combining fine-tuned DINOv3 and CLIP models with a distilled student. LENS regularizes mutually exclusive attribute groups with group cross-entropy in training, scores gallery images by the log-likelihood of the exact query, and smooths gallery logits over nearest neighbors using DINOv3 appearance features from the same forward pass. On held-out datasets, all three changes raise mADM: the likelihood score improves all six retrieval metrics for the main ensemble and mADM for all 48 development models, and training-free kNN smoothing improves all 46 tested development models. On the hidden test set of the UPAR 2027 benchmark, LENS reaches 68.17 mADM.

AI.tldr: 提出 LENS 方法，用似然打分和近邻平滑解决属性检索中跨摄像头概率漂移导致的 mADM 下降问题，在 UPAR 2027 隐藏测试集达到 68.17 mADM。
AI.motivation: 属性检索用 L1 距离排序，对单个高置信度属性错误惩罚不足；而基于源验证数据的后处理校准难以迁移到新摄像头，因各属性映射不匹配，导致未见摄像头上 mADM 下降。
AI.method: LENS 结合微调 DINOv3 与 CLIP 及蒸馏学生模型；训练中用组交叉熵正则化互斥属性组；用精确查询的对数似然为图库图像打分；并利用同一次前向的 DINOv3 外观特征对图库 logits 做 kNN 平滑。
AI.result: 在留出数据集上三项改动均提升 mADM：似然打分提升主集成全部六项检索指标，并使全部 48 个开发模型 mADM 提升；免训练 kNN 平滑提升全部 46 个测试模型。UPAR 2027 隐藏测试集达 68.17 mADM。
AI.conclusion: 用似然评分替代 L1 距离、辅以互斥属性组正则与免训练近邻平滑，可有效缓解跨摄像头概率漂移，稳定提升属性检索性能。

title: MOFjson: An Explicit Topological Representation of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Language Models
summary: Language models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) rely on formats that separate atomic geometry from structural topology, forcing models to choose between unstructured coordinate lists and non-spatial string identifiers[1]. We present MOFjson, the first representation separating structural data into a raw atomic layer with explicit bond shift vectors and a derived layer exposing secondary building units (metal nodes and organic linkers) and network topology. Additionally, we introduce a benchmark with crystal-derived ground truth across four question categories. Across four models, MOFjson beats all three baselines in every category: 100% vs. 18-47% on reaching a block's nearest periodic copy, 96% vs. 71% on crystal system characterisation, and 60% vs. 48% on metal node and organic linker coordination. Ablating shift labels drops accuracy to 12.7%, proving models read the periodic graph rather than the surface format. MOFjson gives language models structure to read rather than reconstruct, establishing a foundation for agentic tool workflows and constrained MOF generation.

AI.tldr: 提出MOFjson——首个将MOF结构分为原始原子层（含显式键平移向量）与派生层（SBU与网络拓扑）的表示格式，并构建四类问题基准，四模型上均优于三个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MOF语言模型表示格式将原子几何与结构拓扑割裂：要么是无结构坐标列表，要么是非空间字符串标识符，模型不得不在两者间取舍，难以正确"阅读"周期结构。
AI.method: MOFjson双层的表示：原始层保留原子坐标并显式编码键的周期性平移向量；派生层暴露二级构建单元（金属节点、有机配体）及网络拓扑。同时构建基于晶体学真值的基准，覆盖四类问题；并在四个模型上做基线对比与消融实验。
AI.result: 四个模型在全部类别上均超越三个基线：到达最近周期副本100% vs 18–47%；晶系判定96% vs 71%；金属节点与配体配位60% vs 48%。消融平移标签后准确率跌至12.7%，说明模型依赖周期图而非表面格式。
AI.conclusion: MOFjson让语言模型直接"读取"结构而非重建结构，为智能体工具工作流与约束式MOF生成奠定基础。

title: The LALA Benchmark: Evaluating Literary and Linguistic Analysis in LLMs
summary: We introduce the Literature and Linguistics Analysis Benchmark (LALA), comprising 236 open-ended questions written by experts in linguistics and literary studies, together with expert-provided ideal answers. By comparing models within families and at similar training scales using human and LLM judges, LALA identifies differences in linguistic competence associated with post-training, offering a framework for evaluating future models and guiding targeted improvements. We administered questions to 17 language models and evaluated their responses using both human expert assessment and two LLM evaluators, Sol and Qwen. Base models displayed little of the linguistic competence assessed by the benchmark, whereas their post-trained versions performed markedly better, suggesting that post-training plays a central role in making linguistic knowledge accessible and usable. Parameter count, by contrast, showed no statistically significant association with partial-credit performance, and competencies remained unevenly distributed across linguistic domains. We interpret this pattern as evidence that post-training adds linguistic competencies piecemeal, without producing a general linguistic intelligence capable of extending them beyond the learned policies that support them. Models performed best on logical relations between statements and selected discourse-level tasks, while even the strongest post-trained models continued to struggle with ambiguity, literary style, reference, and misleading assumptions.
