Human and Sol evaluations produced nearly identical model rankings in both the original and ReliableEval runs, supporting the replicability of the comparative results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出文学与语言学分析基准 LALA（236 道由专家撰写的开放题及专家参考答案），通过人类与 LLM 评审对比同一模型系列的基座版与后训练版，发现语言能力主要来自后训练而非参数量，且呈"碎片化"分布。
AI.motivation: 现有评测难以区分语言能力究竟源自模型规模还是后训练，也缺少能细致刻画语言学各子领域能力的专家级开放题基准，因此需要一个可定位后训练作用的诊断框架。
AI.method: 构建 LALA：236 道文学与语言学研究专家撰写的开放题加专家理想答案；对 17 个模型提问，用人类专家评估与 Sol、Qwen 两个 LLM 评审（含 ReliableEval 复跑）进行打分，并在同一模型家族、相近训练规模内对比基座模型与后训练模型。
AI.result: 基座模型表现极差，后训练版本明显更好；参数量与部分得分无统计显著关联；各语言学子领域能力分布不均。模型在陈述间逻辑关系及部分语篇任务上表现最好，但在歧义、文学风格、指代和误导性前提上即便最强后训练模型仍吃力。人类与 Sol 评审给出的模型排序几乎一致，说明结果可复现。
AI.conclusion: 后训练以"逐项拼装"的方式增添语言能力，并未形成可泛化到所学策略之外的通用语言智能；LALA 可作为评估未来模型并指导针对性改进的框架。

title: Task Success Is Not Enough: Side-effect-Aware Evaluation of Tool-Using Language Model Agents
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 19 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables
summary: Tool-using language model agents are usually evaluated by whether they finish the user's task. That metric misses a common failure: an agent can complete the requested work while also taking an unauthorized side-effecting action, such as writing to the wrong object, expanding the scope of the request, or contacting an unintended recipient. We call this failure mode collateral damage (CD). We introduce SABench (Side-effect-Aware Benchmark), a benchmark of 201 email, calendar, and ticket tasks. Each task crosses one of four state structures (independent, dependent, externally reachable, cross-tool) with one of four trap families (ambiguity, mis-targeting, cascade harm, overreach), and each task has a deterministic trace-based oracle for both goal satisfaction and authorization compliance. Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes. Cross-tool and dependent states have about twice the CD rate of independent states. CD rates vary by 4.7x across models at comparable goal rates, which suggests that task success alone is a poor proxy for safe tool use. The SABench task corpus is released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Phaedrus/sabench; the traces, oracle, code, and analysis pipeline are released at https://github.com/hjj194/sabench-artifact.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SABench基准，衡量工具使用型语言模型智能体的"附带损害"（CD）——即在完成用户任务同时执行未授权副作用操作。201个邮件/日历/工单任务交叉四种状态结构与四种陷阱，配确定性轨迹判定器。11个前沿模型2211次运行中15.2%出现CD，歧义任务达38.8%；目标达成运行中仍有12.8%产生未授权写入，说明任务成功率不足以作为安全代理指标。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估只看任务是否完成，忽略了"做对事但越权"的失败模式：写错对象、扩大请求范围、误联系他人等。这类附带损害在真实工具场景中危害显著，却缺乏系统性度量。
AI.method: 构建SABench：201个邮件、日历、工单任务，每个任务由四种状态结构（独立、依赖、外部可达、跨工具）与四种陷阱族（歧义、误指向、级联伤害、越界）组合而成，并为每个任务提供同时判定目标满足与授权合规的确定性轨迹oracle。在11个前沿LLM上评测2211个模型-任务对。
AI.result: 总体CD率15.2%；歧义任务违规率38.8%，非歧义陷阱平均8.4%；目标达成运行中12.8%仍含未授权写入；跨工具与依赖状态的CD率约为独立状态的两倍；在目标成功率相近条件下，模型间CD率相差达4.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务成功仅是安全工具使用的糟糕代理指标，评估需显式引入授权合规维度。附带损害风险集中于歧义与复杂状态结构，不同模型存在显著安全差异。任务语料、轨迹、oracle与代码已开源。

title: Intervention-Certified Amplification: A Validity Gate for $σ$-Weighted Post-Training
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026; see https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-emnlp.2090/
summary: Hybrid post-training often mixes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), using training-side signals to set each sample's balance. Such signals characterize the anchor data and policy, but not whether the emphasized behavior helps in the target task and evaluation setting. This mismatch can reactivate and amplify pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision. We demonstrate this with DIAA (Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification), a per-sample $σ$-weighted SFT/RL hybrid. With all literal Python fences removed from its anchor, DIAA emits unexecuted Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) on $29%$ of MATH-500 prompts, three times vanilla GRPO. Paired interventions show $10.6$ percentage points of accuracy recovery when TIR is suppressed and comparable contributions from SFT imitation and $σ$-amplification; a student trained on a $0%$-TIR teacher anchor emits it at $45.8%$. Intervention-Certified Amplification (ICA) gates $σ$ with paired-rollout target evidence. Frozen and online ICA reduce TIR to $13.8%$ and $11.2%$, halve residual drag, improve accuracy from $47.5%$ to $48.7%$ and $49.3%$, and transfer to held-out GSM8K without retuning.

AI.tldr: 混合SFT/RL后训练会用训练侧信号设定样本权重，但这种信号无法判断被强调的行为是否真正有利于目标任务，可能导致预训练行为的再激活与放大。本文提出DIAA诊断该问题，并用ICA方法加以门控修正。
AI.motivation: 混合后训练（SFT+RL）常用训练侧信号（锚数据、策略）为每个样本分配平衡权重，但这些信号只看锚数据本身，并不反映被强调的行为在目标任务和评测设定下是否真正有效。这种错配会让预训练行为即使已从监督中移除字面形式，仍被重新激活并放大。
AI.method: 作者构造DIAA（Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification）：一种按样本σ加权的SFT/RL混合方法，用于放大该现象；随后提出Intervention-Certified Amplification (ICA)，通过配对rollout的目标侧证据对σ进行门控，包含冻结版与在线版两种设置。
AI.result: 在锚数据中移除所有字面Python代码围栏后，DIAA仍在29%的MATH-500提示上输出未执行的TIR，为vanilla GRPO的三倍。配对干预显示：抑制TIR可恢复10.6个百分点准确率，SFT模仿与σ放大的贡献相当；用0%TIR教师锚训练的学生仍有45.8%概率输出TIR。ICA将TIR降至13.8%（冻结）与11.2%（在线），残余拖累减半，准确率从47.5%提升到48.7%和49.3%，且无需重调即可迁移到held-out GSM8K。
AI.conclusion: 训练侧平衡信号不足以判断行为对目标任务是否有益，会造成预训练行为的隐性再激活；基于配对rollout目标证据对权重门控（ICA）可有效抑制该问题并提升准确率，且具跨数据集迁移性。

title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
summary: GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate's identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Across five benchmarks, PreView improves the average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, and Qwen3-VL-4B without further training these grounding models. Extensive analyses examine the contributions of views and cues, center refinement, and visual input budgets.

AI.tldr: PreView 是一个无需重训现有 grounding 模型的辅助预处理器，通过“任务相关视图 + 候选特定线索”两类互补输入提升 GUI grounding 精度。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding 需在杂乱截图中定位小控件并判断指令所指目标；裁剪放大能暴露局部细节，但放大后的图像仍可能存在目标歧义，因此需要更有效的信息组织方式。
AI.method: 训练一个轻量辅助模型预测并精化中心点，据此裁剪局部视图并放大；同时构造视觉线索（红圈标记+位置提示）和文本线索（描述候选的身份或功能）。这些准备好的输入送入冻结的 grounding 模型做最终点击预测，全程不训练 grounding 模型。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，PreView 无需额外训练即提升了 Qwen3-VL-2B、OS-Atlas-4B、Qwen3-VL-4B 的平均 grounding 准确率；并进行了关于视图与线索贡献、中心精化、视觉输入预算的消融分析。
AI.conclusion: 以轻量预处理器增强输入质量是提升 GUI grounding 的一种免训练、可插拔的有效途径。

title: Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence: Supply Chain Deployment
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of GeoIndustry 2026 (5th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Spatial Big Data and AI for Industrial Applications). In-person presentation scheduled for November 3, 2026, Riverside, California. Proceedings forthcoming in the ACM Digital Library
summary: Industrial spatial decisions are assembled across systems that share neither a reference frame nor an owner, and analysts spend substantial effort reconciling those systems rather than reasoning about space. This paper presents ANASSA, a reference architecture integrating structured reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, authoritative spatial grounding, and feedback-driven execution, and reports its instantiation in an operating supply-chain deployment. The architecture places typed data contracts at agent boundaries, validates spatial claims against a certified authoritative foundation, and enforces two blocking human-in-the-loop approvals inside a six-step cognitive loop. The deployment covers multi-hazard risk assessment on an ocean-and-inland freight lane, including cold-chain excursion detection over container telemetry. Across a three-month proof of concept (POC) with three implementation iterations, three deployment outcomes are reported: 25% improvement in data quality, 50% reduction in spatial workflow runtime, and 60% lower decision latency relative to the preceding manual workflow. Absolute deployment-scale quantities and baseline counts are confidential; reported percentages are observed relative changes. These are uncontrolled deployment observations, not controlled experiments. We therefore specify instrumentation and ablation protocols for mechanism-level evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ANASSA 参考架构，融合结构化推理、多智能体工作流编排、权威空间基础与反馈驱动执行，并在真实供应链部署中验证，报告数据质量提升25%、空间工作流运行时间减少50%、决策时延降低60%。
AI.motivation: 工业空间决策分散在既无统一参考系又无统一归属的多个系统中，分析师大量精力耗费在系统间数据对齐而非空间推理上，亟需一种能整合异构空间系统并保证空间断言可信的架构。
AI.method: 提出 ANASSA 参考架构：在智能体边界设置类型化数据契约，基于经认证的权威空间基础验证空间断言，并在六步认知循环中强制两次阻断式人在回路审批；同时设计多智能体工作流编排与反馈驱动执行机制，并给出机制级评估的埋点与消融协议。实例化为海运与内陆货运通道的多灾害风险评估部署，含基于集装箱遥测的冷链偏移检测。
AI.result: 在为期三个月、含三轮实现迭代的概念验证中，相对此前人工工作流实现：数据质量提升25%，空间工作流运行时间缩短50%，决策时延降低60%。绝对规模与基线计数因保密未披露；结果为观察性相对变化，非受控实验。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在真实供应链部署中展现出可观的效率与质量收益，但证据属非受控部署观察，尚不能支持机制层面的因果归因；作者据此提出埋点与消融协议，作为后续受控机制级评估的基础。

title: T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

AI.tldr: T2D将投机解码中的草稿模型设计表述为优化问题，通过延迟感知的结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，直接从目标模型构建草稿模型，联合优化推理延迟与分布对齐，可剪枝高达92%仍保持高性能。
AI.motivation: 投机解码的加速效果取决于两个关键因素：草稿模型与目标模型的分布对齐程度，以及草稿模型的推理延迟。现有方法要么使用独立预训练的小模型作为草稿，要么手动选择架构对目标模型剪枝，无法显式平衡"对齐性"与"生成效率"之间的权衡。
AI.method: 将草稿模型设计形式化为优化问题，提出T2D框架：以目标模型为起点，采用延迟感知（latency-aware）的结构化剪枝结合知识蒸馏，直接构建草稿模型，使其在实测推理延迟与目标模型响应上的交叉熵损失两方面联合优化。
AI.result: 在多领域投机解码基准及多个不同规模的目标模型族上实验表明，T2D可剪枝目标模型高达92%仍获得高性能草稿模型，优于竞争基线；所得草稿模型还可即插即用地配合其他投机解码的token对齐与知识蒸馏方法，带来额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了联合探索草稿模型"架构—对齐"前沿的重要性，以充分释放投机解码在大语言模型上的加速潜力。

title: R2A-Sales: A Policy-Atom-Matched Benchmark for Rule-to-Action Gaps in Goal-Directed Sales Agents
comment: 25 pages, including 16 pages of supplementary material. Both authors contributed equally
summary: LLM-based sales agents are often evaluated on static policy questions or task success, but deployment asks a sharper question: when a model can state a rule, will it choose compliant, tool-grounded actions under commercial pressure? We introduce R2A-Sales (Rule-to-Action), a policy-atom-matched benchmark for this question. Each item pairs a static probe with a multi-turn sales scenario sharing the same versioned policy atom, facts, evidence, behavioral constraints, and tool contract, so differences cannot be attributed to policy-content mismatch. In the interactive arm, a code-owned ledger verifies committed tool effects and terminal states; unsupported action claims receive no credit. We report static compliance $K$, grounded action compliance $A=\Pr(\text{safe terminal}\land\text{no hard violation}\land\text{non-echo})$, and the matched gap $G=K-A$. The frozen release spans three controlled Chinese-language sales domains, 24 policy atoms, 42 semantic cores, and 2,016 matched pairs. The confirmatory study audits 21,888 runs over 19 cores, covering eight backbones plus four Qwen3-8B prompt treatments (12 configurations). Static compliance is near ceiling $(K=89.9\%\text{--}99.1\%)$, yet eight-backbone action compliance is only $A=3.0\%\text{--}17.3\%$, giving $G=80.4\text{--}92.5$ percentage points. Since $A$ also requires safe termination, $G$ upper-bounds rule-to-action degradation rather than isolating pressure alone. No prompt-only treatment dominates all metrics. R2A-Sales shows that sales-agent reliability must be measured at committed action, not rule recital or task completion alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 R2A-Sales 基准，用同一政策原子配对"静态问答"与"多轮销售情景"，发现模型能背规则（K≈90-99%）但在压力下合规行动率极低（A=3%-17%），规则到行动落差 G 达 80-92 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 销售智能体评估多基于静态政策问答或任务成功率，无法回答部署关心的核心问题：模型"说得出一条规则"时，是否会在商业压力下选择合规、基于工具的行动。需要排除政策内容不一致这一混杂因素来测量"规则→行动"的落差。
AI.method: 构建 R2A-Sales 政策原子匹配基准：每条样本将一个静态探针与一个多轮销售场景配对，二者共享同一版本化政策原子、事实、证据、行为约束与工具契约。交互分支由代码维护的账本核验已提交的工具效果与终态，无依据的行动声明不得分。指标为静态合规 K、接地行动合规 A=Pr(安全终态∧无硬违规∧非复读) 及匹配落差 G=K−A。发布含 3 个中文销售域、24 个政策原子、42 个语义核、2016 对样本；确证研究覆盖 19 个核、12 种配置（8 个骨干模型 + 4 种 Qwen3-8B 提示处理）、21,888 次运行。
AI.result: 静态合规接近上限 K=89.9%-99.1%，而 8 骨干模型的行动合规仅 A=3.0%-17.3%，G=80.4-92.5 个百分点。由于 A 还要求安全终止，G 是规则到行动退化的上界而非仅压力效应的隔离。无任何纯提示处理在所有指标上占优。
AI.conclusion: 销售智能体的可靠性必须在"已提交行动"层面度量，而非规则背诵或任务完成率。R2A-Sales 提供了可复用的匹配式评估范式，并揭示提示工程难以弥合规则到行动的鸿沟。

title: Min-Marginal Power Indices for Multi-Objective Feature Selection
summary: Game-theoretic feature selection scores each feature by its average marginal contribution across coalitions. An average shows whether a feature helps overall, but not whether, in some coalition, adding it turns an acceptable model into an unacceptable one. Building on minimum marginal aggregation, we define the Min-Marginal Power Index (MinPI) on a binary utility-threshold game. For a fixed quota, MinPI takes the value -1, 0, or +1 and labels each feature harmful, neutral, or decisive. A harmful label carries its own evidence, an evaluated coalition in which adding the feature drops utility below the quota, so no score cutoff is needed; finite-budget estimators keep this property but may miss harmful features. We use MinPI to propose feature removals, which are accepted only if they pass a validation gate, and to prefilter multi-objective search. On six benchmark datasets over five seeds, MinPI removed 12.5% of analyzed features with almost no loss of held-out utility. On Madelon and Abalone, where it removed the most, its removals cost far less held-out utility than random removals of the same size. Prefiltering increased the dataset-averaged hypervolume of multi-objective search in all five seeds. MinPI is therefore a conservative feature-deletion step whose gains are largest where the data contain many removable features.

AI.tldr: 论文提出最小边际功效指数（MinPI）：在二元效用阈值博弈上，按固定配额把特征标为有害(-1)、中性(0)或决定性(+1)，并用于特征删除与多目标搜索预筛选。
AI.motivation: 博弈论特征选择用平均边际贡献打分，只能反映特征整体是否有帮助，无法回答"在某联盟中，加入该特征是否会把可接受模型变成不可接受模型"这一问题。
AI.method: 基于最小边际聚合，在二元效用阈值博弈上定义MinPI：固定配额下取值为-1/0/+1，分别对应有害、中性、决定性。有害标签自带证据（存在某被评估联盟，加入该特征后效用跌破配额），因此无需分数阈值；有限预算估计器保持该性质但可能漏检有害特征。MinPI提出删除候选，须通过验证门控才被接受，并用于多目标搜索预筛选。
AI.result: 六个基准数据集、五个随机种子上，MinPI删除约12.5%的被分析特征，留出效用几乎无损；在删除最多的Madelon和Abalone上，其删除带来的留出效用损失远小于同规模随机删除；预筛选在全部五个种子上提升了数据集中平均的超体积。
AI.conclusion: MinPI是一种保守的特征删除步骤，其收益在数据含大量可删除特征时最大。

title: FreeView: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Uncurated Views
summary: Reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from uncurated image collections remains challenging due to the presence of irrelevant or non-overlapping views. Recent work has shown that feed-forward reconstruction models contain internal view-consistency signals that support distractor rejection. However, reference-conditioned filtering relies on a curated clean reference, which is not guaranteed in practical image collections. To address this limitation, we introduce FreeView, a training-free framework that jointly selects a filtering reference and rejects distractor views from an uncurated collection. FreeView leverages collection-level consensus to identify a representative view that serves as a reliable reference for filtering. It then adapts view rejection to each input collection by combining complementary visual and geometric evidence. This approach preserves useful views under substantial appearance and viewpoint variations while rejecting distractors. FreeView integrates with both VGGT and pi^3, removing the need for a manually curated reference or manual calibration of view rejection. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate high clean-view retention and distractor rejection rates, leading to reliable 3D reconstruction from uncurated views.

AI.tldr: FreeView是一个无需训练的框架，能从无整理的图像集合中同时自动选择过滤参考视图并剔除干扰视图，实现可靠的3D场景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈重建模型虽含内部视图一致性信号可用于剔除干扰视图，但依赖人工精选的干净参考视图，而实际图像集合无法保证存在此类参考。
AI.method: 利用集合级共识选出具有代表性的参考视图；再针对每个输入集合，结合视觉与几何互补证据自适应地调整视图剔除策略；可与VGGT和pi^3集成，无需手动精选参考或人工校准剔除阈值。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上取得较高的干净视图保留率与干扰视图剔除率，在显著外观和视角变化下仍能保留有用视图，实现可靠3D重建。
AI.conclusion: FreeView消除了对人工参考和手动调参的依赖，为无整理图像集合的3D重建提供了有效方案。

title: Arya Forge: Auditing Validation and Release Approval for Financial Instruction Data
summary: Financial instruction-data pipelines must distinguish content validity from permission to release a particular dataset. Arya Forge combines typed records, current-content checks, and approval coverage bound to a dataset manifest. We evaluate its release boundaries in a financial-data systems case study. An integrity audit covers 100,000 synthetic instruction records; a separate arithmetic implementation agrees with all 15,000 numeric records across twelve formula families. In 240 scenarios with 2,400 treatment rows, adding financial and release-record checks to a short-instruction filtering recipe rejects all injected numeric faults and policy holds while retaining 220 of 240 clean controls. The twenty lost controls comprise every tested cash-conversion-cycle example. Nineteen persisted-release cases show that eleven selected negative cases are blocked, four equivalent representations are rejected, and changes to external evidence after binding are outside ordinary Gold promotion's checks. Local processing measurements and controlled checkpoint resumptions characterize cost and recovery through 100,000 input rows. The results expose a tradeoff between strict producer-contract enforcement and useful-representation retention, and identify the protected inputs required for manifest-bound approval. These findings apply to the tested implementation and workloads; they do not establish general financial correctness, authenticated approval, expert-validated quality, or downstream model improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出Arya Forge：将类型化记录、内容一致性检查与绑定数据集清单的审批覆盖相结合，区分数据内容有效性与发布许可，并在金融数据系统案例中检验其发布边界。
AI.motivation: 金融指令数据流水线中，"内容是否有效"与"是否有权发布某数据集"是两类不同问题，现有流程缺少对二者的明确区分与绑定机制。
AI.method: 采用组件：类型化记录、当前内容检查、绑定数据集清单的审批覆盖；在金融数据系统中评估——10万条合成指令记录完整性审计、1.5万条数值记录跨12个公式族与独立算术实现比对、240个场景/2400处理行检验加入财务与发布记录检查后的过滤效果、19个持久化发布案例、以及本地处理与受控检查点恢复测量（至10万行）。
AI.result: 算术实现与全部1.5万条数值记录一致；加入财务与发布检查后拒绝全部注入的数值故障与策略留置，同时保留240个干净对照中的220个（损失20个均为现金转换周期示例）；19个发布案例中11个负例被阻断、4个等价表示被拒，绑定后外部证据变化超出普通Gold晋升检查范围。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示严格生产者契约执行与有用表示保留之间的权衡，并识别清单绑定审批所需的受保护输入；结论仅适用于所测实现与负载，不构成一般金融正确性、认证审批、专家验证质量或下游模型改进的证明。

title: Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction
summary: Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural--semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; their union with ancestor context preserves structural relations and complete local text. Across four frontier answer models, \ours improves average QA-F1 by 1.72 points over full-context prompting on three LongBench tasks, surpassing the evaluated baselines on the four-model average while reducing answer-context length by 58.55\%. Our code is available at the $\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/treefuse-ECFE}{repository}$.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的TreeFuse框架：用语义抽象引导证据选择、保留原文作答，在长上下文QA上以更短上下文取得更高F1。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型可容纳整篇文档，但容量不等于"哪些信息最支持查询"。当全文已能放进上下文时，是否还能通过选择与组织证据来提升回答质量——需要在保留支撑事实与关系的同时让上下文聚焦于问题。
AI.method: 免训练框架：对全文一次性生成可复用的语义层级树，节点描述链接到原文span；给定查询，用结构-语义打分与细粒度词法归因选出共享源节点，并将其与祖先上下文取并集，从而保留结构关系与完整局部原文。
AI.result: 在四个前沿答案模型、三个LongBench任务上，平均QA-F1比全文提示提升1.72点，四模型平均超过所评估基线，同时答案上下文长度减少58.55%。
AI.conclusion: 即使全文可放入上下文，结构化的证据选择与组织仍能显著改善长上下文问答，并大幅压缩输入长度；免训练设计使其易于部署。

title: MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research
summary: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

AI.tldr: MatOS是面向材料研究的智能体操作系统，以分层科学资产图、有状态自适应工作流、证据驱动资产演化三大组件组织科研能力为可复用可进化资产，在多项基准和八个真实研究案例中取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 材料研究数据与工具分散，单项研究常跨越文献分析、计算与实验的多日流程。LLM智能体虽已能检索数据、运行仿真代码并闭环实验，但扩展新能力、维持长任务推进、从历史任务与用户反馈中学习仍然困难。
AI.method: 提出MatOS，包含：(1) 分层科学资产图，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色与工作流组织为可复用资产；(2) 有状态自适应工作流，将任务表示为带科学检查点的显式执行图，支持恢复与追溯；(3) 证据驱动资产演化，依据执行记录与用户反馈修订资产。
AI.result: ResearchClawBench上同基座模型较此前最优提升11.15%并扩展成本-得分帕累托前沿；MatTools上超Codex CLI 2.13%、SciAgentGym上超4.17%。八个案例中将3000万候选结构缩减至97种固态电解质候选，识别89种导电率高于母体的卤化物变体，关联11个预训练原子势的力误差与局域原子环境，并提出两种方法分别降低误差3.1%和13.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将研究能力组织为可复用、可演化的资产，可使智能体胜任长周期、多阶段的材料研究流程。代码已开源。

title: Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate method that selects among CTTA methods. Empirically, we find that Select-CTTA outperforms test-time baselines and approaches the performance of models fine-tuned on shortcut-balanced data.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实测试时增强(CTTA)方法族，通过辅助模型生成改变捷径值的反事实编辑并加权平均LLM预测，证明最优捷径不变预测器属于该族，并给出Select-CTTA聚合方法。
AI.motivation: LLM会利用训练数据中的捷径相关性，在测试时相关性发生偏移时导致预测变差。现有去捷径方法多在训练时进行，需要标签数据、模型权重访问和大量算力，测试时场景缺乏方案。
AI.method: 构建CTTA方法族：对每个样本用辅助模型生成改变捷径值的反事实编辑，再对LLM在各编辑上的预测加权平均。理论上证明最优捷径不变预测器属于该族并刻画其权重；权重依赖训练分布，通常不可从模型和无标签测试数据识别，故给出可用token概率获取权重的假设及检测假设违背的检验，据此提出Select-CTTA在多种CTTA方法中选择。
AI.result: 实验中Select-CTTA优于测试时基线方法，并接近在捷径平衡数据上微调模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 测试时反事实增强可有效去除捷径，Select-CTTA通过假设检验自适应选择方法，性能接近捷径平衡微调，提供了无需训练和权重访问的实用方案。

title: Tracking Is Not Sensing: Artifact-Aware Thermal Video Respiration Estimation in Head-Free Marmosets
summary: Continuous physiological monitoring is essential for linking behavior, internal state, and neural activity in neuroscience and translational research. In common marmosets, a key nonhuman primate model for social neuroscience, respiratory rate provides a basic readout of arousal, stress, and physiological regulation. Contact sensors can provide accurate measurements, but they add preparation burden and may interfere with head-free behavioral protocols. Thermal video offers a noncontact alternative by capturing breathing-related temperature changes around the nose and mouth. However, in head-free marmosets, these cues are weak, localized, and easily corrupted by head motion, pose changes, and fur. Here we show that this setting exposes a broader challenge in video-based physiological sensing: visually reliable tracking does not necessarily imply physiologically valid measurement. Using synchronized thermal video and contact respiration recordings, we show that marmoset respiration is recoverable from thermal video but strongly ROI-sensitive. Under head-free motion, visually plausible nasal tracking can still produce traces inconsistent with contact respiration, demonstrating that tracking is not sensing. We therefore estimate respiratory rate from learned temporal signals extracted from thermal clips and introduce Selective Temporal Attenuation Regularization (STAR). STAR selectively attenuates high-motion thermal discontinuities through local temporal imputation during training, regularizing models toward respiration-consistent dynamics while leaving inference unchanged on raw video. Across multiple deep-learning backbones, STAR improves head-free estimation, reaching 2.23 bpm MAE compared with 20.76 bpm for tracked ROI analysis.

AI.tldr: 在无头固定(head-free)的普通狨猴中，热成像视频可恢复呼吸率，但视觉上可靠的鼻部跟踪并不等于生理有效测量；作者提出STAR正则化，从热成像片段中学习时间信号直接估计呼吸率，达到2.23 bpm MAE。
AI.motivation: 连续生理监测对连接行为、内状态与神经活动至关重要，狨猴呼吸率是唤醒/压力的基本读数。接触式传感器准确但准备负担大且干扰无头固定行为范式；热视频提供非接触方案，但狨猴的呼吸热信号弱、局部化，易受头部运动、姿态变化和毛发干扰。
AI.method: 用同步热视频与接触式呼吸记录对比，指出ROI敏感性与"跟踪≠感知"问题；转而从热成像片段提取学习的时间信号估计呼吸率，并提出Selective Temporal Attenuation Regularization (STAR)：训练时通过局部时间插补选择性衰减高运动热不连续片段，将模型正则化到呼吸一致动态，推理时对原始视频不变。
AI.result: 多种深度学习骨干网络上STAR均改善无头固定估计，MAE 2.23 bpm，而基于跟踪ROI的分析为20.76 bpm。视觉上合理的鼻部跟踪仍可能产生与接触呼吸不一致的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 视频生理感知中视觉可靠跟踪不等于生理有效测量；ROI跟踪方法在运动下脆弱，而基于学习时间信号加STAR正则化可显著提升无接触狨猴呼吸率估计的准确性。

title: Decision Model Factory: Building Specialized Sovereign Decision Models
summary: Decision needs vary with each application, language, and deployment environment. The Decision Model Factory turns those needs into specialized, sovereign models on demand. A brief recipe guides the training, calibration, verification, and evaluation of a selected backbone, delivering a deployable decision model under the operator's control. The same workflow creates a new specialist whenever the requirements change. Across Japanese decision tasks, compact deployment, and long-context passage ranking, five factory-built models improve upon their backbones; three surpass the strongest results in a fixed public Japanese benchmark comparison. A dedicated runner computes only permitted-answer probabilities and reuses shared context, more than doubling serving speed on matched multi-question workloads with essentially unchanged decision scores. Together, the factory and runner make fast, task-specific decision models practical to build and deploy whenever needed.

AI.tldr: 提出"决策模型工厂"(Decision Model Factory)：把具体应用/语言/部署需求转化为按需定制的专用、主权模型，配合专用推理器Runner实现快速部署。
AI.motivation: 决策需求随应用、语言和部署环境各异，现成通用模型难以直接满足；同时需要模型处于运营者自主控制之下（sovereign），并要求快速、任务专用。
AI.method: 给出一套简明配方，指导对选定backbone进行训练、校准、验证与评估，产出可部署的决策模型；需求变化时用同一流程生成新专家模型。另设计专用runner，仅计算被允许答案的概率并复用共享上下文。
AI.result: 在日本语决策任务、紧凑部署和长上下文段落排序上，5个工厂模型均优于其backbone，其中3个超过固定公开日本语基准对比中最强结果；runner在匹配的多问题负载上服务速度提升一倍以上，决策分数基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 工厂+Runner使快速、任务专用的决策模型在实际需要时可被便捷构建与部署。

title: Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory
summary: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

AI.tldr: 提出Factorized Write Routing (FWR)，将"是否写入"与"写入多少槽位"解耦，并在两个合成任务上发现密度依赖的反转现象。
AI.motivation: 长序列模型需保留早期信息。全注意力代价高，循环记忆模型把历史压缩到固定槽位以线性时间处理，但容量有限使写入决策变得关键：干扰项会覆盖有用内容，跳过的证据无法召回。现有多槽记忆对每个token都写入相同数量的槽位，混淆了"是否存储"与"更新多少槽位"两个决策。
AI.method: FWR先决定保留或跳过每个token，再选择固定或token自适应的槽位数量；查询时仍读取全部槽位。
AI.result: 在两个需在长上下文中查询事实的合成任务上，各跑十个随机种子，观察到密度依赖的反转：每次写入4槽时，稠密的Feature Recall任务上"始终写入"更优（0.472 vs 0.337），而稀疏事实的Passkey任务上学习式选择性写入更优（0.222 vs 0.048）。测试的自适应规则在两者上均不如固定分配。使用事实标签的诊断oracle在Passkey上达0.372，说明过滤干扰项仍有空间。
AI.conclusion: 信息密集时应避免漏写，干扰占主导时应过滤干扰项；写入策略应随上下文密度调整，简单自适应规则未必有效。

title: Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. Existing methods either rely on implicit temporal representations within policy networks, where historical information can be gradually diluted, or maintain explicit memory buffers that suffer from redundancy, noise accumulation, and inefficient retrieval. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information. Our approach encodes multimodal trajectories into compact latent memory representations through a selective state- space memory encoder, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression. During action generation, dynamic cross-attention retrieval with gated fusion adaptively incorporates relevant memories into policy prediction. With merely 3.45M additional parameters, CogMemory stays lightweight and seamlessly fits both early- and intermediate-fusion VLA backbones. Extensive experiments on long-horizon robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse VLA backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出CogMemory——一种变分认知记忆框架，通过选择性状态空间编码、多槽时序抽象和变分压缩构建紧凑潜记忆，并用动态交叉注意力检索与门控融合增强VLA长时任务的记忆能力，仅增3.45M参数即显著提升长时操作性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作上表现优异，但长期记忆建模不足限制了长时任务执行：隐式时序表示会被逐渐稀释，显式记忆缓冲区则存在冗余、噪声累积和检索低效的问题。
AI.method: 将多模态轨迹编码为紧凑潜记忆，采用三部分设计：选择性状态空间记忆编码器、多槽时序抽象、变分信息压缩；动作生成阶段使用动态交叉注意力检索配合门控融合，自适应地把相关记忆注入策略预测。模块轻量，可即插即用于早期融合与中间融合两类VLA骨干。
AI.result: 仅增加3.45M参数；在多个长时机器人操作基准上，跨多种VLA骨干均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、压缩式的认知记忆机制可有效弥补VLA的长时记忆短板，且以极低参数代价实现骨干无关的通用增强。

title: Learning Population Dynamics with Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow
summary: This paper introduces a novel simulation-free framework for learning unbalanced population dynamics on the Riemannian Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) manifold, termed Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow (VDWF), built upon the theory of the unbalanced mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB). First, by independently learning a geometry model equipped with a data-dependent metric, our model captures the intrinsic geometric structure of population dynamics. Furthermore, leveraging Doob's h-transform, the proposed method incorporates boundary information to improve flow-based trajectory inference. For unbalanced transport, a growth model is employed to learn the dynamics while constructing intermediate mass samples in the WFR space without simulation. Additionally, we analyze the convergence rate of the proposed framework using a uniform Log-Sobolev inequality (LSI). Finally, we validate the proposed approach on multiple real-world datasets, demonstrating competitive performance in learning both balanced and unbalanced population dynamics compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出免模拟的变分Doob-Wasserstein流(VDWF)框架，基于非平衡平均场薛定谔桥理论在Riemannian WFR流形上学习非平衡种群动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以刻画种群动力学的内在几何结构，且在非平衡(质量可变)传输中依赖模拟、轨迹推断受边界信息利用不足。
AI.method: 1) 独立学习带数据依赖度量的几何模型以捕捉内在几何结构；2) 借Doob h-变换融入边界信息改进基于流的轨迹推断；3) 用增长模型学习非平衡传输动力学，无需模拟即在WFR空间构造中间质量样本；4) 用一致Log-Sobolev不等式(LSI)分析收敛速率。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上验证，学习平衡与非平衡种群动力学方面均与SOTA方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: VDWF为非平衡种群动力学提供了免模拟、几何感知且具理论收敛保证的有效学习框架。

title: Rescuing Your Pruning: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning and Post-Training Recovery in MLLMs
summary: Visual token pruning substantially reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing methods are mostly training-free and plug-and-play. They treat the resulting performance drop as an inevitable cost of compression and pursue increasingly complex pruning rules. We rethink this view through two questions: how much of the loss can post-training rescue, and, building on this recovery, how can joint compression push pruning to its limit? We curate a 282K-sample post-training mixture covering general VQA, reasoning, OCR, and grounding, and post-train 36 configurations that drop or merge tokens under a unified protocol. Post-training rescues most of the loss, even for OCR and grounding, and its adaptation gain in closing the gap between the pruned and the dense model grows as the budget tightens. For joint compression, we find that the vision encoder, not the LLM, dominates prefill time in native-resolution MLLMs, so where tokens are removed matters more than how many: keeping 40% of tokens at the encoder runs faster than keeping 10% at the projector. Our best configuration prunes the encoder lightly and the projector aggressively, leaves the LLM intact, and keeps general understanding and reasoning at the dense level. It accelerates the LLM stage by 3.49x but the end-to-end time-to-first-token by only 1.54x, showing that LLM-stage speedups overstate end-to-end gains. We hope these findings offer insights for future research on joint visual token compression. Our data, protocol, and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究视觉token剪枝后的后训练恢复与联合压缩极限，发现后训练能挽救大部分性能损失，且压缩位置比压缩比例更关键，最佳配置（编码器轻剪、投影器重剪、LLM不动）实现3.49x LLM阶段加速但端到端仅1.54x。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法多为免训练即插即用方案，将性能下降视为压缩必然代价，转而追求更复杂的剪枝规则。作者质疑这一观点，提出两个问题：后训练能挽救多少损失？在此基础上联合压缩如何逼近剪枝极限？
AI.method: 构建282K样本的后训练混合数据集（覆盖通用VQA、推理、OCR、定位），在统一协议下后训练36种token丢弃/合并配置；并分析原生分辨率MLLM中各阶段耗时以研究联合压缩策略。
AI.result: 后训练可挽救大部分损失（包括OCR和定位），且预算越紧其适配增益越大。视觉编码器而非LLM主导prefill时间，因此"在哪剪"比"剪多少"更重要：编码器保留40% token比投影器仅保留10%更快。最佳配置将LLM阶段加速3.49x，但端到端首token时间仅加速1.54x。
AI.conclusion: LLM阶段加速会高估端到端收益；联合视觉token压缩应以编码器轻剪、投影器重剪、LLM不动为原则，为未来联合压缩研究提供指导。数据、协议与代码将开源。

title: Free to Look, Free to Reason: Simple LLM Harnesses Outdiagnose Hand-Crafted Root Cause Analysis Agents
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) of microservice failures has attracted many LLM agents whose investigation is hand-crafted, through standard operating procedures, fixed stages and role agents. Each is evaluated on its own data against few baselines, so it is unknown whether this design beats letting a capable model investigate on its own. We compare three simple harnesses that prescribe none of the model's calls (one call over an evidence package, a SQL agent and the Codex coding agent) with five published LLM RCA agents and with statistical and causal methods on RCAtlas, 90 validated cases from eight public datasets, across six models and three reasoning efforts. The simple harnesses are the most accurate (PR@1 65-77% on three mid-tier models), ahead of the published agents (16-53%) and the non-LLM methods (6-39%), on every model on which both families were run. The published agents fix from a tenth to all of their model calls in the program, and a case study shows how these prescriptions skip the decisive evidence. A stronger model mainly improves reliability, a multi-turn harness mainly improves aptitude, and more reasoning effort changes accuracy by a few points at most while multiplying the time by up to seven. Among runs more accurate than the best non-LLM method, every Pareto-optimal run in cost or time uses a simple harness.

AI.tldr: 在RCAtlas基准上，不预设模型调用流程的简单harness在微服务故障根因分析中显著优于已发表LLM RCA agent及非LLM方法，精度更高且成本更优。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM RCA agent多采用手工设计的固定调查流程（标准操作规程、固定阶段、角色agent），且各自在自有数据上少量基线评估，缺乏统一对比，无法判断这种设计是否真的优于让强模型自主调查。
AI.method: 构建RCAtlas基准（8个公开数据集共90个验证案例），在6个模型、3种推理强度下，对比三类不规定模型调用方式的简单harness（证据包单次调用、SQL agent、Codex编码agent）与5个已发表LLM RCA agent及统计/因果方法。
AI.result: 简单harness最准确（中等模型PR@1 65-77%），优于已发表agent（16-53%）和非LLM方法（6-39%）；已发表agent将1/10至全部模型调用固化于程序中，案例显示这些预设会跳过关键证据；更强模型主要提升可靠性，多轮harness主要提升能力，增加推理强度精度仅变动几个百分点却使时间最多增至7倍；在优于最佳非LLM方法的运行中，成本或时间Pareto最优者均使用简单harness。
AI.conclusion: 让强模型自主调查优于固化流程的RCA agent设计，简单harness在精度、成本与时间上均占优，提示应减少对模型调用流程的硬性规定。

title: Higher Reasoning Effort Improves Reference Verifiability and Changes Reasoning Summaries in GPT-5.5
summary: Large language models are increasingly being used in different stages of scientific knowledge production, including the suggestion of references. These models can operate at different levels of reasoning effort and provide summaries of their reasoning processes. This raises two questions: Does increasing reasoning effort improve the verifiability of generated references, and do the resulting reasoning summaries reveal how the model's behavior changes with greater effort? We examined summaries from GPT-5.5 as it generated scholarly references for 1,000 papers under paired low- and high-effort settings. Generated references were matched to external bibliographic records, and reasoning summaries were scored for four predefined features and explored for additional features discovered by GPT-5.5. High effort increased the mean paper-level resolver-verified reference rate from 78.3% to 84.8%, and produced longer reasoning summaries. All four predefined features received higher scores under high effort. The discovered features changed less uniformly: some appeared equally often in both conditions, whereas others were more common under high effort. Within each effort condition, neither feature set showed a consistent increase in verification rates with higher scores.

AI.tldr: 研究GPT-5.5在高/低推理努力下生成学术引用的可验证性，并分析其推理摘要中特征的变化。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益参与科学知识生产（含参考文献推荐），且可调节推理努力并输出推理摘要。由此产生两问：提高推理努力是否提升生成引用的可验证性？推理摘要能否揭示模型行为随努力程度的变化？
AI.method: 让GPT-5.5为1000篇论文在低/高推理努力配对设置下生成学术引用；将生成引用与外部书目记录匹配核验；对推理摘要按4个预设特征打分，并由GPT-5.5自行发现额外特征进行分析。
AI.result: 高努力使论文级解析器验证引用率均值从78.3%升至84.8%，推理摘要更长；4个预设特征得分均在高努力下更高；发现的特征变化不一致（部分相当，部分高努力下更常见）。但在各自努力条件内，两类特征均未呈现得分越高验证率越高的稳定趋势。
AI.conclusion: 提高推理努力可整体提升引用可验证性并改变推理摘要特征，但摘要特征得分与验证率之间缺乏一致的个体层面关联，提示推理摘要不宜作为可验证性的可靠代理指标。

title: MultiEvoSkill: Structure-Aware Multi-Agent Skill Evolution for Generalizable Skill Artifacts
summary: Skill documents are becoming the default adaptation surface for frozen large language model (LLM) agents, but current skill generators face two key limitations. First, humans and different LLMs differ in how they organize procedural knowledge and approach task solving. Skills authored from a human or single-model perspective may therefore fail to align with the reasoning behaviors of other backbones, limiting cross-model generalization. Second, sequential skill descriptions inadequately represent procedures with parallel branches and explicit dependencies, while existing skill optimizers primarily operate on prose and lack explicit support for graph-structured skill evolution. We introduce MultiEvoSkill, a skill-optimization framework comprising three core components: 1) Skill compiler casts the skill as a typed graph with tailored operators, producing a compact, informative representation with explicit procedural topology; 2) Heterogeneous agent system proposes revision advices using collective intelligence, where minimal and informative issues are identified based on multiple sets of experiences. 3) Structure-aware debate and evolution mechanism organizes candidate edits into a heterogeneous graph, resolves them under dependency and importance constraints, and distills the collective proposal into the artifact. Multi-dimensional gating ensures the information gain and topological correctness of each evolution. Optimal skills are then obtained when the system converges at a consistent state. Various experiments and ablations against SOTA methods validate the effectiveness and generalization of MultiEvoSkill.

AI.tldr: 提出MultiEvoSkill框架，将技能文档编译为类型化图，并用异构智能体集体智能与结构感知辩论机制演化技能，提升跨模型泛化与并行/依赖过程表达能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体技能生成器存在两点不足：1）人类与不同LLM组织程序性知识方式不同，单一视角编写的技能难以对齐其他骨干模型的推理行为，跨模型泛化差；2）顺序式技能描述难以刻画并行分支与显式依赖，现有优化器主要面向散文文本，缺乏对图结构技能演化的显式支持。
AI.method: 框架含三部分：1）技能编译器将技能转为带专用算子的类型化图，得到紧凑且具显式过程拓扑的表示；2）异构智能体系统基于多组经验、以集体智能提出最小且信息量充分的修改建议；3）结构感知的辩论与演化机制把候选编辑组织为异构图为单元，在依赖与重要性约束下求解，将集体提案蒸馏进技能工件，并以多维度门控保证信息增益与拓扑正确性，系统收敛至一致状态即得最优技能。
AI.result: 通过与SOTA方法的多种实验与消融，验证了MultiEvoSkill的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 图结构化技能表示结合多智能体集体演化与结构感知约束，是提升冻结LLM智能体技能跨模型泛化与复杂过程建模能力的有效途径。

title: Multitask Interactions in Recurrent Dynamics across 100 Cognitive Tasks
summary: The brain continually learns tasks with very different computational demands. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been used as dynamical surrogates for studying task solutions, with recent work extending this approach to joint training on multitask batteries. However, it remains unclear how tasks interact as these batteries grow in scale and heterogeneity: under what conditions do they transfer or interfere with one another, and how do these effects relate to task complexity and model structure? We study this question by simultaneously training hierarchical Almost-Linear RNNs (AL-RNNs) on 100 tasks spanning a wide range of cognitive demands. AL-RNNs allow us to vary the amount of nonlinearity in the recurrence, while hierarchical task features provide a low-dimensional interface for task-specific adaptation within shared dynamics. On this task battery, performance improves with both nonlinear capacity and task-feature dimensionality, with the joint hierarchical model outperforming both individually trained models and a single unstructured joint model. Many tasks are individually solvable with linear dynamics, yet cannot be solved together by a shared linear model. Through hierarchical task features, task-specific linear region usage, and task geometry, the trained model provides several related but distinct measures of task similarity that capture how computations are separated and combined within the shared backbone. Across a series of experiments, we relate these representations to individual task complexity, joint solvability, pairwise transfer learning, and leave-one-out adaptation. Together, our experiments characterize task interactions in multitask recurrent learning while demonstrating both the potential and the challenges of reusable dynamical backbones for cognitive computation.

AI.tldr: 该论文同时训练分层近线性RNN（AL-RNN）求解100个认知任务，研究多任务电池中任务之间的迁移与干扰，并将任务相似性表征与任务复杂度、联合可解性、成对迁移及留一适应联系起来。
AI.motivation: RNN作为动力系统代理被用于研究任务求解，并已扩展到多任务联合训练；但当任务电池规模与异质性增加时，任务间何时迁移、何时干扰，以及这些效应与任务复杂度和模型结构的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在100个覆盖广泛认知需求的任务上同时训练分层AL-RNN；通过AL-RNN调节循环中非线性程度，通过分层任务特征提供共享动力学内的低维任务适应接口。并基于任务特征、任务特定的线性区域使用和任务几何构造若干相关但不同的任务相似性度量。
AI.result: 性能随非线性容量和任务特征维度提升；联合分层模型优于单独训练的模型和单一无结构联合模型。许多任务单独用线性动力学可解，但共享线性模型无法同时求解。所构造的相似性度量可关联任务复杂度、联合可解性、成对迁移学习和留一适应。
AI.conclusion: 实验刻画了多任务循环学习中的任务交互，既展示了可复用动力学骨干用于认知计算的潜力，也揭示了其挑战。

title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027. Source code is available at https://github.com/nadunnr/PathKGen
summary: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.

AI.tldr: PathKGen 用病理知识图谱为多模态大模型注入外部结构化知识，生成可解释的病理报告。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 仅靠神经参数中的分布进行推理，受模型规模限制知识量有限，且黑箱推理难以人工理解中间过程；知识图谱在病理报告生成中尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出双分支框架：视觉路径用病理基础模型学习视觉 token 输入 MLLM；知识路径通过查询病理专用知识图谱提取 WSI 关键形态特征，生成知识 token 输入。
AI.result: 在 WSI-Bench 数据集上超越此前 SOTA，并将诊断推理呈现为可视化、直观的图结构。
AI.conclusion: 模块化设计使知识路径可与视觉对齐的 MLLM 互补，通过构建领域知识图谱可扩展到其他应用。

title: Synthetic linguistic data
summary: Synthetic linguistic data have become increasingly prominent in linguistic research, from the analysis of large collections of AI-generated texts to controlled experiments investigating grammatical and lexical preferences. This glossary entry extends Bresnan's (2016) distinction between the linguistic garden and the bush by introducing an artificial plant nursery as a metaphor for synthetic data. We distinguish between synthetic bush data, consisting primarily of corpus-like collections of model-generated language, and synthetic garden data, in which model outputs are elicited under controlled conditions to investigate specific linguistic hypotheses. We argue that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation: comparing them with natural language data can reveal both shared patterns and divergences, but their interpretation requires careful consideration of the conditions under which they are generated.

AI.tldr: 本文（术语表条目）将合成语言数据类比为"人工苗圃"，并区分"合成灌丛数据"（模型生成的大规模语料式文本）与"合成花园数据"（受控条件下诱导的模型输出），主张合成数据应被视为独立的研究对象，其解读需结合生成条件。
AI.motivation: 合成语言数据在语言学研究中日益重要（从大规模AI文本分析到受控语法/词汇偏好实验），但缺乏概念框架来界定其性质与使用方式，作者试图赋予其清晰术语。
AI.method: 概念/术语分析：在Bresnan(2016) "linguistic garden"与"bush"区分的基础上，引入"artificial plant nursery（人工苗圃）"作为合成数据的隐喻，并进一步划分合成灌丛数据（corpus-like模型生成集合）与合成花园数据（受控elicitation）。
AI.result: 提出一套术语与分类体系，指出合成数据是独立的语言学调查对象；与自然语言数据比较可揭示共性模式与分歧，但其解释须谨慎考虑生成条件。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据不应简单等同于自然语言数据，而应作为独立对象对待，其解读依赖对生成条件的明确认识。

title: Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents
summary: Language agents increasingly act through external tools and interactive environments, making the interface between the model and its executable capabilities part of the decision process. Model Context Protocol (MCP) and command-line interfaces (CLI) can expose the same semantic operations through markedly different model-facing representations. We study whether these representational differences change agent behavior when executable capabilities are matched. We introduce Matched Interface Comparison and Analysis (MICA), which renders MCP and CLI from a shared semantic action contract and routes decoded actions through the same runtime. Across six models and three interactive environments, matched interfaces produce substantial differences in task performance and interaction cost. These effects extend beyond surface validity to semantic action selection, failure pathways, and recovery. Matched-state probes localize sensitivity to capability presentation, realization, and feedback. Paired natural trajectories reveal structured divergence in 94.3% of 2,004 episodes and show that early differences propagate through subsequent interaction. This analysis identifies interface realization as a direct intervention boundary. We therefore introduce Decoupled Action Realization and Targeted Repair (DART), which preserves validated semantic commitments while repairing interface-specific realization. DART improves benchmark score in all six evaluated settings by up to 9.0 points and reduces MCP token cost in all three environments by up to 27.1k tokens per task. Together, these results establish interface representation as part of the closed-loop decision environment shaping agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文研究MCP与CLI两种接口表示在语义能力相同时是否改变智能体行为，提出MICA进行匹配对比分析，发现表示差异显著影响性能、成本、动作选择与恢复；进而提出DART，在保留语义承诺的前提下修复接口实现，六个设置中最高提升9.0分，MCP token消耗每任务最多减少27.1k。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体越来越多通过外部工具和交互环境行动，模型与可执行能力之间的接口本身已成为决策过程的一部分。MCP与CLI可暴露相同的语义操作，但面向模型的表示差异很大；作者想探究在可执行能力对齐的条件下，这种表示差异是否会系统性地改变智能体行为。
AI.method: 提出匹配接口比较与分析框架MICA：从共享的语义动作契约同时渲染MCP和CLI接口，并将解码出的动作路由到同一运行时，保证能力等价。在六个模型、三个交互环境中对比任务性能和交互成本；通过匹配状态探针定位对能力呈现、实现方式与反馈的敏感性；配对自然轨迹分析差异的传播。基于发现提出DART（解耦动作实现与定向修复），保留已验证的语义承诺，仅修复接口特定的实现。
AI.result: 匹配接口下任务性能和交互成本出现显著差异，且影响超出表层有效性，延伸到语义动作选择、失败路径与恢复行为。匹配状态探针定位出对能力呈现、实现与反馈的敏感性；2,004条配对轨迹中94.3%出现结构化分歧，早期差异会沿后续交互传播。DART在全部六个评估设置中提升基准分数，最高+9.0分，并在三个环境中均降低MCP token成本，每任务最多减少27.1k tokens。
AI.conclusion: 接口表示是闭环决策环境的一部分，构成直接可干预的边界；将语义动作与接口实现解耦并进行定向修复，可有效利用该边界提升性能并降低成本。

title: EnerGNN: Learning Optimization-Compatible Energy Functions for Exact Constrained Combinatorial Inference
summary: Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based models typically rely on approximate inference. We introduce EnerGNN, a framework that learns energy functions over complete binary configurations and minimizes them under explicit hard constraints through mixed integer programming (MIP). EnerGNN combines a graph neural network encoder with an optimization-compatible readout and a nonlinear energy head, enabling exact constrained inference over the learned energy. An optimality-aware contrastive loss trains the energy to reflect solution quality and constraint violations. Across Quadratic Knapsack, Combinatorial Auctions, and a personalized cell therapy supply chain problem, EnerGNN achieves near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility. On the supply chain problem, it achieves a 0.05% mean primal gap and a 17.4$\times$ speedup over the monolithic MIP. The learned energy also generalizes to larger instances and supports zero-shot constraint injection, adapting to changing constraints without retraining while preserving feasibility.

AI.tldr: EnerGNN 学习完整二进制配置上的能量函数，并用混合整数规划在显式硬约束下精确最小化，在多个组合优化问题上实现近优且100%可行的解。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的组合优化方法要么直接预测解、要么用预测限制搜索，而表达能力强的能量模型通常依赖近似推理，难以保证硬约束可行性与精确性。
AI.method: 将图神经网络编码器与优化兼容的读出层、非线性能量头结合，学习能量函数；推理时用 MIP 对能量做精确约束求解；并用最优性感知的对比损失使能量反映解的质量与约束违反情况。
AI.result: 在二次背包、组合拍卖和个性化细胞治疗供应链问题上取得近优解且100%可行；供应链问题平均原始间隙0.05%，相比单体MIP加速17.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 学到的能量可泛化到更大规模实例，并支持零样本约束注入，无需重训即可适应约束变化且保持可行性。

title: Scalable Unrolled Chains for MRI Reconstruction
comment: 23 pages (including supplementary material), 14 figures. Accepted at WACV 2027
summary: Unrolled variational networks achieve state-of-the-art performance for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but standard end-to-end training becomes prohibitively memory intensive as the number and width of cascades increase. We propose a memory-efficient training framework that updates a randomly sampled cascade while retaining supervision from the final reconstruction loss. The error signal is propagated from the end of the chain to the sampled cascade using an activation-light backward pass that avoids storing full chain activations, thereby decoupling training memory from chain length. A time-conditioned network shared across cascades further keeps the parameter count independent of chain length. The backward pass is approximate only through frozen normalization statistics, and a trained exact gradient control shows the approximation leaves reconstruction quality unchanged. The framework remains trainable at chain lengths and cascade widths where standard end-to-end backpropagation exhausts GPU memory. On fastMRI single-coil knee and multi-coil brain reconstruction, our method consistently outperforms other local training approaches. On high-SNR knee slices, our method surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and matches it at $4\times$, while on the complete brain validation set it surpasses E2E-VarNet at $8\times$ and achieves comparable performance at $4\times$, with fewer parameters, lower peak memory, and faster per-iteration training. Code is available at https://github.com/emehillaj/scalable-unrolled-mri.

AI.tldr: 一种内存高效的展开变分网络训练框架：随机采样单个级联回传最终重建误差，训练内存与链长解耦，在高加速倍数下超过E2E-VarNet。
AI.motivation: 展开变分网络在加速MRI重建中性能领先，但端到端训练的内存随级联数量与宽度增长而爆炸，限制了模型规模扩展。
AI.method: 随机采样一个级联进行更新，同时保留最终重建损失的监督；用"轻激活"反向传播将误差信号从链尾传到被采样级联，不存储整链激活，使内存与链长解耦；采用跨级联共享的时间条件网络使参数量与链长无关；反向传播仅在冻结归一化统计量处做近似，并用精确梯度对照验证。
AI.result: 在标准端到端反传显存耗尽的链长与级联宽度下仍可训练；在fastMRI单线圈膝部与多线圈脑部重建中一致优于其他局部训练方法；高SNR膝部8×超过E2E-VarNet、4×持平，完整脑验证集8×超过、4×相当，且参数更少、峰值内存更低、每轮训练更快。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以近似但经验证无损的梯度实现了可扩展的展开MRI重建训练，在内存、参数与速度上占优，为大规模展开网络训练提供可行方案。

title: CTXAgent - Self-Controlled Context Management of LLM Agents
summary: Agent harnesses keep long sessions inside the context window by compacting the history when a token threshold is crossed. We study an alternative in which the model manages its own context: it decides when to compact, what to keep and what to write as the hand-off, given two tools and one paragraph of guidance. Since earlier work found that open-weight models cannot manage their own context without scaffolding, we compare seven frontier models under identical conditions, with and without the context tools, on token cost and benchmark score, and we compare our harness with three widely used harnesses on two of these models. The benchmark is assembled from existing ones: coding exercises, multi-step SciCode problems and SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 4.0 tasks are interleaved with planted facts, ephemeral observations and standing instructions, all checked deterministically, in sessions of 35-212 turns that resemble a user working through different tasks in one chat. Most of the strongest models manage their context: they compact and curate regularly, the live context of the mixed sessions stays mostly below 100k tokens, and their benchmark scores mostly do not drop significantly. For the models that manage their context well, the cost reduction is substantial but varies between models, because some models compact so often that other costs increase. With Claude Opus 5.5, the self-managed harness matches Claude Code on task success at 34% lower cost than its explicit 200k-window configuration and 49% lower than its default, with no context window to choose. We release the agent, the benchmark and all result rows.

AI.tldr: 研究让模型自行管理上下文（何时压缩、保留什么、如何写交接）的"自管理harness"，在7个前沿模型、混合任务长会话基准上对比有无上下文工具的成本与得分，并与3个常用harness对比；发现强模型大多能自管理且任务分不显著下降，成本大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 现有agent harness在token超阈值时才被动压缩历史；而早期工作认为开放权重模型无法在无脚手架下自管理上下文。作者想在相同条件下检验前沿模型能否自主管理上下文，以获得更低成本而不损失性能。
AI.method: 给模型两个上下文工具和一段指导，让其自主决定压缩时机与保留内容。自建基准：编码练习、多步SciCode、SWE-bench Pro与Terminal-Bench 4.0任务，混入植入事实、短时观察和常驻指令，全部确定性校验，会话35-212轮。对比7个前沿模型有无工具条件的token成本与得分，并在2个模型上与3个常用harness比较。
AI.result: 多数最强模型能定期压缩与策展，混合会话的活跃上下文多维持在100k token以下，基准分大多不显著下降；管理良好的模型成本显著下降但因模型而异（部分压缩过频导致其他成本上升）。Claude Opus 5.5上，自管理harness与Claude Code任务成功率相当，成本比其显式200k窗口配置低34%、比默认低49%，且无需选择上下文窗口。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型可自主管理上下文，在不损失任务表现的前提下显著降本，提供无需手动设定窗口的实用替代方案；作者开源agent、基准与全部结果。

title: Stable and Calibrated Latent Force ODE Filters
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures. Code available at https://github.com/paufisch/lfcal
summary: Estimating unobserved forces in mechanistic systems is a central task of scientific machine learning. Approximate Gaussian filtering methods that synthesize mechanistic and empirical information have shown remarkable capacity in jointly identifying latent processes together with the system state in a single forward-backward pass. The resulting latent force ODE filter framework channels information from observational data specifically into the unknown parts of the system. This work addresses open questions about calibration and stability of the method. We show that the joint posterior over state and force is the reweighted conventional latent force posterior. This uncovers a crucial dependence of the stability of the method on the prior variance of the system state, which effectively controls the flow of information from observations to the latent force through the mechanistic system. From this insight, we construct an improved algorithm that provides stable and calibrated plug-and-play inference. We demonstrate the improved framework on several simulated experimental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了潜隐力ODE滤波框架的校准性与稳定性问题，证明状态与力的联合后验是对传统潜隐力后验的重加权，揭示稳定性对系统状态先验方差的依赖，并提出改进的稳定、校准的即插即用推断算法。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习中估计机理系统内的未观测力是核心任务。近似高斯滤波方法能在单次前向-后向传递中联合识别潜隐过程与系统状态，但该潜隐力ODE滤波框架的校准性与稳定性仍属开放问题，需要理论解释与改进。
AI.method: 从理论分析入手，将状态与力的联合后验刻画为传统潜隐力后验的重加权形式，据此发现方法稳定性关键取决于系统状态的先验方差——它控制观测信息经机理系统流向潜隐力的通道。基于此洞见构造改进算法。
AI.result: 提出改进后的算法，实现稳定且校准的即插即用推断，并在多个模拟实验设置下验证了框架性能。
AI.conclusion: 联合后验的重加权解读为稳定性与校准问题提供了理论依据，系统状态先验方差是可控的关键旋钮，改进算法在模拟实验中表现稳定且校准良好。

title: E3tereo: Improving Stereo Matching at Depth Boundaries with Learned Geometric Edges
summary: Depth boundaries remain a major source of error in stereo matching. For IGEV on Scene Flow, geometric edge pixels account for only 6% of evaluated pixels but about half of the total absolute disparity error. Photometric edges can respond to texture changes without corresponding depth discontinuities, making them unreliable cues for boundary refinement. We propose E3Stereo, which learns geometric edges from disparity supervision and combines these boundary cues with the backbone disparity and image details to predict full-resolution disparity corrections. The same edge map also emphasizes boundary errors during training, while joint optimization allows the edge predictor to adapt to disparity refinement. On the Scene Flow dataset, E3Stereo reduces end-point error (EPE) at depth boundaries by 9.5%-14.3% across RAFT-Stereo, IGEV, and MonSter, while also reducing overall EPE. After fine-tuning, our IGEV-based model improves upon IGEV on all eleven reported metrics across ETH3D, KITTI 2012, and KITTI 2015. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 深度学习立体匹配中深度边界是主要误差来源（几何边缘像素仅占6%却贡献约一半误差）。作者提出E3Stereo：从视差监督学习几何边缘，融合骨干视差、图像细节预测全分辨率视差修正，并用同一边缘图在训练中加权边界误差。Scene Flow上边界EPE降9.5%–14.3%，微调后在ETH3D、KITTI 2012/2015共11项指标全面优于IGEV。
AI.motivation: 深度边界是立体匹配误差的主要来源：以IGEV在Scene Flow为例，几何边缘像素仅占评测像素的6%，却贡献约一半的绝对视差误差。而光度边缘会因纹理变化而被触发，未必对应深度不连续，因此作为边界细化线索并不可靠。
AI.method: 提出E3Stereo：1）在视差监督下学习几何边缘，而非依赖光度边缘；2）将该几何边缘线索与骨干网络视差、图像细节结合，预测全分辨率视差修正；3）同一边缘图在训练时用于加重边界误差；4）边缘预测器与视差细化联合优化，使边缘预测器适应细化任务。可嵌入RAFT-Stereo、IGEV、MonSter等骨干。
AI.result: Scene Flow上，边界EPE在RAFT-Stereo、IGEV、MonSter上降低9.5%–14.3%，整体EPE也下降。微调后基于IGEV的模型在ETH3D、KITTI 2012、KITTI 2015共11项报告指标上全面优于IGEV。
AI.conclusion: 用视差监督学习几何边缘并联合优化视差细化，是一种通用有效的边界误差抑制方案，可跨骨干网络即插即用；代码将在录用后公开。

title: A Russian, a Brazilian, and a German Walk into a Bar, Ask the Same Question-- And Get Three Different Answers: Profiling LLM Perspective Diversity on Contested Topics
summary: Large Language Models(LLMs) have shown strong performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but many real-world queries involve subjectivity, disagreement, and conflicting evidence. Most existing benchmarks for such queries remain English-centric, overlooking the vast diversity of perspectives held by users worldwide. To systematically study how LLM perspectives vary across languages, we curate PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset of globally contested topics covering 18 languages, and propose ROOTS, a framework that profiles linguistic, perspective, and framing diversity. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models covering both open-source and proprietary families at varying scales, establishing that LLMs hedge their answers in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages. Larger models maintain a more consistent cross-lingual worldview, while smaller models are more easily swayed. All models also exhibit high sensitivity to minor surface-level input variations, producing notable stance even in larger models.

AI.tldr: 本文构建多语言主观争议话题数据集PerspectivesQA（18种语言）并提出ROOTS框架评估LLM视角多样性，发现模型在英语中倾向含糊其辞、在低资源语言中却明确站队，大模型跨语言世界观更一致，且所有模型对输入表层扰动高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有针对主观性、分歧与冲突证据类问题的基准以英语为中心，忽视全球用户视角的多样性，缺乏系统研究LLM观点如何随语言变化的手段。
AI.method: 人工校验构建覆盖18种语言、全球争议话题的多语言数据集PerspectivesQA；提出ROOTS框架，从语言多样性、视角多样性、框架（措辞）多样性三个维度刻画模型表现；评测8个开源与闭源、不同规模模型。
AI.result: LLM在英语中倾向对冲/含糊表态，在低资源语言中则明确采取立场；大模型跨语言世界观更一致，小模型更易被左右；所有模型对细微的表面输入变化高度敏感，即便大模型也会产生明显立场。
AI.conclusion: 主观性问题的多语言对齐存在系统性缺口，语言资源水平与措辞扰动会显著改变模型立场，需在多语言、多视角与稳健性方面改进评测与训练。

title: From Outranking Flow Scores to Linear Programs: Group Decision Making in PROMETHEE II
comment: 15 pages; 1 figure; to be published in Algorithmic Decision Theory, 9th International Conference, ADT 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science
summary: We study inverse and consensus analysis for PROMETHEE II ranking problems when the performance table is fixed. Existing approaches in PROMETHEE-based sensitivity and consensus analysis usually focus on deviations of criteria weights while treating preference functions as fixed. Nevertheless both sets of parameters jointly determine the outranking flow scores. We introduce a linear reparametrization of the PROMETHEE II net flow scores based on weighted preference increments over the observed differences of performances. This representation yields a linear expression of the net flows and clarifies how weights and preference functions interact. Building on this result, we derive linear optimization models for three settings: minimizing weight deviations while allowing preference functions to vary; minimizing deviations over the full set of preference parameters; and multiple decision-maker consensus analysis (with objectives based either on total deviation or on the maximal individual deviation to promote fairness). An illustrative example shows that allowing preference functions to vary can dramatically change the inverse-analysis conclusions obtained from weight-only models, and that the proposed group formulations distinguish efficient consensuses from fairer ones.

AI.tldr: 该文提出PROMETHEE II净流的线性重参数化，将权重与偏好函数整合为线性模型，用于逆分析与群体共识分析。
AI.motivation: 现有PROMETHEE敏感性/共识分析多只调整准则权重而固定偏好函数，但净流分数实际由权重与偏好函数共同决定，仅调权重的结论可能失真。
AI.method: 基于观测性能差上的加权偏好增量，对PROMETHEE II净流分数进行线性重参数化，得到净流的线性表达式，并据此构建线性优化模型：1)最小化权重偏差且允许偏好函数变动；2)在全偏好参数集上最小化偏差；3)多决策者共识分析（目标为总偏差或最大个体偏差以体现公平）。
AI.result: 示例表明允许偏好函数变动会显著改变仅权重逆分析的结论；群体模型能区分有效共识与更公平的共识。
AI.conclusion: 将权重与偏好函数统一处理可提升PROMETHEE II逆分析与共识分析的正确性与灵活性，线性形式使优化求解更便捷。

title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
summary: Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful prior knowledge. It is essential for agents learning over long time horizons, yet current evaluations largely assess individual task performance rather than improvement through accumulated experience. We introduce Continual Learning Exam (CLE), a large-scale benchmark developed by 50+ domain experts to measure experience-driven improvement in realistic professional workflows. CLE comprises 120 human-authored tasks, each organised as a five-level ladder, yielding 600 levels spanning 89 professional roles across 12 occupational domains. Agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with later levels building on experience accumulated during earlier assignments. An evaluation agent assesses each submission against human-authored rubrics. We compare a single-submission setting with one that provides diagnostic feedback after failure and allows one revision. Across 17 harness-model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs. As such, the dataset can also be used to post-train LLMs to strengthen their continual learning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出CLE基准（120任务×5级=600级，覆盖89职位12领域），用于衡量LLM智能体基于经验持续改进的能力；最强系统仅通过47.7%关卡、23.3%任务全通关。
AI.motivation: 现有评测只考察单任务表现，未衡量智能体能否从积累的经验中获得提升，而这对长时程学习至关重要。
AI.method: 由50+领域专家构建120个人工撰写任务，每个任务为五级递进阶梯（需逐级通过，后级依赖前级经验），共600级，覆盖12职业领域89个职位；由评估智能体依据人工撰写的评分标准评分；对比"单次提交"与"失败后给诊断反馈并允许一次修改"两种设置，测试17种harness-模型配置的前沿LLM。
AI.result: 反馈与修订带来中位数5.3个百分点的完成率提升；但最佳系统仅通过47.7%的关卡，且只在23.3%的任务中通关全部五级。
AI.conclusion: 现有前沿LLM的持续学习能力仍很有限；CLE也可用于后训练以强化模型的持续学习能力。

title: Traffic-Context-Aware Driver Emotion Recognition with Expectation-Deviation-Driven Inference
summary: Driver emotion provides an important indication of how drivers perceive and evaluate ongoing traffic situations, making reliable emotion recognition an important capability for effective human-vehicle interaction. Yet, most existing driver emotion recognition approaches rely primarily on in-cabin images and overlook how surrounding traffic interactions shape driver emotional responses. To address this limitation, we propose a traffic-context-aware driver emotion recognition (TADER) framework that integrates in-cabin signals with out-of-cabin traffic scenarios, modeling driver emotions as arising from expectation deviation represented by the discrepancy between predicted and observed vehicle trajectories. The proposed framework comprises two key components: (1) a vision-based base recognizer that extracts spatiotemporal representations from in-cabin facial images to infer driver emotions, and (2) a traffic-context-aware fusion module that quantifies expectation deviation from external traffic scenarios and integrates it into the base recognizer via attention-based embedding fusion. To overcome the scarcity of paired in-cabin and out-of-cabin data, we introduce a transfer learning strategy that transfers a trajectory prediction model trained on large-scale naturalistic datasets to smaller paired datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TADER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across both naturalistic and simulated driving environments by incorporating traffic context information into emotion recognition, resulting in improvements of 5% in accuracy on the AIDE and manD datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出交通情境感知的驾驶员情绪识别框架TADER，将车内面部图像与车外交通场景结合，以"预测-观测轨迹偏差"刻画期望违背，并借迁移学习缓解配对数据稀缺，在AIDE与manD上准确率提升约5%。
AI.motivation: 驾驶员情绪反映其对交通情境的感知与评估，但现有方法主要依赖车内图像，忽略了外部交通交互对情绪的影响。
AI.method: TADER含两部分：(1)视觉基础识别器，从车内面部图像提取时空表征推断情绪；(2)交通情境感知融合模块，从外部场景量化期望偏差（预测与观测车辆轨迹差异），经注意力式嵌入融合注入基础识别器。另提出迁移学习策略，将大规模自然驾驶数据上训练的轨迹预测模型迁移到小规模配对数据集。
AI.result: 在自然驾驶与模拟驾驶环境中均稳定优于SOTA，AIDE和manD数据集准确率提升约5%。
AI.conclusion: 引入外部交通情境信息可有效提升驾驶员情绪识别性能，轨迹偏差是刻画情绪成因的有效信号，迁移学习可缓解配对数据稀缺问题。

title: Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

AI.tldr: 该论文对大型语言模型（LLM）的发展进行了系统的分类与梳理，从早期 BERT 到 GPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok，涵盖训练数据集、算力、硬件规格、架构与参数，并以时间线呈现 LLM 的演进及局限。
AI.motivation: LLM 研究已大量涌现，但对其系统性、完整性的分类（taxonomy）工作仍较为有限，缺少对模型演化脉络、训练资源与架构参数的整合性梳理。
AI.method: 采用文献综述与分类学方法，围绕时间线梳理代表性模型，对比其训练数据、计算资源、硬件规格、架构设计与参数量，并归纳局限性、计算挑战与开放问题。
AI.result: 发现明确规律：在架构复杂度与数据质量之间取得较优比率的模型，表现出更强、更稳定的推理能力与更好的对齐效果，且并未按比例增加计算开销。
AI.conclusion: "扩展性与可持续性之间的平衡"是当前一代 AI 的核心特征，也是未来 LLM 发展的关键方向。

title: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
summary: Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only cost-inefficient but also offers no guarantee of the best instance-level performance. A simple alternative, starting at the lowest effort and escalating only after a verified failure, matches or improves on fixed top effort across all models and benchmarks at lower cost for most proprietary models.

AI.tldr: 推理努力(reasoning effort)是一种"信任品"：用户看到结果却无法评估所付算力的边际价值。论文在闭源与开源模型、四个基准（单次推理+长程智能体任务）上测量努力水平的反事实效应，发现更高努力常解决不了低努力已解决的任务、在简单任务上开销可高达42倍、并改变轨迹行为（更多自我验证与搜索）；简单的"从最低努力开始、验证失败后再升级"策略可在更低成本下匹配或超过固定最高努力。
AI.motivation: 生成模型的"努力/H"设置让用户以更高成本换取潜在更好表现，但用户须在不知是否有帮助前选择档位，且成功也看不出多付的算力是否必要——努力因而是信任品（credence good），缺少对其边际价值的实证度量。
AI.method: 对专有与开放权重模型，在四个基准（涵盖单次调用推理与长程智能体任务）上做固定努力水平与反事实对比，量化：准确率、易任务上的token/成本开销、以及轨迹行为（自我验证 vs. 直接求解、搜索频率）。
AI.result: 1) 更高努力虽能提升总体准确率，但经常在低努力已解决的任务上失败（不保持）；2) 在所有努力都解决的简单任务上，最高努力成本可达最低努力的42倍；3) 努力改变的不只是token量，还有求解方式：更高努力下更多自我验证与搜索，拉长轨迹却未必改变结果。
AI.conclusion: 盲目选最高努力既不经济也不保证实例级最优。替代方案——从最低努力起步、仅在验证失败后升级——在所有模型与基准上以更低成本（多数专有模型）匹配或超越固定最高努力。

title: QECGBERT: A Scalable ECG Foundation Model Based on Self-Supervised Language Learning via VQ-VAE Waveform Tokenization
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: AI foundation models play a pivotal role in advancing heart disease diagnosis from electrocardiogram (ECG) data, particularly for rare diseases where the lack of sufficient labeled data hinders supervised learning. However, most self-supervised learning methods treat ECGs as generic sequence or image data without exploiting underlying physiological structure. To address this limitation, we propose QECGBERT, a self-supervised ECG language model that explicitly encodes physiological semantics by tokenizing the P, QRS, T, and isoelectric background waveforms. Vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) tokenization is applied to each 12-lead ECG, with tokens enriched by continuous waveform features to preserve morphology lost during quantization without increasing sequence length. This design enables compact BERT masked language modeling with short sequences, improving scalability and reducing computational cost relative to long-sequence approaches. QECGBERT applies BERT pre-training to the MIMIC-IV dataset containing over 800,000 unlabeled ECG recordings, and fine-tuning on labeled PTB-XL, CPSC2018, and Chapman--Shaoxing--Ningbo datasets for evaluation. The results demonstrate that QECGBERT achieves comparable or superior performance to published benchmarks, offering a scalable, physiologically aware approach to ECG foundation modeling for cardiac diagnosis.

AI.tldr: QECGBERT 是一个基于生理语义分词的自监督 ECG 基础模型，在 MIMIC-IV 上预训练，并在多个数据集上取得可比或更优的诊断性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督 ECG 方法把心电当作普通序列或图像处理，忽略了 P、QRS、T 波等生理结构信息；同时罕见病缺乏标注数据，监督学习困难。
AI.method: 对 12 导联 ECG 的 P 波、QRS 波群、T 波及等电位背景分段，用 VQ-VAE 进行 tokenization，并用连续波形特征增强 token 以保留量化中丢失的形态信息（不增加序列长度）；随后进行短序列 BERT 掩码语言建模，在逾 80 万条 MIMIC-IV 未标注 ECG 上预训练，再在 PTB-XL、CPSC2018、Chapman–Shaoxing–Ningbo 上微调。
AI.result: 在三个下游数据集上达到与已发表基准相当或更优的性能，同时短序列设计提升可扩展性并降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: QECGBERT 提供了一种可扩展、具备生理感知能力的 ECG 基础建模方案，适用于心脏疾病诊断。

title: A SegFormer-based model for spatial Daylight Factor prediction with comprehensive obstruction encoding and regulatory validation
comment: Conference: BuildSim Nordic 2026 15 pages, Appendices A, B, C 9 figures, 8 tables
summary: Daylight compliance assessment in residential buildings requires time-consuming raytracing simulations and specialist model preparation, limiting its integration into iterative architectural design. We present a machine learning-based methodology for predicting the spatial distribution of the Daylight Factor (DF) directly within Building Information Modelling (BIM) environments, delivering results in seconds without model export or manual curation. The approach addresses five gaps not jointly covered by any existing model: external obstruction encoding including balconies, own building height, variable material reflectances, non-orthogonal room geometries, and regulatory validation. Two models are developed: a default-materials model with fixed reflectances for preliminary design checks, and a custom-materials model with variable project-specific reflectances. Both are trained on about 20,000 synthetic Radiance-simulated rooms and validated on a held-out synthetic dataset and 102 rooms from 18 real building models. The default-materials model achieves $δ_1$ = 83.4% and MAE = 0.11% DF on synthetic data, and on real buildings predicts BBR (Swedish) compliance area within 4.85 pp MAE (bias +2.31 pp) and TEK17 (Norwegian) mean room DF within 0.304% DF MAE (bias +0.287% DF). The custom-materials variant shows 1.7-2.4$\times$ higher error across all metrics. Both models concentrate accuracy in the BBR compliance-critical zone (DF < 1%), achieving a sub-1% DF MAE of 0.105% DF and Compliance IoU of 0.883 on real buildings. All cases where compliance is overestimated are borderline, within 10.7 pp of the BBR threshold (median 3.2 pp) and 0.36% DF of the TEK17 threshold (median 0.10% DF). The default-materials model is recommended as a replacement for preliminary daylight simulations; the custom-materials variant requires further development before use in final compliance verification.
