AI.tldr: 该文提出一种在BIM环境中直接预测采光系数(DF)空间分布的机器学习方法，可在数秒内完成、无需导出或手工整理模型。基于约2万间Radiance模拟房间训练的两个模型（默认材质版与自定义材质版），在18栋真实建筑的102个房间上验证，默认材质模型对瑞典BBR合规面积预测MAE为4.85pp，对挪威TEK17房间平均DF预测MAE为0.304% DF。
AI.motivation: 住宅采光合规评估依赖耗时的光线追踪仿真与专家级模型准备，难以融入迭代式建筑设计流程。现有模型未能同时覆盖五类关键因素：外部遮挡编码（含阳台）、自身建筑高度、变化的材料反射率、非正交房间几何，以及法规验证。
AI.method: 构建机器学习代理模型，在BIM环境内直接预测DF空间分布，无需模型导出或人工整理。开发两个模型：固定反射率的"默认材质"模型（用于初步设计核查）与可变项目专属反射率的"自定义材质"模型。均在约2万个Radiance合成的房间上训练，并在留出合成数据集及18个真实建筑模型的102个房间上验证。
AI.result: 默认材质模型在合成数据上δ₁=83.4%、MAE=0.11% DF；真实建筑上BBR合规面积MAE 4.85pp（偏差+2.31pp），TEK17房间平均DF MAE 0.304% DF（偏差+0.287% DF）。自定义材质变体误差为1.7–2.4倍。两模型精度集中于BBR合规关键区（DF<1%），真实建筑上DF<1%范围MAE为0.105% DF、合规IoU 0.883。所有高估合规的案例均属临界情形（距BBR阈值≤10.7pp、中位3.2pp；距TEK17阈值≤0.36% DF、中位0.10% DF）。
AI.conclusion: 默认材质模型可推荐替代初步采光仿真；自定义材质变体误差较大，需进一步开发后方可用于最终合规核验。所有高估均为临界案例，风险可控。

title: CaliMem: Search-Efficient Data Agent via Calibrated Memory
summary:
Data curation is a first-order design choice in machine learning, yet tailoring training data to a downstream model and task remains costly in labor, expertise, and compute. Datasets are therefore often processed through fixed pipelines and reused across applications. We show that this assumption is fragile: across 55 dataset--model tasks spanning biological domains, the same curation recipe can help one model while hurting another. Effective curation must adapt to the downstream setting, motivating automated search over data recipes. We first build an agentic system that searches for curation policies at deployment, improving data utility via \textit{test-time curation (TTC)}. Although achieving performance gains, its search is driven largely by recent feedback and remains local. Adding persistent memory helps the agent retain evidence across iterations and reveals a deeper problem: it forms claims that extend beyond the conditions in which they were observed, sometimes abandoning an entire strategy after a single unsuccessful trial.
  To address this problem, we introduce CaliMem, a calibrated-memory agentic loop that requires the agent to predict the outcome of each proposed policy before executing it. Comparing this prediction with the observed result gives the agent a \textit{reality check} on the claims behind its proposal. It uses the prediction error to retain supported claims, revise mistaken ones, and specify the conditions under which a conclusion holds. This makes the agent's beliefs testable, reduces overgeneralization, and supports more effective long-horizon exploration. Across biological and LLM post-training tasks, CaliMem consistently outperforms fixed curation baselines and published methods, and exceeds full-data training by up to 19.4\%. Code is open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 提出 CaliMem：一个"校准记忆"的智能体式数据策展循环，要求智能体在执行每条策展策略前先预测结果，用预测误差做"现实检验"，从而保留有证据支持的结论、修正错误结论并明确结论成立的边界条件，减少过度泛化。
AI.motivation: 数据策展是机器学习中的一阶设计选择，但为特定下游模型和任务定制训练数据在人力、专业知识和算力上都很昂贵，因此数据集常被固定流水线处理并跨应用复用。作者在跨生物领域的 55 个数据集-模型任务上表明这一假设是脆弱的：同一策展配方可能帮助一个模型却伤害另一个，有效策展必须适配下游场景，需要自动化搜索数据配方。
AI.method: 先构建一个在部署时搜索策展策略的智能体系统，通过测试时策展（TTC）提升数据效用；但发现其搜索主要依赖近期反馈、较为局部。加入持久记忆后暴露更深问题：智能体会形成超出观测条件的结论，甚至因一次失败试验就放弃整个策略。为此提出 CaliMem——校准式记忆智能体循环：让智能体在执行每条候选策略前预测其结果，将预测与实测比较作为对所依据主张的"现实检验"，并利用预测误差保留有支持的主张、修正错误主张、注明结论成立的条件。
AI.result: 在生物领域和 LLM 后训练任务上，CaliMem 稳定优于固定策展基线和已发表方法，相对全量数据训练最高提升 19.4%。
AI.conclusion: 固定策展流水线可跨任务复用的假设不成立，策展需自适应下游场景；通过预测-验证的校准记忆机制使智能体信念可检验、减少过度泛化，并支持更有效的长程探索，代码已开源。

title: Performance of Neural Operator Baselines on 'The Well' Dataset
summary: The Well, a 15-terabyte dataset spanning 16 physical simulation domains, provides an extensive benchmark for developing and evaluating machine learning surrogate models for complex physical systems. The baselines released with the benchmark were presented by their authors as illustrative examples obtained at small computational cost, trained with zero to very limited hyperparameter tuning and under a highly constraining 12-hour per-run wall-clock limit. These results have subsequently been treated as fully tuned benchmarks, and in some cases effectively interpreted as unconstrained performance baselines. We perform a short non-exhaustive hyperparameter search for the Tucker-factorized Fourier Neural Operator (TFNO) under the same 12-hour per-run wall-clock limit, while using only a single input timestep rather than the history of up to four used by the published baselines. Despite this more restrictive setup, tuning alone reduces VRMSE below both published FNO and TFNO baselines on 15 of 17 tasks, sometimes by several orders of magnitude. This sensitivity to a modest tuning effort underscores that the released neural operator baselines should not be treated as architectural benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 对TFNO做简短超参数搜索即可在17个任务中的15个上大幅超越已发布基线，说明The Well的神经算子基线不应被当作架构基准。
AI.motivation: The Well基准发布的神经算子基线本是低算力、几乎无调参的示例，却被后续研究当作充分调优甚至无约束的性能基准，作者质疑其可比性与公平性。
AI.method: 在相同的12小时单次运行时限下，对Tucker分解的傅里叶神经算子(TFNO)进行非穷尽式超参数搜索，且仅使用单个输入时间步而非基线所用的最多四个历史步。
AI.result: 在更受限的设置下，仅靠调参即在17个任务中的15个将VRMSE降至已发布FNO与TFNO基线之下，部分任务提升达数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 已发布的神经算子基线对调参高度敏感，不应被视为架构层面的性能基准，需重新审视基于此类基线的比较结论。

title: Computer Vision Navigation for an Autonomous Vehicle Model Using Reinforcement Learning
summary:
This work aims to assess the capabilities of the reinforcement learning algorithm, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), in developing a policy capable of controlling the speed and steering angle of a vehicle model to navigate within simulated road lines.
  The control system's input is a camera, and its outputs are the rotational speed of the rear wheels and the steering angle of the front wheels, controlling the vehicle's speed and direction, respectively. The algorithm is trained and tested in a simulated environment, where it receives image frames from the vehicle's camera, processes them through a feature extraction algorithm, and feeds them into the policy. For each frame, the policy outputs speed and direction commands for the vehicle. The policy is iteratively updated to enhance its performance.
  The reinforcement learning algorithm successfully generates a policy capable of navigating the vehicle in a simplified environment. Potential improvements are suggested to enhance the system's robustness in more complex scenarios.
  Creating a simulation environment suitable for testing an advanced reinforcement learning algorithm is a complex task. This project offers a framework for other developers to test different approaches and algorithms. The tested algorithm, PPO, uses proximity intervals - an innovative approach in reinforcement learning. In some scenarios, the algorithm achieved better performance than predecessor algorithms, which are typically harder to implement and require tuning more hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用PPO强化学习算法，在仿真环境中训练一个基于摄像头输入的车辆控制策略，实现沿车道线的速度与转向控制，并提供一个可供他人复用测试的仿真框架。
AI.motivation: 作者希望验证PPO这类强化学习算法能否胜任自动驾驶中的车道保持控制任务（速度与转向），同时指出搭建用于测试先进强化学习算法的仿真环境本身复杂且缺乏现成框架，因此也想为其他开发者提供可复用的测试平台。
AI.method: 构建仿真驾驶环境，以车载摄像头图像为输入，经特征提取模块处理后送入策略网络；策略网络输出后轮转速与前轮转向角，分别控制车速与方向；采用PPO算法逐帧迭代更新策略以提升性能。作者还强调PPO的"近端裁剪区间"机制是强化学习中的创新点。
AI.result: 强化学习成功训练出能够在简化仿真环境中完成车道行驶的策略；在某些场景下PPO表现优于前代算法，而这些前代算法通常实现更难、需要调节的超参数更多。作者也指出在更复杂场景下系统鲁棒性仍有待提升，并给出改进建议。
AI.conclusion: PPO结合端到端图像输入可有效实现简化环境下的车辆速度与转向控制；本项目的核心价值在于提供一套可复用的仿真测试框架，便于后续研究者对比不同算法与方法，但向复杂真实场景推广仍需进一步改进。

title: CoLink: Global Compression and Knowledge Linking for Multi-Turn Dialogue Modeling
summary: Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. Guided by the adaptive control of thought, it then retrieves and activates knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology. Crucially, to achieve effective compression of history and knowledge, we ground multi-turn dialogues in information theory and derive a principled optimization objective for extracting the core sense-making information. Coupled with a competitive slot mechanism, CoLink condenses the global context into dedicated memory and knowledge slots, efficiently distilling lengthy, redundant inputs into an extremely compact latent representation. Extensive empirical results on both public and our MMD datasets validate CoLink's superiority and generalizability in knowledge linking and sense modeling.

AI.tldr: CoLink 通过主题图聚类与信息论驱动的压缩，将长程多轮对话的全局上下文蒸馏为紧凑的潜在记忆/知识槽，提升 LLM 的全局感知与知识链接能力。
AI.motivation: 长对话历史中显著信息提取困难：LLM 上下文窗口受限、检索效率低；现有方法依赖历史组织或局部 token 级优化，存在信息丢失、检索冗余和短视注意力问题。
AI.method: 受认知科学"对话即意义建构与记忆联想"启发，先将历史上下文聚类为主题图，与外部知识建立跨语义关联；在"思维自适应控制"引导下，结合语义相关性与图结构拓扑检索激活知识；基于信息论为多轮对话建立原理性优化目标以提取核心意义信息，并配合竞争槽机制，将全局上下文压缩为专用记忆槽与知识槽的极紧凑潜在表示。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和自建 MMD 数据集上的大量实验验证了 CoLink 在知识链接与意义建模上的优越性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 将信息链接与有原理依据的压缩相结合，是提升 LLM 领域特定多轮对话全局上下文感知的有效途径。

title: How Humans Learn Unfamiliar Worlds: A Think-Aloud Dataset on ARC-AGI-3
summary: Learning through exploration and using newly acquired knowledge to achieve goals are central capabilities of general intelligence. Understanding these capabilities requires tracing how learners build, use, and revise world models during interaction. We construct the first dataset that records how humans discover and use the mechanisms of novel environments, using ARC-AGI-3 as a testbed: 144 trajectories from 64 participants across 25 public games, each pairing time-synchronized actions with think-aloud audio, plus 250 trajectories from large language model (LLM) agents with and without harnesses on the same games. We annotate mechanism triggers and recognition, action purposes, and errors and recovery, linking changes in understanding to the observations and actions that support them. We analyze characteristics of human cognition and compare them with those of LLM agents. Both groups anticipate mechanisms and use familiar analogies. Qualitative representations are more common in successful human trajectories than in successful LLM trajectories (50.0% versus 14.3%). Humans more often explore unfamiliar situations without a concrete hypothesis, while hypothesis testing is common in both groups. We also trace how learners recover through belief revision, replanning, and execution correction. As LLMs with well-designed harnesses reach saturated performance on public ARC-AGI-3 games, our cognitive analyses motivate next-generation benchmarks that challenge familiar priors, require accumulated evidence and abstraction, and test planning through subgoals, experimentation, and recovery. Our dataset is available at [https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/](https://arc3-human-think-aloud.github.io/).

AI.tldr: 构建首个记录人类在ARC-AGI-3新环境中发现与使用机制的数据集（144条人类轨迹+250条LLM轨迹），标注机制触发、动作意图与纠错恢复，并对比人类与LLM认知特征。
AI.motivation: 探索学习与利用新知识达成目标是通用智能的核心，需追踪学习者如何在与环境交互中构建、使用和修正世界模型，但缺乏此类细粒度交互数据。
AI.method: 以ARC-AGI-3为测试平台，采集64名参与者在25个公开游戏上的144条轨迹（时间同步动作+出声思维音频），及LLM智能体250条轨迹（有无harness）；标注机制触发与识别、动作目的、错误与恢复，将理解变化关联到支撑它的观察与动作。
AI.result: 两组均会预判机制并使用熟悉类比；成功人类轨迹中定性表征占50.0%，成功LLM仅14.3%；人类更常无具体假设地探索陌生情境，假设检验两组均常见；并刻画了信念修正、重规划与执行纠正的恢复过程。
AI.conclusion: 带良好harness的LLM已在公开ARC-AGI-3游戏上饱和，说明需新一代基准：挑战熟悉先验、要求证据积累与抽象、通过子目标/实验/恢复检验规划。

title: Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets
summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are trained to sample objects from compositional spaces with probability proportional to a reward function, but ineffective exploration can cause learned samplers to concentrate on a few high-reward regions. An intuitive remedy is to train multiple GFlowNets independently in parallel and combine their samples. However, this does not prevent multiple models from collapsing onto the same high-reward areas, leaving large regions of the state space unexplored. With this in mind, we propose Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets (HCG), an approach that dynamically partitions the search space to coordinate discovery without relying on hand-crafted boundaries. HCG imposes an ordering in which the highest-ranked model may explore the entire space, while lower-ranked models are progressively pushed toward regions not covered by higher-ranked ones. We provide a theoretical characterization of how specific learning objectives can shift probability mass away from designated areas, instantiating this mechanism within our architecture. A shared classifier coordinates the hierarchy by partitioning the search space, keeping the GFlowNets independently parameterized and enabling asynchronous training. Furthermore, we derive a normalizer-weighted aggregation rule for the ensemble and prove that it recovers the target reward-proportional distribution under the stated assumptions. Finally, experiments across multimodal distributions, sequence generation, combinatorial optimization, and biological sequence design show that HCG improves mode coverage and target approximation, translating increases in the number of coordinated samplers into broader, complementary exploration.

AI.tldr: HCG 提出分层协作 GFlowNet 框架，通过共享分类器动态划分搜索空间，让高排名模型探索全空间、低排名模型专注未覆盖区域，从而缓解独立多模型采样的模式坍缩问题。
AI.motivation: GFlowNet 旨在按奖励比例采样组合空间中的对象，但探索低效会导致采样器集中在少数高奖励区域。简单地并行训练多个独立 GFlowNet 再合并样本，并不能防止它们坍缩到相同的高奖励区域，大块状态空间仍未被探索。
AI.method: 提出 Hierarchical Cooperative GFlowNets (HCG)：为模型建立排序，最高排名模型可探索全空间，低排名模型被逐渐推向高排名模型未覆盖的区域；理论上刻画特定学习目标如何把概率质量从指定区域转移开，并将其实例化到架构中；用共享分类器协调层级并划分搜索空间，各 GFlowNet 保持独立参数化、支持异步训练；进一步给出归一化加权的集成聚合规则，并在给定假设下证明其恢复目标奖励比例分布。
AI.result: 在多模态分布、序列生成、组合优化和生物序列设计实验中，HCG 提升了模式覆盖率和目标分布逼近程度；增加协作采样器数量能带来更广、更互补的探索。
AI.conclusion: HCG 无需手工边界即可动态协调多个 GFlowNet 的分工，有效缓解模式坍缩并扩大探索覆盖，且其集成聚合在理论上可恢复奖励比例分布。

title: Road Infrastructure Perception for Autonomous Driving: Taxonomy, Representations, Tasks, and Challenges
summary: Road infrastructure perception is a fundamental component of autonomous driving, as it recovers the structured road elements that define roadway geometry, delimit operational space, and encode traffic regulations. Although individual tasks such as lane detection, drivable-space estimation, traffic-sign recognition, and online map construction have been extensively studied, the field remains fragmented across task definitions, sensing assumptions, output representations, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This survey provides a function-oriented synthesis of road infrastructure perception. We first clarify its scope and organize existing studies into three complementary categories: geometric-structural, functional-spatial, and regulatory-semantic infrastructure. Based on this taxonomy, we review sensing modalities, scene representations, representative methods, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols, emphasizing the field's evolution from image-space recognition toward metric, vectorized, topology-aware, occupancy-based, and rule-grounded scene modeling. We further examine how representation choices affect evaluation and downstream usability, revealing limitations of current benchmarks in relation reasoning, temporal consistency, robustness, and planning-oriented assessment. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions toward unified infrastructure representation, open-environment generalization, relation- and rule-aware reasoning, and downstream-oriented evaluation. By connecting tasks, representations, and evaluation under a common functional framework, this survey aims to establish road infrastructure perception as a coherent foundation for map-compatible and behavior-relevant autonomous-driving scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 该综述以"功能"为导向系统梳理道路基础设施感知，将其分为几何结构、功能空间、法规语义三类，回顾传感模态、场景表示、方法、基准与评测，指出当前基准在关系推理、时序一致性、鲁棒性和规划导向评估上的不足，并提出统一表示等未来方向。
AI.motivation: 道路基础设施感知是自动驾驶的基础，但车道检测、可行驶区域估计、交通标志识别、在线地图构建等任务在任务定义、传感假设、输出表示、数据集与评测协议上高度碎片化，缺少统一的功能性框架来整合这些研究。
AI.method: 采用综述与功能导向的综合分析方法：先界定范围，将现有研究归为几何结构类（geometric-structural）、功能空间类（functional-spatial）和法规语义类（regulatory-semantic）三类；再按此分类梳理传感模态、场景表示、代表性方法、基准与评测协议，并分析表示选择对评测和下游可用性的影响。
AI.result: 揭示了该领域从图像空间识别向度量级、矢量化、拓扑感知、占据栅格化及规则约束的场景建模演进；并发现现有基准在关系推理、时序一致性、鲁棒性与规划导向评估方面存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: 提出未来方向包括统一基础设施表示、开放环境泛化、关系与规则感知推理、面向下游任务的评测；通过在同一功能框架下连接任务、表示与评测，将道路基础设施感知确立为地图兼容、行为相关的自动驾驶场景理解的连贯基础。

title: Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning
comment: 11 pages. Preliminary version; further experiments and revisions are planned
summary: Large reasoning models are costly to serve because they are large and because they generate long chains of thought (CoT). Weight pruning and CoT compression address these two costs separately, but they interfere in that pruning adds redundant reasoning on problems the model still solves and incomplete reasoning on those it no longer solves, and on harder problems makes the model less compressible by subsequent length-preference optimization. We trace this to a blind spot on each side: pruning criteria do not distinguish necessary from redundant reasoning, and preference-based CoT compression receives no training signal on problems a pruned model always or never solves. We propose Contrastive Set-Difference (CSD), which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting their activations on long and short correct solutions of the same problem and prunes them preferentially, and we extend preference pairs to the problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20\% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, the combination uses 8--22\% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than pruning with reasoning-aware calibration (RAC) followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出对比集合差异(CSD)剪枝方法,通过对比同一问题长/短正确解上的神经元激活来识别冗余推理相关神经元并优先剪除,同时将偏好对扩展到剪枝模型恒解或恒不解的问题上,从而协同优化权重剪枝与思维链(CoT)压缩。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型的部署成本高,源于模型参数大和思维链冗长两大问题。权重剪枝与CoT压缩分别针对这两点,但二者相互干扰:剪枝会在模型仍能解的问题上引入冗余推理,在无法解的问题上引入不完整推理,且在更难问题上降低模型对后续长度偏好优化的可压缩性。作者指出这源于双方的共同盲区——剪枝准则不区分必要推理与冗余推理,而基于偏好的CoT压缩在剪枝模型恒解或恒不解的问题上缺乏训练信号。
AI.method: 提出对比集合差异(CSD)方法:通过对比同一问题上长解与短正确解时的神经元激活,识别在冗余推理中富集的神经元并优先剪枝;同时将偏好对数据集扩展到剪枝模型恒解或恒不解的问题上,以弥补压缩训练信号的缺失。二者结合形成统一的剪枝+CoT压缩流程。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上剪除20%参数后,相比先使用推理感知校准(RAC)剪枝再做相同压缩的方案,该组合方法在四个数学基准上减少8--22%的思考token用量,同时准确率差异在0.5个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 显式区分必要推理与冗余推理的神经元级剪枝准则,并结合覆盖极端难度问题的偏好对扩展,能有效缓解剪枝与CoT压缩之间的相互干扰,在保持精度的前提下显著降低推理开销。

title: How Much Information Can We Fit inside a Transformer?
summary: How efficiently can transformers store factual knowledge? The answer to this question has implications for both model design and understanding the limits of transformer-based systems. Prior studies observe a linear relationship between the number of facts memorized and the number of model parameters required, substantially worse than what theoretical analyses predict is achievable. We re-examine empirical scaling: through rigorous and systematic experiments, including extensive hyperparameter search via Bayesian optimization, we determine the smallest model that can perfectly memorize a given set of facts, and measure how this minimum size scales with the number of facts. On synthetic datasets of random, independent (subject, relation, object) triples---e.g., (Paris, capital_of, France) ---drawn at random with no exploitable structure, we find that memorization capacity, the size of the largest dataset that a model memorizes completely, grows exponentially with the transformer dimension. Equivalently, the minimum transformer dimension $d_{\min}$ required to memorize $N$ facts grows logarithmically in $N$. Across 11 dataset sizes spanning $N = 45$ to $49{,}920$, a lack-of-fit F-test does not reject the logarithmic fit (with an offset), but it does reject all other tested alternatives including power-law. Along the depth axis, however, at fixed width, the maximum memorizable dataset size grows sublinearly with the number of layers over the measured range. We further extend our exploration to structured data containing symmetric relations or two-hop composition. In this setting, we find that transformers exploit these regularities to further improve capacity. All code to reproduce our results is available at https://github.com/Magronox/transformer_information_capacity.

AI.tldr: 通过系统实验与贝叶斯超参搜索，本文发现Transformer对随机事实的记忆容量随维度指数增长（即最小维度随事实数对数增长），沿深度方向则呈亚线性增长，且结构化数据可被利用提升容量。
AI.motivation: 先前研究观察到记忆事实数与所需参数近似线性关系，远劣于理论预测的可达效率，因此需重新审视经验缩放规律，明确Transformer记忆容量的真实上限，这对模型设计及理解系统极限具有重要意义。
AI.method: 构造无结构随机(subject, relation, object)三元组合成数据集；利用贝叶斯优化进行广泛超参搜索，确定能完美记忆给定事实集的最小模型；在N=45至49,920共11个数据集规模上测量最小维度如何随事实数缩放；另考察深度轴与结构化数据（对称关系、两跳组合）情形。
AI.result: 记忆容量随Transformer维度指数增长；最小所需维度d_min随N对数增长（带偏移）。lack-of-fit F检验不拒绝对数拟合，但拒绝包括幂律在内的所有其他备选。固定宽度下，最大可记忆数据量随层数在测量范围内亚线性增长。结构化数据下Transformer可利用规律进一步提升容量。
AI.conclusion: Transformer的记忆效率显著优于既往线性缩放观察结果，符合对数维度缩放规律；深度带来的增益弱于宽度；模型能利用数据中的结构规律增强记忆。代码已开源。

title: Constrained Gradient Equilibrium: Approachability under Locally Constrained Adversaries
summary: Gradient equilibrium (GEQ) is a recent framework in online learning that requires the time-averaged gradients along the learner's trajectory to vanish. We study GEQ when the learner is constrained and ask when such an equilibrium remains achievable in an adversarial environment. We first show that constrained GEQ (CGEQ) can be impossible even under simple and slowly varying constraints, motivating imposing local temporal structure on the adversary. We then develop an approachability framework for CGEQ under locally constrained adversaries, and obtain necessary and sufficient characterizations in the spirit of classical Blackwell approachability. Beyond these theoretical characterizations, we provide an algorithmic principle that converts window-wise no-regret learners into CGEQ algorithms under a local feasibility condition with margin. Experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate that the resulting algorithms perform strongly in both achieving GEQ and respecting the constraints.

AI.tldr: 研究约束在线学习下的梯度均衡（CGEQ），证明其一般不总可达，提出局部约束对手下的逼近性（approachability）框架并给出充要刻画，还给出把窗口无遗憾学习器转为CGEQ算法的原则，实验中兼顾均衡与约束满足。
AI.motivation: 梯度均衡（GEQ）要求沿轨迹的时间平均梯度趋于零；在学习者受约束的情形下，这一均衡是否在对抗环境中仍可实现尚不清楚，本文对此展开研究。
AI.method: 先构造反例说明即便约束简单且缓慢变化，CGEQ也可能不可实现；随后对局部约束对手建立CGEQ的逼近性框架，给出类比经典Blackwell逼近性的必要与充分刻画；并提出算法原则：在带余量的局部可行性条件下，把窗口无遗憾学习器转化为CGEQ算法。
AI.result: 给出了CGEQ不可实现的负面例子与需要局部时间结构对手的动机；得到CGEQ可达性的充要条件刻画；在合成与真实数据上，所得算法在实现GEQ与满足约束两方面表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 约束条件下GEQ的可实现性依赖于对手的局部时间结构，逼近性框架为CGEQ提供完整理论刻画，且窗口无遗憾学习器可被系统转化为实用CGEQ算法。

title: C-DFF: Concept-Level Diagnostics for Mechanism Parity in Simulation-Based Validation of Autonomous Driving Perception
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Simulation is widely used in autonomous-driving validation, but matching task outputs between real and synthetic images does not guarantee that a system relies on the same visual evidence. This creates a validation gap for transfer, especially in safety-critical perception functions. We present Concept-Decisive Feature Fidelity (C-DFF), a concept-level mechanism-parity diagnostic for paired real-synthetic evaluation. Starting from decisive evidence extracted from a frozen system-under-test (SUT), C-DFF projects that evidence into a shared semantic concept space using off-the-shelf segmentation and compares real and synthetic concept-importance vectors. The result is not only a scalar mechanism-parity score, but also a concept-shift diagnostic that identifies which scene concepts become more or less decisive in simulation. We evaluate C-DFF on KITTI $\leftrightarrow$ Virtual KITTI 2 with 2126 matched pairs across three frozen SUTs (steering regression, YOLOP drivable-area, YOLOP lane-line). Across these tasks, C-DFF is SUT-discriminative and yields interpretable concept-level summaries that support validation triage and simulator debugging. When reported alongside task-specific output-value context metrics, C-DFF shows that output agreement does not by itself establish mechanism parity. These results position C-DFF as a practical semantic diagnostic layer for validation and verification workflows in simulation-based AV testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概念级特征保真度(C-DFF)，用于成对真实-合成图像评估中检测系统是否依赖相同的视觉证据，而不仅仅是输出匹配。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶仿真验证中，真实与合成图像的任务输出匹配并不能保证系统依赖相同的视觉证据，造成安全关键感知功能迁移的验证缺口。
AI.method: 从冻结的被测系统(SUT)提取决定性证据，借助现成分割模型投影到共享语义概念空间，比较真实与合成的概念重要性向量，得到机制一致性标量分数和概念漂移诊断。
AI.result: 在KITTI↔Virtual KITTI 2的2126对匹配样本上，针对三种冻结SUT(转向回归、YOLOP可行驶区域、YOLOP车道线)评估，C-DFF能区分不同SUT并给出可解释的概念级总结；与输出值指标联合报告时表明输出一致性不等于机制一致性。
AI.conclusion: C-DFF可作为仿真AV测试验证与确认流程中的实用语义诊断层，支持验证分诊和模拟器调试。

title: Xing USP: A Cross-Family Semantic Contract for Information Extraction and Intent-Slot Parsing
summary: Structured semantic parsing is typically judged by whether the correct category is assigned, which leaves value recovery and instance-level associations unexamined: a system may recognize an event yet bind an argument to the wrong instance, or identify an intent yet supply an incorrect slot value. We present USP, a cross-family semantic contract that represents categories, fields, values, and instance associations through a common interface for named-entity recognition, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing. The contract is paired with five diagnostic matching views---category agreement, field recognition, field-value pairing, instance-bound assignment, and complete-instance recovery---that ask distinct questions about the same output. Using this contract, we normalize 61 datasets into a unified corpus with shared schemas, prompts, and matching rules, and compare six models on a fixed test subset. Our fine-tuned Xing4.0-29B-Intent attains 57.70 task-balanced Field-Value Micro-F1 (equally weighted across the four task families) and ranks first in every family and on all five views; its margin over the strongest alternative widens from 2.93 points for category matching to 20.73 points for complete-instance matching. This widening gap shows that category agreement alone understates structural deficits. USP thus offers the community a shared representation, a normalized 61-dataset corpus, and a diagnostic evaluation protocol that make structural agreement measurable and comparable across extraction and intent-slot tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨任务族的"语义契约"USP，用统一接口表示类别、字段、值与实例关联，并配套五种诊断匹配视图和61个数据集的规范化语料，使结构一致性可度量、可比较。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化语义解析评测通常只看类别是否判对，忽略了值恢复和实例级关联：系统可能识别出事件却把论元绑到错误实例，或识别出意图却给出错误槽值。因此需要一个能揭示结构性缺陷的统一评测框架。
AI.method: 提出USP语义契约，统一表示命名实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取和意图-槽解析中的类别、字段、值与实例关联；配以五个诊断匹配视图（类别一致、字段识别、字段-值配对、实例绑定赋值、完整实例恢复）；据此将61个数据集归一化为共享schema、提示与匹配规则的统一语料，并在固定测试子集上比较六个模型。
AI.result: 微调后的Xing4.0-29B-Intent取得57.70的任务均衡Field-Value Micro-F1（四个任务族等权），在所有任务族和全部五个视图上均排名第一；相对最强对比模型的领先幅度从类别匹配的2.93分扩大到完整实例匹配的20.73分。
AI.conclusion: 领先幅度随视图严格程度递增，说明仅凭类别一致会低估结构性缺陷。USP为社区提供了共享表示、61数据集归一化语料和诊断式评测协议，使抽取与意图-槽任务间的结构一致性可度量、可比较。

title: Resolving the Mobility-Equity-Emissions Trilemma: A Causal Machine Learning Framework for Dynamic Tolling Policy
summary: We propose a causal machine learning framework to integrate dynamic tolling for mobility, equity, and climate objectives, resolving a long-standing policy trilemma. Using Double Machine Learning, we estimate zone-type-specific treatment effects, showing that commercial zones yield nearly twice the delay reduction of residential zones. Our adaptive quota mechanism expands residential coverage 34-fold while preserving 93% of total delay savings and sustaining high return on investment. The framework delivers climate co-benefits, reducing emissions by 743.5 metric tons of CO2 (valued at 141 USD) via congestion-sensitive pricing under moderate traffic conditions with sensitivity bounds from 557.6 to 929.3 tons. Crucially, we uncover a policy-invariant toll range where performance remains robust across demand scenarios, simplifying implementation. This study reveals critical, previously unidentified insights, such as a policy-invariant toll range, that can significantly simplify real-world implementation. Validated on synthetic data mirroring real-world networks, our methodological advances lay the foundation for future public deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出因果机器学习框架，用Double Machine Learning与自适应配额机制设计动态拥堵收费，同时兼顾 mobility、公平与气候目标，破解政策三难困境。
AI.motivation: 动态拥堵收费长期面临"效率—公平—气候"的政策三难：提高中心商业区收费可降低延误与排放，但会加重对居民区的负担、引发公平争议。既有方法多依赖相关性的需求预测，缺乏对分区异质性因果效应的稳健估计，也难以给出实施可行的费率设计。
AI.method: 采用Double Machine Learning估计分区域类型的处理效应（商业区 vs 居住区）；设计自适应配额机制在保持总体效益的同时扩大居住区覆盖；核验拥堵敏感的定价带来的减排协同效应；并在多需求情景下检验绩效稳健区间。验证基于镜像真实路网结构的合成数据。
AI.result: 商业区的延误削减约为居住区的两倍；自适应配额机制使居住区覆盖扩大34倍，同时保留93%的总延误节省并维持较高投资回报；在中等交通条件下通过拥堵敏感定价减排743.5吨CO2（价值141美元），敏感性区间557.6–929.3吨；发现一个对需求情景稳健的"政策不变费率区间"。
AI.conclusion: 方法学贡献在于揭示了以往未识别的政策不变费率区间等关键洞见，可显著简化现实部署；但研究仅基于合成数据验证，真实公共部署仍是未来工作。

title: Segmentation of Moving Objects During Camera Motion Using the OWL Function
summary: We present a principled, analytical framework for segmenting multiple independently moving rigid objects during single camera motion, built directly upon the OWL perception function. OWL encodes two fundamental visual motion cues, perceived looming $L$ and perceived rotation $ω$, into a single closed-form representation of relative 3D structure. A key consequence of this structure is that the unit direction of relative translation $\hat{t}$ is analytically recoverable per image point from $L$ and $ω$ alone. All points belonging to a non-rotating rigid body share the same $\hat{t}$, whereas points on different rigid bodies generally yield distinct values. This furnishes a natural segmentation criterion: clustering per-point $\hat{t}$ estimates partitions the visible scene into independently moving rigid bodies. Building on the 2D complex form of OWL, we derive the framework in 3D using quaternions, for a single moving camera. The approach is parallel, camera rotation-invariant, and requires no training data, no depth information, and no semantic priors.

AI.tldr: 基于OWL感知函数，从looming和rotation解析地恢复每点相对平移方向，通过聚类实现多独立运动刚体分割。
AI.motivation: 在单相机运动下，对多个独立运动的刚体进行分割是视觉运动分析的核心难题；现有方法多依赖训练数据、深度信息或语义先验。作者希望建立一个无需这些依赖、且有解析基础的框架。
AI.method: 以OWL感知函数为基础，将感知looming L与感知旋转ω编码为相对3D结构的闭式表示；从L和ω解析恢复每点相对平移单位方向t̂，并因其在不同刚体上取值不同，通过聚类t̂实现分割；同时将2D复数形式推广到3D四元数形式。
AI.result: 理论上证明t̂可仅由L与ω逐点解析恢复；同一非旋转刚体上的点共享同一t̂，不同刚体一般不同，从而给出自然的分割判据。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个并行、对相机旋转不变、无需训练数据/深度/语义先验的解析分割框架，为单相机多刚体运动分割提供新思路。

title: Beyond the Opening: Tracing the First Token's Persistent Influence on Reasoning Length
summary: Understanding how individual token choices affect reasoning length is important for characterizing reasoning models. Building on prior findings that changing the first reasoning token (hereafter, the first token) can substantially alter reasoning length, we focus on this initial choice to investigate how its influence operates during subsequent generation. One possibility is that the first token changes the early text that follows, which in turn affects reasoning length. However, replacing only the first token of an existing reasoning prefix and resuming generation substantially changes the remaining reasoning length, even though all other prefix tokens are unchanged. To trace this persistent influence, we compare next-token distributions while varying only the first token and find that sensitivity is concentrated at a small set of generation positions. Blocking attention from these positions to the first token reduces the length gap between first-token conditions. Using next-token distributions from a different first-token condition at these positions also substantially changes subsequent reasoning length. Together, these findings suggest that attention to the first token at a few sensitive positions helps sustain its length effect, illustrating how a local token choice persistently influences a sequence-level outcome.

AI.tldr: 首个推理token的选择可通过少数敏感生成位置上对它的注意力，持续影响后续推理长度。
AI.motivation: 已有发现改变首个推理token能显著改变推理长度，但其影响如何在后续生成中持续传递尚不清楚。
AI.method: 固定其余前缀只替换首个token并继续生成；比较不同首token条件下的下一token分布定位敏感位置；屏蔽这些位置对首token的注意力；在这些位置替换为另一条件下的下一token分布。
AI.result: 仅替换首个token即可改变剩余推理长度；敏感性集中于少数生成位置；屏蔽这些位置的首token注意力可缩小长度差异；替换这些位置的下一token分布也大幅改变后续推理长度。
AI.conclusion: 对首个token的注意力在少数敏感位置上维持其长度效应，说明局部token选择可持久影响序列级结果。

title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal. Verification checks and revises agents' work to improve output quality. Yet there is limited guidance on how harnesses should organize this effort. We study verification as an axis of test-time scaling by examining when to intervene, who checks the work, and how checking leads to revision. Our framework spans four layers of the agent lifecycle: initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, and independent review. We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts. Initial instructions and execution-time reminders yield modest, model-dependent average gains on the coding benchmarks, without substantially increasing average output token use. Completion gates can yield larger gains but may substantially increase cost. Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively. On VisualBench, independent review achieves net preferences of 13.2-23.8 points over the baseline across its four designs, exceeding the evaluated L0-L2 designs. Additional review rounds or independent critics further improve average TB accuracy by up to 3.5 percentage points. Together, these results provide empirical guidance for verification design in agent harnesses and support independent review as a practical axis of test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 系统研究 agent harness 中验证（verification）作为测试时扩展轴的组织方式，提出四层验证框架并比较17种设计，发现独立评审（independent review）在准确率-成本权衡上最优。
AI.motivation: Agent harness 让 LLM 通过工具行动并迭代完成任务，验证检查能提升输出质量，但现有工作缺乏关于 harness 应如何组织验证工作的指导：何时介入、由谁检查、检查如何驱动修订。作者希望将验证确立为测试时扩展的一个可行维度。
AI.method: 提出覆盖 agent 生命周期的四层验证框架：初始指令、轮内提醒、完成门控、独立评审。在 Terminal-Bench（TB）和 SWE-bench Verified（SWE）上，对7个前沿编码模型比较17种设计；并引入 VisualBench 用于视觉与交互产物的专家评估。
AI.result: 初始指令与执行时提醒带来中等且依赖模型的平均增益，未明显增加输出 token；完成门控增益较大但成本显著上升。独立评审（critic）在 TB 上提升平均准确率5.9–9.5个百分点（成本1.13–1.25×），SWE 上提升3.9–6.6（成本1.00–1.04×）。VisualBench 上独立评审四种设计相对基线净偏好13.2–23.8分，优于 L0–L2 设计。增加评审轮次或独立 critic 可再提升 TB 平均准确率至多3.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果为 agent harness 的验证设计提供实证指导，并支持将独立评审作为测试时扩展的一种实用轴。

title: Steering the Teacher: Improving On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using token-level supervision from a reference-conditioned teacher initialized from the same model. However, access to the reference can induce teacher behaviors that undermine independent reasoning in thinking models, leading to reference hallucinations, where the student cites an unavailable reference to justify reasoning steps, and reconsideration suppression, where the teacher discourages verification and revision at uncertain steps. We introduce Steered-Teacher OPSD (ST-OPSD) to jointly address these failure modes through activation steering. ST-OPSD extracts two directions from model-generated reasoning trajectories and applies them to the teacher's hidden states during distillation target computation, suppressing reference-invoking behavior and encouraging reconsideration with marker-family calibration. The student learns from the resulting teacher distributions without being steered. Experiments on AIME and HMMT show that ST-OPSD improves accuracy over vanilla OPSD and other interventions while restoring reconsideration and reference-hallucination rates to base-model levels.

AI.tldr: 提出 ST-OPSD，通过激活引导修正教师模型，缓解在线自蒸馏中的"引用幻觉"和"反思抑制"两个问题。
AI.motivation: On-policy self-distillation 让学生在自身推理轨迹上，接受由同源模型初始化的"参考条件化教师"的 token 级监督。但参考材料的存在会诱导教师产生削弱独立思考的行为：一是引用幻觉（学生引用不存在的参考资料来为推理步骤辩护），二是反思抑制（教师在不确定处不鼓励验证与修正）。
AI.method: ST-OPSD 从模型生成的推理轨迹中提取两个方向向量，在计算蒸馏目标时作用于教师隐状态，抑制"引用"行为、鼓励"反思"，并采用 marker-family 校准；学生只学习引导后的教师分布，自身不被引导。
AI.result: 在 AIME 与 HMMT 上，ST-OPSD 相比原版 OPSD 及其他干预方法提升了准确率，同时将反思率与引用幻觉率恢复到基座模型水平。
AI.conclusion: 对教师端做激活引导即可在不大改蒸馏框架的前提下，同时解决 OPSD 的两种失效模式，兼顾准确率与推理行为健康度。

title: Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval
summary: An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image's own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. We show that this advantage arises because the correct candidate's supports are built differently from those of the negative candidates, with set size and query removal each contributing about half, and that under a fixed support index the residual reduces to a reweighting of what the captions already provide. On compositional benchmarks, the captions help by matching candidates to human descriptions of the image, without improving image-text grounding. The code is available at: https://github.com/nhatkhangcs/clip_consensus

AI.tldr: 在冻结双编码器推理时，将图像相似度与"图像自身多张标注标题"的相似度融合，可显著提升文到图检索R@1；增益取决于标题来源是否与查询同类标注者，且"残差/未解释部分"的额外收益实为评估伪影。
AI.motivation: 检索基准和许多图像集合为每张图配有多条标题，但双编码器仍把每个图文对孤立打分，忽略了这些"邻近标题"在推理时可提供的信息。作者想厘清：冻结编码器若在推理时参考这些邻近标题，究竟能带来多少、以及在什么条件下带来收益。
AI.method: 提出在推理阶段融合"图像—查询相似度"与"查询—该图像自身标题集相似度"；进一步提出对"标题未解释的图像部分"打分的残差精化方案，并用留一法评估其真实贡献（控制支持集大小、查询移除等因素）。在九个冻结编码器、不同标题来源（同源标注者、现成captioner、异构标注）及组合性基准上做系统实验。
AI.result: 同源标注者标题下，文到图R@1提升3.4–16.8点；现成captioner生成时降至1.9–7.2点；异构标注来源时最多约1点；改写训练的文编码器可进一步增强文本侧。残差方案在留一法下看似增益很大，但该优势来源于正候选与负候选的支持集构造方式不同（支持集大小与查询移除各贡献约一半）；固定支持索引后，残差退化为对已有标题信息的重加权。在组合性基准上，标题通过把候选匹配到人类描述而起作用，但并未改善图像—文本的grounding。
AI.conclusion: 多标题融合在推理时是低成本、可观且依赖于标注同源性的增益；"未解释残差"的诱人增益主要是评估偏差，应谨慎解读。标题帮助的是检索匹配而非真正的视觉—语言对齐，提示benchmark设计需控制支持集构成。

title: Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers
summary: In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth of the token cost, and identifies at least 6.1% of the formalized statements as unfaithful without requiring additional judges. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover.

AI.tldr: 提出"联合证明"(Joint Proof)框架，将候选答案选择、答案补充与形式化证明生成统一为一个推理过程，用经训练的证明器在一次调用中选出或提出答案并生成证明，同时可利用生成证明检测形式化陈述的不忠实错误。
AI.motivation: 在Lean 4等形式系统中，传统流程需对上游求解器给出的每个候选答案分别搜索证明，计算冗余、开销大。
AI.method: 训练一个证明器，在一次调用中同时完成：从给定候选中选择答案或提出新答案，并为至少一个答案生成形式化证明；复用生成的证明，若同一唯一答案题的两个不同答案都能在相同形式陈述下获得可验证证明，即判定该陈述不忠实。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、AMC 2023、AIME 2024/2025/2026上，以约六分之一token成本达到与逐候选证明生成相同的形式证明成功率，并在无需额外judge的情况下识别出至少6.1%的不忠实形式化陈述。
AI.conclusion: 联合证明框架能显著降低证明搜索的计算成本，并自带形式化忠实性校验能力，代码与模型已开源。

title: HobbyLM: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Family on a Hobby Budget
summary: We describe HobbyLM, a family of small sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models trained from scratch with a few hundred to a few thousand dollars of rented GPU time. The core is a decoder-only transformer with fine-grained experts, sigmoid routing with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, grouped-query attention with per-head QK-normalization, and aMuon/AdamW optimizer split. Each of these choices was selected with a single-variable ablation suite at 130M parameters. On this architecture we train a 500M-parameter model (169M active) on 40B FineWeb tokens and post-train it into a chat model, a masked-diffusion language model, a function-calling and computer-use agent, and a single "omni" checkpoint that reads text, images, video, sound and speech through frozen encoders and small projectors. We run these models on a laptop CPU with a from-scratch Rust inference engine. Two of the authors then adopted the architecture without architectural changes to build HobbyLM-1B (1.04B total, 305M active parameters), trained on a 100B-token curated mixture with a high-quality anneal. HobbyLM-1B reaches a 47.5 average on seven zero-shot benchmarks, and its builders also release an instruction-tuned model and an on-device macOS computer-use adapter. Finally, we describe HobbyLM-Image, a 333M-parameter flow-matching diffusion transformer that generates 1024x1024 images in a 32x-compressed latent space, together with a dependency-light CPU implementation of the full text-to-image pipeline. We report what worked, what did not, and where the small-scale ceilings lie. We also state for each component which author designed or built it.

AI.tldr: HobbyLM: 低成本从零训练的小型稀疏MoE模型家族，含500M/1B语言模型、多模态omni检查点、图像生成模型及Rust CPU推理引擎。
AI.motivation: 证明在极低预算（数百至数千美元租用GPU）下，个人爱好者也能从零训练出可用的小型稀疏MoE语言模型及多模态扩展，并探索小规模的上限。
AI.method: 解码器-only Transformer + 细粒度专家MoE、sigmoid路由无辅助损失负载均衡、GQA叠加逐头QK归一化、Muon/AdamW混合优化器；130M规模做单变量消融选型。500M模型（169M激活）在40B FineWeb token上预训练并后训练为聊天、掩码扩散、Agent及omni模型；用冻结编码器+小投影器接入多模态；自研Rust推理引擎在笔记本CPU运行。HobbyLM-1B（1.04B总/305M激活）在100B精选token上训练含高质量退火。另有333M流匹配扩散Transformer生成1024×1024图像（32倍压缩隐空间）。
AI.result: HobbyLM-1B在七个零样本基准上平均47.5分；发布指令微调模型及macOS端侧computer-use适配器；提供轻依赖CPU文本到图像流水线；并总结了各组件有效/无效之处及小规模性能上限。
AI.conclusion: 低成本小规模稀疏MoE方案可行且可扩展到多模态与图像生成，但存在明显的规模天花板；论文还标注了各组件由哪位作者设计或实现。

title: Cross-User Adaptation for sEMG Gesture Recognition via Continual Learning
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IEEE BioCAS 2026
summary: Prosthetic and assistive interfaces increasingly depend on decoding hand gestures from surface electromyography (sEMG). Because the signal is shaped by person-specific factors, the recurrent neural networks (RNNs) commonly used to model these temporal streams must adapt to new wearers and new gesture classes after deployment. Continual learning (CL) enables this adaptation without retraining from scratch, yet applying it to recurrent sEMG models is not straightforward. Standard recurrent training practices can destabilize learning, and which CL strategy holds up under realistic cross-user drift is unestablished. We evaluate three representative CL strategies under domain- and class-incremental drift on NinaPro DB1, and find experience replay to outperform elastic weight consolidation (EWC) and naive fine-tuning. It reaches 83.3% final accuracy for class-incremental drift while limiting forgetting to 1.8-5.8% accuracy drop, as against 16.2-28.5% for EWC and naive training. We further show these models must be trained on shuffled, independently-windowed segments. Streaming windows in temporal order collapses the network into predicting a single dominant gesture, while a shuffled, stateless regime trains stably. Finally, hand-crafted time-domain features raise per-task accuracy by up to about 40% over raw signals, but only replay preserves that gain under class-incremental drift.

AI.tldr: 该论文在NinaPro DB1上评估三种持续学习策略用于sEMG手势识别的循环神经网络，发现经验回放优于EWC和朴素微调，并指出必须采用打乱的无状态窗口训练，且手工时域特征能显著提升精度但仅回放能保持增益。
AI.motivation: 假肢与辅助接口依赖sEMG解码手势，但信号受个体差异影响，RNN模型部署后需适应新用户与新手势类别；持续学习可实现免重训适应，但循环sEMG模型的训练稳定性及哪种CL策略在真实跨用户漂移下有效尚不明确。
AI.method: 在NinaPro DB1上，针对域增量与类增量漂移，对比经验回放、弹性权重巩固（EWC）与朴素微调三种持续学习策略；研究训练窗口的时序排列方式（打乱无状态 vs 顺序流式）；并比较原始信号与手工时域特征的效果。
AI.result: 经验回放在类增量漂移下达到83.3%最终精度，遗忘仅1.8–5.8%，而EWC与朴素训练遗忘为16.2–28.5%。按时间顺序流式窗口训练会使网络坍缩为预测单一主导手势，打乱无状态方式可稳定训练。手工时域特征使每任务精度相比原始信号提升最多约40%，但仅在回放下能于类增量漂移中保持该增益。
AI.conclusion: 经验回放是循环sEMG持续学习中最稳健的策略；训练应采用打乱、独立切分的无状态窗口而非时序流式；手工时域特征配合回放可实现最佳且可持续的跨用户/跨类别适应性。

title: ProMo3D: Probing Motion Cues in Frozen 3D Foundation Models
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models have recently reshaped multi-view reconstruction, yet dynamic 4D understanding still often relies on large-scale motion supervision or hand-crafted, architecture-specific heuristics. We ask whether frozen 3D foundation model tokens already encode motion-relevant information that can be exposed by lightweight readout functions, rather than re-learning motion-specific features with high-capacity decoders. Through probing on three representative backbones, we find that static--dynamic separation is decodable from frozen token representations. Our rank-restricted and spectral analyses on $π^3$X reveal that the recovered motion cues are concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this, we propose Probing-based Motion Distillation (PMD), which converts pairwise motion-state compatibility scores against a fixed anchor token into dense motion masks. Trained on only 160 YouTube-VOS videos using a single 16 GB GPU, PMD transfers zero-shot to DAVIS, SegTrackv2, and FBMS-59 without target-benchmark fine-tuning. With multi-view pretrained geometric backbones, PMD outperforms training-free heuristics and approaches substantially heavier supervised and self-supervised methods, suggesting that motion decoding from frozen 3D foundation models can be lightweight and data-efficient.

AI.tldr: 冻结的3D基础模型token已蕴含运动相关信息，仅用轻量读出函数即可提取，提出PMD实现轻量、数据高效的零样本运动分割。
AI.motivation: 动态4D理解仍依赖大规模运动监督或手工的、架构特定的启发式规则；作者想验证是否可直接从冻结的3D基础模型token中读出运动信息，而无需用大容量解码器重新学习运动特征。
AI.method: 在三个代表性backbone上做探测实验，发现静动分离可从冻结token中解码；对π³X做秩约束与谱分析，发现运动线索集中在低维子空间。据此提出PMD（Probing-based Motion Distillation），将相对固定锚点token的成对运动状态兼容性得分转换为稠密运动掩码。
AI.result: 仅用160个YouTube-VOS视频、单张16GB GPU训练，PMD可零样本迁移到DAVIS、SegTrackv2、FBMS-59且无需目标基准微调；在多视图预训练几何backbone下优于免训练启发式方法，并接近更重的有监督/自监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 从冻结3D基础模型中解码运动可以是轻量且数据高效的，为动态4D理解提供了新范式。

title: Does the Voynich Manuscript Mean Anything? Calibrated Tests Find Little Trace of Language
summary: The Voynich manuscript is a fifteenth-century book in a script that no one can read. One account holds that its text means nothing and that a scribe made it by copying his own words and changing them a little. The other holds that a real language lies hidden behind a cipher. We write each account as a program that fills the pages of the manuscript, fit every program with the same budget, and check it on statistics the fit never saw. The copying process of Timm and Schinner predicts these statistics far better than any cipher with one key. But ciphers that switch keys between the manuscript's two dialects, or that encode only the word classes of a real text, predict them equally well. Word statistics alone cannot decide. We look for a trace of language that needs no decipherment. In 28 texts in 16 languages the same word pairs keep sharing a line. The manuscript shows this pattern at half the strength of the weakest of these texts. A word code keeps the pattern above the manuscript unless its plaintext has a weak pattern or many words are miscopied. Solvers that decipher control texts find no readable text in the manuscript under a letter cipher, a word code or 28 codes with one letter, letter pair or syllable per word. Word codes of abbreviated Latin, the plaintext their fits prefer, show which word follows which more clearly than the manuscript unless two words in five are miscopied. One cipher remains possible, a nomenclator with a second key whose scribe miscopies more than half of the words, and our solvers cannot exclude it in 9 of 16 languages. Most of the structure a solver finds comes from how the end of one word shapes the start of the next, which reflects how tightly glyphs are bound to each other. Planted messages are found reliably only when they are long, each letter always becomes the same word and these words are adjacent, so other messages could hide.

AI.tldr: 本文用程序模拟与不可见统计检验比较伏尼契手稿的"无意义抄写"与"加密真实语言"两种假说，发现词统计无法判定，并进一步寻找无需破译的语言痕迹。
AI.motivation: 伏尼契手稿无人能读，学界存在两种对立解释：抄写员生成的无意义文本，或隐藏真实语言的密码；现有词频统计不足以区分二者，需要新判据。
AI.method: 将两种假说各写成生成程序并统一预算拟合，用拟合未见过的统计量检验；再用28种语言/16种语言的词对共行模式作为无需破译的语言痕迹，并对控制文本运行破译求解器检验可读性与可排除性。
AI.result: Timm-Schinner抄写模型预测统计优于单密钥密码，但双方言换钥或词类编码的密码同样好；手稿词对共行强度仅为最弱对照文本的一半；解密求解器找不到可读文本，仅剩"带第二密钥且过半词误抄的nomenclator"无法在9/16语言中排除。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭词统计无法裁决手稿性质；求解器发现的结构多来自词尾对词首的形变约束，可靠植入信息仅在长、逐字同词且相邻时被检出，故仍可能有信息隐藏。

title: A Battery for AI Propensity Measurement: Rubrics, Synthetic Item Banks, and Annotations
summary: We release a battery of 28 propensities for AI research, with expert-written rubrics, synthetic datasets, and annotated demand intervals, built with the method of Romero-Alvarado et al. (2026). We selected a wide collection of generic propensities that may influence the behavior of AI systems and humans. They are inspired by psychometric, psychological, and behavioral research, so that experimental results can be understood in the context of familiar constructs previously used also for human behavior research. The rubrics are useful for annotating existing benchmarks whose items may be relevant or not for one or more propensities. For easier profiling, however, the synthetic datasets are defined in such a way that they should be sensitive to one propensity only, allowing for a quick prototyping of propensity profiles using the battery of datasets. We also outline directions for future propensity research.

AI.tldr: 该文发布了一套包含28种AI“倾向性(propensities)”的评测资源，配有专家撰写的评分量表、合成数据集与标注的需求区间，可用于快速构建AI系统的倾向性画像并支持后续研究。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏系统性、可复用的工具来刻画AI系统（及人类）的通用行为倾向；作者希望借助心理测量学与行为科学的成熟构念，使AI行为实验结果能在熟悉的理论框架下被理解与比较。
AI.method: 遵循Romero-Alvarado et al. (2026)的方法构建28种通用倾向性资源：为每种倾向性编写专家评分量表(rubrics)，生成仅对单一倾向性敏感的合成数据集，并提供标注的需求区间(demand intervals)；同时说明量表可用于对现有基准条目进行倾向性相关度标注。
AI.result: 产出可复用的倾向性评测套件：量表支持对现有基准的标注，单倾向敏感的合成数据集支持以低成本快速原型化倾向性画像；并给出未来倾向性研究的方向。
AI.conclusion: 该资源将心理/行为科学构念引入AI评测，兼顾理论可比性与工程易用性，为AI倾向性的标准化测量与后续研究奠定基础。

title: The Information Geometry of Representation Formation
summary: Most analyses of neural representations focus on trained endpoints, leaving the process by which internal structure forms comparatively unmeasured. We instead treat representation formation itself as an object of study, asking whether the path a representation takes through training reveals information that its endpoint does not. We formalize this idea by viewing representation learning as a geometric trajectory, using Bures geometry to measure movement through representation space and quantum Fisher information to characterize local sensitivity to input factors. We find that learning concentrates local sensitivity on task-relevant factors, and that changing only the prediction target reorganizes this geometry around the corresponding visual factor. More strikingly, representation trajectories become systematically less direct as the learned computation requires higher-order interactions among input factors. This effect persists under matched-performance and training-duration controls and transfers from synthetic vector inputs to residual CNNs on rendered and natural images. Importantly, formation history contains predictive information about the stability of the learned representation: controlling for interaction order, path tortuosity predicts its subsequent drift under continued training and sensitivity to parameter perturbations, whereas endpoint displacement does not. Finally, representation-aware optimization lets us actively shape these trajectories, showing that formation geometry is not only measurable but actionable. Together, these results establish representation formation as a new source of information about learning: its geometry reveals properties of the computation being constructed, predicts subsequent representational stability, and provides a target for intervention during optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文把表征学习视为表征空间中的几何轨迹，用Bures几何度量训练路径、用量子Fisher信息刻画局部敏感性，发现轨迹几何能揭示所构建计算的性质、预测表征稳定性，并可主动优化。
AI.motivation: 以往神经表征分析大多只看训练终点，忽略了内部结构形成的过程，无法判断"路径"是否携带终点没有的信息。
AI.method: 将表征学习形式化为几何轨迹：以Bures几何度量表征空间中的移动，以量子Fisher信息刻画对输入因素的局部敏感性；并通过仅改变预测目标、匹配性能与训练时长等控制实验，以及在合成向量输入与残差CNN（渲染图和自然图像）上的迁移来验证；最后提出表征感知的优化方法来主动塑造轨迹。
AI.result: 学习会把局部敏感性集中于任务相关因素，改变预测目标会围绕相应视觉因素重组该几何；计算需要输入因素间的更高阶交互时，轨迹系统性变得更不直接（更曲折）；该效应在性能与训练时长控制下依然成立并可从合成向量迁移到CNN。控制交互阶数后，路径曲折度能预测后续训练中的表征漂移和对参数扰动的敏感性，而终点位移则不能。
AI.conclusion: 表征形成过程本身是学习信息的新来源：其几何揭示所构建计算的性质、预测后续表征稳定性，并可作为优化干预的目标。

title: Grounded Exploration for Open-Ended Image Editing
summary: Open-ended image-editing requests, such as ``decorate this room,'' admit multiple valid realizations. Direct sampling may produce ungrounded variation, whereas explicit diversity prompting often produces superficial differences. We study how to ground these requests without prematurely eliminating their legitimate ambiguity. We introduce a two-stage framework that first identifies diverse, feasible edit scopes and then realizes them as executable edit instructions. Across 300 open-ended image-editing tasks, our approach achieves 24.6% higher mean semantic dispersion and 17.1% higher mean groundedness than direct diversity prompting, while producing more valid and distinct realizations. These results show that structuring feasible edit directions before realization supports more useful grounded exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架：先识别多样且可行的编辑范围，再将其实现为可执行的编辑指令，以在开放式图像编辑中兼顾"落地性"与"合法歧义"。
AI.motivation: 开放式图像编辑请求（如"装饰这个房间"）存在多种合理解法。直接采样会产生缺乏依据的随意变化，而显式多样性提示往往只带来表面差异，难以在保持歧义合理性的同时让结果有据可依。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段识别多样且可行的编辑范围（edit scopes），第二阶段将这些范围实现为可执行的编辑指令（executable edit instructions）。
AI.result: 在300个开放式图像编辑任务上，相比直接多样性提示，平均语义离散度提升24.6%，平均落地性（groundedness）提升17.1%，并产出更多有效且互不相同的实现结果。
AI.conclusion: 在实现之前先结构化可行的编辑方向，有助于获得更有用、有依据的探索性多样化输出。

title: CSI-TextBench: A Dataset and Benchmark for Language-Grounded Ambient Sensing Perception
summary:
Indoor context deciphered by ambient sensing underpins many applications, from assisted living to smart buildings, yet remains weakly connected to the language-aligned paradigm of modern multimodal systems. Through billions of IoT devices, ambient WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) captures the indoor context of human activity and environmental dynamics passively via ubiquitous, always-on infrastructure. However, unlike vision or audio, CSI lacks naturally paired text like captions or transcripts, limiting its integration with language-driven AI systems.
  We present CSI-TextBench, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for aligning CSI data with natural language, unifying 3 sensing benchmarks into 285,790 samples across 7 tasks and pairing them with 2,291 hierarchically structured, label-derived descriptions via many-to-many assignment to construct 2.0 million CSI-text training tuples. Benchmarking 5 alignment methods from 4 paradigm families, we show that contrastive CSI-text alignment matches supervised classifiers without class labels, adapts to unseen classes with few samples, and responds to open-vocabulary natural-language prompts. A single unified model supports compositional scene understanding, answering joint queries over activity, proximity, and identity, achieving 86.9% top-1 accuracy on 140 composite scenes, outperforming task-specific classifier ensembles. CSI-TextBench enables ubiquitous ambient sensing as a language-indexed perception layer, enabling indoor contextual awareness in language-driven AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出CSI-TextBench，首个大规模CSI-文本对齐数据集与基准，将3个感知基准统一为285,790个样本、7项任务，并构建229万条CSI-文本训练对，验证对比式对齐可媲美监督分类器并支持开放词汇与组合场景理解。
AI.motivation: WiFi CSI可通过普适、常在的基础设施被动感知室内人体活动与环境动态，但相比视觉/音频，CSI缺乏天然配对的文本（字幕、转写），难以与现代语言对齐的多模态AI系统集成。
AI.method: 构建CSI-TextBench：整合3个感知基准为285,790样本、覆盖7项任务；基于标签派生2,291条层次化描述，通过多对多分配生成约200万CSI-文本训练元组；对来自4大范式家族的5种对齐方法进行基准评测。
AI.result: 对比式CSI-文本对齐无需类别标签即可达到监督分类器水平，能少样本适应未见类别并响应开放词汇自然语言提示；单一统一模型在140个组合场景上取得86.9% top-1精度，优于任务专用分类器集成。
AI.conclusion: CSI-TextBench使普适环境感知成为语言索引的感知层，为语言驱动的AI系统提供室内情境理解能力，打通了CSI与语言对齐范式之间的鸿沟。

title: BriLLM-MetaPred: A Representation-Prediction Unity Language Model with Adaptive Self-Measurement
summary: We present BriLLM-MetaPred, the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred machine-learning framework established by a mathematical theory of AGI, instantiated for language modeling. The theory argues that MetaPred is both necessary and sufficient as a machine-learning primitive for general cognition. Taking this theoretical conclusion as a design premise, we report an implementation of the primitive for language modeling. A single continuously evolving dynamical state serves as both the context representation and the state from which predictions are read out. Continuous measurement of its own state reduces finite-depth inconsistency, maintains internal consistency, and provides an endogenous dynamical self-supervision signal in fixed-point form. The single dynamical state of MetaPred intrinsically couples training and inference. MetaPred therefore exhibits symmetry across almost all key elements of machine learning, an intuitive and observable property of the mathematical optimum over the space of all machine-learning paradigms. BriLLM-MetaPred is neither another recurrent language model nor an extension of BriLLM. It provides a bridge between two prior contributions: the construction and motivation of the MetaPred primitive provided by AGI theory, and the SiFu learning paradigm provided by BriLLM (Zhao et al., 2025). The latter's node-signal-flow design enables the primitive to run on available software and hardware accelerators. Our implementation of BriLLM-MetaPred achieves predictive performance comparable to a GPT baseline of the same size. This provides initial evidence for the engineering feasibility of the MetaPred framework established by the mathematical theory of AGI. MetaPred is the first machine-learning paradigm derived entirely from mathematical theory rather than assembled and incrementally improved through human design---and perhaps the last such paradigm.

AI.tldr: BriLLM-MetaPred 是 MetaPred 机器学习框架（由 AGI 数学理论推出）的首个工程实现，用于语言建模；它用单一连续演化的动力学状态同时充当上下文表示与预测读出状态，并在同尺寸下取得与 GPT 基线相当的预测性能。
AI.motivation: AGI 数学理论论证 MetaPred 是一般认知的机器学习原语的充分必要条件，但此前缺乏工程实现验证；本文以此为设计前提，检验其可实现性，并搭建理论与 SiFu 学习范式之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 单一连续演化的动力学状态同时作为上下文表示和预测读出状态；通过对自身状态的连续测量降低有限深度不一致性、维持内部一致性，并形成不动点形式的内生动力学自监督信号；该状态内在耦合训练与推理，呈现机器学习各关键要素上的对称性。实现借助 BriLLM 的 SiFu 学习范式的节点-信号-流设计，使其可在现有软硬件加速器上运行。
AI.result: BriLLM-MetaPred 在同尺寸对比中取得与 GPT 基线相当的预测性能，作为 MetaPred 工程可行性的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作既非另一类循环语言模型，也非 BriLLM 的扩展，而是连接 AGI 理论的 MetaPred 原语与 SiFu 学习范式的桥梁；作者主张 MetaPred 是首个完全由数学理论推导、而非人工拼装与增量改进而来的机器学习范式——或许也是最后一个。

title: Grounding on Request: Learning Modality Control in Vision-Language Models
summary: When an image and its caption disagree, can a user reliably control which one a vision-language model (VLM) follows? Accuracy alone cannot answer this question, since a model might give the correct answer from parametric knowledge without following the requested evidence. We therefore evaluate modality grounding control through conflict-preserving counterfactual interventions. Specifically, Flip measures whether an initially correct answer follows an edit to the requested modality, while Stay measures whether it remains stable when the competing modality is edited. To learn this control, we build on neologism learning by introducing new words for visual and textual grounding, training only their embeddings while keeping the pretrained model fixed. We also introduce Counterfactual Twin-Margin (CTM) supervision, which uses paired interventions to teach how answer probabilities should change when the requested evidence changes. Across three VLMs on three existing benchmarks and our multi-attribute Ground-CF benchmark, we find that learned modality words improve control over natural-language instructions. Surprisingly, a single learned embedding per modality provides strong lightweight visual control and shows little average degradation on held-out values. LoRA remains strongest overall, although its visual advantage narrows under held-out evaluation. Moreover, counterfactual supervision improves control in several settings where standard supervision is weaker. Finally, we test our method on real-world news video and find that visual control improves when the relevant evidence is made easier to access. Overall, our results show that reliable modality control requires testing not only whether an answer is correct, but whether it continues to follow edits to the modality of choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"冲突保持的反事实干预"来评测VLM对模态（图像/文本）的接地控制能力，通过新词嵌入学习与反事实孪生边际（CTM）监督来训练模态控制词。
AI.motivation: 单一准确率无法判断模型是否正确遵循了用户指定的模态证据（可能仅凭参数知识答对），因此需要一个能区分"正确答案是否真的跟随指定模态编辑"的评测与训练框架。
AI.method: 引入Flip（编辑指定模态后正确答案是否随之改变）与Stay（编辑竞争模态后答案是否稳定）两个指标；基于新词学习为视觉与文本各引入一个接地词，仅训练其embedding而冻结预训练模型；并提出Counterfactual Twin-Margin（CTM）监督，利用成对干预教学答案概率如何随证据变化；同时构建多属性Ground-CF基准。
AI.result: 在3个VLM、3个现有基准与Ground-CF上，学习到的模态词优于自然语言指令；单模态embedding即可提供强轻量视觉控制且留出值上退化小；LoRA整体最强但视觉优势在留出评测下缩小；反事实监督在多个标准监督较弱场景中提升控制；真实新闻视频中，当证据更易获取时视觉控制提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的模态控制评测不应只看答案是否正确，还需检验答案是否持续跟随所选模态的编辑。

title: STEP: Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction Correctness via Per-Step Probability Scoring
comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP 2026) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Estimating the correctness of large language model (LLM) predictions without access to ground truth is critical for reliable deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing approaches, such as entropy and perplexity, operate solely on final output statistics, discarding the rich information encoded in intermediate reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose STEP (Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness), a training-free framework that scores each reasoning step via lightweight forward passes to obtain a soft probability distribution qi over candidate answers, from which we derive a set of soft trajectory features capturing per-step confidence and its progression toward the final answer. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, particularly in AUROC, over output-based baselines and hard-indicator trajectory methods. Notably, Temporally-Weighted Consistency, which assigns higher importance to later reasoning steps where answer distributions have stabilized, contributes the largest gains, highlighting the importance of temporal structure in reasoning trajectories. These results further validate the advantage of preserving continuous probability signals over binary discretization.

AI.tldr: 提出 STEP：无需训练的框架，用轻量前向传播为每个推理步骤获得候选答案的软概率分布，据此构造软轨迹特征来估计 LLM 预测正确性。
AI.motivation: 无真值场景下估计 LLM 预测正确性对高风险部署至关重要；熵、困惑度等现有方法只用最终输出统计量，丢弃了中间推理步骤中的丰富信息。
AI.method: STEP 通过每一步的轻量前向传播得到候选答案上的软概率分布 qi，并从中提取软轨迹特征，刻画逐步置信度及其向最终答案的演进；其中时序加权一致性对后期（分布趋于稳定）的步骤赋予更高权重。
AI.result: 在多基准上相较基于输出的基线及硬指标轨迹方法取得一致且显著提升，尤其在 AUROC 上；时序加权一致性贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 推理轨迹的时序结构对正确性估计很重要，保留连续概率信号优于二元离散化。

title: The Symmetry of Differential Neural Tangent Kernel under the Orthogonal Group
summary: The differential neural tangent kernel (DNTK) is a tool for analyzing the training dynamics of overparameterized physics informed neural networks. In this work, we investigate the symmetry of the infinite DNTK under an orthogonal group, for two layer and deep neural networks separately, based on the explicit expression of the DNTK and recursive formula, respectively. The results are for all activations with or without a bias term, and shed insight into the structure of the infinite width DNTK. Then we prove that the integral operators over the unit sphere induced by operators from the same group orbit share the spectrum, and their reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces differ only by an orthogonal transformation, and that the operator fixed DNTK exhibits zonal symmetry on the unit sphere for symmetric operators. Thus the eigenvalue decay rate of the associated integral operator can be derived for shallow networks with RePU activation and zero bias initialization.

AI.tldr: 该文研究无限宽微分神经切线核（DNTK）在正交群作用下的对称性，并据此分析积分算子的谱性质与特征值衰减。
AI.motivation: DNTK 是分析过参数化 PINN 训练动力学的工具，但其无限宽极限下的结构（对称性、谱性质）尚缺乏系统刻画，尤其是与激活函数、偏置、网络深度关系不明。
AI.method: 分别基于两层网络的显式 DNTK 表达式与深层网络的递归公式，对任意（含或不含偏置）激活函数推导无限 DNTK 的正交群对称性；进而证明同群轨道上算子所诱导的单位球面积分算子谱相同、RKHS 仅差一个正交变换，并证明算子固定的 DNTK 对对称算子在球面上呈 zonal 对称。
AI.result: 同轨道算子的积分算子共享谱，其 RKHS 之间仅相差正交变换；对称算子对应的固定 DNTK 具有 zonal 对称性；由此可导出浅层网络在 RePU 激活与零偏置初始化下的特征值衰减率。
AI.conclusion: 正交群对称性为理解无限宽 DNTK 的结构提供了统一视角，并可直接用于刻画相关积分算子的谱与特征值衰减，对 PINN 训练动力学的理论分析有指导意义。

title: TrackTok: Object-Centric Video Tokenization with Semantically Persistent Tokens
summary: We introduce TrackTok, an efficient video tokenization framework that produces object-centric tokens, i.e., tokens that consistently encode the same semantic objects across time, even as it moves, deforms, or undergoes partial occlusion. Conventional patch-based or existing holistic tokenizers produce token identities often tied to fixed image locations. In contrast, our approach learns temporally persistent object-centric representations that bind visual features across frames into stable semantic units. This enables substantially more compact, continuous latent video representations, reducing the number of tokens required for downstream generative modeling with state-of-the-art flow models, while preserving the semantic structure needed for high-quality synthesis. Our tokenizer offers a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. TrackTok achieves comparable class-conditional generative FVD on UCF-101 dataset at 8 times fewer latent tokens and better latency, and outperforms existing 1D tokenization baselines on frame prediction task on Kinetics-600 across low token budgets. These results suggest that object-aligned and temporally persistent tokenization is a promising direction for scalable video generation, where reducing latent token counts is critical for efficient modeling. Our code for this work is available at https://github.com/phamleyennhi/tracktok.

AI.tldr: TrackTok 提出一种以物体为中心的视频分词框架，生成跨帧一致编码同一语义对象的 token，从而用更少 token 实现高质量视频生成。
AI.motivation: 传统基于 patch 或整体式的分词器产生的 token 身份通常绑定固定图像位置，随时间变化的对象无法保持稳定表示，导致下游生成建模需要大量 token、效率低。
AI.method: 学习时间持久的物体中心表示，将跨帧视觉特征绑定为稳定的语义单元，生成物体对齐且跨时间一致的 token，实现更紧凑、连续的潜空间视频表示。
AI.result: 在 UCF-101 上，类条件生成 FVD 与基线相当，但潜 token 数减少 8 倍且延迟更优；在 Kinetics-600 的帧预测任务中，低 token 预算下优于现有 1D 分词基线。
AI.conclusion: 物体对齐、时间持久的视频分词是可扩展视频生成的有前景方向，在减少潜 token 数量以提升建模效率方面具有关键价值。

title: InferPriv: Evaluating Inferential Privacy Leakage in LLM Assistants
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based personal agents are increasingly deployed to handle everyday tasks on users' behalf. These agents have access to private user information, while their tasks involve communicating with third parties; this raises a critical privacy concern that agents may inappropriately reveal sensitive user information to these recipients. Existing benchmarks primarily assess direct privacy leakage, where an agent explicitly states a pre-specified secret or attribute. However, they do not capture \textit{inferential leakage}, where the model leaves indirect cues in the reply that implicitly leaks sensitive attributes. We introduce \textsc{InferPriv}, a benchmark that measures whether an honest-but-curious recipient can infer a user's sensitive attributes from an LLM's reply on routine task. Evaluating five frontier models, we find that inferential leakage substantially exceeds direct leakage across models and prompts. Under a privacy-aware system prompt, GPT-6.1-Sol, Sonnet-5.5, and Gemini-3.8-Flash achieve near-zero direct leakage, yet the inferential leakage rate remains between 16.2--25.2\%. These findings suggest that evaluating explicit leakage alone can substantially understate the privacy risks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 InferPriv 基准，用于衡量 LLM 个人助理回复中的"推断性隐私泄露"（接收方可通过间接线索推断用户敏感属性）。评测五个前沿模型发现推断性泄露显著高于直接泄露：即便在隐私感知系统提示下，GPT-6.1-Sol、Sonnet-5.5、Gemini-3.8-Flash 的直接泄露接近零，推断性泄露率仍达 16.2–25.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM 个人助理可访问用户隐私信息，又需与第三方通信，存在泄露风险。现有基准只评估"直接泄露"（明确说出预设秘密或属性），忽略了模型回复中留下的间接线索所导致的"推断性泄露"，因而低估真实隐私风险。
AI.method: 构建 InferPriv 基准：设定"诚实但好奇"的接收方，从模型日常任务回复中尝试推断用户敏感属性；在该设定下评测五个前沿模型，并在不同提示（含隐私感知系统提示）下比较直接泄露与推断性泄露率。
AI.result: 跨模型、跨提示条件下，推断性泄露均显著高于直接泄露。在隐私感知系统提示下，GPT-6.1-Sol、Sonnet-5.5、Gemini-3.8-Flash 的直接泄露近乎为零，但推断性泄露率仍为 16.2%–25.2%。
AI.conclusion: 仅评估显式泄露会严重低估 LLM 个人助理的隐私风险；隐私评估与防护需将推断性泄露纳入考量。

title: Holding a Steady Course: Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons for Continual Agent Learning
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time. Existing approaches convert interaction trajectories into memories or reusable skills, but experience is not automatically reliable knowledge. Automatically collected skills and memories can propagate errors, mislead, and corrupt useful knowledge. To address this gap, we introduce Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons (KEEL), an agent-agnostic framework that uses verifier evidence to transform successful behavior into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons. As new evidence accumulates, individual skill claims can be supported, contradicted, replaced, or retired. On SkillFlow benchmark, KEEL improves task success by 4.2 to 21.7 percentage points over the no-knowledge baseline, compared with gains of 2.4 to 9.6 points from SkillFlow's default method. Ablations show that skills and lessons are complementary. These results show that reliable continual agent learning depends not simply on accumulating experience, but on continually validating and evolving the knowledge derived from it. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/KEEL-TTCL26.

AI.tldr: 提出KEEL框架，用验证器证据将成功行为转为可复用技能、失败转为纠错经验，并持续支持/反驳/替换/淘汰技能主张，在SkillFlow基准上提升4.2-21.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体在关联任务序列中难以持续保留和改进知识；现有方法将交互轨迹转为记忆或技能，但经验不等于可靠知识，自动收集的技能与记忆会传播错误、误导甚至污染有用知识。
AI.method: KEEL是与智能体无关的框架：利用验证器证据，把成功行为转化为可复用技能、失败转化为纠错经验（lessons）；随新证据累积，对每条技能主张进行支持、反驳、替换或淘汰的动态演化。
AI.result: 在SkillFlow基准上，KEEL较无知识基线提升4.2-21.7个百分点，而SkillFlow默认方法仅提升2.4-9.6；消融显示技能与经验互为补充。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的持续智能体学习不只依赖经验积累，更在于对所衍生知识进行持续验证与演化。

title: Late Breaking Results: Audio-Language-Action Models with Direct Speech Conditioning for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to DAC 2026 Late Breaking Results
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to follow instructions in typed text, limiting broader deployment in natural speech. The traditional solution by prepending a speech recognition before VLA to convert speech into texts would incur additional latency and propagate errors. To address this, we present Speech-$π_{0.5}$, which maps raw speech directly to motor commands without explicit textual transcriptions. Specifically, built on $π_{0.5}$, we use a cross-modal projection to convert voice frames directly into audio tokens with significant response latency reduction. To further improve the accuracy, we adopt split LoRA adaptation with dedicated audio and task adapters, under a two-stage training. Speech-$π_{0.5}$ achieves $3\times$ lower response latency than ASR pipeline while maintaining competitive task success on LIBERO, and generalizes robustly to unseen accents where a single adapter degrades significantly.

AI.tldr: Speech-π0.5 将原始语音直接映射为机器人动作指令，跳过文本转写，在保持任务成功率的同时将响应延迟降低约 3 倍，并具备更好的口音泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型只能接受文本指令，限制了自然语音场景下的部署；而"先 ASR 再 VLA"的传统方案会引入额外延迟并传播识别错误。
AI.method: 基于 π0.5 构建：用跨模态投影将语音帧直接转为音频 token，避免显式文本转写；采用分离式 LoRA（专用音频适配器与任务适配器）配合两阶段训练提升精度。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上任务成功率具竞争力，响应延迟比 ASR 流水线低 3 倍；对未见口音泛化稳健，而单一适配器方案性能显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 端到端语音到动作的映射是可行的，能兼顾低延迟与鲁棒性，为语音驱动的通用机器人策略提供了有效范式。

title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 16 references. Author's preprint; to be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

AI.tldr: 一篇面向工程师的LLM综述：从Transformer与预训练讲起，串起微调、RLHF、RAG、思维链、智能体，以及FlashAttention、QLoRA等效率技术，并给出生命周期图、方法对比表与LLM评估核查清单。
AI.motivation: 使用ChatGPT等生成式AI工具的工程师需要清楚理解"训练改变了什么""提示词又增加了什么"，同时现有文献多偏学术、缺少方法对比与评估陷阱的实操指引。
AI.method: 综述性阐述：以Transformer的上下文词关联和预训练（下一词预测）为起点，依次介绍微调与基于人类答案排序的RLHF、检索增强生成（RAG）、思维链提示与工具调用型智能体；并用FlashAttention降低注意力阶段数据搬运开销、用QLoRA节省微调显存。配套提供生命周期图、方法及其局限的对比表，以及评估核查清单。
AI.result: 形成一条从预训练到部署应用的完整技术脉络梳理，明确各技术解决的问题与代价（如效率与显存开销）；评估清单可用于识别数据污染（测试材料混入训练）和模型自评（LLM-as-a-judge）带来的误判，并讨论长上下文与幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: 理解LLM需区分训练赋予的能力与提示注入的信息；实践中应结合RAG、思维链、智能体与效率优化手段，并在评估时把"事实准确性"与"回答是否显得有帮助"分开判断。

title: SlowLab: Benchmarking Autonomous AI Agents on a Year of Experiments They Cannot Undo
comment: 16 pages (9 main text), 7 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/dingningpei/slowlab-benchmark
summary: AI agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous experimenters, yet the benchmarks that test them mostly offer cheap experiments that answer at once. Experiments in physical facilities are different: they take months, occupy scarce equipment and cannot be undone. We present SlowLab, a benchmark in which an agent runs a one-year campaign in four simulated greenhouse compartments on a site whose crop, facility and prices are hidden. The agent decides when to plant which climate policy, whether to stop a crop and which measurements to read while crops grow, and at the end recommends one policy, which a private evaluator scores in weather the agent never saw. In a preregistered study on 48 unseen sites, three low-cost language-model agents ended near a standard grower setting and clearly below a Bayesian-optimisation baseline that starts from that setting. They ran the facility as two synchronous batches, so measurements taken during the season never changed what they planted, and these measurements improved no method's result. Letting other methods re-read the evidence a campaign had collected did not yield significantly better recommendations, which points to where the models start and which experiments they try. Code is released under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: SlowLab 是一个评测自主实验型 AI agent 的基准，在隐蔽作物/设施/价格的模拟温室中进行为期一年、四隔间的长周期实验战役，48 个未见站点的预注册研究显示低成本 LLM agent 仅接近标准种植者设定，明显低于以该设定为起点的贝叶斯优化基线，且季节中测量从未改变其种植决策。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent 基准多为"低成本、一次即得答案"的实验，无法反映物理设施实验的真实约束：耗时数月、占用稀缺设备、不可撤销。因此需要一个体现长周期、昂贵、不可逆决策的基准来检验 agent 的自主实验能力。
AI.method: 构建 SlowLab：agent 在四个模拟温室隔间中运行一年期实验战役，作物、设施与价格均对其隐藏；agent 需决定何时种植、采用何种气候策略、是否中止作物、生长期间读取哪些测量，最终推荐一个策略，由私有评估器在 agent 从未见过的天气下打分。对 48 个未见站点开展预注册研究，对比三种低成本语言模型 agent、标准种植者设定与以该设定为起点的贝叶斯优化基线，并测试将已有证据重新交给其他方法解读的效果。
AI.result: 三种低成本 LLM agent 的成绩接近标准种植者设定，明显低于贝叶斯优化基线；它们将设施当作两个同步批次运行，导致季节中所做的测量从未改变种植决策，且这些测量未提升任何方法的结果；让其他方法重新读取战役已收集的证据，也未带来显著更优的推荐。
AI.conclusion: 瓶颈在于模型实验的起点选择和所尝试的实验设计，而非证据解读能力；代码以 MIT 许可发布。

title: A Sign Law for Entropy Drift under Sampler Mismatch in RLVR
summary: Entropy in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) moves up or down depending on choices that should be neutral, such as whether over-length responses are masked or counted as failures. We trace this to sampler mismatch, where rollouts are drawn with top-k/top-p truncation or at a temperature the learner does not apply, and prove that a constant advantage shift then changes the entropy of a softmax policy, at first order and in expectation, with a sign fixed by the sampler: positive shifts sharpen the policy under any sampler whose likelihood ratio to the policy increases with token probability, including top-k, top-p, min-p, and temperatures below one, and flatten it under flatter samplers. In group-based RLVR with token-level losses, the baseline-controlled part of this drift is set by the token-weighted net advantage, which masking and failing over-length responses can push to opposite signs; the remainder, a covariance between advantages and the sampler's sharpness gap, can feed back over long horizons. On a 2B model, the entropy slope is linear in shifts of the net advantage under truncated sampling and indistinguishable from flat under exact sampling, and token-level importance ratios leave 98% of the drift. In 100-step runs, a net-zero baseline only delays an entropy explosion that exact sampling does not show, a fixed positive shift delays it further, and a baseline weighted by the sharpness gap keeps entropy stable without changing the learner. On a 9B reasoning model over ten steps, the uncorrected rule loses held-out accuracy, whereas zeroing the net advantage or renormalizing the learner gains 8.2 and 8.8 points over it, with no held-out effect under exact sampling.

AI.tldr: 该文将 RLVR 中"看似中性"的选择（超长响应是否掩码/计为失败）导致的熵漂移归因于采样器不匹配（sampler mismatch），并证明常数优势偏移会一阶改变 softmax 策略熵，符号由采样器尖锐度决定；提出以尖锐度间隙加权的基线来稳定熵而不改动学习器。
AI.motivation: RLVR 训练中熵会因本应中性的决策上下波动，例如超长响应被掩码还是计为失败，导致训练不稳定、超参敏感。作者希望找出这一现象的机制根源，而非把熵当作需要额外正则的独立问题。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为采样器不匹配：rollout 用 top-k/top-p/min-p 截断或温度≠1 采样，而学习器按完整 softmax 更新。理论上证明常数优势偏移在一阶期望意义下改变 softmax 策略熵，符号由采样器对策略的似然比是否随 token 概率增大而增大决定（top-k/top-p/min-p/低温→变尖锐；更平坦的采样器→变平坦）。在基于组、token 级损失的 RLVR 中，漂移的可控部分由 token 加权净优势决定（掩码与失败计分可使其符号相反），剩余部分为优势与采样器尖锐度间隙的协方差，可在长程中反馈。实验：2B 模型、100 步训练、9B 推理模型十步微调。
AI.result: 2B 模型上：截断采样下熵斜率对净优势偏移呈线性，精确采样下与平坦不可区分；token 级重要性比率仅消除 98% 的漂移。100 步训练中：净零基线只延迟熵爆炸（精确采样无此现象），固定正偏移进一步延迟，而按尖锐度间隙加权的基线使熵稳定且不改变学习器。9B 推理模型十步内：未校正规则导致 held-out 准确率下降，将净优势归零或重归一化学习器分别提升 8.2 与 8.8 分；精确采样下无 held-out 差异。
