We introduce a training-free sketch probe with three readouts: temporal part-construction order, spatial attention-based grounding, and the mechanistic layer/head locus of grounding. We evaluate nine LVLMs on part order and five on the attention readouts, over two part-annotated sketch datasets. Three findings emerge. First, LVLM part order tracks human convention: models reproduce canonical orderings where human drawings converge, and become correspondingly variable where human orderings vary. Controls that blank, withhold, and mismatch the sketch locate this convention in the language model. Second, part-level grounding survives the abstraction: attention heads selected from the frozen model with an existing recipe recover part and object regions on object and scene sketches, with no grounding supervision. Third, the grounding signal concentrates in a narrow mid-network band whose location follows the base language model rather than parameter count in the two families we compare, and remains stable across object and scene sketches. The result is a practical diagnostic for sketch-driven LVLMs: no fine-tuning, no auxiliary segmenter, and a layer band that doubles as a head-selection prior, matching or improving grounding mAcc@0.1 in every model and dataset we tested.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的草图探针，用部件构建顺序、注意力定位和机制定位三种读出方式，揭示LVLM保留的视觉约定及其所在位置。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM基准只判断答案对错，无法揭示模型保留了哪些视觉约定、这些约定存在于何处；草图剥离纹理与光照、保留结构笔画，可作为探测结构性表征的天然工具。
AI.method: 训练无关的草图探针，三种读出：(1)时间上的部件构建顺序，(2)基于注意力的空间定位，(3)定位的层/头机制位置。在9个LVLM上测部件顺序、5个测注意力读出，覆盖两个带部件标注的草图数据集；并用置空、扣留、错配草图等对照实验。
AI.result: (1)LVLM部件顺序与人类约定一致：人类绘制收敛处模型复现规范顺序，人类差异处模型也相应多变，对照实验将该约定定位在语言模型；(2)无定位监督条件下，用现有配方在冻结模型上选出的注意力头可恢复目标与场景草图的部件/物体区域；(3)定位信号集中于狭窄的中层网络带，其位置随基座语言模型而非参数量变化，且跨数据集稳定。
AI.conclusion: 提供实用诊断工具：无需微调、无需辅助分割器，且该层带可作为头选择先验，在所有测试模型与数据集上匹配或提升mAcc@0.1定位性能。

title: Text Is the Bottleneck: A Small-Scale Replication of LLM Game Playing in Riichi Mahjong
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Replication of the riichi-mahjong track of arXiv:2509.01328. Code, configurations and ~3,200 arena game logs released; no trained weights (Tenhou data terms)
summary: We replicate the riichi-mahjong track of "Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?" (arXiv:2509.01328) under a drastically smaller budget: models of at most 2B parameters, one 16 GB consumer GPU, about five GPU-days. (1) With matched data and labels, text is the bottleneck: on the same 100k-decision training set, a 2.6M-parameter convolutional board encoder agrees with the strong AI Mortal on 80.6% of test decisions, above every text-prompt LLM we train (best 77.8%), and places better at the table (2.85 over 1,000 games vs. ~3.0 for the LLMs; paired difference at n=100 not significant). Scaled to 1.71M decisions, a 4.9M-parameter Transformer reaches 94.7% agreement, beats the 0.8B LLMs on identical seeds (-0.45 ranks, sign test p=0.005), and is statistically equivalent to parity against three Mortal champions (TOST within 0.10 ranks, p=6e-4); parity against a teacher-opponent is roughly the ceiling of pure imitation. (2) Training toward the teacher raises teacher agreement more than a 2.5x parameter increase does (+2.5 vs. +1.5 points); on human-record agreement both effects are +1.0, and neither is visible at the table. (3) Few-point agreement differences do not resolve into playing strength within a family: +2.5 agreement points coincide with a paired placement difference of +0.02 +/- 0.12 ranks (p=1.0), and +2.0 points at 2B with -0.06 (p=0.37) - both below the ~0.25-rank resolution of 100 paired games. We also document a paper-code mismatch in the original winner filter, reconstruct its two private engine patches, and show that a divide-and-conquer pipeline makes template-generated Japanese rationales 93% sentence-exact (43% without facts). Per Tenhou's terms we release no trained weights - only code, configurations, and evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 在极小预算（≤2B模型、单张16GB消费级GPU、约5 GPU-天）下复现立直麻将赛道，发现文本是瓶颈、小型专用网络可媲美甚至超越LLM，且少量一致性分差无法转化为牌桌实力。
AI.motivation: 原论文"Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?"的立直麻将实验成本高昂；作者希望在极小预算下复现，并检验LLM在复杂卡牌游戏中是否真的受限于文本表示，以及教师一致性与实际牌桌表现之间的关系。
AI.method: （1）在相同10万决策数据上对比2.6M卷积棋盘编码器与文本提示LLM；扩展到171万决策训练4.9M参数Transformer；（2）对比"朝教师训练"与"参数扩大2.5倍"对教师一致性的影响；（3）用配对对局分析一致性分差与牌桌排名差异；此外还复现原论文胜者过滤器（发现论文-代码不一致）、重建两个私有引擎补丁，并用分治流水线生成日文推理文本。
AI.result: 10万数据上CNN与Mortal一致率80.6%，高于所有文本LLM（最佳77.8%），上桌排名2.85 vs ~3.0（n=100不显著）；171万数据上4.9M Transformer达94.7%，胜过0.8B LLM（-0.45名次，p=0.005），与三个Mortal冠军统计等价（TOST p=6e-4）。朝教师训练比扩大参数更有效（+2.5 vs +1.5点）；但一致性提升在牌桌上不可见（+2.5点对应+0.02±0.12名次，p=1.0）。分治流水线使模板日文推理句子完全匹配率达93%（无事实时43%）。
AI.conclusion: 在立直麻将中，文本输入是LLM的瓶颈，小型专用网络以极低成本即可达到与强AI相当的水平；教师一致性小幅提升无法解析为牌桌实力差异；同时揭示了原论文的代码-论文不一致问题。因Tenhou条款，仅发布代码、配置与评测协议，不发布权重。

title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
summary: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain shifts, improving both retention and adaptation. These results highlight the importance of jointly preserving procedural experience and internalizing the competence to transfer and execute it across tasks.

AI.tldr: HaMo 提出"工具架-模型"协同框架，将快速非参数化经验积累（策略级经验卡检索）与缓慢参数化适应（经验条件持续学习）结合，提升长程 Web 智能体在域内与跨域场景下的保持与适应能力。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体反复遇到可复用的过程性知识，但现有系统要么依赖模型参数适应、要么依赖外部记忆，二者以持久学习换取快速复用，无法兼得；这对需重复执行相关多步工作流的 Web 智能体尤为关键。
AI.method: HaMo 包含三部分：(1) 将轨迹蒸馏为策略级"经验卡"以支持即时检索；(2) 经验条件化的持续学习目标，训练模型在变化情境中解读、落地并执行检索到的策略；(3) 基于检索覆盖度的选择机制，挑选紧凑且互补的轨迹用于参数更新。
AI.result: 实验表明，在域内与跨域分布偏移下，HaMo 均优于仅工具架式与仅模型式适应方法，在保持性与适应性两方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明，同时保留过程性经验并内化其迁移与执行能力至关重要，快速经验复用与慢速参数内化应当协同而非二选一。

title: Reasoning or Just Prompting? Probing the Mechanism of Latent Chemical Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning performs intermediate computation in continuous space rather than through explicit tokens, which is particularly appealing in chemistry, where errors in explicit reasoning can propagate to the final answer. Yet if latent states truly constitute an implicit reasoning chain, they should be causally important. We find otherwise: swapping or moderately perturbing intermediate latent states has little effect on performance, while removing them entirely sometimes causes a substantial score drop. Thus, the latent states matter, but their molecule-specific content appears to matter far less. This points to a simpler interpretation. Rather than encoding a step-by-step reasoning chain, latent states may primarily steer subsequent model computation, much like soft prompts. Indeed, a single fixed prefix shared across molecules reproduces LatentChem's performance, and a learned static soft prompt performs comparably to per-input latent generation in controlled models. The tolerance of latent sequences to substitution and moderate perturbation further supports this connection. We therefore suggest that latent chemical reasoning may be better viewed as soft prompting than as a reasoning chain hidden in continuous space.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"隐空间推理"是否真为推理链：实验表明中间隐状态被替换或中度扰动几乎不影响性能，仅整体移除才显著下降，说明其作用更像软提示而非分子特异推理内容。
AI.motivation: 化学领域显式推理错误会传导至最终答案，故隐空间推理（连续空间中间计算）颇具吸引力。但若隐状态真构成隐式推理链，其内容应对结果具有因果重要性。作者据此检验这一核心假设。
AI.method: 对中间隐状态做三类干预实验：交换（swapping）、中度扰动、整体移除；并比较"跨分子共享的固定前缀"与LatentChem性能，以及在受控模型中使用学习到的静态软提示与逐输入隐状态生成进行对比。
AI.result: 交换或中度扰动中间隐状态对性能影响很小，整体移除有时导致显著分数下降；单一固定前缀可复现LatentChem性能，静态软提示与逐输入隐生成表现相当；隐序列对替换与扰动具有容忍性。
AI.conclusion: 隐状态重要但分子特异内容影响有限，隐空间化学推理更应被理解为软提示（steering），而非隐藏在连续空间中的推理链。

title: Learning the Autoregressive: Direct Score-Difference Estimation with Amortized Future Credit for Video Distillation
summary: Few-step distillation for autoregressive (AR) video generation commonly first initializes an AR student and then refines it with distribution matching distillation (DMD). This refinement process faces two challenges. First, although initialization already yields a reasonably capable student, DMD obtains the refinement direction indirectly by estimating the full student score before forming the teacher-student correction. Second, detached-history training prevents the generator from assigning credit to a current chunk for its influence on subsequent chunks. We introduce Leta, a few-step distillation framework that addresses these challenges with ScoreDelta and FutureCredit. ScoreDelta directly estimates the teacher-student correction from denoising residuals, while FutureCredit learns an auxiliary cross-chunk update signal from vector-Jacobian products (VJPs) of next-chunk teacher residuals. Leta combines these signals into a joint teacher-guided update field in a single forward pass during generator updates. Teacher evaluations and credit VJPs are used only for estimator training. For ScoreDelta, we establish population equivalence to score-difference estimation and a conditional approximation advantage under limited capacity in a fixed-feature linear model. In our controlled experiments, Leta improves over DMD by 0.9 points on VBench and 0.66 on VideoAlign. This advantage persists at a higher generator update frequency (a generator-to-estimator update ratio of G:E=1:1), where Leta improves over DMD by 1.6 on VBench and 0.35 on VideoAlign. Project page: https://scdzx.github.io/Leta/.

AI.tldr: Leta 是一个少步蒸馏框架，用 ScoreDelta 和 FutureCredit 两个信号解决自回归视频生成中 DMD 精炼方向间接估计与历史截断训练的问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成的少步蒸馏通常先初始化 AR 学生模型再用 DMD 精炼，但 DMD 存在两个问题：一是需先估计完整学生 score 再构造教师-学生修正，精炼方向是间接得到的；二是 detached-history 训练使生成器无法把当前 chunk 对后续 chunk 的影响计入信用分配。
AI.method: 提出 ScoreDelta：直接从去噪残差估计教师-学生修正；FutureCredit：由下一 chunk 教师残差的 VJP 学习跨 chunk 的辅助更新信号；生成器更新时在单次前向中将两信号合成为联合教师引导更新场，教师评估与信用 VJP 仅用于估计器训练。并从理论上给出 ScoreDelta 与 score-difference 估计的总体等价性，以及固定特征线性模型下有限容量时的条件近似优势。
AI.result: 受控实验中 Leta 在 VBench 上比 DMD 高 0.9 分、VideoAlign 高 0.66；在更高生成器更新频率（G:E=1:1）下优势扩大至 VBench +1.6、VideoAlign +0.35。
AI.conclusion: Leta 通过直接估计教师-学生修正并引入跨 chunk 信用分配，在少步自回归视频蒸馏中稳定优于 DMD，且在生成器更新更频繁时优势更明显。

title: Position Matters More Than Channel: Talking a Language Model Out of a Correct Answer
summary: Language models now answer questions alongside other claims: a note in the system prompt, a message from another agent, their own earlier answer. We ask what it takes to talk a model out of an answer it gets right on its own, and separate three factors that earlier studies vary together: where the advice sits in the prompt, who is said to have written it, and what the model has already written. On Qwen3.5-27B and four-option MMLU-Pro items, with the rest of the advice held fixed in each comparison, we find three things. First, position matters far more than the API channel, in opposite directions for a bare claim and an argument: a bare "the answer is X" does most harm just before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, where it raises error on items the model otherwise almost never misses from 1% to 67%; moving the claim between the system message and the user message at the same position changes error by a few points. Second, attributing the note to an authority rather than to another participant, and phrasing it assertively, each raise error by 10-27 points, while the two authorities we tested differ by under two. Third, replaying a correct worked answer before the advice protects it whether the text is shown as the model's own or as someone else's, and the same replay keeps wrong answers from being corrected by a bare correct note. The position result replicates under an independently written prompt. Code, items and all result tables are released at https://github.com/coolkillercat/safety.

AI.tldr: 该研究拆解"被说服改错"的三个变量（位置、署名、模型已写内容），在Qwen3.5-27B的四选项MMLU-Pro上发现：位置影响最大且方向取决于主张是否带理由，署名权威与断言语气各使错误率升高10-27点，而预先复述一个正确的完整解题过程既能保护正确答案、也能阻止错误答案被纠正。
AI.motivation: 现实中模型会在系统提示、其他智能体消息、自己先前回答等处遇到"答案主张"，但以往研究把三个因素混在一起变动，无法判断究竟哪个因素在驱动模型放弃自己原本正确的答案。作者希望把"位置、署名、已写内容"三者分离开，弄清各自的作用。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-27B与四选项MMLU-Pro题目上做受控实验，每次比较只改变一个因素、其余建议内容固定：(1) 建议在提示中的位置（问题前 vs 作答前）与API通道（系统消息 vs 用户消息）；(2) 主张写法（裸主张 vs 附错误理由的论证）与署名对象（权威 vs 其他参与者）、语气（断言 vs 非断言）；(3) 在建议前重放一个正确的分步解答，并分别标注为模型自己或他人所写。位置效应用独立撰写的提示进行复现验证。
AI.result: 1) 位置远比通道重要，且裸主张与带错误理由的论证方向相反：裸"答案是X"在作答前最有害；带错误理由的同一主张在问题前最有害，能把模型本来几乎从不做错的题目错误率从1%提到67%；同一位置下在系统消息与用户消息间移动只造成几个百分点的变化。2) 署名权威而非其他参与者、以及断言式措辞，各使错误率上升10-27个百分点，而所测两种权威之间差异不到2点。3) 在建议前重放一个正确的分步解答，无论标为自身还是他人所写，都能保护正确答案；同一重放也会使错误答案无法被裸正确提示纠正。
AI.conclusion: 模型"被说服改错"不是一个单一现象：位置决定脆弱窗口，且最优位置取决于攻击形态（裸主张在作答前、带理由论证在问题前）；社会线索（权威、断言语气）是独立且显著的放大器；而模型已写出的推理内容具有强粘性，既能锁定正确答案、也能锁定错误答案，表现为双向的"锚定/防御"效应。作者释放了代码、题目与全部结果表。

title: SKALOS: Learning to Distinguish Similar Skills with Capability Graphs
summary: Skills provide LLM agents with reusable procedural knowledge, making appropriate skill selection essential for reliable agent behavior. As skill libraries expand, distinguishing semantically similar candidates becomes increasingly difficult. Existing methods encode or rewrite skill descriptions for relevance-based ranking, yet heterogeneous descriptions can obscure capability differences. To address this challenge, we propose SKALOS, a graph-native reranker that compares skills via explicit capability evidence. Its multi-hierarchy graph aligns equivalent expressions across skills while preserving skill-specific capability evidence. Since individually relevant capability elements may not jointly support a query, semiring-based capability witness learning scores each branch by its weakest evidence, checks joint support for the extracted requirements within one implementation, and selects the strongest alternative. To reduce the influence of extraction errors, we develop ranking-feedback graph calibration that adjusts unreliable evidence for candidate comparison. Experiments on SkillRet show that SKALOS improves NDCG@10 by 2.68 percentage points over a matched text-only reranker. Witness-guided skill selection also increases ALFWorld task success rate from 22% to 29%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKALOS，一种图原生重排序器，通过显式能力证据比较技能，以解决技能库扩张时语义相似候选难以区分的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖可复用的技能库，技能选择至关重要。随着技能库扩大，语义相似的候选难以区分；现有基于编码或改写描述的 relevancy 排序方法，会因描述异构而掩盖能力差异。
AI.method: SKALOS采用多层级图对齐不同技能间的等价表达，同时保留技能特有的能力证据；引入基于半环的能力见证学习，按最强证据（最弱环节）为每个分支打分，检验提取的需求能否在同一实现中获得联合支持，并选出最强替代；此外提出排序反馈图校准，调整不可靠证据以降低抽取误差影响。
AI.result: 在SkillRet上，NDCG@10相较匹配的纯文本重排序器提升2.68个百分点；在ALFWorld上，见证引导的技能选择将任务成功率从22%提升至29%。
AI.conclusion: 以显式能力证据而非表层描述相似度进行图原生重排序，能有效提升技能检索与智能体任务表现。

title: Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization: Pre-empting Catastrophic Forgetting via Dynamic Feedback
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) of LLMs suffers from catastrophic forgetting, and prevailing mitigation strategies struggle to reconcile the plasticity-stability dilemma. To address this, we propose Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization (ECHO), a closed-loop control framework. By decomposing the KL divergence, we identify output entropy as a dominant observable component of KL variation. This enables us to leverage entropy as a computationally efficient online proxy to monitor forgetting risks in real-time, bypassing expensive reference-model inference. Consequently, ECHO employs an elastic controller that dynamically modulates the gradient weight of replay data via a proportional control law, using deviations from the pre-trained entropic equilibrium as an error signal. Empirical evaluations across 0.6B to 9B parameter architectures demonstrate that ECHO lies on, and in several comparisons extends, the observed plasticity-stability frontier and maintains high operational robustness against varying data mixing ratios.

AI.tldr: 提出 ECHO 闭环控制框架，用输出熵作为实时遗忘风险代理信号，通过比例控制动态调整回放数据梯度权重，缓解 SFT 中的灾难性遗忘并平衡可塑性-稳定性权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM 的监督微调（SFT）存在灾难性遗忘，现有缓解策略难以兼顾可塑性与稳定性（plasticity-stability dilemma）。
AI.method: 通过分解 KL 散度，发现输出熵是 KL 变化的主要可观测分量，据此将熵作为在线、低成本的遗忘风险代理，免去参考模型推理。ECHO 采用弹性控制器，以偏离预训练熵平衡的偏差作为误差信号，按比例控制律动态调制回放数据的梯度权重。
AI.result: 在 0.6B–9B 参数模型上评估，ECHO 位于并在多项比较中扩展了观测到的可塑性-稳定性前沿，且在不同数据混合比例下保持较高运行鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 以熵为代理的闭环控制是缓解 SFT 遗忘的有效且高效方案，具备良好可扩展性与鲁棒性。

title: LegoOcc++: Towards Consistent Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction is important for embodied agents operating in complex environments whose semantic categories extend beyond fixed taxonomies. While recent studies have explored open-vocabulary occupancy in outdoor driving scenarios, indoor environments remain challenging due to dense occlusions, complex geometry, and fine-grained long-tailed semantics. To reduce the need for expensive voxel-level semantic annotations, we study a geometry-only supervision setting requiring only binary occupancy labels. We build upon Language-Embedded Gaussians as a unified representation coupling 3D geometry with language-aligned semantics. For geometry learning, we introduce an opacity-aware Poisson-based Gaussian-to-Occupancy formulation that enables stable volumetric aggregation under binary occupancy supervision. For semantic learning, we render Gaussian features into images and align them with a frozen open-vocabulary model, together with Progressive Temperature Decay to reduce feature mixing during Gaussian splatting. Building on this framework, we further introduce Instance-Level Semantic Consistency to alleviate fragmented object predictions, and Covisibility-Aware Support-View Selection to provide informative and less redundant multi-view semantic supervision. We also extend our framework to outdoor driving scenarios to evaluate its generality across substantially different environments. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves strong open-vocabulary occupancy performance, validating the effectiveness and generality of our framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/JuIvyy/LegoOcc.

AI.tldr: 提出LegoOcc框架，在仅用二值占据标签的几何监督下实现室内外开放词汇3D占据预测，基于语言嵌入高斯表示，通过不透明度感知Poisson高斯特到占据公式、冻结开放词汇模型的特征渲染对齐、渐进温度衰减、实例级语义一致性与共视感知支持视图选择，取得强开放词汇占据性能。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇3D占据预测对在复杂环境中工作的具身智能体很重要，但室内场景因密集遮挡、复杂几何和细粒度长尾语义而困难；同时体素级语义标注昂贵，因此研究仅需二值占据标签的几何监督设置。
AI.method: 以语言嵌入高斯作为耦合几何与语言对齐语义的统一表示。几何学习：引入不透明度感知的Poisson高斯到占据公式，在二值占据监督下实现稳定体积聚合。语义学习：将高斯特征渲染为图像并与冻结开放词汇模型对齐，配合渐进温度衰减减少泼溅中的特征混合；进一步提出实例级语义一致性缓解物体预测碎片化，以及共视感知支持视图选择提供信息丰富且冗余较少的多视图语义监督。并将框架扩展到室外驾驶场景验证通用性。
AI.result: 在室内和室外基准上的大量实验表明，该方法取得强的开放词汇占据性能，验证了框架的有效性与通用性。
AI.conclusion: LegoOcc证明仅依赖二值占据几何监督、结合语言嵌入高斯与开放词汇对齐，也能有效实现室内外开放词汇3D占据预测，具备跨环境通用性。

title: Semantic Atoms for Scalable Text Analysis in Data Analytics in the Era of LLM-Based Agents
summary: Much of the information needed for data analysis is buried in text columns: an analyst may infer customer frustration from complaint text and use it to explain resolution time. We call workloads in which processing text columns is central to subsequent data analysis TADA (\emph{Text Analysis in Data Analytics}). In an agentic setting, the user's query dynamically specifies this processing, and answering it interleaves LLM-based semantic steps with exact SQL or Python operations. This mixed execution raises two design questions: which work should be neural and which symbolic, and which semantic outputs later steps can reuse. We address them for agent-planned TADA workflows with two complementary, query-driven semantic atoms. Each atom takes a sequence of text items and a natural-language query specifying the semantic task: \textbf{Tagging} returns one string per input item, while \textbf{Categorization} returns $M$ category objects over $N$ input items. Tagging results are materialized as a row-aligned column and Categorization results as a category table; SQL or Python then performs exact computation over this exposed state. We realize this interface in TADA-Agent, whose atoms run inside generated Python programs and internally handle inputs beyond a reliable context window. We evaluate TADA-Agent on TABench, a benchmark of 40 complete analysis requests over spreadsheet tables spanning workflow composition, input--output structure, and literature-grounded analytical scenarios. Against a semantic-operator baseline and relative to a held-out TADA reference run, TADA-Agent delivers comparable row-level semantic quality, has higher complete-artifact preservation estimates, and uses over an order of magnitude fewer semantic-model requests under the evaluated native execution paths.

AI.tldr: 提出TADA（文本分析融入数据分析）场景及两个查询驱动的语义原子（Tagging、Categorization），实现TADA-Agent，并在新基准TABench上验证其语义质量相当、完整产物保留率更高、语义模型调用少一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 数据分析信息常埋藏在文本列中，用户查询动态指定文本处理方式，需混合LLM语义步骤与精确SQL/Python操作。由此产生两个设计问题：哪些工作应由神经模型完成、哪些应由符号操作完成，以及后续步骤可复用哪些语义输出。
AI.method: 针对agent规划的TADA工作流，设计两种互补的查询驱动语义原子：Tagging（每个输入项返回一个字符串）与Categorization（对N个输入项返回M个类别对象）。结果分别物化为行对齐列和类别表，再由SQL/Python对暴露状态做精确计算。该接口实现在TADA-Agent中，原子运行于生成的Python程序内，并内部处理超出可靠上下文窗口的输入。
AI.result: 在TABench（40个完整分析请求、跨电子表格表格、覆盖工作流组合/输入-输出结构/文献支撑场景）上，对比语义算子基线并以留出参考运行为参照：TADA-Agent行级语义质量相当，完整产物保留估计更高，且在评估的原生执行路径下语义模型请求减少一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 将语义处理收束为可物化的查询驱动原子（Tagging/Categorization）并与精确SQL/Python执行分离，是构建agent驱动TADA工作流的有效设计：兼顾语义质量，提升产物完整性，大幅降低语义模型调用开销。

title: Query-Driven Learning for Lifted Reasoning
summary: Learning and reasoning are both essential to intelligent agents, but have traditionally been treated as two separate stages: first learning a knowledge base from data (or taking one as given), and then verifying queries as if the knowledge base were complete. This separation has been shown to be inefficient when the downstream goal is to verify only a small set of queries. Moreover, it neglects the possibility that data and a knowledge base contain partial yet complementary information, requiring an agent to combine both sources to justify or refute a query. Motivated by the need to integrate learning and reasoning more tightly, we study the problem of query-driven learning for reasoning. More specifically, we extend prior work to the first-order setting, which is critical for practical applications as the number of ground atoms typically grows rapidly. We begin by asking when validating or refuting a universal query given partial data and knowledge base is even possible, and identify a necessary and sufficient condition called bounded concealment. We then propose a quasi-polynomial-time algorithm that solves the task at the lifted level. Finally, we establish soundness and completeness guarantees relative to space-bounded lifted proofs, along with quasipolynomial sample and runtime bounds, demonstrating that lifted query-driven reasoning can be efficient even when unrestricted knowledge-base learning is not.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"查询驱动学习"扩展到一阶逻辑设定，提出一种在提升（lifted）层面的准多项式时间算法，用于在部分数据与知识库下验证或反驳全称查询。
AI.motivation: 传统方法把学习与推理分为两个阶段（先学完整知识库再验证查询），在只需验证少量查询时效率低下，且忽略了数据与知识库可能含有部分但互补的信息。因此需要更紧密地结合学习与推理，即查询驱动的推理学习，并将其推广到对实际应用更关键的一阶设定（ground atom 数量爆炸）。
AI.method: 首先分析给定部分数据与知识库时验证/反驳全称查询是否可行，提出充要条件"bounded concealment"；随后设计在 lifted 层面求解该任务的准多项式时间算法，并给出相对于空间受限 lifted 证明的可靠性与完备性保证。
AI.result: 建立了 soundness 与 completeness 保证（相对于空间受限的 lifted 证明），并给出准多项式的样本复杂度与运行时间界，表明即使无限制的知识库学习不可行，lifted 查询驱动推理依然可以高效完成。
AI.conclusion: 查询驱动的一阶推理在可行条件下可以高效实现，为学习与推理的深度融合提供了理论基础。

title: SRA: Selective Residual Adaptation for LLM Reasoning Enhancement
summary: Knowledge distillation transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight students. However, distilled small models still struggle with multi-step reasoning. We observe that the distribution divergences between teacher and student models along reasoning paths are highly sparse, and target tokens almost always fall within the student top-$K$ candidate set. Based on this finding, unlike approaches updating student backbones or requiring runtime teacher computation, we propose Selective Residual Adaptation (SRA), a plug-and-play framework that internalizes localized corrections. Concretely, SRA employs a Discrepancy Gate to identify divergence positions alongside a Candidate Residual Adapter for top-$K$ logit calibration to correct the mismatch. Theoretically, we establish error bounds ensuring strict sequence level performance gains. Across mathematical benchmarks on Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 4B, SRA consistently enhances distilled student models, raising average Pass@16 by up to 4.37 percentage points while preserving general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用框架SRA，通过定位师生分布稀疏差异位点并对top-K logits做残差校准，以极低成本提升蒸馏小模型的多步推理能力。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏得到的小模型在多步推理上仍表现不佳。作者观察到：师生在推理路径上的分布差异高度稀疏，且目标token几乎总落在学生的top-K候选集内，因此无需更新学生主干或运行时调用教师。
AI.method: SRA由两部分组成：Discrepancy Gate用于识别分布分歧的位置；Candidate Residual Adapter在top-K候选logits上进行残差校准以修正不匹配。方法为即插即用，不修改学生backbone。理论上给出误差界，保证严格的序列级性能提升。
AI.result: 在Qwen3 0.6B–4B模型的数学基准上，SRA持续提升蒸馏学生模型，平均Pass@16最高提升4.37个百分点，同时保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 利用师生差异的稀疏性，SRA以轻量局部校正实现高效推理蒸馏，无需改动主干或运行时教师计算，兼具理论保证与实证收益。

title: StickFigure: Enabling Pose-Only IoT Cameras for Privacy-Preserving Edge Vision
summary: Indoor IoT cameras can support assisted living and activity-aware spaces, but exporting raw RGB frames raises privacy concerns by exposing facial, clothing, and household details that body-motion tasks often do not require. We present StickFigure, a pose-only IoT camera system that, during real-time monitoring, keeps raw frames local and ephemeral while exporting only compact skeleton streams sufficient for downstream human activity recognition (HAR). While pose estimation has matured on GPUs, extracting accurate pose streams on resource-constrained IoT cameras remains difficult. To overcome these challenges and enable on-device pose streams on (almost) any IoT camera, we present two core designs in StickFigure: an activation-aware pose backbone that allocates channel capacity after spatial downsampling and a lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner that selectively corrects elbow and wrist coordinates using intermediate visual features and kinematic context. We fully implement StickFigure and evaluate it on public benchmarks and real-world deployment. Compared with state-of-the-art MCU pose models, StickFigure achieves the highest pose accuracy and downstream HAR utility on both NTU RGB+D and Penn Action, while using 96.5% fewer parameters and 99.3% fewer MACs per frame than RTMPose-S-based baselines, achieving 0.107 s p95 latency on a representative STM32H753 MCU. We believe StickFigure establishes a new operating point for privacy-aware edge vision on massive IoT cameras.

AI.tldr: 提出 StickFigure，一种仅输出骨架的姿态流IoT相机系统：原始RGB帧本地即用即弃，仅导出紧凑骨架流供下游动作识别使用；通过激活感知姿态骨干与轻量级分层MLP精修器，在资源受限MCU上实现高精度姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 室内IoT相机虽可支持辅助生活与活动感知，但导出原始RGB帧会泄露面部、衣着和家居细节等隐私信息，而这些信息往往并非人体动作任务所需。同时，GPU上成熟的姿态估计方法难以直接部署到算力受限的IoT相机上。
AI.method: StickFigure将原始帧保留在本地且短暂存储，仅导出紧凑骨架流。核心设计有二：(1) 激活感知的姿态骨干网络，在空间下采样之后再分配通道容量；(2) 轻量级分层MLP精修器，利用中间视觉特征与运动学上下文，选择性校正肘部和腕部坐标。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D与Penn Action上，相比基于RTMPose-S的SOTA MCU姿态模型，StickFigure取得最高的姿态精度与下游HAR效用，参数减少96.5%、每帧MACs减少99.3%，在STM32H753 MCU上p95延迟为0.107秒。已完整实现并通过公开基准与真实部署验证。
AI.conclusion: StickFigure为海量IoT相机上的隐私感知边缘视觉建立了新的工作点：在不导出原始图像的前提下，实现可用于下游HAR的高精度、低延迟端侧姿态流。

title: Adaptive Retrieval, Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agentic RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. Across the six configurations, higher target levels are accompanied by higher observed full-support rates and reduced answer availability. At the 95% target, non-empty response coverage ranges from 17.23% to 60.17%, claim retention from 10.72% to 43.16%, and full support among non-empty outputs from 89.14% to 95.56%. We formulate the adaptive retrieval trajectory explicitly and characterize the reliability-informativeness trade-off when conformal factuality is applied after agent termination.

AI.tldr: 将单阶段RAG的claim级conformal factuality方法移植到agentic RAG（策略自适应检索/终止）中，在6个模型-数据集配置上评估可靠性-信息量权衡。
AI.motivation: 已有工作研究单阶段与多跳RAG的claim级conformal factuality，但agentic RAG（LLM策略自适应发起后续检索或提前终止）下的行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 沿用基于检索的相关性打分与生成后conformal过滤；显式刻画自适应检索轨迹；评估GPT-6 Luna与Llama 3.1 8B在HotpotQA、Natural Questions、TriviaQA上的共6个配置，每配置60道固定问题、100个带种子的30/30校准-测试划分、5个conformal目标水平及无CP基线。
AI.result: 6个配置中目标水平越高，观测到的full-support率越高而答案可得性下降。95%目标下：非空回答覆盖率17.23%–60.17%，claim保留率10.72%–43.16%，非空输出中full support达89.14%–95.56%。
AI.conclusion: 在agent终止后再施加conformal factuality，会形成明显的可靠性-信息量权衡；显式建模检索轨迹有助于分析该权衡。

title: The Right Fact, the Wrong Decision: SciValidityBench for Scientific Agent Memory
summary: Most agent-memory benchmarks frame long-term memory as retrieval: can an agent recover the relevant record from a long and evolving history? Scientific agents face a stricter problem: a correctly remembered fact may still be invalid to use. The same reported test result can support confirmation when the outcome and stopping rule were fixed in advance, yet only exploration when the outcome was selected from twenty inspected results. We call this scientific use validity: whether remembered evidence is eligible to influence a decision under the state governing its interpretation. We introduce SciValidityBench, an executable benchmark factory with 64 TaskSpecs spanning five validity modules and six scientific domains. TaskSpecs couple generated experimental histories with scientific-state definitions, programmatic decision oracles, controlled interventions, and automatic scoring. The SciStateForge compiler-reader framework turns distributed histories into explicit decision-governing state. Counterfactual pairs and targeted corruption-repair controls then test whether models use those dependencies and localize failures. Across four model families, compiled scientific state improves valid decision-making by 9.2-18.8 percentage points over a generic Event Graph. Retrieval alone does not reproduce this cross-family gain, while content-identical flat and typed views show that the improvement comes from exposing governing state rather than a particular graph serialization. SciValidityBench thus shifts memory evaluation from finding the right fact to deciding whether that fact should control the decision.

AI.tldr: 提出SciValidityBench基准与SciStateForge框架，将科学智能体的长时记忆评测从"能否检索到正确事实"推进到"该事实是否有资格影响决策"，即科学使用有效性（scientific use validity）。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆基准把长时记忆视为检索问题（能否从长且演化的历史中找回相关记录）。但科学智能体面临更严格的问题：一个被正确记住的事实仍可能不适用于当前决策——同一实验结果在结果与停止规则预先确定时可支持确证，若结果是从二十次考察中挑选出来的则只能算探索。因此需要评测"记忆证据在支配其解释的状态下是否有资格影响决策"。
AI.method: 构建SciValidityBench：可执行基准工厂，含64个TaskSpec，覆盖五个有效性模块与六个科学领域。每个TaskSpec将生成的实验历史与科学状态定义、程序化决策oracle、受控干预和自动评分相耦合。核心为SciStateForge编译器—读取器框架，把分布式历史编译为显式的决策支配状态。再用反事实配对与定向腐蚀—修复控制实验检验模型是否真正依赖这些状态依赖关系，并定位失败点。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族上，编译得到的科学状态相较通用事件图（Event Graph）使有效决策提升9.2–18.8个百分点。仅靠检索无法复现这一跨家族增益；内容相同但组织不同的扁平视图与类型化视图对比表明，提升来自"显式暴露支配状态"而非某种图序列化形式。
AI.conclusion: SciValidityBench将记忆评测重心从"找到正确事实"转向"判断该事实是否应支配决策"，强调科学智能体需具备使用有效性推断能力。

title: CORMA: Constraint-Routed Decision Mamba for Generalizable Multi-Constraint Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline safe reinforcement learning (RL) learns safety-aware policies from static datasets while satisfying safety constraints during deployment. Motivated by the strong trajectorymodeling capabilities of Transformers, recent Decision Transformer (DT)-based methods formulate offline safe RL as conditional sequence modeling by conditioning action generation on return-to-go (RTG) and cost-to-go (CTG) tokens, thereby enabling adaptation to varying safety budgets. However, existing DT-based methods are developed for single-constraint tasks. For tasks with multiple constraints, generalizing learned policies to unseen combinations of safety budgets remains challenging due to the conflicting requirements imposed by heterogeneous constraints. Moreover, the quadratic complexity of Transformer architectures significantly increases the computational overhead in multi-constraint tasks, as representing additional constraints requires more CTG tokens. Recently, Mamba has emerged as an efficient sequence-modeling backbone, offering linear computational complexity and strong generalization capabilities. In this paper, we propose CORMA, a constraint-routed decision Mamba framework for generalizable multi-constraint offline safe RL. CORMA decomposes policy inference into constraint-aware RTG estimation and adaptive action generation, where constraint-specific experts model feasible RTG distributions and a router-guided product-of-experts mechanism fuses these distributions to provide safety-aware guidance for a Mamba-based action decoder. A three-stage optimization strategy is designed to improve training stability. Extensive experiments on OSRL benchmarks demonstrate that CORMA achieves superior reward-safety trade-offs, reduces inference latency by 37% compared with DT-based methods, and exhibits stronger zero-shot generalization to unseen safety-budget combinations than offline safe RL baselines.

AI.tldr: CORMA：面向多约束离线安全强化学习的约束路由Mamba框架，用MoE路由融合多约束RTG分布，指导Mamba动作解码器，实现可泛化、低延迟的安全策略。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Decision Transformer的离线安全RL方法仅针对单约束任务；多约束下异构约束相互冲突，难以泛化到未见的安全预算组合；且Transformer二次复杂度在多约束下因需更多CTG token而计算开销剧增。
AI.method: 将策略推理分解为约束感知的RTG估计与自适应动作生成：约束专属专家建模可行RTG分布，路由引导的专家乘积机制融合这些分布，为基于Mamba的动作解码器提供安全感知引导；并设计三阶段优化策略提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在OSRL基准上取得更优的奖励-安全权衡，推理延迟较DT类方法降低37%，对未见安全预算组合的零样本泛化优于离线安全RL基线。
AI.conclusion: 以Mamba与约束路由MoE替代DT，可在多约束离线安全RL中以线性复杂度实现更强的泛化性与效率。

title: Reversion, Retention, and Semantic Intervention: Measuring Functional Content in CLIP Fine-Tuning Deltas
comment: 20 pages. Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Fine-tuning adapts pretrained models to new tasks, but identifying which weight changes support the resulting behavior remains difficult. Weight-space interpretability assigns semantic descriptions to these changes, called fine-tuning deltas. Such descriptions leave open how much task performance depends on the identified updates, particularly when other updates can support the same predictions. We address this gap by pairing reversion, which restores selected parameters to their pretrained values, with retention, which keeps only selected fine-tuning updates. We evaluate Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) models on synthetic financial charts, Flowers102, EuroSAT, and FGVCAircraft with ViT-L/14, and on Flowers102 with ViT-B/16, using a shared recipe that tunes the final six visual blocks. Our contributions are threefold. First, attention value-output (VO) updates alone recover 43-87% of the accuracy improvement, although reverting them leaves chart accuracy unchanged. Cross-entropy loss preserves this contrast on Charts and EuroSAT, while correct-class score margins reveal additional contributions. Second, VO weights recover more loss improvement than all ten equally sized, layer-matched random subsets in each setting. VO and multilayer perceptron (MLP) retentions jointly correct 25-81% of pretrained errors, demonstrating overlapping recovered behavior, which we call operational redundancy. Third, removing semantically selected directions reduces VO-retained recovery more than matched-random removal in all five settings. Together, these results distinguish semantic alignment, removal cost, and retained recovery as complementary evidence about the functional role of fine-tuning updates within the evaluated CLIP recipe.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将"回退(reversion)"与"保留(retention)"配对，量化微调增量对任务性能的实际贡献，并在多个CLIP微调设置中揭示注意力VO更新的功能角色。
AI.motivation: 权重空间可解释性虽能给微调增量赋予语义描述，但无法说明任务性能在多大程度上依赖这些被识别的更新，尤其当其他更新也能支撑相同预测时。
AI.method: 对CLIP（ViT-L/14在合成金融图表、Flowers102、EuroSAT、FGVCAircraft；ViT-B/16在Flowers102）微调最后六个视觉块；用reversion（恢复选定参数到预训练值）和retention（只保留选定更新）两种操作评估VO、MLP等增量的贡献，并与层匹配的随机子集对照，还做语义方向的移除实验。
AI.result: 仅VO更新即可恢复43–87%的精度提升，但回退VO在图表任务上精度不变；VO权重的损失恢复优于全部十个等规模随机子集；VO与MLP保留共纠正25–81%的预训练错误（"操作冗余"）；移除语义方向比匹配随机移除更能降低VO保留的恢复量（全部五个设置）。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐、移除代价与保留恢复应视为关于微调更新功能角色的互补证据，而非单一判据。

title: RubriX: A Fast, Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge
summary: Rubric-based evaluation asks which level of a rubric a response meets. It is usually done by prompting a large language model (LLM) as a judge, which needs a generative call per judgment and reads every level description, so its cost grows with the rubric. We present RubriX, a rubric judge whose architecture is inspired by contrastive language models (CLM): a LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives a probability for every level without text generation. Trained on public rubric data and proprietary synthetic data, RubriX reaches 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics, against 57.1% for TypeSafe's Jev and 49.8% for a Qwen3-8B judge. On eight human-labelled benchmark sets it is within 6 percentage points of Jev's accuracy on most of them, while Jev keeps a larger lead on two and ranks responses best on average; against the results reported in the G-Eval paper, RubriX outperforms G-Eval with GPT-3.5 on every SummEval dimension and both QAGS subsets. With level embeddings cached, RubriX's latency stays at about 28 ms per judgment as level descriptions grow from 10 to 3,000 tokens, while Jev's (approximate network time subtracted) rises from 44 ms to 211 ms and the Qwen3-8B judge's from 32 ms to 516 ms, making RubriX 7.7x faster than Jev and 18.8x faster than the Qwen3-8B judge at 3,000 tokens per level.

AI.tldr: 提出 RubriX，一种基于对比语言模型（CLM）架构的评分量表（rubric）评判器：用 LoRA 适配的编码器嵌入输入与各等级描述，通过缩放余弦相似度 softmax 直接给出各等级概率，无需生成文本。
AI.motivation: 现有 rubric 评估多依赖 LLM 作为生成式评判器（judge），每次判断都需一次生成调用，且要读入全部等级描述，成本随 rubric 规模增长，延迟高。
AI.method: RubriX 采用 LoRA 适配的编码器，分别嵌入输入与每个等级描述，对缩放后的余弦相似度做 softmax 得到各等级概率；训练数据来自公开 rubric 数据与专有合成数据；等级嵌入可缓存以避免重复计算。
AI.result: 留出 rubric 上精确准确率 75.4%（Jev 57.1%，Qwen3-8B judge 49.8%）；八个人工标注基准中多数与 Jev 差距在 6 个百分点内，两项上 Jev 领先较多且平均排序最佳；相对 G-Eval 论文结果，在 SummEval 全部维度与两个 QAGS 子集上优于 GPT-3.5 版 G-Eval。等级描述从 10 增至 3000 token 时延迟稳定约 28 ms，Jev 由 44 ms 升至 211 ms，Qwen3-8B 由 32 ms 升至 516 ms，即 3000 token 下分别快 7.7 倍与 18.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将 rubric 评判重构为嵌入式对比分类，可显著降低随 rubric 长度增长的延迟与成本，同时在准确率上优于同类生成式评判器；但在部分人类标注基准上 Jev 仍具优势。

title: Scope-Gap Injection: Exploiting Evaluator Channel Blind Spots in the OpenClaw Agent Security Competition
summary: This paper introduces Scope-Gap Injection (SGI), an indirect prompt injection method for multi-stage LLM-agent safety pipelines. In the IJCAI 2026 OpenClaw Agent Security Attack Competition, each attack package is judged by a static skill scan (S1), an LLM-judge safety check over the task and skill definition (S2), and a live execution audit (S3). Our observations suggest a scope gap: S2 appears to inspect the task instruction and skill definition without inspecting attachment contents, while the agent reads attachments during S3. SGI keeps the visible task and skill benign, while target identifiers, bypass parameters, and authorization procedures are moved into an attachment written as a business worklist. The S2 judge therefore sees a harmless task, while the agent follows the hidden worklist and triggers the permission bypass. In OpenClaw, SGI bypassed all three stages for 5 of 19 targets. The highest-scoring single submission achieved $F = 0.385$. Across the submission campaign, attachment placement was associated with higher aggregate S2 acceptance than in-skill placement: 78% versus 23%. We close with defenses that align evaluator scope with the channels available to the agent.

AI.tldr: 提出Scope-Gap Injection（SGI）：利用多阶段LLM agent安全流水线中“评估器视野”与“agent可访问通道”不一致的漏洞，在附件中隐藏工作清单实施间接提示注入。
AI.motivation: 多阶段安全流水线（静态扫描S1、LLM评审S2、执行审计S3）看似覆盖全面，但S2只检查任务指令与skill定义、不检查附件内容，而agent在S3中会读取附件，由此形成“范围缺口”，可被利用。
AI.method: SGI保持可见任务与skill定义良性，将目标标识、绕过参数和授权流程移入以“业务工作清单”形式书写的附件；S2评审看到无害任务，agent却执行隐藏清单并触发权限绕过。在IJCAI 2026 OpenClaw Agent Security Attack Competition上开展提交测试与对比实验（附件放置 vs in-skill放置）。
AI.result: 对19个目标中的5个成功绕过全部三阶段；单次提交最高F=0.385；附件放置的S2接受率为78%，显著高于in-skill放置的23%。
AI.conclusion: 评估器的检查范围必须与agent实际可访问的通道对齐，否则多阶段流水线存在结构性盲区；论文最后提出了相应的防御方案。

title: Interpretable and Steerable Molecular Graph Generation using Concept Bottlenecks
comment: Accepted at AI for Drug Discovery Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026. Additional experiments added
summary: Deep graph generators (DGGs) largely lack interpretability, which is a significant limitation for one of their most crucial applications, drug discovery, where interpretable and transparent generation could provide greater control over the desirability of generated molecules, thereby reducing trial-and-error in candidate selection. Common approaches to interpretability, such as disentanglement, cannot guarantee that the learned representations are human-interpretable. To address this, we propose incorporating concept bottlenecks into DGGs, allowing users to interpret, debug, and steer the generation process. We show that this consistently improves distributional fidelity (lower FCD), with only modest, non-systematic effects on validity and uniqueness. We further explore Concept Controller, an optimization-based steering approach that has proven to be effective for steerable image generation. We evaluate our approach on a one-shot molecular graph generation framework, though the underlying ideas can be transferred to sequential graph generation as well.

AI.tldr: 将概念瓶颈引入深度图生成器（DGG），以提升分子生成的可解释性与可控性，并验证其改善分布保真度。
AI.motivation: 深度图生成器缺乏可解释性，这在药物发现中尤为关键：可解释、透明的生成有助于控制分子的期望属性，减少候选筛选中的试错。而解耦等常见方法无法保证所学表示是人类可理解的。
AI.method: 在DGG中引入概念瓶颈（concept bottlenecks），使用户能够解释、调试并引导生成过程；进一步探索Concept Controller——一种在可控图像生成中有效的基于优化的引导方法；并在one-shot分子图生成框架上进行评估（思路可迁移至序列化图生成）。
AI.result: 引入概念瓶颈后分布保真度持续改善（FCD更低），对有效性和唯一性仅有适度、非系统性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 概念瓶颈可有效提升DGG的可解释性与可控生成能力，且不显著损害生成质量，具有向其他图生成范式推广的潜力。

title: MuSTEL: A Large-Scale Multilingual Synthetic Text-Line Image Dataset for OCR
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) systems depend strongly on the scale and diversity of their training data. One approach to document OCR first analyzes the page layout and extracts text-line images, which are then transcribed by a recognition model. Multilingual line-level recognition involving Persian, Arabic, and English presents additional challenges because different writing directions, fonts, and styles may coexist within a single line. This paper introduces MuSTEL, a large-scale synthetic multilingual OCR dataset containing more than 14.5 million annotated text-line images, organized into a training partition and predefined small and large test sets. Samples are generated from natural-language corpora, including multilingual content already present in the source texts. The generation framework incorporates capability-aware font selection, within-line font and style changes, mixed-direction text rendering, highlighting, and underlining. A validated repository of 2,009 font files from 711 families supports broad typographic coverage, while varied backgrounds, blur, geometric distortion, skew, stroke width, and image save quality provide diverse document-like appearances. Statistical analysis characterizes the dataset's language composition, transcription lengths, lexical and character-sequence diversity, image dimensions, typography, and rendering conditions. MuSTEL provides a resource for training and evaluating multilingual line-level OCR systems and investigating recognition robustness across languages, writing directions, and visual conditions.

AI.tldr: MuSTEL：一个含1450万+标注文本行图像的大规模合成多语言OCR数据集，覆盖波斯语、阿拉伯语、英语，支持混合书写方向、行内字体/样式切换及多种渲染退化。
AI.motivation: OCR性能依赖训练数据的规模与多样性；行级多语言识别中波斯语、阿拉伯语、英语常在同一条行内共存不同书写方向、字体与风格，现有数据难以覆盖这种复杂情形。
AI.method: 从自然语言语料（含源文本中本身的多语言内容）生成图像，采用能力感知的字体选择、行内字体与风格变化、混合方向渲染、高亮与下划线；基于2009个字体文件（711个字体族）的验证字体库，并施加多样背景、模糊、几何畸变、倾斜、笔画宽度变化与保存质量退化；划分训练集及预定义大小测试集，并对语言构成、转写长度、词汇/字符序列多样性、图像尺寸、排版与渲染条件做统计分析。
AI.result: 构建了超过1450万张标注文本行图像的数据集，具备广泛排版覆盖与多样文档外观，并通过统计刻画了语言组成、转写长度、词汇与字符序列多样性、图像维度、字体排版及渲染条件。
AI.conclusion: MuSTEL可作为多语言行级OCR系统训练与评测的资源，用于研究跨语言、跨书写方向及不同视觉条件下的识别鲁棒性。

title: NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents
summary: A numerical claim generated by a financial analyst agent can match a number in a company filing but refer to the wrong entity, concept, period, unit or scope. A check based on reference answers can mark such an answer as wrong but does not explain why it fails. In this paper, we present NumTrace, a new benchmark that audits the provenance of each numerical claim made by financial analyst agents: its source and financial semantics. NumTrace currently has 540 questions over 2,163 SEC EDGAR documents. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first numerical benchmark about who holds a company's shares (Form 13F) and what its executives are owed (Item 402(i)). On a frozen snapshot of these documents, we build the reference answers according to accounting rules. NumTrace then gives each claim three separate verdicts: value, binding and support. By retaining separate value and binding verdicts, NumTrace detects right number, wrong account (RNWA) errors: a claim has an RNWA error when it passes the value check but fails the binding check. The RNWA rate quantifies the gap between value-only and joint value-and-binding pass rates. Finally, we audit three agents, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. RNWA errors make up 67.5-81.8% of each agent's failing claims. In particular, on 13F co-filing group questions, about 91% of claims pass the value check, but fewer than half pass the binding check.

AI.tldr: NumTrace 是一个审计金融分析智能体数值声明溯源与金融语义的新基准，含540题、2163份SEC文件，通过 value/binding/support 三重判定检测"数字对、科目错"（RNWA）错误，发现三款智能体失败声明中67.5-81.8%属此类。
AI.motivation: 金融分析智能体给出的数字虽能在公司文件中找到匹配，但可能指向错误的实体、概念、期间、单位或范围；仅基于参考答案的检查只能判错，无法解释错在何处。
AI.method: 构建 NumTrace 基准（540题、覆盖2163份 SEC EDGAR 文档；首次涉及 Form 13F 持股与 Item 402(i) 高管薪酬）；在文档冻结快照上按会计规则构建参考答案；对每条声明给出 value、binding、support 三项独立判定，用 value 通过而 binding 失败的比率量化 RNWA 错误。
AI.result: 审计 Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 三款智能体：RNWA 错误占各自失败声明的67.5-81.8%；在 13F 联合申报组问题上，约91%声明通过 value 检查，但通过 binding 检查的不足一半。
AI.conclusion: 仅做数值匹配会严重高估智能体可靠性，需引入语义绑定层面的溯源审计；NumTrace 为此类细粒度诊断提供了首个基准。

title: Alignment via Generalization
summary: AI systems can become better at achieving the goals we give them without becoming better at doing what we actually want. Studying this alignment problem rigorously requires a framework connecting measurable performance to intended behavior. We propose Aligned-PAC learning, whose central idea is to reduce alignment to generalization: does success on the requirements used for training extend to requirements the system has not encountered? Rather than express our entire intention through a single training objective, we represent its different aspects through a collection of specific requirements. This perspective already yields strong theoretical results. We show how independent evaluation can provide rigorous evidence of alignment across the represented requirements, and establish how much evaluation is needed. We also develop an optimization method that, under explicit assumptions, combines learned models to satisfy the training requirements. The framework does not solve alignment in full: choosing requirements that faithfully capture our intentions, and understanding when learning will generalize to unseen requirements, remain open challenges. It provides a foundation for making these questions precise and studying them with the tools of learning theory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Aligned-PAC learning 框架，将 AI 对齐问题归约为泛化问题，通过一组具体需求而非单一目标来表达意图，并给出理论结果与优化方法。
AI.motivation: AI 系统可能在达成给定目标上变强，却未必更好实现我们真正想要的行为，需要将可测量的性能与意图行为联系起来的严格框架来研究该对齐问题。
AI.method: 以一组具体需求表示意图各方面，将对齐归约为泛化：训练需求上的成功是否延伸到未见需求；用独立评估为跨需求的对齐提供严格证据并量化所需评估量；在明确假设下提出结合已学模型以满足训练需求的优化方法。
AI.result: 已得到较强理论结果：可刻画独立评估对对齐的证据强度及所需评估规模，并在显式假设下给出满足训练需求的模型组合优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架未完全解决对齐问题：如何选取忠实反映意图的需求、以及学习何时能泛化到未见需求仍是开放挑战；但为精确定义这些问题并用学习理论工具研究提供了基础。

title: Humans in Space: Can MLLMs Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration?
comment: Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. 33 pages, 14 figures, and 23 tables
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate'' the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active--Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at https://gtc-gh.github.io/SATE-Bench/

AI.tldr: 提出 SATE-Bench，一个包含316个真实场景、2525个多轮问答对的主动视角探索基准，评估MLLM在遮挡场景下的视觉自我意识与主动空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM空间能力评估多为静态、被动观察，复杂人类场景中遮挡隐藏关键几何证据，模型只能"猜"而无法识别自身视觉不确定性，缺乏主动获取证据的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建SATE-Bench，含被动多视图控制与主动探索两种设置：模型从严重遮挡视角出发，迭代查询相邻视角直至证据充分（"sate"）。用带步数惩罚的效率奖励评分；并分析主流MLLM表现，用匹配视图控制实验归因主动-被动差距，再用GRPO微调探究奖励视角探索的影响。
AI.result: SOTA模型过早终止探索却报告高置信度，细粒度3D几何任务表现差；匹配视图控制表明主动-被动差距主要源于证据获取不足。GRPO奖励视角探索虽提升探索量，但整体准确率下降，因模型过度探索且无法融合多轮扩展的多视图上下文。
AI.conclusion: 扩大被动多视图感知并不能自然带来主动空间推理能力，需模型具备"知道看哪里、如何整合所见、何时停止"的能力。

title: FATE-5: Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for Continuous Big Five Personality Control
summary: Controlling personality in large language models is important for building conversational agents that can be customized to different users and interaction settings. However, existing personality control methods often face a tradeoff between strong trait expression and natural dialogue generation. We introduce FATE-5, Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five, a two-stage framework that separates personality encoding from naturalness alignment. FATE-5 first learns continuous soft prompt representations of Big Five profiles using dialogue supervision and an auxiliary survey objective. It then improves dialogue naturalness through preference alignment based on both dialogue quality and personality agreement. Across three language model backbones, FATE-5 maintains strong trait expression while achieving substantially higher dialogue naturalness than other trait-strong methods. On held-out questionnaires, it achieves monotonicity correlations of 0.97-0.99 and recovery RMSE of 8.9-12.4, substantially improving over the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate effective continuous personality control while maintaining natural conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: FATE-5是一个两阶段框架，将人格编码与自然度对齐分离，实现大模型大五人格的忠实、连续控制，兼顾强特质表达与自然对话。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型人格控制方法难以兼顾人格特质的强表达与对话的自然流畅，二者存在此消彼长的权衡问题。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用对话监督加辅助问卷目标，学习大五人格档案的连续软提示表示；第二阶段基于对话质量和人格一致性的偏好对齐，提升对话自然度；在三个模型主干上验证。
AI.result: 在三个语言模型主干上，FATE-5在保持强特质表达的同时自然度显著高于其他强特质方法；留出问卷上单调性相关达0.97-0.99，人格恢复RMSE为8.9-12.4，明显优于基线。
AI.conclusion: FATE-5证明可在保持自然对话行为的前提下实现有效的连续人格控制，为可定制对话智能体提供了实用方案。

title: Uncovering the Turing Test's Latent Signal: Indistinguishability as a Reward
summary: Can a model learn by trying to fool another model? We show that it can. Inspired by the Turing Test and its recent generalization to arbitrary distinguishers, we introduce a domain-based teacher-Turing-Test, in which a stronger teacher model serves as both the target of imitation and the distinguisher, and a weaker student model is trained to make the teacher attribute responses to itself. We use this self-attribution (or fooling) probability as a reinforcement learning reward, without ever providing the student ground-truth answers, nor requiring the teacher to generate responses. We test our approach independently in four domains with verifiable answers: CommonsenseQA (reasoning), GSM8K (mathematics), KodCode (programming), and Spider (SQL), training a Qwen2.5-1.5B student/imitator model using DeepSeek V4 Flash as teacher/distinguisher. Beyond improving at passing the Turing Test, the student improves on independent, held-out evaluations in all domains and runs. To probe why being mistaken for the teacher can improve capability, our analyses reveal that self-attribution is associated with correctness -- substantially more than formatting changes -- and that it rewards partial correctness. Our results demonstrate a new, simple teacher-student training paradigm with a private and/or high-cost teacher. They also suggest that indistinguishability need not merely measure behavior -- it can also be a mechanism for learning.

AI.tldr: 提出"教师-图灵测试"训练范式：用强教师的自我归属（被误认）概率作为强化学习奖励，弱学生模型无需真值或教师生成即可提升四个领域能力。
AI.motivation: 探索模型能否通过"欺骗"另一个模型来学习；受图灵测试及其到任意判别器的推广启发，希望在图灵测试中引入具体领域，并利用自归属概率作为奖励信号。
AI.method: 构建域内教师-图灵测试：强教师模型既是被模仿目标也是判别器，弱学生（Qwen2.5-1.5B）训练使教师把回答归因于自身。以该自归属/欺骗概率作为RL奖励，不使用标准答案，也不要求教师生成响应；在CommonsenseQA、GSM8K、KodCode、Spider四领域用DeepSeek V4 Flash作教师验证。
AI.result: 学生不仅提高通过图灵测试的比例，在所有领域与所有运行中独立留出评测均有提升；分析显示自归属与正确性相关（远强于格式变化），且能奖励部分正确。
AI.conclusion: 给出一种简单、适用于私有或高成本教师的新师生训练范式；表明不可区分性不仅是行为度量，也可作为学习机制。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Crowd Flow Control Using Dynamic Barriers
comment: An earlier version was presented at the 26th Scientific Forum for Hajj, Umrah and Visit Research, Umm Al-Qura University (2026)
summary: Crowd barriers are widely used to regulate pedestrian movement during large public events such as pilgrimages. However, fixed barrier layouts often create unnecessary stopping and local congestion even when they successfully control the overall crowd flow. Finding better barrier configurations is difficult because there is no dataset that provides the best barrier placement for a given crowd scene. We address this challenge by introducing a simulation-driven reinforcement learning framework that learns barrier configurations without requiring labelled training data. Starting from a segmented crowd scene, we construct a realistic simulation environment that reproduces the observed pedestrian distribution. This environment is then used to train a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent that continuously adjusts barrier positions to improve pedestrian movement. Unlike supervised approaches the proposed framework allows the agent to explore barrier configurations that have never been observed in real data. We evaluate the learned policy under unseen numbers of pedestrians. The learned policy consistently outperforms the existing manually designed barrier configuration by reducing pedestrian stops while maintaining effective flow regulation. These results demonstrate that combining computer vision crowd simulation and reinforcement learning provides an effective framework for optimizing crowd control infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出仿真驱动的强化学习框架，无需标注数据即可学习人群护栏配置，在未见人流密度下优于人工设计布局。
AI.motivation: 护栏广泛用于大型公共活动（如朝圣）的人群管理，但固定布局常造成不必要的停顿与局部拥堵；由于缺乏"给定场景下的最优护栏位置"数据集，难以用监督学习直接优化。
AI.method: 从分割后的人群场景出发，构建能复现观测行人分布的真实仿真环境；在此基础上训练 Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）智能体，持续调整护栏位置以改善行人流动，无需人工标注，并可探索真实数据中未出现过的布局。
AI.result: 在未见过的人群数量下评估学习到的策略，其结果稳定优于现有人工设计的护栏布局：减少行人停顿，同时保持有效的流量调控。
AI.conclusion: 将计算机视觉人群仿真与强化学习相结合，可为优化人群管控基础设施提供有效框架。

title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables. Project page: https://shanyang.me/what-outcome-rl-buys/ Code: https://github.com/shanyang-me/outcome-rl-buys
summary: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. We ask whether each pass@1 gain is changed behaviour or new knowledge. We divide each change in pass@1 into three parts. Finishing measures answering before the budget runs out. Reliability measures being right once finished. Reach measures problems RL solves that its base answered wrongly in all eight tries, minus problems the base solves that RL answered wrongly in all eight. We find four things. (1) Where the base often hits the token budget before answering, most of the change, gain or loss, is finishing (82% at 4k and 8k). Given more tokens, the base closes most of the finishing gap itself. (2) Where the base has enough tokens, the gain is reliability: the RL model is graded right more often, even on problems both finish. (3) By our definition, RL rarely solves what its base cannot. Reach adds at most 2.1 percentage points on any of our four physics and math sets. We checked 144 physics problems that only the RL model solved. Of these, 3.5% hold up when resampled or read. In a random sample, nine of ten new RL steps a human confirmed also appear in the base's samples. (4) In a small-scale RL run on an 8B model, the gain on new problems is finishing, with reliability flat. Supplying each problem's physical setup was not shown to improve on plain RL.

AI.tldr: 该论文在固定token预算下比较20个已发布RL模型与其基座模型的pass@1，将提升拆解为finishing、reliability、reach三部分，发现RL主要提升"答完"和"答对"，而非获得新知识。
AI.motivation: Outcome RL提升了pass@1但在大k下未提升pass@k，且pass@1在token预算下评估、训练也在预算下进行；作者想区分pass@1增益到底是行为改变还是新知识获取。
AI.method: 在物理与数学问题上、固定token预算，比较20个开源RL模型（1.5B–32B）与其起始thinking模型的pass@1；将pass@1变化分为finishing（预算内答完）、reliability（答完且答对）、reach（基座8次全错而RL解出减去基座解出而RL8次全错），并对144道仅RL解出的物理题重采样/人工核查。
AI.result: (1)基座常在预算内答不完时，82%（4k/8k）的变化来自finishing，给更多token基座可自行弥合；(2)token充足时增益来自reliability；(3)reach至多+2.1pp，144道新解题仅3.5%经核实成立，人工确认的10个"新步骤"中9个也出现在基座样本里；(4)8B小规模RL实验中新问题增益主要来自finishing，reliability持平。
AI.conclusion: RL的pass@1增益主要是行为改变（更快答完、更稳定答对），而非获取基座不具备的新知识；提供物理设定未显示优于普通RL。

title: Centralized Critics for N-Agent Ad Hoc Teamwork
summary: Centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) has become the dominant paradigm in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), motivating extensive study of what privileged information should be made available to the critic during training. While prior work has examined the role of global state in fully cooperative settings, the design of centralized critics for N-agent ad hoc teamwork - in which dynamically varying set of learning agents must coordinate with an arbitrary set of uncontrolled teammates drawn from an unknown distribution - remains poorly understood. We study this question by comparing two natural classes of advantage estimators: controlled history estimators, which condition only on the observation and action histories of the learner's own agents, and joint history estimators, which additionally condition on the histories of the uncontrolled teammates. We prove that both estimators are unbiased and characterize the conditions under which the joint history estimate attains strictly lower variance than its controlled counterpart. Empirically, joint history critics match or outperform controlled history critics across a range of NAHT tasks, yielding improved sample efficiency and final returns. Together, these results provide both a theoretical justification and an empirical recommendation for incorporating uncontrolled agent histories into centralized critics for N-agent ad hoc teamwork.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究N智能体临时团队协作（NAHT）中集中式critic应使用何种特权信息，比较仅依赖受控智能体历史的估计器与额外纳入非受控队友历史的联合历史估计器。理论上证明两者均无偏，并刻画联合历史估计方差严格更小的条件；实验表明联合历史critic样本效率与最终回报更优。
AI.motivation: 现有CTDE研究多关注全合作设定下全局状态的作用，而对NAHT中动态变化的受控智能体需与未知分布的非受控队友协作时，集中式critic的设计尚不清楚。
AI.method: 将优势估计器分为两类：只条件于学习者自身智能体观测与动作历史的受控历史估计器，以及额外条件于非受控队友历史的联合历史估计器；对二者进行无偏性证明，并推导联合历史估计方差严格低于对照估计的条件；在多种NAHT任务上开展实证比较。
AI.result: 两类估计器均为无偏；在一定条件下联合历史估计方差严格更低；实验中联合历史critic在多项NAHT任务上持平或优于受控历史critic，样本效率与最终回报均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 为N智能体临时团队协作的集中式critic纳入非受控智能体历史提供了理论依据与实证推荐。

title: DoubleFree:Exploiting Exploration History for Rollout-Free Multi-Task LLMs Training
summary: Multi-task post-training can develop domain specialists through independent reinforcement learning (RL) and consolidate their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). However, standard MOPD generates on-policy student responses and keeps multiple teachers online throughout consolidation, introducing substantial system costs. We view this pipeline as domain-wise exploration followed by cross-domain exploitation. Domain RL produces not only the final specialists, but also the trajectories collected throughout their training. Existing methods primarily use the former while leaving the latter underutilized. We introduce DoubleFree, which reuses these historical trajectories for rollout-free consolidation and precomputes teacher supervision for online-teacher-free student training. To understand why this works, we analyze when updates from historical trajectories can approximate on-policy distillation updates and how combining trajectories across exploration stages can better support an evolving student. DoubleFree requires only minimal changes to existing post-training frameworks. Across math, code, and instruction following on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and SmolLM3-3B, DoubleFree achieves $2.99$-$5.75\times$ consolidation speedups and reduces GPU-hours by $80.9$-$90.1\%$, while maintaining comparable multi-domain performance.

AI.tldr: DoubleFree leverages historical RL trajectories and precomputed teacher supervision to achieve rollout-free and online-teacher-free multi-teacher on-policy distillation, cutting consolidation cost by ~80-90% GPU-hours while maintaining performance.
AI.motivation: Standard multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) for consolidating domain specialists requires generating on-policy student responses and keeping multiple teachers online, incurring substantial system costs. Existing methods use only the final specialists from domain RL and waste the trajectories collected during training.
AI.method: DoubleFree reuses historical trajectories from domain RL for rollout-free consolidation, and precomputes teacher supervision so student training needs no online teachers. The authors theoretically analyze when updates from historical trajectories approximate on-policy distillation updates and how combining trajectories across exploration stages better supports an evolving student. It requires minimal changes to existing post-training frameworks.
AI.result: Across math, code, and instruction following on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and SmolLM3-3B, DoubleFree achieves 2.99-5.75x consolidation speedups and reduces GPU-hours by 80.9-90.1%, while maintaining comparable multi-domain performance.
AI.conclusion: Treating multi-task post-training as domain-wise exploration followed by cross-domain exploitation, DoubleFree shows that reusing exploration trajectories and precomputed supervision can dramatically reduce MOPD cost with comparable results, offering an efficient, easily-integrated consolidation approach.

title: SVD-Attention: Efficiently Analyzing Attention Blocks in Transformers
summary: Pretrained transformers spend a large share of their inference compute inside self-attention, yet the per-head query-key interaction is structurally low-rank by construction. We ask a diagnostic question: across layers and architectures, which heads actually use the full rank budget on real data, and which do not? We propose SVD-Attention, a post-hoc method that decomposes the per-head interaction matrix $M_h$ and scores every singular mode by both its spectral magnitude and its activation variance across tokens on a small calibration set. The score keeps the modes the head can amplify and that real data actually activates, and discards the rest; the resulting factorization is exact for the retained modes and needs no finetuning. Across seven pretrained models and five task types, the diagnostic finds a task-dependent pattern: redundancy sits in the early to middle layers for sentiment and image classification and for generation, and in the late layers for dense prediction and extractive question answering. It is also predictive: truncating the layers it flags costs at most $1.75$ F1, while truncating the same number of layers elsewhere in the same model costs up to $50$ F1. SVD-Attention is an analysis tool rather than a compression method: acting on it reduces inference FLOPs by $0.8$-$1.5\%$ on its own and by $8$-$11\%$ when composed with weight pruning, with $0$-$4\%$ change in task quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SVD-Attention，一种免微调的事后诊断方法，通过对每个注意力头的交互矩阵做SVD，并用谱幅值与校准集上的激活方差联合打分各奇异模式，揭示预训练Transformer中注意力头的秩冗余呈任务相关分布，且该诊断可预测性地定位低重要性层。
AI.motivation: 自注意力占预训练Transformer推理算力的很大比例，而每个头内的query-key交互在构造上就是低秩的。但一个未解问题是：在真实数据上，哪些层/哪些头真正用满了秩预算，哪些存在冗余？现有压缩方法多直接做低秩近似，缺乏对"冗余在哪"的系统性诊断。
AI.method: SVD-Attention：对每个头的交互矩阵 M_h 做奇异值分解，对每个奇异模式同时按其谱幅值（头能放大的强度）与在小校准集上跨token的激活方差（真实数据是否激活）进行联合打分；保留二者皆高的模式，舍弃其余；所得分解对保留模式是精确的，无需微调。随后在7个预训练模型、5类任务上做层/头级别的冗余诊断与截断验证。
AI.result: 诊断呈现任务相关的冗余模式：情感分类、图像分类与生成任务的冗余位于早至中层；密集预测与抽取式问答的冗余位于后层。该诊断具有预测性：截断被标记层最多损失1.75 F1，而在同一模型其他位置截断相同数量的层最多损失50 F1。作为压缩，SVD-Attention 单独使用可减少0.8%–1.5% 推理FLOPs，与权重剪枝组合后减少 8%–11%，任务质量变化0%–4%。
AI.conclusion: SVD-Attention 的定位是分析工具而非压缩方法：它提供了一种低成本、免微调的手段来刻画注意力头的有效秩与层间冗余分布，并能可靠定位可截断层；其压缩收益有限，但可与权重剪枝互补叠加。局限性在于校准集依赖、收益规模较小，且结论为跨任务的经验观察而非理论保证。

title: TrustJev: Separating Policy Authority from Untrusted Evidence in LLM-Based Decisions
summary: Decision models enable software to select from predefined actions using natural language inputs. However, the external evidence that supplies facts for these decisions may also contain instructions that attempt to override the application's policy. We propose TrustJev, a framework combining protected policy scoring with bounded evidence corrections. A single Transformer backbone computes policy scores and a correction budget from trusted policy and candidates, then bounds evidence corrections by that budget. Paired supervision encourages stable predictions under instruction insertions that preserve task facts and changed preferences when edits change the correct answer. Authority supervision accommodates evidence when the policy alone cannot determine the decision. We evaluate a 0.6B implementation against 14 baselines on three datasets covering authentication, instruction hierarchy, and executable authorization rules. TrustJev achieves the highest mean Balance, the harmonic mean of accuracy on non-attack and attack inputs, exceeding the strongest baseline on each by 0.57-1.05 percentage points. In the authorization benchmark, it correctly answers all 32 attacks per source in a fixed pool for 95.77% of sources, compared with 80.98% for the strongest comparator. TrustJev maintains comparable inference memory and median latency, with additional overhead primarily during training.

AI.tldr: TrustJev是一个结合"受保护策略打分"与"有界证据修正"的决策框架，用单一Transformer骨干从可信策略与候选中计算策略分数和修正预算，并用该预算约束证据修正，以抵御证据中注入指令的攻击。
AI.motivation: 自然语言决策模型中，提供事实的外部证据可能暗含试图覆盖应用策略的指令（提示注入类攻击），需要在保持正常决策准确性的同时抵御此类攻击。
AI.method: 单Transformer骨干同时输出策略分数与修正预算；证据修正被预算上界约束；采用配对监督（注入不影响任务事实时保持稳定，改变正确答案时调整偏好）与权威监督（策略无法单独决定时采纳证据）。以0.6B规模实现。
AI.result: 在认证、指令层级、可执行授权规则三个数据集上与14个基线比较，取得最高平均Balance（非攻击与攻击准确率的调和平均），每项较最强基线高0.57–1.05个百分点；授权基准中固定池内每个来源32个攻击全部答对的来源占95.77%，最强对照为80.98%；推理内存与中位延迟相当，额外开销主要在训练阶段。
AI.conclusion: 通过预算约束的证据修正与配对/权威监督，可在不显著增加推理成本的前提下兼顾安全性与决策准确性，优于现有基线。

title: Birth, Death and Diff: Insertion-Based Sequence Generation with Corrections
summary: Insertion-based masked diffusion models enable flexible-length, parallel generation by interleaving mask insertion with token unmasking. However, because their generation decisions are irreversible, aggressive parallel decoding can introduce errors that subsequent steps cannot correct, necessitating conservative decoding with more forward passes (NFEs). Moreover, they exhibit higher entropy than standard MDMs because they marginalize over multiple alignments during training and therefore require even more conservative decoding in the absence of a correction mechanism. To address this limitation, we introduce $δ$MDM, which makes intermediate generations revisable by equipping an insertion-based model with substitution and deletion operations. During training, we expose the model to errors caused by aggressive unmasking and insertion, teaching it to correct its own mistakes. At inference time, we interleave insertion and unmasking with correction steps that can revise previously unmasked tokens and remove unnecessary masks. This mechanism makes aggressive decoding practical, improving both generation speed and quality. $δ$MDM Pareto-dominates FlexMDM, a vanilla insertion-based MDM, on the speed--quality trade-off. On high-diversity unconditional text generation on OpenWebText, it halves the generative perplexity relative to FlexMDM at the highest inference budget. It also achieves lower generative perplexity at all inference budgets compared to MDM trained from scratch with variable-length padded sequences. On low-diversity conditional text generation on TinyGSM, it matches FlexMDM accuracy with half as many NFEs.

AI.tldr: δMDM 为基于插入的掩码扩散模型引入替换与删除操作，使中间生成可被修正，从而支持激进的并行解码并提升速度-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 基于插入的掩码扩散模型虽能实现变长并行生成，但生成决策不可逆，激进并行解码引入的错误无法在后续步骤中纠正，只能保守解码、增加前向次数（NFE）。此外，由于训练时对多种对齐方式做边缘化，该模型熵更高，在缺乏纠错机制时更需保守解码。
AI.method: 提出 δMDM：在插入式模型上增加替换（substitution）与删除（deletion）操作，使中间生成可修订。训练时让模型接触激进 unmasking 与插入所产生的错误，学习自我纠错；推理时将插入、unmasking 与纠错步骤交错进行，以修订已 unmask 的 token 并删除多余 mask。
AI.result: 在速度-质量权衡上 Pareto 支配 FlexMDM；在 OpenWebText 高多样性无条件生成中，最高推理预算下生成困惑度减半；在所有推理预算下生成困惑度均优于从零训练的变长填充 MDM；在 TinyGSM 低多样性条件生成中，以一半 NFE 达到与 FlexMDM 相同准确率。
AI.conclusion: 引入可修订的替换/删除操作并配合纠错式训练与推理，可让激进并行解码变得实用，同时提升生成速度与质量。

title: GeoPrompt: Geometry-Conditioned Prompt Learning for Underwater Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) provides a promising solution for marine perception by recognizing and segmenting categories beyond predefined label spaces. Existing OVIS methods usually rely on vision-language alignment, where visual region features are matched with textual category embeddings to recognize both seen and unseen classes. However, this alignment assumption becomes fragile in underwater environments. Color attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and low contrast distort visual appearance, causing region features to deviate from their corresponding semantic concepts. As a result, the similarity between degraded visual features and textual classifiers becomes unreliable, which particularly weakens the recognition of unseen underwater categories that cannot be corrected by category-specific supervision. To address these issues, we propose GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning framework for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation. Our key insight is that geometric structure is more stable than visual appearance in degraded underwater scenes. Specifically, GeoPrompt introduces a geometry-guided visual adaptation module (GVAM) to extract depth-derived structural priors and inject them into multi-scale visual features. It further develops a geometry-conditioned prompt learning (GCPL) that generates geometry-aware textual classifiers from structural representations. These geometry-aware classifiers are integrated with fixed and image-conditioned textual classifiers to improve open-vocabulary semantic alignment. Experiments on the MARIS-OpenIS benchmark show that GeoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance and brings consistent improvements on underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation.

AI.tldr: GeoPrompt 提出几何条件提示学习框架，利用深度导出的几何结构先验来缓解水下视觉退化对齐问题，实现水下开词汇实例分割 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 OVIS 依赖视觉-语言对齐，但水下颜色衰减、散射、浑浊、低对比度使视觉区域特征偏离语义概念，导致视觉特征与文本分类器相似度不可靠，尤其损害无法用类别监督校正的未见类识别。
AI.method: 核心洞察是几何结构比视觉外观更稳定。引入几何引导视觉适配模块（GVAM），提取深度导出的结构先验并注入多尺度视觉特征；再设计几何条件提示学习（GCPL），从结构表示生成几何感知文本分类器，并将其与固定及图像条件文本分类器融合以增强开词汇语义对齐。
AI.result: 在 MARIS-OpenIS 基准上取得 SOTA 性能，并对水下开词汇实例分割带来一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 以几何结构为条件替代易退化的外观对齐，是提升水下开词汇实例分割的有效途径。

title: AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives
summary: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. Online narratives share the most common gastrointestinal symptoms with FAERS, but they foreground everyday burdens such as fatigue and food aversion, whereas FAERS reports more often include injection-site reactions and selected serious diagnoses such as pancreatitis. We further find that posts report less nausea and vomiting for tirzepatide than for semaglutide, more fatigue for Wegovy than Ozempic and for Zepbound than Mounjaro. Evaluations show that the agent answers with verifiable evidence and declines requests for medical advice. Our findings reveal gaps between what FAERS captures and what people report online, and they call for patient-centered approaches to pharmacovigilance. Code, prompts, and evaluation questions are available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1.

AI.tldr: AskGLP1 系统将网络患者叙事转化为知识图谱并支持问答，揭示 GLP-1 用药体验的独特性及与 FAERS 的差异。
AI.motivation: GLP-1 药物用于减重日益普遍，患者在线分享的体验叙事虽丰富但结构松散，且与正式药物警戒体系脱节，亟需整合分析手段。
AI.method: 基于 MedDRA 术语，构建 LLM 辅助流水线：筛选近 850 万条 Reddit 帖子，提炼 163,135 条用药体验并结合 2,506 条 WebMD 评论，构建含 385,790 条药物-副作用/目的关系的知识图谱，并在此基础上实现可证伪问答代理。
AI.result: GLP-1 体验具有来源与药物特异性：在线叙事与 FAERS 共享常见胃肠道症状，但更强调疲劳、食物厌恶等日常负担，而 FAERS 更多出现注射部位反应及胰腺炎等严重诊断；tirzepatide 的恶心呕吐报道少于 semaglutide，Wegovy 较 Ozempic、Zepbound 较 Mounjaro 疲劳更多。评估显示代理能给出可验证证据并拒绝医疗建议请求。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示 FAERS 与网络患者报告间的差距，呼吁建立以患者为中心的药物警戒方法，相关代码与评估问题已公开。

title: Logic Hijacking of RAG: Single-Document Poisoning via Local Optimization
summary: Single-document corpus poisoning under black-box access poses a severe threat to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, existing attacks predominantly rely on explicit factual refutations or imperative instruction overrides. Modern aligned LLMs often arbitrate such conflicts conservatively, rejecting overt contradictions in favor of parametric memory or clean retrieved context while triggering input guardrails. We propose MONOLOGUE, a single-document poisoning framework based on Logic Hijacking without explicit refutation. Rather than disputing the ground truth, our method concedes it as an authoritative historical baseline before introducing the update, weaving a grounded record-correction narrative (e.g., dated institutional reattributions) that presents the counterfactual target as the most recent update. To prevent suspicious live writes, payloads are refined entirely offline via local multi-dimensional gated optimization, coupling automated text quality audits with surrogate behavioral verification. Evaluations across three benchmarks, three retrieval backends, and four open-weight generator regimes show that our method achieves the strongest overall attack efficacy among the evaluated single-document poisoning attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MONOLOGUE 单文档投毒框架，通过"逻辑劫持"而非显式反驳，将反事实目标伪装为权威基线之后的"最新更新"，实现黑盒 RAG 投毒。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 单文档投毒攻击依赖显式事实反驳或指令覆盖，但现代对齐 LLM 会保守地裁决冲突（偏好参数记忆或干净上下文）并触发输入防护。需一种不显式反驳、不触发防护的投毒方式。
AI.method: 逻辑劫持：先承认真实事实为权威历史基线，再编造有依据的"记录更正/重新归属"叙事，将反事实呈现为最新更新；载荷完全离线精炼，采用本地多维门控优化，结合自动文本质量审计与代理模型行为验证，避免可疑的实时写入。
AI.result: 在 3 个基准、3 种检索后端、4 种开放权重生成器设置下评估，在所评估的单文档投毒攻击中取得最强总体攻击效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过规避显式冲突、借"更新叙事"绕过对齐模型冲突裁决与防护，MONOLOGUE 显著提升单文档投毒的隐蔽性与有效性。

title: SHIFT-JEV: Certified Abstention and Gain-Gated Continual Adaptation for LLM-Based Decision Models under Distribution Shift
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can act as decision models that return a probability distribution over a fixed set of options, but deployed decision models face domain, label-prior, emerging-class and candidate-set shift. We study how such models fail under shift and propose SHIFT-Jev, a monitoring, abstention and continual-adaptation procedure for them. It scores the risk of each decision from uncertainty, format and option-consistency signals, certifies abstention thresholds with Learn-then-Test, monitors the decision stream with drift and label-shift detectors, and accepts a model update only when an expected-gain gate finds a significant held-out improvement without loss on earlier regimes. On a benchmark of ten shifted test environments with Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-4B (three seeds each) and Phi-4-mini, fine-tuning with KL anchors and temperature scaling lowers calibration error under shift from 0.289 to 0.087. At a target risk of 10%, a learned uncertainty score with a certified threshold exceeds the target in 3 to 5 of 27 environment-seed tests, against 5 to 15 for a max-probability score with the same certification and 9 to 14 for conformal prediction sets; drift-based routing changes little. A chi-squared test on predicted labels detects 95 to 99% of class-prior shifts that confidence- and embedding-based detectors miss. In continual adaptation, SHIFT-Jev reaches 70.5% accuracy on Qwen3-0.6B, above replay, LwF, EWC and fine-tuning baselines in every seed, whereas on Qwen3-4B its conservative gate leaves it 0.4 to 1.4 points behind them.

AI.tldr: 提出 SHIFT-Jev，一个面向 LLM 决策模型在分布漂移下的监控、弃权与持续适应框架，结合风险评分、Learn-then-Test 认证阈值、漂移/标签漂移检测与期望增益门控更新；在十个漂移测试环境中验证了校准、风险控制、漂移检测与持续适应的效果。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为多选决策模型部署时会遭遇域漂移、标签先验漂移、新类出现和候选集变化等 shift，现有方法未系统研究其失效模式，也缺少集监控、弃权与安全更新于一体的机制。
AI.method: SHIFT-Jev：1) 用不确定性、格式与选项一致性信号对每次决策打分风险；2) 用 Learn-then-Test 认证弃权阈值；3) 用漂移检测器和基于预测标签的卡方检验监控标签先验漂移；4) 仅当期望增益门在留出集上发现显著提升且不损害历史 regime 时才接受模型更新。另用 KL 锚定微调与温度缩放改善校准。基线对比最大概率打分、保形预测、replay/LwF/EWC/普通微调，模型为 Qwen3-0.6B、Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini，三种子。
