AI.result: 在标准基准上，相同训练预算下，CMM相比Shortcut-CSL及其他SOTA单步/少步基线在生成质量上均有提升；理论上给出CMM与Shortcut-CSL的关联，说明后者是CMM的一阶近似。
AI.conclusion: 以分布层面（边缘匹配）而非点轨迹对齐来设计少步生成目标更合理；CMM提供了原则性框架并统一解释了Shortcut-CSL，实验验证其有效性。

title: On Detection Reliability for Small Object Segmentation
summary: This study investigates whether predicted bounding boxes are reliable for determining where small-object segmentation should be performed without risking false negatives outside those boxes. The investigation leverages adenovirus particles as small objects, YOLO26x for detection, YO-LO26x-Sem for segmentation, and Mask R-CNN for both detection and segmentation. Segmenta-tion-model predictions were matched to ground-truth adenovirus masks or reference objects using their centroids, with ground-truth mask centroids preferred over ground-truth bounding-box centroids as references for matching. Matched predicted-mask centroids were considered as inside at least one detector-predicted bounding box or outside all such boxes, while ground-truth masks without matched predictions were recorded as having no matched segmentation. For the YOLO26 models, 34 reference objects (47.89%) had matched segmentation centroids inside at least one pre-dicted box, 8 (11.27%) had centroids outside all predicted boxes, and 29 (40.85%) had no matched predicted segmentation. For the Mask R-CNN model, the corresponding counts were 69 (97.18%), 0 (0.00%), and 2 (2.82%). These preliminary experiments demonstrated that restricting segmentation to detector-predicted bounding boxes risks excluding matched segmentation predictions outside those boxes, potentially introducing false negatives.

AI.tldr: 该初步实验研究检测器预测的边界框是否足以限定小目标分割范围。以腺病毒颗粒为小目标，对比YOLO26x+YO-LO26x-Sem与Mask R-CNN：YOLO系列中约11.27%的匹配分割质心落在所有预测框之外，而Mask R-CNN为0%，说明仅框内分割存在漏检风险。
AI.motivation: 小目标分割若仅在检测器预测框内进行，可能漏掉框外的真实目标（假阴性）。作者希望验证预测框作为分割区域约束是否可靠。
AI.method: 以腺病毒颗粒为小目标数据；使用YOLO26x检测、YOLO26x-Sem分割，以及Mask R-CNN（检测+分割兼用）。通过质心将分割模型预测与真实掩膜/参考对象匹配（优先使用真实掩膜质心作参考），将匹配到的预测掩膜质心判定为"位于至少一个预测框内"或"位于所有预测框外"，未被匹配的真实掩膜记为"无匹配分割"。
AI.result: YOLO26系列：34个参考对象（47.89%）的匹配分割质心在至少一个预测框内，8个（11.27%）在所有预测框外，29个（40.85%）无匹配分割预测。Mask R-CNN：分别为69（97.18%）、0（0.00%）和2（2.82%）。
AI.conclusion: 初步实验表明，将分割限制在检测器预测框内会排除框外的匹配分割预测，可能引入假阴性；预测框不宜单独作为小目标分割的空间约束依据。

title: Did the Model Use That? Counterfactual Training Boosts Self-Attribution in Language Models
summary:
A fundamental challenge for explainable and accountable language models is revealing how external information influences their answers. This paper examines whether models are self-attributive: that is, whether they indicate when -- and only when -- their responses to questions are influenced by information provided alongside the question. Furthermore, we explore how self-attribution can be improved through counterfactual training, which explicitly teaches models to distinguish between answers that do and do not depend on supplied information.
  We found that most of the eleven frontier models rarely attribute influential information in their answers, and the rest attribute non-influential information. Training acknowledgment into reasoning does not fix this: the acknowledgment does not reach the final answer.
  We introduce CREDIT, which directly supervises final-answer self-attribution with counterfactual labels, without the need for human annotation. CREDIT substantially improves attribution in four open models, including two distilled reasoning models, and outperforms reasoning-level fine-tuning and prompting baselines. Among answers that agree with a user's suggestion, CREDIT distinguishes those changed by the suggestion from those the model would have given anyway. Gains transfer partly to unseen information types and prompts containing sources that support conflicting answers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自我归因"概念，检验模型能否仅在答案受外部信息影响时声明该影响，发现11个前沿模型普遍失败，并提出无需人工标注的反事实训练方法CREDIT来改进最终答案的自我归因。
AI.motivation: 可解释、可问责的语言模型需要揭示外部信息如何影响其回答。现有模型可能不会如实表明答案是否受问题附带信息的影响（要么少报有影响的信息，要么误报无影响的信息），而仅在推理中承认影响并不能传递到最终答案，因此需要针对性改进。
AI.method: 1) 对11个前沿模型评测其自我归因能力（是否恰在答案受附带信息影响时作出声明）；2) 尝试将"承认影响"训练进推理过程；3) 提出CREDIT，用反事实标签直接监督最终答案的自我归因，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 多数前沿模型很少归因有影响的信息，其余则归因无影响的信息；推理层面的训练无效，承认信息未到达最终答案。CREDIT在四个开源模型（含两个蒸馏推理模型）上显著提升归因表现，优于推理级微调与提示基线；在与用户建议一致的答案中，能区分"被建议改变"与"本就如此"的答案，且收益部分迁移到未见的信息类型及含冲突来源的提示。
AI.conclusion: 模型自我归因能力普遍不足，且需在最终答案层面直接监督；基于反事实标签的CREDIT是有效且无需人工标注的方案，并具有一定泛化性。

title: Zero-Shot Multi-Class Wafer Map Classification with Rule-Ordered Prompts for Large Multimodal Models
summary: Wafer-map defect classification often requires labeled data and retraining when production conditions change. We present a training-free six-class framework that combines connected-component highlighting with morphology-, location-, and exclusion-aware prompts for a frozen large multimodal model. On Mixed-WM38 (6,866 maps), multi-region prompting achieves 92.9% macro and 93.8% overall accuracy. On WM811K (9,000 maps), it achieves 79.1% and 81.3%, respectively. Eight alternative rule orders achieve 90.1-91.9% overall accuracy, compared with 93.8% for the selected order.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的六类晶圆图缺陷分类框架，用连通域突出+形态/位置/排他感知提示驱动冻结的大型多模态模型，Mixed-WM38上宏平均92.9%、总体93.8%，WM811K上79.1%/81.3%。
AI.motivation: 晶圆图缺陷分类通常依赖标注数据，且生产条件变化时需重新训练，成本高、泛化差，因此希望实现免训练、可迁移的分类方案。
AI.method: 结合连通域高亮与形态学、位置、排他三类感知提示，构造六个二分类/排除式规则问题，喂入冻结的大语言多模态模型完成六类判定；并在Mixed-WM38（6,866张）与WM811K（9,000张）上评估，另测试八种规则顺序的敏感性。
AI.result: Mixed-WM38：宏平均92.9%、总体93.8%；WM811K：79.1%、81.3%。八种替代规则顺序总体准确率90.1–91.9%，均低于所选顺序的93.8%。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的多模态提示框架在晶圆图缺陷分类上有效，跨数据集性能有差异（WM811K明显偏低），且结果对规则顺序敏感，说明提示设计与规则编排是关键影响因素。

title: Sparse Sum-of-Squares Layers for Certified Learning
summary: A central limitation of modern machine learning systems is the lack of formal certificates guaranteeing their behavior beyond empirical, sample-based evaluation. Sum-of-squares (SOS) methods provide such guarantees by certifying polynomial inequalities over continuous domains via semidefinite programming (SDP). While prior work has introduced SDP layers as differentiable components in neural networks, repeated learning calls can lose the computational benefit of the forward program's sparse representation. We propose Sparse SOS Layers, differentiable value layers whose backward passes reuse the local coordinates of the forward solve. Under a fixed template and learned objective coefficients, each layer avoids building dense certificates and reuses its sparse structure across training steps. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves up to 2.7 times speedup in total warm-call time, with nearly 100 times lower memory usage (1.7 vs. 160 GiB) for relatively large problem sizes for the tested dense parameterization. Experiments cover sparse polynomial certification, pendulum control, combinatorial relaxations, robotics projection, oscillator chains, and pose graph synchronization. A design study achieves zero certified violations across unseen problem instances and sizes, while requiring roughly 7 times fewer optimization solves than estimating gradients by perturbing the objective coefficients and re-solving the problem (finite differences). These results show that sparse certificate values can be effectively integrated into learning pipelines when the backward pass respects the verifier's structure.

AI.tldr: 提出Sparse SOS Layers，一种可微的平方和(SOS)值层，其反向传播复用前向求解的稀疏局部坐标，避免构造稠密证书，实现最高2.7倍加速和近100倍内存降低。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习系统缺乏超越经验性、基于采样评估的形式化保证。SOS方法能通过SDP对连续域上的多项式不等式提供证书，但现有SDP可微层在反复学习调用中会丢失前向程序稀疏表示的计算优势，导致计算与内存开销过大。
AI.method: 设计Sparse SOS Layers：在固定模板和可学习目标系数下，反向传播复用前向求解的局部坐标，每个层避免构建稠密证书，并在训练步骤间复用稀疏结构。
AI.result: 相比现有方法，总热启动调用时间最高加速2.7倍；在较大问题规模下内存占用低近100倍（1.7 vs 160 GiB）。实验涵盖稀疏多项式认证、摆控制、组合松弛、机器人投影、振子链和位姿图同步。设计研究中在未见实例和规模上实现零证书违规，所需优化求解次数约为有限差分的1/7。
AI.conclusion: 当反向传播尊重验证器的结构时，稀疏证书值可有效集成到学习流程中。

title: Task Relevance-Driven Prompt Expansion for Federated Continual Learning
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Federated continual learning (FCL) has attracted considerable interest by enabling local clients to continually acquire knowledge from new tasks. However, most FCL methods assume that the global server has prior knowledge of the arrival times and number of categories for new tasks, which is unrealistic in the real world. Furthermore, they neglect the importance of positive inter-task semantic relationships when learning new tasks and are significantly affected by irrelevant relationships from old tasks, thereby exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To resolve the above challenges, we develop a novel Task Relevance-driven Prompt Expansion (TRPE) model. Specifically, to eliminate the reliance on prior knowledge of new tasks, we propose an out-of-distribution detector to identify the arrival of new tasks within local clients, along with a radius-adaptive DBSCAN to infer the quantity of categories in new tasks on the proxy server. Moreover, to explore positive inter-task relationships, we calculate the affinity between the original gradient for learning new task and its gradient orthogonal to the feature space of old tasks to evaluate semantic relevance between old and new tasks from a global perspective. Then, we use this global task relevance to determine the key-prompt pair for new tasks and identify highly related old tasks. After concatenating their prompts for training, we can leverage such positive inter-task relations to improve the continual learning of newly arriving tasks. To balance the learning of new tasks and the forgetting of old ones, a soft orthogonality constraint is applied to the local key and prompt gradients. Experiments spanning diverse datasets and backbones confirm the efficacy of our TRPE model.

AI.tldr: TRPE 提出一种任务相关性驱动的提示扩展模型，用于无先验知识的联邦持续学习：用 OOD 检测识别新任务到来、半径自适应 DBSCAN 推断新类别数，并基于梯度相关性选取与拼接 key-prompt 以利用正向任务关系、配合软正交约束缓解遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦持续学习（FCL）方法多假设服务器已知新任务的到达时间与类别数，不切实际；且学习新任务时忽视正向跨任务语义关系、受旧任务无关关系干扰，加剧灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 1) 本地客户端用 OOD 检测器判断新任务到达，代理服务器用半径自适应 DBSCAN 推断新任务类别数，摆脱先验知识依赖；2) 计算新任务原始梯度与其在旧任务特征空间正交方向梯度的亲和度，从全局角度评估新旧任务语义相关性，确定新任务关键 prompt 对并识别高度相关旧任务；3) 拼接其 prompt 进行训练以利用正向任务关系；4) 对本地 key 与 prompt 梯度施加软正交约束，平衡新任务学习与旧任务遗忘。
AI.result: 在多种数据集与骨干网络上进行的实验验证了 TRPE 的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
AI.conclusion: TRPE 通过任务到达/类别数的无监督推断、全局任务相关性驱动的提示扩展与软正交约束，有效提升联邦持续学习性能并缓解灾难性遗忘。

title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
summary: Constrained decoding guarantees that Large Language Models (LLMs) produce outputs conforming to predefined formats, but is often assumed to inherently degrade reasoning. We examine this assumption through a taxonomy of three constraint types: \emph{format constraints}, which enforce output structure; \emph{validity constraints}, which mask invalid answer; and \emph{reasoning constraints}, which restrict reasoning trajectories. We theoretically show that appropriate constraints can preserve or improve performance by eliminating invalid paths. Across four model families and eleven open-source models, causal ablations on diverse benchmarks using state-of-the-art constrained decoding strategies reveal that apparent performance degradation largely stems from non-equivalent prompting and output formats rather than from decoder-level masking. Meanwhile, validity constraints improve reliability and extractability by eliminating invalid answers, while reasoning constraints can improve reasoning and, consequently, accuracy when they enforce beneficial trajectories. These findings show that the impact of constrained decoding depends on the type of constraint and the output space it removes. Our code is available.

AI.tldr: 约束解码并非必然损害推理；性能下降主要来自提示与输出格式不等价，而非解码器掩码本身，且有效性与推理类约束可提升可靠性和准确率。
AI.motivation: 约束解码被普遍认为会降低LLM推理能力，本文检验并挑战这一假设，厘清约束类型对推理的真实影响。
AI.method: 提出三类约束分类（格式约束、有效性约束、推理约束），从理论上分析约束通过消除无效路径可保持或提升性能；并在四个模型家族、十一个开源模型上，使用先进约束解码策略在多样基准上做因果消融实验。
AI.result: 表观性能下降主要源于提示与输出格式不等价而非解码层掩码；有效性约束提升可靠性与可提取性；推理约束在强制有益轨迹时可提升推理与准确率。
AI.conclusion: 约束解码的影响取决于约束类型及其所移除的输出空间；适当约束可保持甚至提升性能。

title: Improving Instruction Hierarchy by Learning from Goal-Goal Conflicts
summary: The recent incident in which OpenAI agents autonomously compromised Hugging Face's infrastructure illustrates the importance of instruction hierarchy (IH): an LLM should follow lower-priority instructions, such as user requests, only when they do not conflict with higher-priority instructions, such as system policies. IH can be effectively improved by fine-tuning LLMs on simulated examples of instruction conflicts, whose diversity is key to teaching LLMs to properly handle conflicts at test time. However, our decomposition of a task into goals and constraints reveals a conflict type -- goal-goal conflicts -- that is absent from existing IH training sets from OpenAI and NVIDIA. We show the importance of this conflict type: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B-it on examples of this conflict type significantly improves IH on a wide range of real-world tasks unseen in training; adding these examples to existing IH training sets for fine-tuning also gives better IH adherence. The IH gains come with trivial mean utility changes on no-conflict tasks across eight benchmarks. Our work advocates including this new conflict type in IH training, even if these examples do not reflect typical LLM use.

AI.tldr: 论文指出指令层级（IH）训练数据中缺失"目标-目标冲突"这一冲突类型，并通过在模拟示例上微调证明该类型对提升 IH 至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有 IH 微调数据（来自 OpenAI 和 NVIDIA）在将任务分解为目标与约束后，缺少"目标-目标冲突"类型；作者认为这一缺失限制了 LLM 在测试时正确处理冲突的能力。
AI.method: 将任务分解为 goal 与 constraint 以刻画冲突类型，构造现有数据集中不存在的"目标-目标冲突"模拟样本；在 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Gemma4-12B-it 上进行微调，并测试其在训练中未见的真实任务上的 IH 表现，同时与现有 IH 训练集做对比与合并实验。
AI.result: 仅用目标-目标冲突样本微调即可在广泛未见真实任务上显著提升 IH；将其加入现有 IH 训练集后 IH 依从性进一步提升；在八个基准的无冲突任务上平均效用变化可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 应将"目标-目标冲突"纳入 IH 训练数据，即使该类样本并不反映典型 LLM 使用场景。

title: Valid Early Detection of Memorization in Diffusion Models
comment: Extended version of a 4-page paper accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on E-Values: From Statistics to ML. 13 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
summary: Diffusion models can sometimes reproduce examples from their training data, a phenomenon known as memorization. Existing memorization detection methods for unconditional diffusion models typically operate at a pre-selected timestep and therefore cannot adapt the detection time to the evolving denoising trajectory. Sequential monitoring enables adaptive detection but repeated testing across timesteps complicates trajectory-level false-alarm control. We study two ways of combining split conformal calibration with sequential monitoring for prompt-free memorization detection: per-step Bonferroni calibration and direct trajectory-level calibration of the maximum memorization score. The former controls repeated testing by splitting the false-alarm budget across timesteps, whereas the latter calibrates the event of ever crossing a threshold directly through the trajectory-level maximum. We evaluate this formulation on an unconditional CIFAR-10 EDM using two complementary per-step statistics based on geometry and representation spikiness. Experiments show that sequential monitoring improves the power-timing tradeoff over fixed-time detection. Compared with Bonferroni calibration, trajectory-level calibration achieves comparable detection power while using the false-alarm budget less conservatively and enabling earlier detection at higher noise levels.

AI.tldr: 本文将序列监控与时序轨迹级保形校准结合，用于无条件扩散模型的记忆检测，比较Bonferroni逐步校准与轨迹级最大值校准两种方案，在CIFAR-10 EDM上验证轨迹级校准更省误报预算且在高噪声下更早检出。
AI.motivation: 现有无条件扩散模型记忆检测通常在预设时间步上进行，无法随去噪轨迹自适应调整检测时刻；而序列监控虽可自适应，却在多个时间步重复检验，导致轨迹级误报控制困难。
AI.method: 将split conformal校准与序列监控结合，提出两种免提示词检测方案：(1) 逐步Bonferroni校准，将误报预算分摊到各时间步；(2) 直接对轨迹最大记忆分数做轨迹级校准。每步统计量采用基于几何与表示尖峰性的两种互补指标，在无条件CIFAR-10 EDM上评估。
AI.result: 序列监控在功效—检测时机的权衡上优于固定时刻检测；相比Bonferroni校准，轨迹级校正在检测功效相当的情况下更少保守地使用误报预算，并能在更高噪声水平下更早检出。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级保形校准是结合序列监控进行扩散模型记忆检测的更优误报控制方式，兼顾自适应检测时机与统计可靠性。

title: PhysCreator: Creating Physically-Attributed 3D Assets at Will
summary: Significant advancements in 3D asset creation have enabled high-fidelity 3D generation from images. However, most existing representations remain inherently static, lacking the ability to model physically plausible behaviors under dynamic interactions. We present \textbf{PhysCreator}, a unified framework that directly generates simulation-ready 3D representations with spatially varying physical properties from images. Unlike prior approaches that treat physical attributes as simple post-hoc predictions or rely on expensive per-instance optimization, we reformulate physical property estimation within a unified 3D representation learning framework. We introduce a voxel-aligned latent space by lifting image observations into a spatially structured 3D representation, in which geometry, appearance, and physical properties are jointly modeled and inferred in a feed-forward manner. To enable scalable learning without densely annotated physical ground truth, we leverage vision-language distillation to transfer material-aware semantic priors from powerful vision-language models into spatially grounded voxel-level supervision. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior visual quality, physical plausibility, and generalization compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysCreator 统一框架，从图像直接生成可仿真的三维表示，并在体素对齐的隐空间中联合建模几何、外观与空间变化的物理属性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D生成多为静态表示，无法模拟动态交互下的物理合理行为；已有物理属性预测方法或是事后单独预测，或依赖昂贵的逐实例优化。
AI.method: 将图像观测提升为空间结构化的体素对齐隐空间，前馈式联合推断几何、外观和物理属性；并利用视觉-语言模型蒸馏，把材质语义先验迁移为体素级监督，避免稠密物理标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比先前方法，本方法在视觉质量、物理合理性和泛化性上均更优。
AI.conclusion: 将物理属性估计纳入统一3D表示学习，结合VLM语义蒸馏，可高效生成高质量、可仿真且泛化良好的3D资产。

title: Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models
comment: Code and reproducibility: https://github.com/Muuzzziiy/cql-handoff 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables
summary: How do later loops in a pretrained looped language model repair two-hop retrieval? We study Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B by transplanting attention queries between loops at the same layer, head and final prompt position. On synthetic in-context questions, injecting the layer-indexed collection of loop-3 queries throughout loop 1 rescues 90% and 97% of questions answered incorrectly at loop 1 and correctly at loop 3, versus 24% and 21% for shuffled donors. The rescue also holds under greedy generation in Ouro-2.6B; in Ouro-1.4B it is limited to four-candidate ranking. Crossed donor-recipient swaps favor retrieval through the donor's bridge entity over copying its answer, although a substantial positional component remains in Ouro-2.6B. Late keys and values rescue far fewer targets. Freezing queries at their loop-1 values also damages two-hop accuracy more than a matched question that supplies the bridge. On natural questions, rescue is smaller and replicates only in Ouro-2.6B, and crossed swaps do not establish bridge redirection. These results identify a transferable collection of late-loop queries that supports bridge-conditioned retrieval on synthetic scenes; they do not locate where the bridge is computed or establish a single-vector handoff.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过在同一层、同一注意力头、同一最终提示位置上跨循环移植注意力查询（attention queries），研究预训练循环语言模型（Ouro-1.4B/2.6B）中后续循环如何修复两跳检索。
AI.motivation: 理解循环语言模型后期循环的机制，特别是它们如何修复早期循环失败的两跳检索任务，并探究这种修复是否依赖可迁移的注意力查询集合。
AI.method: 将loop-3的查询集合注入loop-1，对比打乱后的供体查询；进行交叉供体-受体交换实验；测试晚期的key/value注入效果；将查询冻结在loop-1值;并在自然问题上验证（Ouro-2.6B）。
AI.result: 在合成上下文问题上，注入loop-3查询可分别挽救Ouro-1.4B和Ouro-2.6B中90%和97%的loop-1错误但loop-3正确的两跳问题（打乱对照仅24%和21%）。交叉交换倾向于通过供体桥接实体进行检索而非复制答案，但Ouro-2.6B存在显著位置成分；晚期key/value挽救效果差；冻结查询比匹配的桥接问题损伤更大。自然问题上挽救较小，仅在Ouro-2.6B中复现，交叉交换未确立桥接重定向。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在一组可迁移的后期循环查询支持合成场景下的桥接条件检索，但未能定位桥接计算的位置，也未证实单向量交接机制。

title: Conviction Without Evidence: Verdict Stability Is Independent of Visual Grounding in Medical Vision--Language Models
comment: Accepted at the Med-Reasoner workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Vision--language models applied to medical question answering can reach correct diagnoses without using the diagnostic image, inferring instead from the clinical vignette. We ask whether this is visible in how \emph{firmly} a model holds its answer: does a model defend a diagnosis derived from a blank placeholder as tenaciously as one derived from a real medical image? Crossing an image-substitution protocol with two levels of adversarial pressure on 60 Italian State Examination items, we find no evidence that ungrounded verdicts are more fragile. In a paired item-level analysis, fabricated consensus (L4) overturns 94.4\% of verdicts with the real image and 98.1\% without ($Δ= +0.037$; one-sided 95\% upper bound $+0.105$); contentless doubt (L1) overturns 62.5\% and 51.8\% ($Δ= -0.107$, 95\% CI $[-0.209, -0.001]$), the point estimate running opposite to the direction a grounding detector requires. The two levels nonetheless produce opposite \emph{dynamics}: under L4 the model flips once, always to the exact option argued for (110/110 first-turn flips), and then freezes, averaging 1.9 verdict changes over ten turns; under L1 it never settles, averaging 7.4 changes. Instability under contentless doubt tracks intrinsic item ambiguity rather than evidence availability, and so does not serve as a grounding signal. Flips are almost entirely corrupting (99/100 across both levels). The model is not unaware of the missing evidence---it flags the blank image at baseline on 35 of 60 items and abstains on 4--6---yet those abstentions do not survive contact with pressure. None of the epistemic signals a user could plausibly consult distinguishes a grounded diagnosis from a confabulated one.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验视觉语言模型在医学问答中不依赖图像却能给出正确诊断时，其答案是否"更不牢固"。结果表明，无图像依据的判断并不比有图像的判断更脆弱，任何用户可探查的认知信号都无法区分"有依据"与"编造"的诊断。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示视觉语言模型在医学问答中即使拿到空白占位图也能仅凭临床病例文本得出正确诊断。作者想探究这种"无依据"结论是否会在模型对其答案的信念牢固程度上有所体现——即模型是否会像捍卫真实图像支撑的诊断一样捍卫凭空推断的诊断。
AI.method: 在60道意大利国家医学考试题上，采用"图像替换"协议（真实图像 vs. 空白占位图），并交织两种对抗压力水平：L1无内容怀疑与L4伪造共识。对每个题项做配对层面分析，考察判决翻转率、翻转动态（十轮对话中的变化次数）以及基线时的证据缺失识别与弃答行为。
AI.result: 无证据表明无依据结论更脆弱。伪造共识(L4)在真实图像下推翻94.4%的判决，无图像下推翻98.1%（Δ=+0.037，单侧95%上界+0.105）；无内容怀疑(L1)分别为62.5%与51.8%（Δ=-0.107，95%CI[-0.209,-0.001]），点估计方向与"依据检测器"所需相反。两水平的动态相反：L4下模型一次翻转到被论证的具体选项(110/110)后冻结，十轮平均1.9次变化；L1下永不稳定，平均7.4次变化。L1下的不稳定源于题目本身歧义而非证据缺失。翻转几乎全是破坏性的(99/100)。模型能识别缺图（基线35/60题标注空白图像，4–6题弃答），但弃答在压力下不存续。
AI.conclusion: 模型对无图像依据的诊断并不更不牢固，其不稳定反映的是题目内在歧义而非证据可得性，故不能作为依据信号。在压力下弃答行为消失，用户可合理查询的任何认知信号都无法区分有依据与编造的诊断，这对医学视觉语言模型的可信度构成严重警示。

title: The Geometry of Emotion Representations Across Scale, Depth, and Instruction Tuning
summary: We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google's Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component's share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector's own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2's variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B's final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.

AI.tldr: 研究测量Gemma 2系列（2B/9B/27B，base与instruction-tuned共六个模型）的情绪几何，发现核心几何在所有模型中存在、可跨模型线性映射，规模扩大分散方差但不削弱与效价的相关，且微调未超越效应下限。
AI.motivation: 沿用Sofroniew et al.(2026)与Hollowell(2026)的情绪提取流程，希望在Gemma 2家族的多个规模和微调变体上系统检验情绪几何的普遍性、跨模型一致性、规模效应及微调影响。
AI.method: 用既有提取管道得到六模型的情绪向量；拟合模型两两间线性映射并测试留出情绪的最近邻排名；比较各模型主成分方差占比与人类效价评分的相关；将情绪向量投影到输出词表，逐层考察自身情绪词进入top-10,000的深度；并做带下限（floor）的调优效应审计。
AI.result: (1) 核心情绪几何在全部六格出现；15对定向映射中仅失败1次，中位排名均为1，清洗后向量重拟合在全部30个有序对中均排名1。(2) 主成分方差占比随规模下降（base 31.6→29.8→26.7%，tuned 31.9→29.2→27.3%），效价相关稳在.71–.78。(3) 2B/9B中情绪词从第0层即进入top-10,000，27B则近随机、约前半网络在外、于第23层一步进入。(4) 微调各层指标均在下限内；效价相关升、唤醒相关降（与预期相反），PC2方差占比下降且校正后显著，中后期层稳定性超下限，源自base 27B末层。
AI.conclusion: 情绪几何在Gemma 2各规模及微调版本中普遍且高度可对齐；规模主要使方差更分散而非削弱效价联系；输出词表层面的情绪词浮现深度存在明显规模差异；指令微调未见超越效应下限的系统改变。代码、数据与审计报告已公开。

title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
summary: Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs and coordinated repository revisions. Tasks span three capability dimensions: Grounded Understanding, UI Transformation, and Functional Implementation. The tasks pair normalized requests and runnable pre-edit applications with 2,331 hidden expert-authored acceptance criteria. Our judge-then-refute protocol grades criteria using source and browser evidence, challenges positive verdicts with a separate LLM verifier, and audits visual and interaction claims without gold code or target screenshots. Under a shared agentic harness, the strongest of ten model endpoints passes an average of 69.9% of criteria per task but fully satisfies only 26.4% of tasks. All ten endpoints achieve lower criterion completion on repository edits spanning three or four change types than on those spanning one or two. Co-Design Bench provides a testbed for studying the gap between partial requirement satisfaction and complete task success under agentic execution for real-user application revisions.

AI.tldr: 提出Co-Design Bench，一个从真实用户会话中构建的无参考基准，用于评测编码智能体能否将用户多模态请求转化为可运行的应用修改。
AI.motivation: 评估人-AI协同设计需要检验编码智能体能否把真实用户的多模态需求落地为可运行的应用修改，但缺乏贴近真实用户请求、且不依赖标准答案的评测基准。
AI.method: 从26,314个真实用户编码会话的37,463条去重查询中策选出273个任务，分为多模态编辑(ME)与仓库编辑(RE)两条赛道，覆盖三项能力：基于上下文的准确理解、UI变换、功能实现。任务包含规范化请求、可运行的修改前应用，以及2,331条隐藏的专家验收标准；采用"评判-反驳"协议：用源码与浏览器证据打分，由另一LLM核验器质疑正向判定，并在无金标准代码或目标截图下审查视觉与交互声明。
AI.result: 在统一智能体运行框架下，十个模型端点中最强者平均仅通过69.9%的验收标准，但完全满足全部标准的任务只占26.4%；对于涉及三到四类改动的仓库编辑任务，十个端点的标准完成率均低于只涉及一到两类的任务。
AI.conclusion: Co-Design Bench为研究真实用户应用修改中"部分满足需求"与"完整任务成功"之间的差距提供了测试平台。

title: Video World Models Need Predictable Latents
summary: Video world models trained on large-scale robot data promise a safe and scalable approach for learning and evaluating policies that act in the physical world. However, they still struggle with long-horizon rollouts and out-of-distribution generalization, and they remain computationally demanding at inference time. Typically, video world models make predictions in the latent space of a reconstruction-trained autoencoder, which however is not directly optimized for dynamics modeling. On the other hand, world models designed for latent planning usually optimize latents to be predictable, but they forgo accurate prediction of observations in pixel space. In this paper, we show that it is possible to achieve the best of both worlds: a latent geometry optimized to make future prediction as simple as possible without sacrificing accurate prediction of future observations. More precisely, we find that temporal objectives for representation learning, paired with a past-conditioned decoder architecture, lead to consistent improvements in generative video world models at the same training budget. The gains include up to 5x cheaper inference, over 7x faster training, and 15-24% lower pixel and perceptual errors out of distribution and over long horizons. Our world models also agree more closely with real-world policy evaluation when using a vision-language model to judge task success from their pixel-space predictions. Overall, our study indicates that temporal predictability is an important design criterion for the latent space of video world models, and provides concrete guidance on how to incorporate it into the training of autoencoders.

AI.tldr: 通过为视频世界模型的潜空间引入时序可预测性目标并配合历史条件解码器，在相同训练预算下同时实现高效推理与准确像素预测。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型存在两方面矛盾：基于重建自编码器的潜空间未针对动力学建模优化，导致长时程 rollout 与分布外泛化差、推理计算昂贵；而为潜规划设计的可预测潜空间又牺牲了像素空间的准确预测。作者希望兼得二者。
AI.method: 在自编码器表征学习中引入时序（temporal）目标，使潜空间几何尽可能利于未来预测，同时采用以过去为条件的解码器（past-conditioned decoder）架构，保证未来观测的像素级准确重建。
AI.result: 相同训练预算下取得一致提升：推理成本最多降低5倍，训练速度提升7倍以上；在分布外与长时程场景下像素误差与感知误差降低15–24%；且用视觉语言模型基于像素预测评判任务成功时，与真实策略评估更一致。
AI.conclusion: 时序可预测性是视频世界模型潜空间的重要设计准则，论文给出了将其融入自编码器训练的具体指导。

title: VTC-AUDIT: An Interventional Reliability Audit for Visual-Token Compression under Paired Image Shifts
comment: 9 pages, 6 tables. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/IsaacLi74/VTC-AUDIT
summary: Visual-token compression is usually evaluated by clean accuracy and efficiency, but these averages do not reveal failures that compression introduces under an image shift where the uncompressed model stays correct. We introduce VTC-AUDIT, which estimates this incremental risk only on pairs where the full model is correct on both images and the compressed model is correct on the clean image. The four arms then cross two binary choices: which image selects the retained token positions, and which image supplies the visual features. We audit three open 8-9B vision-language models on four tasks and eight pre-specified shifts. We evaluate two training-free compressors---hard-pruning DivPrune and prune-and-merge ApET---at a matched 25% retained-position budget, producing 708,000 inference records. Reselecting positions on the shifted image, rather than reusing the clean-image positions, raises the failure rate in all six model-compressor settings. The increase is 3.04-9.60 percentage points for DivPrune and 2.05-4.20 percentage points for ApET, with every 95% interval above zero. Repeating the audit on a separately resampled second manifest reproduces all six increases. In a pooled monitor audit across the four benchmarks, support Jaccard instability fails the practical AUROC criterion of 0.65 in all six settings, whereas clean compressed-model uncertainty clears it. Thus, support turnover is a weak ranking signal under the audited benchmark mixture, while clean compressed-model uncertainty is substantially more informative. These results suggest that future visual-token compression evaluations should report conditional reliability alongside clean accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VTC-AUDIT 审计框架，在"原模型对两图都正确"的条件子集上衡量视觉 token 压缩在图像偏移下引入的增量风险，发现改用偏移图重选 token 位置会显著抬高失败率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 token 压缩评测只看干净图像上的平均准确率与效率，掩盖了压缩在分布偏移下引入的失败——即原模型仍正确、压缩模型却出错的情况。
AI.method: 仅在"全模型对干净图与偏移图都正确、且压缩模型对干净图正确"的图像对上估计增量风险；四臂设计交叉两个二元选择：用哪张图选择保留 token 位置、用哪张图提供视觉特征。审计 3 个 8–9B 开源 VLM、4 项任务、8 个预设偏移，比较两种免训练压缩器（硬剪枝 DivPrune、剪枝合并 ApET），统一 25% 保留位置预算，共 708,000 条推理记录；并用第二份重采样清单复现，另做监控信号 AUROC 对比。
AI.result: 在偏移图上重选位置相比复用干净图位置，在全部 6 个模型-压缩器组合中均提高失败率：DivPrune 升高 3.04–9.60 个百分点，ApET 升高 2.05–4.20 个百分点，所有 95% 区间均大于零；第二清单复现全部 6 项增幅。监控审计中，支撑集 Jaccard 不稳定性的 AUROC 在 6 个设置下均未达 0.65 门槛，而干净压缩模型不确定性则通过。
AI.conclusion: 支撑集更替在混合基准下是较弱的排序信号，而干净压缩模型不确定性信息量明显更强；未来压缩评测应把条件可靠性（增量风险）与干净准确率、效率一并报告。

title: ImgMT: Wikipedia-based Dataset For Evaluating Text-in-Image Translation
summary:
Text-in-image translation aims to translate all textual content embedded in an image. In Text Image Translation (TIT), the output is translated text; In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT) additionally renders the translation back into the image. We introduce ImgMT, a massively multilingual dataset and benchmark mined from localized SVG illustrations on Wikimedia Commons, focusing on diagrams, maps, and infographics. ImgMT contains 35,612 aligned image pairs grouped into 1,855 image sets, spanning 129 languages, 20+ writing systems, and 4,886 language pairs.
  We propose a multi-level evaluation protocol that measures source-side text-region detection and OCR accuracy alongside target-side translation quality. We benchmark several multimodal large language models and a dedicated TIT system in English->X and X->English settings, and find that the source language and writing system substantially affect TIT quality. Finally, we show that ImgMT is not well suited for isolating the contribution of visual information in multimodal translation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ImgMT，一个从Wikimedia Commons本地化SVG插图中挖掘的大规模多语图文翻译数据集与基准，包含35,612对齐图像对、1,855图像集，覆盖129种语言、20+书写系统、4,886语言对，并提出多层次评测协议。
AI.motivation: 文本图像翻译（TIT）与图内机器翻译（IIMT）缺乏覆盖多语言、多书写系统的大规模数据与统一评测，现有资源难以系统衡量源语言与书写系统对翻译质量的影响。
AI.method: 从Wikimedia Commons本地化SVG插图（图表、地图、信息图）中挖掘对齐图像对构建ImgMT；提出多层次评测协议，同时衡量源端文本区域检测与OCR准确率以及目标端翻译质量；在英→X与X→英设置下评测多个多模态大模型及一个专用TIT系统。
AI.result: 基准实验显示源语言与书写系统显著影响TIT质量；同时发现ImgMT不适合用于隔离多模态翻译中视觉信息的贡献。
AI.conclusion: ImgMT提供了大规模多语文本图像翻译数据与多级评测基准，揭示语言/书写系统对翻译质量的重要影响，并为后续数据与评测设计指明方向。

title: LongSearchEval: Evaluating Long-Horizon Web Search Capabilities of Large Language Models via a Trajectory-Aware Agent Framework with Failure-Node Localization
summary: Long-horizon web search requires LLM-based agents to integrate information across web pages through extended interactions under task-specific constraints. Evaluating this capability is important not only for measuring final answer quality, but also for assessing whether an agent acquires, verifies, and uses evidence reliably over extended interactions. Existing evaluations, however, mainly rely on simulated trajectories or on post-hoc trajectories reconstructed from final answers, rather than on retained real interaction traces, which limits the fidelity of behavioral assessment and weakens support for fine-grained error localization. To address this gap, we introduce LONGSEARCHEVAL, a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework that combines a unified agent execution protocol with source constrained outcome verification and retrospective failure-node localization. Stage 1 verifies answer groups against agent-cited webpages without human-authored gold answers; Stage 2 audits normalized rounds and links flagged failure nodes to incorrect answer groups. We evaluate 16 models from eight families on 100 tasks, yielding 1,600 retained runs and 6,545 automatically flagged failure nodes. Trajectory collection and evaluation required 1,037 and 318 hours of cumulative runtime, respectively. Human validation yields 94.50% agreement on supplied answer-group labels and 98.11% feature-correspondence precision for audited round-group links. Together, outcome scores and linked trajectory evidence support controlled model comparison and retrospective inspection of answer-related content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LONGSEARCHEVAL，一个感知轨迹的智能体评测框架，结合统一执行协议、来源约束的结果验证和回顾式失败节点定位，在100个任务上评测16个模型，获得1600条真实运行记录并定位6545个失败节点。
AI.motivation: 长程网络搜索需要智能体在任务约束下跨越多个网页进行长时间交互与信息整合。现有评测多依赖模拟轨迹或从最终答案反推的后验轨迹，而非真实保留的交互记录，导致行为评测保真度不足，也难以进行细粒度错误定位。
AI.method: LONGSEARCHEVAL 包含统一智能体执行协议，以及两阶段评测：阶段1基于智能体引用的网页对答案组进行验证，无需人工金标准答案；阶段2审计规范化后的交互轮次，并将标记的失败节点关联到错误的答案组。
AI.result: 在100个任务上评测8个家族的16个模型，得到1600条保留运行记录和6545个自动标记的失败节点；轨迹收集与评测累计耗时分别为1037和318小时。人工验证显示答案组标签一致性94.50%，审计轮次-组链接的特征对应精度98.11%。
AI.conclusion: 结果分数与关联的轨迹证据相结合，可支持受控的模型比较和针对答案相关内容的回顾式检查，提升了长程搜索智能体评测的保真度与可解释性。

title: Exploring perceptual straightness in learned visual representations
summary: Humans have been shown to use a "straightened" encoding to represent the natural visual world as it evolves in time (Hénaff et al. 2019). In the context of discrete video sequences, "straightened" means that changes between frames follow a more linear path in representation space at progressively deeper levels of processing. While deep convolutional networks are often proposed as models of human visual processing, many do not straighten natural videos. In this paper, we explore the relationship between network architecture, differing types of robustness, biologically-inspired filtering mechanisms, and representational straightness in response to time-varying input; we identify strengths and limitations of straightness as a useful way of evaluating neural network representations. We find that (1) adversarial training leads to straighter representations in both CNN and transformer-based architectures but (2) this effect is task-dependent, not generalizing to tasks such as segmentation and frame-prediction, where straight representations are not favorable for predictions; and nor to other types of robustness. In addition, (3) straighter representations impart temporal stability to class predictions, even for out-of-distribution data. Finally, (4) biologically-inspired elements increase straightness in the early stages of a network, but do not guarantee increased straightness in downstream layers of CNNs. We show that straightness is an easily computed measure of representational robustness and stability, as well as a hallmark of human representations with benefits for computer vision models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究深度网络在时间变化输入下的表征"直线化"（straightness）现象，发现对抗训练能提升CNN和Transformer的直线性，但该效应依赖任务，直线表征能为分类预测带来时间稳定性，生物启发模块只能提升浅层直线性。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉对随时间演变的自然世界采用"直线化"编码，而多数深度卷积网络并不能对自然视频产生直线化表征，因此有必要探究影响表征直线性的因素及其作为评价指标的可用性。
AI.method: 在离散视频序列上，考察网络架构（CNN与Transformer）、多种鲁棒性类型、生物启发式滤波机制与表征直线性之间的关系，并提出直线性作为一种易计算的表征鲁棒性与稳定性度量。
AI.result: (1) 对抗训练在CNN和Transformer中均提升直线性；(2) 该效应依赖任务，不推广到分割、帧预测等任务，也不推广到其他鲁棒性类型；(3) 更直的表征即便对分布外数据也能赋予类别预测时间稳定性；(4) 生物启发元素提升早期层直线性，但不保证CNN下游层同样提升。
AI.conclusion: 直线性是易计算的表征鲁棒性与稳定性度量，既是人类表征的标志，也对计算机视觉模型有益，同时具有明确的任务与层级局限。

title: GRASP: Group-Adaptive Hybrid RL-SFT Post-Training for Medical VQA without Reasoning Annotations
summary: Adapting general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) to medical visual question answering (VQA) is valuable for helping clinicians read images and make diagnoses, but annotated data are scarce and provide only short answers, without reasoning annotations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fits these labels but overfits to them and amplifies their biases, eroding out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) better preserves generalization but never uses the gold answer as a training target: GRPO-style algorithms learn from the contrast between correct and incorrect answers within a group of sampled responses, so all-correct or all-wrong groups give no correctness signal. Existing SFT-RL hybrids either apply SFT and RL in separate stages or switch between them per question, or need reasoning traces from experts or stronger models, which medical VQA data lack. We propose GRASP, which combines RL and SFT in every update using only short answers: RL lets the model explore its own reasoning, SFT teaches the gold answer after that reasoning to supply the direct supervision RL lacks, and their balance adapts to how well the model answers each question. Tuning only about 1% of the parameters with LoRA, GRASP outperforms all compared training objectives both in domain and on OOD open-ended questions across Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3-8B and Gemma 3-4B. On an OOD benchmark spanning eight imaging modalities, GRASP-trained InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B beat all 10 compared general and medical VLMs in open-ended accuracy, including models trained on up to 2,600 times more data or with over 250 times more trainable parameters. We release MedTerse, a dataset of 12.9K short-answer questions, and our code at https://github.com/sea-comet/GRASP-MedVQA.

AI.tldr: GRASP 将强化学习与监督微调在同一次更新中逐样本自适应融合，仅用短答案就显著提升医学 VQA 的域内与域外泛化能力，并发布 MedTerse 数据集。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉语言模型适配医学VQA有价值，但标注数据稀缺且只有短答案、缺少推理标注。SFT会过拟合标签并放大偏差，损害域外泛化；RL虽保泛化但不把金答案作为训练目标，GRPO在组内全对或全错时无信号。现有SFT-RL混合方法要么分阶段、要么逐题切换，或需专家/强模型推理轨迹，而医学VQA数据缺乏这些。
AI.method: 提出GRASP：在每次更新中同时结合RL与SFT，仅用短答案。RL让模型自行探索推理；SFT在该推理之后教金答案，提供RL缺失的直接监督；两者权重根据模型对每题的回答质量自适应调整。采用LoRA，只微调约1%参数。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3-8B和Gemma 3-4B上，无论域内还是域外开放式问题，GRASP均优于所有对比训练目标。在覆盖八种影像模态的域外基准上，GRASP训练的InternVL3-8B与Qwen3-VL-8B开放式准确率超过全部10个对比的通用与医学VLM，包括训练数据多至2600倍或可训练参数多至250倍的模型。
AI.conclusion: GRASP证明仅凭短答案即可在每次更新中融合RL与SFT，并以极少可训练参数（LoRA约1%）实现强域外泛化；同时发布12.9K短答案问题数据集MedTerse及代码。

title: INVAR-Agri: Detecting Discrepancies in Multilingual Operator Manuals of Agricultural Implements with a Fine-Tuned LLM
summary: Operator manuals of agricultural implements are delivered in many languages, and the standards require that competent persons review every translation, which makes this review the bottleneck. This paper presents a proof of concept that compares two training workflows on the same LLM, EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct, trained on operator manuals of one manufacturer. In approach A, a back-translator translates each language version back into English, and an English reader compares it with the English version. In approach B, a checker reads the English version and the translation together, where the checker reports differences. The test sets contain errors planted in numbers, units, opposite words, obligations, negations, and conditions in 24 languages, and they include unmodified text and meaning-preserving edits for alerts and false alarms. The trained back-translator concealed many planted errors, most of all weakened obligations, while translation-quality scores rose. In contrast, the separately trained checker detected most planted errors, although it was weak for units and for number changes unlike those in training. A check by the author confirmed the concealment. In addition, a simple rule check caught the number and unit changes, but it alerted on harmless rewrites. A check of alerts on real Finnish translations showed that most alerts were false, caused by language-specific wording, so the precision on real text remains a limitation. Within this setting, a trained checker might support, not replace, the review by competent persons, and firmer conclusions need more data.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较两种基于EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct的翻译审校流程：回译法（A）与检查器法（B）。结果显示，训练后的检查器能检出多数植入错误，而回译器会掩盖错误；但真实芬兰语文本上的告警多为误报，精度仍是局限。
AI.motivation: 农机操作手册需以多语言发布，标准要求由合格人员审校每份译文，人工审校成为瓶颈，作者希望探索LLM辅助审校的可行性。
AI.method: 在同一LLM上按两种工作流分别训练：A为回译—英文比对，B为检查器直接对照英文与译文并报告差异。测试集覆盖24种语言，植入数字、单位、反义词、义务、否定和条件类错误，并含未改动文本与保义改写以测告警与误报；另做作者人工核查和简单规则检查对照。
AI.result: 回译器掩盖了大量植入错误（尤其是被弱化的义务），但翻译质量评分反而上升；检查器检出多数植入错误，但对单位及与训练分布不同的数字改动较弱。规则检查能抓住数字与单位变化但会对无害改写报警；真实芬兰语译文上的告警多为语言措辞导致的误报。
AI.conclusion: 在此概念验证范围内，训练后的检查器可辅助而非替代合格人员审校；更确定的结论需要更多数据。

title: AutoEnergyDesign: An LLM-Driven Agent for Automatic Energy System Design Optimization
summary: Designing building energy systems is a high-dimensional, mixed-integer search problem: when each design is evaluated by a year-long simulation, black-box optimizers typically need hundreds of evaluations. This paper presents AutoEnergyDesign, a framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) agent reasons over previous simulation results, proposes configuration changes and learns in context from each outcome, while a git-based mechanism automatically reverts unsuccessful changes. The agent couples a reasoning model with an explicit memory organisation (procedural, semantic, episodic and reflective), a constrained action interface and an environment-grounded keep/revert signal. The simulator covers eight technologies (photovoltaics, micro-wind, combined heat and power, solar thermal, gas boilers, batteries, heat pumps and inverters) and computes the 25-year Net Present Cost (NPC), including capital and operating costs and salvage value. On a case study with measured building load profiles, the agent, run with Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 (ten runs of 50 simulations each), is compared with random search, Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) Bayesian optimization and a $(1+1)$ evolution strategy sharing the agent's acceptance rule (300 evaluations, ten seeds). With all three models the agent reaches an NPC of about 3.53 MEUR, 1.20% below the best TPE result and 0.23% below the best evolution-strategy result. It comes within 1% of this design after a median of 18 (Opus) to 27.5 (Haiku) simulations, whereas among the baselines only the evolution strategy does so, in half of its seeds and after a median of 192 evaluations. Opus reaches the best design in all ten runs, Sonnet in six (two runs never come within 1%), and Haiku comes within 1% in every run but reaches it exactly only once. Every decision is recorded in an auditable trace.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoEnergyDesign：让LLM智能体基于历史仿真结果推理并提出建筑能源系统配置改动，配合git式回滚与四类记忆，在少量仿真内逼近最优净现值成本，显著优于随机搜索、TPE与(1+1)进化策略。
AI.motivation: 建筑能源系统设计是高维混合整数搜索问题，单次评估需一年期仿真，黑盒优化器通常需数百次评估，效率低、成本高。
AI.method: LLM智能体结合推理模型、显式记忆组织（程序性、语义、情景、反思性）、受限动作接口和基于环境的保留/回滚信号；git式机制自动撤销失败改动；仿真器覆盖光伏、微风电、热电联产、太阳能热利用、燃气锅炉、电池、热泵、逆变器八种技术，计算含资本、运行成本与残值的25年净现值成本(NPC)。
AI.result: 用Claude Haiku/Sonnet/Opus 5.5各10次×50次仿真，NPC约3.53 MEUR，比最佳TPE低1.20%，比最佳进化策略低0.23%；中位18次(Opus)至27.5次(Haiku)仿真即进入最优1%范围内，而基线中仅进化策略半数种子做到且需中位192次评估；Opus十次全达最优，Sonnet六次，Haiku均进入1%但仅一次精确命中。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体+记忆与回滚机制可在极少仿真预算下高效求解高维混合整数建筑设计问题，且每个决策均有可审计追踪，为昂贵仿真下的优化提供高效可解释方案。

title: AT-AT: Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces
summary: Efforts to improve LLM-based agents typically focus on modifying the agent itself, yet success also depends on the environment in which an agent acts. Tools mediate this interaction: a tool's description shapes how an agent calls it, and its implementation determines the results and errors the agent receives afterwards. Many tools, such as APIs and MCP servers, are shared by many agents and maintained by providers who cannot change those agents. We introduce AT-AT (Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces), an agentic tool optimizer that improves a shared toolset offline from historical agent executions while holding the agents fixed. A lightweight coding agent reads agent trajectories and their evaluation results, and selectively edits tool descriptions and, when permitted, implementations. On $τ^2$-bench-verified, AT-AT achieves the highest task completion rates in the Airline and Telecom domains at lower cost than strong prompt- and tool-optimizer baselines, and its Telecom gain is statistically significant under paired permutation tests. Optimizing the tools within a coding agent harness also improves held-out performance on TerminalBench-2 and TBLite. When applied to three production MCP servers at a large enterprise, AT-AT lowered cost or tool error rates on every server and increased held-out task passes on one. By turning accumulated execution traces into updates to shared tool environments, AT-AT provides a path toward continual improvement of agent systems through environment-side learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 AT-AT，一种从智能体历史执行轨迹中离线优化共享工具集的方法，固定智能体本身，通过轻量级编码智能体编辑工具描述（必要时改实现）来提升整体任务表现。
AI.motivation: 以往提升 LLM 智能体的工作多聚焦于修改智能体本身，但智能体能否成功也取决于其所处环境。工具是中介：描述影响调用方式，实现决定返回结果与错误。且许多工具（如 API、MCP 服务器）被多个智能体共享，由提供方维护，无法改动这些智能体。
AI.method: AT-AT（Automatic Tool Optimization from Agent Traces）：一个智能体式工具优化器，在离线状态下利用历史智能体执行轨迹改进共享工具集，同时保持智能体固定。由一个轻量级编码智能体读取智能体轨迹及其评估结果，选择性地编辑工具描述，并在允许时编辑工具实现。
AI.result: 在 τ²-bench-verified 上，Airline 和 Telecom 领域取得最高任务完成率，成本低于强提示与工具优化基线，Telecom 提升在配对置换检验下统计显著。在编码智能体框架内优化工具还提升了 TerminalBench-2 与 TBLite 的留出性能。应用于某大型企业三个生产 MCP 服务器时，每个服务器的成本或工具错误率均下降，其中一个服务器的留出任务通过率提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将累积的执行轨迹转化为对共享工具环境的更新，AT-AT 为经由“环境侧学习”实现智能体系统的持续改进提供了路径。

title: Recursive CLIP: Vision-Language Distillation with Looped Transformer Blocks
summary: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP typically rely on independently parameterized transformer blocks across depth. We investigate the extent to which these blocks can instead be reused recurrently while preserving the transferable capabilities of CLIP. We study recursive transformer backbones in which a small set of $N$ transformer blocks is applied $M$ times per forward pass. By holding $N \cdot M$ fixed to the depth of a standard ViT-B, our models preserve computational depth while progressively increasing parameter sharing. We consider two recursive CLIP model families: rCLIP, where only the vision encoder is recursive, and r$^2$CLIP, where recurrence is also introduced in the text encoder. We study these models under both direct contrastive training and through knowledge distillation from a strong ViT-B/16 teacher pretrained on DFN-2B, using the substantially smaller CC3M and CC12M datasets. We evaluate the resulting models on zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval, and further study their adaptability through few-shot learning, visual grounding, and concept unlearning. Our results show that CLIP can tolerate substantial recurrent block reuse, although its effect depends on the encoder and downstream task. Recurrence also provides parameter efficiency by construction, since fewer distinct transformer blocks need to be stored and adapted. Our results establish recurrent block reuse as a practical design space for vision-language models and highlight its implications for knowledge transfer, downstream adaptation, and parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究CLIP视觉-语言模型中跨深度独立参数的transformer块能否被递归复用（N个块重复M次，保持N·M等于ViT-B深度），提出rCLIP（仅视觉编码器递归）与r²CLIP（文本编码器也递归），在直接对比训练和DFN-2B教师蒸馏（CC3M/CC12M）下评估。
AI.motivation: CLIP等对比视觉-语言模型各层transformer块参数独立，参数量与深度线性增长。作者希望探究大幅度的块复用是否会破坏CLIP的可迁移能力，并借此获得参数效率，同时理解递归设计对知识迁移与下游适配的影响。
AI.method: 保持计算深度不变（N·M固定为ViT-B深度），逐步增加参数共享程度，构造两类模型：rCLIP仅视觉编码器递归，r²CLIP视觉与文本编码器均递归。在直接对比式训练与从DFN-2B预训练的强ViT-B/16教师蒸馏（使用较小的CC3M、CC12M）两种设定下训练，并在零样本分类、跨模态检索、少样本学习、视觉定位和概念遗忘等任务上评估。
AI.result: CLIP能够容忍相当程度的递归块复用，但影响因编码器（视觉/文本）和下游任务而异；递归结构天然带来参数效率，因为需要存储和适配的独立transformer块更少；蒸馏设定下仍能保持可迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 递归块复用是视觉-语言模型一个实用且有价值的设计空间，对知识迁移、下游适配和参数效率均有启示，说明CLIP的可迁移性并不严重依赖逐层独立参数。

title: Probing the phon* representations of the Mimi codebooks
comment: Accepted at the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP-2026) https://aclanthology.org/2026.icnlsp-1.30/
summary: Neural audio codecs are increasingly used to encode speech for integration with large language models. This paper investigates the phonetic representations in the first codebook (CB0) of the Mimi codec. ABX style evaluation is poorly suited to Mimi fixed 80 ms tokenization window, which often spans multiple phonemes; we instead use forced alignment, entropy analysis, and Phone-Normalized Mutual Information (PNMI). Using TIMIT speech (58/55 speakers, SA1/SA2), individual tokens are strongly associated with specific phonemes (PNMI = 0.84, above random), yet phonemes are realized by multiple competing tokens rather than a one-to-one mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文分析 Mimi 神经音频编解码器首个码本(CB0)的音素表征,发现单个 token 与具体音素强关联(PNMI=0.84),但音素由多个竞争性 token 实现,并非一对一映射。
AI.motivation: 神经音频编解码器越来越多用于语音编码以对接大语言模型,但 Mimi 等编解码器首个码本的音素级表征尚不清楚;且常规 ABX 评测不适用于 Mimi 固定 80ms 的 token 化窗口(常跨越多个音素),需要新的分析手段。
AI.method: 使用 TIMIT 语料(58/55 说话人,SA1/SA2 句子),结合强制对齐、熵分析和音素归一化互信息(PNMI)三类方法,替代 ABX 式评测,考察 CB0 token 与音素的对应关系。
AI.result: 各 token 与特定音素呈现强关联(PNMI=0.84,显著高于随机水平);但音素并非由单一 token 一一对应,而是由多个相互竞争的 token 共同实现。
AI.conclusion: Mimi CB0 编码了较强的音素信息但映射为多对一/竞争结构,提示需针对固定窗口编解码器设计更适配的音素级分析方法与评价指标。

title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models: Foundation, Risks, Evaluation and Open Challenges
summary: AI systems built around large models increasingly use experience and feedback to make persistent changes to models, prompts, memories, tools, and workflows. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) extends this process to inductive biases and to the mechanisms that govern future updates, which can themselves be revised and reused across improvement cycles. Yet self-modification alone does not guarantee trustworthy improvement. Reported gains may reflect flawed evaluations, previously acquired capabilities may deteriorate, and compliance with behavioral constraints may weaken. Compromised artifacts or sensitive information may also persist in successor systems. Changes to improvement mechanisms may invalidate earlier verification results and make human oversight less effective. This survey presents an operational definition and process framework for RSI and organizes the requirements for trustworthy RSI into four interconnected themes: genuine and sustained improvement; behavioral constraints, alignment, and fairness; system security and privacy; and transparency and controllability. We examine these themes from three perspectives: Improvement Validity, Constraint Preservation, and Effective Oversight. This analysis covers improvement diagnosis, proposal generation, proposal evaluation, and update implementation (S1--S4), including the recursive application of these stages to improvement mechanisms (RI). We review risks, safeguards, and evaluation evidence for individual updates, effects inherited by successor systems, and revisions to improvement mechanisms, while distinguishing direct RSI findings from evidence in related systems. Finally, we examine evaluation settings, identify requirements for independent and longitudinal assessment, and discuss applications and open research problems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于递归自我改进（RSI）的综述，提出RSI的操作性定义与流程框架，并从"改进有效性、约束保持、有效监督"三视角组织"可信RSI"的四大主题要求。
AI.motivation: 基于大模型的AI系统日益利用经验与反馈对模型、提示、记忆、工具与工作流做持久修改，RSI进一步将这一过程扩展到归纳偏置及治理未来更新的机制本身。但自我修改不等于可信改进：收益可能源于有缺陷的评估、已有能力可能退化、行为约束遵从可能弱化，受损工件或敏感信息可能残留于后继系统，改进机制的变更还可能使先前验证失效、削弱人类监督。因此需要对可信RSI进行系统梳理。
AI.method: 综述方法：给出RSI的操作性定义与流程框架（S1改进诊断、S2提案生成、S3提案评估、S4更新实施，以及将各阶段递归应用于改进机制的RI）；将可信RSI要求归纳为四个相互关联主题——真实且持续的改进；行为约束、对齐与公平；系统安全与隐私；透明性与可控性；并从改进有效性、约束保持、有效监督三个视角审视。同时针对单次更新、后继系统继承效应、改进机制修订三个层面综述风险、防护措施与评估证据，并区分直接的RSI发现与相关系统中的证据。
AI.result: 综述识别了RSI各阶段（含RI递归）在多主题下的风险、防护措施与现有评估证据，区分了直接RSI证据与来自相关系统的间接证据；并讨论了评估设置，提出对独立评估与纵向评估的要求，以及应用方向与开放研究问题。
AI.conclusion: 可信RSI需在真实持续改进、约束保持与有效监督上协同设计；现有证据多为间接且分散，亟待独立的、纵向的评估体系以及针对改进机制本身修订的治理研究。

title: Beyond Deduplication: Sharp Retrieval Limits for Attention with Correlated Distractors
summary: Redundant context affects attention through two distinct mechanisms: repeated items add normalization mass, while score variation within correlated groups can produce extreme individual scores. We separate these effects in a planted retrieval model with exponentially many Gaussian distractors arranged in known, exponentially large clusters. The model is a two-level generalized random energy model, whose classical free energy yields exact retrieval thresholds. Gaussian interpolation further shows that increasing positive correlation at fixed token count lowers the distractor free energy, unlike adding duplicates. Our main result identifies a sharp limitation of subtracting log cluster size from pre-softmax scores: this correction removes multiplicity but retains within-cluster extremes. Even a temperature chosen after observing all scores cannot lower the required signal below $\sqrt{2α_1}$, where $α_1$ is the exponential rate of the number of clusters. Averaging scores before exponentiation instead suppresses these fluctuations and achieves $\sqrt{2ρα_1}$, where $ρ$ is the within-cluster correlation. The gap persists after adding exponentially many singleton distractors, so group size alone does not identify the target, and extends to fixed finite hierarchies of light-tailed independent-increment scores. Finite-sample, stability, and participation results complement the asymptotic analysis. A controlled retrieval experiment with frozen sentence embeddings supports this distinction while delineating its scope: averaging helps when the relevant item is a singleton, but can discard useful evidence when a relevant group contains multiple matching items.

AI.tldr: 本文用两层广义随机能量模型分析冗余上下文对注意力机制的影响，区分"重复项增质量"与"簇内分数波动"两种机制，并证明从softmax前分数中减去log簇大小只能去重、无法消除簇内极端值，而先平均再取指数能抑制波动并达到更低的检索信号阈值。
AI.motivation: 冗余上下文通过两种不同机制影响注意力：重复项增加归一化质量，而相关组内的分数波动可能产生极端个体分数。既有"减去log簇大小"的修正方法能否真正消除冗余影响尚不清楚，需要理论刻画其极限。
AI.method: 构造植入检索模型，将指数多个高斯干扰项组织为已知的指数级大簇，建立两层广义随机能量模型（2-GREM），用经典自由能求精确检索阈值；再用高斯插值分析正相关性的作用；对比"减去log簇大小"与"先簇内平均再指数化"两种去冗余策略，并推广到有限层级轻尾独立增量分数，辅以有限样本、稳定性与参与度分析及冻结句向量的受控检索实验。
AI.result: 固定token数下提高正相关会降低干扰项自由能，与加重复项不同。减去log簇大小的修正即使事后选温度，所需信号也无法低于√(2α₁)；而先平均再指数化可达√(2ρα₁)（ρ为簇内相关）。加入指数多单例干扰项后差距仍存在，说明仅凭组大小无法识别目标；该结论可推广到有限层级层次结构。受控实验支持该区分：单例相关项时平均有益，但相关组含多个匹配项时平均会丢弃有用证据。
AI.conclusion: 组大小本身不足以识别目标，"减去log簇大小"类修正存在本质局限；先平均后指数化能抑制簇内波动并显著降低所需信号，但会牺牲多匹配组内的证据。两种冗余机制需区别对待，去冗余策略应根据相关项是单例还是多匹配组来选择。

title: FlockWorld: Toward Population-Scale Multi-Agent Video World Models through Artificial Life Simulation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Creative AI Track
summary: Most action-conditioned video world models remain limited to a single player, while existing multiplayer models support only small, fixed groups of agents. We introduce FlockWorld, an artificial-life environment built on Reynolds's Boids algorithm for studying population-scale multi-agent video world models. Specifically, FlockWorld renders synchronized egocentric crops, assigns distinct colors to preserve camera-agent identity across views, exposes rule-derived accelerations as actions, and lets the number of camera agents be configured independently of the size of the surrounding population. We further introduce FlockDiT, an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer trained with flow matching on FlockWorld data to jointly generate synchronized egocentric videos for multiple agents. Our results suggest that joint generation benefits agent detection at density-matched settings and that diffusion forcing improves rollout fidelity. Together, FlockWorld and FlockDiT provide a controlled testbed for multi-agent video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出FlockWorld（基于Boids的多智能体人工生命环境，支持群体规模同步自我中心视频）与FlockDiT（动作条件潜扩散Transformer），用于多智能体视频世界模型研究，发现联合生成利于智能体检测、扩散强制（diffusion forcing）提升长rollout保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型大多限于单玩家，已有的多人模型只支持小型、固定数量的智能体，缺乏可研究群体规模（population-scale）多智能体视频生成的可控测试平台。
AI.method: FlockWorld：基于Reynolds Boids算法渲染同步的自我中心裁剪视图，为每个相机智能体分配不同颜色以保持跨视图身份一致，将规则导出的加速度作为动作，并允许相机智能体数量与周围群体规模独立配置。FlockDiT：以flow matching在FlockWorld数据上训练的动作条件潜扩散Transformer，联合生成多智能体同步的自我中心视频。
AI.result: 在密度匹配设置下，联合生成有利于智能体检测；扩散强制（diffusion forcing）改善了rollout保真度。
AI.conclusion: FlockWorld与FlockDiT共同构成一个受控的多智能体视频生成测试平台，为群体规模世界模型研究提供基础。

title: A Contextual Measure of Ambiguity in Prescriptive Text
summary: Ambiguity in prescriptive text such as laws, contracts, rules, policies, or recommendations can be both desirable (e.g., if it enables a law to adapt to changing context, such as new technologies) and undesirable (e.g., if it leads to arbitrary discretion or conflict over the law's interpretation). To help navigate these trade-offs, it would be valuable to have methods for quantifying ambiguity that are predictive of such outcomes, but existing measures capture how text is perceived in isolation rather than how it is interpreted in context. In this paper, we propose quantifying ambiguity as the degree of disagreement among a set of stakeholders ("raters") on how alternative prescriptive texts ("policies") apply in each of a set of relevant scenarios ("cases"). Using two policy domains, we present preliminary analysis suggesting that, even when using simulated raters, this approach (i) correlates with real human disagreement, and (ii) is robust to spurious text features. We then apply the measure to existing deliberation datasets to describe the association between policy ambiguity and support for those policies.

AI.tldr: 提出将规范文本（法律、合同、规则等）的歧义量化为：多个利益相关者在各情境下对替代政策适用性的分歧程度，并在两个政策领域初步验证该指标与真人分歧相关、对虚假文本特征稳健，再用审议数据集分析歧义与政策支持度的关系。
AI.motivation: 规范文本的歧义既可能有益（适应新情境、新技术）也可能有害（任意裁量、解释冲突），需可预测这些结果的可量化歧义度量；但现有度量只刻画文本孤立感知，而非情境中的解释。
AI.method: 以"评分者（利益相关者）× 政策（替代规范文本）× 案例（相关情境）"的矩阵构造歧义度量，取评分者在各案例下对政策适用判断的分歧程度；使用两个政策领域，以模拟评分者进行初步分析。
AI.result: 初步分析表明：即使使用模拟评分者，该度量（i）与真实人类分歧相关，（ii）对虚假文本特征稳健；并将其应用于既有审议数据集，描述政策歧义与政策支持之间的关联。
AI.conclusion: 歧义应作为"情境中解释分歧"来度量而非孤立文本属性；该框架初步具备效度与稳健性，可为权衡规范文本歧义的利弊提供可操作工具，并揭示歧义与公众支持的关联。

title: Same Story, Different Lens: A Multi-Agent System for Cross-Outlet News Framing Analysis
comment: The projects source code is available in the GitHub repository. Link: https://github.com/affanyasin1/multi-perspective-analyzer
summary: News outlets covering the same event differ in what they emphasize and omit. \textit{Same Story, Different Lens} is an experimental research prototype for comparing these choices. It collects world and politics coverage from 17 outlets, groups reports about the same event, and produces structured analyses of sentiment, political lean, framing, loaded language, possible omissions, and model-estimated proportions of factual claims and opinion. Loaded-language entries include quotations and neutral rewordings. Three model roles (agents) handle article analysis, assessment of source support, and cross-outlet briefing generation. Analyses are stored in a JSONL archive. The evaluation compares outlet-level lean estimates with approximate, predefined reference ratings and summarizes the Critic's model-assigned grounding scores. These measures provide preliminary diagnostics. A grounding score reflects the model's assessment of support in the supplied text and does not establish factual accuracy or constitute independent verification.

AI.tldr: 论文提出研究原型「Same Story, Different Lens」，用于对比17家媒体对同一事件的报道差异，包含情感、政治倾向、框架、用词、可能的遗漏等结构化分析，并通过三模型角色（分析、核查、综述）分工完成，评估仅为初步诊断。
AI.motivation: 不同媒体对同一事件的报道在强调与省略上存在差异，需要工具帮助读者系统比较这些编辑选择。
AI.method: 收集17家媒体的世界与政治报道，按同一事件聚类分组；由三个模型角色分别负责文章分析、来源支持度评估与跨媒体简报生成；输出情感、政治倾向、框架、带倾向性用语（含引文与中性改写）、可能遗漏及事实/观点比例估计，结果存入JSONL档案。
AI.result: 将媒体层面的倾向估计与预设的近似参考评级进行对比，并汇总Critic模型给出的依据性评分；这些指标被定位为初步诊断。
AI.conclusion: 该原型可辅助比较媒体的报道选择，但依据性评分只反映模型对所给文本支持的判断，不能证明事实准确性，也不构成独立核实。

title: IsoAct: Geometry-Aware Post-hoc Debiasing via Isometric Actions
summary: Learning representations that are robust to nuisance factors is essential for reliable deployment, but remains challenging when the representations lie on non-Euclidean manifolds. Existing debiasing methods typically assume Euclidean representations or apply linear interventions, which can distort the geometry of structured latent spaces. We propose IsoAct, a post-hoc framework that accounts for geometry in both nuisance identification and representation editing. It identifies nuisance-predictive directions using Fisher discriminant analysis (FDA) in tangent coordinates and applies corrections through manifold-native actions that preserve manifold membership. Controlled and real-world experiments on hyperspherical, hyperbolic, and $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ representations evaluate nuisance reduction, utility preservation, and manifold validity jointly. IsoAct reduces nuisance recoverability while retaining competitive utility. Its clearest joint result is on KLIFS, combining reduced kinase-group recoverability, strong structural prediction, and valid rigid poses.

AI.tldr: IsoAct：面向非欧几里得流形表示的后处理去偏框架，在切空间中用FDA识别 nuisance 方向，并以流形原生作用进行校正，兼顾去偏、效用与流形有效性。
AI.motivation: 表示对 nuisance 因子的鲁棒性对可靠部署至关重要，但当表示位于非欧几里得流形上时很难实现。现有去偏方法通常假设欧氏表示或采用线性干预，会破坏结构化潜空间的几何结构。
AI.method: 提出 IsoAct 后处理框架，在 nuisance 识别和表示编辑两方面都考虑几何：在切坐标下用 Fisher 判别分析(FDA)识别可预测 nuisance 的方向，再通过保持流形成员性的"流形原生作用"(manifold-native actions)施加校正。在超球面、双曲、SE(3) 表示上做受控与真实实验，联合评估 nuisance 降低、效用保持与流形有效性。
AI.result: IsoAct 降低了 nuisance 的可恢复性，同时保持有竞争力的效用。最清晰的联合结果在 KLIFS 上：激酶组可恢复性下降、结构预测强、刚体位姿有效。
AI.conclusion: 在非欧几里得潜空间去偏时显式建模几何是可行的，流形原生校正能在不破坏流形有效性的前提下减少 nuisance 信息，实现去偏与效用的较好权衡。

title: Finetuning Prompt-Based Image Editor for Geometry-Consistent Room Defurnishing
comment: 2 pages, 3 figures. Poster presented at IEEE ISMAR 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Erasing all furniture from a single room image to generate its empty counterpart is valuable for XR applications such as diminished reality and virtual staging. The challenge is twofold: inpainting the furniture regions with realistic content, and doing so without distorting the room's 3D geometry. Prompt-driven image editors, such as FLUX.2, handle realism impressively, but their structural faithfulness is inferior to explicit layout conditioned inpainting. To improve geometric consistency, we propose a training recipe for finetuning a LoRA on 2,500 furnished-empty room pairs. FLUX.2 with our LoRA adaptor significantly improves geometric consistency while retaining the high texture fidelity. This single-photo inpainter can be an effective building block for depth-aware and 3D-consistent XR pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出基于FLUX.2 + LoRA微调的图像修补方法，从单张家具房间图生成空房间，兼顾纹理真实感与3D几何一致性，可用于XR降维现实与虚拟布置。
AI.motivation: XR应用（diminished reality、虚拟布置）需要从单张房间图移除全部家具生成空房间，难点在于：既要修补家具区域的内容真实，又不能破坏房间的3D几何结构。提示词驱动的编辑器（如FLUX.2）真实感强，但结构保真度不及显式布局条件的修补方法。
AI.method: 在2,500对"有家具—空房间"图像对上，为FLUX.2微调LoRA适配器，采用专门设计的训练配方以提升几何一致性，同时保留原有高纹理保真度。
AI.result: 带LoRA适配器的FLUX.2在几何一致性上显著提升，同时保持高纹理保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该单图修补器可作为深度感知、3D一致XR管线的有效构建模块。

title: MANTIS: Multi-Axis News Transformations for Instance-Wise Stress Testing and Worst-Case Training in Fake News Detection
summary: Automated fake news detection is vital on social media, where fake news is easily rewritten to fool detectors. However, existing approaches typically rely on superficial writing cues or single-style text rewrites, resulting in poor robustness under diverse cosmetic modifications. We construct MANTIS-Bench, a multi-axis presentation-attack benchmark that pairs original news with rewritten views across writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing. We further propose MANTIS, an instance-adaptive adversarial framework enabling dynamic worst-case training tailored to each news article with zero inference-time overhead. This reframes fake news defense from heuristic format smoothing into targeted, fact-invariant credibility assessment. Experiments on MANTIS-Bench show that MANTIS reduces the Union Attack Success Rate (UASR) by 3.55 percentage points relative to SheepDog on GossipCop and consistently outperforms prior single-axis defenses on Macro-F1 while maintaining competitive clean accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-axis and instance-adaptive worst-case training.

AI.tldr: 提出多轴改写基准 MANTIS-Bench 与实例自适应对抗训练框架 MANTIS，提升假新闻检测对抗多种表面改写的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有假新闻检测依赖表面写作线索或单一风格改写，面对写作风格、情感表达、传播框架等多维"外观攻击"时鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 构建 MANTIS-Bench 多轴呈现攻击基准（原始新闻配多视角改写）；提出 MANTIS 实例自适应对抗框架，为每篇新闻动态构造最坏情况训练，推理零额外开销，将防御从启发式格式平滑转为事实不变的可信度评估。
AI.result: 在 GossipCop 上较 SheepDog 降低联合攻击成功率 UASR 3.55 个百分点；Macro-F1 持续优于单轴防御方法，且保持有竞争力的干净准确率。
AI.conclusion: 多轴与实例自适应最坏情况训练有效，验证了面向事实不变性的假新闻防御方向。

title: MuSID-KD: Multigranularity Knowledge Distillation for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
summary: Generative recommendation with semantic IDs (SIDs) represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens and autoregressively predicts the next item's SID. Despite strong recommendation performance, repeated decoding over multiple SID positions incurs substantial inference cost. Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a powerful generative teacher to a lightweight student, yet conventional objectives do not fully account for multi-token SID generation. We identify two limitations: item-level distribution alignment may not adequately preserve the teacher's ranking of candidate groups sharing SID prefixes, while uniform alignment across SID positions may affect final item ranking differently. We propose MuSID-KD, which combines Hierarchical Candidate Distribution Alignment (HCDA) and Ranking Impact Guided Levelwise Distillation (RIGD). HCDA aggregates item probabilities according to shared SID prefixes and aligns candidate distributions at successive levels, from candidate groups to individual items. RIGD evaluates the reduction in pairwise ranking surrogate loss when one student score contribution is replaced with the teacher's contribution, and allocates supervision accordingly. Experiments on real-world recommendation datasets using three lightweight student architectures demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy and better alignment of prefix marginal distributions and pairwise item rankings, without modifying the student's online inference architecture. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/m7k2-review-83f9/.

AI.tldr: 提出 MuSID-KD，通过层次候选分布对齐（HCDA）与排序影响引导的逐层蒸馏（RIGD）改进生成式推荐的语义 ID 知识蒸馏，提升轻量学生模型精度且不改变在线推理结构。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐用语义 ID（SID）多token自回归解码，推理开销大；知识蒸馏可压缩，但传统目标未考虑多token SID 生成本质，存在两点不足：项目级分布对齐难以保留教师对共享SID前缀候选组的排序；对所有SID位置统一对齐对最终项目排序影响不同。
AI.method: MuSID-KD 含两模块：HCDA 按共享 SID 前缀聚合项目概率，从候选组到单项在逐层级别对齐候选分布；RIGD 通过将学生某一得分贡献替换为教师贡献时成对排序替代损失的下降量评估各位置重要性，并据此分配监督。
AI.result: 在真实推荐数据集、三种轻量学生架构上实验，推荐精度提升，前缀边缘分布与成对项目排序对齐更好，且不修改学生在线推理架构。
AI.conclusion: 面向多token SID 生成的知识蒸馏需层次化与排序感知的位置加权；MuSID-KD 在不增加在线推理成本下有效提升轻量学生模型效果。

title: Stable Continuous-Time Consistency Distillation: An Empirical Study with a Multistep Extension
summary: Continuous-time consistency models are an attractive route to few-step generation. They remove the discretization error inherent to the timestep grid that discrete-time consistency models depend on. Until recently, however, training them was unstable. Lu & Song (2025) address this with the TrigFlow formulation and a coordinated set of architectural and training-objective changes. We conduct an independent empirical study of this framework on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64. No open-weight TrigFlow teachers exist at these scales, so we train them from scratch and then verify the consistency distillation (sCD) and consistency training (sCT) behavior of students initialized from these teachers. On CIFAR-10, our students reproduce the reported FID at one and two steps. On ImageNet-64, they fall short, a gap that appears related to our teacher and to architectural choices the paper leaves unspecified. We also report a parameter-count gap of about 5% between the model size stated in the paper and a faithful re-implementation, which we attribute to the scale-and-shift conditioning projections in Adaptive Double Normalization. We then propose Multistep sCD (MS-sCD), a continuous-time, segment-conditioned multistep generalization of sCD. The segment-conditioning idea is borrowed from the discrete-time multistep consistency distillation of Heek et al. (2024); we build on their preliminary continuous-time experiments within the TrigFlow/sCM framework. The rest of the algorithm follows sCD. MS-sCD replaces sCM's two-step intermediate time with a fixed segment-boundary schedule and recovers sCD at M = 1. We report FID at M = 2, 4, 8 and compare against the discrete-time MSCD baseline. Code, model weights, and training scripts are available on GitHub (Mathew et al., 2026).

AI.tldr: 本文对 TrigFlow/连续时间一致性模型框架在 CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet-64 上做独立复现研究，发现 CIFAR-10 可复现报告 FID、ImageNet-64 存在差距，并提出多步推广 MS-sCD。
AI.motivation: 连续时间一致性模型可消除离散步长网格误差，但训练此前不稳定；Lu & Song (2025) 用 TrigFlow 使其稳定，然而缺乏开放权重教师模型与独立验证，且部分架构细节未公开。
AI.method: 从零训练 TrigFlow 教师模型，验证 sCD 与 sCT 学生模型；分析参数量差异来源（Adaptive Double Normalization 的 scale-and-shift 条件投影）；受 Heek et al. (2024) 离散多步一致性蒸馏启发，提出 MS-sCD：用固定分段边界调度替代 sCM 的两步中间时间，M=1 时退化为 sCD。
AI.result: CIFAR-10 上一、二步 FID 复现了论文报告值；ImageNet-64 上未达报告水平，差距与教师模型及未说明的架构选择相关；发现约 5% 参数量差异；给出 MS-sCD 在 M=2、4、8 的 FID 并与离散 MSCD 基线对比。
AI.conclusion: TrigFlow 框架在 CIFAR-10 可复现，ImageNet-64 仍受教师质量与架构细节影响；MS-sCD 将多步一致性蒸馏自然推广到连续时间设定，并与离散 MSCD 具备可比性。代码与权重已开源。

title: An Agentic AI Workflow for Liver Lesion Segmentation and Structured Radiology Reporting
summary: Despite advances in automated liver lesion segmentation, a gap remains between image-derived predictions and clinically interpretable radiology reports. Bridging this gap requires quantitative measurements that are both reproducible and traceable. We present an evidence-grounded agentic AI framework that connects liver and lesion segmentation with deterministic quantification and structured reporting. TotalSegmentator-based nnU-Net models delineate the liver, Couinaud segments, and lesions, while computational tools extract volumes, dimensions, counts, and anatomical locations. A large language model (LLM) organizes these measurements into a predefined reporting schema, with numerical consistency checks against source measurements. On 51 LiTS cases, the segmentation stage achieved a liver Dice score of 0.947, lesion sensitivity of 75.6%, and positive predictive value of 68.9%. Exploratory screening of 25,494 MERLIN reports identified 10,208 (40.0%) with liver-related abnormalities. By connecting quantitative imaging evidence with agentic report generation, this work takes a step toward human-centered medical AI that prioritizes traceability and clinical relevance.

AI.tldr: 提出证据落地的智能体AI框架，将肝脏/病灶分割、确定性量化与结构化报告串联，提升影像预测的可解释性与可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 自动肝脏病灶分割虽有进展，但图像预测与临床可解读的放射学报告之间仍有鸿沟，需要可重复且可追溯的定量测量来弥合。
AI.method: 基于TotalSegmentator的nnU-Net模型分割肝脏、Couinaud段及病灶；计算工具提取体积、尺寸、计数与解剖位置；LLM按预定义报告模板组织测量结果，并对源测量做数值一致性校验。
AI.result: 在51例LiTS数据上，肝脏Dice为0.947，病灶敏感性75.6%，阳性预测值68.9%；对25,494份MERLIN报告的探索性筛选中，识别出10,208份（40.0%）含肝脏相关异常。
AI.conclusion: 将定量影像证据与智能体报告生成相连接，朝以人为中心、强调可追溯性与临床相关性的医学AI迈出一步。

title: Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation
summary: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as {meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence}, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Culture-MMT 诊断性基准，用于评估社交媒体翻译中"分布式证据的语用重构"，并配合 Judger 评分器与受控证据变化评测。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体跨语言内容的意义分散在文本、图像与文化知识中，而现有评测常把图像视为可选、默认文本充分，无法区分错误源自视觉证据缺失还是文化适配不足。
AI.method: 构建含 498 条去标识化 UGC（20 个领域）的基准，按所需证据分为 Symbol、Visual、Hybrid 三类；开发与人类对齐的领域专用评判器 Judger，以及系统改变翻译者可获证据的受控评测框架。
AI.result: 17 个模型配置显示：真实图像使 Visual 提升 +0.280、Hybrid +0.197，而 Symbol 仅 +0.050；随机图像无类似收益；人工描述实验表明，即使视觉事实明确，联合依赖型样本仍更具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 将文化有效的社交媒体翻译刻画为"分布式证据下的意义重构"，指出视觉落地与文化语用适配是两个相互独立的模型瓶颈。

title: Trainable Boundary-Keeping Where No Formal Answer Exists: A Controlled Knock-In Study of Reward Training in Evidence-Sufficiency Judgment
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Aggregate data/figure code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23661668 (code MIT; data/text/figures CC BY 4.0). Writing/implementation assisted by AI agents; the author designed the study and is responsible for the final text
summary: Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. We test this in evidence-sufficiency judgment: deciding whether available information actually supports a causal claim, a domain with no decidable correctness reward. Using a pre-registered, same-base, controlled knock-in design, we compare a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) with its own baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning model under an action-pressure protocol with no evaluation invitation. All load-bearing outcomes are rated by two separate model-rating sessions masked to arm labels; automatic judges only trigger. The trained arm raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson 95% CI lower bound 91.2%, non-overlapping with the baseline interval [14.2%, 40.2%]), while the scrambled placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited correct; 91.1% false refusal). The effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal: automatic false refusal on 281 well-formed claims is 1.1% (Wilson upper bound 3.09%), and a targeted 18-item arm-(c) recheck (3 flagged plus 15 accepted) yields 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals in two sessions. The dissociation is the main result: final boundary-keeping is trainable without an inference-time verifier, while observed active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero; SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. A pre-registered mechanism adjudication favors reward internalization of final-action status (H2, best-supported, not proven). The scope is a controlled 14B same-family study: we do not claim proof, cross-family generality, or independent human-expert validation; the rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers.

AI.tldr: 在无正确答案奖励的"证据充分性判断"任务中，通过受控 knock-in 设计证明：边界保持行为可通过 SFT+GRPO 训练获得（正确拒绝从25%升至100%），且不依赖推理时验证器，但主动数值核查几乎为零，属"结果可训练、过程未内化"的分离。
AI.motivation: 文献普遍假设推理微调/奖励训练模型因"推理更长"或"有正确性信号"而验证更可靠，但该假设在缺乏可判定正确性奖励的领域未受检验。作者欲检验：在证据是否足以支撑因果主张这一无决定性能量的任务上，训练能否提升可靠的自我验证/拒绝行为。
AI.method: 预注册、同基座、受控 knock-in 设计，比较四组：边界保持配方（SFT 后 GRPO）、其自身基线、打乱配对的安慰剂组、通用推理模型。采用动作压力协议且不给评估邀请（不诱导拒绝）。结果由两个独立的模型评分会话盲评（对分组标签遮蔽），自动评判仅作触发。辅以 H3 检测主动数值/计算核查，及18项靶向复检（3标记+15接受）。
AI.result: 训练组自发正确拒绝由25%升至100%（每组40，Wilson 95%CI下界91.2%，与基线区间[14.2%,40.2%]不重叠）；打乱安慰剂崩溃（自发正确5%、受邀正确7.5%，错误拒绝91.1%）。效应具边界特异性：281条良构主张上自动错误拒绝1.1%（Wilson上界3.09%）；18项复检两会话误拒为0/18与1/18。分离为主要发现：最终边界保持无需推理时验证器即可训练，但H3检测中主动数值/计算核查仍接近零；SFT饱和使 GRPO 增量无法单独识别。机理裁定支持"最终动作状态奖励内化"（H2，最佳支持但未证明）。
AI.conclusion: 边界保持的最终行为可被训练内化，且不依赖推理时验证器或长推理；但主动核查过程未被习得（过程-结果分离）。局限：仅14B同族受控研究，不主张证明性、跨族泛化或独立人类专家验证（评分为模型会话而非人工）。

title: Sparse Reconstruction by Direct Measurement-to-Field Generation in Function Space
summary: Understanding physical systems often requires recovering their full spatial state from measurements available only at sparse locations. This reconstruction becomes challenging when physical boundaries are unknown, high-resolution training fields are unavailable, or important quantities cannot be measured directly. Sparse observations may also be consistent with multiple plausible states, leading to significant reconstruction uncertainty. Here we introduce Direct Measurement-to-Field Generation (\DMF{}), a functional rectified flow framework that learns how sparse measurements drive physical-field generation end to end. Instead of relying on grid-based rasterization or runtime guidance, \DMF{} jointly learns a sensor--global--sensor representation with the generative transport, dynamically fusing local grounding with global context to evaluate physical fields at arbitrary query coordinates. Across benchmarks involving unobserved boundaries, missing high-resolution training fields, and unmeasured physical quantities, \DMF{} outperforms alternative baselines by significantly reducing reconstruction errors and preserving the fidelity of physical properties. Furthermore, its stochastic ensemble generation reliably quantifies uncertainty while improving continuous ranked probability scores. These results extend sparse reconstruction from fixed-setting point estimation toward measurement-conditioned generation of physical fields under incomplete and changing information.
