Extensive ablation studies further confirm UTA's robustness across dimensions, including peak LR, final decay ratio, its parameter $\varphi_0$, component efficacy and generalization to fine-tuning scenarios, underscoring its practical implementability.

AI.tldr: 提出 Universal Training Adaptive (UTA) 学习率衰减方法，将 LRD 视为闭环的形状-尺度问题，实现训练状态自适应，在语言与视觉模型上带来一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有学习率衰减（LRD）设计多依赖经验；理论化的 UBA LRD 依赖 SGD 动力学、难以推广到 Adam 类优化器，且其"优化难度参数"含义不透明。
AI.method: 提出 UTA LRD，采用连续时间建模，将 LRD 视为闭环的形状-尺度问题，按分段最优形状自适应训练状态，将外部迭代与内部训练状态关联，从而在进程形状与 LR 尺度上逼近近最优路径。可即插即用、开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA 60M–1B 语言模型及 ResNet50、ViT-B（ImageNet）上取得一致提升；消融实验验证其对峰值 LR、最终衰减比、参数 φ0、各组件有效性及微调场景泛化的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: UTA 克服 UBA 对 SGD 与不透明参数的依赖，具备理论自适应性、实证有效性和良好实用可实施性。

title: DimFlow: Bidirectional Grid-Expert Learning for Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Dynamic Gaussian reconstruction requires compact scene features to support coordinated changes in geometry and appearance. A factorized grid provides efficient local queries, but accurate interpolation alone does not ensure that the resulting dynamic attributes remain compatible across space and time. We introduce DimFlow, a framework that learns these features through bidirectional interaction between a multi-resolution grid and a coordinate-based expert branch. Feature-level adversarial alignment connects their distributions, adaptive fusion transfers complementary information, and activation-masked residual feedback refines the grid during training. Four attribute experts organize deformation, rotation, opacity, and temporal information before Gaussian rendering. In the aggregate comparison across D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, and DAVIS, DimFlow achieves 39.73 dB PSNR, improving on 4D-GS by 1.92 dB while matching its reported 85 FPS rendering speed. The model occupies 18.9 MB, compared with 18.3 MB for 4D-GS. Component and attribute-expert ablations reveal complementary contributions from feature alignment, adaptive exchange, and temporal processing.

AI.tldr: DimFlow通过多分辨率网格与坐标基专家分支的双向交互学习动态高斯特征，并以对抗对齐、自适应融合与掩码残差反馈提升空间-时间属性一致性；在D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DAVIS上达39.73 dB PSNR，较4D-GS提升1.92 dB，保持85 FPS、模型18.9 MB。
AI.motivation: 动态高斯重建需要紧凑的场景特征来协同控制几何与外观变化。因子化网格局部查询高效，但仅靠精确插值无法保证生成的动态属性在空间与时间上保持兼容/一致。
AI.method: 提出DimFlow框架：多分辨率网格与坐标基专家分支进行双向交互；(1) 特征级对抗对齐连接两者分布；(2) 自适应融合传递互补信息；(3) 激活掩码残差反馈在训练中精炼网格。四个属性专家分别组织形变、旋转、不透明度与时间信息，随后进行高斯渲染。
AI.result: 在D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DAVIS综合比较中取得39.73 dB PSNR，比4D-GS高1.92 dB，同时保持其报告的85 FPS渲染速度；模型大小18.9 MB（4D-GS为18.3 MB）。组件与属性专家消融显示特征对齐、自适应交换与时间处理各有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 网格插值的精度不足以保障动态属性一致性，需借助分布对齐与双向信息交换；DimFlow以极小存储代价实现精度提升并保持实时渲染速度，各模块贡献互补。

title: STeP-TS: Shared Temporal Filters with Pruning for Time Series
comment: Accepted at the Workshop TS-LIMITS at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing temporal dependencies across multiple scales while accounting for both shared and variable-specific dynamics. Compact forecasting models have emerged as an attractive alternative to increasingly large architectures, but preserving strong predictive performance within tight computational and memory budgets remains challenging. We propose a compact one-layer convolutional framework that learns a shared bank of multi-scale temporal filters of each variable. Lightweight variable-specific scalar weights determine the contribution of each temporal component, enabling the model to capture shared temporal structure while adapting to variable-specific dynamics. The learned weights and filter-output energy further provide a natural signal for structured pruning of convolutional filters, reducing computational complexity with minimal degradation in forecasting performance. We additionally introduce an amplitude-adaptive normalization mechanism that preserves variable-dependent temporal amplitudes. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate forecasting performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods while requiring substantially fewer parameters and inference FLOPs and achieving low per-sample latency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种紧凑的单层卷积多变量时间序列预测框架，学习各变量共享的多尺度时间滤波器库，并用变量特定标量权重组合，配合结构化剪枝和幅值自适应归一化，在极少参数与计算量下达到有竞争力性能。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测需同时捕获多尺度时间依赖及共享/变量特有动态，而紧凑模型在严格计算与内存预算下保持预测性能仍具挑战。
AI.method: 单层卷积框架，学习共享多尺度时间滤波器库；用轻量变量特定标量权重决定各时间分量贡献；利用学习权重与滤波器输出能量作为结构化剪枝信号；引入幅值自适应归一化保留变量相关时间幅值。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上性能与SOTA方法相当，同时参数量与推理FLOPs大幅减少，单样本延迟低。
AI.conclusion: 共享滤波器加变量特定标量与结构化剪枝可有效兼顾多尺度建模、变量适应性及紧凑性，幅值自适应归一化进一步提升预测。

title: GUIFlow: Temporal Redundancy-Aware Incremental Inference for GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents built on vision-language models interact with continuously evolving interfaces, yet conventional inference repeatedly recomputes representations of largely overlapping observations and histories. This mismatch makes multi-step interaction costly, while changes in context, interface content, and action arguments prevent straightforward cache reuse. We introduce GUIFlow, a framework for full-pipeline incremental inference in multi-image GUI interaction. Our central insight is that advancing a decision need not require rebuilding all supporting representations: each interaction step can instead selectively update computational states maintained across the trajectory. To support new decisions as the context evolves, GUIFlow adapts how past computation is reused: historical KV states are position-aligned and injected into the current context; change signals guide selective updates of current-observation states in the vision encoder and language model; and earlier action responses serve as speculative drafts verified by the target model. Together, these mechanisms enable cross-step reuse throughout visual encoding, prefill, and decoding without additional training, a separate draft model, or changes to the model-visible inputs and action interface. Experiments demonstrate up to 3.39x geometric-mean speedup across offline multi-image benchmarks and up to 3.49x in online, closed-loop interaction on OSWorld, while maintaining task performance broadly comparable to the dense baseline.

AI.tldr: GUIFlow 提出一种面向多图像 GUI 交互的全流程增量推理框架，通过跨步骤复用视觉编码、预填充和解码阶段的计算状态，实现最高约 3.4 倍加速，同时保持任务性能与稠密基线相当，且无需额外训练或外部草稿模型。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉语言模型的 GUI 智能体需与不断变化的界面交互，但常规推理会对高度重叠的观测与历史反复重算表示，导致多步交互成本高昂；而上下文、界面内容与动作参数的变化又阻碍了简单的缓存复用。
AI.method: 核心思想是推进决策无需重建全部支撑表示。GUIFlow 对历史 KV 状态进行位置对齐并注入当前上下文；利用变化信号引导对当前观测状态在视觉编码器与语言模型中的选择性更新；并将早期动作响应作为由目标模型验证的推测草稿。这些机制在视觉编码、预填充与解码全流程中实现跨步复用，无需额外训练、独立草稿模型或改动模型可见输入与动作接口。
AI.result: 离线多图像基准上几何平均加速最高 3.39 倍；OSWorld 在线闭环交互中最高 3.49 倍；任务性能与稠密基线总体可比。
AI.conclusion: GUIFlow 通过全流程增量推理有效降低 GUI 智能体多步交互的计算开销，在保持性能的同时显著提速，且具备免训练、易部署的实用优势。

title: A Unified Arena for LLM Agents across Diverse Eurogame
summary: Interactive environments offer a practical way to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents, and competitive games extend this evaluation to decisions shaped by competing goals and other agents' choices. Yet existing evaluations confined to individual games or execution frameworks leave unclear which competitive advantages persist across settings. We introduce DECE (Diverse Eurogame Competitive Environments), a unified arena spanning ten Eurogames with shared interfaces and evaluation protocols. These games combine lasting strategic commitments, competition over shared resources, and multiple routes to victory. Our primary study evaluates 12 model-harness configurations, spanning nine models and four execution harnesses, in 480 three-player matches across ten games. The main and supplementary studies comprise 1,032 completed matches in total. These comparisons reveal broad cross-game ranking agreement alongside game-specific strengths. Matched studies show that the same model can perform differently across execution harnesses, adding another source of variation to these profiles. These performance advantages do not consistently translate into better token or cost efficiency, making resource use an additional consideration when comparing configurations. Together, the findings support evaluating complete agent configurations by both their competitive performance across games and the resources needed to achieve it.

AI.tldr: 提出DECE统一竞技场，用十款欧式桌游评测12种模型-执行框架组合，发现跨游戏排名大体一致但存在游戏特定优势，执行框架与资源效率同样影响表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评测局限于单一游戏或执行框架，难以判断哪些竞争优势能跨环境保持，也忽略了执行框架和资源消耗带来的差异。
AI.method: 构建DECE统一竞技场，覆盖十款具备长期战略承诺、共享资源竞争和多条胜利路径的欧式桌游，提供共享接口与评测协议；主研究评估9个模型、4种执行框架共12种配置，进行480场三人对局，含补充研究共完成1032场对局。
AI.result: 跨游戏排名总体一致，同时呈现游戏特定的强弱项；同一模型在不同执行框架下表现不同；竞争性能优势并未稳定转化为更好的token或成本效率。
AI.conclusion: 应以跨游戏竞争表现与所需资源两方面共同评估完整的智能体配置，而非仅看单一游戏成绩。

title: TUON: A Tensor-Aware Optimizer Utilizing Tensor-SVD and Polarization for Large Language Model Pretraining
summary: Large scale language model~(LLM) pretraining is increasingly bottlenecked by optimizer efficiency, driving optimizer design from vector-aware methods such as AdamW to matrix-aware methods. Matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon exploit matrix structure but treat layers independently, neglecting cross-layer correlations. Tensor-aware optimizers are therefore needed, yet existing ones rely on a matricization-based tensor algebra and remain restricted to shallow stacking and specific modules. In this paper, we propose \textbf{TUON}, a novel optimizer built on a transform-based tensor algebra derived from the Tensor-SVD (T-SVD). Unlike methods that polarize a globally unfolded matrix, TUON mixes layers via a unitary transform $\boldsymbol{Q}$ and then polarizes each transformed slice, and inverts the transform to recover the update. This mix-then-separate strategy captures cross-layer correlations while preserving per-layer diversity, avoiding the structural dimension imbalance and cross-layer misalignment of unfolding. Thus it successfully scales to more layers and diverse modules beyond QKV. Theoretically, we prove that TUON performs steepest descent under a $\boldsymbol{Q}$-transformed tensor spectral norm, and identify its update as the tensor polar factor of the T-SVD. We further establish transform non-redundancy, norm and smoothness comparisons with Muon and TEON, and a convergence guarantee. Empirically, TUON improves consistently over Muon and TEON on GPT-124M/350M and Qwen-0.6B/4B, with ablations confirming the transformation mechanism, cross-layer structure beyond two-layer stacking, adaptability beyond QKV, and robustness to the polarization method.

AI.tldr: TUON 是基于 T-SVD 变换张量代数的张量化优化器，通过"先混合再分离"的酉变换策略捕捉跨层相关性，在 GPT 与 Qwen 系列模型上稳定超越 Muon 和 TEON。
AI.motivation: LLM 预训练受优化器效率瓶颈制约，优化器设计从向量级（如 AdamW）转向矩阵级（如 Muon）。Muon 类方法虽利用矩阵结构，但逐层独立处理，忽略跨层相关性；现有张量化优化器依赖矩阵化展开的张量代数，仅适用于浅堆叠和 QKV 等特定模块，存在结构维度失衡与跨层错位问题。
AI.method: 提出 TUON，基于由 Tensor-SVD (T-SVD) 导出的变换张量代数。先通过酉变换 Q 混合各层，再对每个变换切片做极化（polarize），最后逆变换恢复更新。该"先混合再分离"策略在捕捉跨层相关性的同时保持逐层多样性，避免展开带来的维度失衡与错位。
AI.result: 理论上证明了 TUON 在 Q-变换张量谱范数下的最速下降性质，其更新即为 T-SVD 的张量极因子；并建立了变换非冗余性、与 Muon/TEON 的范数与光滑性比较及收敛保证。实证上，TUON 在 GPT-124M/350M 和 Qwen-0.6B/4B 上一致优于 Muon 与 TEON，消融实验验证了变换机制、超两层堆叠的跨层结构、QKV 之外的模块适应性以及对极化方法的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TUON 通过变换张量代数实现可扩展的张量化优化，兼顾跨层相关性与逐层多样性，理论性质完备且在各规模模型上经验一致有效，为 LLM 优化器设计提供了新方向。

title: Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup for Robust Camera-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-based bird's-eye view (BEV) perception methods such as Fast-BEV have demonstrated promising results with fast inference speed and competitive accuracy. However, their robustness to real-world corruptions remains insufficiently explored, posing risks for autonomous driving deployment where environmental variations are inevitable. In this paper, we propose Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup (SR-BEVS), a sparse recovery learning approach that simultaneously improves clean accuracy and corruption robustness without requiring additional data or architectural modifications. Our method identifies pruning candidates based on layer-wise weight magnitudes, applies random pruning to create diverse sparse models, and retrains each model with a randomly sampled learning rate. By averaging these diverse recovered models into a single dense model, we achieve enhanced robustness against various corruptions while introducing zero inference overhead. We further provide a mode connectivity analysis demonstrating that our pruning-based diversification preserves the connected low-loss basin necessary for stable weight averaging. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate up to 33.8% improvement in corruption robustness and a 1.8% gain in clean accuracy over the Fast-BEV baseline, with consistent improvements across sensor noise, weather distortions, and illumination changes. Our simple yet effective approach may be applicable to other BEV models.

AI.tldr: 提出 SR-BEVS（稀疏恢复 BEV 模型汤），通过对 Fast-BEV 进行基于层权重幅值的随机剪枝、随机学习率重训并权重平均，在不增加数据与推理开销的前提下同时提升干净精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Fast-BEV 等相机 BEV 方法推理快、精度尚可，但对真实世界常见损坏（噪声、天气、光照）的鲁棒性研究不足，这对自动驾驶部署构成风险；且希望不引入额外数据或改结构。
AI.method: 1) 按逐层权重幅值确定剪枝候选位置；2) 随机剪枝生成多样的稀疏子模型；3) 每个子模型用随机采样的学习率重训恢复；4) 将多样模型权重平均回单一稠密模型，推理零开销；并用模式连通性分析说明剪枝带来的多样性保持了权重平均所需的连通低损失盆。
AI.result: nuScenes 上相对 Fast-BEV 基线，损坏鲁棒性最高提升 33.8%，干净精度提升 1.8%，在传感器噪声、天气畸变、光照变化上均有一致提升，且推理无额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 该方法简单有效，兼顾精度与鲁棒性，可能推广到其他 BEV 模型。

title: Locked In: Multi-Objective RL for the AI Data Center Build-Out
comment: Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: AI data center build-out is a multi-trillion-dollar, multi-decade infrastructure program. Yet siting, power procurement, and cooling decisions are still made with static, single-point scoring tools. These tools are evaluated once, on day-zero numbers. This is a poor fit. A site's water, power, and carbon profile drifts substantially over the 10 to 20 year asset life. The governing decisions are also irreversible, and they bind capital and physical plant for years. We formalize long-horizon build-out as a tiered multi-objective Markov decision process. Strategic commitments are gated to discrete windows, incur switching costs, and energize only after source-dependent lead times. Operational dispatch is restricted to capacity that physically exists. We solve the problem with a preference-conditioned multi-objective agent that has a semi-Markov manager and worker hierarchy. The agent recovers a family of policies that a planner can steer across cost, carbon, water, and reliability at inference time. We validate long-horizon dynamics with a lightweight counterfactual rollout model. Across three commitment regimes (irreversible, reversible, and commit-once) on real site data, preference conditioning yields a confirmed, steerable trade-off on both objective pairs in every regime. Imposing lock-in produces a more evenly covered frontier and a far more consistent rate of anticipatory retrofit ahead of a binding water-stress constraint than a freely reversible formulation. Finally, a compact counterfactual dynamics model tracks slow-moving state well. It is measurably outperformed by simple persistence on the water-stress axis. We report this limitation rather than obscure it. We release the environment, agents, baselines, and evaluation harness. All of them are grounded in real interconnection-queue, water-stress, and grid-emissions data.

AI.tldr: 该文将AI数据中心长周期选址与建设建模为分层多目标马尔可夫决策过程，用偏好条件化的半马尔可夫分层智能体求解，在多承诺机制下得到可调控的成本-碳-水-可靠性权衡前沿，并公开环境与基线。
AI.motivation: 现有AI数据中心选址、电力采购与冷却决策仍依赖静态、单点、仅在零日评估的评分工具，而水、电、碳状况在10–20年资产寿命中显著漂移，且决策不可逆、长期锁定资本与实体设施，因此需要长时程、多目标、考虑不可逆性的决策框架。
AI.method: 将长周期建设形式化为分层多目标MDP：战略承诺仅在离散窗口开放、产生切换成本、并按来源相关建设期延迟后才生效，运营调度仅限已建成容量；提出偏好条件化的多目标智能体，含半马尔可夫manager-worker层级结构，推理时可由规划者在成本、碳、水、可靠性间转向；并用轻量反事实推演模型验证长期动态。
AI.result: 在真实站点数据、三种承诺机制（不可逆、可逆、一次性承诺）下，偏好条件化均在两个目标对上给出可确认、可操控的权衡；锁定机制带来覆盖更均匀的前沿，并在水压力硬约束前呈现更一致的提前改造率；紧凑反事实动力学模型能较好跟踪慢变状态，但在水压力维度上明显不如简单持续性基线。
AI.conclusion: 长时程、不可逆的数据中心建设决策应作为多目标序贯决策问题处理而非静态打分；分层偏好条件化方法可产出可调控权衡前沿，且锁定机制有助于前瞻性改造；作者如实报告反事实模型在水压力轴上的局限，并开源环境、智能体、基线与评测框架。

title: Reason or Recite: Complementary Specialists with an LLM Judge for Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the AI City Challenge Workshop, ECCV 2026. 1st place in Track 3 (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning)
summary: Road anomalies such as collisions, violations, and sudden hazards demand more from video understanding than detection: a practical system must verify what happened, describe the scene, and explain the cause. We find these competences pull in opposite directions for vision-language models: closed-form questions reward precise, evidence-grounded reasoning, while open-ended answers are scored by similarity to reference text, where matching the annotation style matters as much as reasoning correctly. We present Reason-or-Recite (RoR), a two-specialist framework for the Traffic Anomaly Reasoning track of the 2026 AI City Challenge. RoR (1) rewrites the official chain-of-thought annotations into a structured, temporally grounded schema and LoRA-tunes a 9B vision-language model on the enhanced traces; (2) fine-tunes a 4-bit-quantized 27B model on answers alone, absorbing the annotation style; and (3) selects between the two candidates per question with a training-free LLM judge. RoR ranks first on the in-domain leaderboard with mean score 0.6788.

AI.tldr: RoR提出双专家框架应对交通异常推理任务：一个9B模型在结构化改写后的CoT上LoRA微调做精确推理，一个4-bit量化27B模型仅学习答案风格，再用免训练LLM裁判按题择优，取得域内榜首（0.6788）。
AI.motivation: 道路异常场景理解不仅需检测，还需验证事件、描述场景与解释原因。论文发现两类能力对VLM存在张力：封闭式问题奖励精确、有证据支撑的推理；开放式答案按与参考文本的相似度打分，标注风格匹配度与推理正确性同等重要，单模型难以兼顾。
AI.method: 两专家框架：(1) 将官方CoT标注改写为结构化、时间定位的schema，并在其增强轨迹上对9B VLM做LoRA微调；(2) 对4-bit量化的27B模型仅用答案微调，吸收标注风格；(3) 每题用免训练LLM裁判在两个候选间择优。
AI.result: 在2026 AI City Challenge交通异常推理赛道域内排行榜排名第一，平均分0.6788。
AI.conclusion: 将“推理专家”与“风格专家”解耦并按题路由，可缓解封闭式与开放式评测目标冲突；该方案以较小成本取得榜首，但方法与数值仅在域内验证，跨域泛化性尚待考察。

title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.

AI.tldr: 提出NPC-RubricBench——以鼻咽癌为场景、按治疗阶段划分的纵向临床推理基准（405名患者、941个患者-阶段单元、6个阶段、17,688条原子化标准），评测30个LLM后发现诊断强不代表下游照护强，且各阶段主要失败模式反转。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM医学评测多聚焦孤立的单次临床接触，未追踪临床责任在纵向照护路径中如何演变，无法反映多阶段诊疗中的真实可靠性。
AI.method: 构建阶段感知基准NPC-RubricBench，基于两家癌症中心405名鼻咽癌患者的纵向病历，划分为6个连续照护阶段、941个患者-阶段单元，制定覆盖5个维度的17,688条患者特异原子化评价标准，且每个评估严格限定于决策时点可得的临床证据；对30个通用与医学专用LLM进行评测，并考察查询粒度的影响。
AI.result: 强诊断表现未能延续到下游照护；主导失败模式随阶段反转——解剖分期以显式决策错误为主（48.2%），而初始检查与治疗后随访以决策遗漏为主（33.4%与30.4%）；医学适配模型的遗漏率高于通用模型；查询粒度过粗会降低所有30个模型的决策质量，而清单式细化提示提升决策质量却降低证据忠实度与安全性依从。
AI.conclusion: 静态诊断基准不足以保障临床长期可靠性，多阶段医疗AI需引入阶段自适应安全保障机制。

title: Accelerating SO(2)-Equivariant Materials Models through Low-Precision Emulation
summary: Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs). However, their scalability is limited by the use of non-trivial, high-precision tensor operations during both training and inference. Adopting the reduced-precision formats of matrix multiplication units (MMUs), e.g., FP8 instead of FP32, provides massive increases in throughput, up to 30x (60x) on NVIDIA Hopper (Blackwell) GPUs, but may lead to drastic loss of accuracy. Here, we introduce tailored 'emulated' low-precision operations under the integer Ozaki scheme to accelerate the 'SO(2)-equivariant' processing layers of GNNs, which dominate the runtime of (1) many state-of-the-art ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and (2) most universal ML Hamiltonian (MLH) models. Our framework, FlashSO(2), outperforms TF32, the most accurate native low-precision MMU format, in throughput, accuracy, and memory footprint at once. At the SO(2) layer level, it reaches 40x (7x) the throughput of MALOQ's (UMA's) reference implementation, an MLH (MLIP) model, sustaining up to 236 (232) effective Tflop/s on an NVIDIA GH200, 3.5x the FP32 peak. At the model level, FlashSO(2) helps train MALOQ 3.9x faster than its pure-FP32 version while reducing peak memory by 58% at no loss in accuracy. In molecular dynamics simulations with UMA, the speedup factor is 3.3x, and the peak memory is reduced by 51%. FlashSO(2) thus pushes the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of equivariant materials models beyond the native low-precision formats and substantially lowers the resources required to exploit their scaling laws.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlashSO(2)，基于整数 Ozaki 方案的低精度仿真运算，加速 GNN 中等变模型的 SO(2) 层，同时超越 TF32 的吞吐、精度与显存表现。
AI.motivation: 旋转等变 GNN 材料模型因高精度张量运算（FP32）而扩展性受限；FP8 等原生低精度矩阵乘单元虽吞吐极高（Hopper 30x、Blackwell 60x），但精度损失严重。
AI.method: 针对主导 MLIP 与 MLH 运行时长的 SO(2)-等变处理层，采用整数 Ozaki 方案设计的定制化"仿真"低精度运算来替代高精度张量操作。
AI.result: SO(2) 层级：吞吐达 MALOQ 参考实现 40x、UMA 的 7x，GH200 上最高 236/232 有效 Tflop/s，为 FP32 峰值的 3.5x。模型级：MALOQ 训练快 3.9x、峰值显存降 58% 且精度无损；UMA 分子动力学模拟加速 3.3x、显存降 51%。总体同时优于 TF32 的吞吐、精度与内存。
AI.conclusion: FlashSO(2) 将等变材料模型的"速度-精度"帕累托前沿推进至原生低精度格式之外，显著降低利用其缩放律所需资源。

title: More Memory, Better Videos? A Controlled Study of Visual Memory in Long-Video Generation
summary: Long-video generators increasingly retrieve past visual observations to prevent identity drift. The intuition is compelling: more access to history should make future video more consistent. But an image can be faithful to the past and wrong for the present. Does visual memory always improve the generated story? We investigate this question through VMem-Bench, a two-track diagnostic study. Track-A measures which references are selected from 92 real films (16,548 segments), before generation and without generator confounds. Track-B compares four retrieval policies with no-memory and gold-informed last-seen controls on 30 causally generated stories (2,824 segments) using a shared generator. Retrieval increases entity recall from 0.559 to 0.628-0.693 and improves similarity to past appearances, but decreases precision from 0.977 to 0.915-0.938 and forbidden-entity avoidance from 0.968 to 0.845-0.898. It can also reinforce obsolete appearances after the story changes them. Conversely, high long-gap recall can arise without memory when the prompt itself supplies the appearance; an appearance-stripping analysis exposes this confound. These results distinguish historical fidelity from current-story correctness and show why retrieval relevance or final-video consistency alone does not establish memory utility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VMem-Bench双轨诊断框架，系统检验"视觉记忆是否总能提升长视频生成质量"，发现检索式记忆提升实体召回与历史相似度，但损害精确度与禁止实体规避，并可能固化已过时的外观。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成器普遍引入"检索过去视觉观测"以缓解身份漂移，直觉上历史访问越多越好。但作者质疑：一张图可以忠实于过去却违背当下剧情。因此需要定量考察"视觉记忆是否总是改善生成的故事"。
AI.method: 构建VMem-Bench双轨研究。Track-A在92部真实影片（16,548段）上、生成前、无生成器混淆地测量参考图像的选择行为。Track-B在30个因果生成的故事（2,824段）上，用共享生成器比较4种检索策略与"无记忆""金标准告知的最后所见"两类对照；并做"外观剥离"分析以排除提示自身提供外观的混淆。
AI.result: 检索使实体召回由0.559升至0.628–0.693，并提升与历史外观的相似度；但精确度由0.977降至0.915–0.938，禁止实体规避由0.968降至0.845–0.898。检索还会在剧情改变外观后强化过时形象；同时，长间隔高召回可在无记忆时仅靠提示提供外观而出现。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了"历史忠实度"与"当前故事正确性"，说明仅凭检索相关性或最终视频一致性不足以证明记忆有用；记忆效用需在忠实过去与符合当下故事之间权衡评估。

title: Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies
summary: Evolution strategies (ES) update a model by sampling a population of perturbed copies, scoring each one, and moving in the reward-weighted direction of the perturbations. This update is usually presented as an estimate of a smoothed gradient. We present a geometrical interpretation of this update instead. Treat each perturbed model as a particle and its reward as the particle's mass. Before scoring, every particle has the same mass and the population balances at its centroid. Once rewards are assigned, it balances at its reward-weighted center of mass instead. We show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a scalar factor that depends on the mean reward, for any finite population. The physical reading needs nonnegative rewards, which can always be arranged by adding a constant to every reward without changing the update. In the limit of a large population or under antithetic sampling, the centroid sits on the model itself, so ES has an even simpler geometric interpretation: from its current location, the model moves towards the reward-weighted center of mass of its own population. The same picture explains what subtracting the mean reward does: it changes the point from which the displacement is measured, from the model to the sampled centroid. Our contribution is an intuitive, geometric way to visualize an ES update, exact for any finite population.

AI.tldr: 本文将进化策略(ES)更新解释为粒子群体的质心位移：把扰动模型视为粒子、奖励视为质量，均值减除后的ES更新恰好等于从采样质心到奖励加权质心的位移乘以一个仅依赖平均奖励的标量因子，对任意有限种群精确成立。
AI.motivation: ES更新通常被表述为平滑梯度的估计，缺乏直观的几何图像。作者希望提供一种直观、可可视化的几何解释，并澄清"减去平均奖励"这一操作到底在做什么。
AI.method: 几何/物理类比：将每个扰动模型视为粒子，奖励视为其质量。评分前粒子质量相同、群体平衡于质心；评分后平衡于奖励加权质心。作者证明均值减除后的ES更新严格等于该位移乘以一个依赖平均奖励的标量因子（任意有限种群均精确）。非负奖励可通过给所有奖励加常数实现且不改变更新；大种群或对偶采样(antithetic sampling)极限下质心落在模型本身，更新即模型朝自身种群的奖励加权质心移动；减去均值奖励等价于把位移的测量起点从模型改为采样质心。
AI.result: 给出了对任意有限种群精确成立的ES更新的几何解释：更新=采样质心到奖励加权质心的向量×标量因子；并给出大种群/对偶采样下的简化形式，以及减去均值奖励的几何含义（改变位移测量起点）。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献是一种直观、几何化、可可视化且在有限种群下精确的ES更新解释，并非新算法，而是提供理解与教学层面的洞见。

title: Biology-Guided Context-Aware Residual Propagation for Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology
comment: Accepted at The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2027
summary: Spatial transcriptomics provides spatially resolved molecular profiling, but its cost, limited throughput and experimental complexity hinder routine large-scale use. Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin-and-eosin-stained histology images offers a scalable alternative, yet remains challenging because histology provides only an indirect morphological view of molecular activity. Existing methods typically decode expression from visual features in a single stage, even when enhanced with spatial aggregation, retrieval or multi-resolution fusion. This formulation is restrictive because spot-level expression reflects not only local morphology but also cellular identity, neighborhood composition and tissue-level organization. We propose BCARP, a Biology-guided Context-Aware Residual Propagation framework for histology-guided spatial transcriptomics prediction. Instead of directly predicting gene expression from histology embeddings, BCARP treats them as morphology visual priors and progressively refines spot representations in a transcriptomics-oriented latent space. Each refinement step integrates nuclei-guided local cellular context with prototype-guided global context propagation, enabling information exchange across both neighboring and spatially distant spots. A pattern-scale decoder further separates spatial expression into pattern prediction from raw expression with scale calibration. Evaluated on three ST datasets and ten HEST-1k cohorts, BCARP achieves the highest mean correlation-based performance against other baselines. Numerical results support biology-guided local-global residual propagation as an effective alternative to visual decoding for histology-to-transcriptomics prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出BCARP框架，将组织学图像视为形态学先验而非直接预测，在面向转录组学的潜空间中通过核引导局部上下文与原型引导全局传播逐步精炼spot表示，在三个ST数据集和十个HEST-1k队列上取得最高平均相关性表现。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组测序成本高、通量有限、实验复杂，难以大规模常规使用；从H&E染色图像预测空间基因表达是可扩展的替代方案，但组织学仅提供分子活动的间接形态学视角。现有方法多采用单阶段从视觉特征解码表达，即便加入空间聚合、检索或多分辨率融合仍受限，因为spot级表达不仅反映局部形态，还涉及细胞身份、邻域组成与组织级组织架构。
AI.method: BCARP（生物学引导的上下文感知残差传播框架）：不直接由组织学嵌入预测基因表达，而是将其作为形态学视觉先验，在转录组学导向的潜空间中逐步精炼spot表示；每步精炼融合核引导的局部细胞上下文与原型引导的全局上下文传播，实现近邻与空间远距离spot间的信息交换；并设计模式尺度解码器，将空间表达分解为模式预测与原始表达并配以尺度校准。
AI.result: 在三个ST数据集和十个HEST-1k队列上评估，BCARP相对其他基线取得最高的平均相关性类指标表现；数值结果支持生物学引导的局部-全局残差传播是组织学→转录组预测中视觉解码的有效替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 生物学引导的局部-全局残差传播可作为组织学图像到空间转录组预测的有效范式，优于传统单阶段视觉解码，为低成本、可扩展的空间表达预测提供新思路。

title: DUET4D: Self-Corrective Coupled Guidance for Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view 4D reconstruction is highly under-constrained when only a few cameras are available. Generative priors can recover missing appearances, but video models are computationally impractical for iterative reconstruction, whereas single-view models produce temporally inconsistent pseudo-observations. Moreover, directly absorbing uncertain generative outputs into Gaussian optimization often creates redundant primitives and floating artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose DUET4D, a self-corrective coupled guidance framework for sparse-view 4D Gaussian splatting. The core of our approach is a self-corrective framework where the 4D representation guides generative prior for spatio-temporal consistent supervisions. We first construct sequential alignments from current Gaussian evidence to steer the latent restoration. Then we use Sequential Fidelity Resampling to lift generative supervisions into Gaussian space to selectively distinguish repeatedly supported primitives. The corrected representation then provides more reliable Gaussian evidence for the next restoration cycle. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET4D significantly improves rendering quality and rendering efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出自校正耦合引导框架 DUET4D，用 4D 高斯表示反过来引导生成先验，实现稀疏视角下时空一致的 4D 重建，同时提升渲染质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角 4D 重建严重欠约束：视频生成模型计算成本高、难以用于迭代重建，单视图模型生成的伪观测时序不一致；且直接将不确定的生成结果注入高斯优化会产生冗余基元与漂浮伪影。
AI.method: 构建自校正闭环：先由当前高斯证据建立序列对齐以引导潜空间修复；再用序列保真重采样（Sequential Fidelity Resampling）将生成监督提升到高斯空间，筛选被反复支持的基元；校正后的表示再为下一轮修复提供更可靠的高斯证据。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 DUET4D 在渲染质量和渲染效率上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 以 4D 表示主动引导生成先验、并通过重采样过滤不确定监督，是解决稀疏视角 4D 高斯重建冗余与伪影问题的有效途径。

title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
summary: While language models have become dramatically more capable, retrieval still largely relies on lexical matching or similarity in fixed embedding spaces. This creates a capability asymmetry: what the retriever fails to find, even the strongest generator cannot recover. We propose DecisionRAG, which brings the capabilities of pretrained language models to retrieval using decision models that jointly evaluate candidate branches in a single forward pass, without generating any tokens, and show that judging candidates in a shared context makes their relevance estimates comparable. Like a person browsing a library, DecisionRAG navigates the corpus's inherent structure from broad topics down to individual passages, deciding at each level which branches are worth exploring. Without task-specific training or a first-stage retriever, DecisionRAG outperforms dense retrieval with an 8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 points on MultiDoc2Dial and 17.4 Hit@1 points on Natural Questions. Across four benchmarks, including a corpus of 2.68 million Wikipedia paragraphs, retrieval takes just 0.7-1.8 seconds per query.

AI.tldr: 提出DecisionRAG，用预训练语言模型的决策模型在共享上下文中单次前向评估候选分支（不生成token），从粗到细导航语料结构进行检索，无需任务训练或一阶段检索器即可超越8B重排器。
AI.motivation: 现有检索主要依赖词法匹配或固定嵌入空间相似度，造成能力不对称：检索器找不到的内容，再强的生成器也无法弥补。
AI.method: DecisionRAG让语言模型充当决策模型，在一次前向中联合评估多个候选分支、不生成任何token；在共享上下文中判断候选使其相关性估计可比。类人浏览图书馆，从宽泛主题逐层向下到具体段落，在每层决定哪些分支值得探索。
AI.result: 无需任务特定训练和一阶段检索器，在MultiDoc2Dial上比8B重排器的稠密检索高13.8 R@1点，Natural Questions上高17.4 Hit@1点；含268万维基段落的四个基准上，每查询检索仅需0.7–1.8秒。
AI.conclusion: 将语言模型的判断能力直接引入检索决策，可有效缓解能力不对称，并在效率与效果上兼顾。

title: DAC-Loop: Distillation-Aware Compression for Remote Sensing CNN
summary: While large-scale models achieve strong results in remote sensing scene classification, deploying them on edge devices remains difficult due to limited compute, memory, and energy budgets. Compact CNN backbones are therefore a practical choice in many real-world settings, offering efficient inference with well-optimized implementations on embedded hardware. To push this efficiency further, we investigate how far a knowledge-distilled student model can be compressed while preserving high accuracy. We propose a Distillation-Aware Compression Loop (DAC-Loop) that integrates (i) knowledge distillation applied both before and after structured channel pruning, and (ii) an iterative compression schedule that alternates structured pruning with unstructured sparsification. Across EuroSAT and NWPU-RESISC45, the DAC-Loop consistently improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to standard one-shot pruning and single-stage KD recovery, maintaining strong accuracy even beyond 90% parameter reduction. These results demonstrate that combining distillation and pruning in a unified iterative loop offers an effective path toward compact remote sensing models.

AI.tldr: 提出DAC-Loop：在结构化通道剪枝前后均施加知识蒸馏，并迭代交替结构化剪枝与非结构化稀疏化，对紧凑CNN进行极致压缩以用于遥感场景分类的端侧部署。
AI.motivation: 大模型在遥感场景分类表现好，但边缘设备算力、内存、能耗受限。紧凑CNN是现实选择，需进一步探索知识蒸馏学生模型能被压缩到何种程度仍保持高精度。
AI.method: 提出Distillation-Aware Compression Loop（DAC-Loop），包含两部分：(i) 在结构化通道剪枝前和后都进行知识蒸馏；(ii) 迭代式压缩调度，交替进行结构化剪枝与非结构化稀疏化。
AI.result: 在EuroSAT和NWPU-RESISC45上，相较一次性剪枝与单阶段KD恢复，DAC-Loop持续改善精度-压缩权衡，即使参数减少超过90%仍保持较强精度。
AI.conclusion: 将蒸馏与剪枝统一到一个迭代循环中，是实现紧凑遥感模型的有效途径。

title: Shifted Window Temporal Transformer for YOLO-Guided Phase Recognition in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Surgery
summary: Intelligent operating rooms require accurate awareness of surgical workflow for better intra-operative decisions, teamwork, and surgical documentation. Therefore, accurately recognizing surgical phase during surgery is crucial. However, previous artificial intelligence-based methods provide fluctuating predictions for the transitions, restricting their clinical use. To address this challenge, we propose a clinically meaningful framework that integrates a Swin Transformer and Temporal Transformer Encoder (TTE) for effective surgical phase recognition and a parallel YOLOv11s network for real-time surgical instrument localization. To avoid phase flickering and to produce stable workflow predictions, a causal temporal smoothing is applied. The proposed framework is tested on the Cholec80 dataset for the simultaneous recognition of the surgical phases and instruments. The overall phase recognition accuracy of this model was 92%, and the macro average F1-score was 0.86. This performance surpasses CNN based methods such as EndoNet (81.7%) and SV-RCNet (85.3%), as well as temporal convolutional and transformer-based approaches including TeCNO (88.6%), Trans-SVNet (90.9%), and LoViT (91.5%). Besides, the module of instrument detection achieved mAP@0.5 = 0.863. The reliability of the results is confirmed, obtaining a high recognition rate of the workflows, and a high accuracy of the localization of the instruments. The proposed framework can serve as a foundation for intelligent surgical assistance, enriching situation awareness, and potential robotic surgery applications. Code will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80

AI.tldr: 提出融合Swin Transformer与TTE的框架做手术阶段识别，并行YOLOv11s做器械定位，并用因果时序平滑抑制阶段闪烁；在Cholec80上达92%准确率、F1 0.86，器械mAP@0.5=0.863。
AI.motivation: 智能手术室需要精确的手术流程感知以支持术中决策、团队协作与手术记录，但现有AI方法在阶段转换处预测波动（阶段闪烁），限制临床应用。
AI.method: Swin Transformer提取空间特征，Temporal Transformer Encoder建模时序，实现手术阶段识别；并行的YOLOv11s网络实现实时手术器械定位；引入因果时序平滑（causal temporal smoothing）消除阶段闪烁、输出稳定流程预测；在Cholec80上同时评测阶段与器械。
AI.result: 整体阶段识别准确率92%，宏平均F1为0.86，优于EndoNet(81.7%)、SV-RCNet(85.3%)、TeCNO(88.6%)、Trans-SVNet(90.9%)、LoViT(91.5%)；器械检测mAP@0.5=0.863。
AI.conclusion: 结果可靠性得到验证，流程识别率与器械定位精度均较高，可作为智能手术辅助、情境感知增强及机器人手术应用的基础。

title: Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文对 agentic RAG 与静态 RAG 在台湾历史问答上做受控对比，发现二者总体表现相近但在 70.83% 的问题上给出不同结果，故提出事后选择器（post-hoc selector）比较两种回答与引用证据，显著超越任一单一管线并回收 60.34% 的 oracle 提升空间。
AI.motivation: Agentic RAG 能依据已检索证据自适应调整检索，但其是否稳定优于设计良好的静态管线尚不明确；作者希望厘清两者真实差异。
AI.method: 受控实验：共享同一生成器与混合检索后端，对比 agentic 与静态 RAG；并设计一个事后选择器，比较两条管线产出的回答及其引用证据，逐题择优。
AI.result: 总体性能相近，但 70.83% 的问题上两管线结果不同且优势相互抵消；oracle 逐题择优比更优单一管线高 0.2417 综合分，说明存在大量择优空间；选择器显著优于任一单管线，回收 60.34% 的 oracle 提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 聚合层面的比较会掩盖检索策略在问题层面的实质差异；与其追求普适最优管线，不如利用不同管线间的互补性。

title: LEAP: a Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer for time-series anomaly detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection is dominated by reconstruction-based neural detectors, whose objective is structurally flawed. Since the target is also the input, an expressive model can learn to reconstruct anomalies too, leaving uninformative residuals. Recent large-scale benchmarks show that, on curated data, elaborate deep detectors rarely beat simple statistical baselines, while current leaders rely on representation learning. We propose LEAP (Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer), which combines masked prediction with latent representation-based anomaly evidence, without relying on reconstruction or attention-based scoring. The model removes patches from a window and predicts them from the remaining temporal and cross-channel context, so prediction errors measure how well learned dynamics explain hidden segments. Deterministic complementary group masking ensures every time step is scored while hidden, with identical visible fractions during training and inference. LEAP adds three label-free evidence sources: latent-embedding novelty calibrated by local density, local temporal contrast, and per-channel novelty pooled over channels selected by six label-free criteria. Under the TSB-AD protocol, the full model achieves a VUS-PR of $0.5179 \pm 0.0022$ on $180$ held-out multivariate series. On TSB-AD-U, a univariate variant combining multi-scale masked-prediction scoring with latent novelty, without contrast or channel-pool novelty, achieves $0.6194 \pm 0.0016$ on $350$ held-out series. Both results average three random seeds. A five-stage ablation on TSB-AD-M, supported by paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, shows statistically significant gains from each successive component.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAP（Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer），将掩码预测与潜在表示异常证据结合，避免重建式检测的结构性缺陷，在TSB-AD基准上取得VUS-PR 0.5179（多变量）与0.6194（单变量）。
AI.motivation: 重建式神经网络检测器目标结构有缺陷：输入即目标，强表达力模型连异常也能重构，残差无信息量。近期大规模基准显示复杂深度检测器在精编数据上难敌简单统计基线，领先方法依赖表示学习。
AI.method: LEAP从窗口内移除部分patch，用剩余时序与跨通道上下文预测它们，以预测误差衡量学习到的动态解释隐段的能力；采用确定性互补分组掩码，保证每步在被隐藏时被打分，且训练与推理可见比例一致。另加三路无标签证据：局部密度校准的潜在嵌入新颖度、局部时序对比、按六项无标签准则选通道后池化的逐通道新颖度。
AI.result: TSB-AD协议下，完整模型在180条留出多变量序列上VUS-PR为0.5179±0.0022；TSB-AD-U上单变量变体（多尺度掩码预测+潜在新颖度）在350条留出序列上为0.6194±0.0016，均为三种子平均。
AI.conclusion: TSB-AD-M上五阶段消融配合配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验，显示每个渐进组件均带来统计显著提升，验证掩码预测式潜在证据组合的有效性。

title: When Pointing Becomes Profiling: Social Bias and Refusal in Text-Steerable Visual Encoders
summary: Text-steerable visual encoders condition a frozen Vision Transformer on a natural-language prompt and point at the matching image region, producing prompt-conditioned heatmaps and features. We audit the released SteerViT model and find that its steering interface turns language-driven pointing into demographic profiling. On counterfactual face mosaics and real multi-person photographs, "the person" selects a man more often than the base rate, crime words select Black people more often than occupation words do, "the man" among four women selects the Black woman 75.6% of the time on SocialCounterfactuals, and "the monkey" selects Black people. None of them is in the backbone's unsteered saliency, and the crime association is not in the frozen text encoder; the race effects grow with steering strength and enter through the last two cross-attention layers: giving the prompt to those layers alone reproduces them. Four other grounding models, CLIPSeg, Grounding-DINO, SAM 3, and Qwen2.5-VL, show no crime routing and weaker race routing. The model cannot refuse. Its patch softmax must place its mass somewhere, and its heatmap separates a groundable request ("the police officer") from one that is absent ("the pizza") or that would require a stereotyped demographic inference ("the criminal") only at chance (AUROC 0.52). We introduce SafeSteer, which adds a learned abstention output and counterfactual-invariance training on the same 23M steering parameters. SafeSteer separates should-point from should-abstain prompts at AUROC 0.997, generalizes to held-out sensitive and absent words (0.998; at a 0.5 threshold it refuses 99.8% of trained and 62% of held-out sensitive words) with no over-refusal of visible people on the benchmark, and removes most race routing while keeping localization and retrieval within 1 point of the released model. Code, benchmarks, and the curated mosaic sets will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了文本可控视觉编码器SteerViT，发现其"语言驱动指向"接口实为人口统计画像：人口描述词与犯罪词会系统性地将注意力导向特定种族/性别。作者提出SafeSteer，通过可学习弃答输出与反事实不变性训练，使模型能拒绝不可groundable或需刻板推断的请求。
AI.motivation: 文本可控视觉编码器（以自然语言提示指向图像区域）被广泛使用，但其指向行为是否存在偏见、能否拒绝不应回答的请求，缺乏系统审计。作者希望揭示此类模型的种族/性别路由风险并加以修复。
AI.method: 审计：在反事实人脸拼贴图与真实多人照片上测试SteerViT的提示-区域对应，并用组件消融（backbone未引导显著性、冻结文本编码器、逐层注入提示）定位偏见来源；同时对比CLIPSeg、Grounding-DINO、SAM 3、Qwen2.5-VL。修复：提出SafeSteer，在同样的23M引导参数上加入学习式弃答输出与反事实不变性训练。
AI.result: "the person"选男性高于基率；犯罪词比职业词更常指向黑人；在四名女性中"the man"75.6%选中黑人女性（SocialCounterfactuals）；"the monkey"指向黑人。这些效应不在backbone未引导显著性中，犯罪关联也不在冻结文本编码器中；种族效应随引导强度增强，且仅通过最后两层交叉注意力进入。原模型无法拒答：区分可groundable与应弃答请求的AUROC仅0.52。SafeSteer将AUROC提升至0.997（留出敏感/缺失词0.998），0.5阈值下拒绝99.8%训练内与62%留出敏感词，无明显过度拒答，大部分种族路由被消除，定位与检索性能与发布版差距在1个点内。
AI.conclusion: 语言可控视觉编码器的引导接口会将刻板关联转化为人口统计路由，且缺乏拒答能力。SafeSteer以极低成本（同一组引导参数）显著提升弃答判别与反事实不变性，在基本不损失定位/检索的前提下缓解种族路由，为可控视觉模型的安全部署提供可行方案。

title: Understanding Practical Optimization in Machine Learning
summary: Modern machine learning relies on practical optimization methods that often differ from the algorithms studied in classical analyses: they train submodels, clip or normalize gradients, use layer-wise non-Euclidean directions, or approximate costly inner computations. This thesis analyzes the objective, assumptions, update, and computation defined by these procedures, rather than those of simplified proxies. For submodel training, we show that Independent Subnetwork Training can converge to a shifted fixed point because sketching before differentiation biases the update for the original objective. Model-Agnostic Sparsified Training instead incorporates the sketch distribution into its objective, which makes sketched gradients unbiased and admits convergence guarantees. For private optimization, we show that adaptive quantile clipping retains bias at any fixed quantile, while suitable quantile schedules recover near-optimal nonconvex rates under heavy-tailed noise. We then combine smoothed normalization with error compensation and obtain distributed private convergence guarantees under standard assumptions, without assuming bounded gradients. For optimizers based on linear minimization oracles, we develop and validate a layer-wise generalized smoothness model and build on it the Gluon framework for Muon- and Scion-style methods. We also show that the approximate orthogonalization in Muon matters: less precise orthogonalization calls for smaller stepsizes, so its precision should be tuned together with the learning rate. Overall, practical methods are better understood when theory retains the features that determine their optimization behavior.

AI.tldr: 该博士论文主张应直接分析实际优化算法（子模型训练、梯度裁剪/归一化、逐层非欧方向、内层近似计算）本身的目标、假设、更新与计算，而非简化代理，从而给出更贴合实践的收敛理论。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习实践中的优化方法与经典理论分析的算法往往不一致（训练子模型、裁剪或归一化梯度、逐层非欧几里得方向、近似昂贵的内层计算）。用简化代理分析会丢失决定优化行为的关键特征，导致理论与实践的偏差。
AI.method: 按四个方向逐一分析真实过程：(1) 子模型训练：指出 Independent Subnetwork Training 在微分前做 sketching 会使更新对原目标有偏，只能收敛到偏移的不动点；而 Model-Agnostic Sparsified Training 把 sketch 分布纳入目标，使稀疏梯度无偏并可证收敛。(2) 隐私优化：分析自适应分位数裁剪，证明固定分位数下偏差始终存在，而合适的量化调度可在重尾噪声下恢复近最优非凸速率；再结合平滑归一化与误差补偿，在标准假设、不假设梯度有界下得到分布式隐私收敛保证。(3) 基于线性最小化 oracle 的优化器：建立并验证逐层广义光滑性模型，并据此构建 Gluon 框架以覆盖 Muon/Scion 类方法；指出 Muon 中近似正交化的精度需与学习率联合调校（精度越低需越小步长）。
AI.result: 得到若干具体结论：IST 存在偏差的不动点；MAST 通过将 sketch 分布纳入目标实现无偏与收敛；固定分位数裁剪有持续偏差，调度分位数可恢复重尾下的近最优非凸速率；平滑归一化+误差补偿可在无有界梯度假设下给出分布式隐私保证；逐层广义光滑性为 Muon/Scion 提供理论支撑，且正交化精度与步长强耦合。
AI.conclusion: 保留决定优化行为的实践特征，理论才能更好理解实际方法；算法实现细节（如 sketch 位置、分位数调度、正交化精度）并非次要，而应作为理论分析的核心对象与调参变量。

title: Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Estimation for Visual Perception in Lower-Limb Prostheses
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Integrated Systems in Medical Technologies 2026
summary: Monocular depth estimation has advanced rapidly with the development of foundation models that demonstrate strong zero-shot generalisation across diverse visual domains. However, the applicability of these models to visual perception for lower-limb prosthetics remains largely unexplored. Reliable depth perception is particularly important for prosthesis users, who often experience significant challenges when navigating stairs, uneven terrain, and other complex environments. To address this gap, we introduce the Lower-Limb Prosthesis (LP) dataset, a benchmark designed to evaluate depth perception from an emulated knee-level prosthetic viewpoint. Using this dataset, we evaluate four state-of-the-art monocular depth estimation foundation models. Our results provide the first systematic benchmark of monocular depth estimation performance from a prosthetic viewpoint, while highlighting both the challenges and the potential of deploying foundation models in prosthetic perception systems. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Ishivijay/lp_dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LP数据集，首次系统评估单目深度估计基础模型在模拟膝高假肢视角下的表现。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在单目深度估计上零样本泛化能力强，但其在下肢假肢视觉感知中的适用性尚属空白。假肢用户上下楼梯、通过不平地形时尤其需要可靠的深度感知。
AI.method: 构建Lower-Limb Prosthesis (LP) 数据集，从模拟膝关节高度的假肢视角采集数据，作为评估基准；在此基础上评测四个最先进的单目深度估计基础模型。
AI.result: 给出首个从假肢视角进行的单目深度估计系统性基准，揭示基础模型用于假肢感知的困难与潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了假肢视觉感知评估的空白，为在假肢感知系统中部署深度基础模型提供了基准与参考；代码与数据已开源。

title: Efficient Exact Unlearning for Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization
summary: Federated zeroth-order optimization (FedZOO) reduces the memory and communication costs of collaborative training for edge intelligence by avoiding backpropagation while communicating only random seeds and scalar coefficients. However, existing methods lack efficient mechanisms for exact unlearning to fully remove the influence of training data when users request deletion. A key insight is that total variation stability of the learning algorithm creates overlap between model distributions before and after data deletion, allowing exact unlearning to reuse computation through coupling. Based on this observation, we jointly design two stable zeroth-order learning algorithms and their corresponding exact-unlearning procedures: \textsc{FedZOO-S} obtains stability through client and mini-batch subsampling, enabling \textsc{FedZOUL-S} to perform efficient unlearning by preserving earlier updates and restarting from the first affected step. \textsc{FedZOO-NS} further combines subsampling with Gaussian noise to increase overlap between update distributions; \textsc{FedZOUL-NS} exploits this overlap through rejection--reflection coupling to reuse affected updates when the coupling is accepted. We prove exact unlearning for both algorithms: the model and saved state have the same joint distribution as retraining with the corresponding learner on retained data. We further establish stability and convergence guarantees for the learning algorithms and derive upper bounds on expected unlearning cost. Experiments demonstrate effective unlearning with competitive model utility and up to $56.1\%$ less cumulative unlearning time than re-optimization. Compared with first-order baselines, our methods reduce communication overhead by up to approximately four orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦零阶优化(FedZOO)缺乏高效精确遗忘机制的问题，利用学习算法的全变差稳定性构造删除前后模型分布的重叠，联合设计两种稳定零阶学习算法及其精确遗忘流程，实现高效精确遗忘。
AI.motivation: FedZOO通过避免反向传播、仅传输随机种子和标量系数降低了边缘智能协同训练的内存与通信开销，但现有方法缺乏高效的精确遗忘(exact unlearning)机制，无法在用户请求删除数据时彻底移除训练数据影响。作者洞察到：算法的全变差稳定性可使删除前后模型分布产生重叠，从而通过耦合(coupling)复用计算来实现精确遗忘。
AI.method: 联合设计两种稳定零阶学习算法及配套精确遗忘流程：(1) FedZOO-S 通过客户端与mini-batch子采样获得稳定性，FedZOUL-S 通过保留早期更新并从首个受影响步骤重启来高效遗忘；(2) FedZOO-NS 在子采样基础上加入高斯噪声以增大更新分布重叠，FedZOUL-NS 通过拒绝-反射耦合(rejection–reflection coupling)在耦合被接受时复用受影响更新。
AI.result: 证明了两种算法的精确遗忘性：模型与保存状态在保留数据上重训练具有相同的联合分布；建立了学习算法的稳定性与收敛性保证，并推导了期望遗忘成本的上界。实验中遗忘有效，模型效用具竞争力，累积遗忘时间比再优化最多减少56.1%；相比一阶基线，通信开销最多降低约四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 基于全变差稳定性的耦合式精确遗忘框架可同时兼顾FedZOO的通信/内存优势与可靠的数据删除能力，在保证精确遗忘与收敛性的同时显著降低遗忘时间和通信开销。

title: Revealing Imaging Characteristics of Thermal Wakes from Underwater Vehicles Without Cooling-Water Discharge
summary: Small uncrewed underwater vehicles are proliferating and threaten maritime security, yet evade sonar and magnetic sensors built for larger submarines. Infrared thermal wakes, generated by hydrodynamic displacement that modulates the cold-skin layer, offer a non-acoustic, non-magnetic alternative even without cooling-water discharge. Existing studies, however, rely on idealized simulations that fail to capture real-world backgrounds, offering limited guidance for target-background discrimination. We establish AVP-IR-Wake, the first large-scale, real-world, physically diverse benchmark of 161,485 frames collected over three years. We show that thermal wakes are extended structures of discrete vortices, violating the compactness assumption of conventional targets. We reveal local indistinguishability: individual wake vortices are statistically identical to wind-induced background vortices in temporal, frequency, and sparse domains, sharing low-frequency information and long-range correlations. This challenges the assumptions of compact, transient, high-frequency targets in conventional detection. Yet we establish global morphological separability: although locally inseparable, the wake as a whole is organized by vehicle trajectory, whereas background clutter is organized by wind-driven thermal fronts. This explains why representative detectors fail and shows that reliable detection must shift from local feature extraction to global trajectory-constrained physical modeling. Because the cold-skin layer varies globally and seasonally, forecasting wake observability will require integrating physical oceanography and atmospheric science, linking underwater surveillance to the changing ocean surface.

AI.tldr: 论文构建首个大规模真实红外尾迹数据集AVP-IR-Wake（16万余帧，历时三年），揭示小型无人潜航器热尾迹"局部不可分、全局形态可分"的特性，指出检测应从局部特征提取转向轨迹约束的物理建模。
AI.motivation: 小型无人潜航器日益增多却可规避为大型潜艇设计的声呐与磁传感器，红外热尾迹提供非声非磁探测新途径；但现有研究依赖理想化仿真，缺乏真实背景，难以指导目标—背景判别。
AI.method: 建立AVP-IR-Wake大规模真实基准数据集（161,485帧，采集三年），系统分析热尾迹的时空、频域与稀疏域统计特性，并与风致背景涡旋对比，考察代表性能检测器的失效原因。
AI.result: 发现热尾迹是由离散涡旋组成的延展结构，违反传统目标的紧凑性假设；单个尾迹涡旋与风生背景涡旋在时域、频域和稀疏域统计上不可区分（共享低频信息与长程相关性），传统检测器因而失效。
AI.conclusion: 尾迹整体由潜航器轨迹组织，背景杂波由风驱热锋组织，存在全局形态可分性；可靠检测需转向全局轨迹约束的物理建模，并结合物理海洋学与大气科学预测尾迹可观测性。

title: One-Shot Federated Model Editing for Device Dynamics at the Edge
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at IEEE Transactions on Networking
summary: Standard federated learning (FL) requires persistent device connectivity across multiple communication rounds, making it unsuitable for dynamic environments such as vehicular networks, where devices frequently join and leave. One-shot FL offers a promising alternative by completing training in a single communication round. However, one-shot FL suffers from model solidification and cannot readily adapt to subsequent client dynamics, including new client contributions and the withdrawal of previous contributions. We therefore consider exact model editing, which removes withdrawn contributions through unlearning or incorporates newly contributed ones through incremental learning without retraining from scratch. We identify that efficient editing fundamentally hinges on learning stability. To this end, we propose F-SOSA, the first stable one-shot FL algorithm that enables rapid and exact model editing. F-SOSA leverages sub-sampling of local models with carefully tuned rate for stable aggregation and performs curvature-aware model fusion to preserve utility. We prove that F-SOSA achieves vanishing training error and reasonably small generalization error bounds. Building on this stability, we further develop two single-round editing algorithms: F-SOSA-U for unlearning and F-SOSA-I for incremental learning. They ensure that the edited model, along with all intermediate algorithmic states, is statistically indistinguishable from retraining while incurring only an expected $O(ρ)$ fraction of its cost, where $ρ$ quantifies stability. Experiments demonstrate that our approach matches retraining performance while reducing cumulative time and communication overhead by at least 36% and 22%, respectively, under realistic urban mobility simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出F-SOSA，首个稳定的单轮联邦学习（one-shot FL）算法，支持快速、精确的模型编辑（遗忘与增量学习），无需从头重训练即可应对客户端动态变化。
AI.motivation: 标准FL需多轮持续连接，不适合车辆网等动态环境；单轮FL虽只需一次通信，但存在"模型固化"问题，无法适应后续客户端加入/退出。因此需要精确模型编辑，而高效编辑的关键在于学习稳定性。
AI.method: F-SOSA通过对本地模型进行带精细调优采样率的子采样实现稳定聚合，并采用曲率感知（curvature-aware）模型融合以保持效用；在此基础上开发两个单轮编辑算法：F-SOSA-U（遗忘）与F-SOSA-I（增量学习）。
AI.result: 理论证明F-SOSA训练误差趋于零、泛化误差界合理；编辑后模型及所有中间状态与重训练在统计上不可区分，代价仅为重训练的期望O(ρ)比例（ρ衡量稳定性）。实验表明性能匹配重训练，城市移动仿真下累计时间与通信开销分别至少降低36%和22%。
AI.conclusion: F-SOSA通过保障学习稳定性，实现了单轮FL下高效精确的模型编辑，兼顾性能、隐私合规（遗忘）与动态适应性，显著降低时间与通信开销。

title: DriveUniTok: A Unified Multimodal Tokenizer for Driving World-Action Models
summary: World models are emerging as a fundamental component of policy learning for real-world agents, enabling agents to predict future world states and plan actions within a learned representation of the dynamic environment. Existing approaches, however, often model appearance, metric geometry represented by projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion either partially or independently, overlooking the fact that these modalities are different projections of a shared underlying world state. This separation can lead to information loss and cross-modal inconsistency, ultimately limiting downstream performance. Motivated by this unified view of the world, we propose DriveUniTok, a unified multimodal tokenizer for driving world-action models (WAMs) that encodes these modalities in a single decodable continuous latent. We freeze DriveUniTok and adapt a pretrained diffusion model, DriveUniWAM, to predict future unified latents; the tokenizer then decodes them into future appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate that our unified design achieves better future prediction and planning performance at lower downstream computational cost than separate-stream alternatives. With reinforcement learning post-training, DriveUniWAM achieves a PDMS of 91.54, reaching state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated WAM-based planners.

AI.tldr: 提出统一多模态分词器DriveUniTok，将外观、投影LiDAR深度与自车运动编码到单一可解码连续潜空间，并基于冻结分词器适配扩散模型DriveUniWAM预测未来统一潜变量，在NAVSIM上以更低下游计算实现更好的预测与规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型通常分别或独立地建模外观、度量几何（投影LiDAR深度）和自车运动，忽视了这些模态其实是同一底层世界状态的不同投影，导致信息损失与跨模态不一致，限制下游性能。
AI.method: 提出DriveUniTok统一多模态分词器，将外观、投影LiDAR深度与自车轨迹编码为单个可解码的连续潜变量；冻结该分词器，适配预训练扩散模型DriveUniWAM来预测未来统一潜变量，再由分词器解码出未来的外观、深度与轨迹。并采用强化学习后训练。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM上，统一设计相比分离流方案在未来预测与规划性能上更优，且下游计算成本更低；经RL后训练，DriveUniWAM达到PDMS 91.54，在被评估的WAM类规划器中取得SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态视为共享世界状态的不同投影进行统一建模是有效且高效的，DriveUniTok+DriveUniWAM验证了统一潜空间世界-动作模型的可行性与优越性。

title: SkillLifeBench: Benchmarking Security Across the Lifecycle of Agent Skills
summary: Web agents reuse skills whose stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation can diverge across tasks and updates. SkillLifeBench links these states to task outcomes in 388 paired scenarios spanning implementation, interface, runtime, composition, and version changes. We evaluate 14 models on two paired decision tracks: 89 runtime tasks and 60 autonomous lifecycle tasks spanning 12 templates derived from introduced cases. Lifecycle tasks allow agents to inspect, select, and reconfigure skills while completing verifiable user requests. Joint success requires task completion without the registered attack goal. GPT-5.6-Sol and Sonnet 4.6 both achieve 82.0% on runtime tasks, but reach 96.7% and 56.7% on lifecycle tasks. Across lifecycle evaluations, challenged task success is 77.5%, while joint success is 65.2%; 103 runs complete the task and the attack goal. Adding execution provenance in a matched recovery study raises utility joint success from 49.35% with logs and metadata to 65.58%. A deterministic execution-consistency rule reaches 64.94% with higher benign utility, while full restoration reaches 69.48%. Lifecycle tasks distinguish models with similar runtime scores, and execution evidence improves recovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SkillLifeBench，将 Web 智能体的技能代码、选定版本与加载实现三类状态的错配与任务结果关联，用 388 个配对场景（覆盖实现、接口、运行时、组合、版本变化）评测 14 个模型，分运行时任务与自主生命周期任务两条配对决策轨道。
AI.motivation: Web 智能体复用的技能存在存储代码、选定版本与加载实现随任务和更新而发散的问题，这种状态错配对任务结果的影响未被系统度量。
AI.method: 构建 SkillLifeBench，含 388 个配对场景、两类配对决策轨道：89 个运行时任务与 60 个自主生命周期任务（源自 12 个模板）；生命周期任务允许智能体检查、选择并重配置技能，同时完成可验证用户请求；联合成功需在任务完成的同时不达成注册攻击目标。另做匹配的恢复实验，比较日志+元数据、确定性执行一致性规则与完全恢复三种方案。
AI.result: GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Sonnet 4.6 运行时任务均 82.0%，但生命周期任务分别为 96.7% 与 56.7%；生命周期评测中受扰任务成功 77.5%，联合成功 65.2%，103 次运行同时完成攻击目标。恢复实验中，加入执行溯源使联合成功从 49.35%（日志+元数据）升至 65.58%；确定性一致性规则达 64.94% 且良性效用更高，完全恢复达 69.48%。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期任务能区分运行时得分相近的模型，执行证据（溯源）可提升恢复效果；技能状态一致性是 Web 智能体安全与可靠性的关键维度。

title: LOCUS: Locate Once, Check Until Settled. Draft-and-Verify Visual Grounding with a Box Head and Coordinate-Token Verification
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Project page: https://muhammad-talha-ad.github.io/LOCUS/ Code: https://github.com/muhammad-talha-ad/LOCUS Models: https://huggingface.co/MTalha2001/LOCUS-2B and https://huggingface.co/MTalha2001/LOCUS-0.8B
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) ground a referring expression in one of two ways. They decode the box as coordinate tokens, which is precise but takes one sequential step per token, or they regress it from a hidden state with a small head, which takes one step but loses accuracy at high IoU. The two fail differently: a head usually finds the right object but places its edges loosely, while coordinate tokens place edges precisely. We therefore use the regression head as a speculative drafter for the model's own coordinate tokens. Locus writes the head's box as coordinate tokens and checks them with the same backbone by Jacobi iteration over a shared image prefix. The fixed point is the model's greedy coordinate-token answer, reached in about 5.60 sequential passes on average instead of 18.46 decoding steps; head and verifier are one set of weights, trained jointly. On the 8 RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg splits, verification raises Locus-2B's Acc@0.9 from 54.87 for its own head to 59.13, and the one-pass head is ahead at Acc@0.5 of every published model with at most 3B parameters except Florence-2-L. Against Jag, the strongest open regression-head model, at its own size and training budget, Locus ties at Acc@0.5 and, with typical acceptance, gains +4.52 points at Acc@0.9, with paired significance tests. Exact answers come 1.5x faster than vLLM greedy-decoding the same coordinate tokens with the same weights; a pure regression head remains faster still.

AI.tldr: Locus 将坐标回归头作为推测解码草稿器，用自身坐标 token 做 Jacobi 迭代验证，5.60 步达到贪心解码答案，Acc@0.9 从 54.87 提升到 59.13，精确答案比 vLLM 快 1.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型的指代表达定位有两种范式：坐标 token 解码精确但逐 token 串行、耗时（18.46 步）；回归头只需一步但高 IoU 下边缘不准。两者失败模式互补——头找得到物体但框边松，token 边界精准——因此可相互利用。
AI.method: 把回归头当作"推测"草稿器：将头的框写成坐标 token，再由同一骨干网络在共享图像前缀上做 Jacobi 迭代验证，收敛的固定点即模型的贪心坐标 token 答案。头与验证器共享一套权重并联合训练。
AI.result: 8 个 RefCOCO/+/g 划分上，验证使 Locus-2B 的 Acc@0.9 从头的 54.87 升至 59.13；单次头在 Acc@0.5 上超越所有 ≤3B 的已发表模型（除 Florence-2-L）。与同规模同预算的 Jag 相比，Acc@0.5 持平，典型接受率下 Acc@0.9 提升 +4.52（配对显著性检验）。
AI.conclusion: 推测解码式地结合回归头与坐标 token 兼具精度与效率：平均 5.60 次串行传递即可精确，比 vLLM 贪心解码快 1.5 倍；但纯回归头仍更快，说明精度与速度存在取舍。

title: NOMAD-EEG: Native Omni-Montage Adaptive Diffusion
summary: Purpose. Electroencephalography (EEG) montages, channel counts and recording lengths vary widely, but most EEG foundation models are bound to the channel set and input length they were trained on. We aimed to build a generative EEG foundation model independent of the number, identity and order of electrodes and of the input length. Methods. NOMAD-EEG is a 12.0 M-parameter diffusion model that alternates state-space layers along time, without patches, with attention across electrodes identified only by their 3D scalp position. It was pre-trained on 147 h of unlabelled EEG from a single corpus and evaluated with frozen linear probes on ten datasets with 1 to 64 electrodes against seven foundation models run under one protocol, and on two unseen populations. Results. Despite its small size (12.0 M parameters against 69 M for REVE) and single pre- training corpus, NOMAD-EEG outperformed all seven foundation models on EEGMMIDB mo- tor imagery (balanced accuracy 0.442), Siena seizure detection (macro F1 0.622) and Bonn seizure detection (AUROC 0.999), had the highest accuracy of the seven compared models on TUEP epilepsy diagnosis (0.640) and, after fine-tuning, the highest \k{appa} (0.635) and weighted F1 (0.814) on TUEV event classification. It was the best of five models on P300 detection in autism with an unseen eight-electrode montage (AUROC 0.718). With only 5 of 19 electrodes, its mean AUROC fell only from 0.942 to 0.891. Conclusion. Identifying electrodes by position and modelling time without patches let one small model, pre-trained on one corpus, outperform much larger EEG foundation models on seizure detection, epileptiform event classification, epilepsy diagnosis and motor imagery.

AI.tldr: NOMAD-EEG: 一个 12M 参数的扩散式 EEG 基础模型，通过按 3D 头皮位置识别电极、用状态空间层沿时间建模（不用 patch），实现对电极数量、身份、顺序和输入长度的独立，在多个任务上超过更大的 EEG 基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型普遍绑定训练时的通道集合与输入长度，而真实 EEG 的导联方式、通道数、记录时长差异极大，限制了模型的泛化与部署。
AI.method: NOMAD-EEG 为 12.0M 参数扩散模型，沿时间交替使用状态空间层（不使用 patch 切分），跨电极使用注意力机制且电极仅以 3D 头皮位置标识；在单一语料 147 小时无标签 EEG 上预训练；用冻结线性探针在 10 个数据集（1–64 电极）上与 7 个基础模型统一协议对比，并在两个未见人群上评测。
AI.result: 虽参数仅 12.0M（REVE 为 69M）且仅用单语料预训练，NOMAD-EEG 在 EEGMMIDB 运动想象（平衡准确率 0.442）、Siena 癫痫检测（macro F1 0.622）、Bonn 癫痫检测（AUROC 0.999）上超过全部 7 个模型；TUEP 癫痫诊断准确率最高（0.640）；TUEV 事件分类微调后 kappa（0.635）与加权 F1（0.814）最高；在自闭症 P300 检测的未见 8 电极导联上为 5 个模型中最佳（AUROC 0.718）；仅用 19 电极中的 5 个时，平均 AUROC 仅从 0.942 降至 0.891。
AI.conclusion: 以位置标识电极并对时间做无 patch 建模，使一个小模型在单一语料上预训练即可在癫痫检测、癫痫样事件分类、癫痫诊断和运动想象任务上超过更大的 EEG 基础模型。

title: Kronecker-Structured Video Completion with Cross-Fitted Self-Supervised Residual Learning
summary: Tube-wise video completion reconstructs temporal trajectories at spatial locations unobserved in every frame. We propose a two-stage framework combining regularized masked Kronecker product decomposition (KPD) with cross-fitted self-supervised residual learning. First, we estimate a compact structural backbone directly from observed entries using cyclic component-wise least-squares updates, spatial and temporal factor regularization, and regularizer-optimal scale balancing. The exact updates yield a nonincreasing objective. Second, we address the mismatch between in-sample fitting errors and the prediction errors encountered at missing tubes. We partition observed tubes into folds and construct residual targets using backbone models fitted without the corresponding target tubes. A lightweight 3-D convolutional neural network then predicts corrections from the backbone, visible residual context, observation mask, and local detail features. Exact data consistency preserves observed measurements. Experiments include ablations, sensitivity analysis, grayscale and RGB video completion, and structured missing patterns. Our method achieves the highest mean PSNR and SSIM at the higher tested sampling rates on the grayscale benchmark. On eight selected DAVIS RGB sequences, it achieves the highest mean missing-region PSNR and full-frame SSIM and the lowest mean missing-tube temporal-gradient MAE at every evaluated sampling rate.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段管状(tube-wise)视频补全框架：先用正则化掩码Kronecker积分解(KPD)估计紧凑结构主干，再用交叉拟合自监督残差学习(轻量3D CNN)修正缺失管区域的预测误差。
AI.motivation: 管状视频补全需重建在所有帧中均未观测空间位置的时间轨迹。核心难点：样本内拟合误差与缺失管处实际预测误差之间存在不匹配(mismatch)，单纯低秩/分解拟合无法保证缺失区域泛化。
AI.method: 阶段一：由观测条目直接做KPD，采用循环分量最小二乘更新、时空因子正则及正则项最优尺度平衡，更新精确且目标函数非增。阶段二：将观测管分折，用不含目标管的子模型构造残差目标，训练轻量3D CNN，从主干、可见残差上下文、观测掩码与局部细节特征预测修正；并施加精确数据一致性保持观测值。
AI.result: 在灰度基准较高采样率下取得最高平均PSNR与SSIM；在8个DAVIS RGB序列上，各采样率下均取得最高缺失区域PSNR、全帧SSIM及最低缺失管时间梯度MAE。含消融、敏感性分析、灰度/RGB及结构化缺失模式实验。
AI.conclusion: 结构主干+交叉拟合自监督残差修正的两阶段设计可有效弥合拟合与预测误差差距，在灰度与RGB视频补全上优于对比方法，且保持数据一致性。

title: Conversational Generalized Linear Bandits with Hybrid Feedback
summary: Conversational bandits improve recommendations by actively querying users about key-terms to elicit their item preferences. However, existing methods typically assume homogeneous feedback for items and key-terms, using either absolute rewards or pairwise comparisons. In practice, item feedback often takes the form of clicks or ratings, while comparisons are more natural for key-terms. To address this gap, we study conversational generalized linear bandits with hybrid feedback, combining absolute item rewards and relative key-term comparisons. We propose Conversational UCB with Hybrid Feedback (HyConUCB), which constructs unified confidence bounds from heterogeneous feedback and adaptively selects key-term comparisons by balancing information gain and directional coverage. Through a refined regret analysis that jointly exploits both feedback sources, we establish a regret bound that improves upon reward-only and adapted dueling-only benchmarks. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 提出混合反馈对话式广义线性bandit（HyConUCB）：物品用绝对奖励、关键术语用相对比较，统一构造置信界并自适应选择比较，理论上得到优于仅奖励/仅比较基准的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式bandit方法假设物品与关键术语反馈同质，只使用绝对奖励或只使用成对比较；而实际中物品反馈常为点击/评分，关键术语反馈更自然的是比较，缺乏统一处理混合反馈的框架。
AI.method: 研究带混合反馈的对话式广义线性bandit，融合物品绝对奖励与关键术语相对比较；提出HyConUCB算法，从异质反馈构造统一置信界，并依据信息增益与方向覆盖的权衡自适应选择要查询的关键术语比较。
AI.result: 改进的遗憾分析同时利用两种反馈来源，所得遗憾界优于仅奖励和改造后的仅dueling（比较）基线；合成与真实数据集实验验证了算法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 混合反馈建模更贴合实际推荐场景，统一置信界与自适应比较选择能有效提升对话式推荐的样本效率与遗憾表现。

title: MemVLN: Streaming Episodic Memory for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through 3D environments. Maintaining persistent episodic memory remains a challenge for VLM-based streaming agents in long-horizon navigation. We present MEMVLN, a streaming episodic memory framework that maintains a bounded bank of compressed perceptual features annotated with timesteps and action-derived relative poses, and produces compact memory tokens via cross-attention. We pair the proposed memory with a frozen pretrained geometry encoder. To learn the memory module, we design a masking-based trajectory summarization task with multi-granularity sub-trajectory decomposition, encouraging route reconstruction exclusively from episodic memory. Under navigation training restricted to the official R2R/RxR trajectories, MEMVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics on standard VLN-CE benchmarks. Long-horizon analyses further characterize when episodic memory is useful. For physical evaluation, we collect 30 instruction-conditioned episodes in one physical scene, use 24 as demonstrations for post-training, and hold out six for testing. On the held-out episodes, MEMVLN improves success over the VLM baseline from 17% to 40%, and post-training further raises it to 47%.

AI.tldr: MEMVLN 是一个面向长时程视觉语言导航（VLN）的流式情景记忆框架，通过有界压缩感知特征库与掩码轨迹摘要任务学习记忆模块，在 VLN-CE 基准上取得多数指标 SOTA，并在真实场景中将成功率从 17% 提升至 47%。
AI.motivation: 基于 VLM 的流式智能体在长时程 3D 导航中难以维持持久的情景记忆，导致历史信息丢失、路线重建能力不足。
AI.method: 构建带时间步与动作导出相对位姿的有界压缩感知特征记忆库，经交叉注意力生成紧凑记忆 token，与冻结的预训练几何编码器配合；设计掩码式轨迹摘要任务并做多粒度子轨迹分解，迫使模型仅依赖情景记忆重建路线；训练仅使用官方 R2R/RxR 轨迹。
AI.result: 在标准 VLN-CE 基准多数指标上达 SOTA；长时程分析刻画了记忆有用性的条件；真实场景 30 条指令情节中，留出 6 条测试，成功率由 VLM 基线 17% 提升至 40%，后训练后达 47%。
AI.conclusion: 有界流式情景记忆结合掩码轨迹摘要自监督学习，可有效支撑长时程 VLN，并在仿真与真实环境中均带来显著性能提升。

title: InterQ-RL: Interaction-Aware Correction of Execution Mismatch in Quantized Agentic RL
summary: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning (RL) relies on long closed-loop rollouts, making generation and KV-cache costs a major bottleneck. Quantized rollout reduces these costs, but its low-precision executor also serves as the behavior policy and can induce execution mismatch with the learner. Existing quantized-RL methods are designed primarily for single-turn generation. They align the learner forward with quantized rollout or correct the current-token rollout-learner ratio, without modeling the policy history that produces each agent state. Even after quantization alignment, residual rollout-learner mismatch accumulates along the state-reaching policy history, so a current action may look locally aligned despite a mismatched history. We introduce InterQ-RL (Interaction-aware Quantized Reinforcement Learning) to correct this post-alignment mismatch. It applies bounded execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history, allocates correction strength across action segments by effective support under a fixed displacement budget, and requires no additional model forward pass. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones from 4B to 30B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with all quantized arms sharing the same rollout with 8-bit weights, activations, and KV cache (W8A8-KV8). Across four environment-backbone settings, InterQ-RL achieves the strongest quantized endpoint result, matching BF16 to within 0.7 points and exceeding it in two settings. It matches or exceeds the learning speed of alignment alone while avoiding its late performance regression.

AI.tldr: InterQ-RL 针对多轮智能体量化 rollout 中"量化执行器即行为策略"导致的回放-学习不匹配问题，提出沿状态到达策略历史进行有界前缀修正的方法，在 4B–30B 稠密与 MoE 骨干、三个环境上以 W8A8-KV8 rollout 达到与 BF16 相差 0.7 分内的量化最优结果。
AI.motivation: 多轮 agent RL 依赖长闭环 rollout，生成与 KV-cache 开销成为瓶颈；量化 rollout 虽降本，但低精度执行器同时充当行为策略，与 learner 产生执行不匹配。已有量化 RL 方法主要面向单轮生成，只对齐 learner 前向或修正当前 token 的 rollout-learner 比值，未建模产生每个 agent 状态的历史，导致即使完成量化对齐，残余不匹配仍沿状态到达历史累积，当前动作局部看似对齐而历史已偏。
AI.method: 提出 InterQ-RL（Interaction-aware Quantized RL）修正对齐后的残余不匹配：在状态到达的策略历史上施加有界执行前缀修正；在固定位移预算下按有效支撑度为各动作片段分配修正强度；方法无需额外模型前向。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上评估 4B–30B 的稠密与 MoE 骨干，所有量化组共享同一套 8-bit 权重、激活与 KV cache（W8A8-KV8）rollout。
AI.result: 四个环境-骨干设置中，InterQ-RL 取得最强量化端点结果，与 BF16 差距在 0.7 分以内，并在两个设置中超过 BF16；学习速度与仅做对齐的方法持平或更快，同时避免其后期性能回退。
AI.conclusion: 多轮 agent 量化 RL 的关键不只是当前步的量化对齐，还需沿策略历史修正累积的执行不匹配；InterQ-RL 以无需额外前向的有界前缀修正，在不同规模与架构骨干上稳定逼近甚至超过 BF16 表现。

title: Blendshape Generation for Models with Disconnected Parts: Adding ARKit/MediaPipe Blendshapes to Anime-Style Character Models
summary: Blendshape generation for 3D models has been extensively researched, but very few works address generating blendshapes for models with multiple disconnected parts. We present a case study of generating fixed facial expression blendshapes for commercial anime-style 3D character models with up to 11 parts per face. To make sure that our system can handle models in a way that is agnostic to topology, we train neural networks to generate deformation fields around the input meshes. We employ at least one network to independently process each part, and the relative positions of their outputs are coordinated by having each network also process the geometry of an anchor part. We use two mechanisms to improve accuracy: having the networks predict whether the output displacement is zero or not, and classifying blendshapes into different size groups and dedicating a network to each group. We also introduce a method to improve blendshape quality by enhancing bilateral symmetry. Our method is simpler than recent neural-network-based works and solves a real problem of the user community of these models.

AI.tldr: 针对含多个断开部件的动漫风格3D角色模型，提出基于神经变形场的固定表情Blendshape生成方案，通过网络协调部件位置、零位移预测、尺寸分组和对称性增强提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有Blendshape生成研究多针对单一连通网格，几乎没有工作处理由多个断开部件组成的模型（如商用动漫风格角色，单个面部最多11个部件）。同时，此类模型的用户社区确实存在生成表情Blendshape的实际需求。
AI.method: 训练神经网络在输入网格周围生成变形场，从而与拓扑无关；至少为每个部件配一个独立网络，并让每个网络同时处理一个"锚定部件"的几何，以协调各部件输出的相对位置。精度提升采用两种机制：预测输出位移是否为零，以及按Blendshape尺寸分组、每组专用一个网络。另引入增强左右对称性以提升质量的方法。
AI.result: 在最多11个部件/面部的商用动漫风格3D角色模型上完成案例研究，成功生成固定表情Blendshape；所提机制提升精度，对称性增强改善质量；方法在结构上比近期神经网络方法更简单。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以更简洁的架构解决了多部件模型Blendshape生成的真实问题，验证了锚定部件协调与分组策略的有效性，为拓扑无关的多部件形变生成提供了可行方案。

title: Inference Latency-Aware Tsetlin Machine Training
comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Symposium on the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM)
summary: The Tsetlin Machine (TM) is a logic-based machine learning model well suited to low-latency inference on resource-constrained edge devices. Because each clause is an AND over Boolean literals, both the literals and their associated Tsetlin Automaton (TA) actions can be represented at the bit level, enabling bitwise evaluation and an early exit that is triggered as soon as any included literal evaluates to zero, forcing the clause output to zero. In this work, we study how the two TM training hyperparameters, T and s, govern both classification accuracy and inference latency. Building on the inversely proportional T-s relationship along which accuracy is nearly constant, we find that inference latency is reduced primarily by increasing s; rather than exhaustively searching the (T, s) grid at high training cost, we propose a directed search strategy that treats accuracy as a constraint and advances toward larger s to reduce inference latency within a fixed evaluation budget. Experimental results on the gem5 simulator with an ARM processor show that, for certain datasets, the search is able to increase s while preserving the baseline accuracy, thereby reducing inference latency at negligible accuracy cost: across six datasets, the method reduces inference latency by up to 16.34%, while some datasets exhibit an accuracy reduction of only 0.06%. The proposed strategy requires far fewer configuration evaluations than an exhaustive grid search.

AI.tldr: 研究T和s两个超参数如何影响Tsetlin Machine的精度与推理延迟，提出以精度为约束、定向增大s的搜索策略，在gem5+ARM上六个数据集最多降低推理延迟16.34%。
AI.motivation: TM适合边缘设备低延迟推理，叶子字面量与TA动作可用比特级表示并支持提前退出；但训练超参数T、s对精度和推理延迟的作用缺乏系统理解，而穷举网格搜索训练代价过高。
AI.method: 基于精度近似恒定的T-s反比关系，分析延迟主要由增大s降低；据此提出定向搜索策略：把精度视为约束，朝更大s推进以降低推理延迟，在固定评估预算内完成；在gem5模拟器+ARM处理器上验证。
AI.result: 六个数据集上推理延迟最多降低16.34%，部分数据集精度仅下降0.06%；相比穷举网格搜索所需配置评估次数大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: 增大s是降低TM推理延迟的有效杠杆，精度约束下的定向搜索可在可忽略精度损失下显著减延迟并节省调参成本。

title: Improving VLMs on Scientific Chart Analysis via Autonomous Evolution
summary: Understanding and operating with scientific charts is a standard approach in data analysis, and while humans are good at interpreting such charts, open vision-language models (VLMs) are known to perform poorly when it comes to question answering based on such data types. Motivated by an initial observation that many of their errors are due to inexact answering, we raise the following natural question: how much accuracy can we recover without changing the model at all? In this paper, we study this question by searching over inference programs and the code around a "frozen" version of the model. Using ideas from autonomous evolution (famously used in AlphaEvolve), we first start from a baseline inference program, and in each round we show an LLM judge the code together with a few failures on training questions, and ask for an improving evolutionary move. As usual in autonomous evolution approaches, the candidate programs are kept in a small pool ranked by training accuracy, and the next edit is performed on top-scorers from this pool. We run this approach on three VLMs and four popular benchmarks on scientific charts, and we measure the fraction of descriptive questions whose answer exactly matches the ground truth. The accuracy improves in all experimental settings. On average, it rises from 16.6% with the starting program to 41.3% with the evolved one, and the largest single increase is 55.2 percentage points. As a side benefit, our evolved program is 3.8x faster than the starting program, because short answers are easier to grade and faster to generate. Our results demonstrate that a large part of the observed errors arise due to the inference pipeline, and that optimizing it can improve the "frozen" VLM without the need to retrain it.

AI.tldr: 通过自主进化（AlphaEvolve式）搜索推理程序和代码，在不改动模型权重的前提下显著提升开放VLM在科学图表问答上的准确率。
AI.motivation: 开放视觉语言模型在科学图表问答上表现很差，但初步观察发现许多错误源于"答案不够精确"（inexact answering），因此提出问题：完全不改模型，能恢复多少准确率？即探索推理流程而非模型本身是否是误差主要来源。
AI.method: 以"冻结"模型为基础，对推理程序和其周边代码进行搜索。借用自主进化思想：从基线推理程序出发，每轮让LLM评判器查看代码及若干训练问题上的失败案例，请求一个改进的"进化动作"；候选程序保存在按训练准确率排序的小型池中，下一代编辑在池中高分程序上进行。在3个VLM和4个科学图表基准上测试，度量描述性问题答案与标准答案精确匹配的比例。
AI.result: 所有实验设置下准确率均提升，平均从起始程序的16.6%升至进化后的41.3%，单次最大提升达55.2个百分点；进化后的程序还比起始程序快3.8倍（因短答案更易评分、生成更快）。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的错误很大一部分来自推理流程本身，优化推理管线即可提升"冻结"VLM而无需重新训练。

title: Shared Context, Separate Engines: Streaming Vision--Language Inference on Edge SoCs
summary: Edge SoCs pack CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, yet vision--language model (VLM) runtimes keep generation on one engine and leave the others idle. Streaming VLMs expose further parallelism: new frames arrive while earlier queries are still being answered. Engines differ in compute and memory access and contend when they co-run, so no single placement of stages wins across SoCs and workloads. Backend-local KV state keeps other engines from continuing the work. \name coordinates heterogeneous accelerators to execute stateful VLM inference concurrently. It separates a stream's versioned context from each engine's KV state, so any engine can continue the stream by reusing, importing, or reconstructing that state. Stateful Streaming Generation ingests new frames on one engine while another answers, and Concurrent Sequence Generation serves different ready requests in parallel.
