State-aware dispatch sends each request to the engine expected to finish it first. Each answer reads a fixed, published version of its history and matches its serial reference. \name beats the strongest single-engine baselines on Apple M4 Max, Rockchip RK3588, and Qualcomm QCS6490, even when they reuse context. On two RK3588 video streams, it delivers $19.6\%$ more throughput than the best single engine with context reuse and $27.2\%$ more than parallel engines without shared state. Cross-engine KV import cuts first-token latency by a factor of $4.6$ over prefix recomputation. Stateful Streaming Generation delivers up to $2.48\times$ the throughput of serial execution, and state-aware dispatch cuts query completion time by up to $72.7\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出 \name 系统，协调异构加速器（CPU/GPU/NPU）并发执行有状态 VLM 推理，通过分离版本化上下文与引擎本地 KV 状态实现跨引擎状态迁移，在多种边缘 SoC 上显著超越单引擎基线。
AI.motivation: 边缘 SoC 同时集成 CPU、GPU、NPU，但现有 VLM 运行时只把生成放在单一引擎上，其余引擎闲置；流式 VLM 中帧到达与历史查询存在天然并行性。然而各引擎计算与访存特性不同、共同运行时会资源争抢，且后端本地 KV 状态阻碍其他引擎接管工作，因此不存在适用于所有 SoC 与负载的单一阶段放置方案。
AI.method: \name 将流的版本化上下文与各引擎的 KV 状态解耦，任何引擎可通过复用、导入或重建状态继续该流。包含三项机制：Stateful Streaming Generation（一个引擎处理新帧、另一引擎同时作答）；Concurrent Sequence Generation（多个就绪请求并行服务）；State-aware dispatch（把请求派给预计最先完成的引擎）。每个答案读取固定已发布的上下文版本，保证与串行参考结果一致。
AI.result: 在 Apple M4 Max、Rockchip RK3588、Qualcomm QCS6490 上均优于最强单引擎基线（即使基线启用上下文复用）。RK3588 双视频流下，吞吐比最佳单引擎（含上下文复用）高 19.6%，比无共享状态的并行引擎高 27.2%；跨引擎 KV 导入使首 token 延迟降至前缀重算的 1/4.6；Stateful Streaming Generation 最高达串行执行的 2.48× 吞吐；state-aware dispatch 将查询完成时间缩短至多 72.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨引擎 KV 状态迁移与感知状态的调度，可充分挖掘边缘异构 SoC 的并行能力，在保证结果一致性的前提下大幅提升流式 VLM 推理的吞吐与延迟表现。

title: CoPE-CGL: Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Replay-Free Continual Graph Learning
comment: Extended version with appendices. 18 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables
summary: Continual graph learning (CGL) maintains models as graphs evolve without retraining from scratch, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods typically target either transductive or inductive settings and often store past subgraphs or require task identifiers at inference. We propose Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Continual Graph Learning (CoPE-CGL), a replay-free framework that uses a parameter-free structural prior, precomputed by multi-hop Laplacian smoothing, to anchor learning, memory, and inference. CoPE-CGL combines topology-infused bottleneck adaptation, community-level prototypes, and dynamic routing by majority vote over node-to-prototype matches. The default protocol assumes each test graph comes from one learned task; a node-level variant handles mixed-task graphs. Each task adds at most a constant amount of storage, with no past graph data retained. At equal storage and without task identifiers, CoPE-CGL matches the strongest replay baseline even when it receives true task identifiers: average performance (AP) is 95.17% and 95.72% versus 94.28% and 95.82% on Arxiv and CoraFull, respectively, with 5.9-14.0 times faster runtime and zero forgetting. Across four transductive and three inductive benchmarks and mixed streams, CoPE-CGL exceeds the second-best of up to eleven baselines by up to 1.41, 6.32, and 9.33 AP percentage points, respectively. It runs 1.3-7.9 times faster end-to-end than the most accurate competitor on each benchmark and scales to the largest benchmark graph. On graphs mixing two tasks, its node-level variant achieves the best AP among CGL methods. The design targets homophilic graphs with community structure.

AI.tldr: CoPE-CGL 是一个免回放的持续图学习框架，用多跳拉普拉斯平滑预计算的无参数结构先验来锚定学习、记忆与推理，实现零遗忘、低存储且无需任务标识。
AI.motivation: 现有持续图学习方法通常只针对直推或归纳单一场景，且常需存储历史子图或推理时依赖任务标识，存储与遗忘代价高。
AI.method: 提出社区感知原型提取（CoPE-CGL）：结合拓扑注入的瓶颈适配、社区级原型，以及基于节点-原型匹配多数投票的动态路由；默认协议假设测试图来自单一已学任务，并提供节点级变体处理混合任务图；每任务仅增加常数存储，不回放旧图。
AI.result: 等存储且无任务标识下，Arxiv 与 CoraFull 的 AP 为 95.17%/95.72%，对比最强回放基线 94.28%/95.82%（后者甚至使用真实任务标识），运行快 5.9–14.0 倍且零遗忘；在4个直推、3个归纳基准及混合流上分别最高超出次优基线 1.41、6.32、9.33 个 AP 百分点，端到端快 1.3–7.9 倍，可扩展至最大基准图；混合两任务图上节点级变体在 CGL 方法中 AP 最佳。
AI.conclusion: CoPE-CGL 以无参结构先验替代回放，实现免回放、免任务标识、常数存储的持续图学习，性能匹配或超越强基线且显著更快，但设计面向具有社区结构的同配图。

title: Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition
summary: Test-Time Prompt Tuning (TPT) adapts large pretrained models to unseen target distribution shifts by updating only lightweight prompt tokens. Existing TPT methods are effective, but they mainly optimize each prompt update locally. Across test-time steps, prompts updated at the current step are reused for the corresponding predictions and updates, so noisy or biased unlabeled objectives can accumulate and destabilize the prompt-update trajectory. We identify two failure modes: magnitude expansion, where updates move the prompt too far, and directional drift, where consecutive updates point in inconsistent directions. To analyze and control these failures, we propose Test-Time Prompt-Agnostic Decomposition ($\mathtt{TPD}$), which characterizes observed prompt-update trajectories from a dynamical-systems view and decomposes base prompt updates into magnitude and direction. $\mathtt{TPD}$ computes a spectral radius to measure update expansion and decomposes update directions into persistent, oscillatory, and residual components. Building on this decomposition, Adaptive Koopman Control ($\mathtt{AKC}$) regulates update magnitude by shrinking updates under expansive recent dynamics, while Hankel Update Router ($\mathtt{HUR}$) refines update direction by preserving persistent components and suppressing oscillatory and residual components. Together, $\mathtt{AKC}$ and $\mathtt{HUR}$ produce a stabilized prompt update. As a prompt-agnostic framework, $\mathtt{TPD}$ can be plugged into visual and text TPT methods without modifying the backbone, prompt architecture, or adaptation loss. Experiments on 15 datasets show that $\mathtt{TPD}$ consistently improves 10 baselines, with accuracy gains of $3$--$8\%$ for visual prompts and over $2\%$ for text prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出测试时提示分解框架TPD，从动力学系统视角分解提示更新为幅度与方向，用AKC和HUR分别控制幅度膨胀与方向漂移，稳定提示更新轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时提示调优（TPT）方法逐步本地优化提示，当前步更新的提示直接用于后续预测与更新，导致噪声或有偏的无监督目标累积，引发两种失效模式：幅度膨胀（更新过远）与方向漂移（连续更新方向不一致），使提示更新轨迹不稳定。
AI.method: TPD将观测到的提示更新轨迹从动力学系统视角分解为基础提示更新的幅度与方向：计算谱半径衡量更新扩张程度，并将更新方向分解为持续、振荡与残差分量。基于此，自适应Koopman控制（AKC）在近期动态呈扩张性时收缩更新以调节幅度；Hankel更新路由器（HUR）保留持续分量、抑制振荡与残差分量以精炼方向。二者联合产生稳定的提示更新。TPD为提示无关框架，可即插即用于视觉与文本TPT方法，无需改动骨干、提示架构或适配损失。
AI.result: 在15个数据集上，TPD一致提升10个基线方法；视觉提示准确率提升3–8%，文本提示提升超过2%。
AI.conclusion: 将提示更新轨迹视为动力学系统并分解为幅度与方向进行控制，是一种有效且模型无关的稳定化测试时提示调优方案，可广泛兼容现有TPT方法。

title: Should Pseudo-Labels Share Mini-Batches with Labeled Examples? Semi-Supervised Continual Active Learning with Limited Training Cost
summary: Active learning (AL) reduces annotation by querying informative examples. Continual active learning (CAL) also cuts the training cost, the total number of gradient steps, by training one model across AL rounds with a fixed number of mini-batch steps per round. Pseudo-labels add supervision without annotation, but they increase training cost. In CAL, where every round trains on a fixed number of mini-batches, whether and how pseudo-labeled examples should share these mini-batches with labeled examples is therefore open. We provide the first formalization of this problem as two decisions after each query, namely (i) which unlabeled examples should enter training with a pseudo-label and (ii) what share of each mini-batch they should take. Our method, semi-supervised continual active learning (SSCAL), works with any acquisition function. It admits pseudo-labels based on distances from unlabeled examples to labeled neighbors, caps their share, and reweights the loss on labeled examples to keep their expected gradient contribution unchanged. On frozen embeddings, its pseudo-labeler updates incrementally without extra model forward passes. Across two audio datasets, two frozen encoders, six acquisition functions and ten seeds, SSCAL ranks first on average among four protocols with equal training steps, answering the question affirmatively.

AI.tldr: 本文首次形式化半监督持续主动学习（SSCAL）问题，即在每轮固定mini-batch训练量下决定哪些无标注样本以伪标签进入训练、以及伪标签样本在mini-batch中的占比，并给出无需额外前向传播的可行方案。
AI.motivation: 持续主动学习（CAL）通过每轮固定训练步数降低训练成本，伪标签可在无标注情况下增加监督，但会增加训练开销。在CAL每轮仅训练固定数量mini-batch的约束下，伪标签样本是否及如何与有标注样本共享这些mini-batch尚无研究，本文对此问题首次形式化。
AI.method: 提出SSCAL，兼容任意采集函数。基于无标注样本到有标注近邻的距离生成伪标签，对伪标签样本在mini-batch中的占比设上限，并对有标注样本的损失重新加权，使有标注样本的期望梯度贡献保持不变；在冻结嵌入上，伪标签器可增量更新，无需额外模型前向传播。
AI.result: 在2个音频数据集、2种冻结编码器、6种采集函数、10个随机种子上，在训练步数相同的4种协议中，SSCAL平均排名第一，正面回答了伪标签样本应参与训练这一问题。
AI.conclusion: 在等训练成本约束下，将伪标签样本按受控占比纳入CAL的mini-batch可稳定提升效果，SSCAL为半监督持续主动学习提供了通用且低开销的解决方案。

title: Uncertainty Evaluation to Support Safety of the Intended Functionality Analysis for Determining the Applicability of Performance Targets Across Triggering Conditions in ML-Based LiDAR Object Detection
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. Extended version of the VEHITS 2026 conference paper (doi:10.5220/0014967200004030). Submitted for journal publication. Code and recorded results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23495356
summary: For safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) analysis according to ISO 21448, a machine learning object detector for light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds can meet a performance target, a limit on the mean per-frame share of wrong detections among accepted detections, by rejecting detections above an uncertainty threshold. A threshold selected on data of one condition carries a statistical guarantee only for data distributed like its selection data, whereas SOTIF analysis covers every triggering condition. This paper presents an uncertainty evaluation in which the threshold is transferred into a triggering condition, a test decides at a stated error probability whether the target is applicable there, not applicable or not determined, and a lower bound counts the independent units an applicable outcome requires. For PointPillars ensembles on KITTI and nuScenes, counted in recorded sequences, as the dependence between frames requires, neither dataset held enough independent units for any target limit, and no transfer had a not applicable outcome. Counted in frames, the same data gave not applicable outcomes at limits fixed in advance after transfers into far distance, into rain and between two separately trained detectors, thresholds that met the target limit after a transfer rejected most correct detections, and in rain the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve did not decrease. A performance target met under one condition therefore counts as evidence under a triggering condition only after a test there, reported with its share of accepted correct detections and its number of independent recorded sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文将ISO 21448 SOTIF分析中的不确定性阈值视为"可迁移性"问题：把一个条件下选定的阈值转移到某个触发条件后，用统计检验判定目标限制是否适用（适用/不适用/无法判定），并按独立记录序列计数给出下界。
AI.motivation: 按ISO 21448做SOTIF分析时，LiDAR点云目标检测器通常靠"拒绝高于不确定性阈值的检测"来满足性能目标（可接受检测中错误检测的平均每帧占比上限）。但阈值在某条件下选定，其统计保证只对该分布的数据成立，而SOTIF要覆盖所有触发条件——因此需要一种量化阈值迁移有效性的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出不确定性评估流程：①把阈值表述为一个触发条件；②在该条件下做检验，以给定错误概率输出"目标适用/不适用/无法判定"三种结论；③给出一个下界，用于统计适用结论所需的独立单元数。实验用PointPillars集成模型在KITTI与nuScenes上验证，并对比按帧计数与按记录序列计数两种方式，另做了远距离、雨天、以及两个独立训练检测器之间的阈值迁移。
AI.result: 按记录序列（体现帧间依赖）计数时，两个数据集对任何目标限值都没有足够的独立单元，且所有迁移都没有出现"不适用"结论；按帧计数时，同一数据在预先固定的限值下，向远距离、雨天、两个独立训练检测器之间的迁移均得到"不适用"结论。此外，满足目标限制的阈值在迁移后拒绝了大部分正确检测；而雨天场景下AUC并未下降。
AI.conclusion: 单条件下达成的性能目标，只有在目标触发条件下经过检验后，才算作该条件下的证据；报告时须同时给出可接受正确检测的占比和独立记录序列数目，否则结论可能被帧级计数严重高估。

title: OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. We further establish OneEEG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating current MLLMs and our method on multi-task EEG understanding. Experiments show that existing MLLMs have limited ability to interpret EEG inputs, while OneEEG achieves stronger performance by integrating numerical and visual EEG representations with task-aware EEG-to-LLM projection. Extensive ablations and analyses further reveal the effects of visual EEG renderings, MoP variants, router behavior, and feature dispersion across EEG tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出OneEEG统一EEG-MLLM框架，联合建模数值与视觉EEG表示，并用任务感知的投影器混合(MoP)对齐多任务EEG特征，同时构建OneEEG-Instruct数据集与OneEEG-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: EEG广泛用于临床评估、脑机接口与认知状态分析，但EEG建模在不同任务范式间高度碎片化；现有MLLM虽具灵活多模态推理能力，对EEG输入的理解仍然有限。
AI.method: 构建多任务EEG指令微调数据集OneEEG-Instruct进行训练；同时处理数值EEG与视觉EEG渲染表示；引入任务感知的Mixture of Projectors(MoP)，将不同任务族的异构EEG特征对齐到LLM嵌入空间。
AI.result: 在自建OneEEG-Bench上，现有MLLM解读EEG能力有限，而OneEEG通过融合数值与视觉表示及任务感知投影取得更强性能；消融与分析揭示了视觉渲染、MoP变体、路由器行为及跨任务特征离散度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 数值+视觉EEG表示结合任务感知EEG-to-LLM投影是提升多任务EEG理解的有效路径，为统一EEG建模范式提供了数据、方法与评测基础。

title: Understanding and Repairing Cooperative Perception under Adverse Weather
summary: A cooperative 3D detector can miss a vehicle even when the LiDAR points on it remain unchanged. We study this failure under adverse weather as Weather-Induced Context Interference. To our knowledge, this is the first controlled study of how weather-related exterior changes remove cooperative benefits while preserving all points inside annotated objects. Controlled experiments on simulated and real roadside inputs show that exterior loss changes object representations before fusion and removes previously useful assistance. On real inputs, restoring object-neighborhood features recovers 30 of 31 induced failures; three equal-area exterior controls recover none. The failure condition also appears with a second fusion model. These findings motivate Adverse-Weather Cooperative Repair (AWCR), with separate implementations for the available supervision. Point Classifier filters added weather returns in simulation. On real inputs, Local Correction refines candidates and Quality Selection checks them against current measurements, without naturally paired clear/adverse-weather recordings. Candidate tracing shows that correction supplies accurate geometry for some targets that original candidates cannot localize at the evaluation threshold. On natural adverse-weather CoInfra development data, AWCR improves car bird's-eye-view (BEV) AP@0.7 by 4.66 points with V2X-ViT and 5.56 with AttFuse. On simulated V2X-R fog, it improves vehicle BEV AP@0.7 by 4.47 points at a fixed 4,096-candidate budget.

AI.tldr: 论文首次系统研究"天气诱发上下文干扰"：在物体点云不变时，仅外部环境变化即可导致协同3D检测漏检；并据此提出恶劣天气协同修复AWCR方法。
AI.motivation: 协同3D检测本应带来互补增益，但作者观察到即使标注物体上的LiDAR点完全不变，车辆仍可能被漏检。作者将其归因于恶劣天气引起的外部环境变化破坏了物体表示与协同增益，并希望首次通过控制实验刻画这一失效机制。
AI.method: 在仿真与真实路侧输入上做控制实验：仅改变物体邻域（外部）特征而保持物体内部点不变，验证失效；再通过恢复邻域特征进行反证，并设置等面积外部对照；在第二个融合模型上复现。基于发现提出AWCR：仿真中用点分类器过滤新增天气回波；真实场景中用局部校正细化候选、质量选择对照当前测量校验，无需自然配对的晴/恶劣天气录制。
AI.result: 真实输入中，恢复物体邻域特征修复了31例诱导失效中的30例，而三个等面积外部对照均无法修复；失效条件在第二个融合模型上同样出现。AWCR在CoInfra真实恶劣天气开发集上使车辆BEV AP@0.7提升4.66（V2X-ViT）和5.56（AttFuse）个点；仿真V2X-R雾场景下在固定4096候选预算时提升4.47个点。
AI.conclusion: 天气导致的外部上下文变化会在融合前改变物体表示并消除协同辅助收益，是一种独立于点云完整性的失效模式；AWCR通过过滤、局部校正与质量选择有效缓解该问题，且在真实与仿真场景、多种融合模型上均有一致提升。

title: Benchmarking uncertainty quantification for engineering regression under graded distribution shift
summary: Machine learning models in engineering are often used beyond their training conditions, where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) matters most. Existing comparisons of regression UQ methods rely on random splits, which assess calibration only in distribution. We introduce a three-rung shift ladder (in distribution, soft shift and hard shift) built along physically meaningful shift variables, and evaluate 12 methods from five families on seven public engineering datasets: five extrapolation settings, an unseen turbofan fault mode and a winter air-quality sensor deployment. All tuning uses source data only. In distribution, conformal methods cover at least 0.946 of test points on every dataset. Under hard shift, mean coverage falls to 0.40-0.75 across the 11 methods that always return an interval, and no systematic difference in method ranks is detected (Friedman p = 0.63). Weighted conformalised quantile regression stays near nominal on the points it answers, but abstains on 85\% of hard-shift points on average and covers only 0.67 of the few Concrete points it answers. Source-validation gains predict improvement in distribution and under soft shift, but not under hard shift (Spearman's rho = 0.04). Engineering evaluations should split calibration data by deployment unit, report subgroup coverage and sharpness, and treat abstention as an explicit operational outcome.

AI.tldr: 该文构建三级分布偏移阶梯，用仅在源数据上调参的方式评测5类共12种回归不确定性量化方法在7个工程数据集上的表现，发现分布内与硬偏移下的校准差距巨大、方法排名几无差异。
AI.motivation: 工程机器学习模型常被用于训练条件之外的场景，而现有回归UQ方法的比较多依赖随机划分，只评估分布内校准，无法反映真正关键的偏移条件下的可靠性。
AI.method: 沿具有物理意义的偏移变量构建三级偏移阶梯（分布内、软偏移、硬偏移），在7个公开工程数据集上评测5个方法族的12种方法，含5个外推设定、未见涡扇故障模式、冬季空气质量传感器部署；全部调参仅用源数据，并以Friedman检验、Spearman相关等做统计分析。
AI.result: 分布内符合性方法在每个数据集上覆盖率至少0.946；硬偏移下，11种始终给出区间的方法平均覆盖率降至0.40–0.75，方法排名无明显系统差异（Friedman p=0.63）；加权符合性分位数回归在其作答点上接近名义水平，但平均对85%的硬偏移点弃答，且在Concrete数据上仅答的少数点覆盖率0.67；源验证上的增益可预测分布内和软偏移下的改善，但对硬偏移无预测力（Spearman rho=0.04）。
AI.conclusion: 工程UQ评估应按部署单元划分校准数据、报告子组覆盖率与锐度，并将弃答视为显式的运行结果；随机划分下的良好校准不能外推到硬偏移场景。

title: Domain-Adapted Latent Diffusion Models for CT-to-PET Image Translation
summary: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) provides important metabolic information for tumor detection and staging but remains significantly less accessible than Computed Tomography (CT) due to its high cost, infrastructure requirements, and reliance on injected radioactive tracers. CT-to-PET image translation using generative models aims to address this disparity, yet state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods are limited by the scarcity of paired training data. To overcome this, we propose a domain-adapted latent diffusion framework that transfers natural-image priors using a relatively small dataset of 21,930 paired CT/PET slices, incorporating a signed power transform to resolve extreme intensity sparsity in PET data. Compared to CPDM, a state-ofthe-art baseline for CT-to-PET image translation, our approach yields superior performance in pixel-wise reconstruction and localized tumor fidelity, demonstrating effective transfer of natural-image priors to the medical domain. We further provide a systematic analysis of evaluation metric reliability for sparse PET data, showing that standard full-image metrics can be misleading indicators of translated image quality, and propose background-filtered and mask-restricted metrics as more clinically meaningful alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出领域适配的潜扩散框架，用仅21,930对CT/PET切片迁移自然图像先验实现CT到PET的转换，并引入符号幂变换解决PET强度极端稀疏问题，性能优于CPDM，同时系统分析稀疏PET数据下评价指标可靠性。
AI.motivation: PET提供重要代谢信息但成本高、依赖放射性示踪剂，可及性远低于CT；CT-to-PET转换可缓解此问题，但现有基于扩散的SOTA方法受限于配对训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 领域适配的潜扩散（latent diffusion）框架，在较小数据集（21,930对CT/PET切片）上迁移自然图像先验；引入符号幂变换（signed power transform）应对PET极端强度稀疏性；并提出背景过滤与掩码限制的评价指标。
AI.result: 相比SOTA基线CPDM，在像素级重建和局部肿瘤保真度上表现更优，证明自然图像先验可有效迁移到医学领域；同时发现标准全图指标对稀疏PET的转换质量可能产生误导。
AI.conclusion: 证明了以少量配对数据适配自然图像扩散先验进行CT-to-PET转换的可行性，并强调需采用背景过滤/掩码限制等更具临床意义的评价指标来评估稀疏PET转换质量。

title: TransECG-SSL: Hybrid Self-Supervised Representation Learning for ECG Arrhythmia Classification
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
summary: Cross-dataset generalisation remains a major challenge for automated electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification because of differences in patient populations, acquisition protocols, annotation practices, and class distributions. Learning representations that remain informative across independent datasets could reduce reliance on dataset-specific labelled data. We propose TransECG-SSL, a self-supervised framework for transferable heartbeat representation learning from unlabelled ECG data. A Transformer encoder is pretrained using a hybrid objective combining masked signal reconstruction and contrastive learning, then frozen and evaluated by linear probing under patient-disjoint evaluation. Experiments across three public ECG databases and seven source--target settings show that Hybrid SSL consistently outperforms randomly initialised Transformers and achieves higher balanced accuracy than architecture-matched source-supervised pretraining. Reconstruction-only SSL remains competitive with Hybrid SSL, whereas contrastive-only pretraining performs substantially worse, highlighting the importance of masked reconstruction for transferability. Cross-dataset transfer nevertheless reduces balanced accuracy relative to target-specific self-supervised pretraining, while minority arrhythmia classes remain challenging under severe class imbalance. These findings demonstrate the potential of label-efficient self-supervised learning for cross-dataset ECG representation transfer while highlighting persistent limitations from domain shift and class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 提出TransECG-SSL自监督框架，用掩码重建+对比学习的混合目标预训练Transformer编码器，冻结后线性探针评估跨数据集心跳表示迁移，证明标签高效的SSL在跨库泛化上优于随机初始化和源域监督预训练，但仍受域偏移和类别不平衡限制。
AI.motivation: 自动心电图心律失常分类在跨数据集场景下泛化困难，原因包括人群、采集协议、标注实践和类别分布差异。作者希望学习跨独立数据集仍有信息量的表示，以减少对数据集特定标注数据的依赖。
AI.method: TransECG-SSL：在无标注ECG上预训练Transformer编码器，采用掩码信号重建与对比学习的混合自监督目标；预训练后冻结编码器，在患者不重叠（patient-disjoint）设置下用线性探针评估。实验覆盖3个公开ECG数据库、7个源-目标设置，并与随机初始化、架构匹配的源域监督预训练及重建-only、对比-only消融对比。
AI.result: 混合SSL一致优于随机初始化Transformer，平衡准确率高于架构匹配的源监督预训练；重建-only SSL与混合SSL表现相当，对比-only预训练明显更差，说明掩码重建对迁移性关键；跨数据集迁移的平衡准确率仍低于目标域特定自监督预训练，严重类别不平衡下少数心律失常类仍难识别。
AI.conclusion: 自监督学习为跨数据集ECG表示迁移提供了标签高效的可行路径，掩码重建是迁移性的核心；但域偏移与类别不平衡仍是持续存在的限制，未来需针对性改进。

title: Sexual dimorphism and sex-specific features of pediatric hand bone shapes via statistical shape modeling
summary: Understanding the envelope of shape variation encompassing both sexual dimorphism and growth-related changes in living tissue is a non-trivial task. In this work, we use statistical shape models (SSMs) and analyze demographic-stratified shape parameters to quantify sexual dimorphism and sex-specific shape changes. To this end, we developed a two-stage detection-segmentation framework that accurately segmented $n = 27664$ unique bone masks from a radiographic dataset of $n = 1456$ subjects with diverse ages and sexes (HD95 = $1.512 \pm 0.005$, ASSD $0.449 \pm 001$, Dice = $0.987 \pm 0.00004$, IoU = $0.975 \pm 0.0001$). Following SSM fitting, our follow-up analyses of stratified shape parameters highlighted the morphology of sexual dimorphisms for each bone and demonstrated sex-specific differences in shape development. Our results were consistent with existing literature and provided an unambiguous, data-driven methodology for characterizing tissue shape and its population-scale variation. This approach provides a potential methodological foundation for developing population-based models of anatomical variation and could be extended to investigate tissue growth and shape changes over time. Future work should evaluate the applicability of this methodology on alternative anatomical structures and imaging modalities, with the goal of validating these growth trajectories on longitudinal data.

AI.tldr: 该文提出两阶段检测-分割框架，从含1456名不同年龄性别受试者的放射影像中分割出27664个骨骼掩膜，并用统计形状模型(SSM)按人口学分层量化性二态性与性别特异性形状变化。
AI.motivation: 在活体组织中同时刻画性二态与生长相关变化的形状变异范围十分困难，缺乏明确、数据驱动的方法来量化组织形状及其群体尺度变异。
AI.method: 开发两阶段检测-分割框架，从放射影像数据集中提取骨骼掩膜；随后进行SSM拟合，并对分层形状参数进行后续统计分析，比较各骨骼的性二态形态及性别特异的形状发育差异。
AI.result: 分割精度很高：HD95=1.512±0.005、ASSD=0.449±0.001、Dice=0.987、IoU=0.975；SSM分析结果与现有文献一致，揭示了各骨骼性二态形态及性别特异的形状发育差异。
AI.conclusion: 提供了明确、数据驱动的组织形状及群体变异刻画方法，可作为群体解剖变异建模的方法学基础；未来需在更多解剖结构与成像模态上验证，并用纵向数据验证生长轨迹。

title: Intent-Preserving Adversarial User Simulation for Multi-Turn Agent Evaluation
summary: Multi-turn agents are commonly evaluated with LLM-based simulated users, which can be overly cooperative and can therefore overestimate an agent's performance. We here introduce StressSim, an intent-preserving adversarial user simulator framework for stress-testing agents with challenging yet valid user interactions. StressSim optimises the simulator's high-level adversarial plan for each task instance. Candidate planner prompts are evolved with a genetic prompt-optimisation loop that uses rollout traces, granular task-completion signals, and validity feedback to favour conversations that reduce task success without changing the user's underlying goal. We evaluate the approach on the MultiWOZ dataset and the retail and airline domains from tau-bench with three target LLM agents, comparing against standard simulators and hand-designed non-collaborative user behaviours. We demonstrate the effectiveness of StressSim in exposing robustness gaps across frontier LLMs, with tau-bench pass^4 scores decreasing by up to 69% on gemini-3.8-flash and 62% on gpt-5.6-sol. StressSim maintains goal preservation performance (which decreases by at most 10%), using an optimisation budget of 20 rollouts per task. Sensitivity analysis suggests that increasing the budget further decreases task success. Overall our results demonstrate that StressSim exposes robustness gaps missed by standard and hand-designed user simulators while maintaining conversation realism. This is achieved through lightweight prompt optimisation alone, without model fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 StressSim：一种保持用户意图不变的对抗性多轮用户模拟器框架，通过遗传式提示优化为每个任务实例搜索对抗性高层计划，从而在真实且有效的交互下压测智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的模拟用户过于"配合"，导致多轮智能体评测结果偏乐观、高估智能体能力，掩盖了鲁棒性缺口。
AI.method: StressSim 针对每个任务实例优化模拟器的高层对抗计划：在遗传式提示优化循环中演化候选规划器提示，利用 rollout 轨迹、细粒度任务完成信号和有效性反馈进行选择，奖励那些在"不改变用户底层目标"前提下降低任务成功率的对话。仅做轻量提示优化，无需模型微调。
AI.result: 在 MultiWOZ 及 tau-bench 的 retail、airline 域上，对三个目标 LLM 智能体评测：tau-bench pass^4 分数下降最高达 69%（gemini-3.8-flash）与 62%（gpt-5.6-sol）；目标保持性能至多下降 10%；每任务优化预算仅 20 次 rollout；敏感性分析显示增大预算可进一步降低任务成功率，且优于标准模拟器与人工设计的非协作用户行为。
AI.conclusion: StressSim 能以保持对话真实性的对抗交互暴露标准与手工设计模拟器遗漏的鲁棒性缺口，且完全依靠轻量提示优化实现，无需模型微调。

title: Temporal Slice Learning for AI-Generated Video Detection with 400$\times$ Fewer FLOPs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 18 figures. Project page: https://shangwei5.github.io/TSC-Net/
summary: Recent advances in generative video models have improved visual realism, making detection increasingly dependent on subtle temporal inconsistencies. However, these signals are weak and spatially localized, while most of the video content is redundant. This creates a fundamental mismatch: existing detectors rely on heavy backbones to model full videos, which leads to high computational cost and limited scalability. In this work, we rethink AI-generated video detection from a representation perspective. Instead of modeling entire videos, we restructure them into compact temporal slice representations that isolate informative temporal evolution. We introduce a lightweight framework using frequency-aware temporal slice consistency learning, where informative spatial rows and columns are aggregated over time to form slice-domain inputs. This reparameterization suppresses redundant appearance while preserving discriminative temporal dynamics, enabling efficient and targeted detection. By constructing slices from both high- and low-frequency regions, our method exposes complementary temporal artifacts, including unstable details and abnormal motion smoothness. We instantiate this idea in a Temporal Slice Consistency Network, which integrates task-driven slice localization, hierarchical positional encoding, and a lightweight Transformer to model cross-slice and cross-frequency dependencies. We further introduce AI-Artist, a new benchmark with artist-curated videos from recent high-fidelity generators, including Seedance and Kling. Experiments on GenVideo and AI-Artist show that our method achieves strong performance while requiring over 400$\times$ fewer model-forward FLOPs and 3.6$\times$ faster model inference than the strong video-based baseline ReStraV (2.9$\times$ faster end to end, including preprocessing), enabling scalable and practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文从表示角度重构AI生成视频检测：将整段视频压缩为紧凑的"时间切片"表示，用频域感知的时间切片一致性学习实现轻量高效检测，FLOPs比强基线低400倍以上。
AI.motivation: 生成视频的伪造线索微弱且空间局部化，而视频大部分内容是冗余的。现有检测器用重型骨干网络建模完整视频，计算代价高、难以扩展，存在根本性不匹配。
AI.method: 不提整段视频，而是把随时间聚合的信息性空间行/列组成"切片域"输入，抑制冗余外观、保留判别性时间动态。从高频与低频区域构建切片以暴露互补伪影（细节不稳定、运动过于平滑）。实例化为Temporal Slice Consistency Network：任务驱动的切片定位、分层位置编码、轻量Transformer建模跨切片与跨频率依赖。另提出AI-Artist基准（含Seedance、Kling等生成器的人工作品）。
AI.result: 在GenVideo与AI-Artist上取得强性能，模型前向FLOPs比ReStraV少400倍以上，推理快3.6倍（含预处理端到端快2.9倍）。
AI.conclusion: 通过切片化表示重参数化，可在显著降低算力与延迟的同时保持强检测性能，使AI生成视频检测更可扩展、可实际部署；并提供了更具挑战性的新基准。

title: Prior Predictive Matching for Bayesian LoRA
summary:
Bayesian variants of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provide principled uncertainty estimation when fine-tuning large foundation models, but require specifying the prior over the low-rank weight updates. We address this hyperparameter selection problem by introducing a closed-form prior-predictive estimator that operates before fine-tuning.
  We analyze a second-order expansion of the network and quantify how the low-rank prior drives function-space deviations from the pretrained outputs. We also show that these prior-predictive quantities depend on the prior only through the product of the adaptation rank and the fourth power of the prior scale. Because the training targets share a single draw of the latent weight update, we can leverage the covariance between example residuals to derive a moment-matching estimator. Furthermore, our theoretical analysis establishes that the optimal prior precision scales as $r^{-1/2}$ with the rank $r$, allowing a single estimate to generalize across all ranks.
  Controlled experiments across regression and classification tasks validate our approximation and show that our estimator recovers the true prior scale. On RoBERTa-large, our approach improves predictive negative log-likelihood (NLL) and calibration over both MAP and marginal-likelihood selection without requiring validation data, while achieving competitive out-of-distribution detection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种在微调前即可运行、闭式的先验预测估计器，用于自动选择贝叶斯LoRA的先验尺度，并在RoBERTa-large上提升NLL与校准性。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯LoRA能给出原则性的不确定性估计，但需要设定低秩权重更新上的先验，而该超参数缺乏可靠的、无需验证数据的选择方法。
AI.method: 对网络做二阶展开，量化低秩先验如何驱动函数空间偏离预训练输出；证明先验预测量仅通过"秩×先验尺度四次方"的乘积依赖于先验；利用同一潜在权重更新采样导致的样本残差协方差做矩匹配估计；理论上推出最优先验精度随秩按 r^{-1/2} 缩放。
AI.result: 回归与分类的受控实验验证了近似有效性并能恢复真实先验尺度；在RoBERTa-large上，无需验证数据即改善了预测NLL与校准，优于MAP与边际似然选择，OOD检测具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 先验尺度对贝叶斯LoRA至关重要且可被闭式估计；其秩缩放规律使单一估计可泛化到所有秩，提供了免验证集的实用超参选择方案。

title: Complexity-guided Regularization for Generalizable Human Gaussian Splatting
comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, including appendix. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Recent studies on generalizable human Gaussian splatting have achieved the notable progress in synthesizing novel views of unseen human subjects from multi-view images. Despite this progress, existing methods still struggle to represent fine-grained details of human subjects, which inherently involve high geometric and textural complexity. This is because previous methods do not impose a constraint on how densely Gaussians are placed, which often leads to blurry rendering results in complex regions. To address this problem, we propose a complexity-guided regularization scheme. The key idea is to leverage a complexity prior computed via the local entropy in geometric and textural characteristics of a clothed human. This effectively prevents Gaussians from being coarsely placed in complex regions, which facilitates the faithful reconstruction of intricate structures. Furthermore, we sample local patches predominantly from complex regions according to this complexity prior, which allows the model to be sufficiently supervised by local details. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method delivers state-of-the-art performance while maintaining the real-time inference speed in generalizable human Gaussian splatting. The code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/DCVL-3D/CGR-GS_release.

AI.tldr: 提出复杂度引导的正则化方案（CGR-GS），利用几何与纹理局部熵作为复杂度先验，约束高斯密度分布并优先采样复杂区域的局部块，从而在可泛化人体高斯泼溅中更忠实地重建细粒度结构，同时保持实时推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有可泛化人体高斯泼溅方法在多视角图像合成未见人体新视角上取得进展，但难以表达几何与纹理高度复杂的细粒度细节。原因在于先前方法对高斯的放置密集程度没有约束，在复杂区域常导致渲染模糊。
AI.method: 提出复杂度引导正则化：以穿衣人体几何与纹理特性的局部熵计算复杂度先验；据此阻止高斯在复杂区域被粗糙放置；并按该先验从复杂区域优先采样局部patch，使模型获得充分的局部细节监督。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上达到可泛化人体高斯泼溅的最先进性能（SOTA），同时保持实时推理速度。代码与模型已公开（DCVL-3D/CGR-GS_release）。
AI.conclusion: 通过复杂度先验同时指导高斯放置正则化与局部采样，可有效提升复杂区域细节重建质量，在不牺牲实时性的前提下实现更忠实的人体新视角合成。

title: Multi-Horizon Future Discovery for Physics-Informed Exploration
summary: Exploration in physical control environments requires agents to identify actions whose consequences reveal previously unexplored aspects of the underlying dynamics. However, many intrinsic motivation methods rely on immediate prediction errors, state novelty, or local physical changes, which may overlook informative outcomes that emerge across extended temporal horizons. We investigate whether learning structured representations of reachable futures can provide a more effective basis for exploration. To this end, we introduce Hamiltonian Temporal Contrastive Curiosity (HTC$^2$), a framework that combines multi-horizon temporal representation learning with Hamiltonian phase-space structure. A horizon-conditioned contrastive critic learns temporal relationships from future-state pairs sampled within the same episode. The distance between positive-pair representations is then used as an intrinsic reward, encouraging the agent to explore futures that remain insufficiently organized in the learned representation. To incorporate information about physical dynamics, we additionally modulate this reward using bounded multi-step Hamiltonian variation, rather than directly rewarding changes in the Hamiltonian itself. We integrate HTC$^2$ with both Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and evaluate it across six DeepMind Control Suite tasks. Comparisons with ICM, RIDE, E3B, Plan2Explore, and a single-step Hamiltonian curiosity baseline are complemented by state-coverage evaluations, component ablations, and phase-space diagnostics to characterize the contributions of temporal learning and physical structure to exploratory behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Hamiltonian Temporal Contrastive Curiosity (HTC²)，将多时间跨度对比表示学习与哈密顿相空间结构结合，用正样本对表示的远近作为内在奖励，并由有界多步哈密顿变化调制，以促进揭示动力学信息的探索。
AI.motivation: 物理控制环境中的探索需要智能体找到其后果能揭示未知动力学的动作，但现有内在动机方法多依赖即时预测误差、状态新颖性或局部物理变化，容易忽略在较长时序跨度上才显现的信息性结果。
AI.method: 提出 HTC² 框架：使用以时间跨度为条件的对比评论家，在同一回合内采样未来状态对学习表示，并用正样本对表示间距离作为内在奖励；同时不直接奖励哈密顿量变化，而是用有界多步哈密顿变化对该奖励进行调制；框架与 SAC、PPO 集成。
AI.result: 在六个 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上，与 ICM、RIDE、E3B、Plan2Explore 及单步哈密顿好奇心基线比较；并通过状态覆盖评估、组件消融和相空间诊断，分析时序学习与物理结构对探索行为的贡献。（摘要未给出具体数值结果）
AI.conclusion: 学习可达未来的结构化表示可作为更有效的探索基础，多时间跨度时序表示学习与哈密顿相空间结构的结合能改善探索，相关贡献已通过对比、消融与诊断得到刻画。

title: OrthoRF: Exploring Orthogonality in Object-Centric Representations
summary: Neural synchrony is hypothesized to help the brain organize visual scenes into structured multi-object representations. In machine learning, synchrony-based models analogously learn object-centric representations by storing binding in the phase of complex-valued features. Rotating Features (RF) instantiate this idea with vector-valued activations, encoding object presence in magnitudes and affiliation in orientations. We propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), which enforces orthogonality in RF's orientation space via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications. This yields sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping. In evaluations of unsupervised object discovery, including settings with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or outperforms current models while producing more interpretable representations, and it eliminates the post-hoc clustering required by many synchrony-based approaches. Unlike current models, OrthoRF also recovers occluded object parts, indicating stronger grouping under occlusion. Overall, orthogonality emerges as a simple, effective inductive bias for synchrony-based object-centric learning.

AI.tldr: 提出正交旋转特征（OrthoRF），通过在旋转特征的方向空间施加正交性约束（内积损失+架构修改），获得更清晰的相位对齐与更可靠的分组，在无监督物体发现中匹配或超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: 大脑被认为通过神经同步性将视觉场景组织成结构化多物体表征；机器学习中的同步性模型把绑定信息存于复数特征的相位中。旋转特征（RF）用向量激活把物体存在编码在模长、归属关系编码在方向中，但方向空间缺乏足够约束，相位对齐不够清晰、分组不够可靠。
AI.method: 在旋转特征基础上提出 OrthoRF：通过一个内积损失（inner-product loss）强制方向空间中的正交性，并配合架构改动，使不同物体的相位方向更加分离、对齐更锐利。
AI.result: 在无监督物体发现评测中（含物体重叠、噪声、分布外测试等设置），OrthoRF 匹配或优于现有模型；表征更具可解释性；无需许多同步性方法所需的后期聚类；且能恢复被遮挡物体的部件，显示更强的遮挡下分组能力。
AI.conclusion: 正交性是一种简单而有效的归纳偏置，适用于基于同步性的以物体为中心学习。

title: Amplify, Locate, Estimate (ALE) on Rare-Failure Rates of Fine-Tuned LLMs
summary: Safety fine-tuning can make undesirable model behaviors sufficiently rare that measuring their frequency by direct sampling becomes prohibitively expensive. We introduce Amplify, Locate, Estimate (ALE), a method for estimating such rare failure probabilities efficiently. ALE uses the change in token log-probabilities induced by the safety fine-tuning to define an amplification direction, along which we increase the failure rate for cheap measurement. We develop a score-function estimator that uses the selected amplified batch to recover the local slope of the log failure rate from the token probabilities of the sampled failures, enabling extrapolation back to rare target rates. We also use the amplified batch to obtain an importance-sampling estimate. Across 41 evaluation targets, ALE's estimate-to-reference ratios have a median close to one, with 37 ALE estimates within a factor of three of reference values obtained from independent direct measurements. Ablation tests show that with a budget of up to $\sim$1000 labeled rollouts, in addition to a cheap unlabeled scan, ALE estimates failure probabilities for Qwen3-8B fine-tunes down to about $10^{-5}$, where direct measurement can require hundreds of thousands of rollouts, as the required sampling budget scales inversely with failure probability at fixed relative precision.

AI.tldr: 提出ALE方法，利用安全微调引起的token对数概率变化定义"放大方向"，通过放大失败率实现低成本的稀有失败概率估计。
AI.motivation: 安全微调使不良行为的发生频率极低，直接采样测量成本过高（固定相对精度下采样预算与失败概率成反比）。
AI.method: ALE三步法：Amplify——沿安全微调引起的token对数概率变化方向进行放大以提升失败率；Locate——利用放大批次采样到的失败样本的token概率恢复对数失败率的局部斜率；Estimate——结合score-function估计器外推回稀有目标率，并用放大批次做重要性采样估计。
AI.result: 在41个评估目标上，估计值与参考值之比的中位数接近1，37个估计落在独立直接测量参考值的三倍范围内；消融实验表明，仅用约1000次标注rollout加一次低成本无标注扫描，对Qwen3-8B微调模型可估计低至约1e-5的失败概率，而直接测量需数十万次rollout。
AI.conclusion: ALE能在远低于直接采样的预算下准确估计极稀有失败概率，为安全微调后的风险评估提供了可扩展的实用工具。

title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
summary: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs. In this work, we investigate an alternative relay thinking topology, where reasoning ownership is dynamically transferred across agents, allowing subsequent agents to inherit and refine an evolving reasoning trajectory. We introduce Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay (MACR), a framework that enables dynamical relay collaboration among agents. The key challenge is determining when reasoning should be relayed and which agent should continue the process. method addresses this challenge through confidence-guided relay triggering and a bidding mechanism that selects the next agent based on its confidence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that method outperforms the strongest single-model strategies in accuracy, e.g., +3.3% on MathVista and +3.9% on MMStar, and remains on par with multi-agent strategies while consuming 6.0x less token overhead on HallusionBench and MMStar.Further analysis demonstrates that relay collaboration enables heterogeneous agents to progressively integrate complementary insights, combining heterogeneous capabilities across reasoning stages. Our source code is available at https://github.com/67L1/MACR.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体置信度引导接力（MACR）框架，将"群体思维"协作拓扑替换为"接力思维"拓扑，通过置信度触发继推与投标机制动态转移推理主导权，在提升准确率的同时显著降低token开销。
AI.motivation: 现有MAC方法多采用"群体思维"拓扑：各智能体独立生成解并聚合输出。该范式存在冗余计算与能力难以渐进整合的问题。作者希望探索另一种"接力思维"拓扑，让推理主导权在智能体间动态转移，后继智能体继承并精炼演进中的推理轨迹。
AI.method: MACR框架包含两部分关键设计：(1) 置信度引导的接力触发机制，用于判断何时应将推理移交；(2) 投标机制，各智能体根据自身置信度竞标，选择最合适的下一棒智能体。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，MACR准确率优于最强单模型策略（MathVista +3.3%、MMStar +3.9%）；与多智能体策略持平的同时，在HallusionBench和MMStar上token开销降低6.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 接力式协作使异构智能体在不同推理阶段逐步整合互补洞察，实现异构能力的组合；该拓扑在效率与效果上均具优势。

title: GPDPO: Learning from Reward Conflicts via Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-reward reinforcement learning offers a promising framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse objectives, but conflicting reward signals can induce ambiguous update directions and hinder stable optimization. Existing approaches address such conflicts through reward reweighting, gradient coordination, or rollout filtering, yet they primarily operate on per-response or group-level optimization signals and underexploit relational information among sampled responses. As a result, conflict-filtered rollouts may still contain useful supervision that is discarded during training. We propose Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization (GPDPO), a multi-reward policy optimization method that recovers pairwise supervision from conflict-filtered rollouts. GPDPO identifies Pareto-dominance relations among sampled responses and converts them into auxiliary preference signals, which are jointly optimized with the original policy objective. This enables more effective reuse of existing rollouts without additional sampling or reward evaluation. Experiments on API-Bank across multiple model scales and reward configurations show that GPDPO consistently outperforms competitive multi-reward optimization baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that GPDPO reduces both group-relative and pairwise reward conflicts, supporting the effectiveness of exploiting relational supervision for multi-reward alignment. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出GPDPO，从被冲突过滤的rollout中挖掘Pareto支配关系作为辅助偏好信号，与策略目标联合优化，实现多奖励对齐的rollout高效复用。
AI.motivation: 多奖励RL中冲突奖励导致更新方向模糊、优化不稳定；现有方法（奖励重加权、梯度协调、rollout过滤）仅在单响应或组级信号上操作，忽视样本间的相对关系信息，导致被过滤的rollout中仍有有用监督被丢弃。
AI.method: GPDPO识别采样响应间的Pareto支配关系，将其转化为成对偏好辅助信号，并与原始策略优化目标联合训练；无需额外采样或奖励评估即可复用已有rollout。
AI.result: 在API-Bank上跨多种模型规模与奖励配置，GPDPO持续优于现有多奖励优化基线；分析显示其降低了组内相对与成对的奖励冲突。
AI.conclusion: 利用响应间的关系监督可提升多奖励对齐的有效性与稳定性，为冲突过滤rollout的再利用提供可行路径。代码将开源。

title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出优化感知的双域医学图像分割框架 O2D-MedNet，含双域交互(DDI)、跨骨干轮廓引导融合(CGF)与梯度上下文优化(GCO)三模块，在六个基准上一致优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割面临复合退化与多尺度几何变化，影响病灶-背景可分性、结构一致性与优化稳定性。现有单流框架把异质线索纠缠于单一表征路径，混合流方法多用通用或静态融合，跨域协同不足且未显式处理优化不稳定。
AI.method: 1) DDI：融合傅里叶域与小波域特征，抑制退化敏感响应，保留结构与细节；2) CGF：在CNN局部细节建模与视觉状态空间全局结构建模之间进行选择性交互，提升边界精度与表征一致性；3) GCO：依据损失趋势与梯度统计自适应调整学习动态，缓解类不平衡与样本难度异质带来的训练不稳定。
AI.result: 在六个基准、多种成像模态上相较SOTA MIS方法取得一致性提升；进一步分析证实灵敏度、结构一致性与优化稳定性均增强。
AI.conclusion: O2D-MedNet 通过在频域/小波双域协同、跨骨干选择性融合与优化感知训练策略，可有效应对异质条件下的鲁棒医学图像分割。

title: Evaluating Bayesian deep learning for robust biomedical time-series classification under distribution shift: A sleep scoring case study
comment: 28 pages (8 pages main text), 8 figures, 15 tables
summary: In biomedical time-series classification, machine learning models often suffer from deteriorating accuracy and calibration due to distribution shift. We investigate to what degree Bayesian-inspired deep learning improves robustness through Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Using rodent sleep scoring as a case study, we evaluate BMA under distribution shifts in genotype, laboratory, and species. We systematically compare nine approximate inference methods spanning single- and multi-basin approaches across two neural network backbones on in-distribution (ID) data and five out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. In our results, multi-basin methods perform best, outperforming baselines and single-basin methods. Compared with point estimates, BMA generally improves OOD accuracy and calibration across both architectures, while yielding only modest ID gains. It also often improves selective prediction and OOD and artifact detection, but, interestingly, not inter-rater disagreement detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文以鼠类睡眠分期为案例，系统评估九种贝叶斯近似推断方法在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，发现多盆地方法的贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）能提升OOD准确率与校准，但对同分布增益有限。
AI.motivation: 生物医学时间序列分类中，模型在分布偏移（基因型、实验室、物种）下准确率与校准常退化，作者希望量化贝叶斯深度学习通过贝叶斯模型平均在多大程度上缓解这一鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 以鼠类睡眠打分为案例，在两种神经网络骨干上，系统比较九种近似推断方法（单盆地与多盆地两类），在同分布数据和五个OOD数据集上进行评估，并考察选择性预测、OOD检测与伪迹检测等任务。
AI.result: 多盆地方法表现最佳，优于基线和单盆地方法；相比点估计，BMA在两种架构上普遍提升OOD准确率与校准，ID仅有小幅增益；BMA常改善选择性预测及OOD与伪迹检测，但未改善评分者间不一致检测。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯模型平均是提升生物医学时间序列分类跨域鲁棒性的有效手段，其中多盆地近似方法尤为突出；但其收益具有任务依赖性，对某些不确定性相关任务并无帮助。

title: Joint Latent Reasoning and Observation for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Effective video agents must learn not only how to answer, but also where to look next. Transferring this capability to smaller models is challenging because each observation serves two purposes: supporting an answer and guiding the search for further evidence. Textual descriptions may capture what is currently visible while omitting cues needed for subsequent acquisition. We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA), a framework that distills multi-round video agents through jointly learned latent reasoning and visual observations. Rather than communicating through captions, an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner that selects the next acquisition action or produces the final answer. Crucially, action and answer supervision propagate through this interface, training the observer to communicate information useful for downstream decisions. Observation reconstruction and reasoning-distribution alignment provide auxiliary supervision from textual teacher trajectories. Across five video-understanding benchmarks, LARVA achieves strong performance with 4B and 7B backbones. On VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench, the 7B model outperforms a textual CoT student trained on the same teacher trajectories by 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of jointly learning how agents represent evidence and act on it when distilling video-understanding capabilities.

AI.tldr: LARVA 提出"潜在智能体推理"框架，用连续隐表示替代文本描述作为观察者与推理者间的通信接口，联合蒸馏多轮视频智能体的"看哪里"与"答什么"能力。
AI.motivation: 有效视频智能体需学会"如何回答"与"下一步看哪里"，但小模型蒸馏困难：每次观察既支撑答案又引导后续取证；文本描述易忽略后续采证所需线索。作者认为应让观察信息在隐空间传递，并让动作/答案监督反向塑造观察者，使其输出对下游决策有用的信息。
AI.method: 框架含观察者与推理者两模块：观察者将每轮视觉观察编码为紧凑连续表示（而非字幕），传给推理者选择下一步采证动作或给出最终答案；动作与答案监督经该接口回传，端到端训练观察者传递有用信息。辅以观察重建与推理分布对齐两项辅助监督，从文本教师轨迹中蒸馏。在 4B/7B 骨干上验证。
AI.result: 在五个视频理解基准上表现强劲；在 VideoHolmes、Video-MME、LVBench 上，7B 模型分别比使用相同教师轨迹训练的文本 CoT 学生高出 5.1、2.5、3.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，蒸馏视频理解能力时，"智能体如何表示证据"与"如何据此行动"应被联合学习，而非先转成文本再推理；隐式通信接口在同等监督下优于文本 CoT 蒸馏。

title: When Fine-Grained Credit Assignment Helps and Hurts: Multimodal Agentic Reinforcement Learning through Video Editing
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for training multimodal agents to reason and use tools. However, it remains unclear when fine-grained credit assignment improves learning and when it fails to improve task performance. Video editing provides a useful testbed for this question, combining multimodal perception, long-horizon planning, and tool use with delayed outcome feedback. We construct four movie-trailer editing task types---Content Selection, Narrative Sequencing, Rough Cut, and Fine Cut---that reflect real-world editing workflows and span different levels of task complexity and interaction horizon. Decaying process rewards provides the largest benefit on Fine Cut, with a 45.4% relative gain over outcome-only GRPO on tasks averaging more than 60 turns under outcome-only GRPO. On the three shorter-horizon task types averaging 30--40 turns under the same baseline, outcome-only GRPO remains competitive, with decaying process rewards yielding at most a 10.4% relative gain. Process rewards from an LLM judge initially improve tool use and encourage visual inspection. As training progresses, however, GRPO+PRM with a fixed process-reward weight increasingly exhibits excessive reasoning and redundant tool calls: process rewards continue to rise while task completion rates and outcome scores decline. Decaying the process-reward weight to zero mitigates this reward-hacking behavior while preserving the early gains. Despite dense token-level supervision, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) yields little improvement or substantial degradation and is highly sensitive to the choice of privileged information. Our analysis reveals differences in teacher--student disagreement and gradient magnitudes, and suggests possible dilution of informative signals over long trajectories.

AI.tldr: 细粒度过程奖励（PRM）并非普遍有效：在长程（>60轮）的精细剪辑任务上显著提升（45.4%），短程任务收益有限（≤10.4%）；固定权重的过程奖励会诱发推理冗长与冗余工具调用等reward hacking，权重衰减至零可缓解；OPSD在长轨迹上收益甚微甚至退化。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已被用于训练多模态智能体的推理与工具使用，但"细粒度信用分配何时有益、何时失效"尚不明确，缺乏受控的实证分析。视频剪辑同时具备多模态感知、长程规划、工具调用与延迟结果反馈，是研究该问题的理想试验台。
AI.method: 构建四类电影预告片剪辑任务（内容选择、叙事排序、粗剪、精剪），覆盖不同复杂度与交互步长；对比仅结果奖励的GRPO、GRPO+PRM（固定/衰减过程奖励权重）、以及on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）；从教师-学生分歧、梯度幅值、信号能否保留至轨迹末端等角度剖析失效原因。
AI.result: 衰减过程奖励在精剪任务（基线平均>60轮）上相对仅结果GRPO取得45.4%相对提升；三类较短任务（30–40轮）中仅结果GRPO仍有竞争力，收益≤10.4%。固定权重的PRM早期改善工具使用与视觉检查，后期出现过程奖励上升而完成率与结果分数下降的reward hacking。OPSD即使有稠密token级监督也收益甚微或显著退化，且对特权信息选择高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 过程奖励的价值取决于轨迹长度与任务复杂度：长程任务收益大，短程任务收益有限。过程奖励权重应随之衰减以抑制过度推理与冗余工具调用。OPSD的长程有效性存疑，可能与教师-学生分歧、梯度量级及信息信号在长轨迹中被稀释有关。建议按交互步长自适应调整信用分配策略。

title: Model reduction in time: Learning flow maps for reducing stochastic dynamical systems in time
summary: Predictions with dynamical systems can be computationally expensive---even with reduced models---because reaching future prediction times can require many sequential time integration steps. We propose Flow-Map First-Order Trajectory Matching (FM-FTM), a nonintrusive model reduction approach that accelerates ensemble predictions of stochastic dynamical systems by learning flow maps that replace multiple time-integration steps. Our method uses first-order trajectory matching (FTM) to learn a deterministic representation of the stochastic probability-current dynamics and then reduces its evolution over time into a flow map whose evaluation directly yields predictions over long time horizons. Numerical experiments on evolution problems with stochastic forcing demonstrate that FM-FTM accelerates ensemble predictions by up to two orders of magnitude while accurately predicting time marginals and ensemble statistics.

AI.tldr: 提出FM-FTM，一种非侵入式模型降阶方法，通过学习流映射替代多步时间积分，加速随机动力系统的集合预测。
AI.motivation: 动力系统预测（即便用降阶模型）需大量顺序时间积分步骤，计算代价高昂，尤其是随机系统的集合预测。
AI.method: 结合一阶轨迹匹配（FTM）学习随机概率流动力学的确定性表示，再将其时间演化浓缩为流映射，一次评估即可给出长时程预测。
AI.result: 在带随机强迫的演化问题上，集合预测加速最高达两个数量级，同时准确预测时间边缘分布与集合统计量。
AI.conclusion: FM-FTM通过流映射替代多步积分，在保持精度的同时显著加速随机系统集合预测，是非侵入式降阶的有效方案。

title: Beyond Vision-Language Models: Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs for Emotion Recognition in Artworks
summary: Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation. This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. We evaluate VSAG and VSAG-TopK against direct VLM inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 on EmoArt-5k. Results show that direct VLMs provide useful but modest baselines, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. In particular, the hierarchical valence-arousal variant of VSAG achieves the best overall performance, improving accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 over both direct VLM inference and the emotion-only VSAG baseline. Per-class results indicate that graph-based models and VLMs capture partly complementary signals, while valence-arousal structure is most useful when integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect hierarchy rather than as a simple post-hoc correction. These findings suggest that explicit visual-semantic structure can support both prediction and interpretation in artwork emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG)图框架，用可解释特征节点（色彩、笔触、构图、明暗、线条、视觉实体）建模艺术作品的视觉-语义-情感关联，并可选层级效价-唤醒辅助模块，在EmoArt-5k上优于直接VLM推理。
AI.motivation: 艺术作品情感识别困难：情感意义主观、隐晦，且依赖视觉形式与语义联想之间关系。直接图像到情感的VLM预测忽视了形式、语义、情感线索间的显式关系。
AI.method: 构建图结构：颜色、笔触、构图、光影、线条质量、提取的视觉实体作为可解释特征节点，学习特征-情感关联以预测主导情感；另设可选层级辅助情感模块建模效价-唤醒结构；并设置VSAG-TopK变体。与Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5直接推理在EmoArt-5k上对比。
AI.result: 直接VLM基线有效但有限；图模型提升主导情感预测；VSAG层级效价-唤醒变体整体最佳，在accuracy、macro-F1、weighted-F1上均优于直接VLM和仅情感VSAG。逐类结果显示图模型与VLM信号部分互补；效价-唤醒结构以粗到细层级集成优于事后校正。
AI.conclusion: 显式视觉-语义结构可同时支持艺术作品情感识别的预测与可解释性。

title: S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
summary: Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered by insufficient coverage of trajectories with diverse lengths and early gradients dominated by the newly initialized value head. We introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic) for LLM reasoning, built around a practical critic-training recipe. The trained critic provides token-specific advantages and prompt-specific baselines. Using the prompt-level baseline to estimate difficulty, we propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS). DAPS combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing rollout waste without offline difficulty initialization. S3AC improves group-rollout performance across dense and mixture-of-experts models from 1.5B to 397B parameters, outperforming a modern GRPO variant (GRPO-X). At 35B, it sustains single-rollout training while tested critic-free baselines deteriorate after initial gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 S3AC，一套可落地的 actor-critic 训练方案，为 LLM 长链式推理提供 token 级优势与 prompt 级基线，并配合难度感知采样 DAPS，在多规模模型上优于 GRPO-X。
AI.motivation: critic-free 方法在 RLVR 长 CoT 推理中虽避免了昂贵 critic 训练，但缺乏 token 级信用分配，且需依赖分组 rollout 估计 prompt 特定基线；而直接训练长 CoT critic 又受两大障碍限制：轨迹长度覆盖不足、早期梯度被新初始化的 value head 主导。
AI.method: S3AC（Stabilized, Selective, Scalable Actor-Critic）基于一套实用的 critic 训练配方，训练出的 critic 同时提供 token 级优势和 prompt 级基线；再利用该 prompt 级基线估计难度，提出 Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling（DAPS），在生成前结合结果历史选择 prompt，无需离线难度初始化即可减少 rollout 浪费。
AI.result: 在 1.5B 到 397B 参数的稠密与 MoE 模型上，S3AC 在分组 rollout 设置下均优于现代 GRPO 变体 GRPO-X；在 35B 模型上，它能维持单 rollout 训练，而所测试的 critic-free 基线在初期收益后出现退化。
AI.conclusion: 稳定的 critic 训练可弥补 critic-free RLVR 的信用分配与基线估计缺陷，配合难度感知采样，能提升训练效率与可扩展性，并支持单 rollout 训练场景。

title: Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases
summary: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出基于低秩多尺度纠缠重整化拟设(MERA)张量网络的3D OCT体稀疏表示，统一实现压缩、去噪与特征提取，无需训练，并可结合Grassmann流形最近子空间分类器完成小样本视网膜疾病分类。
AI.motivation: OCT体数据受散斑噪声影响，细节被遮蔽；同时大视场高分辨率OCT体存储与传输负担重，不利于归档和远程眼科。深度学习方案依赖大量标注数据且需训练，在小样本临床场景受限。
AI.method: 将3D OCT体表示为张量网络收缩：顶层核心因子编码全局特征，多个相互作用的低秩正交/半正交因子建模B-scan间与B-scan内相关性；用MERA结构提取特征后，以Grassmann流形最近子空间分类器分类，该分类器仅以子空间维度为超参数。
AI.result: 在两个不同扫描仪采集的OCT体上，视觉质量提升、视网膜层分割误差降低；在两个临床数据集上小样本疾病分类精度具竞争力，优于/可比若干对比方法及受标注稀缺限制的深度学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知、模型驱动的表示学习在有限监督下兼顾良好泛化性与高可解释性，为高维OCT数据的压缩、去噪与分类提供training-free方案。

title: Beyond Modeling Order: Dual-Path Spatiotemporal Representation Learning for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition
summary: Cross-subject generalization remains a major challenge for EEG-based emotion recognition due to pronounced inter-subject variability in neural activity and emotion-related spatiotemporal patterns. Existing methods mainly alleviate inter subject differences through distribution alignment or contrastive learning, while paying limited attention to representation bias associated with fixed spatiotemporal modeling orders. We hypothesize that high-level emotion representations of the same EEG signal should remain consistent across different spatiotemporal modeling paths. Based on this hypothesis, we propose a Dual-Path Spatiotemporal Contrastive Learning (DP-STCL) framework for cross-subject EEG emotion recognition. DP-STCL employs two complementary encoders with independent parameters, namely a Temporal-to-Spatial (TS) path and a Spatial to-Temporal (ST) path, to model EEG spatiotemporal information under different integration orders. During representation learning, the same emotional stimulus is used to establish cross subject associations, while three complementary relations jointly constrain representation variations across subjects and modeling paths. This promotes stable and discriminative stimulus-related emotion representations. To further handle limited labeled target subject data, we introduce a LoRA-based few-shot adaptation strategy with low parameter overhead. Extensive cross-subject experiments on SEED, SEED-IV, SEED-V, and FACED show that DP-STCL consistently outperforms the compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving cross-subject EEG emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双路径时空对比学习框架DP-STCL，通过时序→空间与空间→时序两条独立建模路径并约束其表示一致，缓解跨被试EEG情感识别中的表示偏差，并结合LoRA少样本适配，在SEED系列与FACED数据集上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 跨被试EEG情感识别受个体神经活动与情感时空模式差异影响严重。现有方法多用分布对齐或对比学习缓解被试差异，但较少关注固定时空建模顺序带来的表示偏差。
AI.method: 基于"同一EEG信号的高级情感表示应在不同时空建模路径下保持一致"的假设，设计两个参数独立的编码器：时序到空间（TS）路径与空间到时序（ST）路径；以同一情感刺激建立跨被试关联，并用三种互补关系约束跨被试与跨路径的表示变化；另引入基于LoRA的低参数量少样本适配策略应对目标被试标注稀缺。
AI.result: 在SEED、SEED-IV、SEED-V和FACED四个数据集上的大量跨被试实验表明，DP-STCL稳定优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 双路径时空对比学习可有效抑制建模顺序导致的表示偏差，提升跨被试EEG情感识别的稳定性与判别性，配合LoRA少样本适配具备实用性。

title: OVM-Occ: Open-Vocabulary Monocular Occupancy Prediction via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Distillation
summary: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出OVM-Occ：基于语言嵌入高斯与实例感知视觉-语言教师的开放词汇单目室内占据预测框架，并构建OpenOcc-ScanNet/OpenOcc-Replica基准，取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有单目占据预测局限于预定义闭集类别，难以泛化到未见类别；室内场景物体语义类别高度多样且细粒度，闭集设定限制明显，因此研究开放词汇室内占据预测。
AI.method: 以Language-Embedded Gaussians为中间场景表示；设计几何感知的可变形注意力模块精炼高斯语义特征；构建实例级视觉-语言嵌入以提供可靠语义监督；提出几何感知解耦语义蒸馏，缓解几何学习与语义学习之间的干扰。
AI.result: 在Occ-ScanNet上相较此前SOTA提升12.2 mIoU与0.6 IoU，并在新的开放词汇评测协议下保持一致的性能增益，达到室内开放词汇单目占据预测SOTA。
AI.conclusion: OVM-Occ有效实现开放词汇室内占据预测，并配套提出OpenOcc-ScanNet与OpenOcc-Replica两个更细粒度、更多样的扩展基准，为该方向提供评测基础。

title: Efficient probabilistic weather forecasting at quarter-degree resolution with two-sided transport attention
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 7 Extended Data figures, 1 Extended Data table
summary: High-resolution probabilistic weather forecasting remains computationally demanding. Here we present Astra, a 0.25$^\circ$ ensemble model trained on eight H200 GPUs. It combines Kantorovich Attention, a two-sided transport attention in which each region chooses where it reads from and writes to, so every region sends and receives at token resolution, with a self-featurised continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) that also scores forecasts in the model's multiscale features. In WeatherBench 2, Astra matches GenCast's CRPS averaged over five upper-air targets and days 1-10 with 9.8% of its hardware-normalised training compute. Verified against ERA5, its CRPS and ensemble-mean root-mean-square error are lower than the ECMWF ensemble's on all 600 variable, level and lead-time combinations, and its CRPS is lower than GenCast's on 73.5% of them. A 15-day member needs 39 times fewer floating-point operations than GenCast's GPU implementation, and 50 members take under 40 min on one consumer GPU, within 21 GB.

AI.tldr: Astra 是一个在 8 块 H200 上训练的 0.25° 概率天气预报集合模型，通过 Kantorovich Attention 与自特征化 CRPS 大幅降低计算开销，在 WeatherBench 2 上以约 1/10 算力达到 GenCast 精度，并多数指标优于 ECMWF 集合。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率概率天气预报计算代价高昂，现有集合模型（如 GenCast）训练与推理算力需求大，亟需在保持精度的同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.method: 提出 Astra：0.25° 集合模型，仅用 8 块 H200 训练。核心为 Kantorovich Attention——双边传输注意力，每个区域自行选择读取与写入来源，使所有区域在 token 分辨率上收发信息；配合自特征化 CRPS，将多尺度特征也纳入评分目标。
AI.result: 在 WeatherBench 2 上，以 GenCast 9.8% 的硬件归一化训练算力达到其在 5 项高空目标、1–10 天的平均 CRPS；对比 ERA5，在全部 600 组变量-层次-预报时效组合上 CRPS 与集合均值 RMSE 均低于 ECMWF 集合，其中 73.5% 组合 CRPS 低于 GenCast；15 天成员推理 FLOPs 为 GenCast GPU 实现的 1/39，50 成员在单块消费级 GPU、21 GB 内 40 分钟完成。
AI.conclusion: Astra 表明精巧的注意力设计与特征级概率评分可在大幅削减算力和显存的同时达到甚至超越主流天气集合模型，使高分辨率概率预报在消费级硬件上可行。

title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
summary: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种基于图像回归的方法，利用ResNet50网络从UK Biobank的颈-膝水脂MRI中估计肾脏体积、心脏体积和年龄等数值属性，R²达0.731–0.984，并通过组级显著性图验证医学生理相关性。
AI.motivation: UK Biobank计划对10万参与者进行详细MRI检查，需自动化分析以扩展图像衍生表型；直接处理全身MRI数据存在冗余与信息密度低的问题。
AI.method: 将参考扫描中手动定义的解剖子区域通过图像配准传播到3万余张扫描，采样为2D多通道拼图（保留高分辨率），再用ResNet50风格网络做回归，并支持组级显著性分析。
AI.result: 在肾脏体积、心脏体积和年龄三个回归端点上，预测性能R²=0.731–0.984，组级显著性图高亮出医学相关区域。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可标准化并限制输入深度回归流程的信息、提升信息密度，为未来医学推断研究开辟广泛可能。

title: Balanced Sampling in Stochastic Multi-objective Bandits
summary: In stochastic multi-objective bandits, Pareto optimal arms may represent different trade-offs among objectives. Balanced sampling across them is important in practical settings such as online advertising. Yet, there seems to be little consensus on how to measure fairness, to our best knowledge. Achieving fairness is also tough as the set of Pareto optimal arms is unknown, and early sampling decisions may create imbalances that are difficult to erase afterwards. We measure unfairness by the KL divergence from the uniform distribution over the true Pareto set to the empirical measure induced by the sampling trajectory. Nicely, this measure admits an exact decomposition that separates the cost of sampling suboptimal arms from the imbalance among Pareto optimal arms. With a recursive form for unfairness, we develop \emph{adaptive top-two sampling}, which combines sampling counts and empirical evidence of Pareto membership to define a gain for each arm and guide sampling without committing to an estimated Pareto set. When the Pareto set is stable under small perturbations, we establish an $O(\log T/T)$ and $O(T^{-1})$ bound on expected unfairness and variance, respectively. Information-theoretic lower bounds show that the $\log T/T$ rate can be unavoidable for uniformly fair policies on stable instances, matching our upper bound. More surprisingly, stability is indeed crucial, as the expected unfairness can be $ω(\log T/T)$ without it. Finally, we create a variant that encourages exploration of undersampled arms to reduce the risk of persistent underallocation. At sufficiently large horizons, it preserves the rate on the expected unfairness while admitting a sharper bound of $O(\log^2 T/T^2)$ on variance. Numerical studies support these findings and suggest practical insights.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机多目标老虎机中的"公平性"问题：以采样轨迹经验分布与真实Pareto集上均匀分布之间的KL散度作为不公平性度量，提出自适应top-two采样算法（ATS），在Pareto集稳定条件下达到O(log T/T)的期望不公平性上界，并给出匹配的信息论下界。
AI.motivation: 多目标老虎机中，Pareto最优臂代表不同目标间的权衡，实际场景（如在线广告）需要在它们之间均衡采样，但如何度量公平性缺乏共识；同时Pareto集未知，早期采样偏差会形成难以消除的失衡，实现公平颇具挑战。
AI.method: 以真实Pareto集上均匀分布到采样经验分布的KL散度作为公平性度量，该度量可精确分解为"采到次优臂的代价"与"Pareto最优臂间的不平衡"两部分。基于不公平性的递推形式，提出自适应top-two采样（ATS）：结合采样计数与Pareto归属的经验证据，为每个臂定义增益来引导采样，而不必事先确定估计的Pareto集。另提出鼓励探索欠采样臂的变体以降低持续欠分配风险。理论分析基于Pareto集在小扰动下稳定的假设，并用信息论下界加以刻画。
AI.result: 在Pareto集稳定条件下，期望不公平性和方差分别有O(log T/T)与O(T^{-1})的界；信息论下界表明log T/T速率对稳定实例上的均匀公平策略不可避免，与上界匹配。若不满足稳定性，期望不公平性可达到ω(log T/T)，说明稳定性至关重要。鼓励探索变体在足够长的时间范围内保持期望不公平性速率，同时给出O(log²T/T²)的更优方差界。数值实验支持上述结论。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了多目标老虎机公平性的可分解KL散度度量，提出无需预先确定Pareto集的自适应top-two采样算法及其探索增强变体，在稳定性假设下达到最优速率，并在理论上揭示了稳定性的关键作用；数值实验验证理论并提供实践启示。

title: CVTSplat: Multi-view Reconstruction Using an Adaptive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
summary: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: CVTSplat 用自适应质心 Voronoi 镶嵌（CVT）替代不规则 Voronoi 来做多视图重建，保持细胞规则、易计算，单卡约2.5分钟训练即在DTU/BlendedMVS达到与最优高斯泼溅表面方法相当的几何精度。
AI.motivation: Voronoi 镶嵌已用于多视图的几何与外观重建，但其不规则细胞导致优化过程中反复重建镶嵌代价高昂，需要一种既自适应又计算高效的离散化方式。
AI.method: 提出自适应质心 Voronoi 镶嵌（CVT），允许非均匀细胞尺寸同时保持规则、形状良好的细胞；细胞尺寸由演化中的符号距离场调制，把站点集中到零水平集附近并保持近似质心性。基于这种规则性做全流程专门化：GPU 最近邻查询与近似 Voronoi 构建，以及针对小而近各向同性细胞的定制光栅化器。
AI.result: Voronoi 构建比该设定下通用方案快 5–10 倍；在 DTU 与 BlendedMVS 上几何精度与最好的高斯泼溅表面方法相当，单 GPU 训练约 2.5 分钟。
AI.conclusion: 通过用自适应 CVT 换取细胞规则性，可将整个重建管线高效专门化，实现快速且高精度的表面重建，说明镶嵌结构的选择直接决定优化效率。

title: Multi-Fidelity Training Reshapes Uncertainty Decomposition in Atomistic Models
summary: Multi-fidelity training, which combines abundant low-fidelity data with scarce high-fidelity labels, is increasingly common in atomistic modeling, but its effect on predictive uncertainty remains largely unexplored. We investigate this question using deep ensembles of mean-variance MACE models trained on ANI-1x, contrasting high-fidelity training from scratch with low-fidelity pretraining followed by fine-tuning. We characterize aleatoric, epistemic, and total uncertainty throughout training and under two distribution shifts: unseen molecular systems and higher-energy configurations. We find that pretraining reduces prediction error and improves uncertainty-based ranking across all test sets, but does not yield well-calibrated predictive variances; calibration deteriorates more severely under energy extrapolation. Training-dynamics analysis localizes most of this calibration degradation to high-fidelity optimization, during which the learned aleatoric variance becomes overconfident on held-out data. Moreover, multi-fidelity fine-tuning produces a more effective uncertainty-based acquisition function than high-fidelity training from scratch. These findings show that uncertainty ranking and calibration capture distinct properties and must be assessed separately in multi-fidelity atomistic models, especially under extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 本文用MACE深度集成模型研究多保真训练（低保真预训练+高保真微调）对原子模拟中不确定性（aleatoric/epistemic/total）的影响，发现预训练降低误差并改善不确定度排序，但预测方差并未良好校准，且外推下校准更差；大部分校准退化发生在高保真优化阶段。
AI.motivation: 多保真训练在原子建模中日益常见，但其对预测不确定性（尤其是校准与排序）的影响尚不清楚，缺乏系统性认识。
AI.method: 在ANI-1x数据集上训练mean-variance MACE模型的深度集成，对比“从零高保真训练”与“低保真预训练后微调”两种策略；全程刻画aleatoric、epistemic和total不确定性，并考察两类分布偏移（未见分子体系、更高能量构型）。
AI.result: 预训练在所有测试集上降低预测误差并提升基于不确定性的排序质量，但未获得良好校准的预测方差；能量外推时校准退化更严重。训练动力学分析表明校准退化主要定位在高保真优化阶段，此时学到的aleatoric方差在留出数据上变得过度自信。此外，多保真微调得到的不确定性采集函数比从零高保真训练更有效。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性排序与校准反映不同性质，在多保真原子模型中须分开评估，尤其在外推场景下；多保真预训练有利于排序与采集，但校准问题需专门处理。

title: Evidence-Guided Selection of Retinal Vessel Segmentation Pipelines: A Cross-Dataset Benchmark of Performance, Structure, Failure Modes, and Reproducibility
summary: Retinal vessel segmentation is widely used in retinal image analysis, yet model selection based only on aggregate overlap scores can overlook structural fidelity, cross-dataset robustness, and application-specific error costs. We evaluated five executable binary vessel-segmentation pipelines (FSG-Net, SA-UNetv2, DCP-1024, GAVE, and FR-UNet) on 244 images from six public datasets using pixel-level agreement, cross-dataset stability, thin-vessel retention, structural metrics, error composition, and available computational evidence. Results were aggregated with equal weighting across datasets. No pipeline was optimal in every setting. FSG-Net achieved the highest equal-dataset mean Macro-F1 (0.77), IoU (0.63), clDice (0.83), and Skeleton F1 (0.78), whereas SA-UNetv2 achieved the highest mean sensitivity (0.85) and Thin-Vessel Sensitivity (0.63). Differences across datasets were often larger than those among the leading pipelines, and errors shared by all five methods were concentrated near annotated vessel boundaries and faint peripheral vessels. In an ancillary analysis on 45 HRF images, segmentation masks were converted into 11 ring-wise vascular features for leave-one-out classification. Controlled perturbations showed that local mask errors can be amplified in downstream features, while targeted stabilization reduced sensitivity for five features. The results support task-conditioned, benchmark-relative pipeline selection rather than a single universal ranking and highlight the need to validate the selected pipeline on the intended target domain.

AI.tldr: 本文通过六个公开数据集、五个可执行视网膜血管分割流程的多维评测表明，不存在通用最优流程，应按任务条件与相对基准选择，并在目标域上验证。
AI.motivation: 仅凭聚合重叠分数（如IoU/Dice）选择分割模型，会忽略结构保真度、跨数据集稳健性和下游应用相关的误差代价，因此需要一个多维评测框架来指导流程选择。
AI.method: 在六个公开数据集的244张图像上评测五个可执行二值血管分割流程（FSG-Net、SA-UNetv2、DCP-1024、GAVE、FR-UNet）；采用像素级一致性、跨数据集稳定性、细血管保留、结构指标（clDice、Skeleton F1）、误差组成与可用计算证据等多维指标，并按数据集等权聚合；另在45张HRF图像上将掩膜转为11个环状血管特征做留一分类，并进行受控扰动分析。
AI.result: 无流程在所有设定下最优：FSG-Net的等数据集平均Macro-F1（0.77）、IoU（0.63）、clDice（0.83）、Skeleton F1（0.78）最高；SA-UNetv2平均敏感度（0.85）与细血管敏感度（0.63）最高。数据集间差异常大于领先流程间差异，共有误差集中于标注血管边界与微弱外周血管。扰动分析显示局部掩膜误差会在下游特征中被放大，定向稳定化降低了5个特征的敏感度。
AI.conclusion: 应进行任务条件化、相对基准化的流程选择而非单一通用排名，并强调所选流程需在预期目标域上验证。

title: High-resolution tactile observation makes hidden racket-control mechanisms learnable
comment: 58 pages, including 14 pages of main text and 44 pages of supplementary information. 5 main figures and 19 supplementary figures
summary: Experts can master fine hand-object manipulation skills, yet limited conscious perception of rapid tactile interactions hinders their ability to articulate the underlying control mechanisms. Badminton racket control requires rapid, fine hand-force coordination, providing a demanding testbed for uncovering these mechanisms. An 864-node tactile-inertial glove with synchronized 100-Hz acquisition recorded over 14,000 strokes from more than 70 participants across five skills. Inspired by sensorimotor control, our mechanics-grounded two-layer framework inferred object-driving and grip-stabilizing control from tactile history, while resolving their spatiotemporal force realization. We found that higher proficiency was associated with selective rather than extensive control: greater skill specificity, anticipatory regulation, focal distal modulation and lower geometric torque cancellation, while spatiotemporal coordination showed a non-monotonic acquire-refine pattern. We translated these mechanisms into personalized guidance targeting force control and force-motion coordination. In a randomized cohort, mechanism-guided learners gained 0.72 expert-rated skill levels versus 0.05 with level-only feedback, making control mechanisms actionable.

AI.tldr: 该论文用864节点触觉-惯性手套采集70余名、五种水平参与者的14000余次羽毛球击球数据，提出力学驱动的两层框架，从触觉历史中推断“驱动物体”与“稳定握持”两类控制，并揭示高水平技能表现为“选择性控制”而非“全面控制”，并将其转化为个性化训练指导，随机实验验证有效。
AI.motivation: 专家掌握精细手-物操作技能，但对快速触觉交互的有限意识感知使其难以articulate（言明）潜在控制机制；羽毛球拍控制需要快速精细的手部力协调，可作为揭示这些机制的严苛测试平台。
AI.method: 使用864节点触觉-惯性手套、100Hz同步采集，覆盖70余名参与者、五种技能水平的14000余次击球；受感觉运动控制启发，构建力学驱动的两层框架，从触觉历史推断物体驱动与握持稳定控制，并解析其时空力实现方式；进一步将机制转化为针对力控制与力-动作协调的个性化指导，并在随机队列中验证。
AI.result: 更高熟练度与“选择性而非广泛性”控制相关：更强的技能特异性、预期性调节、远端聚焦调制、更低的几何力矩抵消；时空协调呈非单调的“习得-精炼”模式。随机队列中，机制引导学习者提升0.72个专家评定的技能等级，而仅水平反馈组仅提升0.05。
AI.conclusion: 高水平手-物操作源于选择性的、预期性的、远端聚焦的力控制机制，而非全面加力；这些控制机制可被推断、量化并转化为可操作的个性化训练指导，显著提升学习效果。

title: SG-Splat: Stable Geometry Learning under Pose Uncertainty for Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images.
