However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.

AI.tldr: SG-Splat 是一个无位姿前馈 3DGS 框架，通过解耦几何估计与高斯属性预测、粗到细位姿/几何精修，以及对位姿不确定性更鲁棒的双路径训练，实现更稳定可靠的高斯重建。
AI.motivation: 现有无位姿前馈 3DGS 对残余位姿误差敏感：位姿误差会扰动规范空间中的高斯变换，使几何与属性学习受到噪声监督。作者希望提升对位姿不确定性的鲁棒性并稳定高斯基元的学习。
AI.method: （1）双分支解耦：几何估计与高斯属性预测分离，降低位姿敏感几何与属性之间的误差耦合；（2）粗到细精修：Flow-Guided Pose Refinement（FGPR）用流相关特征和可微捆绑调整精修相机位姿，Residual-Guided Geometry Correction（RGC）利用 FGPR 得到的深度残差修正初始点图以获得更可靠的高斯中心；（3）双路径训练策略：混合真实位姿与预测位姿进行规范变换，为高斯属性提供干净监督，同时增强几何对残余位姿误差的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 DL3DV 和 RealEstate10K 上，SG-Splat 在新视角合成和位姿估计两方面均达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦分支、位姿—几何精修与位姿混合监督，可有效缓解无位姿前馈 3DGS 中的位姿误差耦合问题，实现鲁棒且高质量的重建与位姿估计。

title: ExCal: Optimization-Free Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Excess Calibration
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026), Special Session on Intelligent Data Mining. 10 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables
summary: We introduce ExCal, a normal-only multivariate time series anomaly detector that combines raw state retrieval, a signal/derivative subspace, and robust statistics across temporal scales. Each expert map receives a high normality floor from the training prefix. During scoring, positive excess is retained, attenuated for broadly firing maps, and combined with a small rank term. The method fits reference memories and projections without gradient optimization or anomaly labels. Prevalence and ranks depend on the complete scored sequence, making inference batch and transductive rather than online. On 180 series from 17 TSB-AD-M families, ExCal obtains AUC-PR $0.421\pm0.37$ and VUS-PR $0.452\pm0.37$ over three seeds, ranking second among 24 methods. Holm-adjusted paired tests detect no significant difference from AxonAD or StreamVAE, which are the two leading non-pretrained methods on TSB-AD-M, on either primary metric, while finding significant positive differences against the other 21 baselines. A separate single-run probe over three series measures median model-wrapper time of $0.0662$ s. Ablations associate the largest primary-metric changes with raw retrieval and excess-magnitude preservation. The evaluated score is decomposable by expert, but its diagnostic utility and online suitability remain untested.

AI.tldr: ExCal 是一个仅用正常数据训练的多变量时间序列异常检测器，结合原始状态检索、信号/导数子空间与多时间尺度稳健统计，在 TSB-AD-M 上24种方法中排名第二，与两个领先的非预训练方法无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 提出一种无需梯度优化、无需异常标签、仅依赖正常数据拟合的多变量时间序列异常检测方法，并在 TSB-AD-M 基准上与现有领先的无预训练方法进行严格比较。
AI.method: 组合三类"专家图"：原始状态检索、信号/导数子空间、跨时间尺度的稳健统计；每个专家图由训练前缀得到高正常性下限，评分时保留正向超额、对广泛触发的图做衰减，并叠加小秩项；参考记忆与投影无梯度优化，用完整评分序列确定流行度与秩（批量、直推式推理）。
AI.result: 在17个 TSB-AD-M 家族的180条序列上，三随机种子平均 AUC-PR 0.421±0.37、VUS-PR 0.452±0.37，24种方法中排名第二；Holm 校正配对检验显示与 AxonAD、StreamVAE 无显著差异，而显著优于其余21个基线；单次探针测得中位模型-包装耗时 0.0662 s；消融显示原始检索与超额幅度保留影响最大。
AI.conclusion: ExCal 在无需预训练与标签的条件下达到与领先非预训练方法相当的性能，且评分可分解到各专家；但其诊断价值与在线适用性尚未验证，且受限于批量直推式推理。

title: Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery
summary: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR

AI.tldr: 提出DiffTR，一个基于坐标条件扩散的无监督框架，将张量补全、去噪与高光谱超分辨统一到同一表示学习中。
AI.motivation: 张量恢复涉及异构数据结构与观测过程，需要一种能跨模态、跨任务自适应的统一表示方法。
AI.method: 以张量坐标索引的共享因子条件化紧凑得分网络，通过得分匹配联合学习因子与隐式张量表示；支持标量与向量输出以统一表格张量、图像和视频；将表示学习与任务特定观测建模分离——反向扩散补全缺失值，基于Tweedie公式、软阈值与空间一致性去噪，测量引导采样实现超分辨，并以数据一致性与谱子空间正则后处理。
AI.result: 在多种张量模态与恢复任务上取得有竞争力的重建质量，体现出统一条件生成表示的灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 该分离式设计使表示可兼容不同退化模型，并支持在同一框架中引入任务特定约束。代码已开源。

title: Distilling neural networks into equations to predict planetary instability
comment: 32 pages, 15 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/simonalford42/planet_eqs
summary: The problem of predicting when a multi-planet system will become dynamically unstable has defied analytical progress over the past three hundred years. Recent machine learning advances achieve high predictive performance of instability dynamics, but as black-box systems cannot be interpreted to connect to existing scientific understanding. Here we show analytic equations that predict when a multi-planet system will undergo instability. We discover these equations by first training a neural network on a dataset of N-body simulations, and then distilling its latent knowledge into closed-form algebraic expressions. Our two-stage pipeline first learns an interpretable variable basis, then searches for equations using symbolic regression. The resulting equations outperform existing analytic estimates of instability and apply across wide ranges of mass ratios, spacing, and orbital eccentricities. They capture structure in the prediction landscape with a small number of variables amenable to dynamical interpretation. These results demonstrate how symbolic learning can be combined with neural networks to extract scientific insight from complex dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 通过"神经网络+符号回归"的两阶段管道,首次导出可解析、可解释的多行星系统动力学不稳定性预测方程,其精度超过现有解析估计。
AI.motivation: 多行星系统何时失稳的预测三百年来缺乏解析进展;近年机器学习虽预测精度高,但黑箱模型无法与既有科学理解相联系,难以提供洞见。
AI.method: 在N体模拟数据集上先训练神经网络,再将其潜在知识蒸馏为闭式代数表达式。两阶段管道:先学习可解释的变量基,再用符号回归搜索方程。
AI.result: 所得方程优于现有解析不稳定性估计,且适用于大范围的质量比、间距和轨道偏心率;以少量可做动力学解释的变量刻画出预测景观中的结构。
AI.conclusion: 符号学习与神经网络结合,可从复杂动力系统中提取科学洞见,实现可解释的解析预测。

title: GIFT: Representation Geometry Matters for Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection
summary: Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) aims to generalize from a single source domain to unseen domains under distribution shifts. Existing efforts mainly focus on simulating unseen domains or suppressing domain-specific factors. However, they largely overlook the intrinsic generalization capability embedded in Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). In this work, we show that unconstrained fine-tuning disrupts the geometric structure of pre-trained representations, which encodes domain-invariant semantics. Motivated by this, we propose Geometric-Invariance Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a geometric-aware fine-tuning method for VFMs. Specifically, we introduce a series of learnable Householder reflections to the pre-trained weights to encourage geometry-consistent adaptation under domain shift. In addition, we propose a lightweight channel-wise scaling to facilitate effective task-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches on two S-DGOD benchmarks. Notably, by introducing fewer than 1% additional trainable parameters into the frozen backbone, the proposed method achieves improvements of +7.9% and +2.9% in mPC over the previous SOTA on the Cityscapes-C and Diverse Weather Dataset, respectively. This finding highlights that preserving representation geometry is crucial for robust cross-domain generalization, establishing GIFT as a principled and efficient solution to domain shift.

AI.tldr: 提出几何不变性微调方法GIFT，通过可学习的Householder反射保持VFM预训练表示的几何结构，实现单源域泛化目标检测。
AI.motivation: 现有S-DGOD方法主要依赖模拟未见域或抑制域特定因素，却忽视了视觉基础模型（VFM）本身固有的泛化能力。作者发现无约束微调会破坏预训练表示中的几何结构，而该结构编码了域不变语义。
AI.method: 在预训练权重上引入一系列可学习的Householder反射，促使模型在域偏移下进行几何一致的适应；并设计轻量的通道级缩放以支持有效的任务特定适应。冻结主干，仅增加不到1%的可训练参数。
AI.result: 在两个S-DGOD基准上持续优于SOTA；在Cityscapes-C和Diverse Weather Dataset上mPC分别提升+7.9%和+2.9%，额外可训练参数不足1%。
AI.conclusion: 保持表示几何结构对鲁棒的跨域泛化至关重要，GIFT为域偏移问题提供了原理清晰且高效的解决方案。

title: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Pretrain to Adapt
summary: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.

AI.tldr: 提出OpTTA：在测试时适应世界模型时，目标函数除预测损失外加规划器"到达目标代价"项，使模型对达成目标持乐观态度；在操作/到达/导航任务上把规划成功率较冻结模型提升约13.5个百分点，显著优于仅预测目标（6.9）。
AI.motivation: 潜空间世界模型通常离线预训练后冻结，遇到分布偏移时规划性能下降；测试时适应(TTA)可缓解，但TTA用于规划是闭环的：规划器用模型 rollout 选动作，产生的转移又驱动下一次更新。仅用预测损失时，模型只拟合自身动作的结果，对"能达成目标的动作"仍可能判断错误，低预测误差未必带来更好的规划。
AI.method: 受自适应控制中"奖励偏置最大似然"启发，提出乐观测试时适应(OpTTA)。其目标含两项：观测转移上的预测损失 + 规划器在候选 rollouts 上的到达目标代价，二者均对模型参数最小化。该规划项无需额外环境交互，即可将适应偏向"对达成目标乐观"的模型。
AI.result: 在视觉与动力学偏移下，覆盖操作、到达、导航任务：仅适应预测器时，OpTTA 最终规划成功率平均比冻结模型高13.5个百分点，而仅预测目标(AdaJEPA)为6.9；同时适应编码器时为13.5 vs 7.5。实验涵盖三种不同编码器与训练目标的JEPA世界模型，以及CEM与基于梯度的规划器。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型用于规划的测试时适应，在预测损失之外加入乐观的、任务相关的项能带来实质收益。

title: ACSAN: All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network Integrating Convolutional Operations with Vision Transformer
summary: In the past few years, Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved excellent performance in the field of computer vision. However, there still some problems remain. For instance, ViTs heavily rely on large-scale training data since they simply contain a large number of trainable parameters, which slows down their learning efficiency and limits their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model, namely All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which applies convolution operations to replace fully-connected matrices multiplications in the ViT framework. To implement ACSAN, we firstly design Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) as the basic module, which employs multi-scale dilated convolutions to generate Query, Key, and Value. We defined spatial self-attention and channel self-attention to generate attention features respectively. The two attention features are finally merged as the output of the DCSA module. Based on DCSA, we then construct the basic ACSAN block. Comparing with ViT, we use DCSA to replace the regular self-attention operations, and use convolution layers to replace MLPs. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we train ACSAN on three widely-used image classification databases, i.e. CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k, from scratch. Experimental results show that ACSAN achieves excellent classification accuracy comparing with standard ViT with comparable or fewer parameters, as well as other state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify that each component contributes positively to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 提出全卷积自注意力网络ACSAN，用卷积替代ViT中的全连接矩阵乘法，在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k上从零训练即取得优于标准ViT的分类精度，且参数量相当或更少。
AI.motivation: ViT参数规模大、严重依赖大规模训练数据，导致学习效率低，难以适用于资源受限场景。作者希望减弱对全连接矩阵乘法的依赖以提升效率。
AI.method: 核心模块为动态卷积自注意力（DCSA）：用多尺度空洞卷积生成Query、Key、Value；分别构造空间自注意力与通道自注意力，再将两者特征融合作为DCSA输出。在此基础上构建ACSAN基本块，以DCSA替换常规自注意力，以卷积层替换MLP。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k上从头训练，ACSAN在参数量与标准ViT相当或更少的情况下取得更优分类精度，并优于其他先进方法；消融实验证明各组件均有正向贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以卷积全面替代ViT中的矩阵乘法是可行且有效的，可在不增加参数的前提下提升分类性能；但摘要未给出具体精度与参数数值，也未验证在更大规模或非分类任务上的泛化性。

title: Proofs of strong forms of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture and a complex analogue
summary: We prove two universality theorems for neural networks consisting of a single neuron. First we prove a strong form of the Bovdi--Geche universality conjecture on neurons over finite fields, where the activation function is a certain modification of the discrete logarithm, using the Weil bound on multiplicative character sums over finite fields. Then we show a generalisation of Aizenberg's universality theorem for complex binary neurons with a weight vector independent of the target function, positively answering another question in the literature. The proof of the latter uses an equidistribution theorem for the dilates of certain maps into tori.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了单神经元神经网络的两个普适性定理：有限域上关于Bovdi–Geche猜想的强形式，以及复数二元神经元上Aizenberg定理的推广。
AI.motivation: 单神经元网络的表达能力和普适性问题是神经网络理论的基础问题，Bovdi–Geche猜想和Aizenberg定理的相关推广问题在文献中尚未解决。
AI.method: 有限域情形下使用有限域乘法特征和的Weil界；复数情形下利用某些映射到环面上的伸缩等分布定理。
AI.result: 证明了有限域神经元上Bovdi–Geche普适性猜想的强形式（激活函数为离散对数的某种变形），并证明了权重向量与目标函数无关的复数二元神经元普适性定理的推广。
AI.conclusion: 两类单神经元网络均具有普适性，正面回答了文献中两个公开问题，并将数论工具（Weil界、等分布理论）引入神经网络普适性研究。

title: Toward Clinical Translation of Deep Learning-Based Intracranial Super-Resolution 4D Flow MRI Using Multi-Cohort Transfer Learning
comment: 28 pages, 6 main figures, 4 main tables; supplementary material includes 6 sections, 2 figures, and 1 table
summary: We evaluated synthetic pretraining and multi-cohort transfer learning for deep learning-based super-resolution of intracranial 4D Flow MRI across heterogeneous neurologic cohorts. This mixed prospective-retrospective study analyzed 18 participants (12 healthy participants, 3 with moyamoya disease, and 3 with multiple sclerosis) with paired 1.2-mm and 0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI scans. A convolutional neural network pretrained on synthetic cerebrovascular data was fine-tuned using cohort-specific or pooled multi-cohort in vivo data. High-resolution-derived inputs enabled voxel-wise evaluation; native standard-resolution scans were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Synthetic pretraining reduced mean artery-wise velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE) versus interpolation (0.147 vs 0.166). Pooled transfer learning yielded the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for cohort-specific models and 0.147 for synthetic pretraining), with narrower 95% limits-of-agreement widths than synthetic pretraining across all test cases (0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s). Super-resolved phase-contrast angiography achieved higher precision-recall area under the curve than native standard-resolution imaging in all cohorts (0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805). These results indicate that pooled transfer learning improves cross-cohort reconstruction agreement and that super-resolution can improve vessel depiction, supporting further multi-center validation for cerebrovascular imaging.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了合成数据预训练与多队列迁移学习用于颅内4D Flow MRI超分辨率的可行性，发现汇总多队列迁移学习能提升跨队列重建一致性，超分辨率可改善血管成像质量。
AI.motivation: 颅内4D Flow MRI受限于分辨率，深度学习超分辨率需在异质性神经系统队列中验证其泛化性与重建可靠性，尤其是数据稀缺下的训练策略选择（合成预训练 vs 真实多队列迁移）。
AI.method: 前瞻-回顾混合研究，纳入18名受试者（12健康、3烟雾病、3多发性硬化），均有配对的1.2 mm与0.6 mm 4D Flow MRI。采用在合成脑血管数据上预训练的CNN，再用队列特异性或汇总多队列体内数据进行微调；以高分辨率衍生输入做体素级评估，用原生标准分辨率扫描做血管造影与血流动力学分析。
AI.result: 合成预训练较插值降低平均动脉vNRMSE（0.147 vs 0.166）；汇总迁移学习得到最低vNRMSE（0.119，队列特异0.127，合成预训练0.147），且95%一致性界限宽度在所有测试中均更窄（0.109–0.222 vs 0.154–0.278 m/s）；超分辨率相位对比血管造影在各队列中PR-AUC均高于原生标准分辨率（0.848–0.896 vs 0.486–0.805）。
AI.conclusion: 汇总多队列迁移学习优于合成预训练与队列特异模型，能提升跨队列重建一致性；超分辨率可改善血管描绘，支持开展多中心验证以推进脑血管影像应用。

title: Active Learning of Conditional Generative Models via the Transport Neural Tangent Kernel
summary: Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict outcomes at new inputs. Acquiring experimental data at new conditions (e.g., for a new antigen or a new cell type) is often expensive, motivating the need for automated experimental design methods. However, existing active learning frameworks are limited as they assume scalar or vector-valued outputs. We first show that the Wasserstein test risk of a conditional generative task decomposes into a mean term and a shape term, demonstrating why mean-based active learning is blind to distributional shape. To capture both, we propose the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), a tractable kernel that measures how sensitive a generative model's predicted distribution is with respect to its parameters. The tNTK recovers the standard NTK in the deterministic limit and upper-bounds the posterior Fréchet variance of the prediction under small parameter perturbations. It admits a closed-form expression for affine Gaussian transport and tractable Monte Carlo estimators otherwise. Treating the tNTK as the covariance function of a Gaussian process, we greedily select inputs that minimize the total GP posterior variance across the pool, yielding a distribution-aware active learning strategy. We evaluate this strategy across four classes of conditional generative models, including conditional flow matching and conditional Monge gap, on synthetic distributions, intent-labeled sentences, and single-cell perturbation responses. In these experiments, the tNTK outperforms the baseline NTK computed from the conditional mean, demonstrating the value of distribution-aware active learning for generative-modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出tNTK（transport Neural Tangent Kernel），一种对条件生成模型输出分布敏感的可处理核，用于分布感知的主动学习（实验设计），在多种条件生成模型与数据集上优于基于条件均值的NTK基线。
AI.motivation: 高通量实验产生分布型输出，需条件生成模型来预测新输入下的结果；获取新条件下的数据（新抗原、新细胞类型）代价高，需要自动实验设计。但现有主动学习假设输出是标量或向量，忽略分布形状。作者先证明条件生成任务的Wasserstein测试风险可分解为均值项与形状项，说明基于均值的主动学习对分布形状"视而不见"。
AI.method: 提出tNTK：度量生成模型预测分布对参数的敏感性的可处理核。性质包括：确定性极限下退化为标准NTK；在参数小扰动下上界预测的后验Fréchet方差；仿射高斯传输情形有闭式表达，其他情形可用蒙特卡洛估计。将tNTK作为高斯过程的协方差函数，贪心地选择使池上总GP后验方差最小的输入，得到分布感知的主动学习策略。
AI.result: 在四类条件生成模型（含条件flow matching与条件Monge gap）上评测，涵盖合成分布、意图标注句子和单细胞扰动响应。tNTK在各实验中均优于由条件均值计算的NTK基线。
AI.conclusion: 分布感知的主动学习对生成建模任务有价值：仅关注均值的采集函数会遗漏形状信息，tNTK能同时捕捉均值与形状，是有效的实验设计准则。

title: Unveil the Mask: Jointly-Optimized Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Appearance-Agnostic Operator Verification
comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026 Workshop on Who Is Behind the Avatar? (WBA)
summary: Photorealistic avatar videos decouple the appearance of a rendered face from the person who operates it, which makes conventional face recognition unsuitable for identifying the operator. Verifying the operator therefore requires representations of how a face moves that are insensitive to what the avatar looks like. We propose a verification framework built without any external pretrained model. It uses two complementary modalities provided for each sample: facial landmark sequences and video frames. From the landmark modality, it learns motion representations by diffusion masked pretraining over grouped landmarks, guided by lightweight auxiliary tasks that predict behavioral cues such as motion intensity and eye openness, and turns them into operator embeddings with a contrastive linear probe. To generalize to unseen avatar generators, the pretraining input is randomly transformed to simulate how a generator may alter the operator's motion. From the video modality, it captures fine facial motion through differences between consecutive frames. The embeddings of the two modalities are combined into one. Our approach reaches an overall AUC of 0.769 on the WBA2026 benchmark. Linear probing shows that the video embedding retains little information about the avatar's identity, whereas the landmark embedding retains some, and fusing the two modalities improves verification in particular across speaking and listening modes.

AI.tldr: 提出无外部预训练模型的算子验证框架，利用人脸关键点序列与视频帧双模态学习与外观无关的运动表征，在WBA2026基准取得0.769 AUC。
AI.motivation: 逼真虚拟人视频将渲染人脸的外观与操控者解耦，使传统人脸识别无法识别操控者，因此需要对面部运动方式建模，且该表征需对虚拟人外观不敏感。
AI.method: 不使用任何外部预训练模型。关键点模态：对分组关键点做扩散掩码预训练，辅以预测运动强度、眼睛开合等行为线索的轻量辅助任务，并用对比线性探针转为操控者嵌入；预训练输入随机变换以模拟生成器对运动的改变，提升跨生成器泛化。视频模态：用相邻帧差分捕捉细微面部运动。最后融合两模态嵌入。
AI.result: 在WBA2026基准上总体AUC达0.769。线性探针显示视频嵌入几乎不含虚拟人身份信息，关键点嵌入保留部分信息；两模态融合尤其提升说话与聆听模式下的验证效果。
AI.conclusion: 运动导向的双模态表征可有效验证虚拟人操控者；视频模态更外观无关，关键点模态含更多运动判别信息，二者互补融合带来增益。

title: A Hybrid Framework for Explainable Aviation Risk: Causal Chain Extraction from Safety Reports with Physics-Based Failure Quantification and Interventional Analysis
summary: Aviation authorities hold decades of accident reports whose narratives record how investigators reconstructed each accident. Computational work on these archives has mostly sorted reports into fixed taxonomies. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework in which a text-based corpus identifies the leading factors of a failure mode. Physics-based models then quantify how likely that failure is at a stated operating point. Ordered causal chains extracted from 56,202 American accident reports with a local large language model aggregate into a causation knowledge graph. On an evaluation sample of 2,000 reports, the chains recover 90.8% of investigator-flagged causes. Each physical factor whose drivers the record carries receives an occurrence model calibrated to the accident population. A leaky noisy-OR fitted to the corpus combines the factors into a failure mode probability that supports intervention. For engine power loss, the carburetor icing model separates 1,205 icing accidents from other accidents using temperature and dewpoint alone, reaching 0.61 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve against a density ratio ceiling of 0.64. Routine weather hours give no valid control, because flying concentrates in fair weather. On later years the physics adds 0.03 to that area for occurrence and nothing for severity, so its value lies in interpretability. On four named accidents, abduction gives a probability of necessity of 0.29 to 0.50 for the heat omission, under monotonicity. The Fast Causal Inference algorithm does not license the largest backdoor adjustment on the learned networks.

AI.tldr: 提出"语料+物理"混合框架：用本地LLM从56,202份美国事故报告中抽取有序因果链并构建因果知识图谱，识别失效模式的主导因素，再由物理模型在给定工况下量化失效概率，并以leaky noisy-OR合成概率。
AI.motivation: 航空当局积累数十年事故报告，记录调查员如何重建每起事故，但已有计算研究多只把报告归入固定分类体系，未利用其中的因果结构；同时纯数据驱动的失效概率缺乏可解释性与物理约束，需要在真实工况点上给出可干预的概率估计。
AI.method: 用本地大语言模型从56,202份美国事故报告中抽取有序因果链，聚合成因果知识图谱；为记录载有其驱动因素的物理因素建立校准于事故总体的发生模型；用基于语料的leaky noisy-OR把各因素合成失效模式概率；以汽化器结冰为例用温度与露点建模；并用溯因（abduction）与FCI算法做因果推断检验。
AI.result: 在2,000份报告评估样本上，因果链覆盖调查员标注原因的90.8%。汽化器结冰模型仅用温度与露点即可区分1,205起结冰事故，AUC 0.61（密度比上限0.64）；常规天气小时不构成有效对照（飞行集中于晴好天气）；后续年份物理项对发生概率的AUC仅增0.03，对严重度无增益。四起具名事故中，"热源遗漏"的必要性概率在单调性假设下为0.29–0.50；FCI算法不支持对所学网络做最大的后门调整。
AI.conclusion: 文本语料可高覆盖地恢复事故成因，物理模型的价值主要在于可解释性与假设透明的干预评估，而非精度提升；因果发现方法对所得网络的调整效力有严格限制，结果需谨慎解读。

title: OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery
comment: Published in Remote Sensing 18(20), 3535 (2026). Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/ce-dric/OBB-PBD and https://huggingface.co/ce-dric/OBB-PBD
summary: Referring expression grounding in overhead imagery requires oriented bounding boxes rather than horizontal ones, since aerial objects appear at arbitrary orientations. Most grounding models emit box coordinates sequentially; Parallel Box Decoding (PBD) instead predicts all geometry slots in one forward pass, but only for four-coordinate horizontal boxes. We extend this block-aligned interface to a six-slot oriented representation using a double-angle parameterization. Rather than assuming correctness from a decreasing loss curve, we verify the extension with image/prompt-shuffle controls and visibility/leakage probes, which show that the corrected model depends on both the image and the prompt rather than on prompt statistics alone. On the aerial vehicle visual grounding (AVVG) benchmark, whose targets are genuinely oriented, the extended model improves rotated intersection over union (rotIoU) from 0.1253 for the zero-shot baseline to 0.303 +/- 0.012 (mean +/- standard deviation over three training seeds) across the complete 6139-record test split spanning all 120 images. Learning oriented boxes rather than their axis-aligned envelopes adds 0.055 +/- 0.008 rotIoU beyond a matched control (per-seed 95% confidence intervals all excluding zero), whereas block expansion alone yields no rotIoU gain distinguishable from zero.

AI.tldr: 该论文将并行框解码（PBD）从四坐标水平框扩展到六槽有向框表示，采用双角度参数化实现遥感图像指称表达定位，并在AVVG基准上用图像/提示词打乱控制与可见性/泄漏探针验证模型确实依赖图像和提示词。扩展模型rotIoU从零样本基线0.1253提升至0.303±0.012，且有向框相比轴对齐包络额外带来0.055±0.008的rotIoU增益。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中的目标朝向任意，指称表达定位需要定向边界框而非水平框；现有PBD虽能一次前向预测全部几何槽，但仅支持四坐标水平框，直接扩展到有向表示后必须验证其是否真正利用了图像与提示词信息，而不能仅凭损失曲线下降判断正确性。
AI.method: 将PBD的块对齐接口扩展为六槽有向框表示，采用双角度参数化；通过图像/提示词打乱对照实验以及可见性/泄漏探针，检验模型对图像和提示词的依赖，而非仅依赖提示词统计量；并设置匹配控制组与块扩展消融，隔离有向框学习本身的效果。
AI.result: 在AVVG基准（6139条测试记录、120张图像、三个训练种子）上，rotIoU由零样本基线0.1253提升至0.303±0.012；相比匹配控制组，学习有向框比学习其轴对齐包络额外带来0.055±0.008 rotIoU（各种子95%置信区间均不含零），而单纯块扩展无显著rotIoU增益。
AI.conclusion: 六槽双角度PBD在有向遥感指称表达定位中有效，性能提升主要来源于有向框表示本身而非块扩展；结合干扰对照与泄漏探针的可信性验证，为后续航空定位模型评估提供了更严谨的范式。

title: SCAFFOLD under Hessian Similarity: Sharp Convergence Rates
summary: One of the main challenges of federated learning is heterogeneous data split among the clients, leading to biased local updates called client drift. The SCAFFOLD algorithm (Karimireddy et al., 2020) corrects client drift with control variates, but its relation to the similarity of client data is not yet fully understood: the original similarity-based guarantees cover only quadratics with a stronger second-order similarity assumption, and a follow-up weakly convex analysis (Luo et al., 2025) obtains a $\sqrt{Lδ}$ dependence for $L$-smooth losses with averaged Hessian similarity $δ$. We analyze SCAFFOLD with minibatch-based control variates and establish linear dependence on Hessian similarity beyond quadratics, for both convex and nonconvex objectives. In particular, for convex objectives with exact gradients, $R$ SCAFFOLD rounds with $K$ local steps lead to an objective gap of order $(L/K+δ)D_0^2/R$, where $D_0$ is the initial distance to a minimizer. When $K=Θ(L/δ)$, it improves the minibatch SGD rate by a factor $Θ(L/δ)$. For nonconvex objectives, we prove an analogous stationarity guarantee under uniform Hessian similarity for a client-selection variant. In both settings, we extend these guarantees to stochastic gradients and prove matching lower bounds for the analyzed methods with constant local stepsizes. We also show that, under partial participation, even identical clients need not obtain the full communication benefit of additional local steps.

AI.tldr: 本文分析带minibatch控制变量的SCAFFOLD算法，证明了在二次函数之外，对凸和非凸目标均能获得与Hessian相似度δ成线性依赖的收敛保证，并给出匹配下界。
AI.motivation: SCAFFOLD用控制变量修正client drift，但其与客户端数据相似度的关系理解不足：原有相似度保证只覆盖二次函数且需更强二阶相似假设，后续弱凸分析只得到√(Lδ)依赖。
AI.method: 对带minibatch控制变量的SCAFFOLD进行理论分析，覆盖凸与非凸目标、精确与随机梯度；非凸情形采用均匀Hessian相似度下的客户端选择变体；并推导常数局部步长下匹配的下界。
AI.result: 凸精确梯度下，R轮、每轮K步的目标间隙为O((L/K+δ)D₀²/R)；当K=Θ(L/δ)时比minibatch SGD速率提升Θ(L/δ)倍。非凸情形得到类似平稳性保证，并给出匹配下界；部分参与下即使客户端相同也未必获得额外局部步长的全部通信收益。
AI.conclusion: SCAFFOLD对Hessian相似度具有线性依赖，显著优于先前的√(Lδ)结果；同时揭示了部分参与条件下局部步长收益的局限。

title: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
summary: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

AI.tldr: 提出TP-JSCC，结合局部/全局语义混合token剪枝与token级联合信源信道编码，为云边协同下LVLM的3D-VQA实现180倍数据压缩与鲁棒传输。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限具身智能体上部署大型视觉语言模型做3D视觉问答需要云边协同，但带宽受限且有噪声的信道下上传海量视觉数据会带来严重时延与传输失真。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：(1) LGS-HTP混合token剪枝，解耦前景/背景token并联合选择局部与全局语义，剔除冗余同时保留推理关键token；(2) T-JSCC轻量token级联合信源信道编码，用级联线性层与SNR自适应机制进一步压缩并抗信道差错，计算开销极小。
AI.result: 在ScanQA与SQA3D上验证：ScanQA验证集上LGS-HTP达90%剪枝率且CIDEr损失<1%；T-JSCC再将token压缩18倍，整体数据量减少180倍，LVLM部署计算复杂度降低90%。
AI.conclusion: TP-JSCC在保持精度的前提下显著降低传输数据量与计算开销，并具备对信道波动的鲁棒性，适合云边协同的具身3D-VQA部署。

title: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
summary: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: CounterFlow：基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的反事实解释框架，直接在像素空间将源图导向用户指定目标类别，生成高真实感、低计算开销的视觉反事实解释，性能达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉反事实解释方法多依赖GAN或扩散模型，计算开销大、部署成本高。作者希望提供更实用、更贴近真实部署的方案，同时保持高真实感与有效的目标类别切换能力。
AI.method: 提出CounterFlow框架，利用条件流匹配（CFM）构建目标类别条件化的向量场，直接在原始像素空间中将源图像"引导"向用户指定的目标类别，从而产生语义上合理且真实的修改，而无需GAN/扩散架构。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的实验表明，CounterFlow在视觉真实感与目标类别切换两方面均达到SOTA；同时计算开销显著低于传统GAN或扩散方法。
AI.conclusion: CounterFlow证明在原始像素空间使用条件流匹配生成反事实解释是可行且高效的，兼顾真实感、有效性、低算力，为实际部署提供更实用的反事实解释方案。

title: S$^2$-RL: Sample-Set Dual Reinforcement Learning for Generative Semantic Segmentation Dataset Distillation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://00why00.github.io/S2RL/
summary: While dataset distillation has witnessed significant advances in image classification, its extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation is plagued by two core bottlenecks: bi-level optimization-based approaches suffer from prohibitive computational costs stemming from pixel-wise gradient unrolling, whereas proxy-based generative methods merely infuse visual textures into fixed semantic masks derived from real data, thus failing to condense rich semantic knowledge into a compact set of informative, novel scene generations. To address both bottlenecks simultaneously, we propose a novel Sample-Set Reinforcement Learning (S$^2$-RL) framework for generative semantic segmentation dataset distillation (SSDD). Specifically, S$^2$-RL formulates SSDD as a diffusion model based text-to-image generation paradigm, enabling flexible generation of images with informative, novel semantic distributions via a concise text prompt. Furthermore, we fine-tune a diffusion policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), leveraging a sample-set dual reward paradigm: for individual samples, it enforces semantic alignment with input text prompts and intra-class feature diversity; for sample sets, it maximizes inter-sample semantic distribution diversity by solving a contextual multi-armed bandit problem. These design choices enable S$^2$-RL to distill large-scale semantic segmentation datasets into a compact set of generated samples that encapsulate diverse, informative semantic knowledge without the need of pixel-wise gradient unrolling. Extensive experiments on the ADE20K and COCO datasets demonstrate that S$^2$-RL achieves substantial and consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, establishing a new benchmark for SSDD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S²-RL框架，将生成式语义分割数据集蒸馏（SSDD）建模为基于扩散模型的文生图生成任务，并用GRPO微调扩散策略，以"样本-集合"双重奖励实现高效、多样化的场景生成。
AI.motivation: 语义分割等密集预测任务上的数据集蒸馏受两大瓶颈制约：基于双层优化的方法需逐像素梯度展开，计算代价高昂；基于代理的生成方法只是把视觉纹理注入来自真实数据的固定语义掩码，无法将丰富语义知识压缩为紧凑、新颖的场景生成。
AI.method: 将SSDD形式化为扩散模型驱动的文生图生成范式，用简洁文本提示灵活生成具有信息量高、新颖语义分布的图像；再用GRPO微调扩散策略，采用样本-集合双重奖励：单样本层面约束与文本提示的语义对齐及类内特征多样性，集合层面通过求解上下文多臂老虎机问题最大化样本间语义分布多样性。整个过程无需逐像素梯度展开。
AI.result: 在ADE20K和COCO数据集上的大量实验表明，S²-RL相较最先进基线取得显著且一致的提升，为SSDD树立了新基准。
AI.conclusion: S²-RL同时缓解了计算成本与语义知识浓缩两大瓶颈，证明强化学习驱动的生成式蒸馏可为语义分割数据集蒸馏提供高效且语义丰富的新范式。

title: GNN-VIEW: Visual Inspection and Explanation of Graph-based Earth-System Models
comment: Accepted to The 2nd Workshop on Advances in Representation Learning for Earth Observation at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Machine learning Earth-system models are becoming increasingly important, and so is their development. Graph-based models, one of the most prominent approaches, allow developers to constrain the learning process before training via graph connectivity. Yet, developing these models remains challenging: the graph is built algorithmically with little intuition about the final result beyond static plotting, which requires extra work and is often not detailed enough. Even after successful training, how the model arrives at forecasts remains obscure. We present GNN-VIEW, an interactive browser-based tool that supports the development of such systems. GNN-VIEW exposes the graph's information pathways, allowing model developers to debug the graph structure before training. After training, GNN-VIEW uses attribution-based explainability to reveal which input features are used by the trained model for a given forecast. This helps developers understand why a model fails. We showcase the usefulness of GNN-VIEW in the construction stage of a graph for an ocean forecasting model, and in explaining poorly predicted precipitation of a trained weather forecasting model during Hurricane Laura.

AI.tldr: GNN-VIEW 是浏览器交互工具，用于开发基于图的 Earth-system 模型：训练前可视化图的信息路径以调试结构，训练后用归因方法解释预报所用输入特征。
AI.motivation: 基于图的机器学习 Earth-system 模型图由算法生成，静态绘图难以直观理解其结构与最终结果；训练成功后模型如何得出预报仍不清楚，失败原因难诊断。
AI.method: 构建基于浏览器的交互式可视化工具 GNN-VIEW，暴露图的信息通路用于训练前结构调试；训练后采用基于归因的可解释性方法揭示给定预报所依赖的输入特征。
AI.result: 在海洋预报模型构图阶段展示了其可用性，并用于解释一个已训练天气预报模型在 Laura 飓风期间降水预测不佳的原因。
AI.conclusion: GNN-VIEW 支持图神经 Earth-system 模型从构图到训练后解释的完整开发流程，有助于开发者调试结构并理解失败原因。

title: Learning Scene Coordinate Reconstruction from Unposed Images via Pose Graph Optimization
summary: Learning-based structure-from-motion methods such as ACE-Zero have demonstrated strong performance in estimating cameraposes and scene coordinates from unordered image collections without requiring ground truth supervision. However, the lack of global and multi-view consistency constraints in ACE-Zero can lead to pose drift and misalignment, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenes. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates pose graph optimization (PGO) into ACE-Zero to refine camera poses and suppress incorrect refinements. We construct pose graphs directly from ACE-Zero outputs by extracting relative pose constraints from predicted scene coordinates. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-aware optimization strategy by estimating confidence scores using geometric priors, including epipolar and optical flow consistencies across views. Our approach improves the robustness and accuracy of pose estimation, demonstrating that global geometric reasoning can effectively complement learning-based inference in structure-from-motion.

AI.tldr: 将位姿图优化(PGO)与不确定性感知加权引入ACE-Zero，提升无序图像SfM的位姿估计鲁棒性与精度。
AI.motivation: ACE-Zero等学习式SfM方法无需真值监督即可从无序图像估计相机位姿与场景坐标，但缺乏全局与多视图一致性约束，在复杂或歧义场景中易出现位姿漂移与错位。
AI.method: 提出混合框架：从ACE-Zero预测的场景坐标中提取相对位姿约束，直接构建位姿图并执行PGO以精化相机位姿、抑制错误修正；同时利用几何先验（跨视图的对极约束与光流一致性）估计置信度分数，实现不确定性感知的加权优化策略。
AI.result: 提升了位姿估计的鲁棒性与准确性，表明全局几何推理能有效补充学习式推理在SfM中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 全局几何优化与学习式推断具有互补性，将PGO与不确定性加权融合进ACE-Zero是可提升SfM位姿估计性能的有效途径。

title: MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors
comment: 20 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://github.com/runchu-tian/MiRL
summary: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Misbehavior-driven RL（MiRL），将"错误靶向学习"应用于长程终端智能体：先挖掘跨环境复现的"错误行为"（misbehavior），再从这些错误步骤起始做 RL 训练，仅在通过测试且不重复错误时给奖励。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，八类错误行为占错误步骤的 52.1%；训练后未见过前缀上的重复率下降 43%–57%，并在 Terminal-Bench Lite 上以 51.8% 超过 TMax-4B 的 47.4%，在 2.1 上持平（21.3% vs 20.6%），rollout 用量仅为其 35%。
AI.motivation: 错误靶向学习（定位弱项→训练修复→验证是否修复）思路清晰，但现有方法面向单轮任务；而对智能体失败的分析多用于评估和调试，而非训练。如何将其推广到与命令行 shell 交互、完成自然语言长程任务的终端智能体，是本文动机。
AI.method: MiRL 分两步：1）对策略的错误进行画像，找出跨多个环境反复出现的"可泛化错误行为"（错误步骤的类型）；2）做强化学习，rollout 从这些错误行为发生的步骤处开始，只有当轨迹通过测试且不再犯该错误行为时才给予奖励，从而在不丢弃已有能力的前提下针对性修复弱项。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3.5-4B 为例，八种错误行为覆盖了 52.1% 的错误步骤；训练后在未见过的前缀上，测得错误行为的重复率平均降低 43%–57%。下游评测：Terminal-Bench Lite 51.8% vs TMax-4B 47.4%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 21.3% vs 20.6%（基本持平），而 rollout 消耗仅为 TMax-4B 的 35%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明错误靶向学习可有效用于真实、长程的终端任务，既减少可泛化的错误行为，又以更低采样成本取得有竞争力的表现。

title: HiFiPix: Bringing High-Fidelity Real-World Super-Resolution Back to Pixel Space
summary: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high-faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix, a pixel-space Real-ISR framework capable of ultra high-fidelity reconstruction and fine-grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art latent space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: HiFiPix 是一个像素空间（非潜在空间）的真实世界图像超分框架，通过小波判别器、混合对比自蒸馏和选择性 LoRA 剪枝，同时解决块边界伪影与生成能力退化问题，实现高保真重建与细粒度生成效果。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的 Real-ISR 因 VAE 潜在表征的信息损失而重建保真度受限。像素空间扩散模型可避免压缩、保真度高，但直接迁移面临两大障碍：分块（patch）边界伪影，以及预训练模型生成能力退化。
AI.method: 1) 跨尺度小波判别器 CWSD，在图像级惩罚不真实的高频周期分量以抑制块边界伪影；2) 混合对比自蒸馏 MixCSD，对中间表征做正则化；3) 发现 LoRA 层存在异构的生成-保真权衡，提出选择性 LoRA 剪枝 LoRA-SP，自适应裁剪 LoRA 层，在重建保真度几乎不降的前提下提升生成能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HiFiPix 在复原精度与感知质量两方面均大幅、稳定地超越现有最先进的潜在空间方法。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间扩散模型经针对性改造（伪影抑制+LoRA 剪枝）可充分发挥其高保真潜力，成为优于潜在空间范式的 Real-ISR 方案；代码与模型将开源。

title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.

AI.tldr: Triage：一种免训练的视频DiT注意力方法，将每个tile分配到"跳过（块均值替代）/NVFP4粗算/NVFP4残差精修"三档，用轻量router按误差-计算权衡决定升级，融合kernel单遍执行，端到端最高加速2.32x且PSNR优于所有基线0.3-3.0 dB。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中数万视觉token的注意力是推理瓶颈。现有稀疏化/低精度方法对所有保留tile使用统一精度，但作者观察到近似带来的输出误差在不同tile间差异极大：许多tile可跳过几乎无误差，一些只需低精度即可，少数即便低精度仍误差显著。统一精度因此浪费计算或损失质量。
AI.method: 免训练的tile级三档近似：(1) skip——用block均值替代直接跳过；(2) skim——NVFP4低精度计算；(3) refine——NVFP4加残差校正精修。轻量router依据block统计预测各档位下的tile误差，仅当预测误差下降足以抵偿额外计算时才升级档位，由单一"价格"参数控制权衡；并用融合kernel在RTX Blackwell的FP4张量核上单遍完成三档计算。
AI.result: 在Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo、LTX-2.5上，相比dense FlashAttention端到端生成最高加速2.32x；在全部五个设置中均快于所有基线，且PSNR比最高PSNR的基线高出0.3–3.0 dB。
AI.conclusion: 按tile误差自适应分配近似档位（而非统一精度）是视频DiT注意力加速的有效方向，配合硬件友好的FP4融合kernel，可在实际GPU上同时取得显著加速与更高质量。

title: Learning High-Quality Pseudo-Labels for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) aims to recognize and localize action instances in untrimmed videos using only point-level annotations. Existing pseudo-label-based methods have made substantial progress in PTAL. However, confidence-based initialization can overlook well-localized proposals. Meanwhile, existing methods either keep pseudo-labels fixed during detector training or update them without fully exploiting alternative boundary evidence from the original proposal pool. These limitations constrain supervision quality, thereby hindering detection performance. To learn high-quality pseudo-labels, we propose a framework that integrates prior-guided initialization with consensus-guided refinement during detector training. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived priors to establish instance-specific reliability for initial pseudo-label selection and candidate retention. CGR continually uses the retained original candidates to construct boundary targets, combining their consensus with evolving detector predictions to refine pseudo-labels throughout training. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. In particular, our method achieves 68.5\% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1--0.7 on THUMOS14, surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP

AI.tldr: 提出融合先验引导初始化与共识引导精炼的框架，用于点监督时序动作定位，生成高质量伪标签，在THUMOS14上达68.5%平均mAP。
AI.motivation: 现有基于伪标签的点监督时序动作定位方法存在问题：基于置信度的初始化会忽略定位良好的候选提案；且伪标签在训练中要么固定不变，要么更新时未充分利用原始提案池中的边界证据，限制了监督质量与检测性能。
AI.method: 框架包含两个模块：先验引导初始化（PGI）——结合提案置信度与点派生的先验，为初始伪标签选择与候选保留建立实例级可靠性；共识引导精炼（CGR）——持续利用保留的原始候选构造边界目标，将其共识与不断演化的检测器预测结合，在整个训练过程中精炼伪标签。
AI.result: 在四个基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能；在THUMOS14上tIoU 0.1–0.7平均mAP达68.5%，比PseR高3.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时提升伪标签的初始化与持续精炼质量，可有效改善点监督时序动作定位性能，验证了先验信息与候选共识的价值。

title: Detecting bus delays and service anomalies in Niterói with autoencoder latent feature representations
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Full report for the NetMob 2026 Data Challenge (Niterói, Brazil). Winner of the Best Poster award
summary: Bus riders judge service by two failures: single trips that run late, and days on which the whole system misbehaves. We ask whether one unsupervised representation of raw GPS telemetry can serve both diagnoses on the NetMob 2026 Niterói bus dataset. An autoencoder compresses each trip into a 64-dimensional latent vector; the frozen encoder feeds supervised delay classifiers, and the reconstruction error serves as an anomaly score. Two findings are negative. First, the latent representation does not improve delay detection: gradient boosting on per-trip summary features reaches $0.846 \pm 0.013$ ROC-AUC against $0.838 \pm 0.016$ for the best latent setup, and the gap becomes significant once the preprocessing filters are relaxed. Second, two of the three external checks of the anomaly score were circular. Retraining without rainfall removes the rain association ($5.4\%$ against $5.0\%$ flagged, $p = 0.84$) and an apparent citywide disruption on 23 March. What survives is a day-level signal stable across three autoencoders (Spearman $ρ\geq 0.96$), driven mostly by day type, with degraded-telemetry days still separable within weekday and weekend strata. The alarm threshold limits detection more than the score does: a pooled percentile cut flags $5.7\%$ of trips on the worst degraded day, while re-scaling within each bus line flags $29.3\%$. The delay model rests almost entirely on one feature, no latent dimension is individually interpretable, and 22 chronic line-directions carry half of all delayed trips.

AI.tldr: 用自编码器从Niterói公交GPS遥测中学单一无监督表示，同时服务于「单车晚点」与「系统异常日」两类诊断；结论偏负面：潜在表示未提升晚点检测，异常分数部分校验循环，日级信号勉强保留。
AI.motivation: 乘客对公交服务的感受集中在两类故障：单次行程晚点，以及整系统行为异常的日子。作者想检验一种无监督的GPS遥测表示能否同时支撑这两种诊断，从而避免为两个任务分别建模。
AI.method: 在NetMob 2026 Niterói公交数据集上训练自编码器，将每趟行程压缩为64维潜向量。冻结编码器后接监督式晚点分类器；同时用重构误差作为异常分数。对比基线为基于单趟汇总特征的梯度提升模型。异常分数做三项外部校验，并对比池化百分位阈值与按线路重新标定的阈值。
AI.result: 两项负面结果：(1) 潜表示未改善晚点检测——汇总特征梯度提升ROC-AUC为0.846±0.013，最佳潜表示方案为0.838±0.016，放宽预处理过滤后差距显著；(2) 异常分数的三项外部校验中两项存在循环性，去掉降雨重训后降雨关联消失（5.4% vs 5.0%，p=0.84），3月23日的全城扰动也随之消失。仍保留的是日级信号：跨三个自编码器稳定（Spearman ρ≥0.96），主要由日期类型驱动，降级遥测日在工作日/周末分层内仍可区分。阈值比分数更限制检测：池化百分位在最差降级日仅标记5.7%行程，按线路重标定则为29.3%。晚点模型几乎依赖单一特征，无单个潜维可解释，22条长期问题线路方向承担了一半的晚点行程。
AI.conclusion: 单一无监督表示未能同时胜任两个诊断任务：对个体晚点无增益，对系统异常仅剩脆弱的日级信号且高度依赖日期类型与阈值设定。日期类型混杂与阈值选择是此类异常检测评估的关键陷阱；运营洞察上，晚点高度集中于少数长期问题线路方向。

title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/
summary: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

AI.tldr: GenSfM 将基于图像的 3D 重建与原生 3D 扩散模型结合，用多模态扩散 Transformer 联合去噪形状隐变量与逐视图位姿隐变量，从未标定的少量视图恢复忠实于输入的完整 3D 物体与相机位姿。
AI.motivation: 从少量未标定视图恢复 3D 结构与相机运动是计算机视觉的基础难题。经典 SfM 无法补全未观测区域；原生 3D 生成方法产出合理但未必忠实于输入图像的物体；简单串联重建与生成会导致误差级联，难以同时满足数据分布与输入一致性。
AI.method: 提出 GenSfM：采用多模态扩散 Transformer，在共享自注意力下联合去噪形状隐变量与逐视图位姿隐变量，以观测视图约束生成几何、以物体级先验推断未观测区域；使用紧凑的 3D 原生 UV-volume tokenization，使联合序列随视图增加仍保持较小规模；再用位姿感知阶段在恢复的相机位姿上采样逐体素图像特征，精化几何与纹理。
AI.result: 在 Toys4k 与 GSO 上，使用 4 张未标定视图，相比强原生 3D 生成基线，新视图 PSNR 提升 3.2–4.5 dB，Chamfer 距离中位数降低 2.8–3.8 倍；在无需外部位姿估计主干、后处理优化或已知内参的情况下，输入视图位姿恢复达到 96% 以上 Acc@5°.
AI.conclusion: 将重建与生成在扩散框架内原生耦合，可同时保证几何对输入的忠实性与对未观测区域的合理补全，并隐式完成无标定位姿估计，避免两阶段误差级联。

title: Quantitative Generalization Bounds for Multi-Layer Transformers: A Few Long Strings can Beat Many Short Ones
summary: Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer ones.These two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. Finally, we illustrate how the requirements in the sample count and training length trade off. In particular, we find that increasing training length can be exponentially more efficient than increasing the sample size. Experiments support predictions of the theory.

AI.tldr: 该论文对固定精度Transformer联合分析了分布内统计泛化与长度泛化两条轴，给出以参数规模、量化空间和字母表大小为变量的泛化保证，并揭示增加训练长度可比增加样本数指数级更高效。
AI.motivation: Transformer能泛化到比训练时更长更难的问题，但理论理解滞后。现有研究通常把统计泛化与长度泛化分开讨论，二者如何交互仍不清楚，本文试图填补这一空白。
AI.method: 针对固定精度（量化）Transformer，联合刻画分布内泛化和长度外推两个维度，推导泛化界，界依赖模型参数规模、量化空间大小及序列字母表大小，并分析样本数与训练长度需求之间的权衡关系。
AI.result: 给出了联合双轴的泛化保证；发现增大训练长度相比增大样本数可带来指数级的效率提升；实验支持理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 统计泛化与长度泛化应被统一研究，固定精度Transformer在参数、量化与字母表约束下具备可证的联合泛化能力，且训练长度是比样本量更高效的资源。

title: EARS: Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and Motion for Budgeted Video Reasoning
summary: Uniform frame sampling can miss brief evidence in sparse-event videos when the VLM sees only K frames. We propose EARS (Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and motion), a training-free, query-free front-end that ranks frames using optical-flow motion and audio energy, then applies temporal non-maximum suppression for diversity. The evidence score alone has frame-level AP 0.39; used only to select frames for the VLM, EARS with temporal diversity reaches localization AP 0.94, compared with 0.88 under Uniform sampling. In the updated matched study, at K = 1 EARS reaches XD-subset F1 0.660 versus 0.614 for centered Uniform (the paired interval includes zero); earlier backbone studies use separate protocols. On mostly-silent UCF-Crime, however, EARS slightly trails Uniform. A single configuration is used across both benchmarks; the new controls do not repeat the original held-out search. EARS therefore targets low-budget videos whose salient evidence aligns with motion or audio; on dense narratives or stealthy events, uniform or semantic selection remains preferable, and cheap modality statistics cannot reliably route between them. Code: https://github.com/mikeslin-ir/EARS

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、免查询的前端EARS，用光流运动与音频能量为帧打分并经时间非极大值抑制选帧，在稀疏事件视频低帧预算下把定位AP从0.88提到0.94。
AI.motivation: VLM只接收K帧时，均匀采样容易漏掉稀疏事件视频中的短促关键证据；需要一种低成本、无需训练和查询的选帧方式提升有限帧预算下的证据覆盖。
AI.method: EARS对每帧融合光流运动量与原音频能量构成证据分数，再用时间非极大值抑制保证选帧的多样性；整套流程免训练、免查询，单一配置同时用于两个基准，不做重新调参或held-out搜索。
AI.result: 仅用证据分数做帧级排序AP为0.39；将其用于VLM选帧后，EARS定位AP达0.94（均匀采样0.88）。匹配研究K=1时XD子集F1为0.660，居中均匀采样为0.614，但配对区间包含零，且早期骨干实验协议不同；在以静音为主的UCF-Crime上EARS略逊于Uniform。
AI.conclusion: EARS适用于证据与运动或声音对齐的低预算视频；对密集叙事或隐蔽事件，均匀或语义选帧更优，且廉价模态统计不足以可靠地在两者间路由，需更审慎的适用性判断。

title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?
summary: Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; $Δ$ = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV's observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.

AI.tldr: 比较非生成式决策模型JEV与schema约束的Qwen Flash在临床试验预筛中的表现：JEV在MIMIC-III上显著更优（尤其对"信息不足"条件的召回），且延迟与成本更低。
AI.motivation: 临床预筛需区分患者记录中"条件未满足"与"证据不足"两种情况，而生成式LLM在这类判定上可能不可靠、成本高、延迟大；需评估非生成式方案在隐私合规（ZDR）下的可行性与性价比。
AI.method: 在严格零数据保留（ZDR）政策下，回顾性比较JEV（返回原选项概率的非生成式决策模型）与schema约束的Qwen Flash。数据为TrialGPT及源自MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV的问答数据集，共2,048个患者-条件测试对；两种模式下（单条/批处理共享患者上下文）对照参考标签评估，并比较延迟与成本。
AI.result: 批处理模式下：TrialGPT macro-F1相近（0.652 vs 0.660），MIMIC-IV相近（0.807 vs 0.814），但MIMIC-III上JEV大幅领先（0.768 vs 0.534，Δ=+0.234，95%CI 0.187–0.281），主要源于对"信息不足"标签的召回提升（56.3% vs 9.9%）。JEV中位作业延迟更低（1.18–1.40 s vs 2.80–8.90 s），每条件估计成本低53%–74%。
AI.conclusion: JEV适合作为初步评估组件，提供criterion级判断并标记信息缺口供人工复核；但其临床证据解读仍存在错误，输出须对照患者记录核验后方可用于资格决策。

title: Audit Where Hacks Pay: Budgeted Strong-Verifier Audits Against Reward Hacking in GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains on cheap checks, such as unit tests, that a policy can learn to game, while a stronger check is too expensive to run on every rollout. We study how to spend a limited strong-verifier budget in GRPO, separating which weakly passing rollouts to audit from what reward a caught hack receives. At a fixed policy state with centered advantages, the expected update depends on a design only through each rollout's marginal audit probability and correction; reflecting a caught hack's reward about the failure reward negates the advantages of an all-hack group; and auditing whole groups with the fewest weak passes first (low-pass budgeted audits, LB) minimizes the advantage mass left on hacks among pass-count designs with a fixed correction when a label's value falls with the pass count. We tested this analysis in actual LLM training: from each run's starting state, the sign of this mass on a frozen panel predicted whether hacking would be suppressed in 33 of 39 runs, including 13 of 16 preregistered ones. In LeetCode (Wong et al., 2026) and Countdown-Code (Khalifa et al., 2026), LB drives hacking to near zero, while random audits with the same penalty and budget do not and use more labels. We also find that the randomness of the update affects training: in Countdown-Code, two unbiased corrections, per-item reward-level IPW and a group-level advantage correction, bring hacking down too but end 6.1-11.8 and 8.0-11.5 points lower in held-out accuracy than LB at the same budget. A full audit, which the group-level correction reproduces in expectation, stays within about two points of LB in three seeds, while LB uses 28% of its labels, and allocating the same correction by pass count recovers most of the loss (one seed). Training outcomes thus depend not only on the expected update but also on the randomness of its estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在GRPO中如何分配有限的强验证器审计预算，将"审计哪些弱通过轨迹"与"被抓作弊者给予什么奖励"两设计分开分析，提出按弱通过数最少优先整组审计（LB）策略，并发现训练结果不仅取决于期望更新也取决于其随机性。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励RL用廉价检查（如单元测试），策略易学会钻空子；更强的验证器太贵无法对每个rollout运行，因此需研究如何在GRPO中高效花费有限强验证预算。
AI.method: 在固定策略状态下用中心化优势推导：期望更新仅通过每条rollout的边际审计概率与修正项影响设计；分析把被抓作弊奖励反射到失败奖励可抵消全作弊组优势；证明在固定修正且标签价值随通过数下降时，按弱通过数最少优先整组审计（low-pass budgeted audits, LB）最小化作弊上的优势质量。随后在真实LLM训练中验证，比较LB、随机审计、两种无偏修正（per-item reward-level IPW与group-level advantage correction）及全审计。
AI.result: 冻结面板上该优势质量的符号预测作弊是否被抑制，39次运行中33次正确（含16次预注册中的13次）。在LeetCode与Countdown-Code中LB将作弊降至接近零，同预算同惩罚的随机审计不能且用更多标签。Countdown-Code中两种无偏修正虽也降低作弊，但留出准确率比LB低6.1–11.8与8.0–11.5分；全审计在三个种子内与LB差距约两点而LB仅用28%标签。
AI.conclusion: 训练结果不仅取决于期望更新，还取决于其估计的随机性；LB在固定预算下既有效抑制作弊又保持准确率，是一种高效且低标签成本的审计分配方式。

title: Metric Scale for Insta360 Structure-from-Motion from the Camera's Embedded IMU
summary: Structure-from-motion (SfM) from the dual-fisheye video of a consumer 360-degree camera recovers geometry only up to a similarity transform; in the pipeline considered here, metric scale is obtained from smartphone ARKit or ARCore poses captured alongside the camera. This paper evaluates a self-contained alternative: the IMU embedded in the Insta360 X5 and X6, recorded at 1 kHz. The sensor is characterised (noise density, camera-IMU synchronisation, accelerometer scale factor, bias stability), the camera-IMU rotation and frame timing are estimated from the data, and the scale is recovered by a linear visual-inertial alignment over the SfM poses of a whole survey. The standard formulation, with gravity and accelerometer bias shared across the survey, overestimates the scale by 3.4% on average; estimating each contiguous segment independently and averaging removes the bias. On nine surveys with a co-mounted LiDAR scanner the inertial scale deviates from the LiDAR by 0.74% in mean absolute error, against 1.94% for the smartphone scale; on printed fiducial markers both agree within the 1% uncertainty of the target. On the reference trajectories of thirty sequences of a public benchmark, brought to scales of 1/40, 1 and 40, the estimator recovers the metric scale with a mean error of -0.07% and a standard deviation of 1.28%. On fifty production surveys where the smartphone is the only reference, the two scales agree to a standard deviation of 2.6%, the inertial scale being 0.9% lower on average; the difference does not depend on window construction, grows with the extent of the smartphone anchor, and cannot be attributed to either reference. An ablation over window construction and a comparison with monocular metric-depth networks complete the study.

AI.tldr: 用 Insta360 X5/X6 内置 IMU（1 kHz）替代手机 ARKit/ARCore 提供双目鱼眼 360 相机 SfM 的度量尺度，在 LiDAR 参照下误差 0.74%，优于手机的 1.94%。
AI.motivation: 消费级 360 相机做 SfM 只能恢复相似变换，尺度需外部来源；现有做法依赖同步采集的手机 AR 位姿，作者希望验证相机内置 IMU 能否构成自包含的替代方案。
AI.method: 先标定传感器（噪声密度、相机-IMU 同步、加速度计尺度因子、零偏稳定性），估计相机-IMU 旋转与帧时序，再对整段测绘的 SfM 位姿做线性视觉-惯性对齐求解尺度；针对全局共享重力与零偏导致 3.4% 高估的问题，改为分段独立估计后平均。
AI.result: 九组搭载 LiDAR 的测绘中，惯性尺度平均绝对误差 0.74%，手机尺度 1.94%；打印靶标上两者都在 1% 目标不确定度内。公开基准 30 条序列缩放到 1/40、1、40 时，平均误差 -0.07%、标准差 1.28%。50 组仅有手机参照的生产测绘中两者标准差 2.6%，惯性尺度平均低 0.9%。
AI.conclusion: 内置 IMU 可独立提供实用精度的度量尺度并优于手机 AR 位姿；但与手机尺度间约 0.9% 的系统差异随手机锚点范围增大而增大，无法归因于任一参照，提示存在尚未解释的尺度来源；另完成窗口构造消融与单目度量深度网络对比。

title: Quantifying the failure of symmetry learning in linear diffusion models due to initialization and finite-sample effects
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
summary: Data distributions often possess one or more symmetries: for example, all orientations of any specific dog are included in the distribution of all possible dog pictures. Despite the omnipresence of such symmetries, modern generative modeling approaches may fail to incorporate or learn them, which can lead to lower sample efficiency and poorer generalization. To what extent do diffusion models fail to learn data distribution symmetries, and what sources of symmetry breaking are most responsible? Here, we answer this question in the theoretically tractable setting of linear diffusion models. We show that of three potential sources of symmetry breaking---a non-symmetric initial weight matrix, a noisy learning target, and finite-sample noise---target noise produces the most robust symmetry breaking, since it persists even in the sample-rich regime. Using local laws from random matrix theory, we derive formulas for average symmetry error in fairly general cases involving symmetry within a subspace and show that smaller symmetries are harder to learn.

AI.tldr: 在可解析的线性扩散模型框架下，论文发现三种对称性破坏来源中"目标噪声"最稳健，并推导了平均对称性误差的公式，指出更小的对称性更难被学习。
AI.motivation: 数据分布常具有对称性（如任意旋转的狗），但现代生成模型（如扩散模型）可能无法学习这些对称性，导致样本效率低、泛化差。作者希望明确扩散模型在多大程度上无法学习数据分布对称性，以及哪一种对称性破坏来源最应负责。
AI.method: 采用理论上可处理的线性扩散模型设定，比较三种潜在对称性破坏来源：非对称初始权重矩阵、带噪学习目标和有限样本噪声。借助随机矩阵理论中的局部定律（local laws），推导了一般情形（包括子空间内对称）下平均对称性误差的公式。
AI.result: 目标噪声导致最强的对称性破坏，即使在样本丰富的情形下仍持续存在；而初始权重非对称和有限样本噪声在样本充足时可被缓解。推导出的公式还表明，更小的对称性（子空间维度或对称群规模较小）更难被学习。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的对称性学习失败主要源于目标噪声而非样本量不足，且对称性规模越小越难学习；这为设计更善用数据对称性的生成模型提供了理论指引。

title: Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying
summary: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.

AI.tldr: CaD（Copying-as-Defense）通过在早期DiT block中最大化目标token对参考图的注意力，诱导编辑器"复制"而非"编辑"输入图像，将平均编辑成功率从81.4%降至24.0%。
AI.motivation: 基于DiT的图像编辑器（如Flux Kontext）可将单张照片改成有害或未经同意的操纵图像。现有主动防御思路是让输出"少关注"受保护的参考图，但这样模型仍会依文本和已生成的token继续编辑，产出弱关联的新图像，无法真正阻止编辑。
AI.method: 作者通过受控注意力干预发现，只需在少数早期block中把目标token注意力集中到参考图上，就能瓦解编辑行为，使模型复现（往往是带损的）输入。据此提出CaD：在早期transformer block中最大化逐token的目标-参考注意力质量；由于注意力行经过归一化，提升参考注意力会自然压制文本和生成画布的注意力份额。仅作用于早期block还可截断反向传播路径，降低优化成本。
AI.result: 在多种编辑器和基准上，CaD将平均编辑成功率从无保护图像的81.4%降到24.0%（相对降低70.6%），并相对最强基线DeContext（43.0%）再降低44.3%。每步优化速度约为同类方法的1.8–2.0倍。
AI.conclusion: "引导复制"而非"引导忽略"是保护DiT上下文编辑器的更优防御范式，CaD兼顾效果与效率。

title: Hyperspectral Unmixing using a Structured Linear Mixing Model with Additive Spectral Variability
summary: Linear hyperspectral unmixing aims at retrieving pure material spectra present in an observed scene and their associated abundance fractions in each pixel. In most practical situations, hyperspectral images are affected by spectral variability (SV) also known as intra-class variability, which is caused by different physical phenomena including atmospheric effects, intrinsic variability of the pure materials and illumination or topographic changes. Nevertheless, the standard hyperspectral unmixing methods that rely on the Linear Mixing Model (LMM) do not consider these phenomena. Thus, neglecting them will spread errors throughout the linear hyperspectral unmixing process. To avoid this problem, this paper proposes two hyperspectral unmixing algorithms dedicated to a parametric model called Structured Additive Variability LMM (SAV-LMM). This mixing model handles SV in an additive manner by incorporating two terms into the standard LMM. Moreover, the designed algorithms are based on Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and optimize a cost function which integrates additional penalization accounting for SV. Furthermore, a novel improved initialization scheme, which takes SV into account, is proposed. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for linearly unmixing hyperspectral images with SV compared to the tested state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该文针对线性高光谱解混中的光谱变异性(光谱类内变异)问题，基于结构化加性变异线性混合模型(SAV-LMM)提出两种NMF解混算法，并设计考虑SV的初始化方案，在合成与真实数据上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 实际高光谱图像普遍受光谱变异性(SV)影响（大气效应、纯物质内在变异、光照/地形变化），而标准基于LMM的解混方法忽略这些现象，导致误差在整个解混流程中传播。
AI.method: 面向参数化模型SAV-LMM（在标准LMM中以加性方式引入两个变异项），基于非负矩阵分解设计两种解混算法，优化含SV附加惩罚项的目标函数；并提出考虑SV的改进初始化方案。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实数据集上的实验表明，所提算法在存在SV的线性高光谱解混任务中优于所对比的现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将SV以加性结构显式建模并融入NMF解混框架（含惩罚项与初始化），可有效缓解SV带来的误差传播，提升线性高光谱解混性能。

title: TRACE: Memory-Efficient Time Series Class-Incremental Learning via Temporal-Spectral Reconstruction
summary: Web-connected sensing applications continuously generate multivariate time series with evolving behavioral categories, making Time Series Class-Incremental Learning (TSCIL) essential for adapting to new classes without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. However, preserving diverse and evolving class distributions under strict privacy and memory constraints remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches often face a trade-off between retaining sufficient historical knowledge for accurate recognition and minimizing the memory required for continual adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a memory-efficient, replay-free framework that preserves class-specific knowledge through generative modeling rather than sample rehearsal. TRACE employs a compact, frozen temporal-spectral representation and lightweight class-specific autoencoders to capture complex intra-class variations. By independently preserving each class model, TRACE avoids recursive generation and catastrophic forgetting, while enabling direct classification through reconstruction-based scoring without retaining historical samples or large statistical matrices. Extensive experiments across five TSCIL benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE achieves competitive classification accuracy while reducing mean retained memory by approximately 98.26% compared with TS-ACL, the strongest evaluated analytical baseline, and achieving an approximately 33.43% relative improvement in accuracy on GrabMyo.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE——一种无需回放的记忆高效时间序列类增量学习框架，用类特定自编码器保留类知识，在五个基准上保持竞争力精度的同时将记忆降低约98.26%。
AI.motivation: Web传感应用产生不断演化类别标签的多变量时间序列，TSCIL需在适应新类的同时不忘旧知识；但在严格隐私与内存约束下，现有方法在“保留足够历史知识以保证识别精度”与“最小化持续适应所需内存”之间存在权衡难题。
AI.method: TRACE采用紧凑且冻结的时序-频谱表示，配合轻量级类特定自编码器刻画类内复杂变化；通过独立保留每个类模型避免递归生成与灾难性遗忘，并基于重构误差打分实现直接分类，无需保存历史样本或大型统计矩阵（无回放）。
AI.result: 在五个TSCIL基准上，TRACE取得有竞争力的分类精度；相比最强分析基线TS-ACL，平均保留内存降低约98.26%，并在GrabMyo上取得约33.43%的相对精度提升。
AI.conclusion: TRACE表明基于生成建模的类特定表征可在无回放、低内存条件下有效缓解TSCIL的稳定性-可塑性权衡，是一种适用于隐私受限场景的记忆高效持续学习方案。

title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Self-Supervised Representation Forcing for Few-Step Video Generation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sotamak1r.github.io/SF2-web/
summary: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry. This formulation forces the student to predict the teacher's internal representations from a more corrupted input, effectively integrating self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SF$^2$ effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic - seamlessly supporting both bidirectional and causal models - and requires no external feature extractors, introducing minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出Self Flow Forcing (SF²)，在分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)框架中加入预测式表征损失，用异构噪声水平构建信息不对称，让学生从更受损的输入预测EMA教师的内部表征，提升少步视频扩散模型的时空质量。
AI.motivation: DMD是少步视频扩散蒸馏的有力范式，但仅依赖输出空间目标，缺乏对内部表征的显式正则；当蒸馏步数极少时，这种纯输出监督不足，导致学生模型在细粒度空间结构和时序动态一致性上退化（闪烁等）。
AI.method: SF²在不改变DMD原有输出目标的前提下引入预测式表征损失：给学生和EMA教师施加不同噪声水平以形成信息不对称，迫使学生从更受损的输入预测教师的内部表征，从而将自监督表征对齐融入分布匹配。方法架构无关，支持双向与因果模型，且无需外部特征提取器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SF²有效缓解时序闪烁，并持续提升空间保真度与运动质量；机制对不同架构（双向、因果）通用，计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 通过补充内部表征层面的监督，SF²弥补了DMD纯输出空间目标的不足，是一种通用、低开销的少步视频扩散蒸馏增强方案。

title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
comment: 30 pages. To appear at NeurIPS 2026 (extended version)
summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.

AI.tldr: 论文针对多目标强化学习中目标冲突导致按偏好学策略样本效率低的问题，提出目标冲突系数、路由集成策略学习算法和核代理轨迹归因算法，在Meta-World/MO-Gymnasium上平均性能提升4.3%，归因与LOO相关性提升50%，轨迹选择奖励提升27%。
AI.motivation: 多目标RL需平衡如帮助性vs诚实、速度vs能耗等冲突目标；最优策略随权重组合剧烈变化，变化程度取决于目标冲突程度，导致逐偏好学习样本效率低。作者希望量化错配对学习效率的影响，并缓解目标冲突。
AI.method: 1) 定义目标冲突系数并据此推导在线设置的近优regret界；2) 设计路由集成策略学习（routed ensemble policy learning）：维护少量基策略，动态将轨迹路由到潜在奖励最高的策略；3) 将轨迹选择视为缓解冲突的另一手段，设计核代理轨迹归因（kernel surrogate trajectory attribution），估计轨迹反馈对其他轨迹策略学习的影响，可刻画协同与拮抗等非线性交互。
AI.result: Meta-World与MO-Gymnasium在线环境中，路由集成较基线平均性能提升4.3%；核代理归因与leave-one-out分析的相关性较现有基线提升50%；用于轨迹选择时，基于核归因的方法奖励较基线归因方法提升27%。
AI.conclusion: 目标冲突是可量化的学习效率瓶颈；路由集成与轨迹选择（核归因引导）是两种有效缓解手段，实验验证其在性能、归因准确性和轨迹选择效率上的优势。

title: Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction
comment: 34 pages, including 5 pages of Supplementary Methods; 10 main-text figures and 1 supplementary figure
summary: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.

AI.tldr: 该文提出合成可变形管状基准（Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark），基于开源工具LumenMorph生成5580张RGB图像，提供相机位姿、几何、深度、形变场及材料对应等标注，用于评估可变形3D重建。
